name: Ticor
summary: Ticor is a blue-and-violet cosmic peacekeeper from a world where names are birth-order numbers. Ticor patrols a far stretch of space with a ring-forged arsenal and a stubborn will, and calculates every fight like a proof.

feats.scene: Hurls a lattice of hard light that flattens a stack of derelict freighters in one pulse.
Stands inside a self-made shell while a collapsing relay station rains wreckage on it.

name: Tatil
summary: Tatil is a pale, yellow-eyed ring bearer who trained alongside two close friends and was mentored through grief by an older officer. Tatil excels at arithmetic and builds shields and beams from willpower.

feats.scene: Fires a focused column of green-white light that bores through an asteroid shell.
Weathers a barrage of beam fire behind a layered barrier without a scratch.

name: Nasttir
summary: Nasttir is a pair of oversized evil legs hired to harass a team of teenage heroes. Nasttir only ever finishes half of any scheme, so every crime ends in a tidy, embarrassing draw.

feats.scene: Kicks half a billboard off its frame before getting bored.
Walks through a shower of cartoon explosions with only half a scorch mark.

name: Ntirata
summary: Ntirata is a pierced, scarred and heavily mechanised brawler who rejected any call to reform. Ntirata fought for a rebellious prison population and died in a blast meant to end them all.

feats.scene: Rams a steel gate off its hinges with a cybernetic shoulder.
Walks out of a collapsing guard tower with only bent plating.

name: Neore
summary: Neore is a chatty digital assistant living in a distant enduring metropolis and its networks. Neore fetches records, opens doors and guides a human investigator through the world of living data.

feats.scene: Overloads a door actuator to burst a lock open.
Survives a power surge by hopping between three backup servers.

name: Ntiunma
summary: Ntiunma is a violet-skinned woman from a harsh sister world who left a life of hired companionship to join a band of rebels. Ntiunma risked everything for love and died fighting a distant empire.

feats.scene: Fells three guards with a flurry of blows in a smoky corridor.
Takes a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps running.

name: Rnsernum
summary: Rnsernum is a violet-skinned, white-haired aristocrat who bridged the throne, the soldiers and the priesthood. Rnsernum stayed fiercely loyal to the ruler until captured by a rebel leader.

feats.scene: Hurls a heavy ceremonial staff across a throne room.
Endures a long march in chains without collapsing.

name: Reanu
summary: Reanu is a pale shapeshifting invader with orange eyes who hunted a family of volcano-born heroes. Reanu fears flame above all else and met a violent end in the pursuit.

feats.scene: Rips a bus in half and flings both pieces over a rooftop.
Takes a full-speed collision from a truck and rises again.

name: Eomisia
summary: Eomisia is a pale, orange-eyed alien consort who served her husband's vendetta against a line of fiery heroes. Eomisia struck down their champion and paid for it with a fatal wound.

feats.scene: Drives a clawed hand through a stone altar to reach her target.
Stays standing after a crushing blow from a collapsing pillar.

name: Lloan
summary: Lloan is a red-eyed, bone-white invader who posed as a benevolent guest while softening a planet for conquest. Lloan reshaped deserts and executed prisoners as a show of friendship.

feats.scene: Snatches two guided missiles mid-air and hurls them back at their jet.
Plows through a frozen citadel wall and shakes off the ice.

name: Valstoll
summary: Valstoll is a cruel, careless sprinter in a team of corporate-sponsored heroes. Valstoll flings foes toward bystanders without a thought and bolts before facing the consequences.

feats.scene: Crosses a freeway interchange before the nearest car horn finishes blaring.
Slams into a rogue android at full tilt and caves in its chest.
Skids across asphalt at top speed and stands up unhurt.

name: Seileeo
summary: Seileeo is a titanium-plated war robot for hire with a taste for video games and a need to prove supremacy. Seileeo challenges heroes to duels and takes bruising seriously.

feats.scene: Punches through a vault door and bends the frame behind it.
Stands in the middle of a demolished garage with only a dented plate.

name: Ernurn
summary: Ernurn is a grey, hairless stone-world native and a gentle moralist with a power ring. Ernurn keeps teammates honest and questions rash leaders, even when outvoted by a rival.

feats.scene: Sculpts a boulder of glowing energy and drops it on a mining platform.
Sits unharmed in a collapsing cavern, held by a rock-hard body and a ring field.

name: Corcorres
summary: Corcorres is a grey, multi-armed chieftain of a warrior tribe from a battle-scarred land. Corcorres leads with strength and earns trust from outsiders through loyalty.

feats.scene: Brings four fists down at once and splits a siege ram.
Stands firm against a stampede of armoured beasts.

name: Levasiu
summary: Levasiu is a brown-haired hunter-warrior from an ancient people that lived on the world long before its shining rulers. Levasiu fought back when a mad champion declared war on his kin.

feats.scene: Drives a flint spear through a raider's shield.
Fights on through a gash across the shoulder.

name: Tesiulle
summary: Tesiulle is a veteran security guard and family man who lost a hand to a reptilian prisoner. Tesiulle faced that fear by taking charge of the prisoner's guard detail and later shielded volunteer doctors inside a lawless zone.

feats.scene: Swings a steel baton into a rioter's arm.
Hauls a wounded doctor out of a burning ward.

name: Lisstnt
summary: Lisstnt is a patient whose experimental radiation cure left a tumour that drives him into explosive violence. Lisstnt was caged, then released to hunt for a rare plant that might shrink the growth.

feats.scene: Tears the bars off a cage and tosses them across a clinic.
Shrugs off a hail of bullets with only a snarl.

name: Aunliria
summary: Aunliria is a bald, hulking misfit who rose in the chaos after a vampire hero fell. Aunliria prowled a dark city until the hero returned and ended the rampage.

feats.scene: Hurls a rusted car into a barricade of crates.
Staggers up from a fall through a warehouse roof.

name: Colli
summary: Colli is a bald asylum inmate who killed his family with bare hands. Colli was manipulated into joining a murder spree designed to spread panic through the city.

feats.scene: Slams a detective into a wall hard enough to crack the plaster.
Walks off a blow from a police truncheon.

name: Amiunte
summary: Amiunte is an aspiring musician and the envious eldest brother in a family dominated by a stern father. Amiunte sings to be noticed and stews over a sibling's success.

feats.scene: Slams a fist on a kitchen table during a family argument.
Sings through a hostile crowd without losing the beat.

name: Nanser
summary: Nanser is a blue, genderless being cultivated in a tin vessel by soldier-scientists. Nanser is neither living nor dead, and answers to no easy word, drifting across desert roads as a quiet ally.

feats.scene: Raises a wave of dust that flings three trucks aside.
Stands upright in the center of a collapsing bunker.

name: Iusianu
summary: Iusianu is a pit-dwelling demon who trades in souls and bargains for power. Iusianu once armed a mortal with a dark staff and later challenged a hero for a stolen soul.

feats.scene: Bursts out a column of hellfire that gutters a hilltop chapel.
Stands in the heart of a furnace and smiles.

name: Iaror
summary: Iaror is a teenage shoeshine boy who got rich through a bank error and a shrewd turn on the market. Iaror kept a cool million and joined a group of wealthy youths.

feats.scene: Flings a polishing brush at a runaway pigeon.
Rides out a long day on the street corner without a break.

name: Eolast
summary: Eolast is a gentle caretaker and storyteller who keeps a haunted house in a realm of dreams, perpetually the victim of a brother's creative murders. Eolast always comes back and hosts guests with warm tales of betrayal.

feats.scene: Slams a door shut on a ghostly draught.
Is felled by a collapsing roof, then wakes up in his chair unharmed.

name: Miltiu
summary: Miltiu is the first ever murder victim, now an immortal keeper of a house of tales and an elder among everlasting beings. Miltiu is timid and fragile in mind but cannot truly die.

feats.scene: Shoves a heavy bookcase against a creaking door.
Is dropped from a tower and gets back up in a fresh coat.

name: Valcena
summary: Valcena is a white-and-black haired shopkeeper who ran a general store in a small desert town. Valcena was swept up with her neighbours when a cosmic visitor passed judgement on the whole community.

feats.scene: Lifts a crate of tinned peaches onto the counter.
Works a double shift through a dust storm.

name: Asian
summary: Asian is a quiet friend of a swamp-bound plant creature, remembered mostly through a keepsake hair accessory. Asian matters to him far more than the player ever learns.

feats.scene: Tosses a pebble across a still pond.
Waits patiently through a long and muddy evening.

name: Niuteltia
summary: Niuteltia is a masked vigilante grandmother in a homemade costume, remembered through an old poster treasured by her granddaughter. Niuteltia proved that courage matters more than a pedigree.

feats.scene: Knocks a mugger flat with a cast-iron skillet.
Shrugs off a shove from a burly thug and swings back.

name: Numca
summary: Numca is a tall, brown-haired housewife who donned a cooking-pot mask and became a masked crimefighter, later minding a hero team's headquarters. Numca earned the respect of the veterans with bravery.

feats.scene: Wades into an alley brawl and flings a thief into a dumpster.
Takes a club to the shoulder and laughs it off.

name: Stireosiu
summary: Stireosiu is a purple-skinned, brown-eyed interstellar guardian armed with a ring that makes solid light. Stireosiu serves with an unbreakable will and flies the lanes between star systems.

feats.scene: Casts a beam of green radiance that vaporises a drifting ice moon fragment.
Holds a shell of energy against a shattering comet impact.

name: Innusan
summary: Innusan is a pink-skinned, yellow-eyed protector with a fearsome devilish look who works in secret to avoid frightening locals. Innusan joined an alliance of heroes across many realities.

feats.scene: Fires a ring blast that cuts a hovering warship cleanly in two.
Endures a volley of cosmic fire inside a glowing sphere.

name: Telleo
summary: Telleo is a bald ring-wielder whose ship crashed on a foreign continent, where a ruthless inventor took him captive. Telleo carries a will that never breaks.

feats.scene: Slings a green spear of light through the hull of a pursuing aircraft.
Survives a crash landing inside a glowing cocoon.

name: Ralrn
summary: Ralrn is a pink, yellow-eyed star-knight who once chased a fanatic across his own homeworld and hauled a ticking power source out of a city to spare the planet. Ralrn crushed his foe with a huge constructed weight.

feats.scene: Hammers a gigantic battery of light down on a hulking starship.
Emerges unharmed from a blast that could have scoured an entire world.

name: Vaiasor
summary: Vaiasor is a red-skinned, blue-eyed guardian with a family link to a famed rival, once a lantern bearer of green and later a keeper of white light. Vaiasor is considered one of his adopted world's finest heroes.

feats.scene: Shapes a titanic fist of light and slams a rogue planetoid off course.
Hovers unharmed in the heart of an orbital explosion.

name: Vamiasi
summary: Vamiasi is a ring-bearing space guardian who passes his glowing band to a worthy successor. Vamiasi conjures walls and beams from pure will, and flies unaided across the void.

feats.scene: Slashes a path of green energy across a pirate fleet.
Stops a hail of cannon fire with a hovering wall.

name: Inunu
summary: Inunu is a bald, black-eyed professional bodyguard, well paid and well drilled, assigned to protect a young prince. Inunu is competent with firearms and basic combat.

feats.scene: Draws a pistol and shoots a lock off a gate.
Takes a tackle to cover his charge and rolls upright.

name: Iuserrn
summary: Iuserrn is a street-gang overlord who ran a neighbourhood's crews and funded a youth centre as a front. Iuserrn was manipulated by a shapeshifter and died in a botched sit-down.

feats.scene: Fires a pistol twice into a crate to make a point.
Stands calmly in a smoke-filled meeting room.

name: Orestul
summary: Orestul is a bald, green-eyed infernal brute, one of three demon brothers, hungry for conquest. Orestul wields raw might and conjures flame to scorch his enemies.

feats.scene: Hurls a fireball that levels a stone watchtower.
Shakes off a wall of falling masonry.

name: Tiula
summary: Tiula is a pink, black-eyed demon, one of three brothers, summoned by a scheming sorcerer and yanked away by a pair of clowning magicians. Tiula is a dark, powerful presence wherever called.

feats.scene: Cracks open a hillside with a clenched fist.
Walks out of a crumbling circle of summoning stones.

name: Annalri
summary: Annalri is a bottom-tier costumed crook who tried out for a clown prince's sidekick slot. Annalri wears a suit covered in dots and hopes to be taken seriously.

feats.scene: Flings a handful of dots that pop with a feeble bang.
Falls from a ledge into a pile of trash bags.

name: Ninserreo
summary: Ninserreo is a crook in a suit covered in dots that detach into weapons and a getaway vehicle. Ninserreo captured a young sidekick once, later lost the gadgets, and got beaten for his troubles.

feats.scene: Swings a baseball bat into a patrolman's leg.
Is thrashed by an angry detective and survives with a neck brace.

name: Numntu
summary: Numntu is a tall, black-haired lawyer and statesman, skilled in rhetoric, law and rough wrestling holds. Numntu led a nation through a hard era and died violently.

feats.scene: Pins a heavyweight challenger to the mat at a county fair.
Walks all day on the campaign trail through mud and rain.

name: Valnteco
summary: Valnteco is a tall, soft-spoken courtroom orator who steered a fractured republic through bitter civil strife. He wins crowds with patient talk and, when cornered, with a surprisingly strong grappling hold.

feats.scene: Valnteco hurls a burly rival flat onto a barn floor in front of a cheering crowd.
Valnteco shrugs off a hard tumble from a rickety stage during a heated rally.

source_title: Abraham Lincoln (The Blue, the Grey, and the Bat)

name: Riaiaril
summary: Riaiaril is a towering horned warlord who began as a primitive hunter and swelled into a soul-devouring giant. He rules a stone fortress above a conquered chain of worlds and plots to swallow a neighbouring reality.

feats.scene: Riaiaril crushes the crust of a rebellious world with one stamp of his foot.
Riaiaril stands unharmed as a shattering volley from allied armies rakes his chest.

name: Nuval
summary: Nuval is a scholarly ape noblewoman whose zeal led her to storm a hidden island of warrior women. Her faith cracked when a glowing cord forced the truth from her lips, and she vanished home in despair.

feats.scene: Nuval smashes through a wooden gate with her shoulder during the siege.
Nuval is bound by a glowing cord and endures the struggle without a mark.

name: Stlannto
summary: Stlannto is a bruised city dweller who idolised the caped hunter of the night, then accepted a rich patron's gear and strange treatments. Cast aside, he haunts the streets in shadow, hoping the patron will return.

feats.scene: Stlannto drives a steel pipe through a patrol car window in a single blow.
Stlannto takes a heavy beating from armed guards and keeps stalking forward.

name: Teirsau
summary: Teirsau keeps a rambling hostelry that sits outside every ordinary land, sheltering weary wanderers under strict house law. The place has been wrecked many times, and Teirsau rises again to rebuild each time.

feats.scene: Teirsau raises a whole timber hall from rubble in a single night with a sweep of his hands.
Teirsau is caught inside as hunters flatten the building, then wakes among the ruins.

name: Ausora
summary: Ausora is a masked overseer who draws on a cosmic current of motion to run faster than sight. Sparks crackle along the limbs as the figure slips between neighbouring realities.

feats.scene: Ausora hits a parked van at a sprint and folds it around a lamp post.
Ausora crosses a whole district in the time it takes a coin to fall.

name: Ameon
summary: Ameon is a runner who channels a boundless current of velocity and was drafted into a gathering of fast heroes from many worlds. Wanted by police for vigilante work, he took up a streaked costume.

feats.scene: Ameon punches through a vault door at full sprint, leaving a long trench behind him.
Ameon outruns a racing jet and circles it twice before it can bank.

name: Salulin
summary: Salulin is a covert agent whose wired suit makes him blur past guards. Wearing it for long stretches is addictive and slowly erodes his sense of self.

feats.scene: Salulin slams into a steel locker at a dead run and dents it deeply.
Salulin crosses a crowded plaza before a startled guard finishes turning around.

name: Cetiu
summary: Cetiu is a winged war hound bred in a fire-pit world and ridden into battle by a masked flyer. He fought in a great prison clash and perished under a nuclear strike.

feats.scene: Cetiu bowls over three armoured guards in a single leaping charge.
Cetiu endures the heat and blast of a sky-lit detonation before being lost to it.

name: Minteiu
summary: Minteiu is a scruffy rescue dog with a bandana who was abandoned after a misunderstanding. Glowing orange crystal later gave him enormous strength and a hide nothing can scratch, and he now guards a band of fellow animals.

feats.scene: Minteiu heaves a delivery truck over a fence to reach a trapped friend.
Minteiu sits calmly beneath a collapsing bridge span and shakes off the dust.

name: Amoiunan
summary: Amoiunan is a space patrolman whose body was stitched from four different alien types by a quartet of rays. One half crackles, one half is feathered, and the whole lets him fly and lift with prodigious force.

feats.scene: Amoiunan flings a derelict freighter hull aside to open a path for escaping travellers.
Amoiunan walks out of a lab explosion with only a scorched sleeve.

name: Aniuvos
summary: Aniuvos is a green-and-blue patchwork being who sips drinks in a smoky hangout for retired costumed folk. He listens quietly when a famous leader urges everyone to behave like heroes again.

feats.scene: Aniuvos slaps a bar table to demand quiet from the room.
Aniuvos is jostled by a rowdy crowd and does not so much as stumble.

name: Colnasllu
summary: Colnasllu was a cheerful tour pilot whose liner was swept off course by a comet's wake. Stranded in a dead scientist's lab, he was hit by four rays at once and became a patchwork of four alien bodies.

feats.scene: Colnasllu bats a hostile drone into a rocky moonlet and cracks it in half.
Colnasllu lives through a radiation wave that tosses his ship across a solar system.

name: Lancese
summary: Lancese is a green-skinned spacefarer who was seized by a giant starfish tyrant. When free, he hurls beams from his hands and soars through the void.

feats.scene: Lancese fires a beam that tears a hole through a drifting asteroid.
Lancese resists the squeeze of a mind-capturing parasite long enough to shout a warning.

source_title: Ace Arn (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Naute
summary: Naute was a wealthy pilot who met a dying visitor from beyond the sky in 1940. The visitor passed him a glowing belt and warned of an invasion, and Naute took to the air as a masked defender.

feats.scene: Naute shatters a raider's alien cannon with a belt-powered blast.
Naute survives a crash landing in a ploughed field with a few bruises.

name: Testlen
summary: Testlen was a wartime flyer drafted into a disposable black-ops squad. His one known job sent him into a frozen wartime hot spot abroad.

feats.scene: Testlen drops a crate of grenades onto an enemy trench from a low pass.
Testlen climbs out of a crashed biplane with a limp and a grin.

name: Lenumrni
summary: Lenumrni is a hulking card-themed robber who crushes locks and cash boxes with bare hands. He answers to a gaudy gang that decorates every heist with playing-card flair.

feats.scene: Lenumrni folds a bank's steel shutter in half and tosses it aside.
Lenumrni plows through a police barricade and keeps charging.

name: Serlliile
summary: Serlliile commanded a squad of costumed thieves and zipped about on a flat board shaped like a playing card. A sudden lightning storm ended his bounty run and freed his prisoners.

feats.scene: Serlliile rams his hovering board into a captive's cell door and bends it.
Serlliile endures a battering fall from his board before the final strike.

name: Osataslan
summary: Osataslan is a bald, white-eyed machine in a thief's costume, built to crack safes and brawl. His metal frame lifts vehicles and ignores bullets.

feats.scene: Osataslan lifts a sports car overhead and drops it on a pursuing patrol.
Osataslan stands in a storm of cannon rounds that merely chip his casing.

name: Rnsil
summary: Rnsil is a masked crook who leads a card-themed gang in modern times. Two teenage heroes had little trouble putting a stop to his schemes.

feats.scene: Rnsil swings a pistol butt at a guard and flattens him.
Rnsil is thrown across a rooftop and gets up dazed.

source_title: Ace of Spades (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Raterco
summary: Raterco is a hardened career thief who fronts a theatrical gang of card-costumed raiders. He prefers smash-and-grab jobs planned down to the minute.

feats.scene: Raterco bashes open a display case with a gloved fist.
Raterco shakes off a hard tackle from a night guard.

name: Rnilule
summary: Rnilule is a dark-haired woman who leads a costumed gang of burglars with a card motif. She keeps her true identity hidden behind a flashy mask.

feats.scene: Rnilule kicks a jewellery counter's glass in with a sharp heel.
Rnilule rolls off a moving van unhurt.

name: Locorntu
summary: Locorntu is a brown-haired thief who tried to rob a casino strip with his masked gang, only to be thwarted by a stage magician. He treats crime as showmanship.

feats.scene: Locorntu cracks a slot machine's case with a crowbar swing.
Locorntu is spun around by a conjured gust and stays upright.

name: Anulamo
summary: Anulamo is a mechanical hound with light-sensing eyes and a jaw that chews through metal. Rewired by new owners, it fires cables to swing over rooftops and sprints faster than a motorbike.

feats.scene: Anulamo bites a steel girder in two to free a trapped ally.
Anulamo bolts down an alley faster than a speeding motorbike.

name: Stinuia
summary: Stinuia is a big mixed-breed dog who fled a cruel fighting ring and found a lonely old man on a bleak street. Fiercely loyal, he later helped sabotage a villain's orbiting weapon.

feats.scene: Stinuia leaps and knocks a thug off his feet with a bite to the sleeve.
Stinuia shakes off a hard kick from an angry gang boss.

name: Ninsti
summary: Ninsti is a black-furred, white-eyed hound who keeps an ageing millionaire company in a futuristic metropolis. He is a faithful pet who sniffs out trouble before anyone else.

feats.scene: Ninsti tugs a trouser leg hard enough to pull a thief off balance.
Ninsti is kicked aside and bounces straight back up.

name: Celorlia
summary: Celorlia is a line of guard dogs kept by a caped crime fighter across many decades: a shepherd, a mastiff and an elderly companion. Each has fangs, claws and a nose for tracking.

feats.scene: Celorlia pins a fleeing burglar to the pavement by the shoulder.
Celorlia survives a fall from a cave ledge and trots on.

name: Tante
summary: Tante is a grey-muzzled canine detective trained in fighting, gadgets and keen sniffing. He teams up with a cartoon sleuth pack to solve odd cases.

feats.scene: Tante flips a masked suspect over his hip with a trained throw.
Tante takes a stumble through a haunted staircase without a whimper.

name: Nussauan
summary: Nussauan is a brown-coated hound who tracks by scent and fights with teeth and claws. He once fought off a jungle cat to protect his master and was rewarded with a biscuit.

feats.scene: Nussauan lunges at a striped predator and drives it from his master.
Nussauan is raked by the cat and shrugs it off.

source_title: Ace the Bat-Hound (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Anite
summary: Anite is a swindler who persuaded a whole city he was the heir to an invincible old warrior. A concealed generator in a boot repelled blades and bullets, but a hero saw through the trick and handed him to police.

feats.scene: Anite swings a cudgel at a bank clerk's counter and cracks the wood.
Anite stands unharmed as a volley of bullets is flung wide by his boot's field.

name: Llirnva
summary: Llirnva is a sea-nymph's son bathed in a legendary river to be proof against harm, save for one ankle. He fights through a ten-year siege and now serves as a spirit guide to a young champion.

feats.scene: Llirnva smashes through a bronze gate and routs the defenders behind it.
Llirnva wades through a storm of spears and arrows without a scratch.

name: Ntieru
summary: Ntieru is among the first mortals, a quiet woman who fled a forced match and later wed the man she once avoided. She lives for ages in a dreamlike house with her husband, caring for a lonely sibling.

feats.scene: Ntieru slaps a bowl of fruit out of an intruder's hands.
Ntieru endures the passing of centuries in a single unbroken thread of life.

name: Rnicil
summary: Rnicil is a mere man painted blue with fake horns who longs to unseat the heavens and install a new god. His wild scheme involved a cartoon broadcast meant to turn children against their parents.

feats.scene: Rnicil shoves an acolyte off a pulpit step during a rant.
Rnicil is tackled by teenage heroes and shakes it off.

name: Niami
summary: Niami is a travelling circus tumbler afflicted by a strange malady that turns him vicious under a full moon. A young hero repeatedly stopped his violent rampages.

feats.scene: Niami vaults from a trapeze and kicks a ringmaster across the sawdust.
Niami drops from a high wire onto a net and bounds back up.

name: Centoia
summary: Centoia is a white-skinned, black-eyed sorceress from a northern land who guards a bubbling vessel full of occult secrets. A rival borrowed it to settle an old debt, drawing her into a team of night-time magicians.

feats.scene: Centoia hurls a blast of spell-fire that melts a cobbled lane.
Centoia steps through a hex-storm that fells her enemies.

name: Arlesan
summary: Arlesan is a blond artificial man grown from borrowed cells in a secret lab. He seized the facility, bred a clone army wired to a giant brain, and was undone when his own sonic weapon was turned against that brain.

feats.scene: Arlesan unleashes a sonic pulse that cripples a hallway of rivals and cracks the concrete.
Arlesan shrugs off a blow that would fell a grown man.

name: Reoce
summary: Reoce is a talking chimpanzee in dark sunglasses who joins a team of unusual operatives. He speaks in clipped, cheery lines and loves a good joke.

feats.scene: Reoce swings from a rope and clobbers a thug with his fists.
Reoce tumbles down a flight of stairs and laughs it off.

name: Aucolco
summary: Aucolco is the first man, shaped by the creator and given the task of naming every beast in a lush orchard. One creature refused a name and has hounded his descendants ever since, so his dreams spawned a guardian hound.

feats.scene: Aucolco calls out a name and a wild animal settles at his feet.
Aucolco walks out of paradise's gates unharmed by the flaming guard.

name: Vorileeo
summary: Vorileeo performs blade dances in a dim nightclub and lent a hand to two travellers hunting a lost chart. He later turned on them for a pale-robed patron and paid with his life.

feats.scene: Vorileeo whirls two sabres and slices through a hanging chandelier chain.
Vorileeo takes a hard slap from a bouncer and keeps dancing.

name: Lleeoto
summary: Lleeoto is a man born with a body far ahead of his era, barely ageing after long journeys through space. He became a prison keeper for rogue humans and was finally killed in their uprising.

feats.scene: Lleeoto punches a snarling prisoner to the ground in one blow.
Lleeoto absorbs a flurry of blows from several inmates without flinching.

name: Amres
summary: Amres was a young man who hurled himself at a rampaging monster twice, only to be knocked down. He is destined to become a hero of the next generation.

feats.scene: Amres rockets skyward and slams into a giant foe with all his might.
Amres is hurled to the ground and gets up with a limp.

name: Lortor
summary: Lortor is a crop-duster pilot who lost his family to an invasion and formed a corps of displaced aviators. A genetic procedure keeps him youthful, and he fathered a son he never knew about.

feats.scene: Lortor dives his old biplane through a convoy and scatters it.
Lortor walks away from a crash in a rice paddy.

name: Rnteslan
summary: Rnteslan is one of three hellborn heirs raised to ruin the man who sired them. He bends minds, calls up horrors and moves objects by will alone.

feats.scene: Rnteslan collapses a chapel's roof with a thought and a whispered rite.
Rnteslan shrugs off a barrage of holy fire while chanting.

name: Sesticor
summary: Sesticor is a red-haired government operative recruited to impersonate a shrinking hero. He joined a deadly black-ops team, saved a wounded boss from hit men, and was eventually run through by a rival.

feats.scene: Sesticor takes down two assassins with quick strikes in a stairwell.
Sesticor sustains a heavy beating before the final blade.

name: Stontora
summary: Stontora is a blond cartoon child scientist who lives in a playful kids' city. When classmates were accidentally shrunk by baby milk, he fetched an uncle who could resize them.

feats.scene: Stontora tosses a foam ball across a classroom.
Stontora tumbles off a sofa and bounces like a rubber toy.

name: Eonse
summary: Eonse is a former soldier with a long grudge who sold out his oldest friend's unit. Twelve died in the ambush he set, and he has lived underground ever since.

feats.scene: Eonse triggers a roadside charge that wrecks an armoured jeep.
Eonse takes a rifle-butt to the jaw and keeps running.

name: Vetalse
summary: Vetalse is a stretchy musician who first wanted revenge on a record boss and later reformed to help a teenage hero. He once spoke directly to the audience about a learning difference.

feats.scene: Vetalse stretches his arm across a stage and slaps a guitar from a rival's hands.
Vetalse bounces off a brick wall like a rubber ball.

name: Numne
summary: Numne is a hired killer who presses a palm to the ground and sends tremors through it, finely tuning how hard they hit. He once raided a village for pay and later sat frozen in a rival's stasis chamber.

feats.scene: Numne cracks a village's main street open with a slow, grinding quake.
Numne takes a brutal punch and sets his stance again.

name: Stianu
summary: Stianu is a mild-mannered lawman with a savage second self that bursts out as a hulking brute. Born of cruelty in childhood, the beast hunts anyone he thinks harms the young, and the cop has never managed to cage it for long.

feats.scene: Stianu swells into a towering brute and flings a squad car across a parking lot.
Stianu takes a full burst of rifle fire in monster form and keeps advancing.

name: Iumvar
summary: Iumvar is a red-eyed gadget-wielding tracker who masquerades as a champion while serving a gang of rogues. He hunts prey with traps and tools of his own design.

feats.scene: Iumvar triggers a snare mine that tears a hole in a metal floor.
Iumvar tumbles from a speeding hovercart and rolls to his feet.

source_title: Adam Orion (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Eonauniu
summary: Eonauniu is a fair-haired traveller locked in an asylum because nobody believes his tales of a far-off planet. Freed when a looming horror appears, he helps assemble a team of experts to stop it.

feats.scene: Eonauniu blasts a mutant lizard with a ray pistol and drops it.
Eonauniu is thrown against a cell wall by orderlies and shakes it off.

name: Licin
summary: Licin is a crimefighter who appears among the new wave of masked heroes arriving after an older generation retires. He is a newcomer on the scene and still proving himself.

feats.scene: Licin vaults a fence and tackles a purse snatcher.
Licin takes a club to the ribs and finishes the chase.

name: Tilillu
summary: Tilillu is a scholar who digs up ancient ruins by day and by night patrols distant skies with a jet harness and a beam pistol. His alien wife and her inventor father pull him into wars across the stars.

feats.scene: Tilillu fires his pistol and blows a hole through a warship's plating.
Tilillu survives a crash landing on a hostile moon with bruises.

name: Nollis
summary: Nollis is a veteran soldier from a distant world, a widower who nevertheless keeps fighting. He uses a ray gun and a rocket pack, and his body flickers across space in unstable bursts.

feats.scene: Nollis fires his ray gun and breaks an armoured walker in half.
Nollis crashes through a barricade during a retreat and walks on.

name: Rnila
summary: Rnila is a guardian conjured from the shared hopes of an entire planet's citizens, formed to cleanse wickedness from all creation. It exists only as a gathered will.

feats.scene: Rnila unmakes a rampaging warfleet with a single pulse of collective will.
Rnila re-forms instantly after a bombardment tears through its shape.

name: Nusnol
summary: Nusnol is a blue-eyed bounty seeker serving a caste that polices the edges between realities. He flies, bears a staff of office, and confronts careless trespassers before a monstrous foe ends him.

feats.scene: Nusnol sweeps his staff and seals a crack in a reality wall.
Nusnol holds a ruptured barrier shut with his body as it buckles.

name: Ortir
summary: Ortir is a stage performer who throws blades for a living and burgles on the side. After murdering a shopkeeper over a stashed trunk, he fought two tiny heroes before landing in jail.

feats.scene: Ortir hurls a dagger and pins a hat to a wooden wall.
Ortir shrugs off a hard shove from a pursuer and keeps running.

name: Iutisor
summary: Iutisor is a career crook who schemed to steal a prototype racer, then bet everything on a contest against a fast-moving hero. His gang rigged a throat ailment to sabotage the rival's chant, yet the rival won anyway.

feats.scene: Iutisor smashes a garage window with a spanner.
Iutisor stumbles in a scuffle and keeps barking orders.

name: Lleceo
summary: Lleceo is a ghost of a woman slain in a gloomy old house by her own spouse. Bound by his rites for a hundred years, she shakes off the spells, remembers everything, and claims a bitter reckoning.

feats.scene: Lleceo hurls a heavy wardrobe across a hall with a howl.
Lleceo drifts through a hail of iron shot untouched.

name: Arcoli
summary: Arcoli is a red-haired delegate on a secretive council of nations who wept as she voted to fire an orbital cannon at a war-torn continent. She has no powers, just a hand in a terrible decision.

feats.scene: Arcoli casts the deciding vote that unleashes a space-borne beam on a battlefield.
Arcoli sits through a heated council shouting match unscathed.

name: Inuillal
summary: Inuillal is a brown-eyed seer of the early twentieth century who held sittings and joined a band of occult defenders. Her mind can reach others across distance.

feats.scene: Inuillal sends a mental jolt that staggers a startled intruder.
Inuillal sits through a violent seance without flinching.

name: Eonnonan
summary: Eonnonan is a purple-skinned peacekeeper with a glowing ring that makes solid shapes from light, shields her and carries her through the air. She is eaten alongside her partner by a beast at a remote outpost.

feats.scene: Eonnonan hurls a green beam that blasts a rock spire to gravel.
Eonnonan weathers a mauling from a huge creature behind her glowing shield.

name: Orsees
summary: Orsees is a white-haired, widowed sea officer in charge of a spy bureau, quietly aided by a masked aviator who happens to be his daughter's sweetheart. He keeps a close eye on saboteurs.

feats.scene: Orsees slams a heavy file drawer into an intruder's knee.
Orsees keeps issuing orders while a window shatters beside him.

name: Teroream
summary: Teroream is a grey-furred rodent who became a monster-sized foe after his mother was crushed on a road. A mocking voice urges him to seek vengeance on a metal-bodied man.

feats.scene: Teroream stomps through a street and flattens a row of parked vans.
Teroream takes a barrage of police rounds and keeps lumbering ahead.

name: Valtertel
summary: Valtertel is a dark-eyed heir to a tyrant clan who enjoys tormenting prisoners for sport. His cruelty ends badly once his family's rule begins to crack.

feats.scene: Valtertel lashes a restrained captive with a leather strap.
Valtertel is knocked off his chair and rises with a sneer.

name: Amoti
summary: Amoti is a vain troublemaker who fights in a bulky mechanical suit that boosts his strength. Underneath is a frail man, and a green teenager twice smashed the rig apart.

feats.scene: Amoti punches a steel door off its hinges in his armour.
Amoti stands against a hail of lab equipment inside the armour unharmed.

name: Iumnumval
summary: Iumnumval is a red-haired, green-eyed forge-worker from a hidden island of warrior women, living in disguise as a street beggar. Her trained body is tougher than any ordinary person's.

feats.scene: Iumnumval hammers a blade flat in one stroke at a hidden anvil.
Iumnumval takes a hard fall onto cobbles and walks it off.

name: Raunusse
summary: Raunusse is a campus advisor dismissed for improper questions, who then abducted an elderly professor to pry out secrets about a fiery hero. He has no special abilities beyond his nerve.

feats.scene: Raunusse drags a struggling professor into a van.
Raunusse takes a stumble down a lecture hall step and gets up.

name: Tiariiu
summary: Tiariiu is a cheerful busboy with a blade fixation who wears a black-and-blue costume to execute wrongdoers, even over trivial offences. He hero-worships a pacifist soldier and fights alongside him.

feats.scene: Tiariiu cuts a chain across a doorway with a swift strike of his blade.
Tiariiu keeps grinning through a savage beating in an alley.

name: Niuanu
summary: Niuanu is a stern magistrate who moonlights as a brutal masked avenger. Haunted by his abandonment of the law, he ends his own life in remorse.

feats.scene: Niuanu fires a shotgun and drops a fleeing mugger.
Niuanu staggers through a barroom brawl and walks out.

name: Reraule
summary: Reraule is a faulty copy of a rich man's brother, whose body aged to extreme old age far too fast. Desperate to expose the lab that made him, he planted an explosive on a reporter's relative before being shot.

feats.scene: Reraule plants a pipe bomb that wrecks a newsroom corridor.
Reraule clings on while his frail body fails.

name: Cormil
summary: Cormil is a retired masked genius, the cleverest mind alive, who frightened a whole planet into unity to avert a nuclear war. He was later exiled to a heavenly prison that nearly broke his sanity.

feats.scene: Cormil detonates a staged catastrophe that flattens a city's coast for the sake of peace.
Cormil survives a bruising fall onto an icy plain.

name: Ileni
summary: Ileni is a vicious killer working the streets of a gritty city, hunted by a lightning-handed champion. He is a plain thug with a cruel streak.

feats.scene: Ileni knocks a shopkeeper down with a single wild swing.
Ileni stumbles from a collapsing stair and keeps limping off.

name: Rnasi
summary: Rnasi is a tall, silver-eyed former space traveller whose mind merged with a mystic sphere, granting glimpses of the future and the power to step across great distances. Her personality was lost to the merge.

feats.scene: Rnasi opens a portal and drops a hostile squad into a frozen sea.
Rnasi stands in a firefight and vanishes before the rounds land.

name: Lunovos
summary: Lunovos is a queen of a desert kingdom who shouts a magic word to become a winged goddess. She was thrown from a moving train during a plot against her husband's rule.

feats.scene: Lunovos transforms and lifts a derailed carriage clear of the tracks.
Lunovos walks away from a plunge off a speeding train.

name: Velocor
summary: Velocor is a brown-haired general of a warrior sisterhood, an unyielding radical who was tricked into a civil war by a disguised schemer. She fell in the final clash.

feats.scene: Velocor cleaves a shield and the arm behind it with a spear thrust.
Velocor takes a heavy spear hit and keeps leading the charge.

name: Ronser
summary: Ronser is a dark-eyed flyer who bore a lover through three days of sky to reach a stronghold as the dead rose around them. They later raced away from a horde of ravenous infected before it struck.

feats.scene: Ronser dives and drags a companion clear of a lunging corpse.
Ronser outpaces a pack of lurching dead in a long flat dash through the sky.

name: Antor
summary: Antor is a rebel who was given wings in a cruel lab, then pushed off a cliff and discovered they could fly. Now they fight for a cause, loyal to friends and enemy of the state.

feats.scene: Antor swoops into a guard and bowls him across the yard.
Antor survives a chain-yanked tumble from the sky onto rock.

name: Ariariu
summary: Ariariu is a bald, black-eyed technician among the best in a shadowy underworld, sweeping up the damage after brawls. He works through machines with an unspeaking assistant at his side.

feats.scene: Ariariu triggers a shaped charge that clears a collapsed corridor.
Ariariu keeps tapping at a console as dust rains around him.

name: Minanrn
summary: Minanrn is a brawler with a brain implant that shows him five ticks of the future, so he anticipates every blow. A combat harness gives him stamina to match.

feats.scene: Minanrn slips a punch and drops a bruiser with a counter-blow.
Minanrn is hit by a staggering barrage and rises again.

name: Lltoris
summary: Lltoris is a blue-skinned monarch of a far-off planet, who leads a corps of women wielding violet crystals powered by affection. She governs a proud court.

feats.scene: Lltoris sends a violet burst that shatters a stone terrace.
Lltoris stands firm through a rain of rubble in her crumbling hall.

name: Tentisi
summary: Tentisi is a white-eyed, blue-skinned queen whose home was invaded by robotic hunters. Controlled by a parasitic machine, she was freed by a visiting pilot.

feats.scene: Tentisi lashes out under outside control and cracks a marble pillar.
Tentisi withstands an invasion bombardment in her palace.

name: Iraunel
summary: Iraunel is a green-eyed, blue-haired convict who feeds on the feelings of others and whips his long hair like limbs. Once stuffed with enough emotion he fights rings of light hand to hand.

feats.scene: Iraunel grows huge on stolen emotion and smashes a prison wall.
Iraunel shrugs off a heavy glowing cage and tears it open.

name: Isnen
summary: Isnen is a quiet man with a birdcage for a chest who melts invisibly into any crowd, aching to surprise somebody. In his last moments a toy plane flies from his ribs and startles the shooters.

feats.scene: Isnen shoves an astonished guard from behind.
Isnen is riddled by sniper fire and dies smiling.

name: Intorse
summary: Intorse is a strawberry-haired enemy agent working in secret in a capital city during wartime. He seizes a monstrous prisoner as a weapon and finally tries to wipe out an entire timeline.

feats.scene: Intorse sets a time device to collapse a whole timeline into dust.
Intorse takes a boot to the ribs and snarls on.

name: Lurena
summary: Lurena is a spy who poses as a frightened fugitive to lure a squad of boy soldiers into a trap. She slips away when her accomplices are rounded up.

feats.scene: Lurena slams a trap door shut on a startled boy.
Lurena tumbles down a cellar stair and flees in the dark.

name: Serense
summary: Serense is a ruthless state operative who hunts the owner of a crashed starship and binds captives in glowing shackles that drain their strength. It relies on borrowed authority and patient cruelty rather than any gift of its own.

feats.scene: Serense slams a restraint cuff onto a struggling captive hard enough to bruise the bone.
Serense is flung into a steel wall by a desperate prisoner and gets up still giving orders.

name: Aulonane
summary: Aulonane rebuilt her face and name to take revenge on a rubbery trickster who left her behind, then dropped the plan when she learned why he stayed away. She fights with trained hands and sharp detective instincts, and later shared his adventures.

feats.scene: Aulonane drops a charging gunman with a flurry of tight, practised strikes.
Aulonane crashes through a shop window during a chase and keeps running.

name: Ereleo
summary: Ereleo is a bitter veteran-turned-bomber who torches targets with a fuel-gel launcher and plots to flood a metropolis with poison fumes. His grievance is real, his methods are monstrous, and his followers are few.

feats.scene: Ereleo sprays burning gel across a warehouse until the whole roof collapses in flames.
Ereleo takes a heavy beating from masked pursuers and is hauled off still breathing.

name: Amcoium
summary: Amcoium is a mute government weapon whose veins run with poison that would kill anyone else. It obeys orders through a tracker under the skin and shrugs off wounds that would stop a crowd.

feats.scene: Amcoium hurls a fugitive across a motel room with one silent swing.
Amcoium walks calmly out of a flipped, burning truck with no sign of pain.

name: Tinlunt
summary: Tinlunt abandoned peaceful protest decades ago and now conjures phantom battalions and shellfire from every era to fight for him. He ages slowly, reads minds, and treats killing as a tidy trade.

feats.scene: Tinlunt calls down a phantom artillery barrage that flattens a whole row of warehouses.
Tinlunt shrugs off a glancing bullet graze and keeps walking.

name: Iateraus
summary: Iateraus is a cold, white-haired intelligence officer who oversees contact with invaders across several decades. He will gladly kill a child to protect a secret, and the consequences echo through time.

feats.scene: Iateraus fires a single pistol round that ends a young boy's life in a quiet wood.
Iateraus is clubbed unconscious by escaping prisoners and wakes the next morning.

name: Corson
summary: Corson is a cheerful errand runner who crossed an ocean as a child and now hauls parcels for a corner shop. He tags along on the adventures of a neighbourhood masked champion, always a step behind the danger.

feats.scene: Corson shoves a crate of bottles off a counter to block a thug's path.
Corson tumbles down a flight of stairs with a basket of deliveries and laughs it off.

name: Lleser
summary: Lleser was a temple priest whose cruelty cost a strongman everything. The strongman's rage ended the priest's life, and the memory of it still burns across the centuries.

feats.scene: Lleser strikes a kneeling servant with a ceremonial staff.
Lleser is seized by the throat and thrown down the temple steps by a furious avenger.

name: Taeor
summary: Taeor is a luminous being born of an idea, descending in primeval times to seed a world with the notion of costumed champions. Nothing forged by mortals could kill it, though a humble thinking object finally did.

feats.scene: Taeor floods the entire planet with a single idea, rewriting what its people dare to dream.
Taeor outlasts every blade, blast, and age of siege without a scratch.

name: Rininlu
summary: Rininlu is a studious young artist raised in a closed country, unaware that his father is a sea monarch of scale and fire. Arrest by officials shoves him toward a destiny he never asked for.

feats.scene: Rininlu smashes through a locked interrogation door in a surge of newfound strength.
Rininlu weathers a squad's truncheon blows without breaking a rib.

name: Cantost
summary: Cantost is a half-divine sorcerer of a drowned age, trained from boyhood to shield his people from a coming catastrophe. He wears enchanted robes woven for his future and leads the champions of harmony against chaos.

feats.scene: Cantost hurls a spell that cracks a mountain pass and seals an invading horde beneath it.
Cantost stands in the heart of a collapsing tower of crystal and walks out unharmed.

name: Cilanuial
summary: Cilanuial is a long-dead sorcerer-king who rose again with colder eyes and a wider vision. Once a tender hero of the deep, it now wields vast arcane and scientific knowledge without a trace of pity.

feats.scene: Cilanuial calls a wall of sea and sorcery down upon a coastal metropolis.
Cilanuial rises from his own tomb unmarked by centuries of rot.

name: Amsir
summary: Amsir is a veiled cosmic guardian who once poured every ounce of her power into another to stop a world-eating invader. She loves a being of pure time and fate, and rival schemers have snared them both.

feats.scene: Amsir pours her whole essence into an ally and the surge scatters an invading armada across the void.
Amsir is bound by twelve relics of boundless might and survives the squeeze of an entire reality.

name: Rates
summary: Rates is a purple-skinned officer of a stellar police force who died giving birth while her ring chose a successor. She kept her grim humour even as she lay dying.

feats.scene: Rates blasts a hulking raider back through a bulkhead with a glowing construct.
Rates is caught in a massive blast of shrapnel and clings to life long enough to speak.

name: Enullueo
summary: Enullueo is the greedy heir of a notorious umbrella-wielding crime lord, schooled in street brawling and nothing else. Its ambitions outrun its patience, and it ends up another victim of the family trade.

feats.scene: Enullueo pummels a rival courier into a gutter with a pair of heavy punches.
Enullueo takes a rooftop fall onto a parked van and staggers to his feet.

name: Iummia
summary: Iummia is a reformed convict turned scientist who fights crime beside a masked mentor inside a bottled city. He was once framed by his own accomplices and later wed the niece of a mentor.

feats.scene: Iummia hurls a boosted punch that caves in a storage vault door.
Iummia shrugs off a collapsing lab ceiling and keeps working on the controls.

name: Ossereor
summary: Ossereor is a soldier of a doomed world, husband and father, who charges a sealed city perimeter alongside his unit. He falls to a hostile machine before his daughter's eyes.

feats.scene: Ossereor drives a rifle butt into a drone's sensor array as his squad advances.
Ossereor absorbs a glancing scorch from an attacking probe before the fatal blow lands.

name: Oretan
summary: Oretan is a gentle child of a bright sky-realm who befriends a furious outsider after a schoolyard scrap. His family is slaughtered by raiders, and the grief reshapes a friend's whole life.

feats.scene: Oretan trades fierce blows with a young rival in the courtyard until both collapse laughing.
Oretan takes a thrown boulder to the chest and stays on his feet.

name: Sersa
summary: Sersa is a scholar-warrior who redesigned a champion's armor by merging engineering with enchantment. She fought bravely once, then gave the suit away, convinced someone else carried it better.

feats.scene: Sersa slams a gauntleted fist through a barricade of crates to cover a retreat.
Sersa is struck by a bomb blast in her enchanted armor and survives with bruises.

name: Soriullo
summary: Soriullo is an undying desert king who plots to wipe out modern humanity and resurrect his old realm through radio-controlled thralls. His servants live only while his will endures.

feats.scene: Soriullo cleaves a stone idol in half with one sweep of his blade.
Soriullo is buried under a collapsing pyramid chamber and walks out dusty and furious.

name: Neovaosa
summary: Neovaosa is a poacher-turned-tyrant who rules riverside villages with armed men and a reputation for the supernatural. He moves with blinding speed, fights with razor claws, and coats his wounds with venom.

feats.scene: Neovaosa rakes a heroine's shoulder open with a flurry of claws.
Neovaosa takes a hard strike to the jaw and sneers through the blood.
Neovaosa blurs across a village square before the onlookers can blink.

name: Ntiasi
summary: Ntiasi is a weary short-order cook whose restaurants keep getting wrecked by one brutish regular. He rebuilds each time, hoping the next grand opening will finally survive.

feats.scene: Ntiasi swings a frying pan at a would-be robber and clangs him across the skull.
Ntiasi is hauled around by thugs as a hostage and walks away shaken but whole.

name: Reoauser
summary: Reoauser is a swaggering gangland chief who frightens witnesses into taking the fall for him. Only a lawyer's stubborn conscience stands in the way.

feats.scene: Reoauser orders a pistol fired at a trembling informant across a back-room table.
Reoauser shrugs off a thrown ashtray and calls for another round.

name: Viveori
summary: Viveori is a bloated crime chief who commands the underworld through loyalty and menace. A crusading attorney turned vigilante eventually targets his empire.

feats.scene: Viveori backhands a debtor across a restaurant booth, splintering the table.
Viveori takes a fall down a loading ramp and laughs about it.

name: Reorer
summary: Reorer is a gleeful young swindler who learns pranks from an older rogue, then overtakes him in daring heists. A jealous master and an angry hero both end up behind bars because of it.

feats.scene: Reorer springs a rigged trap that slams a vault door onto a guard's cart.
Reorer is flung through a hay cart by a stronger hero and bounces up cackling.

name: Searser
summary: Searser is a quick-fingered street thief of a fabled desert city who stumbles into a wish-granting lamp. Time travelers pass through and he helps them.

feats.scene: Searser tosses a ripe melon that cracks a guard's helmet.
Searser tumbles off a market awning onto cobblestones and is up before the guard arrives.

name: Nansiacor
summary: Nansiacor is a daring flier and wartime adventurer famous for smashing enemy plots, who later retired under a new alias. He pilots submersible craft and fights hand to hand with practised precision.

feats.scene: Nansiacor knocks a saboteur off a dock with a thundering right hook.
Nansiacor crash-lands a fighter plane in a field and climbs out with a grin.

name: Tineas
summary: Tineas is a flashy filmmaker who doubled as his own stuntman after meeting a tough drifter. He hopes to cast the stranger again and throws lavish parties to impress him.

feats.scene: Tineas leaps from a prop truck and tackles a runaway camera dolly.
Tineas takes a staged car crash on set without a scratch.

name: Reveo
summary: Reveo is a retired local who opened a roadside restaurant themed on atomic-age nostalgia and passed it to his son. Whether he vanished or simply left the town is a mystery.

feats.scene: Reveo flips a heavy griddle with one practised heave.
Reveo slips on a greasy floor tile and bounces up laughing.

name: Llotelol
summary: Llotelol is a secret wartime agent who lights the way for a team of masked operatives with a ring that conjures solid light. A traitor erases the hand wearing it.

feats.scene: Llotelol shapes a glowing wall of light that drives back a squad of armed guards.
Llotelol loses a hand to a vaporising blast and stays conscious long enough to report.

name: Ternuva
summary: Ternuva draws power from a captive star-fragment and becomes a luminous guardian who befriends distant peacekeepers. It conjures solid light, shields allies, and soars on emerald beams.

feats.scene: Ternuva molds a colossal glowing fist that levels a whole block of warehouses.
Ternuva rides out a shockwave behind a shell of light that holds without a crack.

name: Stsor
summary: Stsor is a broadcasting magnate who once fought as a masked hero and later retires, afraid of his own power. He testifies before suspicious lawmakers while a hidden enemy waits.

feats.scene: Stsor remembers unleashing a blast he believes outweighs the bombs that ended the war.
Stsor is shot by a thief in an alley while unarmored and nearly dies.

name: Certel
summary: Certel is a jailed roboticist whose attempt to build a perfect thinking machine ended in failure and a life sentence. He only wants his teacher daughter left in peace.

feats.scene: Certel shoves a toolbox across the cell at a visiting student.
Certel takes a hard fall down the prison stairs and shrugs it off.

name: Llluium
summary: Llluium is a nineteenth-century patriarch who founded a vast business empire and feared a secret society. He slips into a sewer while fleeing and meets a silent killer.

feats.scene: Llluium swings a cane at a masked attacker in the dark.
Llluium drops through an open manhole and keeps running on a bruised leg.

name: Eosorium
summary: Eosorium is a grieving traveler from a future world who builds a plague meant to turn every human into something alien. A time scientist hurls him into the distant past, where the virus escapes anyway.

feats.scene: Eosorium smashes a vault console to steal passage into the past.
Eosorium is hurled across centuries by a time device and lands alive.

name: Telcorniu
summary: Telcorniu is a red-haired warrior raised from childhood to fight an interdimensional tyrant, wearing a living liquid-metal suit forged by ancient sorcerers. The suit grants her flight, strength, and speed, and she sends the demon fleeing.

feats.scene: Telcorniu drives her blade through a demonic knot of flesh so hard that a ridge splits.
Telcorniu stands against a demon's crushing blow with her suit rippling around her.
Telcorniu rockets over a battlefield too fast for the eye.

name: Stitone
summary: Stitone is a corporate saboteur who dons a bird-themed disguise to wreck a rival railway. A masked hero and a determined reporter thwart the scheme.

feats.scene: Stitone pries a rail spike loose with a crowbar and sends a handcar tumbling.
Stitone is tackled onto a platform by a hero and wriggles in the grip.

name: Tileoceo
summary: Tileoceo was a college football star so brutal that opponents forfeited. Abducted by a secret program, he now fights as an armored warrior in a virtual world, shrugging off blows.

feats.scene: Tileoceo drives a shoulder into a barricade and bursts it into the street.
Tileoceo stands in the path of a speeding truck and the truck folds around him.

name: Raaun
summary: Raaun was a bullied, tiny student who trained under a retired boxer and became a ferocious bare-fisted crusader. An accident later made him far stronger.

feats.scene: Raaun lands a haymaker that launches a thug through a plank fence.
Raaun takes a brutal beating from a gang of enforcers and rises again.

name: Vatelna
summary: Vatelna inherited atomic powers from a villainous grandfather and grows to towering size when he fights. He bounces between hero teams and a prison task force, and dreams of justice.

feats.scene: Vatelna swells to the height of a house and hurls a truck through a warehouse wall.
Vatelna stands in his enlarged form as a cannon salvo bursts across his chest.

name: Ritornti
summary: Ritornti is a size-changing champion who battles a gigantic rival amid a wrecked metropolis. He grows enormous, hits hard, and takes giant blows without flinching.

feats.scene: Ritornti grows to the height of a tower and bats a giantess back through a billboard.
Ritornti stands firm as a giant fist lands on his shoulder.

name: Rilira
summary: Rilira is a forensic analyst with a quiet ambition and a borrowed frost projector, using it to clear anyone standing between a desk and a promotion. Every victim becomes a puzzle for colleagues she controls, until a mask slips at the wrong moment.

feats.scene: Rilira freezes a supervisor solid with a single burst from the projector.
Rilira takes a hard shove into a lab bench and keeps moving.

name: Valrnuval
summary: Valrnuval began as a gentle researcher dreaming of a protective generation of improved people, then tested the process on himself. The change warped his kindness into a need to rule, and his mind now broadcasts orders to every listener on the planet.

feats.scene: Valrnuval raises a volcanic island from the open sea and sends a giant wave across the ocean as a mere side effect.
Valrnuval shrugs off the collapse of a research tower around his swollen body.

name: Toreorn
summary: Toreorn is a loyal field operative in a rewritten world, guarding a prisoner she slowly realises was never the villain. Once her false memories crack she turns on her own commander and leads a daring escape.

feats.scene: Toreorn lands a trained strike on a guard in a narrow corridor.
Toreorn is thrown across a laboratory floor and gets back up swinging.

name: Linumtu
summary: Linumtu is a freelance photographer whose warmth steadies a young hero through his first uncertain months. Her bright, ordinary life ends too soon, and what she left behind shapes him for years.

feats.scene: Linumtu swings her camera bag at an intruder in a dark stairwell.
Linumtu is knocked flat on a concrete floor by a much larger attacker.

name: Resranum
summary: Resranum takes over a harbor crime family after her father dies and fights a bloody turf war across the docks. She breaks alliances as easily as she makes them, double-crossing a rival at a staged meeting.

feats.scene: Resranum orders an ambush that wipes out a rival crew in a warehouse.
Resranum survives a car crash on a wet bridge with only bruises.

name: Nticortes
summary: Nticortes is a brilliant chemist who lost her husband and puts all the blame on a famous flying hero. She plots patiently in a private lab, building traps meant for someone who cannot be hurt.

feats.scene: Nticortes detonates a lab-built charge that collapses a loading dock.
Nticortes stumbles through a smoke-filled stairwell after her own device backfires.

name: Nelniulia
summary: Nelniulia is a skyborne raider who despises smokestacks and wants a new century stopped before it starts. From a patched balloon-ship he focuses sunlight through a giant lens and burns a slum to the ground.

feats.scene: Nelniulia sweeps a focused sunbeam over a crowded slum and sets entire streets alight.
Nelniulia crashes through a hull of brittle timber and keeps fighting.

name: Aniari
summary: Aniari was altered in a secret lab until his voice became a weapon, a boom that rolls from his chest and cannot be switched off. Implants keep the echoes in check, barely.

feats.scene: Aniari unleashes a booming shout that cracks the walls of a concrete bunker.
Aniari endures the roar of his own echo bouncing around a steel cell.

name: Sortia
summary: Sortia is a gloomy ex-astronaut with a mind that leaks whatever he feels into the heads around him. He earns his keep questioning suspects at a busy precinct and shares his flat with a clever primate.

feats.scene: Sortia pushes a suspect's thoughts into the open during a long interrogation.
Sortia powers through a brutal morning after a long night of drinking.

name: Talvi
summary: Talvi is a hardened ex-soldier haunted by an old crime at sea, now guarding a deep-diving research craft. When something ancient wakes in a wreck, he sacrifices himself by overloading the ship's experimental core.

feats.scene: Talvi triggers a collapsing singularity engine that tears apart a cosmic horror.
Talvi hauls himself through a flooding corridor under crushing pressure.

name: Rustoncin
summary: Rustoncin is a red-haired schemer with a hundred false names who spends decades trying to ruin the strongest man alive. He prefers cruelty by rocket, striking at friends instead of the target himself.

feats.scene: Rustoncin launches a salvo of homemade missiles at a newspaper building.
Rustoncin walks out of a collapsing hideout covered in dust.

name: Tecor
summary: Tecor is a retired spacefarer pulled into a squad of armoured guardians after a rescue from the sky. Strapped into a bulky red exosuit, he leads an elite unit through border emergencies.

feats.scene: Tecor blasts a stalled tank into scrap from the shoulder cannons of his suit.
Tecor stands inside the armour as a missile detonates against the chest plate.

name: Tanel
summary: Tanel is a refugee inventor who built a helmet that hardens whatever its wearer imagines into real matter. Hunted by a greedy tycoon, he puts it on once in anger and then learns to put it down for good.

feats.scene: Tanel imagines a wall of rock and watches it slam down on a pack of thugs.
Tanel is dragged across a circus yard by guards and keeps his grip on the helmet.

name: Lencor
summary: Lencor works under a grease-stained apron by day and runs errands for a crime ring by night. He is bald, quiet and careful, and the crew trusts him with engines, not with decisions.

feats.scene: Lencor swings a wrench into a rival's knee behind a garage.
Lencor takes a beating in a back room and refuses to talk.

name: Ninrn
summary: Ninrn is a dreamer raised on tales of fantastic machines, turned away by his ruler and driven abroad. He builds an enormous underwater vessel, crews it with outcasts and plunders sunken fortunes.

feats.scene: Ninrn rams his hulking vessel into a merchant ship and splits it in two.
Ninrn rides out a deep-sea storm inside the riveted hull.

name: Ratia
summary: Ratia lost her village to chainsaws and carries a bond with wild creatures that lets her borrow their gifts after a single glance. She is a future rebel who fights for animals, living and extinct.

feats.scene: Ratia takes the strength of a charging beast and flips a delivery truck.
Ratia borrows the thick hide of a rhino and shrugs off a barrage.

name: Tilva
summary: Tilva is a former chemistry student dazzled by a clown prince of crime, now a gleeful accomplice with a taste for poisons. She mixes noxious cocktails and throws them with startling accuracy.

feats.scene: Tilva hurls a vial of caustic gas that empties a crowded theatre.
Tilva tumbles down a flight of stairs laughing and gets up unhurt.

name: Cellis
summary: Cellis was a firebrand extremist before the night-feeders overran the city, and now rules a thriving underground bazaar with red eyes and a cold smile. Her fangs are for negotiating.

feats.scene: Cellis flings a rival across the bazaar and through a market stall.
Cellis walks away from a wall of gunfire, her wounds already closing.

name: Terte
summary: Terte is the lonely heir of a famous villain, a clever and slighted girl who spurns her father's path until a snub breaks her. She rewires the guardian machines of a peaceful age and turns them on whole cities.

feats.scene: Terte commands rebuilt guardian machines to level an entire city.
Terte is thrown against a console in a tense stand-off.

name: Ranco
summary: Ranco is a bald inventor in a mirror-image world where the lawmen are the outlaws. He chases the wrong pair of strangers across rooftops, then redeems everyone with a brain-altering device.

feats.scene: Ranco fires a rewiring device that flips a whole gang's loyalties.
Ranco survives a lab explosion behind a heavy desk.

name: Taunti
summary: Taunti is a bald genius who keeps changing his name, his crime and his gadgets while nursing a lifelong grudge. Strapped into a bulky battle rig, he is a spiteful, endlessly inventive threat to a hero who cannot be killed.

feats.scene: Taunti levels a stadium with the armoured fists and cannon of his battle suit.
Taunti takes a point-blank blast inside the suit and walks out.

name: Lorsa
summary: Lorsa steers a polished convertible through crowded streets, a cheerful servant who keeps a double secret behind a polite smile. Nobody guesses that the driver knows exactly who is under the cowl.

feats.scene: Lorsa hauls a heavy crate into the boot of the car single-handed.
Lorsa tumbles out of the driver seat during a sharp turn and dusts himself off.

name: Milnt
summary: Milnt is a dignified manservant in a bright, silly world who hides a talent for disguise, fencing and archery. He turns up in unlikely costumes whenever his household needs a quiet rescue.

feats.scene: Milnt fells a bumbling crook with a well-aimed fencing thrust.
Milnt is dunked in a trap-filled pond and emerges unruffled.

name: Varll
summary: Varll keeps a grand house running, carrying out tea trays, bandages and dry remarks with equal calm. Every wound that comes home gets stitched by hands that never shake.

feats.scene: Varll cracks a fire poker across the wrist of an intruder in a hallway.
Varll holds the door against a pounding crowd until help arrives.

source_title: Alfred Pennyworth (Batman: Under the Red Hood)

name: Torason
summary: Torason is a white-haired caretaker minding a clocktower full of young heroines, fussing over birthrights and meals. He keeps a shotgun and a revolver close, and uses both without drama.

feats.scene: Torason fires a shotgun through a locked door to scatter a gang of burglars.
Torason is shoved into a bookcase and rises with his tea tray intact.

name: Naeosar
summary: Naeosar serves a ruthless tyrant under a hidden threat, with an explosive device lodged beside his spine to guarantee obedience. He finally walks out and hands the proof to the police.

feats.scene: Naeosar slams a ledger onto a desk and demands that the officers read it.
Naeosar lives for years beside a charge that could end him at a whim.

source_title: Alfred Pennyworth (Dark Multiverse: The Grim Knight)

name: Autor
summary: Autor is a fussy former records clerk turned live-in guardian of an orphaned heir. Under a madman's laughing gas he wrecks an elegant sitting room, then spends the next morning mortified and sweeping.

feats.scene: Autor smashes furniture and shatters windows while lost in a giggling haze.
Autor staggers through a thick cloud of gas and stays on his feet.

name: Rnicisle
summary: Rnicisle is a steady house servant whose calm voice leads a team through a cavern full of screens and trophies. His work is tidy, quiet and nearly invisible, which is how he likes it.

feats.scene: Rnicisle drags a heavy equipment crate across the cavern floor.
Rnicisle shakes off a hard tumble down a flight of steps.

name: Llitire
summary: Llitire is the spotless valet in a world with a flying champion in place of a masked one. To shield a friend's secret, he dresses up as his employer and plays the part with total conviction.

feats.scene: Llitire pushes a stubborn intruder out of the drawing room with both hands.
Llitire keeps a straight face while a reporter peppers him with questions.

name: Celamo
summary: Celamo is a grey-haired domestic who tends the wounds of a family of night patrollers, steady hands and a calm word. He dresses cuts, resets shoulders and says very little about it.

feats.scene: Celamo sets a dislocated shoulder back into place in one firm motion.
Celamo stays up for three nights straight patching the injured.

name: Seoneton
summary: Seoneton is the faithful steward of a grand estate in a darkened world, loyal to the last, with a father who served the same house. He turns up as a collectible helper in a battle game.

feats.scene: Seoneton lifts a loaded tray and sweeps it across the floor without a spill.
Seoneton stays standing through a long, tense night.

name: Arseole
summary: Arseole watches a hero fall into ruin and, in grief, wakes a hidden cloning engine to give the boy a gentler second life. He builds a vast replica of the old streets beneath a burning desert for the clone to grow up in.

feats.scene: Arseole throws the lever that wakes the cloning engine in a dark vault.
Arseole survives a ferocious mob outside a crumbling hall.

name: Orios
summary: Orios is a bouncy plastic-brick manservant, happy to dance, take photographs and toss gadgets at the heroes while they study clues. His acrobatics are goofy and his loyalty is complete.

feats.scene: Orios flings a plastic tray across a cave and knocks a villain flat.
Orios bounces off a wall of loose bricks and snaps back together.

name: Eotesar
summary: Eotesar is an old servant who is dying and bathes in a pool of green fluid mixed with a monster serum. His strength returns long enough to cook one last holiday dinner, then fades by the week's end.

feats.scene: Eotesar carves a roast with surprising vigour after his bath.
Eotesar rises from a deathbed made new by the strange waters.

name: Raami
summary: Raami is a rubbery face stuck among a pile of novelty masks, chatting happily until someone yanks him off. He is a visual gag more than a person, and a very cheerful one.

feats.scene: Raami flaps his rubber lips and nudges a teen's hand away.
Raami is torn from a gag costume and stretches without tearing.

source_title: Alfred Pennyworth (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Riaiaiu
summary: Riaiaiu is a small brick butler with a dry wit who keeps a cheerful household running while its heroic owner sulks. He is more composed than the minifigure scale would suggest.

feats.scene: Riaiaiu shoves a heap of bricks aside and clears a path.
Riaiaiu survives a tumble down a stack of toy furniture.

name: Iumlan
summary: Iumlan quietly sets a tea service for a patrol in a world where one small event went differently. He observes the heroes with a patient eye and pours without being asked.

feats.scene: Iumlan hauls a trunk up a winding staircase in one go.
Iumlan works through a sleepless week of emergencies.

name: Tirnti
summary: Tirnti is a black-haired manservant who occasionally pulls on a feathered mask and tags along as a sidekick. Under that cheerful costume he is every bit as devoted and a little more daring.

feats.scene: Tirnti swoops in wearing the feathered cowl and tackles a lurking gunman.
Tirnti takes a hard knock in a rooftop scuffle and gets up grinning.

source_title: Alfred Pennyworth (The World of the Knight)

name: Miseo
summary: Miseo is a grey, horned brute who started as a human security chief and a hidden lover, then swallowed a drug that twisted him into a monster. Fists like boulders and a hide like iron make him a menace.

feats.scene: Miseo punches through a tower wall and sends a whole corner crashing down.
Miseo takes a falling girder on his horned skull and shrugs it off.

name: Iumrn
summary: Iumrn is a bedridden old servant on a breathing machine, kept alive by borrowed cold technology. With his last strength he tends a wounded master and writes a farewell note.

feats.scene: Iumrn pulls himself upright and dresses a deep gash with trembling hands.
Iumrn lingers through a long illness before the final night.

name: Lallaco
summary: Lallaco was a soldier of an ancient desert city who found a glowing relic and became something no longer human. He swore to hunt others of his kind and plays a bitter game of rivalry across the centuries.

feats.scene: Lallaco hurls a column of stone across the courtyard with a single transformed arm.
Lallaco's altered flesh turns aside a volley of spears.

name: Veorarni
summary: Veorarni is a turbaned swindler who stages fake killings in a hotel so frightened guests pay for protection. Spun in his own headwear by a speedster, he is bundled up and caught.

feats.scene: Veorarni orders his goons to seize a clerk and drag him into a back room.
Veorarni is wrapped in yards of cloth by a whirling blur and cannot break free.

name: Neium
summary: Neium is a cloned soldier from a bleak future where the sun was turned red, and she wears her stolen strength like armour. Thrown back in time, she fights a young farm hero with a poisoned weapon and is defeated by her own blade.

feats.scene: Neium punches a heavy truck clean across a field.
Neium shrugs off a tanker explosion without a scratch.
Neium streaks across a farmland in the blink of an eye.

name: Tautilva
summary: Tautilva is a quiet student who learns that her bloodline carries an old curse: wherever she goes, tempers flare and fear spreads. She resolves to stop apologising and take control of it.

feats.scene: Tautilva's presence drives a crowded hall into a sudden brawl.
Tautilva is thrown against a locker and keeps her stubborn stare.

name: Cinrause
summary: Cinrause is a mirror-wielding trickster from a madcap brotherhood of absurd villains. Anyone who looks into her glass grows old in moments, and she giggles at the wrinkles.

feats.scene: Cinrause holds up her mirror and ages a whole squad into frail elders.
Cinrause laughs off a punch to the ribs from a masked fighter.

name: Tenitir
summary: Tenitir is a gentle grandmother in a crowded borough with an old sorrow for a lost love. She watches over her family and a legend made of clay that her granddaughter will one day lead.

feats.scene: Tenitir swats a stray cat off the porch with a rolled newspaper.
Tenitir endures a bitter winter on a draughty tenement stair.

name: Setel
summary: Setel is a quiet student in dark clothes who loves biology and is quick to stand up for a friend. When a brash bully pushes too far, she and a plant-obsessed classmate grow closer than either planned.

feats.scene: Setel shoves a bully away from a locker in a crowded hallway.
Setel takes a hard shove into a wall and stays defiant.

name: Nuveo
summary: Nuveo is a blond widow raising a spirited daughter in a rough, soot-streaked city. After her husband dies at the hands of two cops she spits bitter words at every badge that knocks on her door.

feats.scene: Nuveo slaps a hand across a detective's desk and demands to be heard.
Nuveo endures a bleak winter in a drafty tenement flat.

name: Taser
summary: Taser works as a bright office clerk who brightens a lonely colleague's mornings without ever noticing his crush. A night of mind-controlled antics leaves her baffled, and her fiance rescues her from the chaos.

feats.scene: Taser shoves a stack of files into a startled intruder's chest.
Taser stumbles through a wrecked living room and keeps her composure.

name: Sieorsa
summary: Sieorsa is the white-haired wife of a gruff newspaper editor, with an old scandal and a wounded family behind her. She wins her husband back, buries a son and later opens her home to an adopted boy.

feats.scene: Sieorsa storms into a corridor and slaps a smug industrialist.
Sieorsa endures grief at a hospital bedside through the long night.

name: Erute
summary: Erute was touched by falling space rock as a child and can vanish and reappear elsewhere, but her frightened parents locked her inside a sealed room. As a teenager her devotion curdles into obsession and ends in tragedy.

feats.scene: Erute blinks behind a rival and drives her into a hard stone wall.
Erute collapses against a barred door but gets up with a stubborn glare.

name: Ronaliar
summary: Ronaliar is a conqueror from a distant age who bends whole populations into monstrous forms and commands them like a general. A hidden ray can undo his work, and he runs the moment his captives are cured.

feats.scene: Ronaliar twists a whole city district into obedient, snarling monsters.
Ronaliar staggers through a blast of purifying light before slipping away.

name: Ilstu
summary: Ilstu is a literate settler in a tiny frontier hamlet who watches a friend burned by a frightened mob. She records every culprit in a book that outlives her by centuries.
