feats.scene: Ilstu presses a quill to paper and names every face in the angry crowd.
Ilstu endures a freezing winter in a cabin of rough timber.

name: Rnicorton
summary: Rnicorton is a hairless grey ghoul who haunts a weird club at the edge of a black hole, drinking and dancing with other undead partygoers. He is more at home with the bass than with a fight.

feats.scene: Rnicorton hurls a bar stool across the club during a drunken scuffle.
Rnicorton takes a bottle to the skull and keeps dancing.

name: Saasi
summary: Saasi is a red-haired former tumbler who steals with her sister from rooftops and skylights. She flips, vaults and twists out of trouble, and the pair rarely agree except when a heist is on.

feats.scene: Saasi launches a flying kick and knocks a guard off a balcony.
Saasi lands badly on a fire escape and rolls straight back up.

name: Ninin
summary: Ninin is a young widow whose body is sealed in a living skin that makes her tough, strong and airborne. She joins a ragtag band of unlikely champions and learns to enjoy the attention.

feats.scene: Ninin dives into a parked van and flips it over a fence.
Ninin takes a point-blank volley from a heavy gun without a scratch.

name: Irnte
summary: Irnte is the many-armed queen of a swarm of giant insects living on a distant paradise, ruling the hive with a patient, clicking command. Her purple eyes miss nothing in the colony.

feats.scene: Irnte lashes out with four limbs and cracks a stone pillar.
Irnte's chitin turns aside a hail of hot shards.

name: Terser
summary: Terser is a sly she-demon bound to an older wizard and sent to seduce a boy magician. Freed of her bond, she takes up modelling and later guards a desert shrine in the shape of a sea-maid.

feats.scene: Terser reshapes herself into a hundred different faces within a single heartbeat.
Terser shrugs off a flaming blade through her ribs.

name: Ortate
summary: Ortate is the hugely overweight chief of a secretive order, brilliant and zealous yet ruined by his appetites. Staff and vehicles are rebuilt around him, and nobody dares to mention it until a rival pushes him from a helicopter.

feats.scene: Ortate slams a fist on a banquet table and silences a hall of loyal servants.
Ortate falls from a helicopter, a long drop from a great height.

name: Amlenter
summary: Amlenter is the wealthiest noble of a sunken city, a quiet widower who arranges a grand marriage for his son. At the feast he sits back with a drink, content to watch his family prosper.

feats.scene: Amlenter sets down a heavy goblet with a firm thump.
Amlenter breathes comfortably in the crushing depths.

name: Niastnen
summary: Niastnen is a towering robot formed when six metallic friends merge, each limb a different element and personality. It survives a disaster, joins a rebuilt team and is split in half when a bomb falls.

feats.scene: Niastnen hammers a rampaging monster through a building with a combined fist.
Niastnen is blown in half by a nuclear strike but fights until the end.

name: Amiar
summary: Amiar is a cold entity born from pure spite, bonded long ago with a gentle princess in a magical land. Sealed in a blade and freed by trickery, she curses anyone who loves the heroine of the tale.

feats.scene: Amiar casts a curse that drives a famous wizard out of the world.
Amiar endures long years sealed within an enchanted sword.

name: Collean
summary: Collean is a gentle mother who stays behind in a floating colony while her daughter ventures away to fetch a glowing relic. Her people carry strength and flight under the right sun.

feats.scene: Collean lifts a fallen beam off a trapped neighbour with one hand.
Collean waits calmly while a tremor shakes the dome overhead.

name: Urnreau
summary: Urnreau is the charismatic head of a cult that insists every person has a mirrored twin in a dark dimension. Armed with a pendant and a cursed gem, she tries to merge both worlds into one.

feats.scene: Urnreau channels a cursed gem to try to fuse two worlds into one.
Urnreau is knocked to the floor and keeps preaching.

name: Eoncolte
summary: Eoncolte is a round-faced chatterbox who wanders into two detective cases and drives everyone mad with his endless stream of talk. He means well and cannot stop speaking.

feats.scene: Eoncolte claps a heavy hand on a detective's shoulder mid-sentence.
Eoncolte trips over a curb and carries on talking.

name: Llitosan
summary: Llitosan is a brown-haired spy who ran field operations for a covert agency until an accusation of loyalty to a cult ended her career. She still moves unnoticed among the powerful.

feats.scene: Llitosan disarms a bodyguard in a crowded lobby with a swift wrist-lock.
Llitosan walks off a hard fall from a balcony.

name: Taseraus
summary: Taseraus is a white-eyed defence minister of an ancient world who designs a vast shield that a goddess blesses with her own power. He later seals it permanently so that his queen can never leave.

feats.scene: Taseraus smashes the controls of the shield with a heavy hammer.
Taseraus's sealed shield withstands a fleet of invading armies for years.

name: Rentorrne
summary: Rentorrne is a bald schemer who hides behind a title and troubles a masked avenger for a few weeks. His plans are loud, messy and ultimately fatal.

feats.scene: Rentorrne swings a heavy chair at a guard in a narrow office.
Rentorrne takes a beating in a back alley and keeps scheming.

name: Corstval
summary: Corstval is a gray-haired professor who builds a tiny window in time and fishes for relics with a magnet on a line. When memory fails him he tries to turn back his age and is cleaved in two.

feats.scene: Corstval drops a magnet into the shimmering gap and hauls up a rusted blade.
Corstval survives being cleaved by his own invention, half of him lost in time.

name: Tiuereaun
summary: Tiuereaun is a green-skinned technician with a knack for bending machinery to her will, recruited to study a celebrated flier. Her black hair and bright eyes hide a restless curiosity.

feats.scene: Tiuereaun twists a forklift into a metal knot with a flick of her fingers.
Tiuereaun is flung across a lab and bounces off a cabinet.

name: Telral
summary: Telral is a masked crusader of an old imperial city who dresses in bronze armour and carries a long spear. He trades on his fame, gains weight and dies stabbed many times in a very theatrical way.

feats.scene: Telral drives a spear through a wooden door and pins a thug behind it.
Telral takes a hard blow on his breastplate and stays upright.

name: Seirnnau
summary: Seirnnau patrols a sunlit city in a bronze cuirass, a protector who leaves his duties to his daughter when he falls. His name travels far beyond the streets he guarded.

feats.scene: Seirnnau parries a knife and flings the thief over his shoulder.
Seirnnau braces against a rolling barrel in a narrow lane.

name: Rianti
summary: Rianti is a young exile who was raised in disguise to escape the swords of a new dynasty, hidden with an uncle who studies alchemy. He is caught up in a chase for a legendary blade and an offering to a dragon.

feats.scene: Rianti hurls a stone at a snarling raider and bowls him over.
Rianti survives a harsh night bound to a sacrificial post.

name: Iumun
summary: Iumun is an immortal ruler of a drifting ocean realm who was once taken from her homeland and made a captive on a ship. Her people control weather above the waves, and a tyrant seizes her to bend them to his will.

feats.scene: Iumun's people unleash a storm over the waves with a giant weather machine.
Iumun remains a captive through a long night aboard a tyrant's ship.

name: Ressi
summary: Ressi is a brown-haired officer in an island queen's personal guard, trained in archery, riding and the blade. She follows her ruler into a foreign town and keeps close watch over her.

feats.scene: Ressi unhorses a rider with a single lance blow.
Ressi stands firm as a heavy wooden beam falls across her shoulders.

name: Tilcovas
summary: Tilcovas is the last of an army once raised from the damned to clear a haunted island, betrayed and slaughtered by the gods who promised them freedom. He hides for millennia and plots to claim the island at last.

feats.scene: Tilcovas rips a marble statue from its plinth and hurls it at a foe.
Tilcovas endures a god's wrath beneath a collapsing temple.

name: Valvalam
summary: Valvalam is a shape-shifting metal automaton, one of an evil set of mechanical duplicates built by a villainous copy of a scientist. He is quickly beaten and melted down.

feats.scene: Valvalam stretches a metal arm and slams a lab door off its hinges.
Valvalam's metallic body takes a heavy blow and dents without breaking.

name: Corsili
summary: Corsili is a distant memory in a story about a lost homeland, remembered only through a shard of a protective shield. That fragment keeps her daughter going through long nights.

feats.scene: Corsili is remembered by a girl clutching a splinter of glass.
Corsili's shield shard still glows after a catastrophic blast.

name: Valam
summary: Valam is a calm diplomat of a doomed floating colony, mother to a girl who will one day cross the stars. Her people can fly and shrug off harm, and she prefers talking to fighting.

feats.scene: Valam lifts a collapsed archway off a family trapped beneath.
Valam walks calmly through a rain of falling debris.

name: Nenseto
summary: Nenseto is a small-town reporter who writes an exposé of a gang boss and his friends in office. His reporting costs him dearly, but his son and granddaughters carry on in his footsteps.

feats.scene: Nenseto slams a typewriter carriage across the newsroom desk.
Nenseto takes a beating on a dark street and still files his story.

name: Tiarananu
summary: Tiarananu is a slightly built woman who calls herself a featherweight as a joke, yet flings armoured trucks into a building and partly brings it down. She joins an unlikely crew of thieves and keeps her real strength quiet.

feats.scene: Tiarananu hurls armoured vehicles into a block and partly collapses it.
Tiarananu shrugs off a hail of riot rounds without flinching.

name: Arrnu
summary: Arrnu is a cheerful chef and café owner who once poured drinks by night and painted by day. She takes in a secretive roommate, marches for causes she believes in and sweeps up after her wife.

feats.scene: Arrnu hoists a heavy sack of flour onto the counter.
Arrnu works a double shift in a steaming kitchen.

name: Amosorcor
summary: Amosorcor is a gentle boy who wants to free his homeland without more bloodshed and agrees to carry the lightning of an old sage if his uncle is saved. His uncle's greed ends the boy's life and takes the power.

feats.scene: Amosorcor calls down a bolt that shatters a slaver's palace gate.
Amosorcor stands in the open as the lightning wraps around him.

name: Irnnti
summary: Irnnti is a vengeful teenager who climbs into her imprisoned father's war machine and goes on a rampage through the city. She is brought down by exposed cables, serves her time and finds love.

feats.scene: Irnnti smashes a row of storefronts with the mechanical fists of a giant walker.
Irnnti rides out a heavy barrage inside the walker's armour.

name: Tesern
summary: Tesern is an efficient executive who runs a giant corporation while its owner serves a long prison sentence. Her loyalty to him goes beyond business.

feats.scene: Tesern stamps a signature on a stack of contracts with a firm slap.
Tesern endures a marathon boardroom day without a break.

name: Rnrnra
summary: Rnrnra is a blonde tech worker who joins a shadowy government agency after leaving a tower of glass and steel. She types quickly and cracks jokes about sports.

feats.scene: Rnrnra bangs on a keyboard and shuts down a rival's firewall.
Rnrnra keeps working through a day of heavy alarms.

name: Numeo
summary: Numeo is a skilled surgeon at a busy hospital who treats a gifted engineer when he starts work there. She is brisk, kind and rarely rattled by a bleeding patient.

feats.scene: Numeo presses down hard on a wound to stop the bleeding.
Numeo stays on her feet through a thirty-hour shift.

name: Miltau
summary: Miltau is a hardened government handler who leads a squad of expendable agents into a nightmare. Her team is wiped out by a horde of walking corpses, and her authority cannot save them.

feats.scene: Miltau fires a rifle at a shambling corpse in a dark corridor.
Miltau survives a night of terror in a bunker.

name: Rantirer
summary: Rantirer is a cold-eyed marshal of a drowned-coast kingdom who serves the throne while quietly plotting to wear it; she trusts drilled soldiers and patient treachery over any gift of power.

feats.scene: Rantirer cleaves through a rival officer's shield with a single blade stroke during a palace coup.
Rantirer shrugs off a cavalry charge that slams her against a rampart wall.

name: Leorta
summary: Leorta is a recruit turned spymaster who survives a scrapheap duel with a weaponised alien machine by baiting it beside a truckload of explosives; she later runs a hidden bureau that hunts visitors from other worlds.

feats.scene: Leorta lures the metal horror next to the loaded truck and the blast leaves a crater where the yard once stood.
Leorta is thrown clear by the detonation and wakes up bruised but alive.

name: Lonuter
summary: Lonuter is a twin from across the channel who wears a little raincloud badge on her outfit and calls up soaking downpours to flush foes out of cover; she speaks two languages and prefers drenching enemies to hurting them.

feats.scene: Lonuter gathers a heavy storm front over a refugee camp and drops a flood that sweeps attackers off their feet.
Lonuter takes a thrown crate on the shoulder and keeps singing to her clouds.

name: Lloti
summary: Lloti is a bald, mushroom-like space cop whose ring shapes glowing constructs, shields and bolts; he is rounded up with his peers and used as fuel for a tyrant's doomsday device.

feats.scene: Lloti fires a green bolt that cracks an asteroid-sized fortress wall.
Lloti hides behind a ring shield while a rival battery drains his reserves.

name: Torcor
summary: Torcor is a four-foot fungal being from a swamp planet who paints its beauty and speaks so slowly that conversation takes patience; his mind is said to see the whole universe, and rumour calls him older than his own order's founders.

feats.scene: Torcor, after a very long pause, projects a green lance that pierces a drifting warship hull.
Torcor drifts for years in open space with nothing but his own patience to keep him alive.

name: Ceoliti
summary: Ceoliti is a small, fungus-bodied peacekeeper stationed on a distant hub world, armed with a power ring that builds shields, weapons and wings of light; his will is steady and his manner gentle.

feats.scene: Ceoliti hurls a green construct hammer that flattens a pirate cruiser's engine block.
Ceoliti sits inside a ring force field as raiders pound it for an hour.

name: Varre
summary: Varre is a mechanical menace built to echo every ability of a team of heroes; when a catastrophe strips all living wonders of their gifts, its metal body stays whole and it tries to profit from the chaos.

feats.scene: Varre rips a bank vault door from its hinges and flings it across a street.
Varre keeps marching through a tank barrage that scorches its plating.

name: Anstrn
summary: Anstrn is a red-eyed machine that borrows any ability it witnesses, from spinning cyclones to bendy limbs and ghostly passage; it is pieced together by a scheming inventor and turns up whenever he wants a fight.

feats.scene: Anstrn fires a stolen atomic blast that melts a lab's concrete roof.
Anstrn endures a hero's thrown wreckage and keeps advancing with one arm hanging loose.
Anstrn copies a speedster's gait and crosses a warehouse in a blink.

name: Nuntevi
summary: Nuntevi is a hulking guard-robot with burning eyes and a heavy punch, steered by a tiny pilot from inside its head; it is deployed to quash a jailbreak at a villains' lockup.

feats.scene: Nuntevi blasts a cell wall with a beam from its eyes until the bricks glow.
Nuntevi absorbs a prisoner's fire-blast and its paint blisters.

name: Annau
summary: Annau is an eight-foot artificial man whose absorbent cells let him mimic the gifts of every hero he meets. Built by an immortality-obsessed inventor, he outgrows his orders and nurses a bitter rivalry with a time-lost hourglass hero.

feats.scene: Annau mimics a flying hero's strength and drives a fist through a bridge pylon.
Annau sits in a sealed chamber for years and walks out undamaged.

name: Tellluinu
summary: Tellluinu is a synthetic copy-engine created as an experiment long before any hero alliance existed; it later becomes a pawn of villain syndicates and infiltrates a floating hero base to test a lone masked fighter.

feats.scene: Tellluinu blasts a hole through a satellite hull using a power it has just copied.
Tellluinu is scattered into pieces and keeps twitching in separate crates.

name: Ceolltum
summary: Ceolltum is a bronze machine from a dead cosmos who burns his own planet, then slaughters every living thing he finds before swallowing a doctrine of despair; he batters the walls of a mirror chamber until reality shudders across many worlds.

feats.scene: Ceolltum shatters his home world into drifting rubble with one concentrated surge.
Ceolltum keeps pounding a barrier of living mirrors that would flatten a sun.

name: Levaes
summary: Levaes is a plant-descended mercenary hired to fill a corporate strike team after its young members are dismissed. Little is known about her beyond a steady paycheck and a quiet temper.

feats.scene: Levaes whips a thorned vine across a security door and splinters it.
Levaes takes a hard fall onto concrete and stands up without complaint.

name: Stirnirus
summary: Stirnirus is a teenage flyer from a small city who helps a boy cross the country when the usual shortcuts fail. At midnight on her birthday she is flung into another world and plummets until a hero catches her.

feats.scene: Stirnirus hauls the throttle back and pulls a light aircraft out of a dive.
Stirnirus survives a terrifying drop through open sky before being scooped up.
Stirnirus pushes her little plane to full speed across the coast.

name: Rumte
summary: Rumte is a blond young woman bred as one of a new generation of engineered fighters, whose body splits into endless duplicates; her copies are used as targets until she escapes and joins other runaways.

feats.scene: Rumte splits into a dozen copies that all tackle a guard at once.
Rumte endures a firing range of rifles as the targets are replaced by fresh duplicates.

name: Stnira
summary: Stnira is a blond, wisecracking dabbler in dark arts who bears a strong resemblance to a famous trenchcoated conjurer; he tracks a loose fiend to a suburban house and distracts it while a friend slips away.

feats.scene: Stnira chalks a binding sigil and sends a minor fiend tumbling across a kitchen.
Stnira tumbles down a flight of stairs and keeps up his patter.

name: Tieon
summary: Tieon is a thundering showoff who gains the power to drain current from any wire after a cosmic accident; he speaks in a grandiose old-fashioned way and conjures serpents of crackling light.

feats.scene: Tieon sends a bolt of lightning through a subway tunnel and blows out the lights of a whole district.
Tieon is overloaded by a rail's raw current and vanishes in white fire.

name: Amvas
summary: Amvas is a monocled schemer who plans to steal a legendary youth-giving spring by sneaking a gullible accomplice onto a guarded island; the plot collapses when the water dries up the moment an outsider reaches for it.

feats.scene: Amvas jams a hidden radio in a coat pocket to steer his accomplice along the shore.
Amvas stumbles into a thorn hedge and comes out only scratched.

name: Soniarvar
summary: Soniarvar is a nervous, brown-haired camera operator who follows a news reporter into a strange story; he is happiest when he is filming and has no special gift beyond a steady hand.

feats.scene: Soniarvar swings his heavy camera rig into a thug's elbow.
Soniarvar bounces off a van door and still gets the shot.

name: Lanumror
summary: Lanumror is a polite money manager for a crime family in daylight and a purple-haired road racer after dark. A fiend borrows her body and turns her tidy life upside down, so she carries a grudge against its human partner.

feats.scene: Lanumror channels the fiend and flips a speeding sports car across three lanes.
Lanumror walks away from a high-speed wreck with only a cracked lip.
Lanumror hits top speed on a night highway with her engine screaming.

name: Rainsi
summary: Rainsi is the daughter of a cooking-pot costumed vigilante and joins a gang of kid helpers; she grows up to marry and keeps the family's scrappy habit of jumping into trouble.

feats.scene: Rainsi hurls a bucket of flour into a burglar's face.
Rainsi gets knocked off a fence and bounces right back up.

name: Vamonmil
summary: Vamonmil is a former pickpocket revived after being run down by a truck and rebuilt with a strange metal; she steals kinetic force from anything she touches and turns it into brief bursts of velocity.

feats.scene: Vamonmil siphons the motion from a charging bruiser and slams into a wall at full speed.
Vamonmil survives a truck collision on a city street before her rebuilding.
Vamonmil dashes down an alley powered by stolen momentum.

name: Tilnolneo
summary: Tilnolneo is an ancient desert priest-sorcerer who fakes his death by sleeping through the centuries, then wakes in modern times intending to rule; his spells prove no match for a stage magician, and his body is blown to powder.

feats.scene: Tilnolneo calls down a sandstorm that peels the roof from a stone temple.
Tilnolneo is reduced to dust by a counter-spell and scatters on the wind.

name: Ticolas
summary: Ticolas is a tall, shaven angel sent to drag a prodigal sibling home, who ends up a father, a patrol officer and finally a ruler of paradise; he can slow time around him and cannot be slain by ordinary means.

feats.scene: Ticolas smashes through a concrete overpass with one heavenly shove.
Ticolas stands unmoved as a fuel depot erupts around him.

name: Sorcorleo
summary: Sorcorleo is a proud, white-haired angel of an upper choir who despises a rebel sibling and sets out to wipe him from existence; he leads a doomed host against a doorway to an empty creation and refuses to bend even when his side takes heavy losses.

feats.scene: Sorcorleo hurls a lance of holy light that levels a hillside.
Sorcorleo stands against a rebel's blazing counter-attack and only steps back once.

name: Liaer
summary: Liaer is a patriotic super-soldier from a distant race who leads a squad of avengers and rallies fighters from across many worlds against an invading darkness; he is eventually undone when a warlord's schemes ignite a nuclear war.

feats.scene: Liaer punches through a rival's armoured hull and caves in a wall of the city.
Liaer holds his ground against a rain of alien artillery.

name: Ntoamo
summary: Ntoamo is a flag-draped militia man in an exaggerated costume who leads armed followers against newcomers at a harbour monument; he is stopped by a team of strong heroes before his scheme does lasting harm.

feats.scene: Ntoamo clubs a startled bystander with the butt of a rifle.
Ntoamo is tossed across a pier and breaks his fall on the rail.

name: Iltor
summary: Iltor is a blond princess with violet eyes who sits on a panel of royals that coach a friend through a ritual combat; she is quick to bow when the friend wins.

feats.scene: Iltor flicks a gem-tipped wand and sends a gilded chair skidding across a throne room.
Iltor is knocked back by a sparring blow and shakes it off with a laugh.

name: Luall
summary: Luall is a pink-skinned warrior of a conquering race who rises to forge weapons for her empire; when she learns her masters serve a darker patron, she defects and ends up raising a child for a tycoon.

feats.scene: Luall hammers a glowing blade into shape and cuts a steel plate in half.
Luall wades through a blaster volley behind a forged shield.

name: Niutil
summary: Niutil is a white-haired colonial sorceress burned for her craft, who lays a curse that lets her possess her own descendants. Through them she hunts the heirs of her killers for centuries.

feats.scene: Niutil hurls a ghostly flame that brings down the beams of an old academy hall.
Niutil is burned at the stake yet her spirit keeps whispering from the ashes.

name: Riatavar
summary: Riatavar is the calm, brown-haired chief of a hidden settlement who greets a stranger as a long-awaited saviour; he has a daughter and a settled belief that destiny sent his guest.

feats.scene: Riatavar shoves open a heavy timber gate to welcome the visitor.
Riatavar stands firm as a gust of dust sweeps through the village square.

name: Cecer
summary: Cecer is a yellow-skinned, orange-haired space guardian who is drafted alongside her spouse the very day they wed; she gives birth mid-battle, then quits the order for love and settles at home with her family.

feats.scene: Cecer fires a ring beam that pins a fanatical hunter against a hull.
Cecer wraps her newborn in a ring shield as the fight rages around them.

name: Laseolium
summary: Laseolium is a physicist who stumbles into a pocket cosmos during an experiment and becomes a walking pocket cosmos himself, with rules of his own; he drifts between his private space and ordinary reality and joins a secretive league.

feats.scene: Laseolium opens his private cosmos wide and swallows a collapsing tower block.
Laseolium lets a rocket strike pass through him as if he were a mirage.

name: Nauirnium
summary: Nauirnium is a dark-haired chemist who drinks a serum that lets him split into copies of himself; he commits offences across a dozen cities simultaneously until an antidote ends the scheme.

feats.scene: Nauirnium and a dozen duplicates empty several vaults in the same minute.
Nauirnium is hammered by a flying hero and dissolves back into one body.

name: Niuta
summary: Niuta is an ambitious northern thug who wants fame by beating the strongest hero in the city. A stolen boost makes him fearsome for a while, until the surge of energy inside him overloads and kills him.

feats.scene: Niuta explodes in a final blast that takes the front off a warehouse.
Niuta takes a punch that would fell a bull and keeps swinging.

name: Lennti
summary: Lennti is a pink-skinned brute from a warlike race who joins an interstellar police force despite the distrust of his kin; when he returns home his reputation is wrecked, so he becomes a hired gun.

feats.scene: Lennti flings a rioter through a plank barricade with one arm.
Lennti brushes off a barrage of stun rounds in a crowded plaza.

name: Tontau
summary: Tontau is a prince who thinks himself a living deity after receiving a borrowed gift of lightning and flight. Grief over his sister's death pushes him to vote for annihilating both sides of a war with a beam from orbit.

feats.scene: Tontau calls down a spear of lightning that bursts a bridge span.
Tontau walks out of a collapsed palace wing without a mark.

name: Rnnin
summary: Rnnin is a white-haired swindler who gains a gift for reading and bending minds after being tortured by alien scientists; when calm he can persuade people of nearly anything, and he joins a roving band of survivors.

feats.scene: Rnnin murmurs a story into a guard's mind and the man unlocks a gate.
Rnnin survives an ordeal of flames that kills most of the captives.

name: Ntonumst
summary: Ntonumst is a cruel organ-collecting killer from a volcanic planet who is recruited into a fear-powered army; he prefers his glowing ring to his fists and slips back home to resume his crimes.

feats.scene: Ntonumst fires a yellow ring blast that pierces a landing craft.
Ntonumst shrugs off a counter-volley behind a ring shell.

name: Vaeru
summary: Vaeru is a smiling gangster in one century and a galaxy-spanning tyrant in another, who claims to be older than time; her swarming minions kill half a team of heroes while she takes a world with ease.

feats.scene: Vaeru erases a fleet of warships with a wave of her hand.
Vaeru lets a champion's strongest blow land on her and smiles.

name: Cocelone
summary: Cocelone is a small brown-and-white capuchin who is the only male creature left alive after a plague wipes out the rest; he tags along with his owner as a loyal companion.

feats.scene: Cocelone swats a fruit off a high branch and into his owner's lap.
Cocelone rides out the plague that kills every other male, showing no fever.

name: Sanlanval
summary: Sanlanval is a blue-haired black-market boss who runs a hidden trading ring for outlaws and wipes the memories of anyone who leaves. After altering her ex-partner's potion, she can graft steel onto skin and sculpt it.

feats.scene: Sanlanval merges a steel girder into her arm and swings it through a wall.
Sanlanval takes a flurry of blows on a hardened metal forearm.

name: Talnumll
summary: Talnumll is a silver-skinned fighter whose body is coated in a quantum metal, granting near invulnerability, strength, flight and bursts of concussive energy; she joins a young team briefly, then leaves to chase her own agenda.

feats.scene: Talnumll blasts a rival's armoured tank with a concussive burst over the sea.
Talnumll is hit by a tank shell and takes no harm.
Talnumll streaks over the waves toward a battle.

name: Arniaamo
summary: Arniaamo is a tiny silver-haired schoolkid who treats jeans and a shirt as a perfect costume and shows off a shiny armour skin; she lives in a toddler town of heroes and has a stubborn obsession.

feats.scene: Arniaamo bops a toy robot over a sandbox fence.
Arniaamo bounces off a playground slide with a metallic ring.

name: Tircor
summary: Tircor is a fifteen-year-old bullied at school who talks to a beetle, leaks strange strange ooze out of her soles, and discovers she can command round objects by calling up her moments of shame. Squares are her enemies and circles her friends.

feats.scene: Tircor hurls a rolling ball that bursts the locker of a bully.
Tircor is chased across a schoolyard by a square-headed tormentor and trips but gets up.

name: Tater
summary: Tater is a blond woman from a rough, disreputable world who falls into a grubby lifestyle and lures a former sweetheart home as bait; her betrayal ends in her murder at the hands of a space-bound villain.

feats.scene: Tater slaps a stranger across the face on a dim street.
Tater is killed by a single strike from a schemer.

name: Llriarni
summary: Llriarni is a warrior of an island sisterhood who trains a visiting young hero and stays friendly with her even after they end up on opposite sides; she is skilled with bow, horse and blade.

feats.scene: Llriarni shoots an arrow through a straw target at full gallop.
Llriarni takes a hit from a rival's spear shaft and keeps riding.

name: Mioll
summary: Mioll is a blue-eyed partisan who works with allied troops during a long war and fails in an attempt to kill a brutal officer; she is caught and shot, and the cloak she wore passes to a teenager who avenges her.

feats.scene: Mioll fires a pistol at an officer's motorcade from a hay barn.
Mioll is beaten in a cell and refuses to speak.

name: Ntocol
summary: Ntocol is a troubled man who invents a fantasy of being a vengeful time traveller, wears a centurion-like costume and carries a doctored pistol that he swears is a futuristic ray; he has no true powers, only a deep grudge.

feats.scene: Ntocol fires his doctored handgun at a statue and chips the stone.
Ntocol tumbles off a ledge in his costume and crawls away.

name: Cisnte
summary: Cisnte is a trickster deity of a savannah people, known only by name to the heroes who inherit a gifted totem from him; he is distant, amused and rarely seen.

feats.scene: Cisnte conjures a dust devil that flattens a village market in an instant.
Cisnte laughs as a collapsing hillside passes harmlessly through him.

name: Sereias
summary: Sereias is a celebrated coastal folk hero who borrows a weaver-spirit's gift of tales to conjure lifelike illusions and cling to sheer walls; his acrobatics are sharp, though he leans heavily on a charm for his magic.

feats.scene: Sereias spins a phantom stampede out of thin air and scatters a gang of poachers.
Sereias slides down a cliff face and lands in a crouch without a scratch.

name: Sercostu
summary: Sercostu is a blond runner built in a lab as one of three engineered sprinters, who sets up a courier business after emigrating; he delivers parcels at astonishing speed, even while unknowingly carrying ingredients for a dangerous stimulant.

feats.scene: Sercostu skids to a halt and sends a cardboard crate through a shop window.
Sercostu is ambushed by two addicts and ends up in a hospital bed but returns within days.
Sercostu streaks along a highway shoulder faster than any truck.

name: Ratant
summary: Ratant is a surly inmate with a mechanical hand, locked up in a jail for outlaws; his plans to join a breakout end early when a guard machine executes him on the spot.

feats.scene: Ratant crushes a steel mug in his mechanical grip and hurls it at a guard.
Ratant is slammed against his cell bars and keeps scowling.

name: Nelastnu
summary: Nelastnu is a cartoonishly menacing villain who prowls a snowbound capital. A caped crimefighter flies in to haul him in.

feats.scene: Nelastnu swings a chain at a lamppost and bends the pole.
Nelastnu tumbles down an icy stair and glares up undaunted.

name: Talsor
summary: Talsor is a blond, six-foot-three hired killer trained in many fighting arts and fitted with machine-boosted limbs that rip a person in half. Cut loose after his masters disbanded, he freelances as a mercenary with a grudge against a young sidekick.

feats.scene: Talsor tears a steel door off its frame and tosses it at pursuers.
Talsor walks off a gunfight with only a few bullets lodged in his vest.

name: Neoleovor
summary: Neoleovor is a bald, blue-eyed lieutenant in a crime ring based in a gloomy metropolis, handy with a pistol and basic brawling; he answers to a brother and enjoys the power of a crime lord's chair.

feats.scene: Neoleovor empties a pistol into a parked car as a warning.
Neoleovor is thrown over a bar counter and stands back up.

name: Inusoal
summary: Inusoal is a tough, brown-haired boss of a sprawling crime syndicate who relies on guns, hard interrogation and ruthless leadership; he has crossed paths with a hooded archer for years.

feats.scene: Inusoal fires a rifle through a warehouse window at a distant target.
Inusoal takes a savage beating in a gym and laughs it off.

name: Lesmeres
summary: Lesmeres is a brown-haired fighter from a rival island sisterhood who learns photography from a royal visitor and is hurt in a bombing. Later she frees prisoners so they can help defend the world.

feats.scene: Lesmeres draws a bow and lands an arrow in the centre of a straw dummy at fifty paces.
Lesmeres is caught when a bomb goes off and recovers in a hospital bed.

name: Innan
summary: Innan is a white-haired matriarch who shelters her children in a baron's castle when her country is overrun in war; she helps tend a wounded flyer and slowly realises that her eldest son has dark plans.

feats.scene: Innan hauls a wounded stranger onto a cart and drives it through a muddy lane.
Innan keeps walking through a snowstorm with a child on each arm.

name: Leslia
summary: Leslia is the stern top lawman of a hawk-people world, doubtful at first about the policing ways of a faraway planet. Two of his officers persuade him to keep their mission going and adopt computer files for criminals.

feats.scene: Leslia slams a baton on a desk and splits the wood.
Leslia takes a stun-bolt to the chest and keeps issuing orders.

name: Nallaau
summary: Nallaau is a grey-haired immigrant scientist who works at an atomic research centre and later builds a mind-regulating machine for an asylum; under a clown's thrall he briefly dons a scarlet cowl and turns criminal.

feats.scene: Nallaau switches on a radiation lamp that cooks a steel plate through.
Nallaau stumbles through a laboratory fire with singed sleeves.

name: Sucol
summary: Sucol is a green-skinned reptilian sorceress, once a vain huntress who spilled innocent blood to win a jealous bargain with a forest god; she is lynched and returns as a monstrous witch of the jungle.

feats.scene: Sucol hurls a curse that withers an acre of jungle in a moment.
Sucol survives a mob's rope and fire and rises as a monster.

name: Oraorian
summary: Oraorian is a black-haired aviator who flies for an elite squadron of wartime pilots; he pilots a twin-engine fighter against enemy aircraft until he falls in a later war.

feats.scene: Oraorian strafes a convoy of trucks with his fighter's cannons.
Oraorian crashes through a wooden barn roof and walks away.
Oraorian pushes his fighter plane into a long power dive.

name: Nialuast
summary: Nialuast is a dapper, green-eyed pilot and resistance leader who plans daring raids, speaks many tongues and trains a team's pet hawk. Decades later he tinkers with machines under a new alias and ends up running a supper club.

feats.scene: Nialuast dive-bombs a bridge and drops a span into the river.
Nialuast bails out of a burning cockpit and lands in a haystack.
Nialuast races his jet low over the countryside.

name: Tiaroram
summary: Tiaroram is a bald spymaster for a global assembly who convinces its delegates to field an international squad of super-powered peacekeepers; his speeches argue that governments are broke and short on options.

feats.scene: Tiaroram slams a folder down on a conference table to make his point.
Tiaroram is shoved back by protesters at the steps and keeps talking.

name: Iurnice
summary: Iurnice is a nobleman and fighter pilot who rules the skies of an old trench war, wearing a violet mask and a rope about his neck to frighten rivals; he is the sworn foe of a lone enemy ace.

feats.scene: Iurnice rakes an enemy biplane with machine-gun fire until it spirals down.
Iurnice nurses a shot-up biplane home on a single wing.
Iurnice chases a rival through low cloud at full throttle.

name: Asicoial
summary: Asicoial is a black-haired cat burglar and member of a gang of evil masterminds, skilled mostly at lifting valuables from locked rooms; he is a nuisance to teen heroes.

feats.scene: Asicoial picks a lock in seconds and slips a gem into his pocket.
Asicoial drops from a window ledge, rolls and sprints off.

source_title: Andre Le Blanc (Teen Titans TV Series)

name: Rnuri
summary: Rnuri is a schoolgirl who takes a strange gadget from her father's luggage and discovers it grants her temporary powers whenever she dials; she uses it to cope with a new school and creates convincing illusions.

feats.scene: Rnuri dials up a phantom monster that panics a corridor of students.
Rnuri shrugs off a shove from a bully while holding the gadget close.

name: Terniva
summary: Terniva is a restless wanderer who spends years searching the globe for her missing father; she keeps an old flame close with postcards from every stop and leaves a voicemail urging an old flame to be careful.

feats.scene: Terniva hauls a heavy trunk up a gangway at a foreign dock.
Terniva sleeps rough through a cold monsoon without complaint.

name: Reoosant
summary: Reoosant is a red-haired masked avenger who stalks the leaders of a city's underworld after a loss in her youth leaves her bitter; she trained in fighting arts and now strikes from shadow, torn between love and revenge.

feats.scene: Reoosant slices a gangster's rifle in two with a curved blade.
Reoosant takes a flying kick and rolls back to her feet.
Reoosant sprints along a rooftop edge in the dark.

name: Tirni
summary: Tirni is a seven-foot, white-haired hybrid hero formed by merging two lost people, one a troubled woman and one a crippled rider remade with horse genes; the merged being brags with a comedian's patter and claims to be a love-driven angel.

feats.scene: Tirni gallops into a lorry and overturns it with a shoulder charge.
Tirni shrugs off a collapsing grandstand and keeps joking.

name: Maasi
summary: Maasi is a masked street avenger whose strength comes from a transplanted heart bathed in alien radiation from a meteor shower; she hunts the gang that killed her mother and briefly teams up with a farm boy.

feats.scene: Maasi flips a parked van onto its side to block gunmen.
Maasi takes a knife in the chest and survives only thanks to the new organ.

name: Llita
summary: Llita is a masked young mutant who gives up his life by diving into the heart of a star-devouring monster. Powered up by borrowed antimatter for three days, he reaches the creature's living core and wrecks it when all others fail.

feats.scene: Llita rams the monster's glowing core and detonates it from within.
Llita endures the heat of a superheated core long enough to reach its heart.

name: Anlumi
summary: Anlumi is a blond, tireless flyer on a floating fortress built to watch for cosmic threats; he can shoot heat blasts and shrug off bullets, yet a lurking entity vaporises him in a blink.

feats.scene: Anlumi fires a heat blast that carves a glowing trench across an ice field.
Anlumi takes a missile barrage at point blank and is merely singed.
Anlumi shoots out of an airlock and circles the carrier at high speed.

name: Llcorto
summary: Llcorto is a red-haired, blue-eyed girl born of an ocean king and queen who grows up with a village of sea deities watching over her; she is brash and fearless, with a royal lineage that runs deep.

feats.scene: Llcorto commands a tidal surge to swamp a harbour wall.
Llcorto dives from a high cliff into the swell and surfaces laughing.

name: Iumveomi
summary: Iumveomi is a blonde assassin who rises to lead a hidden sisterhood of warriors founded in the hills; under her command the order hires out its blades to whoever pays most, and her rule ends when she moves to kill a rival.

feats.scene: Iumveomi cuts down three guards with a curved sword in a single sweep.
Iumveomi takes a spear thrust on her armour and counter-strikes.

name: Resnum
summary: Resnum is a dark-haired warrior reborn from a magic well, who once taught schoolchildren in a big city; she excels at athletics and combat in her new life and is shortlisted to take over a guardian's post.

feats.scene: Resnum bests a sparring partner in the circle with a disarming twist.
Resnum is flung across the arena floor and rolls up ready to fight.

name: Sareo
summary: Sareo is a vigilante in the tropics who turns into a clawed, fanged beast wreathed in hellfire and wrapped in mystic chains; his body shrugs off intense heat and he can hold down a strong sea-themed brute.

feats.scene: Sareo swings his glowing chains through a loading crane and drops it on a smuggler's truck.
Sareo wades into a pit of burning coals and comes out unharmed.

name: Aulen
summary: Aulen is a yellow-eyed trainee villain whose power comes from the feathered wings on her back; she can shrink them to hide them or stretch them out until they nearly dwarf her.

feats.scene: Aulen beats her enlarged wings and sends a table of papers flying across a classroom.
Aulen is knocked into a bin on landing and flaps free.
Aulen glides across the rooftops of her city.

name: Amlara
summary: Amlara is a platinum-blond urbanite with a keen eye for photographs and a big online audience; when a thief steals her bag, she cheers for her rescuer and spreads the word to every follower.

feats.scene: Amlara swings her handbag at a fleeing thief and misses.
Amlara trips on a kerb and springs up smiling for a selfie.

name: Rileose
summary: Rileose is a platinum-blond private eye who works cases alongside a talkative ape partner. Their agency solves odd mysteries in the city with more charm than muscle.

feats.scene: Rileose bonks a suspect on the head with a rolled-up newspaper.
Rileose hops out of a skidding taxi and dusts off her coat.

source_title: Angel O'Day (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Iavalere
summary: Iavalere is a bald, tall enforcer who escapes a prison riot with a masked terrorist and becomes his second in command; he sets up a base in a nightclub in a new city and gets caught after a short scuffle.

feats.scene: Iavalere smashes a bar stool across a rival gang member's back.
Iavalere takes a flying kick to the jaw and goes down only after a second blow.

name: Santi
summary: Santi is an orange-haired mercenary with unexplained gifts who is hired alongside others to guard an amusement park; she earns her pay by making trouble for a masked local hero.

feats.scene: Santi cracks a turnstile with a single glowing swipe.
Santi is thrown into a ticket booth and brushes off the splinters.

name: Nolelreo
summary: Nolelreo is a black-haired broadcaster who reports broadcasts aloft in a chopper as villains besiege a great hall of heroes; her calm voice cuts through the chaos of the assault.

feats.scene: Nolelreo points her microphone at the burning facade and narrates the attack.
Nolelreo grips her seat as the helicopter shudders in the blast wave.

name: Ntoraunt
summary: Ntoraunt is a blonde, blue-eyed homemaker who raises foster daughters with her wife and fusses over a house pest. One of the girls grows up to wield a ring of emerald light.

feats.scene: Ntoraunt swats a rolled magazine at a scurrying creature in the kitchen.
Ntoraunt slips on a wet floor and laughs it off.

source_title: Angela Cruz (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Iarnren
summary: Iarnren is a blue-eyed schemer who projects crippling fear into her victims' minds and drags young heroes through their worst nightmares; her illusions fail if a target realises what is going on.

feats.scene: Iarnren floods a tower with waking nightmares and drops its defenders to their knees.
Iarnren is cornered by a hero who has walled off his mind, and loses her hold.

source_title: Angela Hawkins III (Teen Titans TV Series)

name: Orllo
summary: Orllo is a blond forensic scientist who studies the cold blue fire left behind after a museum is wrecked; she falls for a visitor from another reality and agrees to marry him before he vanishes.

feats.scene: Orllo scrapes a sample of strange flame residue into a glass vial.
Orllo stays calm while the lab shudders from a nearby explosion.

name: Valmiast
summary: Valmiast is a black-haired runaway who joins a devil-worshipping circle and is chosen as bride of a demon king; she flees to a quiet realm of mystics and raises a gifted daughter under a new name.

feats.scene: Valmiast scatters a candle ring with a pulse of dark magic as she flees.
Valmiast endures a night of dread in a cellar and walks out at dawn.

name: Liium
summary: Liium is a silver-eyed machine-bodied commander whose blood is replaced with tiny builders, letting her reshape her limbs, stretch, throw up shields and fire energy. A devolving gadget twists her mind and she plans to erase humanity before her ship is blown apart.

feats.scene: Liium reshapes her arm into a cannon and blows a hole in a warship's hull.
Liium is buried beneath rubble after her ship crashes and is thought dead.

name: Riant
summary: Riant is a green-eyed prodigy who grew up building circuits as a child and later swaps her blood for liquid machines; her metal-flecked body lets her fly and craft rockets, weapons and spare lungs from nothing.

feats.scene: Riant grows a rocket engine from her back and carries a crowd away from a collapsing tower.
Riant re-forms her body after a blast tears her torso apart.
Riant rockets across the sky above her flying base.

name: Rnicorun
summary: Rnicorun is a scarred, one-eyed spy who feeds a mercenary information on his targets and has a healing factor from lab tinkering; she survives a skull-cracking punch and keeps sniffing out secrets.

feats.scene: Rnicorun breaks a captive's finger to make him talk.
Rnicorun shrugs off a skull fracture and is on her feet within days.

name: Lirnuaul
summary: Lirnuaul is a young girl in a bayou town who has a telepathic knack; she uses it to work out that her new friend, frozen in stone, is a queen in hiding.

feats.scene: Lirnuaul reaches into the mind of a statue-still friend and hears her story.
Lirnuaul stays up through a thunderstorm while reading the thoughts of the neighbourhood.

name: Nareamo
summary: Nareamo is a black-haired scholar of ruins who is mortally hurt in a booby trap and rebuilt by a masked patron into a flying, talon-handed agent of his team; the pain slowly unhinges her, and she dies in an arena of fighters.

feats.scene: Nareamo hurls a bolt of energy that cracks a stone pillar.
Nareamo is clawed and burned in a pit fight and keeps swinging.

name: Tellital
summary: Tellital is a white-haired freelance soldier who commands a roving team of mercenaries for hire across the continent; she is known for hard bargains and professional coldness.

feats.scene: Tellital storms a compound at the head of her squad and fires the first volley.
Tellital takes a rifle butt to the jaw and answers with a kick.

name: Veooll
summary: Veooll is a brown-haired master thief who bends reality with a special tool that lets him slip past the law. After a rival steals the tool, he drops back to cheap tricks and gets a crush on a warrior who catches him.

feats.scene: Veooll warps the space around a museum vault so its door opens onto the street.
Veooll is tackled on a gallery floor and gives up quietly.

name: Cilta
summary: Cilta is a scheming swindler who plans every robbery by finding a sideways route round locks and witnesses. Cilta pins the blame on respectable neighbours, but has no gift beyond a sharp, patient mind.

feats.scene: Cilta shoves a safe-door shut on a guard's hand in a panicked getaway.
Cilta tumbles down a flight of warehouse stairs and walks away bruised.

name: Liseren
summary: Liseren is a gang boss who loves inventing fresh schemes and tried to trick a famed warrior into unmasking herself. The plan collapsed, and Liseren ended up in a prison cell with a long sentence.

feats.scene: Liseren swings a cane at a rival's hat and knocks it across the alley.
Liseren takes a fist to the jaw during the arrest and stays upright.

name: Toraulrus
summary: Toraulrus is a masked agent of a ruthless businesswoman who wields a borrowed gadget able to fold space and fracture moments of time. A reinforced costume boosts the device, making Toraulrus a menace to any opponent.

feats.scene: Toraulrus tears open a rift beneath a bridge deck and drops half the span into it.
Toraulrus absorbs a tank shell on the boosted costume and keeps advancing.

name: Siiacel
summary: Siiacel is a pale-haired arms broker who designs and sells weapons through a big defence firm, then diverts stolen prototypes to street crews. Siiacel relies on henchmen and firearms rather than any power.

feats.scene: Siiacel fires a handgun at a pursuing van and shatters its windscreen.
Siiacel survives a rough tumble from a moving crate truck.

name: Rauntti
summary: Rauntti is a pink, yellow-eyed lab-grown creature that gnaws through almost anything, especially timber furniture. Rauntti sees in the dark and slips unseen through hidden corridors, loyal to one young friend.

feats.scene: Rauntti chews through a thick oak table leg in a single night.
Rauntti is stepped on by a hurrying guard and scampers off unharmed.
Rauntti bolts down a service tunnel to dodge a sweeping flashlight.

name: Selli
summary: Selli is a dark-haired metahuman raised by a cruel guardian, who broke into a vault to reclaim a locket with her mother's portrait. Selli can thicken her body, turn intangible and hit with great strength.

feats.scene: Selli punches a vault door off its hinges and sends it skidding across the floor.
Selli stands firm while a ceiling beam collapses squarely on her shoulders.

name: Vavalnau
summary: Vavalnau is a dark-haired gadgeteer who fights for a shadowy graveyard crew, building clever devices from scrap. Vavalnau relies on tinkered tools instead of innate power.

feats.scene: Vavalnau triggers a homemade coil that blows out a streetlamp with a loud crack.
Vavalnau is thrown against a brick wall and gets back up.

name: Iumor
summary: Iumor is an elderly antique dealer in a rough old harbour town, squeezed for protection money by rival thugs. Iumor stood up to them once, with no skill or power to back the courage.

feats.scene: Iumor shoves a bully away from the counter with both hands.
Iumor weathers a beating from three men before slumping to the floor.

name: Nalveolor
summary: Nalveolor is a rich property dealer turned undead feeder, ruthless in business and later fixated on making fresh brains free for all. Nalveolor endured torture and months in a dry well, then founded a congregation of the hungry dead.

feats.scene: Nalveolor drags a struggling victim across a parking lot with one arm.
Nalveolor survives a long plunge down a stone shaft and a stretch of starvation.

name: Tostle
summary: Tostle is a violet-skinned, yellow-eyed deity of death who guards the rainforest and its creatures and has no love for people. Tostle strikes bargains that cost innocent blood and then reveals their true meaning to the desperate.

feats.scene: Tostle blights a whole valley of canopy in a single night.
Tostle walks through a roaring wildfire that gutters out around the god's feet.

name: Norsirvor
summary: Norsirvor is a masked vigilante who borrows the abilities of creatures and was once flung decades into the past. Norsirvor was rescued by a mysterious wanderer and carried home.

feats.scene: Norsirvor kicks a gang enforcer through a plywood door.
Norsirvor survives a rooftop fall and rolls to his feet.

name: Neoti
summary: Neoti is a red-skinned, purple-haired son of an ancient nameless parent and brother to a goddess of strife, dwelling in a hidden fortress-city. Neoti belongs to an old race of primordial beings.

feats.scene: Neoti hurls a fractured tower into a ravine and the ground splits for a mile.
Neoti shrugs off the collapse of a cliff face.

name: Eonani
summary: Eonani is a tall young teacher and medical student who moonlights as a masked vigilante with immense strength, quick healing and a body that can turn impervious for a short while. Eonani can also release energy bursts.

feats.scene: Eonani drives a fist into a parked truck and folds its hood in half.
Eonani hardens her body and lets a speeding car rebound off her.

name: Stval
summary: Stval is a cheerful pupil at a school for young heroes who can multiply her body density without changing size. Stval stomps to make shockwaves and becomes immovable when she piles on mass.

feats.scene: Stval stomps a courtyard and the shockwave rattles every window around.
Stval densifies and holds her ground while a wrecking ball swings into her.

name: Vossilnto
summary: Vossilnto is a trained medic and city vigilante who can change her mass at will, absorbing blows from bruisers and resisting energy blasts. Vossilnto also stamps the ground to send out shockwaves.

feats.scene: Vossilnto stamps once and the pavement ripples outward across a street.
Vossilnto soaks a giant bruiser's full-force punch and does not budge.

name: Veoto
summary: Veoto is a blonde newspaper writer who was coerced into guiding a gangster to a hidden island of warriors after he threatened her brother over gambling debts. Veoto has only a reporter's skills.

feats.scene: Veoto slaps a notebook against a desk in frustration.
Veoto is dragged roughly into a car by two men and shaken but unhurt.

name: Tecolau
summary: Tecolau is a black-haired heiress who runs a vast family corporation and funds secret research, tasked with making sure morning always arrives. Tecolau ages far slower than ordinary people and expects a three-century life.

feats.scene: Tecolau slams a boardroom door in fury at a business partner.
Tecolau walks away from a limousine crash with a scratch.

name: Iumnel
summary: Iumnel is a red-haired young woman who took a fiery curse from her sibling and now commands blazing elemental power. Iumnel hunts the dark forces behind the curse alongside monsters and misfits.

feats.scene: Iumnel hurls a ball of flame that burns a farmhouse to its foundation.
Iumnel stands inside a blazing barn as it caves in around her.

name: Ntolnel
summary: Ntolnel is a brilliant brain researcher and psychiatrist who built a headpiece meant to calm the minds of the very dangerous. Ntolnel speaks bluntly and has caught her employer's eye.

feats.scene: Ntolnel activates her headpiece prototype and a bench of glassware cracks.
Ntolnel is jostled by an intruder yet stays on her feet.

name: Stillri
summary: Stillri is a stranded space traveller who was raised by devout settlers and came to believe he was a heavenly warrior. Stillri flies, hits hard, is tough, and screams with sonic force.

feats.scene: Stillri bellows and a seawall crumbles along its length.
Stillri keeps fighting after a collapsing temple lands on his back.
Stillri streaks across the bay faster than sound.

name: Llium
summary: Llium is a hired thug whose great strength only works while his feet touch the soil. Llium once joined a gang of mythology-themed criminals, and lifting him off the ground left him weak.

feats.scene: Llium plants both feet and heaves a stone statue over a fence.
Llium takes a car's full impact standing on bare earth.

name: Tantela
summary: Tantela is a living darkness, the hostile counterpart to the force that governs animal life, wanting only an end to all living things. Tantela was driven from reality once, returned, and was finally sealed in a newly made cosmos.

feats.scene: Tantela drains the life from a whole star system in a single exhalation.
Tantela is struck by the combined will of ancient guardians and is merely bound, not slain.

name: Stosil
summary: Stosil is a warrior from a harsh world who serves a tyrant, embodying hatred and rage. Stosil attacks the heroes of a divine realm with fury that never cools.

feats.scene: Stosil smashes a bunker into rubble with a roaring charge.
Stosil carries on fighting through a barrage of blaster fire.

name: Nicor
summary: Nicor is a dark-haired hotelier who built a lavish gambling palace in the middle of a rebuilt city. Nicor is under scrutiny by a keen reporter and keeps a glowing green ring.

feats.scene: Nicor thumps the roulette table to silence a heckler.
Nicor is shoved into a marble pillar and keeps his grin.

name: Liuamo
summary: Liuamo is a dark-haired city mayor who presides over civic life until a masked brute ends his term in the middle of a stadium game. Liuamo has political skill and nothing else.

feats.scene: Liuamo bangs a gavel to call a council meeting to order.
Liuamo stumbles on the podium steps and brushes himself off.

name: Stvor
summary: Stvor is a brown-haired police chief who took over from his retired father and works alongside two masked crimefighters. Stvor is father to a daughter who will one day lead a nation.

feats.scene: Stvor fires a service pistol at a fleeing car's tyre and hits it.
Stvor is knocked flat by a crook's wild swing and stands again.

name: Enuiu
summary: Enuiu is a vain inventor of robots who craves wealth, fame and endless life, resentful that crowds ignore his work. Enuiu built a copying android to strike at heroes, which shorted out when dunked.

feats.scene: Enuiu orders his android to wrench a streetlight from its base.
Enuiu is hauled off to a cell without a scratch to show for his schemes.

name: Letiin
summary: Letiin is a demented robotics scientist whose creation could mimic anyone's abilities. Letiin died of an unexplained cause, leaving behind only the machine.

feats.scene: Letiin powers up a workshop robot and its arm bends a steel girder.
Letiin dusts off after a lab bench tips over.

name: Norres
summary: Norres is a corrupt churchman who kept quiet about atrocities in exchange for a fat monthly bribe, then rose to lead a great cathedral. Norres met a violent end at the hands of a masked avenger's helper.

feats.scene: Norres cuffs a frightened prisoner across the face.
Norres is struck hard with a candlestick and collapses.

name: Tertesvi
summary: Tertesvi is a former sports champion who suffered terrible headaches and was turned into a wolf-man by a serum. Tertesvi fled to the cold north, hunting game, and later accepted help from a masked detective.

feats.scene: Tertesvi rakes his claws across a steel dumpster and rips it open.
Tertesvi is hit by a bolt of lightning and walks it off.

name: Reolennu
summary: Reolennu is a rich, blue-eyed legislator who secretly ran a smuggling ring while his adopted daughter fought as a costumed teen. Reolennu was exposed when she discovered his crimes on a trip.

feats.scene: Reolennu pounds a desk during a heated phone call.
Reolennu tumbles on an icy walkway and is only winded.

name: Terresrn
summary: Terresrn is a polite, wordy slum kid who grew into a gene scientist and helped clone his old gang. Terresrn was looked after by a kindly police officer who secretly fought crime.

feats.scene: Terresrn swings a rolled newspaper bundle and topples a street stall.
Terresrn takes a hard shove from a bigger boy and stays on his feet.

name: Stutasia
summary: Stutasia is a short, brown-eyed lab-grown boy with a big vocabulary who drives the gang's flying car and fixes electrical gear. Stutasia helped free a captive clone from his underground prison.

feats.scene: Stutasia heaves a crate against a security door to jam it.
Stutasia gets thrown into a pile of crates and bounces back up.

name: Ilesiela
summary: Ilesiela is a white-haired convict who broke out of jail during a dictatorial era, remarkable for taking repeated super-fast blows without falling. Ilesiela is a living wall of metal.

feats.scene: Ilesiela drives a girder-hard fist through a prison wall.
Ilesiela endures a blur of rapid strikes and remains standing.

name: Tiliuniu
summary: Tiliuniu is a hulking steelworker whose body became living metal after a plunge into molten alloy, giving great strength and toughness, though oxygen makes him rust. Tiliuniu runs with a gang of costumed thieves.

feats.scene: Tiliuniu pounds a loading crane and bends its arm to the ground.
Tiliuniu stands in the path of a runaway freight cart and stops it.

name: Amani
summary: Amani is a black-haired boss of a sprawling criminal syndicate in a gloomy city, ruling through fear and orders. Amani has leadership but no fighting gift.

feats.scene: Amani slaps a lieutenant across the cheek in a smoky back room.
Amani takes a clumsy blow from a rival and glares back.

name: Loramotas
summary: Loramotas is a blue-eyed racketeer who cut a trapeze rope when a circus refused to pay protection. Loramotas was later arrested, then abandoned to his own bosses' gunmen.

feats.scene: Loramotas fires a pistol into a rope and the swing drops.
Loramotas is rattled around in a prison van but stays conscious.

name: Amnaulor
summary: Amnaulor is a grey-haired explorer-warrior whose soul was trapped in a cursed blade and called up by a vengeful gang leader. Amnaulor briefly fought a team of masked heroes before returning to the sword.

feats.scene: Amnaulor swings a heavy axe and splits a wooden gate.
Amnaulor shrugs off a thrown knife that passes through his chest.

name: Cournsia
summary: Cournsia is a demonic hybrid child engineered to bring about the end times, born of an infernal spirit and a human mobster. Cournsia was cut down with an axe by a scruffy occultist.

feats.scene: Cournsia flings a delivery truck into a shop front with a sweep of a clawed arm.
Cournsia shrugs off a barrage of bricks and a thrown bottle.

name: Llantite
summary: Llantite is a huge, long-lived alien hunter who tracks famous champions with advanced weapons, once capturing one and posing as him. Llantite finally listened to the champion's friends and vowed to atone.

feats.scene: Llantite stays upright after a hail of rifle fire.

name: Seaul
summary: Seaul is a red-eyed conqueror who betrayed his own cosmic race, feeding on annihilated realities until he grew immense. Seaul waged a campaign that wiped out countless universes before being stopped at terrible cost.

feats.scene: Seaul unleashes a wave of dark radiance that erases a cluster of whole universes.
Seaul weathers the combined assault of a thousand galaxies' champions.

name: Luorco
summary: Luorco is a white-eyed, pale cosmic being in a cartoonish world of tiny heroes, acting as the opposite of a gentler counterpart. Luorco lives in a toy-sized town and plays more than destroys.

feats.scene: Luorco stomps a sandbox flat and shakes the playground.
Luorco is dropped from a slide and bounces without a mark.

name: Lermi
summary: Lermi is a black-haired officer on a sheltered island of warrior women, eager to repel invaders and surprised by talk of peace. Lermi has blessed strength and toughness, and is skilled with a blade.

feats.scene: Lermi cleaves a rowing boat in two with a single sword stroke.
Lermi stands against a charging war-horse and holds the line.

name: Lleirnnau
summary: Lleirnnau is a brown-haired fighter of an island tribe, trained in the bow, saddle and sword and blessed by two goddesses. Lleirnnau fell protecting the shore from monsters of the deep.

feats.scene: Lleirnnau looses an arrow that pins a raider's shield to a mast.
Lleirnnau holds a surf-battered ridge against a lashing tentacle.

name: Vosvalam
summary: Vosvalam is a blue-eyed ruler of an early sisterhood devoted to the hunt goddess, skilled at stealth and command. Vosvalam carries a truth-binding rope and a bow, and welcomed the founder of a later kingdom.

feats.scene: Vosvalam shoots an arrow clean through a bronze shield.
Vosvalam stands against a stampeding herd on a mountain pass.

name: Varen
summary: Varen is a green-eyed rocket engineer recruited to sabotage a space programme, causing a fatal capsule explosion and later trapping reporters in a chemical blast. Varen was betrayed and died when her helicopter blew up.

feats.scene: Varen rigs a launch pad with charges and the booster erupts in flame.
Varen braces against a lab blast door that slams on her arm.

name: Miialeru
summary: Miialeru is a coastal researcher who built a serum that lets people breathe seawater, and who later carried a machine-made infection granting great strength and durability. Miialeru lives among the drowned districts he unintentionally saved.

feats.scene: Miialeru fires a bolt of pent-up energy that tears the hull from a patrol boat.
Miialeru is hit by a cargo container swung from a crane and keeps working.

name: Colam
summary: Colam is a red-haired electrical expert and reincarnated tyrant who once flew an eye-shaped airship powered by the pooled willpower of scholars. Colam is the oldest foe of a winged hero.

feats.scene: Colam stumbles from a crashed cockpit with only scrapes.

name: Nenrela
summary: Nenrela is a career thief in a cartoon city who vanishes from sight at the right moment, relying on flash and bad luck for opponents. Nenrela gets by on wit.

feats.scene: Nenrela jabs a security guard in the stomach and sprints for the window.
Nenrela survives a rough landing on a rooftop of gravel.

source_title: Anton Lamont (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Iaarco
summary: Iaarco is a grey-haired envoy who negotiated peace between worlds and resented young guardians sent to watch the talks. Iaarco was later puppeted by a mind-bending villain.

feats.scene: Iaarco slaps a treaty folder against the lectern to end a debate.
Iaarco stumbles from a conference stage and is only embarrassed.

name: Lentna
summary: Lentna is a dark-haired nobleman of a mountain castle who moves objects with his mind and turns soil into obedient clay giants. Lentna descends from an ancient warlord.

feats.scene: Lentna is thrown against a battlement and rises to his feet.

name: Setiran
summary: Setiran is a black-haired frontier lawman who served a young republic in the 1840s, patrolling dusty trails on horseback. Setiran has no gifts but a steady aim.

feats.scene: Setiran fires a rifle and drops a bandit's horse mid-gallop.
Setiran is dragged by a spooked mount for fifty yards and walks off.

name: Iutau
summary: Iutau was a trapeze artist who fell to his death during a show where the owner skimped on nets. Iutau's grieving siblings then turned to crime in his memory.

feats.scene: Iutau pushes off the platform bar with both feet.
Iutau lands hard on sawdust from a low swing without injury.

name: Nanri
summary: Nanri is a brown-haired counsellor to a criminal syndicate, a fluent, well-read polyglot who knows the rivals' dealings but protects his own relatives first. Nanri keeps a friendship with a police detective.

feats.scene: Nanri closes a heavy ledger with a thud to end a meeting.
Nanri is bumped into a doorframe and shrugs it off.

name: Anumiial
summary: Anumiial is a white-haired, sightless winged deity who ruled the sky and lived so long he outlasted nearly every living thing. Anumiial waited at the end of time for the last act of the cosmos.

feats.scene: Anumiial beats his wings once and a storm front spans a whole hemisphere.
Anumiial remains standing as the last stars gutter around him.
Anumiial soars across the dying sky in moments.

name: Rnren
summary: Rnren is a young rebel from a grim possible future who is strong, tough and surrounded by a protective barrier. Rnren charged a tyrant's hovercraft and was killed by two energy bolts.

feats.scene: Rnren rips the door off a patrol hovercraft with both hands.
Rnren holds the barrier up as a barrage of cannon fire hammers it.

name: Tetelil
summary: Tetelil is a frail white-haired priest of a far world who helped a warrior woman free captives from invaders. Tetelil leans on a walking stick and knows the old rites.

feats.scene: Tetelil raps his stick on a stone floor to call a gathering.
Tetelil is shoved by a guard and catches himself against a pillar.

name: Vital
summary: Vital is a hairless, black-skinned sovereign of the eastern waters, a dragon who rules a coastal realm and nurses a long rivalry with a trickster ape. Vital commands tides and sea-folk.

feats.scene: Vital lashes his tail and a tidal wall drowns a coastline.
Vital rides out a whirlpool that tears apart a fleet.

name: Amiont
summary: Amiont is a black-haired sword-for-hire from a subterranean land who senses the future and wears a crown inherited from a wicked ancestor. Amiont chose to defend the weak.

feats.scene: Amiont cuts through a wooden barricade in two strokes.
Amiont keeps fighting with a deep cut across her arm.

name: Rnseso
summary: Rnseso is a tribal hero who shouts a battle word to swell into a towering colossus, usually the height of a tall building and at times truly cosmic. Rnseso also has a keen inner sense for hidden danger.

feats.scene: Rnseso swells to colossal size and flattens a bridge tower with one stamp.
Rnseso stays upright as a crane collapses across his giant shoulders.

name: Tesre
summary: Tesre is a gorilla who learned speech and fire and declared himself fit to rule, rallying jungle primates to terrorise villages. Tesre's human henchmen eventually turned on him.

feats.scene: Tesre swings a thick branch and shatters a hut wall.
Tesre takes a fall from a tall tree and keeps climbing.

name: Rnenteon
summary: Rnenteon is a pink-eyed deity of love and desire whose affection can bind the will of those who adore her. Rnenteon lends a slice of her might to a mortal champion and does not age or die.

feats.scene: Rnenteon sighs and every watcher on a mountain slope falls helplessly in love, shaking the slope loose.
Rnenteon is unmarked by a thunderbolt from a rival deity.

name: Valti
summary: Valti is a white-haired heroine in a mirror-image world, the flipped counterpart of a sun-themed hero, who flies a team's giant airborne base. Valti is rumoured to be in love with a fellow hero.

feats.scene: Valti rams the airborne base through a tower facade.
Valti survives a missile salvo against the base's armour.

name: Tecar
summary: Tecar is a black-haired, white-eyed goddess and one of five divine mothers who raised a nation of warriors and gave them gifts, though she cannot fully take form in the physical world. Tecar commands water.

feats.scene: Tecar lifts an ocean swell and sets it down gently around a new island.
Tecar is dispersed into mist by a blow and slowly reforms.

name: Iuanceo
summary: Iuanceo is a pink-haired deity of love who teaches her restless son that affection must be inspired, not forced, after his meddling causes a chaotic wedding brawl. Iuanceo never dies.

feats.scene: Iuanceo claps once and an entire brawling crowd falls calm.
Iuanceo is unmoved by a barrage of villains' blasts.

name: Aulto
summary: Aulto is a green-eyed, red-haired deity of love, a daughter of the sky-king, who proudly recalls giving fallen women a new life on a paradise isle. Aulto is deathless and sharp-tongued.

feats.scene: Aulto raises an island from the sea and covers it in blooms.
Aulto stands unscathed in a storm of divine lightning.

name: Cortia
summary: Cortia is a black-maned, brown-eyed horse who carries a masked rider through frontier skirmishes in wartime. Cortia is steady, fast and loyal.

feats.scene: Cortia kicks a fence rail in half while spooked by gunfire.
Cortia gallops through brambles and a hail of bullets without a mark.
Cortia sprints flat out across an open prairie.

source_title: Apocalypse (The Blue, the Grey, and the Bat)

name: Erneru
summary: Erneru is a white-eyed, golden-haired sun deity who flies, controls light and cannot die, and who brought an infant to a witch while forbidding a certain word. Erneru answers only to a father-king.

feats.scene: Erneru focuses sunlight into a lance that boils a whole bay.
Erneru walks through a volcanic eruption without a singed hair.

name: Nescaeon
summary: Nescaeon is a brown-haired, deathless archer-god of a forgotten empire, quick with a bow and a quiver of arrows. Nescaeon lives on in a parallel world's legends.

feats.scene: Nescaeon looses a flaming arrow that levels a watchtower.
Nescaeon takes a boulder to the chest and laughs it off.

name: Teelnt
summary: Teelnt is a white-haired, brown-eyed wandering swordsman, gentle until provoked, who killed a band of drunks in one stroke and later fell in love with a shogun's bodyguard. Teelnt died fighting hundreds of assassins in the night.

feats.scene: Teelnt draws and cuts down a whole row of attackers in a single sweep.
Teelnt keeps fighting through dozens of cuts before he drops.

name: Taltestel
summary: Taltestel is a brown-haired space-age adventurer with cat-like gifts: strength, speed, reflexes, claws, fast recovery and a rapport with animals. Taltestel serves in a team of young heroes across the stars.

feats.scene: Taltestel rakes her claws through a metal hatch and rips it from its frame.
Taltestel lands from a high ledge on all fours without injury.
Taltestel bounds down a long corridor in seconds.

name: Anevaco
summary: Anevaco is a tentacled, eyeless officer of a galactic police force who was called to arrest a notorious vigilante and was killed by him. Anevaco carries little record beyond that single fight.

feats.scene: Anevaco lashes a tentacle and flings a metal chair across the room.
Anevaco survives a hard slam into a wall before being overwhelmed.

name: Restost
summary: Restost is a tall, eyeless, genderless veteran of a cosmic police force who founded its elite guard and trains recruits. Restost wields a power ring that makes solid light constructs, shields and beams and enables flight.

feats.scene: Restost casts a green construct ram and punches a hole through a bunker.
Restost's shield holds against a salvo of artillery shells.

name: Valtor
summary: Valtor is an eyeless, genderless alien officer of an interstellar peacekeeping corps, equipped with a ring and a charging battery, who relies on unbending resolve. Valtor can summon constructs, a force shield and blasts, and can fly.

feats.scene: Valtor fires a concentrated beam that bores through a freight hull.
Valtor holds a barrier against a crashing starship's debris.

name: Reorvi
summary: Reorvi is a tentacled, eyeless peacekeeper in a cartoon cosmos, armed with a ring that builds shapes from light, throws blasts, raises shields and flies. Reorvi serves a galactic police corps.

feats.scene: Reorvi blasts a rogue robot and its chassis splits in half.
Reorvi's shield withstands a heavy cannon round.

name: Torial
summary: Torial is a white-haired, black-eyed cow in a pint-sized cartoon world, a swimming pet of a young sea heroine who joins a club of heroic cattle. Torial lives happily under the waves.

feats.scene: Torial butts a beach ball clear across the pool.
Torial gets knocked into a coral wall and shakes it off.
Torial paddles hard to reach her owner's side.

name: Carlanleo
summary: Carlanleo is a yellow-eyed weapons scientist whose body was merged with lake water after a failed teleport experiment, leaving him obsessed with ruling the seas. Carlanleo built a huge cannon to wreck the moon.

feats.scene: Carlanleo's cannon backfires and its blast levels the whole fortress.
Carlanleo reforms his liquid body after a hail of gunfire passes through him.

name: Liastiial
summary: Liastiial is a black-haired, black-eyed girl of a sunken city who leads a pint-sized team of sea heroes and breathes both air and water. Liastiial's club was overrun by tiny parasitic starfish.

feats.scene: Liastiial flicks a tail and sends a boulder-sized sponge rolling.
Liastiial endures a tumble through a rocky reef.
Liastiial darts between coral heads in pursuit of a friend.

name: Llererva
summary: Llererva is a black-haired young sea-city hero who aids a teen team, with webbed skin, quick swimming, a friendly bond with creatures and a talent for diving. Llererva helped a lost sea girl return home with her turtle.

feats.scene: Llererva shoulders a heavy fish crate off a dock.
Llererva takes a hard tumble in a flooded tank and recovers quickly.
Llererva streaks across the bay faster than a speedboat.

name: Saualsor
summary: Saualsor is a blue-eyed, brown-haired ocean hero wielding a three-pronged spear, who joined a team of champions against a wave of annihilating matter. Saualsor was erased with the rest of his reality, then restored elsewhere.

feats.scene: Saualsor drives his spear into the seabed and a wave capsizes a tanker.
Saualsor shrugs off a cannonade of depth charges.

name: Telsor
summary: Telsor is a black-haired killer in a team of assassins, fitted with machine enhancements and skilled with arms. Telsor was slaughtered alongside the squad by a mysterious doom.

feats.scene: Telsor fires a rifle round through a steel door.
Telsor keeps advancing after taking a burst to the armoured chest.

name: Oluson
summary: Oluson is a black-haired, black-eyed sea champion of a doomed alliance who rescued his teammates from a collapsing base by calling on a pod of dolphins. Oluson vanished when his whole world was wiped away.

feats.scene: Oluson hurls a harpoon and pins a drifting buoy.
Oluson dives through the falling wreckage and surfaces unharmed.

name: Irnam
summary: Irnam is a green and gold dinosaur with a long snout who guards coastal fishing villages from sea predators. Irnam has near-impenetrable hide, claws, fangs, powerful limbs, and fights with a three-pronged spear.

feats.scene: Irnam clamps his jaws on a giant sea beast and flings it onto the shore.
Irnam's hide turns aside a giant squid's crushing grip.

name: Siltor
