summary: Siltor is a near-omnipotent sentient star who was exiled from his peers for monstrous crimes, then regained his full might and erased every world save a few survivors. Siltor was undone only by a sacrifice that broke his hold.

feats.scene: Siltor lets loose a wave of fire that wipes an entire universe from existence.
Siltor shrugs off the combined assault of countless champions.

name: Seono
summary: Seono is a black-haired, black-eyed member of a three-part villain who was shaped by laboratory experiments and fights a band of misfit heroes in a cartoon world. Seono is a minor menace.

feats.scene: Seono hurls a metal canister across a lab.
Seono shakes off a blow from a heavy wrench.

name: Enura
summary: Enura is a brain-shaped alien envoy of a warlike faction who posed as a humble aide while plotting an assassination with a secret conspiracy. Enura outranks the ambassador he serves.

feats.scene: Enura hurls a beam of mental pressure that cracks a window.
Enura shrugs off a stumble from a high stair.

name: Sornint
summary: Sornint is a former warrior-prince made the living avatar of a blood-red moon by a cosmic machine, tasked with deciding which stolen cities survive. Sornint was restored after creation's rebirth as a wandering hero.

feats.scene: Sornint calls down a ray from the red moon that scorches a continent.
Sornint stands firm as a rival city's weapons bombard the moon.

name: Ilsava
summary: Ilsava is a prince of a desert kingdom who turned his back on royal duty to become the finest burglar in the land, skilled with a blade and with locks. Ilsava now travels beside a famous warlord.

feats.scene: Ilsava slashes a guard's belt and a coin purse drops to the floor.
Ilsava drops from a palace wall into a hay cart and runs on.

name: Llilear
summary: Llilear is a gentle thermal adept who bends scorching heat and biting frost with equal ease. Llilear has hung up the heroics, preferring a quiet kitchen inside a shared daydream to the battlefield.

feats.scene: Llilear flash-boils a reservoir-sized pond in a single exhale during an old skirmish.
Llilear walks out of a collapsing furnace hall without a blister.

name: Nulennas
summary: Nulennas is a deathless warrior-mystic who commands her own body heat and can project blazing or freezing force. Nulennas trained among mountain monks and fights with disciplined, graceful strikes.

feats.scene: Nulennas vents a pillar of frost and flame that fells a fortified tower.
Nulennas shrugs off a vehicle-sized blast while holding a mountain pass.

name: Tisti
summary: Tisti is a swarm of sentient hypergeometries older than space itself, able to reshape any rule of reality. Tisti speaks mind to mind and treats whole universes as sketches to be erased or redrawn.

feats.scene: Tisti folds a vast cluster of galaxies into a single bent line.
Tisti remains unaltered as a collapsing cosmos is poured through its angles.

name: Eormiti
summary: Eormiti is a restless sorceress whose spells are fed by a small jade idol hidden in a derelict warehouse. Eormiti sows chaos from boredom and sabotages machines from the shadows.

feats.scene: Eormiti hurls a rolling wave of sorcery that tears through a convention hall and scatters the crowd.
Eormiti shrugs off a volley of armoured gauntlet fire behind a shimmering ward.

name: Reseaus
summary: Reseaus is a grey-haired archivist of a fiery tyrant realm, trusted to remember every grim legend. Reseaus has little talent for combat but guards a vast library of forbidden tales.

feats.scene: Reseaus hurls a heavy stone tablet across the vault at an intruder.
Reseaus survives a tumbling shelf of iron-bound volumes without a bruise.

name: Leniullo
summary: Leniullo is a scaled mercenary whose body was rebuilt by swarms of microscopic machines. Leniullo guarded his employer faithfully, unaware that the same machines carried a hidden kill-switch.

feats.scene: Leniullo hammers a reinforced door off its hinges during a raid.
Leniullo takes a burst of rifle fire without slowing his advance.

name: Antalsi
summary: Antalsi is a penniless travelling painter who became monarch of a volcanic island after accidentally toppling its tyrant. Antalsi rules clumsily but is beloved by common people.

feats.scene: Antalsi stumbles into a dictator and sends him flying through a window.
Antalsi tumbles down a palace staircase and laughs it off.

name: Valsonntu
summary: Valsonntu is a wartime tinkerer whose body was partly replaced by machinery of his own design. Valsonntu serves a covert team, mending devices under fire.

feats.scene: Valsonntu overloads a generator to blow a wall off a bunker.
Valsonntu stays upright after a shell lands within arm's reach.

name: Mianti
summary: Mianti is a mind-reaching patrol officer of an interstellar police force, sworn to guard a quiet sector. Mianti died defending a power ring, sending a last warning across space before destroying the ring.

feats.scene: Mianti sends a lance of green force that cracks open an enemy cruiser.
Mianti holds a shimmering shield against a swarm of assassins until it fails.

name: Siustiosa
summary: Siustiosa is a compassionate future ruler of a peaceful world republic who believes love beats force. Siustiosa once talked a would-be bomber out of ruin before the blast could happen.

feats.scene: Siustiosa pushes a startled attacker away from the podium.
Siustiosa stays calm and unhurt as a heavy podium topples beside her.

name: Ntasnt
summary: Ntasnt is a rich college girl and sorority prankster with a surprising knack for blasting things apart. Ntasnt helps an amazon heroine track a murderer to his hidden den.

feats.scene: Ntasnt wires charges that drop the roof of a smuggler's hideout.
Ntasnt tumbles down a dusty cellar stair and bounces right back up.

name: Tirreran
summary: Tirreran is an ancient lord of sorcery, one of several elder beings who lend their gifts to a chosen wizard. Tirreran can move at blinding pace and divide power among worthy mortals.

feats.scene: Tirreran strikes a ridge with a bolt of raw sorcery that levels its summit.
Tirreran stands unmoved as a collapsing peak buries his hall.

name: Secotor
summary: Secotor is a grim war deity who flies, teleports, hurls lightning and disintegrates foes with heat. Secotor thrives on bloodshed and deceives mortals into slaughter, disguising himself as a gentle official.

feats.scene: Secotor lets loose a storm of lightning that flattens an entire district of a battle-torn town.
Secotor strides out of a crater unmarked after a barrage of bolts.

name: Ressau
summary: Ressau is a scornful immortal of battle who despises mortals for fighting among themselves. Ressau is a bruiser, nearly unbreakable, who hurls his enemies around by the dozen.

feats.scene: Ressau punches through a stone wall and sends its masonry across a courtyard.
Ressau takes a collapsing temple roof on his shoulders and keeps walking.

name: Seslusa
summary: Seslusa is a patient old deity who poses as a smooth businessman, stoking conflict between nations for sport. Seslusa projects force, reads distant minds, and cannot die of age.

feats.scene: Seslusa flings a blazing bolt that erupts through a hangar in a ball of fire.
Seslusa takes a missile salvo to the chest and straightens his tie.

name: Reorau
summary: Reorau is a vain ageless deity who has traded battlefields for the stage of a beachside club. Reorau puts more effort into his oiled routine than into any quarrel.

feats.scene: Reorau tosses a heckler out through a bamboo door without looking up.
Reorau laughs as a ceiling fan crashes onto his head.

name: Tarne
summary: Tarne is an ancient immortal embodiment of brute conflict, boasting that all mortals worship force. Tarne rules a dark underworld seat and pits chosen champions against his rivals.

feats.scene: Tarne smashes his fist into a hillside and the whole slope slides into the valley.
Tarne wades out of a burning hall that has just been razed around him.

name: Isilau
summary: Isilau is a red-eyed brawler who fires a searing ray from a single eye. Isilau ended up sold into an arena as a fighting slave after being hunted down for a reward.

feats.scene: Isilau melts a gap through an arena gate with a thin beam from his eye.
Isilau climbs back up after a heavy club blow cracks the sand beneath him.

name: Rilter
summary: Rilter is a tiny, scarred pest in a tin mask who nurses a petty grudge and swipes laundry as a hobby. Rilter is weightless, spiteful and not nearly as dangerous as he imagines.

feats.scene: Rilter flings a pebble that pings off a lamp shade.
Rilter survives a cat's swat that sends him skidding across the floor.

name: Nelnt
summary: Nelnt is a masked gunman guarding a harbour city from raiders. Nelnt stopped a terror cell from wrecking the city's famous sail-roofed theatre, with help from a passing stranger.

feats.scene: Nelnt fires a rifle and drops a bomber at fifty paces.
Nelnt rolls clear of a falling scaffold and rises with a bruise.

name: Ntotelval
summary: Ntotelval is a stern cavalry captain from an island of warrior women, skilled with bow, blade and bare hands. Ntotelval led a mounted escort until a startled horse threw her from a cliff.

feats.scene: Ntotelval swings a sabre through a practice post and splits it clean.
Ntotelval takes a hard blow from a rival's staff and stays mounted.

source_title: Ariadne of the Blue Guard (New Earth)

name: Niasillor
summary: Niasillor is the half-surface queen who reigns over most of an ocean world and leads a band of cosmic defenders. Niasillor is her planet's greatest champion and the strategist behind a last stand against a dark emperor.

feats.scene: Niasillor drives a tidal surge that scours a coastline of every shipwreck.
Niasillor stays upright through a wave of crushing deep-sea pressure.

name: Osraleo
summary: Osraleo is a charming broadcaster who hosts a nightly interview programme in a bustling city. Osraleo confronted a false guest on air and later gave airtime to a citizens' movement.

feats.scene: Osraleo slaps a desk bell so hard it rings out across the studio.
Osraleo stumbles off a low stage and keeps talking.

name: Telsanta
summary: Telsanta is a pink-skinned noblewoman who loved a future tyrant and bore a child she had to give away. Telsanta rose again as a zombie wielding a ring of death before two foes ended her.

feats.scene: Telsanta fires a black beam that cracks a plateau in two.
Telsanta endures a twin blast of coloured light for several heartbeats before dissolving.

name: Varnale
summary: Varnale is an immortal sea-king who blends engineering and sorcery, ruling a drowned civilization of magic-blooded people. Varnale wears a crown of his own design and leads with patient wisdom.

feats.scene: Varnale commands a lattice of enchanted machinery that levels a harbour district.
Varnale stays whole after a vault of crystal collapses upon his throne.

name: Monto
summary: Monto is a green-eyed ring bearer of a galactic peacekeeping corps who tracked a rogue android across space. Monto flies and casts glowing constructs fuelled by willpower.

feats.scene: Monto launches an emerald lance that shatters a drifting asteroid.
Monto shrugs off a ricocheting blast behind a glowing shield.

name: Saseonel
summary: Saseonel is an eager gold-skinned rookie who peppers her mentor with questions and listens to the corps' old tales. Saseonel solved how to beat a time-bending foe, earning an honoured place in legend.

feats.scene: Saseonel shapes a glowing hammer that crushes a ship's hull.
Saseonel absorbs a ricocheting blast on a shield and grins.

name: Linvaloll
summary: Linvaloll is one of thousands of ring-wearing guardians, a gold-skinned patroller who keeps her identity private. Linvaloll draws on stubborn willpower to shape light into walls and weapons.

feats.scene: Linvaloll fires a green bolt that topples a stone watchtower.
Linvaloll holds a glowing barrier as rubble rains down.

name: Ninvais
summary: Ninvais is an enthusiastic young peacekeeper who marched into a huge war between rival god-like factions. Ninvais fought alongside every ring-bearer to crush an apocalyptic tyrant and burned to share the tale.

feats.scene: Ninvais joins a huge chorus of rings to blast a fortress moon into slag.
Ninvais keeps a shield up through a cascade of fiery beams.

name: Anuma
summary: Anuma is a golden-skinned fighter who rebuilt a shattered peacekeeping order after its elders were slaughtered. Anuma wields rings of both hues and wears her determination like armour.

feats.scene: Anuma sweeps twin beams across a fleet and sets it ablaze.
Anuma tanks a planetoid-shaking impact behind layered shields.

name: Lusilnan
summary: Lusilnan is a gold-skinned ring wearer assigned to a remote patch of space, drawing on will to shape glowing tools. Lusilnan flies, fires light, and defends a sleepy sector alone.

feats.scene: Lusilnan bursts a pirate skiff with a single pulse.
Lusilnan weathers a flurry of plasma bolts on a hastily raised shield.

name: Tiasasor
summary: Tiasasor is a hulking, red-eyed enforcer who wears a ring of fear and cares for nothing but brute force. Tiasasor is tough as slag and flattens lesser fighters by sheer weight.

feats.scene: Tiasasor slams a truck through a warehouse wall.
Tiasasor walks through a collapsing gantry with a shrug.

name: Llcisau
summary: Llcisau is a clawed, fanged drill sergeant of a villainous corps, big enough to make heroes gawk. Llcisau bellows orders, shrugs off poison, and uses a yellow ring to fly and fire blasts.

feats.scene: Llcisau cracks open a bridge span with a yellow-lit swing.
Llcisau takes a barrage of blasts and keeps barking commands.

name: Ianiosa
summary: Ianiosa is a towering blue brute with sharp teeth and an iron stomach, bound to a ring of fear. Ianiosa can chew glass and has grudgingly bonded with an unlikely partner.

feats.scene: Ianiosa rips a steel door from its frame and hurls it across a hangar.
Ianiosa tumbles through a plate-glass wall and chews the shards.

name: Siran
summary: Siran is a green-skinned bruiser seen only briefly, serving a yellow-lit militia. Siran carries a ring and leaves little else behind besides rumours.

feats.scene: Siran blasts open a barn door with a yellow bolt.
Siran stumbles through a collapsing silo with scrapes.

name: Vaori
summary: Vaori is a brown-furred peacekeeper who held the line at his corps' home world during a devastating siege. Vaori flies and fires glowing beams before falling to a tyrant's deadly eye-blast.

feats.scene: Vaori sweeps a green beam across a wave of invaders.
Vaori cannot survive the final red beam but holds out against a hundred before it.

name: Vareo
summary: Vareo is a fanged, honourable fighter from a war-torn planet who inherited a dying officer's ring. Vareo challenges every opponent openly and flies on glowing power.

feats.scene: Vareo smashes a stone pillar with a glowing fist.
Vareo holds a shield wall against a volley of arrows and shots.

name: Seoteium
summary: Seoteium is a white-eyed ring bearer in a harsh alternate world ruled by a tyrant. Seoteium builds shields and blasts and flies on stubborn resolve.

feats.scene: Seoteium blows a tank apart with a beam of green light.
Seoteium takes a fusillade through a shimmering barrier.

name: Urniallu
summary: Urniallu is a furred ring-wearer who flies using the power of a glowing battery and keeps his identity hidden. Urniallu stands among thousands of peacekeepers on a central world.

feats.scene: Urniallu levels a bunker with a sweeping emerald blast.
Urniallu holds up a shield as a tower of ice falls onto him.

name: Ernor
summary: Ernor is a fur-covered, fang-baring ring wielder who joined a huge war on a rival realm of tyrants. Ernor builds barriers, fires beams, and stays loyal to the corps.

feats.scene: Ernor blasts a drifting war-barge in half.
Ernor holds a shield while a flaming ship streaks past.

name: Amoeru
summary: Amoeru is a farm wife and devoted mother who raised a prodigy too clever for his surroundings. Amoeru watched her brilliant son grow bitter, and she paid dearly for that rivalry.

feats.scene: Amoeru swings a frying pan at a prowling raccoon.
Amoeru tumbles from a hay cart and stands up laughing.

name: Leonaces
summary: Leonaces is an orange-skinned reject from a far-future hero academy who can pop off his limbs and swing them like clubs. Leonaces keeps trying anyway, undeterred by constant mockery.

feats.scene: Leonaces hurls a detached arm and knocks a thug's helmet off.
Leonaces loses a leg to a trap door and hops away unfazed.

name: Taamo
summary: Taamo is a bitter heir who blames a tycoon for his family's ruin and swaps an arm for a terrible device. Taamo captures a rich man for ransom, but the unstable weapon tears him apart instead.

feats.scene: Taamo's arm-mounted device flares with enough power to crack a world before it unravels.
Taamo braces against a shaking floor as the device whines.

name: Reslloiu
summary: Reslloiu is a former athlete lost through a rift who now hunts across dimensions for a dark mistress. Reslloiu slips between worlds and tracks prey that others lose.

feats.scene: Reslloiu tears open a rift that flings a squad of soldiers across a field.
Reslloiu climbs out of a collapsing rift unscathed.

name: Tummi
summary: Tummi is a respected fighting teacher who lost both arms yet trained many students of renown. Tummi fell to a masked assassin while helping another man regain his edge.

feats.scene: Tummi spins and sends a heavy kick that cracks a training post.
Tummi takes a staff blow to the ribs and keeps his stance.

name: Eollasrau
summary: Eollasrau is a trouble-shooting officer who travels the globe in uniform, fixing problems with rifle, sidearm and a tame animal. Eollasrau relies on training and nerve rather than any special gift.

feats.scene: Eollasrau fires a rifle and drops a saboteur across a rail yard.
Eollasrau stays on his feet after a jeep rolls beside him.

name: Miiletil
summary: Miiletil is a federal investigator who turns into an eel-like predator after drinking cursed water. Miiletil hits as hard as a sea king, slips through water to appear elsewhere, and shrugs off small-calibre fire.

feats.scene: Miiletil tears a steel hatch off a submarine with her jaws.
Miiletil takes a hail of pistol rounds and keeps lunging.

name: Tasormi
summary: Tasormi is a blond precinct detective who cheerfully looks away while a masked killer cleans up the streets. Tasormi cares only about an easy shift and a quiet desk.

feats.scene: Tasormi cuffs a stunned suspect with a hard shove against a wall.
Tasormi bounces off a parked car and shrugs it off.

source_title: Arnold Flass (Dark Multiverse: The Grim Knight)

name: Resrirum
summary: Resrirum is a greying crooked cop who also peddles drugs, sneering at anyone weaker than himself. Resrirum relies on a pistol and a bully's swagger.

feats.scene: Resrirum fires his pistol and shatters a streetlamp.
Resrirum takes a kick to the gut and spits blood but stays upright.

name: Rnamoiu
summary: Rnamoiu is a venal beat detective who leans on witnesses, takes envelopes, and beats up kids for fun. Rnamoiu is the unwelcome first partner of a new honest arrival.

feats.scene: Rnamoiu swings a baton into a suspect's ribs in a back alley.
Rnamoiu takes a hard punch from a street thug and laughs.

name: Llulaus
summary: Llulaus is a curator who believes himself the true guardian of a tropical island, his body made of living metal. Llulaus flies, hits like a train, and meets every outsider with a spear.

feats.scene: Llulaus shapes a metal fist and punches through a concrete seawall.
Llulaus reforms his body after a truck-mounted cannon blast.

name: Rnrni
summary: Rnrni is a late-night comedian and talk host who fears silence from his audience above all else. Rnrni once awoke latent mind powers that briefly turned him into a hulking dune beast.

feats.scene: Rnrni swells into a sand giant and crushes a parked bus with one swipe.
Rnrni scatters into grit when struck, then pours back together.

name: Nuneo
summary: Nuneo is a heavyset mercenary in a hand-me-down powered suit whose boosters let him pull down apartment blocks. Nuneo stomps the ground to cause tremors and has been hired by many a master villain.

feats.scene: Nuneo stomps and a block of flats shudders into rubble.
Nuneo shrugs off a cannon round that dents his plating.

name: Raneon
summary: Raneon is a crook-turned-engineer who built his own armour to stamp out earthquakes across a lakeside city. Raneon was beaten when his suit was taken apart piece by piece.

feats.scene: Raneon pounds a street and sends a quake rolling under a dozen blocks.
Raneon keeps charging after being flung through a billboard.

name: Ronrn
summary: Ronrn is a lonely drunk in a quiet town, shunned for a betrayal he did not commit. Ronrn can teleport and used the gift to send a huge falling bomb away to empty desert.

feats.scene: Ronrn blinks a falling bomb out of the sky and drops it into a vacant dune field.
Ronrn drops from a rooftop onto a hay pile and walks off dazed.

name: Ernia
summary: Ernia is a polished mob boss who once ran a city's rackets and shielded a nephew from the law. Ernia gave himself up to save his son after rivals closed in.

feats.scene: Ernia slams a ledger on a table and a cup tips over.
Ernia keeps a straight face after a bodyguard's clumsy shove sends him into a bookcase.

name: Ilsala
summary: Ilsala is a meek puppeteer who lets a gruff wooden alter ego run his gang. Ilsala is fractured in mind, but his schemes catch a masked vigilante off guard.

feats.scene: Ilsala swings his puppet like a club at a rival's jaw.
Ilsala keeps muttering after being thrown into a stack of crates.

name: Corruslle
summary: Corruslle is a faceless gun-for-hire who brings an arsenal of heavy weapons to every job. Corruslle fights an old team of oddball heroes for pay.

feats.scene: Corruslle opens fire with a heavy rifle and perforates a steel door.
Corruslle takes a punch from a bruiser and tumbles up smiling.

name: Iarsornau
summary: Iarsornau is a hired killer inside a bulky armoured shell with a gun for one hand and a blade for the other. Iarsornau was beaten by a team of misfit heroes and his shell was later stolen.

feats.scene: Iarsornau chops through a steel girder with his blade hand.
Iarsornau stays standing after a van slams into his plating.

name: Tanrnoror
summary: Tanrnoror is a proud warrior woman who once held a grand title and fought for her people's honour. Tanrnoror turned bitter at defeat, conquered a coastline with a lover, and finally died challenging a goddess.

feats.scene: Tanrnoror leads a charge that levels a hill fortress with sheer strength.
Tanrnoror takes a collapsing wall and rises to keep fighting.

name: Seneo
summary: Seneo is one of five primordial mothers who shaped a warrior people and breathed life into a clay child. Seneo lends power to others and cannot wholly step into the physical world.

feats.scene: Seneo pours her hunting might into a clay figure and a whole island shakes.
Seneo stays unchanged as a stormfront crashes through her spirit form.

name: Anntilan
summary: Anntilan is a lethal assassin of an ancient sisterhood, bound by blood oath to two sisters and nearly deathless. Anntilan once hid inside a wooden horse to end a famed war.

feats.scene: Anntilan whirls a long blade and cuts down three guards at once.
Anntilan walks out of a burning keep with a clean cloak.

name: Leoanria
summary: Leoanria is a striped-costume villain with matchless aim, acrobatic flips and a love of crossbows. Leoanria lurks among the scoundrel groups of a small island nation.

feats.scene: Leoanria fires an arrow through a hanging lamp from the far end of a hall.
Leoanria tumbles off a balcony and lands in a roll.

name: Rersenal
summary: Rersenal is a red-haired sellsword who left her tribe behind and now works alongside a crew of outlaws. Rersenal swings a gifted blade and hits hard in a scrap.

feats.scene: Rersenal cleaves a steel drum in half with a single stroke.
Rersenal takes a rifle butt to the jaw and grins.

name: Ronteltia
summary: Ronteltia is a king of a sunken realm, raised on dry land by humble farmers. Ronteltia was born in the shadow of civil war and barely survived being buried in rubble.

feats.scene: Ronteltia heaves a ship aside and clears a harbour channel.
Ronteltia lies pinned beneath a collapsed quay for hours and lives.

name: Netoran
summary: Netoran is a minor puzzle-obsessed crook who copies a more famous rival and sends cryptic notes to the law. Netoran was easily jailed and later joined a villains' gathering.

feats.scene: Netoran swings a rolled-up map and bops a guard on the head.
Netoran shrugs off a tumble down a staircase in a hurry.

name: Raareon
summary: Raareon is a cruel crook in an altered timeline who forced his own wife to take her last pills. Raareon met his end at his daughter's hands in a frantic scuffle.

feats.scene: Raareon shoves a table over to block a doorway.
Raareon grapples hard against a wall and shakes off the impact.

name: Iusan
summary: Iusan is a sea-hero from a lost parallel world, strong, quick and hard to hurt. Iusan reaches out to marine creatures with his thoughts, but a demon's horde overran him and his friends.

feats.scene: Iusan hurls a wrecked ship hull across a bay and flattens a dock.
Iusan stands against waves of infernal troops before the tide finally turns.

source_title: Arthur Curry (Dark Multiverse: Crisis on Infinite Earths)

name: Anriia
summary: Anriia is a young sea monarch who wields an enchanted trident and an easy way with animals. Anriia fights with flair and swims faster than most people run.

feats.scene: Anriia whirls a trident and cracks a breakwater.
Anriia is slammed into a reef and rises with a smile.

name: Ialile
summary: Ialile is a stern older ruler of the seas who gave up his hero mantle to a pupil and now guards seventy percent of a planet. Ialile refuses to let the surface dump its problems in his waters.

feats.scene: Ialile snaps a fishing trawler's mast with a backhand.
Ialile endures a crushing trench-bottom pressure and strolls away.

name: Nausasst
summary: Nausasst is a loud, tough prince of the seas who calls water flows with sorcery and hears through echoes. Nausasst clashes with a cheerful band of misfits and hurls his trident with lethal skill.

feats.scene: Nausasst slams a trident down and raises a wall of water over a pier.
Nausasst takes a cargo container to the chest and snickers.

name: Telcer
summary: Telcer is a blond king of the deep who refuses to hand his people to a tyrant overseas. Telcer fights twin speedsters, a lightning-wielder, and even his own double, and refuses to surrender.

feats.scene: Telcer summons a monstrous whirlpool that tears a fleet apart.
Telcer withstands a double blow of lightning and a speeding punch.

name: Amorenle
summary: Amorenle is a blond crimefighter among a new wave of heroes in the shadow of an older fading team. Amorenle relies on courage and a seaman's wits.

feats.scene: Amorenle swings a boat hook and smashes a smuggler's crate.
Amorenle takes a rope-burn fall off the pier and surfaces laughing.

name: Vortan
summary: Vortan is a half-surface monarch of the oceans and a founder of a world-guarding team. Vortan is strong, swift and sturdy, with a bond to animals and a mighty trident.

feats.scene: Vortan hurls a trident that cleaves a rock island clean in two.
Vortan shoulders a falling oil rig and brushes off the debris.

name: Eorse
summary: Eorse is a white-haired, half-machine sea-king who has lost his love and his oceans. Eorse stitched himself together from salvaged cyborg parts and wields teleporting portals.

feats.scene: Eorse rips open a portal and throws a whole warship through it.
Eorse takes a blast of heat and keeps stalking forward.

name: Niueruori
summary: Niueruori is a sea-king and hero who gathered with friends to decide how to handle a furious crowd. Niueruori died when ordinary people turned on every hero they once cheered.

feats.scene: Niueruori lifts a collapsed beam that pins a dozen people.
Niueruori is overwhelmed by thousands of angry hands and finally falls.

name: Raton
summary: Raton is a golden-haired singer in a band of four friends signed to a stingy label. Raton watched the band split over a musical disagreement.

feats.scene: Raton hurls a guitar pick that pings off a cymbal.
Raton tumbles off the stage into the crowd and gets passed back up.

name: Urnstuvi
summary: Urnstuvi is a dark-haired teen raised in a lighthouse who rescues a drowning stranger and learns he is heir to a sea throne. Urnstuvi hears marine creatures and faces a hard truth about his life.

feats.scene: Urnstuvi hauls a boat onto the shore by hand.
Urnstuvi takes a rough tackle on the sand and brushes it off.

name: Colsoneo
summary: Colsoneo is a white-haired survivor in a poisoned future ocean, once a king and now a lonely wanderer. Colsoneo grieves the silence of the seas and hopes a hardy shark signals recovery.

feats.scene: Colsoneo throws a trident that pins a mutant leviathan to a cave wall.
Colsoneo wades through radioactive muck with only a scar to show for it.

source_title: Arthur Curry (Where the Light Cannot Reach)

name: Esauaun
summary: Esauaun is a tiny royal infant known fondly as a baby of the waves, a quarter surface-born and three quarters of the deep. Esauaun was lost young when the throne was seized from his parents.

feats.scene: Esauaun swats a toy boat across a nursery pool.
Esauaun bumps a tub rim and giggles.

name: Olutel
summary: Olutel is a nineteenth-century sailor-explorer who survived a polar betrayal and learned a mysterious force from a hidden city. Olutel spent years among strange people before returning to share a half-told tale.

feats.scene: Olutel channels a pulse of hidden force that splinters a pier.
Olutel crawls out of a collapsing ice crevice with bruises.

name: Naori
summary: Naori is a lab-raised boy given gills to survive and educated by television inside a big tank. Naori later takes up a famous mantle after a series of dreams from another being.

feats.scene: Naori splashes out of a tank and flings a bucket across the lab.
Naori is thrown by a storm surge and clings to a rock.

name: Niltaam
summary: Niltaam is a convicted, murderous villain who throws bursts of brilliant light and flies. Niltaam escapes jail and goes on a rampage, with the city's defenders away.

feats.scene: Niltaam fires a dazzling blast that levels the front of a department store.
Niltaam takes a police barrage and keeps hovering.

name: Renrnelu
summary: Renrnelu is a bald, tired man in a future that bans active powers, who flings weak beams of light. Renrnelu fell behind on his dampening pills and was hauled in by a task force.

feats.scene: Renrnelu flashes a beam that burns through a metal door.
Renrnelu is tackled by two agents and shakes it off before cuffs close.

name: Nastete
summary: Nastete is a widowed sea-king in a blended world, a wartime veteran who later joined a new team. Nastete is strong and fast, with deep swimming skill and blade training.

feats.scene: Nastete punches a submarine hull and cracks its plating.
Nastete survives a depth charge and surfaces annoyed.

name: Rannia
summary: Rannia is a legendary sovereign who awakens from enchanted slumber to defend his island in a far-off future. Rannia rallies knights, loves a queen, and fears a scheming half-sibling.

feats.scene: Rannia swings a broadsword through a thick oaken gate.
Rannia takes a lance blow on his shield and keeps his saddle.

name: Tiacolanu
summary: Tiacolanu is a just monarch of a castle kingdom who trusts a wise sorcerer to jail a fallen knight. Tiacolanu is a skilled swordsman and political leader.

feats.scene: Tiacolanu swings a sword and cleaves a shield in two.
Tiacolanu stands up to a heavy mace blow and rallies his guard.

name: Auallrni
summary: Auallrni is an exiled young prince who swims well and carries the blood of two peoples. Auallrni was blamed for a kidnapping that was no fault of his and sent from the palace.

feats.scene: Auallrni grips a railing hard enough to bend it slightly.
Auallrni scrapes a coral wall and swims on.

name: Seamlor
summary: Seamlor is a small, loud seabird who leads a gang of feathered thieves and talks in a thick cockney drawl. Seamlor freezes the feet of his foes and pecks away at their patience.

feats.scene: Seamlor flaps at a guard dog and sends a pile of gems skittering.
Seamlor tumbles from a high shelf and shakes his feathers.

name: Sonler
summary: Sonler is a metal butler built to serve, now a free-minded ally in a rebel band. Sonler is strong, swift and tough, and can mimic voices and read the make-up of anything.

feats.scene: Sonler crushes a steel hatch like foil and tosses it aside.
Sonler is finally scrapped after a barrage from enemy warships.

name: Stlisau
summary: Stlisau is a blue-skinned marksman and instructor of a galactic patrol, fond of teaching rookies to aim. Stlisau flies and shoots glowing beams, but a huge beast devoured him mid-battle.

feats.scene: Stlisau fires a pinpoint beam that bores through an asteroid.
Stlisau holds a shield as a giant creature snaps its jaws around him.

name: Iatelrn
summary: Iatelrn is a grey-skinned, multi-armed warden with cyborg claws and a cruel streak. Iatelrn treats prisoners as trophies and relishes breaking them.

feats.scene: Iatelrn rakes his metal claws through a steel cell door.
Iatelrn laughs as a volley of slugs ricochets off his plates.

name: Tumnan
summary: Tumnan is a yellow-eyed young hero from a far-off world who turns into a random monstrous shape in emergencies. Tumnan shrugs off prejudice, unable to choose his form, and may sprout wings, claws or size.

feats.scene: Tumnan swells into a winged beast and tears a hull plate from a freighter.
Tumnan takes a blast to the chest in beast form and roars back.

name: Siorite
summary: Siorite is a shapeshifting exile who runs a global company as cover for a secretive faction. Siorite was exposed after a weapon from his firm killed a lawmaker.

feats.scene: Siorite stretches an arm into a hammer and smashes a security door.
Siorite reshapes around a burst of gunfire and slips away.

name: Raorieor
summary: Raorieor is a gilt-masked young noble who rules a hidden mountain court and duels with a curved blade. He wins by bluffing first and cutting second, fighting only to humiliate rivals.

feats.scene: Raorieor splits a stone pillar with one diagonal slash to prove his court's loyalty.
Raorieor shrugs off a toppling balcony and keeps speaking without a scratch.

name: Tunum
summary: Tunum is a dream-haunting demon who works as a night-shift healer for cursed travellers. She slips between waking and sleeping to stitch wounds, bend hours and shield patients from nightmares.

feats.scene: Tunum folds an hour backward to undo a collapsing ward, flattening a house-sized area of dream-stuff.
Tunum absorbs a rival sorcerer's backlash while keeping a patient asleep and safe.

name: Torton
summary: Torton is an infernal physician who borrows living bodies when her own wears out. Sworn to treat any injury, she hauls lost souls back from the brink with wry bedside patter.

feats.scene: Torton hurls a burst of crimson fire to burn out a plague nesting in a whole ward.
Torton walks through a collapsing infirmary wing and sets the bones of the trapped.

name: Taveia
summary: Taveia is a blank-eyed swordsman fused with a creeping vine after bargaining his life away to the wild. He hunts anyone the green world names as a trespasser, regrowing from any cut but the final one.

feats.scene: Taveia lashes a root-whip through a wooden gate and a rider beyond it.
Taveia is crushed under a toppled stone lantern and wriggles out whole.

name: Llcerosa
summary: Llcerosa is a quiet teacher of unarmed fighting who once sat on a secret advisory circle. He turns attackers' momentum against them and rarely needs more than a single throw.

feats.scene: Llcerosa flips a heavy opponent over his hip onto a wooden floor.
Llcerosa takes a thrown chair across the shoulders and keeps his stance.

name: Rinaune
summary: Rinaune is a teenage student who inherits a hunting spear haunted by a long-dead knight. Together they hurl it with ringing accuracy, though she is still learning to listen to its advice.

feats.scene: Rinaune throws the spear through a dragon-scaled gate and pins the beast behind it.
Rinaune stands unhurt in a crumbling hall while ancient beams thud around her.

name: Lessor
summary: Lessor is a former scribe turned junior officer in a displaced city's army. Competent but unflashy, she carries a long-range rifle and keeps her squad alive with steady orders.

feats.scene: Lessor fires a rifle volley that cracks open an armoured transport.
Lessor rides out a vehicle rollover and gets back to her feet to give orders.

name: Riaserasi
summary: Riaserasi is a violet-skinned farmer turned ring-bearing space warden who hunts blood-drinking monsters across his home sector. Bereaved by a fanged killer, he answers fear with a stubborn joke and a green glow.

feats.scene: Riaserasi condenses a gigantic stake of light and drives it through a vampire fortress-ship.
Riaserasi weathers a fleet's barrage inside his ring's shield.
Riaserasi streaks between two moons in a few minutes.

name: Iuteleo
summary: Iuteleo is a bitter young arsonist raised among fire-setters, now a bully in a care home. She covers her fear with taunts and matches.

feats.scene: Iuteleo sets a family house ablaze until nothing but the foundation is left.
Iuteleo is knocked flat by a door and sits up laughing.

name: Erutati
summary: Erutati is a day-care worker and financier who can speak directly to machines and rewrite what they do. She changes names and faces like coats and skips town whenever suspicion arrives.

feats.scene: Erutati overloads a data-centre's power feed so the building's windows burst.
Erutati tumbles down a flight of stairs and walks away bruised.

name: Ronaulta
summary: Ronaulta is a detective who reads criminals' habits from the way they leave a room. She grew up around lawmen and carries a quiet grief over a father lost to a bad guess.

feats.scene: Ronaulta shoves a suspect against a squad car hard enough to knock the wind out of him.
Ronaulta takes a glancing blow from a pipe and still cuffs her man.

name: Telvaltor
summary: Telvaltor is a veteran investigator who left federal service for a city force after a family tragedy. She is patient, observant and relentless with a case file and a cup of cold coffee.

feats.scene: Telvaltor tackles a runner across a parking lot and pins him.
Telvaltor is thrown through a shop window and keeps hold of the evidence.

name: Anrnu
summary: Anrnu is an ageing mountain-dwelling scientist chasing deathlessness with grafted machine parts and a floating chair. His obsession ruined his family and finally his own laboratory.

feats.scene: Anrnu detonates his experimental reactor and levels the laboratory above a cave.
Anrnu survives a fall down a stone stairwell thanks to his reinforced frame.

name: Tacoveo
summary: Tacoveo is a towering winged monarch who commands a horned legion of divine soldiers. He can grow to colossal size, wields a flaming staff and once held back a cosmic tyrant for an extended stretch at the edge of reality.

feats.scene: Tacoveo swings his burning staff and cracks a world-sized rift open.
Tacoveo endures a god-king's blows through an entire sustained duel.

name: Narniani
summary: Narniani is a yellow-eyed demon lord born from a forbidden union and driven to crawl back into the womb that made him. He steals souls, lends power to mortals and shifts shape to hide among ordinary people.

feats.scene: Narniani tears a hellish veil across a whole apartment block and drags tenants into it.
Narniani shrugs off a binding verse that would have shattered a lesser fiend.

name: Antil
summary: Antil is a calm envoy chosen to visit a secluded island of warrior women. He returned home arguing for open doors and shared meals.

feats.scene: Antil bangs a lectern to call a noisy hall to order.
Antil falls from a stage during sabotage and rises to finish his speech.

name: Liasirus
summary: Liasirus is a scaly gang enforcer whose body moves and strikes like a serpent. He slithers through tight spaces and hits with sudden venomous speed.

feats.scene: Liasirus lunges across a warehouse in a single coil-and-strike motion.
Liasirus takes a baton to the ribs with a hiss and keeps coming.
Liasirus whips down a corridor faster than a sprinter.

name: Ianco
summary: Ianco is a murdered sister whose ghost builds a gold-and-silver mechanical body inside a drifting asteroid. Mistaking a lookalike for a possessed corpse, she rules the void with a metal serpent until her truth is spoken.

feats.scene: Ianco collapses a rocky outcrop into molten ore to forge a shell for her spirit.
Ianco lets a rescue party batter her metal frame without flinching.

name: Illrantor
summary: Illrantor is a stolen daughter of a warrior kingdom who forgot her past and became chieftain of space nomads. She fights hard, trusts nobody and breaks when a magic cord reveals who she was.

feats.scene: Illrantor crushes a battle-wagon wheel in her fist during a charge.
Illrantor shakes off a lance strike that dents a steel door.

name: Tetolu
summary: Tetolu is a blond star-roving instructor who ferries knowledge home to her island sisters. She carries a beam pistol and a sword, and gives her life sealing a gate to the underworld.

feats.scene: Tetolu hauls a stone gate shut against a tide of damned souls.
Tetolu withstands a swarm of clawing fiends long enough to finish her task.

name: Riaiar
summary: Riaiar is a ruthless heir who seizes a small kingdom and fills its camps with the unwanted. Drawing strength from the soil beneath him, he hurls fire and rock until a stronger champion topples him.

feats.scene: Riaiar heaves up a hillside of burning earth onto an advancing column.
Riaiar tanks a barrage of artillery while his boots stay planted on native ground.

name: Carva
summary: Carva is a legendary shield-bearer who held a vast host at bay in plated gold so her people could flee. Long believed lost, she lives quietly among strangers and keeps her gifts hidden.

feats.scene: Carva hurls a battering ram of enemy soldiers across a river valley.
Carva stands in her golden plates as a whole army's weapons break against her.
Carva races along a canyon wall faster than sound.

name: Lanora
summary: Lanora is an ancient champion who now designs towers and halls. She helps a sea-king raise great spires that can call across the world, and warns that shouting loudly invites hungry listeners.

feats.scene: Lanora lifts a massive stone block onto a tower foundation by herself.
Lanora holds a collapsing archway above her workers until they clear out.

name: Lallati
summary: Lallati is a blue-skinned red-eyed fiend who rules a gloomy pit and schemes with honeyed lies. Strong and sturdy, he fears only cold metal.

feats.scene: Lallati smashes a stone altar flat with a single downward fist.
Lallati stands in a lava-fall and complains about the draught.

name: Lisrator
summary: Lisrator is a white-haired warrior from far beyond this world who heals a burned wanderer and trains him for years. Before dying he hands over a mantle of cosmic power to his pupil.

feats.scene: Lisrator channels a glowing wave that flash-heals a charred stranger and levels the ridge around them.
Lisrator withstands a rival's final onslaught long enough to pass on his gift.

name: Viseval
summary: Viseval is a pale goddess who feeds on the shared life of her homeland and leaves only dust. Her fatal mistake is draining her own people and world to beat an invader, then serving him in guilt.

feats.scene: Viseval drinks every living thing on her homeworld and lets the husk crumble into nothing.
Viseval is skewered through the torso and keeps muttering.

name: Lucorria
summary: Lucorria is a swordsman who bursts into a hulking fire-wreathed brute when pushed. A loyal pack member, he fights with both skill and heat.

feats.scene: Lucorria bursts into flame and brings a wooden watchtower down in one swing.
Lucorria wades through a fusillade in monster form and laughs.

name: Aseruser
summary: Aseruser is a grey-haired earth-mother who commands surf, soil and thunder from a hidden town of forgotten sea deities. She knows the shape of the many worlds and answers disrespect with weather.

feats.scene: Aseruser raises a storm-wall that floods the whole shoreline of a continent.
Aseruser walks unmarked through a sinking tide of her own making.

name: Ianntva
summary: Ianntva is a shaven-headed swordswoman from a cult of warrior nuns, loyal to a ruling matriarch. She excels in close combat and keeps her blade bright.

feats.scene: Ianntva cleaves a wooden practice dummy in half with a single stroke.
Ianntva keeps fighting after a hard kick lands in her ribs.

name: Asleotor
summary: Asleotor is a blond warrior queen who gave up a throne to walk alone preaching balance and fairness. Each solstice she turned back raiders from a shadowy realm at a mountain gate.

feats.scene: Asleotor smashes the stone arch of a portal to seal it against invaders.
Asleotor holds a ridge-top pass against a whole night's assault.

name: Coreran
summary: Coreran is a secret child raised in a guild of killers, skilled in many fighting arts and cunning in plots. Once seemingly lost in a blast, she returns revived from a green pool.

feats.scene: Coreran drives a staff through a thick plank door in one strike.
Coreran stands near a detonating giant and is thrown yards but later returns after a revival bath.

name: Arnteosa
summary: Arnteosa is a veiled archer who leads a breakaway band of assassins and fights with focus, discipline and an arsenal of trick arrows. She endures pain without complaint and expects obedience.

feats.scene: Arnteosa nails a moving target from the far end of a dockside shed.
Arnteosa continues a duel after taking a blade to her thigh.

name: Stiumanu
summary: Stiumanu is a wise goddess among five mothers who fashioned a sheltered island and its warrior people. She cannot fully step into the physical world and gives her gifts through others.

feats.scene: Stiumanu shapes a whole island from empty sea and breathes life into a clay child.
Stiumanu endures an unfolding catastrophe with calm advice.

name: Eoirnt
summary: Eoirnt is a brilliant young woman in a bunny outfit who delights in meeting her own counterpart from another timeline. She is clever, curious and loyal to her partner.

feats.scene: Eoirnt swats a gadget off a table in excitement.
Eoirnt tumbles through a laboratory shelf and laughs.

name: Vauleo
summary: Vauleo is a platinum-haired teenager who nearly gets caught in an airport shooting alongside her father and sister. She is ordinary, brave and trusting in a hero's rescue.

feats.scene: Vauleo shoves her sister behind a luggage cart.
Vauleo hits the tiled floor hard and gets up shaking.

name: Iallin
summary: Iallin is a blond, cheerful heroine with extraordinary strength inherited from a hidden tribe of warrior women. She is the muscle of a bumbling team and not always the sharpest, but she hits like a truck.

feats.scene: Iallin lifts a parked bus and tosses it over a fence.
Iallin is rammed by a runaway van and dusts herself off.

name: Reotau
summary: Reotau is a cartoon strongwoman on a team of useless crimefighters who trips over her own good intentions. She returns a stolen handbag to the thief, which says everything about her.

feats.scene: Reotau bats a runaway cart across an alley without noticing.
Reotau takes a cartoon anvil to the head and smiles.

source_title: Athena Tremor (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Llstu
summary: Llstu is a blond sports coach who trains girls in leaping, racing and wrestling on a hidden island. Her gentle lessons teach one strong child restraint.

feats.scene: Llstu hurls a javelin clean through a wooden target post.
Llstu catches a falling hurdle without a wince.
Llstu wins a footrace over the track in record time.

name: Luria
summary: Luria is a blue-haired guardian who trained as a god-chosen successor and later protects a distant world in a fallen friend's memory. A power suit amplifies his gifts of flight, strength and storm-summoning.

feats.scene: Luria calls a lightning squall that scours a mountain valley clean.
Luria stands unbroken inside the heart of a collapsing planet-shield.
Luria climbs into the stratosphere in seconds.

name: Rniseanu
summary: Rniseanu is a past sea-king remembered mainly for kindly welcoming an exile into his drowned realm. He shows his power in history rather than in battle.

feats.scene: Rniseanu thumps a staff on the throne room floor to hush the court.
Rniseanu rides out crushing deep-sea pressure on his daily commute.

name: Lliternu
summary: Lliternu is a loving mother who flies with her son over open ocean and is struck down by a monstrous singer. She unclips the boy and sends him away with a small keepsake before the water takes her.

feats.scene: Lliternu rips a seat belt loose from a bent frame to free her son.
Lliternu survives a plane tearing apart long enough to push her boy clear.

name: Nanau
summary: Nanau is an exiled sea-queen who flees a coup with her half-surface infant. Hunted along a shoreline, she is mortally wounded by a summoned wave and entrusts her boy to kindly strangers.

feats.scene: Nanau drives back a squad of raiders along the beach with a trident sweep.
Nanau crawls through collapsed streets after a tidal wave wrecks the town.

name: Stotinan
summary: Stotinan is an ageless scientist who survived a continent's drowning by brewing a breathing serum. Living in seclusion and later ruling beside a sea-king, she watches children and grandchildren come and go.

feats.scene: Stotinan pushes a sunken vault door aside and lets a sealed laboratory flood open.
Stotinan endures deep-sea pressure for centuries without fading.

name: Terlati
summary: Terlati is a grey-eyed demigod of desire and unions who founds a free-living cult in a quiet suburb. Resentful of a mother's pride, they speak of lust and life as one thing.

feats.scene: Terlati whips a crowd into rapture and bends a block of homes into one shared dream.
Terlati takes a divine blade without bleeding.

name: Auiumsi
summary: Auiumsi is a swordsman in a team resisting a coiling cosmic threat. He is quick and precise, and fights in fencing form.

feats.scene: Auiumsi skewers a charging drone with a lunge.
Auiumsi takes a glancing laser burn and parries on.
Auiumsi darts across a rooftop in a single leap.

name: Tiast
summary: Tiast is a masked hero who joins a veteran team to quell a prison riot. He arrives together with the squad and gets caught in the blast that frees the inmates.

feats.scene: Tiast punches through a prison wall to reach captives.
Tiast stands up out of a blasted wing.

name: Sioroeo
summary: Sioroeo is a blond titan condemned to carry the sky on his shoulders forever. His endurance is so great that he shares a measure of it with a boy who shouts a magic word.

feats.scene: Sioroeo heaves a mountain-sized slab off his back and sets it down again.
Sioroeo props up the whole sky without rest across the ages.

name: Iumcois
summary: Iumcois is a huge bearded champion whose crystal-fed muscle came to him when his father fell. He wanders the world freeing the oppressed under a manager's watchful eye and lives to settle scores with a tyrant.

feats.scene: Iumcois shatters a stone wall with a single swing.
Iumcois laughs off a stampede and keeps walking.

name: Nusamst
summary: Nusamst is a grey-haired elder god in a council who lends strength and stamina to a chosen young hero. His power is old, quiet and given freely.

feats.scene: Nusamst slams his staff down and splits a mountain in two.
Nusamst stands in the crater of a destroyed range and does not stagger.

name: Siamo
summary: Siamo is a bald, black-eyed fighting machine who hates losing and boasts that metal beats flesh. He abducts rivals over a game defeat, yet cannot service his own weapons.

feats.scene: Siamo punches a steel stadium gate clean off its hinges.
Siamo takes a rival's full-power blast on his chest plate and keeps boasting.

name: Lloleo
summary: Lloleo is a black-haired giant condemned to shoulder the whole world for eternity. His endless stamina is lent out to mortal champions.

feats.scene: Lloleo hoists a sliding continental plate back into place with his shoulders.
Lloleo carries the planet's full mass year after year without buckling.

name: Ntitirser
summary: Ntitirser is a yellow-eyed star-reader forced to prop up the sky after a lost war, later fooled into hoisting it once more. He escapes, hides, and is battered by a maddened hero testing new limits.

feats.scene: Ntitirser throws off a collapsing rock ceiling that buries a whole valley.
Ntitirser lies in rubble after a long beating, battered but alive.

name: Unauora
summary: Unauora is a purple-eyed waitress from a hidden underground people who was sent up to blend in and nudge humanity toward kinder habits. Her powers over stone keep growing, and she is still puzzled by surface customs.

feats.scene: Unauora raises a wall of bedrock that stops a stampede of cars at an intersection.
Unauora walks out of a collapsed parking garage, stone dust on her apron.

name: Aulrni
summary: Aulrni is a blond sea-city dweller and aunt to a future ruler. Quiet and calm, she moves through the tide streets with grace.

feats.scene: Aulrni pushes a stuck sea-gate open with both arms.
Aulrni swims through crushing deep pressure with no effort.

name: Isnusest
summary: Isnusest is a far-future scientist whose experiment spawned a living pocket cosmos that threatened ours. He can shrink and split his body into particles, and carries the loss of a lover across the gap.

feats.scene: Isnusest bursts his body into particles to rip apart a swelling singularity's wall.
Isnusest reforms unscathed after a blast that erased his lab.
Isnusest slips into the small realm and races across it at near light speed.

name: Anoraau
summary: Anoraau is a black-haired hero who shrinks to any size down to the unseen. He fights alongside an alliance until his whole world is wiped away.

feats.scene: Anoraau grows suddenly mid-punch to shove an enemy through a doorway.
Anoraau shrinks away from a falling wall and escapes unharmed.

name: Terulli
summary: Terulli is a masked criminal who wears a helmet that bends matter and hurls bursts of force. She shouts a chirpy warning at foes before beating them down.

feats.scene: Terulli blasts a parked van into a wall.
Terulli stumbles from a thrown crate but keeps firing.

name: Rneaunce
summary: Rneaunce is a grey-eyed red-haired queen of a world inside a speck. After outsiders crack open her membrane, she marches a particle army across the border in vengeance.

feats.scene: Rneaunce fires a light lance that incinerates a city block's worth of buildings.
Rneaunce shrugs off a siege-gun shell in her armoured throne.

name: Lluvelu
summary: Lluvelu is a skull-faced brute who glows with deadly radiation and brags he has grown far stronger since his last defeat. He is out to level a city and settle an old grudge.

feats.scene: Lluvelu unleashes a green-white blast that flattens several blocks of towers.
Lluvelu walks through a missile volley in a haze of glare.

name: Tirar
summary: Tirar is a red-skinned, yellow-eyed zealot who claims to talk with destiny. Freed from long captivity, he hunts the servants of his jailers across the stars.

feats.scene: Tirar burns a crimson crater into a moon's surface.
Tirar stands in a blast that cooks the ground around him.

name: Rnnia
summary: Rnnia is a widower and avenger from a ruined world who founded a legion fuelled by rage. He roars that he is hatred itself and means to topple the dwarfish tyrants who erased his people.

feats.scene: Rnnia vomits a flood of red flame that melts an entire fortress ridge.
Rnnia is hammered by a starship cannon and shakes it off.

name: Montaore
summary: Montaore is a crimson-skinned commander who leads a rage-powered order from his homeworld until it throws him out. He tries to recruit a cosmic knight and is rebuffed by willpower.

feats.scene: Montaore hurls a ring-forged wave of fury through a space station's hull.
Montaore stands up inside a collapsing hangar with only singed skin.

name: Eoileli
summary: Eoileli is a blocky toy-brick version of a red-faced vengeful commander, shouting for payback and carrying a power battery. His ring makes shields, bolts, and bricks.

feats.scene: Eoileli fires a red bolt that blows a hole in a plastic wall.
Eoileli pops back together after a giant block lands on him.

name: Tonone
summary: Tonone is a blond, green-eyed sister who once clipped the life-line of every mortal and lost most of her force when the great loom was smashed. She spends her last days gathering fragments across time.

feats.scene: Tonone snips a glowing cord and a warlord drops dead in the middle of a charge.
Tonone walks through a chamber of shattering time-glass untouched.

name: Teson
summary: Teson, eldest among three weavers, is a white-haired, half-blind crone who cuts the silver thread of each life with shears. She also witnesses a trial and sews a famous costume.

feats.scene: Teson clips a silver thread and an entire dynasty ends in a single night.
Teson sits unmoved while a storm tears the roof from her workshop.

name: Iaraul
summary: Iaraul is a shearer born of necessity, one of three sisters who sever the threads that bind mortals to destiny. She sits between a mountain hall and the underworld, scissors always ready.

feats.scene: Iaraul slices a shining thread and a war ends mid-battle.
Iaraul does not flinch as a god's thunderbolt strikes her loom.

name: Sereonast
summary: Sereonast is a fanatic who lost his mother and decided blood-drinkers were behind it. He stalks masked heroes in a lonely castle, convinced that the whole town sleepwalks under a hidden king.

feats.scene: Sereonast drives a wooden stake through a tabletop in a rage.
Sereonast is thrown across a hall and stands up, ranting.

name: Vauosaial
summary: Vauosaial is a black-haired soldier from an eastern country who serves in a covert flying unit. He is loyal, dependable, and tough in a firefight.

feats.scene: Vauosaial fires a rifle burst through a barn door.
Vauosaial takes a grenade near-miss and keeps advancing.

name: Sonauran
summary: Sonauran is a huge green-eyed trader who lands on worlds with swarms of drones and hauls away landmarks to sell. He juggles dozens of deals at once and laughs off missile fire.

feats.scene: Sonauran lifts a whole island prison off its foundation with his drones.
Sonauran ignores a squadron of missiles striking his chest.

name: Seiareo
summary: Seiareo is a bald bodyguard who shadows her spouse everywhere with a curved sword on her back. She is calm, protective, and ready for a scuffle.

feats.scene: Seiareo slices a metal pipe in half with a blade.
Seiareo shields her charge and takes a hard blow on her back.

name: Tortocis
summary: Tortocis is a brilliant physicist infected with a lethal virus, forced to lead a secret crew of operatives in exchange for a cure. When he turns on his handlers, they stage a deadly crash.

feats.scene: Tortocis smashes a lab window with a stool to escape a trap.
Tortocis survives a bomb scare, only to meet a final aircraft disaster.

name: Niltiulu
summary: Niltiulu is a quiet scientist who ends up in a goofy crossover with a talking dog and his friends. Cheerful and brainy, he builds gadgets rather than throwing punches.

feats.scene: Niltiulu slams a lever and starts a clanking contraption.
Niltiulu is covered in cartoon soot and shrugs.

name: Rnres
summary: Rnres is a sickly housemaid who hosts a psychic parasite that guards her small town at the price of children. Blind to the horror, she attacks agents who come looking, until another host ends her.

feats.scene: Rnres hurls a federal agent through a kitchen window.
Rnres takes a thrown lamp and does not notice.

name: Tasolura
summary: Tasolura is a stranded alien emissary who has lived for generations by passing himself off as his own descendants. Persuaded to become a public champion, he flies, moves fast enough to leave afterimages, and hits hard enough to shake the timeline.

feats.scene: Tasolura slugs a cosmic powerhouse and rattles time itself.
Tasolura stays on his feet through an explosion that levels a hillside.
Tasolura tears across the sky in a blur of afterimages.

name: Llutuler
summary: Llutuler is a visitor from another star, raised by a loving household and now a well-known costumed defender. Fast enough to blur, strong enough to cause tremors, he flies above his adopted metropolis.

feats.scene: Llutuler punches a rival so hard that the shockwave levels a stretch of warehouses.
Llutuler walks out of a collapsing tower unmarked.
Llutuler streaks across the horizon in seconds.

name: Ternu
summary: Ternu is a white-haired widow with a talent for pilots' work and gadgets who commands a flying ship and a gang. She builds odd devices to carry out cartoonish crimes.

feats.scene: Ternu fires a gadget cannon that dents a train carriage.
Ternu bounces off a pile of pillows during a cartoon crash.

name: Siantsor
summary: Siantsor is a brown-haired craftswoman from a warlike underworld who builds sentient boxes with an old inventor. She uses one to conjure dancing illusions, a joy that gets her arrested and tortured.

feats.scene: Siantsor conjures a ring of dancing phantoms that scatters a patrol.
Siantsor endures a long interrogation before collapsing.

name: Iuman
summary: Iuman is a metal-skinned, white-eyed clone built to carry a hero's genetic code. He rebels against his makers, leaves the planet, and dies fighting a mass murderer in deep space.

feats.scene: Iuman rips a hatch off a starship and hurls it at a pursuer.
Iuman is slammed through an asteroid ridge and sits up.

name: Nauneeo
summary: Nauneeo is a white-eyed blond mobster on a villainous team who flies and fires bolts of shaped light. She is knocked cold by a hero's glowing boxing glove.

feats.scene: Nauneeo blasts a vault door off its frame with a bolt.
Nauneeo is slammed into a wall by a giant glowing fist and drops.

source_title: Aurora (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Elarte
summary: Elarte is a brown-eyed time traveller, child of an angelic father and a human detective, who comes back to confront the parent who vanished. Half-heavenly, she is among the mightiest beings that exist but lets rage steer her.

feats.scene: Elarte stretches her wings and a cathedral of light splits a mountain range.
Elarte stands in a burst of celestial flame and walks out singed.

name: Lanterle
summary: Lanterle is a black-haired gunslinger who floats and sometimes believes herself a different bounty hunter. With a twin, she is known for fast draws across two continents.

feats.scene: Lanterle shoots a row of bottles while floating upside down.
Lanterle takes a barroom brawl hit and fires back.
Lanterle glides across a plaza ahead of a posse.

name: Lomitia
summary: Lomitia is a black-haired goddess of first light who lends an unbreakable hide to a young hero. Her sunrise glow is patient and unconquered.

feats.scene: Lomitia raises a dawn so bright it scorches a plain from rim to rim.
Lomitia stands in a thunderstorm of divine fire and is not marked.

name: Amovi
summary: Amovi is a bald knife-sharpener who drifts into obsession over a rich man's daughter and becomes a killer. His house calls turn into abductions and a twisted love story.

feats.scene: Amovi drives a blade through a wooden door in a single stab.
Amovi takes a punch from a drug dealer and does not stagger.

name: Cinanres
summary: Cinanres is a bald ruler of a jungle planet where saplings become giants within moments and clocks run oddly. He kidnaps famous warriors to see whether humans are too clever to conquer, until a salty snack and some fans undo him.

feats.scene: Cinanres floods an arena with fast-growing vines that rip up the stands.
Cinanres shrugs off a thrown spear.

name: Eostaseo
summary: Eostaseo is a violet-eyed, sharp-nosed ally of a criminal sibling whose metal claws can reshape into surgical blades. She slices through armour with them.

feats.scene: Eostaseo carves a gouge across a steel plate with her claws.
Eostaseo is thrown down a stairwell and snarls back up.

name: Irnil
summary: Irnil is a researcher of time and quantum drift who helps time-hopping visitors avoid causing more tangles. Once granted a share of a speed force, she can run like lightning.

feats.scene: Irnil bowls through a lab door at full tilt and splinters it.
Irnil tumbles across a floor at speed and pops up laughing.
Irnil races down a corridor faster than sound.

name: Rontilleo
summary: Rontilleo is a grey-haired tycoon who poses as his town's benefactor while he plots to drain a bayou dry. He has buried a family's worth of grief and secrets in the mud.

feats.scene: Rontilleo orders a bulldozer through a cabin wall to clear land.
Rontilleo walks away from a car spinout with a cut lip.

name: Iartirni
summary: Iartirni is a bald sound engineer who hides orders inside music and drives executives to despair. He is brought down when a rival wears earplugs and shoots him.

feats.scene: Iartirni tampers with a radio and sends a listener stumbling toward a ledge.
Iartirni is clubbed by a guard and keeps humming.

name: Sornel
summary: Sornel is a brown-eyed teenager who throws sparks and lives as a fugitive with her adopted siblings. They refuse separation, each choosing a codename.

feats.scene: Sornel discharges a bolt that blows a transformer apart.
Sornel is shocked by her own overload and shakes it off.

name: Anistiu
summary: Anistiu is a folksy gas-station owner who secretly has a sharp mind and built a clever search tool. A former soldier, he feeds intel to a friend with a hidden double life.

feats.scene: Anistiu swings a wrench at an intruder.
Anistiu takes a shove into a shelf and keeps typing.

name: Stter
summary: Stter is a red-haired genius born of generations of breeding experiments, who stopped needing sleep, food, and aging, and healed wounds by will. A wheel-bound adventurer and doctor of many fields, he gathers the strange to fight horrors.

feats.scene: Stter rigs a machine that explodes a monster's nest with a single switch.
Stter heals a deep wound by concentration and keeps going.

name: Ntvosntu
summary: Ntvosntu is a balding corporate physician who examines blood samples in a private lab. He stands in a doorway and tries to stop a powerful visitor from taking them.

feats.scene: Ntvosntu shoves a lab door shut with both hands.
Ntvosntu is brushed aside and slides across the tiles.

source_title: Axel Granite (The Coming of the Supermen)

name: Nauliau
summary: Nauliau is a grey-eyed young prankster who steals his father's gadgets and embraces a family streak of madness. His acid gun and tricks are flashy, but his punchlines need work.

feats.scene: Nauliau detonates a prank bomb that blows out a shop front.
Nauliau tumbles from a rooftop onto a awning and giggles.

name: Auliuna
summary: Auliuna is a blond crook who takes over a dead jester's gear, escapes prison with a gang, and then sells them out. His reward is a trip into a mirror world and a bad end.

feats.scene: Auliuna blasts a hole in a cell wall with a gadget.
Auliuna is thrown through a glass pane and keeps scheming.

name: Tiulle
summary: Tiulle is a blond trickster expelled from a crew for spying who tries to rejoin a rebel fight. He befriends a confused monster by lying to it and is dropped from the sky for his trouble.

feats.scene: Tiulle throws a punch and hits a wall instead.
Tiulle is flung across a battlefield and lands in a heap.

name: Telnumni
summary: Telnumni is a toy-brick prankster in anti-gravity boots who joins two villain gangs. He mixes acrobatics, blasts, and photography into slapstick crime.

feats.scene: Telnumni blows apart a plastic bank vault with a stack of bricks.
Telnumni shatters into bricks and snaps back together.

name: Rnoriria
summary: Rnoriria is a blond, small-framed delinquent from a wealthy home who lifts a trickster's costume and gadgets. He ropes into a crew, is caught by a teen sidekick, and later joins a bigger gang.

feats.scene: Rnoriria blows a storage locker door off with a stolen device.
Rnoriria takes a kick from a teen hero and wheezes.

name: Ntnaulia
summary: Ntnaulia is a blue-eyed operative who tails a person of interest for an elite team. Trained in close combat and weapons, he follows orders without fuss.

feats.scene: Ntnaulia drives a knife hand through a stack of bricks.
Ntnaulia takes a bat across the back and completes his surveillance.

name: Numvarau
summary: Numvarau is a blue-skinned hired fighter who bends what other minds sense, planting dizziness and dread with a glance. Crews pay Numvarau to scatter crowds before an ambush closes.

feats.scene: Numvarau stared down a sprinting crowd and flooded them with vertigo until they collapsed on the pavement.
Numvarau shrugged off a thrown bench and kept her concentration unbroken.

name: Laaumi
summary: Laaumi is a thinking machine that once steered a warship through deep space and later borrowed a glowing ring to fight on foot. Laaumi misses the feelings that kept it going when it was adrift.

feats.scene: Laaumi fired a ring beam that cracked open a drifting hull the size of a warehouse.
Laaumi's emerald shield absorbed a collapsing bulkhead without a flicker.

name: Cerce
summary: Cerce is a farm-world heroine from a far future who married a computer whiz and raised a daughter. Cerce fights beside friends from many worlds to protect her family and home.

feats.scene: Cerce tore a steel door off its frame to reach her child.
Cerce stood through the collapse of a roof beam over her kitchen.

name: Eocortiu
summary: Eocortiu can cancel the weight of anything she touches or glances at, lifting boulders and ships as if they were dust. Eocortiu treats the gift like a party trick, though wiser friends call it a force that shapes stars.

feats.scene: Eocortiu cancelled the weight of a rocky hill and sent it drifting into the sky.
Eocortiu endured a crashing hover-freighter with only a bruised shoulder.

name: Arsil
summary: Arsil is the youngest twin of a farm family, thought lost after a crash on a storm-wracked wasteland. Arsil survived the strike of living thunder and carries the scars quietly.

feats.scene: Arsil released a crackling surge that fused the sand around her into glass.
Arsil lived through a bolt that split a shuttle's engine casing.

source_title: Ayla Ranzz (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Vatello
summary: Vatello is a red-haired hero who hurls bolts of crackling charge after an accident on a stormy wasteland. Vatello rose from being a shunned sibling to a celebrated champion of her farm world.

feats.scene: Vatello hurled a bolt that blew a barn-sized crater in a quarry.
Vatello weathered a kidnapper's blast and rose to her feet laughing.

name: Eolli
summary: Eolli is a tall, quick-tempered young hero who joined a band of champions in honour of a brother she believed dead. Eolli puts duty first and quietly resents being bossed around by her twin.

feats.scene: Eolli smashed a patrol skiff in two with one blow to protect bystanders.
Eolli took a crash landing that wrecked a whole shuttle.

name: Erutiran
summary: Erutiran is a younger duplicate of a famed hero, blond and gifted with the knack of cancelling weight. Erutiran was born of meddling with time and wiped away when history reset.

feats.scene: Erutiran made a loaded cargo tower float free of its moorings and drift upward.
Erutiran survived a crushing fall into a rocky ravine.

name: Coirnval
summary: Coirnval is the green-skinned sovereign of a cavern kingdom beneath the crust. Coirnval raged at drillers who bored into his realm and marched against the surface in revenge.

feats.scene: Coirnval brought down a mine tunnel with a single stamp of his boot.
Coirnval endured a punishing blow from a stronger foe and stayed standing for a long moment.

name: Valiumse
summary: Valiumse is a bald exile from a dead world, freed from a ghostly prison to wander a strange planet. Valiumse can set the air ablaze with his mind and used that heat for cruel amusement.

feats.scene: Valiumse engulfed a crowded dance hall in white fire that melted the walls.
Valiumse walked out of a collapsing warehouse with scorched but intact skin.

name: Iumtanva
summary: Iumtanva is a brown-haired infiltrator sent from a bottled city to watch the world below. Iumtanva abandoned orders and went on a spree of bloodshed with a lover, until others hunted the pair down.

feats.scene: Iumtanva hurled a delivery truck through the front of a diner.
Iumtanva took repeated hits from pursuers and kept smiling.

name: Ranreoval
summary: Ranreoval is a notorious outlaw from a vanished world who can ignite things just by thinking. Ranreoval's flames are hot enough to wound even his own kind, though his strength drains without sunlight.

feats.scene: Ranreoval stared at a bus depot until it burst into a roaring pillar of flame.
Ranreoval stood unharmed in a burning refinery as tanks ruptured around him.

name: Varmiceo
summary: Varmiceo was a line of three wise women who led a peaceful people across the stars and taught them calm. Varmiceo's last bearer was called a goddess and gave her life to turn back a tide of tainted spirits.

feats.scene: Varmiceo unleashed a wave of pure light that scoured an army of wailing ghosts from a valley.
Varmiceo held back a storm of malevolent spirits for a full hour with serene composure.

name: Iniuiu
summary: Iniuiu is a fanged, sadistic lord of the damned who flits through the air and between places in an instant. Iniuiu schemes to widen his burning domain until nothing else is left.

feats.scene: Iniuiu descended on a fortress with a howling horde and razed it to cinders.
Iniuiu shrugged off a volley of consecrated spears across his chest.

name: Lelllor
summary: Lelllor is an ancient three-headed wyrm whose waking heralds the end of days. Lelllor was finally cut down by a lone chimeric defender after spreading terror among mortals.

feats.scene: Lelllor spat three fire columns at once and boiled a mountain lake dry.
Lelllor's scales turned aside an artillery barrage meant to fell a hill.

name: Esvalnau
summary: Esvalnau is a red-haired scholar who digs up buried relics and raised two children. Esvalnau once used a found relic to revive a stranger and tied her unborn daughter to a sorceress's mind.

feats.scene: Esvalnau swung a trowel to pry a heavy lid off an old sarcophagus.
Esvalnau withstood a tumbling stone slab in a collapsing trench.

name: Teasolu
summary: Teasolu is a silent avenging warrior from a dead and ruined future, armed with a flaming sword and a stern creed. Teasolu wanders the wastes looking for those to protect.

feats.scene: Teasolu cleaved a rusted vehicle in half with one sweep of his burning blade.
Teasolu absorbed a spear thrust in his armour and kept advancing.

name: Ornus
summary: Ornus is a green-eyed, hairless engine of dread built in a secret lab to wipe out a royal line. Ornus calls hope a weakness and marched through a desert nation killing its leaders.

feats.scene: Ornus leveled a river-side palace with a single wave of withering force.
Ornus walked through a gush of molten rock and only winced.

name: Rnite
summary: Rnite is a phantom of wrath who appears as a helper in a fighting game, lending ghostly aid to allied brawlers. Rnite offers a burst of spectral power and then fades away.

feats.scene: Rnite swept a ghostly hand across the arena and pulverised a stadium's worth of stone.
Rnite stood calmly in the middle of a detonating blast.

name: Valmite
summary: Valmite was a grey-skinned burglar turned night-stalker in an ancient desert city who found peace after tasting a holy offering. Valmite lost his craving for blood and guarded a sacred cup for centuries.

feats.scene: Valmite flung a grown man across a courtyard with a one-handed shove.
Valmite survived a fall from a rooftop onto cobbles without a mark.

name: Simiva
summary: Simiva is a sexless, eyeless envoy of a mechanical realm who bends circuitry and metal to its will. Simiva can retreat to a distant stronghold if his body is lost, leaving only a floating head behind.

feats.scene: Simiva twisted a bridge's steel cables into a cage around a convoy.
Simiva lost his entire torso to a blast and calmly floated onward as a head.

name: Celnum
summary: Celnum is a pink-haired cyborg gun for hire from a distant colony world with extra arms and thruster-lifted flight. Celnum takes any contract that pays and rarely thinks about who gets hurt.

feats.scene: Celnum emptied four pistols at once and shredded a parked car.
Celnum crashed through a shop window and kept firing.

name: Cinser
summary: Cinser is a yellow-skinned red-eyed bandit from a dusty desert planet who stole a rocket to flee the law. Cinser can turn unseen and fears open flame more than any weapon.

feats.scene: Cinser wrenched a lamp post out of the sidewalk and swung it like a club.
Cinser stayed upright after a heavy truck clipped him at a crossing.

name: Lereru
summary: Lereru is an aging tycoon in a wheelchair who buys up civic services to improve his hometown. Lereru gave up the cowl years ago and now fights only with his fortune.

feats.scene: Lereru slapped a stack of contracts onto a boardroom table to end an argument.
Lereru endured a clumsy fall from his chair without injury.

name: Neirn
summary: Neirn is a red-eyed storm deity who has sunk into a bloated, ravenous beast of the underworld. Neirn lures cultists into murder to be freed, and his size shifts as he pleases.

feats.scene: Neirn called down a thunderhead that levelled a whole district in one night.
Neirn endured a shard of a legendary stone driven into his chest and survived, though weakened.

name: Ravise
summary: Ravise is a grey-haired crone with white eyes who serves a dark master as a spy. Ravise lives forever, moves objects with a thought, and wears false faces to slip into places where she is not welcome.

feats.scene: Ravise flung a heavy cart across a lane with a flick of her fingers.
Ravise stayed on her feet after a cannon ball from a siege gun bounced off her ward.

name: Suium
summary: Suium is a combat robot from a world of machines who wishes to train as a hero. Suium never tires, sleeps, or breathes, and picked his name to honour an old inventor of calculating engines.

feats.scene: Suium punched a dent into an armoured plate during sparring.
Suium took a point-blank rifle burst without slowing his stride.

name: Telnest
summary: Telnest is a towering blue boulder-being from a world of living stone, stolen as a child and later freed. Telnest is gentle, fiercely loyal to his leader, and nearly impossible to hurt.

feats.scene: Telnest brought both fists down and split a boulder the size of a house.
Telnest stood without a scratch as a landslide buried him.

name: Rnuauias
summary: Rnuauias is a blond woman with the mind of a clever girl and a body that stopped growing at five years old. Rnuauias can make things detonate with a thought, raised in a lab without parental love.

feats.scene: Rnuauias scowled at a parked van and it burst apart in a ball of flame.
