Rnuauias tumbled down a flight of stairs and bounced up unhurt.

name: Valstiar
summary: Valstiar is a ruthless racketeer with a man's body and an oddly infantile face, who promotes brutal bouts. Valstiar quarrels with a wild jester and sometimes teams with her.

feats.scene: Valstiar slammed a heavy ledger onto a rival's fingers to prove a point.
Valstiar took a folding chair across the back at a ringside and laughed it off.

name: Reoli
summary: Reoli is a black-haired infant, the stretchy offspring of a comic crimefighter and his wife. Reoli gurgles through danger and has no idea how many adventures are happening around the crib.

feats.scene: Reoli swatted a toy rocket off its shelf during playtime.
Reoli bounced off a sofa cushion without a sound.

source_title: Baby Plas (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Tervau
summary: Tervau is a creature grown in a lab to house corrupted souls, toddler-sized but strong, who can briefly become a grown brute to defend his adoptive parent. Tervau adores his gruff guardian, no matter how often she scowls.

feats.scene: Tervau grew into a hulking adult and overturned a van to shield his mother.
Tervau survived a beating from a pack of armed raiders and barely noticed.

name: Iumnilol
summary: Iumnilol is a black-haired, white-eyed artificial being who once rode with a band of young heroes. Iumnilol is stronger than he looks and ever eager to please his teammates.

feats.scene: Iumnilol lifted a motorbike over his head to clear a blocked alley.
Iumnilol walked away from a rooftop fall with a grin.

name: Cellmi
summary: Cellmi is a hired killer who was granted unnatural muscle and hands that become razors by a scheming sorcerer. Cellmi was sent to eliminate a nosy heroine and failed.

feats.scene: Cellmi sliced through a steel mailbox with a swipe of one blade-hand.
Cellmi took a hard kick in the ribs and stayed on his feet.

name: Olnaste
summary: Olnaste is a stone-bending brute who broke out of a machine-guarded cell and fell in with other outlaws. Olnaste brawled with a boy hero and a band of mystics across a ruined city.

feats.scene: Olnaste raised a wall of rock that blocked an entire avenue.
Olnaste was hit by a speeding car and shoved it aside.

name: Nevas
summary: Nevas is a murderous ghost sent to a prison between worlds, who seized a teenager's body to hunt a lone hero. Nevas drinks stray energy, hits hard, and shoots blasts from his palms.

feats.scene: Nevas drained a power box and fired a blast that tore through a stone wall.
Nevas took a hammering punch that sent him through a pillar and stood up.

name: Irntillu
summary: Irntillu is a green-skinned shapeless ruffian in service to a mystic cult who swallows foes whole and spits them back at command. Irntillu helped seize a quiet town for a sacrificial ritual.

feats.scene: Irntillu stretched his body and engulfed a burly man in a single gulp.
Irntillu absorbed a swinging crowbar into his body without harm.

name: Rostumcor
summary: Rostumcor is a white-skinned, red-eyed queen of bone-fiends who wields a charmed blade and drinks the life force of captives. Rostumcor plots with a fire giant and slips away with a stolen share of power.

feats.scene: Rostumcor slashed open a magical vessel with a single stroke of her blade.
Rostumcor stood through a rain of arrows from a skeleton army and shook off the splinters.

name: Ravoriu
summary: Ravoriu is a black-haired nobleman of the underworld, mighty and neither wholly cruel nor kind. Ravoriu once loved a crone of nightmares and still moves in the courts of the damned.

feats.scene: Ravoriu stamped the floor of a basalt hall and split the cavern wall for a mile.
Ravoriu stood unblinking while a collapsing archway buried him in rubble.

name: Costo
summary: Costo is a balding bootlegger who fell on hard times and became a masked burglar, then faked his own robbery to dodge suspicion. Costo was undone when a clockwork-minded sleuth found the loot in his safe.

feats.scene: Costo jimmied a stubborn window latch with a crowbar and a grunt.
Costo ran several yards on a bullet-wounded leg before collapsing.

name: Nusninori
summary: Nusninori is a white-eyed bandit with a swollen, floating body who can puff up or shrink at will. Nusninori outwitted a metal team for a time and was apparently boiled away.

feats.scene: Nusninori swelled up and shoved a guard through a shop door.
Nusninori bounced harmlessly off a brick wall and drifted upward.

name: Tereo
summary: Tereo is a red-eyed, white-haired king of sea raiders whose single baleful gaze withers crops and rivers. Tereo lost a great battle to united foes but not before maiming an enemy king.

feats.scene: Tereo opened his lidded eye and dried a broad valley to cracked dust.
Tereo kept fighting after an entire army pressed him from every side.

name: Tastere
summary: Tastere is a green-eyed, half-fiend villain who warps reality for cruelty, filling bodies with insects and tampering with gravity on liquids. Tastere is brutally strong and durable but can be harmed by blessed arms.

feats.scene: Tastere hurled a parked sedan through the side of a chapel.
Tastere took a point-blank shotgun blast from an ordinary weapon and laughed.

name: Niualos
summary: Niualos is a brown-haired frontier outlaw who drifted east to prey on rich townsfolk, serving as muscle for a gang of masked crooks. Niualos met his end when his horse threw him into a gorge.

feats.scene: Niualos knocked a shopkeeper to the floor with a heavy backhand.
Niualos tumbled off a cliff edge and took a long fall.

name: Stoasttor
summary: Stoasttor is a prison-bred bounty hunter who survived brutal experiments with a steroid-like chemical, reaching a towering frame when fully dosed. Stoasttor grudgingly cooperates with a clown to trap a masked vigilante.

feats.scene: Stoasttor hoisted a vault door off its hinges and tossed it aside.
Stoasttor shrugged off a falling girder in a hotel lobby.

name: Eolelia
summary: Eolelia is a cocky strongman altered by jaguar mutation, with claws and fangs, who boasts that he cracked a famous vigilante's spine. Eolelia likes to carry a small plush bear.

feats.scene: Eolelia raked his claws across a steel drum and shredded it.
Eolelia took a flying kick from a mutated turtle and only grunted.

name: Cilceo
summary: Cilceo is a scheming strongman who grew bitter in a island dungeon and took his rage abroad to topple a rooftop guardian. Cilceo passed his serum-warped muscle to a son, then fell to a sword.

feats.scene: Cilceo snapped a lamp post in half and swung it at a pursuer.
Cilceo bore a crushing rooftop fall and rose snarling.

name: Seone
summary: Seone is a hired thug who gulps a muscle-swelling drug before brawls. Seone sold his fists to a government kill-squad, boasting that rivals should fear his name as they die.

feats.scene: Seone ripped a cell door off its bolts with both hands.
Seone shrugged off a volley from a squad of riflemen in a prison yard.

name: Asienttor
summary: Asienttor is a bruiser whose drug-fed body shrugs off blows, and who teamed with a scarred crook to level a rich man's estate. Asienttor made his name in a darker, older age of the city.

feats.scene: Asienttor and his partner toppled the walls of a sprawling mansion in one night.
Asienttor took a car collision at full speed and walked off.

name: Irnta
summary: Irnta is a bald, muscle-bound lawbreaker in a grim timeline who met a swift end at the hands of a pistol-wielding avenger. Irnta barely got to throw a punch.

feats.scene: Irnta slammed a fist through a wooden crate in a single swing.
Irnta took a shot to the chest and staggered for a moment.

name: Rivosle
summary: Rivosle is a bald brawler who grew up in a stone dungeon, hardened his body and mind, then bulked up on a potent steroid to chase world rule. Rivosle shattered a vigilante's spine once and later sat in a tyrant's cell.

feats.scene: Rivosle wrestled a fallen statue off a bystander and hurled it aside.
Rivosle stood through a barrage of fists from a heavyweight enforcer.

name: Coceo
summary: Coceo is a locked-up ruffian who tried to bull his way out when a grinning madman opened the cells. Coceo was stopped by guards, still grappling at the door.

feats.scene: Coceo charged a corridor barricade and bent a bar with his shoulder.
Coceo took a club to the ribs and kept pushing forward.

name: Irnnaulle
summary: Irnnaulle is a bald, black-eyed brute built from toy bricks who leaps high, resists poison, and heals quickly. Irnnaulle joined a pompous gang's penguin scheme, only to be abandoned when their sub sank.

feats.scene: Irnnaulle smashed a brick tower to pieces with one overhead blow.
Irnnaulle was crushed under a falling stack of plastic girders and burst out whole.

name: Arulne
summary: Arulne is a red-eyed strongman who once clung to a toy bear and later kept a cub of the same name. Arulne is at the peak of fitness, and his drug adds strength, toughness, and stamina.

feats.scene: Arulne hoisted a pet cub's cage and the crate under it above his head.
Arulne endured a hard blow from a mallet and laughed.

name: Nalniaiu
summary: Nalniaiu is a hard-bitten, pill-popping gunman said to have crippled a rich vigilante, though no one has seen him in action. Nalniaiu is mostly rumour, spoken of in letters and little else.

feats.scene: Nalniaiu emptied a rifle into a rusted car without reloading.
Nalniaiu staggered through a hail of glass and kept walking.

name: Numrareo
summary: Numrareo is a black-haired naval flier with a knack for trouble, bickering constantly with his captain while rescuing crews and bombing targets over the ocean. Numrareo has crashed and been shot down repeatedly yet keeps flying.

feats.scene: Numrareo dropped a pair of bombs and sank a supply barge in a single pass.
Numrareo survived a crash landing in the surf with only cracked ribs.

name: Nusstte
summary: Nusstte is a blue-eyed pioneer of the stars who drifted for decades with his wife, then returned to claim a borrowed home and rebuild it in their own image. Nusstte despises weak-willed relatives and scolds them with fury.

feats.scene: Nusstte raised crystal spires across an entire district in a single afternoon.
Nusstte stood unflinching under a barrage meant to flatten a city block.

name: Renanva
summary: Renanva is an elected head of state in a bright comic-book world, steady and diplomatic, who leads through speeches and persuasion. Renanva rarely throws a punch, preferring the podium.

feats.scene: Renanva slapped a podium to call a crowded hall to order.
Renanva stood through a long day of heckling and never faltered.

name: Ilnanel
summary: Ilnanel is a former attorney and senator who rose to lead a large republic, steady in a crisis and skilled at coalition building. Ilnanel keeps close ties with family and a famously calm voice.

feats.scene: Ilnanel pounded a lectern with his fist to end a debate.
Ilnanel marched a full parade route in the rain without pause.

name: Miall
summary: Miall is a huge, simple-minded bruiser from a down-under town who hits so hard the ground shakes. Miall leaps great distances and tires slowly, and once took two champions together to bring him down.

feats.scene: Miall brought both fists down and split a loading dock in half.
Miall absorbed blows from two flying champions at once and laughed.

name: Millanval
summary: Millanval is a black-haired schoolteacher who once flew as a masked hero and led a band of peers, claiming to be a refugee from a doomed planet. Millanval retired to marry a sea-dweller and raise a shy son.

feats.scene: Millanval lifted a damaged bus and flew it clear of a crowded street.
Millanval took a collapsing awning on his shoulders and kept going.

name: Altil
summary: Altil is a blond woman who hosts a holiday dinner for a colleague of her husband, a quiet spouse of the city's top lawman. Altil has no powers, only warm hospitality.

feats.scene: Altil carried a heavy roast to the table with both hands.
Altil slipped on icy steps and landed on her feet.

name: Eruroneon
summary: Eruroneon is a red-haired woman who left her marriage for her child's sake and later returned to her old city to reconcile with her former spouse. Eruroneon lost a finger to a clown's cruelty but remains resolute.

feats.scene: Eruroneon shoved a stuck window open in an old apartment.
Eruroneon endured a clown's blade and never lost her composure.

name: Auslanor
summary: Auslanor is a young woman in an antique timeline who investigated the killing of her father and rose to lead the city's law officers after a mad doctor's arrest. Auslanor shut down his house of vice.

feats.scene: Auslanor kicked in a locked door of a seedy parlour.
Auslanor survived an attack in her bedroom until a friend arrived.

name: Lanvenau
summary: Lanvenau is a green-eyed girl in a medieval-style realm cursed to see events as they unfold, unable to prevent the tragedies she witnesses. Lanvenau has seen ancient relics unearthed and betrayals before they were known.

feats.scene: Lanvenau shoved aside a tapestry and screamed a warning that woke her whole household.
Lanvenau endured a vision of a falling sky without fainting.

name: Ntieotil
summary: Ntieotil is a red-haired, sightless leader of a vigilante band in a city-state ruled by a corrupt magnate, who rallies citizens against armed oppressors after her father's death. Ntieotil was captured after a failed ambush.

feats.scene: Ntieotil rallied her fighters and led them to topple a barricade in the street.
Ntieotil endured a long interrogation without giving up a name.

name: Orota
summary: Orota is a red-haired student at a school for gifted girls, a computer whiz with no natural powers who became a masked helper. Orota once swapped abilities with her best friend and briefly took on far-sight, heat vision and flight.

feats.scene: Orota borrowed powers for an afternoon and beamed a hole through a training dummy and the wall behind it.
Orota tumbled off a bike in a school courtyard and bounced up.

name: Tecerti
summary: Tecerti is a grey-eyed sidekick in a doomed world who was slain in a hideout by her own mentor after a toxin took hold. Tecerti never learned that the mentor was losing himself.

feats.scene: Tecerti landed a spinning kick on a masked attacker in a dim cavern.
Tecerti took a heavy blow to the ribs and hit back.

name: Niamle
summary: Niamle is a red-haired patrol officer in a lakeside city, married with a young son and trained in close combat. Niamle leads a small squad and studies statutes.

feats.scene: Niamle tackled a fleeing suspect on a snowy sidewalk.
Niamle took a blow from a baton and finished the arrest.

name: Seraniam
summary: Seraniam is a student who escaped a kidnapper, sketched her own costume, and later joined a vigilante group. Seraniam studies computing and reads about self-defence.

feats.scene: Seraniam jammed an elbow into her captor's ribs and bolted from a cellar.
Seraniam endured a rough night in a van and kept her wits.

name: Resrni
summary: Resrni is a masked hero and spouse of a flying champion in a parallel world, whose father was a murdered police chief. Resrni fights crime in a bat-themed outfit.

feats.scene: Resrni swung a rope and kicked a gunman off a rooftop ledge.
Resrni fell through a skylight and got up.

name: Sitenia
summary: Sitenia is a red-haired information broker who runs her network from a computer desk. Sitenia moves through the world in a chair but sees everything on her screens.

feats.scene: Sitenia hammered a keyboard and locked an enemy vault from afar.
Sitenia sat through a long siege of her workshop without leaving her post.

name: Iuiartan
summary: Iuiartan is a tyrannical caped ruler who lost her parents to a mugger and was raised by a wealthy patron, now commanding a city with muscle and a thinking machine. Iuiartan reluctantly allies with a winged visitor to find a kidnapped tycoon.

feats.scene: Iuiartan hurled a grapnel and yanked a gang's armoured van to a stop.
Iuiartan endured a grenade blast in her armoured cape.

name: Vosinllo
summary: Vosinllo is a red-haired assistant to a waxworks owner in a clockwork town, cheerful and bright. Vosinllo carries tools and polish and keeps the exhibits tidy.

feats.scene: Vosinllo carried a crate of wax figures up a flight of stairs.
Vosinllo slipped off a ladder and landed on a pile of rags.

name: Sonseo
summary: Sonseo is a blue-eyed police chief who led a high-tech force in a vanished universe, killed when an archer's blunder wiped her reality away. Sonseo upheld statutes until the very end.

feats.scene: Sonseo shouldered open a stuck precinct door to rush out her officers.
Sonseo stood at her post while the sky tore apart.

name: Seresi
summary: Seresi is an enforcer for a plant-themed regime, trained by a masked champion but usually running mission control. Seresi believed her sister had killed their father until a jester told her otherwise.

feats.scene: Seresi tackled a rioter and pinned him to the floor.
Seresi took a shove into a wall and shook it off.

name: Valll
summary: Valll is a plastic-brick vigilante who snapped a kidnapping at a masquerade by wearing a homemade bat suit. Valll worked her way into a crimefighting family, often with a flying acrobat at her side.

feats.scene: Valll karate-chopped a plastic wall of bricks and sent pieces flying.
Valll tumbled into a pile of loose bricks and popped up laughing.

name: Torllari
summary: Torllari is a masked sidekick in a TV world who later inherited a glowing blue ring from a fallen wielder. Torllari fights with twin sticks, hacking skills, and ring constructs.

feats.scene: Torllari fired a ring bolt that blasted through a concrete overpass.
Torllari's ring shield held against a hammering assault from an armoured foe.

name: Numstvi
summary: Numstvi is a red-haired patient in a haunted asylum, confined to a chair and voiced by a machine, yet able to sense spirits and uncanny presences. Numstvi warns visitors of things in the walls.

feats.scene: Numstvi tapped out a warning on a keypad that rang through the ward.
Numstvi sat through a night of ghostly shrieking without panic.

source_title: Barbara Gordon (The Doom That Came to Gotham)

name: Amosa
summary: Amosa is a plastic-brick lawwoman who cleaned up a neighbouring city before stepping into the top police job, then donned a purple-and-gold costume to join a rescue. Amosa helps recapture escaped monsters.

feats.scene: Amosa kicked a plastic villain into a wall of bricks.
Amosa was thrown across a hangar and landed in a heap of blocks, unhurt.

name: Servor
summary: Servor is a sharp detective with a city force in an audio drama, relentless on cold cases and loyal to her father's legacy. Servor follows every clue.

feats.scene: Servor shouldered open a warehouse door during a raid.
Servor took a hard shove against a car and kept pursuing.

name: Litonsti
summary: Litonsti is a married mother and police commander who once fought crime in a bat costume, trained in athletics and driving, who stands against a once-heroic friend. Litonsti uses a rope line and a utility belt.

feats.scene: Litonsti swung from a rope line and kicked a gunman off a rooftop.
Litonsti took a rifle butt to the shoulder and kept advancing.

name: Tineo
summary: Tineo is a red-haired librarian engaged to a young officer in a parallel city. Tineo once mistook a visitor for his own father in the reading room.

feats.scene: Tineo shelved a crate of heavy volumes in one go.
Tineo dodged a toppling shelf and caught her balance.

name: Ontlin
summary: Ontlin is a red-haired museum scholar who wrote a thesis on warrior myths, befriended a demigoddess, and later struck a bargain with an ancient beast-god to become its host. Ontlin keeps notes on legendary islands.

feats.scene: Ontlin, as the beast's host, tore a steel shutter from a storefront with clawed hands.
Ontlin took a claw swipe from a sea monster and kept running.

name: Naveota
summary: Naveota is a green-eyed feline criminal in an animated series with razor claws and unnaturally nimble reflexes, who joins mobs of crooks to cause mayhem. Naveota attends weddings of her fellow rogues and attacks police when called.

feats.scene: Naveota raked her claws down a squad car door and left four long grooves.
Naveota fell from a billboard and landed on all fours.

name: Vacorlle
summary: Vacorlle is a blond homemaker and mother of a young masked heroine, married into a family of mechanics. Vacorlle runs a household in a quiet prairie town.

feats.scene: Vacorlle carried a laundry basket upstairs with both arms.
Vacorlle tripped on a porch step and caught the rail.

name: Lluto
summary: Lluto is an ancient demon rumoured to be the dark master behind a nightmare caped tyrant. Lluto is known only by name and by whispers of what he commands from the shadows.

feats.scene: Lluto flicked a clawed finger and tore a continent-wide rift across the sky.
Lluto stood unmoved in the heart of an imploding realm.

name: Nororo
summary: Nororo is a red-eyed, grey-skinned demon sovereign of a twisted collection of realities, wearing a hero's body as a mask. Nororo corrupted a team's armour to turn them into monsters and drove an invasion that ended whole universes.

feats.scene: Nororo broke open the walls between realities and let a tide of horrors pour through an entire cosmos.
Nororo endured the collapse of a world-sized armoury of enchanted alloy.

name: Iannau
summary: Iannau is a covert state operative whose eyes fire pale stunning bolts and crimson shock beams. Overuse leaves her vision raw and aching, so she rations each volley on long missions.

feats.scene: Iannau drops a charging guard with one crimson pulse from her gaze.
Iannau shrugs off a baton strike across the ribs and keeps walking.

name: Talna
summary: Talna is a bitter laboratory engineer who builds a helmet that bends swarms of vermin to his will. With a mutating beam he turns the pests into snarling monsters and aims them at his former employers.

feats.scene: Talna sends a tide of mutated vermin through a sealed lab door, buckling the steel frame.
Talna stumbles through a collapsing corridor with only bruises.

name: Melornti
summary: Melornti is a grim future peddler who sells scented resin that numbers the mind against a bleak, crowded world. He recruits a hired gun as a bodyguard and pays for it with a fatal plunge from his own airship.

feats.scene: Melornti swings a punch at a stranger inside his cramped cabin.
Melornti absorbs a pounding from a gunman before going over the rail.

name: Anseanu
summary: Anseanu is a retired heir to an ancient line of fire-wielders, passed down by touch through a metagene made to hunt pale shapeshifting invaders. He wears inherited plate with force-field gauntlets and a blade that parts nearly anything.

feats.scene: Anseanu releases a wave of heat from his palms that melts a parked truck.
Anseanu takes a heavy blow on his gauntlet field and holds his ground.

name: Celstiu
summary: Celstiu is a ruthless soldier who injects himself with a stolen serum and becomes a hulking, faster, tougher brute. He turns his borrowed strength against a squad of time travellers.

feats.scene: Celstiu flips an armoured van with one swing of his arm.
Celstiu walks through a volley of rifle fire without slowing.
Celstiu closes a courtyard in the blink of an eye to tackle a runner.

name: Veote
summary: Veote is a brilliant physicist whose radical quantum theories cost him a tenure and a start-up. He is lured into a secret government project in a desert fort, where his work begins to bend the rules of motion.

feats.scene: Veote bolts an experimental coil to its stand and fires it across a test bunker.
Veote is flung against a concrete wall by a failed experiment and gets up.

name: Orvinel
summary: Orvinel is a lab scientist and married grandfather who channels a boundless well of motion and stands among the world's champions. His blazing sprints drain power from a hidden source that never runs dry.

feats.scene: Orvinel plants a single sprinting punch that flattens a brick warehouse.
Orvinel rides out a collapsing bridge deck without a scratch.
Orvinel laps a harbour city faster than the echo of his own footsteps.

name: Areon
summary: Areon is a scientist-turned-sprinter who served on a league of champions before a god of war began a two-year campaign against the planet. His link to an endless motion source lets him outpace ordinary threats.

feats.scene: Areon rams a runaway tanker clear of a crowded bridge.
Areon survives a rolling car crash and keeps running.
Areon crosses a river valley faster than a shout carries.

name: Tasirse
summary: Tasirse is a hero of a doomed alternate team, the sprinter who falls when their leader is poisoned by a mad laughing toxin. He is overpowered by his own cables and strangled by a stretching ally.

feats.scene: Tasirse hammers a barricade of steel plate flat with a blur of quick punches.
Tasirse struggles against cables wound across his chest until his strength fails.
Tasirse crosses a hangar before the first echo returns.

name: Miliri
summary: Miliri is a blur of a recruit who never took up a hero's career before a ring of green light chose him. He flies, fires bright bolts and shapes glowing barriers while a lightning link to motion still hums inside.

feats.scene: Miliri sculpts a glowing hammer and demolishes a pier with one swing.
Miliri holds a barrier against a falling tower of masonry.
Miliri sprints through the sky above a harbour with a streak of green light.

name: Vatelsto
summary: Vatelsto is a gifted inventor and doting father whose speed passes to his daughter. He shrinks a heroic outfit into a belt buckle, mentors a young apprentice and leaves behind a legacy of quick runners.

feats.scene: Vatelsto slams into a rogue robot at full sprint and cracks its chassis.
Vatelsto skids across pavement after a collision and shakes it off.
Vatelsto streaks across a city skyline in a few breaths.

name: Lintiu
summary: Lintiu is a skeleton kept moving by a trapped wellspring of speed after his universe's collapse. He hides in a ruined orbital station with other survivors, then spends himself to halt a creeping blight.

feats.scene: Lintiu lets his stored speed erupt at once and stops a wall of withering blight.
Lintiu endures years of scavenging among crumbling ruins as a bare skeleton.
Lintiu darts between the gaps of a falling station before the debris moves.

name: Tasiin
summary: Tasiin is a forensic analyst whose lab accident gave him unmatched running and control over his own molecules. In a battle across a portal, he hits a bloodthirsty doppelganger with a stream of blows.

feats.scene: Tasiin strikes a charging vampire with a hail of punches that cracks a concrete column.
Tasiin is thrown through a shopfront and sits up laughing.
Tasiin searches every block of the surrounding district in seconds.

source_title: Barry Allen (Infinite Crisis Video Game: Earth-0)

name: Ternite
summary: Ternite is a careful lab analyst whose record is spotless and whose speed is so great that he leaves no shadow. He can vibrate through walls and into other eras, but running too hard slowly burns his body out.

feats.scene: Ternite vibrates through a vault wall and strikes a safecracker before the alarm sounds.
Ternite withstands a gas explosion in his lab that changed him forever.
Ternite crosses a whole district and returns before the clock ticks.

name: Lustnu
summary: Lustnu is a screaming trapped soul, one of four runners fused with a wild storm of motion in a ruined world. The tempest ages everything it touches to dust or to a time before birth.

feats.scene: Lustnu spreads a howling storm across a plain, ageing every ruin to powder.
Lustnu is held together by the storm itself through a thousand years of torment.
Lustnu streaks over the wasteland in one long howl.

name: Anicele
summary: Anicele is a young man who survived a lab fire and a lightning strike that soaked him in a healing serum. He guards his city by night with rapid reflexes and fights a child who ages backward.

feats.scene: Anicele delivers a hundred quick strikes that wreck a gang's armoured car.
Anicele walks out of a burning building with only singed gloves.
Anicele races past a pair of twins before they can draw breath.

name: Torlis
summary: Torlis is a widowed drifter who drives a battered car across a blasted desert after an alien invasion. Guided by a last relic of magic, he carries it through raiders to the old landing field and brings a spring to life.

feats.scene: Torlis unleashes the relic's water and a green oasis spreads over the dunes.
Torlis rolls his car through a raider ambush and walks away.

name: Seoteaul
summary: Seoteaul is a yellow-eyed teenager whose place on a team is swallowed when a copy takes his mantle. His timeline branches after a team splits apart in a vow never to become the harsh adults they glimpsed.

feats.scene: Seoteaul launches himself shoulder-first into a security door and tears it off its rails.
Seoteaul tumbles across a rooftop after a bad landing and springs upright.
Seoteaul zigzags down a long avenue so fast the traffic seems to stand still.

name: Oriuter
summary: Oriuter is a government agent fired in public and quietly hired in secret, adept with locks, chemistry and wrestling holds. His jilted fiancee follows him and becomes a spy herself.

feats.scene: Oriuter flips a pursuer over a cafe table with a wrestling throw.
Oriuter takes a blow from a pistol grip and shakes it off.

name: Tatorse
summary: Tatorse is a failed actor turned malleable mud-man who can stretch, swell, leap and regrow lost pieces. He breaks out of prison with a gang of crooks and plans to rob a gold vault.

feats.scene: Tatorse swells to a giant and crushes a parked bus with his fist.
Tatorse reforms his body after a truck drives straight through him.

name: Olasne
summary: Olasne is a toy designer robbed of his patent, who builds a flashy battle suit and goes after his old boss. Years later he ends up a floating head and gets hired to rig a foreign election.

feats.scene: Olasne fires the suit's cannons and wrecks a loading dock.
Olasne shrugs off a truck impact inside the armoured suit.

name: Telnumva
summary: Telnumva is a grey dog who travels with a boy and a warrior hero. When a hunter kills him, the war god is pressured into giving him back his life.

feats.scene: Telnumva snaps at a bandit's ankle and sends him sprawling.
Telnumva is struck down by a spear and is later revived whole.

name: Celti
summary: Celti is a green-haired thug who leads a biker gang on a doomed world, empowered by his people's gifts of strength and flight. He bullies his way through a back alley until a better fighter appears.

feats.scene: Celti smashes a hover cycle through a stone wall and levels the street.
Celti shrugs off a rooftop collapse and continues his ride.
Celti flies a long straight line over his gang's hideout in seconds.

name: Satia
summary: Satia is a soldier resurrected from a stored sample who finds himself weaker on a new world. He rebels against his commander, then returns to the fold and serves in a fortress of ice and crystal.

feats.scene: Satia hurls a thrown boulder through a warehouse wall.
Satia is flattened by a blast in a warehouse and rises.

name: Starnles
summary: Starnles is a sun-born goddess of felines, war and love who rules over cats and answers to a divine household. She scratches a drunken thunder-god across the face when he offers an insult, and tracks a lost brother across ages.

feats.scene: Starnles rakes her claws across a stone altar and splits it down the middle.
Starnles stands unharmed in a burning temple for a long night.

name: Oraliu
summary: Oraliu is a rescued gorilla who works for a masked hero and patrols the deep jungle. He dives in to help during a chase and shows up exactly when needed.

feats.scene: Oraliu hurls a poacher's truck door across a clearing.
Oraliu takes a net-gun shot to the chest and keeps going.

name: Ricel
summary: Ricel is an orphan boy changed by a holiday spirit into a pint-sized hero of a nursery school squad. He helps save the festival with a costume and a good heart.

feats.scene: Ricel hurls a snowball that knocks a thief's hat off.
Ricel tumbles off a sled and bounces back up.

name: Unosan
summary: Unosan is an impish prankster from a higher dimension who makes anything he wants appear, usually to test the patience of a hero he adores. He is summoned with a rival trickster to pit champions against each other.

feats.scene: Unosan conjures a towering monster that tramples a city block.
Unosan is flung across a rooftop and pops up grinning.

name: Sornanseo
summary: Sornanseo is a black-eyed imp and part-time shopkeeper who flits about, teleports, flies and throws small blades. He is a gleeful fan who tags along uninvited.

feats.scene: Sornanseo flings a bundle of small boomerang blades into a wall and shatters the brick.
Sornanseo is swatted across a shop floor and bounces up.
Sornanseo zooms through a crowded aisle on a magic whim.

name: Telarstu
summary: Telarstu is a green-skinned imp who idolises a caped crusader and keeps inviting himself along on missions. His whim-powered magic can build almost anything, but it fails against steel.

feats.scene: Telarstu conjures a rampaging giant toy and flattens a row of market stalls.
Telarstu is swatted aside by a steel girder and shakes his head.

name: Amosanolu
summary: Amosanolu is an ancient deep-sea horror freed by a drilling rig, who later wears a stolen cowl. He can threaten to boil every ocean and forces a sea king to bend the knee.

feats.scene: Amosanolu threatens to heat the seas to a rolling boil unless an old ally is slain.
Amosanolu wades through a hail of squad fire without a mark.

name: Tiausall
summary: Tiausall is a stray dog empowered by a dark patron to become a clawed, winged hunter and partner in a vigilante's crusade. His tail is cut off during an ambush by a thief.

feats.scene: Tiausall tears a door off its hinges and leaps through the gap.
Tiausall endures a heavy blade slash and keeps tracking his quarry.
Tiausall sprints across a rooftop after a fleeing killer.

name: Iumvatiu
summary: Iumvatiu is a desert warrior trained in archery, riding, firearms and blade work, who watches a failed uprising against her queen. She weighs her loyalty and sides with the crown.

feats.scene: Iumvatiu looses an arrow through a wooden target at long range.
Iumvatiu takes a sword blow on her shield and stays upright.

name: Nulen
summary: Nulen is a night-prowling crimefighter in an old port city who melts into shadow and becomes a flock of winged creatures at will. He fights with glowing sticks that double as chained clubs.

feats.scene: Nulen cracks a glowing rod across a thief's shoulder and sends him sprawling.
Nulen takes a hit from a pair of thieves and walks it off.

name: Erter
summary: Erter is a tall guardian of a far-future prison world who rose after a massacre of guards and their families. He trains his body and mind for lifetimes of discipline and calls himself an ideal.

feats.scene: Erter disarms three rioters in a single sweeping movement.
Erter takes a prison-yard beating and keeps on his feet.

name: Ntoanime
summary: Ntoanime is a dissident bomber in a vast red empire, hardened by the loss of his parents. He wages a long campaign of terror against a godlike ruler, becoming a legend among the oppressed.

feats.scene: Ntoanime blows up a barracks depot with a stack of homemade charges.
Ntoanime tumbles through a window and outruns the patrol.

name: Setantal
summary: Setantal is a young vigilante in a neon future city, daughter of the previous cowled hero. She wears a gadget-packed suit and moves with acrobatic grace and trained fists.

feats.scene: Setantal vaults a rail and drives both boots into a gang enforcer.
Setantal absorbs a baton blow on her armoured shoulder.

name: Rnole
summary: Rnole is a small barnyard hero in a cape and mask who narrates his own deeds. Equipped with gloves and a boast of sharp claws, he goes out for snacks and ends up foiling a poisoning plot.

feats.scene: Rnole scrambles up a fence and swats a croaking schemer with a paw.
Rnole drops from a haystack and lands squarely on his feet.

name: Irnia
summary: Irnia is a thinking, chatty rescue jet with a sleek sensor-eyed face who joins a squad of sentient vehicles. She trades speed and tactics for gadgetry and flies rescue sorties in the dark.

feats.scene: Irnia dives through a storm cloud and drops a tow cable onto a stranded bridge.
Irnia endures a crash landing in a field and powers back up.
Irnia breaks the sound barrier above a coastal city.

name: Stotelton
summary: Stotelton is a lanky infantryman in a desert battle who hauls a wounded comrade across the sand. When a storm of bullets arrives, he accepts the risk and dies protecting his friend.

feats.scene: Stotelton hurls a grenade across a dune and silences a machine-gun nest.
Stotelton shields a wounded friend from a burst of fire at close range.

name: Anuvarve
summary: Anuvarve is a red-haired, immortal youth of a bright sky-realm who travels with a band of free spirits. His great strength and leaping power make him a tank among his companions.

feats.scene: Anuvarve punches a crag and sends a landslide down a valley.
Anuvarve stands his ground as a cliff face collapses on him.

name: Cortaiu
summary: Cortaiu is a green-skinned outlaw in a medieval farming realm with sharp canine teeth who shifts into any creature he has seen. He can become a dragon, flying and breathing flame.

feats.scene: Cortaiu rises as a dragon and torches a whole siege tower.
Cortaiu takes a catapult stone in dragon form and shakes it off.

name: Niunan
summary: Niunan is a shy, red-furred demon exiled from the underworld for having a kind heart, and is bound to a boy through a careless ritual. He is a gentle companion hiding from the world until an evil elder returns.

feats.scene: Niunan lifts a wrecked sedan over his head to free a trapped child.
Niunan weathers a thrown anvil without a flinch.

name: Osate
summary: Osate is a living stereo built by two teenagers who fused a staff with a speaker, now a loyal pet and brawler. The little machine fights with rhythm and an enthusiasm for noise.

feats.scene: Osate blasts a bass pulse that knocks a stack of crates over.
Osate is knocked off a shelf and keeps the beat going.

source_title: Beat Box (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Corti
summary: Corti is a winged criminal who steals and defaces statues and carries a deadly secret about her origin. Born as an antibody against divine beings, she devours souls and fires blasts strong enough to pierce a demigod.

feats.scene: Corti projects a lance of raw energy that opens a hole in a titan's chest.
Corti takes a point-blank blast from a rival and drags herself to her feet.

name: Teser
summary: Teser is a former model and secret operative who gains blazing powers in a plasma blast and joins an international team of heroes. She bends flame to her will and wears a famous green outfit.

feats.scene: Teser wraps an armoured truck in green flame and melts its frame.
Teser walks through a burning warehouse untouched.

name: Torllori
summary: Torllori is an executive who transforms through ancient magic into a flaming champion. Her emerald fire can heal small wounds, repair her clothes, fly her like a rocket and cast dazzling illusions.

feats.scene: Torllori sprays white-hot flame across a barricade and melts it into slag.
Torllori is thrown through a boardroom window and lands in a controlled flame-blast.

name: Orirnva
summary: Orirnva is a green-haired psychic with burning mental force who flies in an aura of emerald fire shaped like a bird. She joins a team of mutant-like heroes and a rival circle of villains.

feats.scene: Orirnva hurls a bird of green flame that smashes through a steel bulkhead.
Orirnva endures a collapsing ship corridor in her flaming aura.

name: Orainu
summary: Orainu is a knight of an ancient fellowship whose spirit is bound inside a lance after a king's son betrays the order. With no body of his own, he waits for a new hand to wield him.

feats.scene: Orainu drives the lance through a stone shield in a single thrust.
Orainu endures centuries inside the lance, unbroken by the curse.

name: Valau
summary: Valau is a purple-eyed soldier from a dark world who flies, reads thoughts and bends minds. He takes control of captives to open a portal strong enough to pull a planet toward his master's realm.

feats.scene: Valau seizes the minds of three captives and holds a portal open against a counterattack.
Valau takes a hydro-blast to the chest and stumbles away.

name: Oreorre
summary: Oreorre is a being woven entirely of old evil magic, born in a relic of the deep. He grows and shrinks at will, whips up gales that wreck a headquarters and rewrites reality to suit himself.

feats.scene: Oreorre summons a gale that wrecks the wall of a hilltop base and scatters its defenders.
Oreorre shrugs off a team's combined attack and swells to fill the room.

name: Valca
summary: Valca is a purple-skinned corps soldier wearing a ring of yellow fear-light that makes constructs, shields and flight. He helps a squad pin down a rival corps.

feats.scene: Valca fires a lance of yellow light and cracks a concrete pylon.
Valca holds up a shimmering shield against a rifle volley.

name: Loeonri
summary: Loeonri is a scheming ruler of the underworld who possesses hosts, shifts shape, bends minds and teleports. He tricks a living visitor into abandoning a friend for a soul that did not wish to leave.

feats.scene: Loeonri tears open the floor of his throne room and swallows an entire legion.
Loeonri stands untouched in a rite meant to banish him.

name: Vinisa
summary: Vinisa is a mechanic aboard a time-travelling ship who once wielded a wind relic as a vigilante in a bleak future. His timeline shifts and he becomes a member of a ragged crew of heroes.

feats.scene: Vinisa spins a cyclone from the relic and flings a patrol vehicle over a wall.
Vinisa is blasted through a hull plate and picks himself up.

name: Mitilte
summary: Mitilte is an immortal ruler of a fiery realm, a goddess of love who can stir deep affection in others, though she falls for her target in return. She also senses the bonds of those around her.

feats.scene: Mitilte raises a hand and an entire army of soldiers lays down its weapons in tears.
Mitilte stands calmly in a rain of fire from her own pits.

name: Novatir
summary: Novatir is a grieving exile from a bright sky-realm who carries a dimension-folding blade and hunts the profiteers of old wars. Novatir hides among research staff by day and fights with cold, patient fury by night.

feats.scene: Novatir slices a seam through the air and drags a squad of armoured raiders through it before the seam snaps shut.
Novatir stands unmoved as a collapsing bridge of fused metal buries her.

name: Ntureo
summary: Ntureo grew up hiding in a tyrant's shadow, and her calm presence can ease the rage of the most savage warriors around her. Ntureo tends wounds with patient hands and quietly aids an underground rebellion.

feats.scene: Ntureo shoves a heavy iron gate off its hinges to free a captive woman.
Ntureo shrugs off a collapsing tunnel wall while shielding a wounded fighter.

name: Vaseo
summary: Vaseo is a pale-haired swamp demon who turns unseen at will and commands the drowned victims offered to her. Vaseo spreads sickness quietly, and even powerful dealers in cursed bargains step aside when she appears.

feats.scene: Vaseo raises a whole flooded harbour crew from the mud and sends them to tear a pier apart.
Vaseo walks out of a burning chapel without a mark on her pale skin.

name: Aunserte
summary: Aunserte is a sharp-eyed newspaper publisher who rebuilt a struggling paper in a new headquarters. Aunserte has no powers, only a nose for news and a stubborn work ethic.

feats.scene: Aunserte slaps a stack of proofs on the desk hard enough to silence the room.
Aunserte is knocked off her feet by a delivery cart and gets straight back up for the deadline.

name: Unntniu
summary: Unntniu is a widowed inventor who built a flying harness that fires bursts of heating rays. Unntniu works day shifts as a hired hero, balancing patrols with raising three children.

feats.scene: Unntniu cooks a robber's getaway engine solid with one sustained burst from her harness.
Unntniu takes a thrown crate on her padded shoulder and keeps flying.

name: Teseani
summary: Teseani is a swaggering war goddess who delights in carnage and joins fellow battle-deities against rival warrior women. Teseani wields a blade with godly skill and cannot die of age, only of heavy violence.

feats.scene: Teseani drives her sword into a fortress hill and the whole ridge splits into rubble.
Teseani laughs through a bombardment that flattens the camp around her.

name: Numnuni
summary: Numnuni is a furred, horned demon lord once worshipped by a desert people, and he rules a fiery underworld. Numnuni hounds wandering heroes and the wizards who side with them through sorcery.

feats.scene: Numnuni exhales a wave of hellfire that melts a cliff-side temple into glass.
Numnuni stands in the heart of a collapsing volcano and merely yawns.

name: Veoco
summary: Veoco is a poised spymaster who directs a network of agents from a domed hideout, reading minds to keep them safe. Veoco shuts it all down with grace when funding dries up, and then lunches with an old friend.

feats.scene: Veoco slams a heavy steel door on a pursuer in the corridor.
Veoco takes a stumble down a stone stairway and brushes off the dust.

name: Miraau
summary: Miraau is a young sea-dweller who studies in a coral-domed academy under a queen. Miraau breathes both air and water, and uses curiosity rather than muscle to solve problems.

feats.scene: Miraau drives a school of fish and a heavy kelp net into a smuggler's hull at speed.
Miraau rides out a pressure surge from a deep trench without losing his breath.

name: Reocelli
summary: Reocelli is a red-eyed, hairless noblewoman of a star-devouring bloodline who commands a fleet of raiders. Reocelli was married off young to settle debts, and she has plotted against her father ever since.

feats.scene: Reocelli drains the light from a small moon, and its crust cracks apart.
Reocelli swims through the corona of a dying sun and steps out smiling.

name: Estniore
summary: Estniore is a pale, red-eyed street criminal who bends wood to his will and wraps it in razor-edged sheets of paper. Estniore dreams of a big reputation but keeps ending up bruised in a cell.

feats.scene: Estniore whips up a storm of paper blades that shreds a row of parked cars.
Estniore takes a beating from a speedster and stays on his feet for one more taunt.

name: Mitico
summary: Mitico is a teenager from a rough neighbourhood who gained a goofy older father figure through his mother's romance. Mitico speaks two languages, avoids dairy, and swings a bike chain when scared.

feats.scene: Mitico swings a bike chain at a startled stranger and misses by an inch.
Mitico tumbles off a fence and gets up complaining about his knee.

name: Nonas
summary: Nonas is a white-haired professional killer who works the back alleys and docks for pay. Nonas ends up on the wrong side of a family grudge.

feats.scene: Nonas fires a heavy pistol through a car door and drops the driver.
Nonas absorbs a brutal beating in a warehouse and keeps his composure.

name: Llaern
summary: Llaern is a mercenary and psychic consultant whose mind can lift and crush objects. Llaern learned as a child that his gift, joined with his sister's, can mend or destroy.

feats.scene: Llaern wrenches a parked van off the road with his mind and flattens it against a wall.
Llaern endures a rooftop fall cushioned only by his own mental grip on the air.

name: Sassorstu
summary: Sassorstu is a tall, sturdy rebel in a ruined world whose artificial heart works like a tiny reactor to shield his body from radiation. Sassorstu helps free a captive child from a cruel feline regime.

feats.scene: Sassorstu overloads his chest reactor to blast a locked gate off a prison wall.
Sassorstu wades through a radioactive crater that kills the guards chasing him.

name: Tonti
summary: Tonti is a quiet university student with a dabbling interest in the occult who runs with a mystic crew in a big port city. Tonti has little power of his own, but he meddles with forces he does not understand.

feats.scene: Tonti scratches out a ritual circle and a sudden gust throws a stool across the room.
Tonti survives a violent fall down a stairwell with a cracked rib.

name: Serran
summary: Serran is a reluctant hired killer who apologises as he works and mourns a lost family. Serran uses a fearsome pulsing weapon to settle contracts as painlessly as he can.

feats.scene: Serran detonates a pulse that collapses a gatehouse roof onto a rival crew.
Serran takes a hard kick to the ribs, coughs once, and keeps talking.

name: Vacorter
summary: Vacorter is a ruthless ex-soldier whose body leaks harsh radiation, which he channels from his palms through a protective suit. Vacorter fires blasts that burst like small bombs.

feats.scene: Vacorter lets loose a radiant blast that collapses a warehouse into slag.
Vacorter takes a point-blank cannon shell on his suit and sneers.

name: Cesri
summary: Cesri is a cold, reclusive scientist who secretly altered unborn children with experimental drugs and then raised some of them in isolation. Cesri hides behind several false names.

feats.scene: Cesri shoves a gurney across a lab to block a doorway.
Cesri survives a hard fall to the desert floor after being cast loose by his own creations.

name: Tostin
summary: Tostin is a resurrected sentinel with a mixture in his blood that knits flesh back together and keeps him nearly deathless. Tostin guards a hidden mask beneath a hotel and fights with a blade, though cold slows his healing.

feats.scene: Tostin cuts through a steel grate and an intruder's rifle in a single stroke.
Tostin is crushed under a falling chandelier and rises with his bones already mending.

name: Ranrasau
summary: Ranrasau is a smooth casino owner who has traded other people's souls to a demon of greed to stretch out his own life. Ranrasau throws lavish parties and summons the corpses of past victims when cornered.

feats.scene: Ranrasau calls up a mob of dead gamblers who smash a stage set to splinters.
Ranrasau shrugs off a heavy blow from a bouncer's stool and adjusts his cuffs.

name: Ntralra
summary: Ntralra is a former code-breaker whose mind moves objects, kept in check by a helmet that tames the pain. Ntralra glides on a wingsuit and turns against the cult of killers who once trained him.

feats.scene: Ntralra hurls a shipping container across a yard with his mind.
Ntralra survives a savage beating and a long night in the cold wilderness.

name: Linlisam
summary: Linlisam is a hospital psychiatrist whose mind snapped under possession by a lord of disorder, handing him a warped helm and a bag of strange abilities. Linlisam can slip through walls, grow huge, and hurl fear and force.

feats.scene: Linlisam swells to the size of a tower and brings a clinic wing down with one swing.
Linlisam walks out of a collapsing ward with the helm gleaming and no wound.

name: Nerau
summary: Nerau is a retired master assassin who swore off violence and now teaches self-defence in public parks. Nerau reluctantly returns to crime for money after being shut out of renting a proper studio.

feats.scene: Nerau snaps a wooden training post with one precise strike.
Nerau takes a pair of heavy blows and answers with a disarming throw.

name: Teltorsta
summary: Teltorsta is a fanged, yellow-eyed brawler who attacks a young crimefighter in a seaside city. Teltorsta is beaten without ever understanding who beat him.

feats.scene: Teltorsta bites through a leather strap and slams a thug into a wall.
Teltorsta takes a brutal kick to the jaw and charges anyway.

name: Leocolnum
summary: Leocolnum is a disciplined karate instructor and secret vigilante who hunts a fanatic cult with knife-studded knuckles. Leocolnum became a bogeyman whispered about among his enemies.

feats.scene: Leocolnum drives his blade-knuckles through a wooden barricade and into the man behind it.
Leocolnum fights on through a rain of blows in a cult cellar.

name: Ntern
summary: Ntern is a mid-ranking black-market arms dealer who is always trying to climb the underworld ladder. Ntern runs from trouble the moment a deal goes wrong.

feats.scene: Ntern slams a case of crates shut and hurries toward the exit.
Ntern shrugs off a bruising tackle and keeps running.

name: Natoncor
summary: Natoncor is a patient burglar who spends months tunnelling into a hero base to steal its computers. Natoncor threatens to blow the whole building when cornered, but is caught off guard.

feats.scene: Natoncor rigs a charge in his tunnel that could bring down a wing of the headquarters.
Natoncor is hauled out of the dirt by guards and barely scratched.

name: Tunurn
summary: Tunurn is a warm, flamboyant cabaret owner who becomes a fairy godparent to a lost teenager. Tunurn defends a beloved venue from a wave of developers with a baseball bat and sharp wit.

feats.scene: Tunurn cracks his bat across a bully's shin and the whole room goes quiet.
Tunurn is shoved into a stack of chairs and stands up sparkling.

name: Lisirti
summary: Lisirti is a former gang bodyguard who becomes a masked night vigilante in a crowded harbour city to find his best friend's killer. Lisirti walks the line between justice and revenge.

feats.scene: Lisirti drops three henchmen with a spinning kick on a neon-lit rooftop.
Lisirti drops from a fire escape and rolls to his feet.

name: Nioll
summary: Nioll is a sixth-century warrior sent by a mysterious shaper through the underworld, a bog, and a sunken city to reach a fruit that can slay a monster. Nioll meets a gallery of legends on the way.

feats.scene: Nioll cleaves a labyrinth beast in half with a single mighty swing.
Nioll climbs out of a fiery pit with his armour smoking.

name: Nanential
summary: Nanential is an engineered super-soldier who slept for centuries in a hidden fortress before being woken to hunt a man-eating monster. Nanential is silent, swift, and enhanced in strength, sight, and smell.

feats.scene: Nanential tears through a hall of armed men and leaves a single survivor.
Nanential takes a ballista bolt in the shoulder and keeps fighting.

name: Nttare
summary: Nttare is a small, brown-furred space-born monkey with hero ambitions who lives in a big city. Nttare has the body of an alien species and wears a little cape.

feats.scene: Nttare flings a bus-sized boulder into orbit by accident while playing.
Nttare shakes off a falling skyscraper billboard as if it were confetti.

name: Ilnanti
summary: Ilnanti is a brilliant monkey chemist who cures his friends of a virus, only to watch the cure fade. Ilnanti mourns a ruined world and fears his feral companions.

feats.scene: Ilnanti heaves a lab stool at a charging teammate and runs.
Ilnanti tumbles through a shelf of glassware and scrambles upright.

name: Neosst
summary: Neosst is a dark-haired deity from a bleak fire-pit world who keeps company with a stern warlord. Neosst has the vast durability and strength of her divine kind.

feats.scene: Neosst hammers the ground and levels a whole block of slums.
Neosst walks through a barrage of rockets in the burning streets.

name: Onttera
summary: Onttera is a trainee from a family of wind-callers who dreams of joining a famous team of young heroes. Onttera whips up gusts and gales and studies at an academy on a rocky coast.

feats.scene: Onttera spins a storm of wind that rips the roof from a barn.
Onttera is knocked flat in a training bout and bounces back up laughing.

name: Tumiasmia
summary: Tumiasmia is a bloodthirsty demon who has possessed many bodies over the centuries to carry out grisly murders, then hangs their portraits in a ruined chapel. Tumiasmia lures a mighty warrior into her trap to steal her body.

feats.scene: Tumiasmia screams and a whole chapel wall bursts outward in a rain of stone.
Tumiasmia stands unharmed amid a fiery collapse of her hideout.

name: Stistone
summary: Stistone is a gentle father and husband from a ringed-planet moon whose mind-reading gift runs in the family. Stistone raised daughters who would grow to be great heroes.

feats.scene: Stistone nudges an apple cart upright after a storm.
Stistone slips on an icy road and gets up laughing.

name: Resnania
summary: Resnania is a patient alien scientist who spent years tinkering on a captive monster to make it unkillable. Resnania is killed when his creation breaks free and keeps his skull as a trophy.

feats.scene: Resnania slams a lever and a restraint clamp locks shut on a thrashing beast.
Resnania is thrown across a lab bench and clings to a rail.

name: Lertes
summary: Lertes is a former crimefighter whose body was overwritten by a hostile machine mind and rebuilt as a gleaming chrome copy of herself. Lertes now stalks her old allies through their own cave hideout.

feats.scene: Lertes smashes a steel workbench in half with a servo-driven fist.
Lertes takes a rocket-propelled grenade to the chest plate and keeps advancing.

name: Resnte
summary: Resnte is a black-haired frontier rider who policed the countryside from horseback long ago. Resnte was later honoured with a painting in a hall of old heroes.

feats.scene: Resnte leaps from the saddle and tackles a fleeing bandit into the dust.
Resnte is thrown from her galloping mount and rolls up unhurt.

name: Seoraveo
summary: Seoraveo is a soldier from a distant future who jumps backward through time to hunt a famous runner, then switches sides. Seoraveo built a device that lets others skip along the timeline and she vanishes automatically when exhausted.

feats.scene: Seoraveo hurls herself into a blinking sprint and shoves two trucks off a blast radius.
Seoraveo is pounded by an angry speedster until her body flickers away to safety.

name: Lannolse
summary: Lannolse is a young black-haired adventurer from a rainy northern port city who joined a team of explorers. Lannolse has no known gifts beyond nerve and loyalty.

feats.scene: Lannolse hauls on a rope to drag a teammate from a pit.
Lannolse tumbles down a cave slope and comes up scraped and grinning.

name: Eolllte
summary: Eolllte is a patient wife whose preacher husband crosses a local drug lord, putting both their lives at risk. Eolllte lives in constant fear, relying on a hired stand-in to take the heat.

feats.scene: Eolllte slams the car door and drives her son away from the danger.
Eolllte is knocked down by a panicked crowd and stands back up shaking.

name: Cosiia
summary: Cosiia is a red-haired television journalist who slants her broadcasts to flatter a sinister cult and smear young heroes. Cosiia later hosts a show carrying her own name.

feats.scene: Cosiia throws her microphone across the studio in a rage.
Cosiia is jostled in a street riot and keeps talking to camera.

name: Llulecor
summary: Llulecor is a hard-bitten defence lawyer of the early twentieth century who bends the rules in court and carries a hidden pistol. Llulecor can shoot a gun out of a hand from across a room.

feats.scene: Llulecor fires once across a crowded courtroom and the killer's weapon spins away.
Llulecor takes a shove through a glass partition and walks out unfazed.

name: Titirno
summary: Titirno is a small-town girl who witnesses a gangland killing, testifies, and is given a new name and hypnotic suggestions to bury the trauma. Titirno later falls in love with a neighbour who resembles her old boss.

feats.scene: Titirno slaps a would-be attacker hard across the face.
Titirno is knocked flat in a stairwell struggle and rises shaking.

name: Aninorre
summary: Aninorre is a dark mirror of a futuristic bat-masked hero, recruited by a sinister laughing overlord to join a conquering band of twisted heroes. Aninorre is dissolved the moment his master no longer needs him.

feats.scene: Aninorre blasts a guard tower to rubble with a shoulder cannon.
Aninorre drops through a collapsing fortress floor and lands upright in the smoke.

name: Iarvase
summary: Iarvase is a brown-eyed warrior reborn at a sacred spring who glimpses events before they happen and serves as an oracle. Iarvase discovered her gift in a trial of spinning spheres, impressing the scribes.

feats.scene: Iarvase hurls a training spear through a bronze shield before the target even moves.
Iarvase steps out of a rockfall seconds before it lands.

name: Semirn
summary: Semirn is a black-haired girl grown in a laboratory as a replica of her adoptive parent's mother, with false memories fed to her by a drug. Semirn works as a gifted young scientist at a vast company.

feats.scene: Semirn sweeps a tray of instruments off a bench in frustration.
Semirn slips on a wet lab floor and bounces up.

name: Ialtiu
summary: Ialtiu is a bald, cheerful spice trader and innkeeper in a medieval town of stone towers. Ialtiu serves every traveller a hot meal and a rumour.

feats.scene: Ialtiu hefts a barrel of cloves onto the counter without a grunt.
Ialtiu is shoved over a bench in a tavern scuffle and laughs it off.

name: Rornueo
summary: Rornueo is a big, clumsy young man who took up skin diving to improve himself and ended up a master swimmer. Rornueo hunts sunken treasure with a trio of friends beneath the waves.

feats.scene: Rornueo wrestles a stuck anchor free from a wreck and hauls it up.
Rornueo endures a deep descent and a brawl with a reef monster.

name: Lanrent
summary: Lanrent is a red-haired former big-top clown who traded the circus for life as a masked crimefighter's sidekick. Lanrent boxes well and drives a mean getaway.

feats.scene: Lanrent lands a jab that sends a thug through a barrel stack.
Lanrent skids a car into a lamp post and steps out with a grin.

name: Mirni
summary: Mirni is a flashy young hero with a gadget harness that fires bursts, scans surroundings, and projects holograms for meetings. Mirni joined a team mostly to chase fame and the heart of a teammate.

feats.scene: Mirni fires a harness blast that shreds a parked van into scrap.
Mirni is thrown from a speeding wagon and bounces to his feet.

name: Saesium
summary: Saesium is a black-furred, red-eyed storybook predator who disguises himself as a kindly elder and hunts for a cruel queen. Saesium slashes with claws and bites with fangs.

feats.scene: Saesium rakes his claws through a barn door and the planks fly apart.
Saesium takes a crossbow bolt in the flank and keeps running.

source_title: Big Bad Wolf (Harley Quinn TV Series)

name: Oleri
summary: Oleri is a blue-eyed divine warrior from a bright sky-city who loves his wife and settles quarrels with a song. Oleri bears the endurance and strength of his people.

feats.scene: Oleri strikes a boulder-strewn hillside and the whole slope collapses.
Oleri walks out of a landslide humming a tune.

name: Rerluau
summary: Rerluau is a black-haired, one-eyed sky pirate from a fiery planet who sails with a crew of fierce women. Rerluau takes what she wants and fears nobody.

feats.scene: Rerluau rips the door off a freighter hold with her bare hands.
Rerluau stays upright after a cannon salvo shreds the deck around her.

name: Siramo
summary: Siramo is a towering warrior woman from a divine bloodline who left a fiery homeland for a bright sky-city. Siramo is agile, durable, and hits hard, and she carries a staff that fires energy beams.

feats.scene: Siramo fires her staff and a beam levels a row of warehouses.
Siramo laughs through a collapsing skyscraper floor.

name: Sticis
summary: Sticis is a brown-haired masked poacher who follows in his dead father's footsteps hunting people for sport. Sticis hides his face and his name.

feats.scene: Sticis fires a heavy hunting rifle through a thick door.
Sticis falls from a jungle gantry and limps away.

name: Lentorser
summary: Lentorser is a swaggering frontier outlaw who runs a gang from a dusty settlement. Lentorser mocks strangers by their looks and pays for it.

feats.scene: Lentorser fires his revolver and splinters a saloon post.
Lentorser takes a bar-stool to the back and keeps swinging.

name: Iueonar
summary: Iueonar is a storybook predator who walks as a man but is truly a great wolf, kept alive for centuries by a witch's bargain. Iueonar changes shape at will and grows in size, fangs, and claws when he does.

feats.scene: Iueonar swells into a huge wolf and tears a car roof off in one bite.
Iueonar walks out of a burning tenement with his coat singed.

name: Urntilau
summary: Urntilau is a nimble street runner from a big river city who vaults roofs and railings to protect his neighbourhood. Urntilau joined a network of masked allies abroad.

feats.scene: Urntilau launches off a wall and drops a mugger with a flying kick.
Urntilau lands a long roof leap badly and rolls out of it.

name: Letarer
summary: Letarer is a descendant living a thousand years ahead who speaks a clipped version of an ancient word to become a champion, though it keeps him timid and earthbound. Letarer flies and fights bravely once he speaks the whole word.

feats.scene: Letarer shouts the full word and a bolt of lightning turns him into a giant who hurls a tank across a street.
Letarer endures a collapsing tower of glass and steel without a bruise.

name: Retau
summary: Retau is a slick young executive who inherits a crime syndicate from his jailed father and tries to run it with a salesman's smile. Retau threatens anyone who refuses to work for him.

feats.scene: Retau slams his fist on a boardroom table to make a point.
Retau is tossed against a wall by a bodyguard and brushes off his suit.

name: Anenum
summary: Anenum is an aging grey-haired tycoon who hides a crime syndicate behind a chain of discount stores and charity galas. Anenum gets a heart transplant and a second chance, only to be betrayed by family.

feats.scene: Anenum bangs his cane on the desk and a clerk flinches.
Anenum survives surgery on a failing heart and returns to work.

name: Vassaule
summary: Vassaule is a grey-haired, blue-eyed city detective who is competent with investigation and firearms but corrupt in the end. Vassaule meets a quick, grim fate during a balloon scheme.

feats.scene: Vassaule fires his service pistol and a lamp shatters.
Vassaule is shoved against a squad car and shakes it off.

name: Amnal
summary: Amnal is a grey-haired drag singer who was locked in an asylum by family, survived a brutal operation, and escaped to perform in underground bars. Amnal carved a lantern out of a strange glowing green ore for a friend.

feats.scene: Amnal chisels a lantern from a lump of green ore with a hammer and patience.
Amnal endures years of cruel treatment and walks out singing.

name: Amolon
summary: Amolon is a portly, red-haired boy from a big borough who shares a name with a radio star, and who becomes a mighty giant when he shouts an old word with his friends. Amolon helps defeat a scheming scientist.

feats.scene: Amolon shouts the word, becomes a hulking hero, and snaps a buzzsaw rig in half.
Amolon is struck by a lightning bolt and stands taller for it.

name: Llelenamo
summary: Llelenamo is a blond young man named for a famous hero who serves with two fellow lieutenants against a society of monsters. Llelenamo transforms into a flying, speedy, invulnerable adult by speaking an old word.

feats.scene: Llelenamo flies into a monster fortress and shatters its gates.
Llelenamo is buried under a collapsing dome and emerges laughing.
Llelenamo streaks above the rooftops faster than any jet.

name: Alllevor
summary: Alllevor is an orphan from a coastal city whose guardian murdered his parents, and who is chosen by a sage to become a hero empowered by six legends. Alllevor works as a television reporter by day.

feats.scene: Alllevor says the sage's name and throws a lightning-wreathed punch through a bank vault.
Alllevor stands his ground in a battle with a cosmic warlord.

name: Minuam
summary: Minuam is an orphaned schoolboy who loves old comics about a hero with his own name and dreams he could be one. Minuam tries the magic word in front of a villain and nothing happens.

feats.scene: Minuam throws a schoolbag at a looming tyrant in a brave moment.
Minuam is grabbed and shaken like a rag doll and still shouts.

name: Cailri
summary: Cailri is a black-haired young man who takes up a fallen hero's costume to calm a nervous world, hiding behind a helmet. Cailri calls lightning to transform when forced to reveal himself.

feats.scene: Cailri calls down the bolt and a blast of lightning knocks a rampaging brute cold.
Cailri tears through his own costume and keeps flying unharmed.

name: Renol
summary: Renol is a teen gamer pulled into duty by an old sage to fight a banished rival, calling on divine power when he shouts the sage's name. Renol is nearly at a new level in his video game when summoned.

feats.scene: Renol shouts the name, becomes a champion, and blasts a horde of ancient spirits across a canyon.
Renol takes a sorcerer's blast and shakes his head, annoyed.

name: Siace
summary: Siace is a television news reporter in the days of cartoon adventure who calls on the strength of legends when he shouts an elder's name. Siace is stuck as a mortal whenever his lightning is blocked or his voice silenced.

feats.scene: Siace turns into a hero and hurls a rampaging machine over a zoo wall.
Siace shrugs off a barrage from a villain's mirror weapon.

name: Llolli
summary: Llolli is a legendary caped hero known to children in a tiny cartoon city, whose poster hangs on an orphan's wall. Llolli carries the divine gift of mythic champions.

feats.scene: Llolli lifts a toy-sized bus above his head and sets it gently on a rooftop.
Llolli takes a falling building block on his shoulder without a flinch.

name: Iumauni
summary: Iumauni is a hero who guards a mountain military refuge for a scheming president, using speed and great strength. Iumauni is eventually beaten by a stronger opponent.

feats.scene: Iumauni slams a hover-tank into the cliff face and cracks the ridge.
Iumauni is struck by a volley of missiles and stays on his feet.

name: Ntema
summary: Ntema is a troubled young man in a crowded city who starts hearing a voice urging him to speak a certain name. Ntema resists until the voice threatens someone he loves.

feats.scene: Ntema pushes a stranger away from the platform edge in a panic.
Ntema collapses on the subway steps and drags himself upright.

source_title: Billy Batson (The Possession of Billy Batson)

name: Sancelri
summary: Sancelri is a cartoonish schoolboy who shouts a wizard's name to gain super-strength, healing, memory, and flight, and who guides tiny friends to a magic home. Sancelri gives them a boulder as a replacement for their lost treehouse.

feats.scene: Sancelri hoists a giant boulder and sets it down in the clubhouse yard.
Sancelri bounces off a toy car crash without a scratch.

name: Telli
summary: Telli is a washed-up pop singer who gets a second, grim life as a hulking reanimated brute, sent after his own brother. Telli had been chewed up and tossed aside by greedy executives.

feats.scene: Telli smashes a delivery truck into a wall with a stiff, hulking swing.
Telli takes a hunting spear through the chest and lurches on.

name: Vaser
summary: Vaser is a cartoon teen villain who splits his body into many copies of himself through cell division. Vaser is also a decent athlete and leaps into trouble with a crew of fellow miscreants.

feats.scene: Vaser splits into ten copies who all kick a gate at once.
Vaser is flattened by a mallet and peels himself off the floor.

source_title: Billy Numerous (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Oreul
summary: Oreul is a brown-haired space bounty hunter who survives in vacuum, plays the drums, and throws a sharpened steel comb with deadly aim. Oreul wins bets, partners with brawlers, and fears few targets.

feats.scene: Oreul flings her steel comb and pins a smuggler's sleeve to a wall.
Oreul floats unharmed in hard vacuum for minutes after a hull breach.

name: Tirviamo
summary: Tirviamo is a bald machine-cyborg assembled by linked computers to study planetary decline, which decides humanity itself is the disease. Tirviamo builds a hidden base under the ice and flies with an army of droids of its own design.

feats.scene: Tirviamo bombards a ridge of glacier and brings an ice cliff down on a convoy.
Tirviamo's metal hull withstands a jet's missile strike in the polar sky.

name: Lecorti
summary: Lecorti is a scholarly outcast of a crime family who masks a murderous jealousy behind a courteous manner. Passed over by his father, he kills on dates marked for celebration.

feats.scene: Lecorti fires a pistol round point blank into a rival's chest in a candlelit study.
Lecorti is hurled down a stairwell by a pursuer and crawls out of the hall alive.

name: Nauanrer
summary: Nauanrer is a quiet garage mechanic who loves his family and wants only a safe, ordinary home for his children. He keeps his cool when strange events circle his son.

feats.scene: Nauanrer cranks a stuck bolt loose with a wrench and a grunt.
Nauanrer slips from under a lifted car and bangs his head on a jack.

name: Vatele
summary: Vatele is a hardworking veteran and small-town mechanic who worries about his teenage son's strange new powers. He worked double shifts to keep the family afloat and accepts that parenting means facing whatever comes.

feats.scene: Vatele hauls an engine block onto a workbench with a heave.
Vatele is knocked flat by a backfiring tow truck and dusts himself off.

name: Sentite
summary: Sentite is a struggling painter turned forger who vows revenge after a hero exposes his counterfeits. He shoots trick arrows of every hue but one, in memory of a rival.

feats.scene: Sentite fires a tinted arrow that bursts a smoke canister over a cash truck.
Sentite is wrestled to the ground by two officers and wriggles free.

name: Tausti
summary: Tausti is the estranged son of a scientist-hero, raised by a fanatical soldier mother to rebuild her fallen regime. He leads, plans, and quarrels with his own father.

feats.scene: Tausti commands a volley from his followers that shatters a barricade of crates.
Tausti is flung across a briefing room by his father and waves off the bruises.

name: Saoro
summary: Saoro is a bone-sucking horror freed from a prison dimension who gorges on a ship's crew. Its enormous strength nearly kills a hero before a shapeshifting elder ends it.

feats.scene: Saoro rips a steel hatch off its hinges and flings it across the pier.
Saoro takes a crane's swinging hook to the head and snarls through the dent.

name: Saulu
summary: Saulu is a bullied orphan who steals a rare comic and is transformed into the costumed idol he worshipped. The wish turns on him as the curse tightens.

feats.scene: Saulu lifts a parked sedan to scare off a bully.
Saulu takes a heavy blow from a pickup and sits up dazed but intact.

name: Cisiu
summary: Cisiu is a swamp-born orphan chosen by a living memory of color to bring back a vanished green world. He restores color for a moment to whatever he touches and travels toward a ruined capital.

feats.scene: Cisiu thrusts his hand into a frost-locked wall and a tide of roots bursts through it.
Cisiu shrugs off a spear thrust that should have pierced a lung.

name: Vorartal
summary: Vorartal is a red-eyed plant guardian who bends toxins and vines to his will. He cannot be truly killed so long as roots still grip the earth.

feats.scene: Vorartal calls up a forest of thorned trunks that wrecks an entire city block.
Vorartal re-knits his torso after a crushing blast from an invading war engine.

name: Irnvas
summary: Irnvas guards the planet's greenery with one vow, to stand apart from human wars. He can swell or shrink at will, heal any hurt, and cannot die while a single leaf lives.

feats.scene: Irnvas thrusts a sprouting root through a fortress and tears it down.
Irnvas weathers a point-blank orbital strike and regrows by the next sunrise.

name: Ticeotan
summary: Ticeotan is a scientist-turned-swamp protector whose flaming accident merged him with the marsh. He wrestles dark experimenters and watches over bayou friends.

feats.scene: Ticeotan crushes a mutant brute's armor with a two-handed slam.
Ticeotan shrugs off a cluster of blasts that would flatten a house.

name: Sorse
summary: Sorse is a green plant-monster who saves a government agent from hired killers while his formula is hunted by a villain. He once fell into flames in his own lab.

feats.scene: Sorse hurls a gunman clear across a boathouse.
Sorse is hit by a shotgun volley and keeps walking.

name: Stuau
summary: Stuau is a lonely inventor who sews tiny teleport devices into his gloves and commits burglaries dressed in white. He vanishes through walls and always takes more than he needs.

feats.scene: Stuau drives a crowbar into a safe and cracks it before the alarm sounds.
Stuau is knocked down a flight of stairs mid-teleport and reappears across the room.

name: Minauni
summary: Minauni is a veteran interrogator and spy who masks his face and moves through shadowy cabals. He prizes secrets above loyalty and sneaks into guarded sites.

feats.scene: Minauni plants a silenced round in a compromised informant at a dockside meeting.
Minauni takes a rifle butt to the ribs and slips away through a service door.

name: Reoosni
summary: Reoosni is a clawed, winged avenger of an ancient order of punishers, one of three sisters who hunt the guilty. She takes to the air and rakes her prey.

feats.scene: Reoosni dives from a cloud and tears the roof from a stone shrine.
Reoosni shrugs off a chariot ramming at full gallop.
Reoosni streaks across the moonlit sky on her beating wings.

name: Leomi
summary: Leomi is a half-alien teenager, hailed as the hope of a barren world. Her bloodline even supplied the cells that rebuilt her father's eyes.

feats.scene: Leomi shoves a heavy lab cart through a doorway to clear a path.
Leomi tumbles off a garden wall and picks herself up laughing.

name: Leoteeo
summary: Leoteeo is a tall, winged horror created when a prayer to a fiery demon answered a murderer's scream. Centuries later he kidnaps children and turns them into beastly copies of himself.

feats.scene: Leoteeo swoops down and rips a lamppost out of the pavement.
Leoteeo bursts out of a burning chapel and flies on, singed.

name: Llria
summary: Llria is a towering warrior who envies a rival's destiny and gradually turns bitter. She loves, resents, and finally quarrels with the princess she once sparred with.

feats.scene: Llria cleaves a practice dummy in half with a blow of a heavy blade.
Llria is battered by her sparring partner's fists and refuses to yield.

name: Iumeoltin
summary: Iumeoltin is a cold gang lord who rules a sprawling city and executes failed assassins. His anger at one bumbling vigilante grows with every arrested lieutenant.

feats.scene: Iumeoltin orders the shooting of a hired gun who botched a job.
Iumeoltin takes a thrown vase to the head without losing his composure.

name: Llole
summary: Llole is a smooth political strategist hired to polish a campaign. Hidden mind control turns him into a pawn who traps the person he loves.

feats.scene: Llole slams a door shut on a locked chamber and drives the bolt home.
Llole drops to the floor under a tranquilizer dose and wakes hours later.

name: Serlo
