summary: Renran is a far-future descendant of a famous vigilante who wears a bat cowl after finding an old recording. Renran trains a young partner and uses fists and leadership to overthrow a conquering robot army.

feats.scene: Renran flips a robot trooper over his shoulder and shatters its chest plate.
Renran drops from a gantry onto a metal floor and rolls up ready to fight.

name: Sevalau
summary: Sevalau is a black-haired young woman who conjures heavy firearms from thin air and swaps them in a heartbeat. Sevalau turns a rocket tube into a rotary gun on the fly and unloads on whoever annoys her.

feats.scene: Sevalau conjures a rocket tube and blows a parked bus into scrap.
Sevalau is thrown against a brick wall and gets up swearing.

name: Cesreoau
summary: Cesreoau is a masked saboteur who hides a ruthless streak behind a comic sausage gimmick. Cesreoau serves a small secret cell and is better known for ridiculous stunts than for cold efficiency.

feats.scene: Cesreoau hurls a greasy sack of cured meat at a guard to cover an escape.
Cesreoau tumbles off a delivery truck and scrambles up without a scratch.

name: Nttalli
summary: Nttalli is a red-haired husband turned into a mute brute by a ruthless tycoon who wanted a monster of his own. Nttalli pounds a flying hero to a standstill until restraint ends, then is shut off remotely just as speech returns.

feats.scene: Nttalli drives both fists through a delivery van and a storefront wall in one rush.
Nttalli keeps swinging after a ferocious series of blows to the jaw.

name: Ianussti
summary: Ianussti is a black-haired abductee turned test subject who learned she could dissolve her body into particles. Ianussti flees her captors, frees fellow prisoners, and returns with an ally to topple her tormentor.

feats.scene: Ianussti reforms inside a guard's holster and snaps the weapon apart in her fist.
Ianussti breaks apart as bullets pass through, then reassembles on the far side.

name: Monnanmi
summary: Monnanmi is a red-haired, blue-skinned contract killer who commands the wind so completely that she can draw the air out of a victim's chest. Monnanmi leads a crew of killers and prefers deaths that look natural.

feats.scene: Monnanmi strips the air from a banker's lungs across a crowded ballroom.
Monnanmi falls from a balcony onto marble and walks away.

name: Torntlli
summary: Torntlli is a nervous young cold-wielder who auditions to join a squad of future heroes. Torntlli chills the air around himself with ease, wears a ring that lets him fly, and wilts in any heat.

feats.scene: Torntlli sheets a pond in solid ice with one sweep of his hands.
Torntlli's blue jacket shrugs off a minor burn from a flamethrower, though he gasps for breath.

source_title: Brek Bannin (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Iuesrer
summary: Iuesrer is a fair-haired, blue-eyed cold-bearer from a frozen world, passed over by bigger teams and welcomed by a team of substitutes. Iuesrer hurls waves of frost and tolerates scorching air.

feats.scene: Iuesrer coats a rampaging machine in ice and stops it dead.
Iuesrer wanders through a smouldering corridor and emerges unharmed.

name: Tauel
summary: Tauel is a blonde heiress bored with party life who dons a mask to steal from thieves and hand it to the poor. Tauel recruits an all-female patrol, outwits scammers and frustrates a grumpy officer.

feats.scene: Tauel lands a quick jab on a con artist and ties him up with his own scarf.
Tauel leaps from a moving coach and tumbles clear.

name: Stuse
summary: Stuse is a red-haired student from a border town who survived a cruel home and leans on close friends. Stuse practises a soft grappling art, speaks several tongues, and backs a masked buddy whenever she can.

feats.scene: Stuse flips a much larger bully onto a gym mat.
Stuse endures a hard blow and still smiles for her friends.

name: Risauco
summary: Risauco is a pink-haired hacker who worked alongside a girlfriend to break an inmate free and ended up in a recovery group for former villains. Risauco does his damage with keyboards, not fists.

feats.scene: Risauco bursts a server cabinet's lock with a hasty kick.
Risauco takes a punch from a prison guard and drops to his knees.

name: Valsoror
summary: Valsoror is a red-haired inmate with a lullaby voice that sends listeners drifting into a trance. Valsoror sings softly to soften up victims and is a poor fighter once the humming stops.

feats.scene: Valsoror hums a slow tune until a guard drops his keys and blinks.
Valsoror is tackled by two orderlies and keeps singing.

name: Aulacor
summary: Aulacor is a wealthy heir raised in a hidden prehistoric valley by a feathered beast after a crash orphaned him. Aulacor guards his wild home against raiders and vows to hunt anyone who poisons it.

feats.scene: Aulacor tackles a charging beast and wrestles it to the ground.
Aulacor takes a hit from a raider's heavy gun and fights on.

name: Vices
summary: Vices is a sightless demon-born leader of exiled craftsmen, half angel and half rebel. Vices traded his eyes and strength for the gift of seeing hidden rot, and he steers his people with grim foresight.

feats.scene: Vices strikes a stone pillar with a ritual staff and collapses a gatehouse.
Vices stands untouched as a hail of fire sweeps across the courtyard.

name: Toriumse
summary: Toriumse is a scarred, white-haired veteran killer and gun expert with astonishing coordination. Toriumse accepts a deadly team assignment to cut his sentence while a bomb sits in his skull.

feats.scene: Toriumse empties a rifle with pinpoint hits on a line of distant targets.
Toriumse endures a severe beating without a sound.

name: Serra
summary: Serra is a brown-haired senior lawman who runs a harbour-city police force and answers to a crowded city hall. Serra sits behind a desk more than he fights, relying on rank and paperwork.

feats.scene: Serra slaps a stack of files onto a desk and silences the room.
Serra stays standing after being jostled in a press scrum.

name: Vauter
summary: Vauter is a red-haired storybook princess cursed by a spiteful fairy so that a finger-prick sends her and everyone nearby into deep slumber. Vauter now trades stocks and is used as a living sleeping gas.

feats.scene: Vauter pricks her thumb and puts an entire banquet hall to sleep.
Vauter wakes from a century of rest with only a mild stiffness.

name: Micorrus
summary: Micorrus is a blue-skinned giant of the hundred-handed kind who guards a sky-throne and fights as champion for the king of the gods. Micorrus changes shape, never dies of age, and is turned to stone by a severed head.

feats.scene: Micorrus slams a hundred fists into a hillside at once and flattens it.
Micorrus withstands a thunderstorm of bolts before a gaze turns him to stone.

name: Siium
summary: Siium is a red-haired foster boy sent into a school of young heroes to wreck it from within, wearing a thief's mask. Siium turns every classmate toward revolt and finally blows the whole campus apart with an electrical surge.

feats.scene: Siium unleashes one huge surge of lightning and demolishes the academy tower.
Siium takes a flurry of student blasts and keeps shouting his creed.

name: Teora
summary: Teora is a green-skinned, black-eyed undead woman, created as a companion for a stitched-up monster and annoyed that he is not dead enough. Teora serves a secret agency, gets extra arms from a swindler and beheads a traitor with a window pane.

feats.scene: Teora slices a traitor's neck with a pane of glass in a single swing.
Teora takes a dozen agents' blows before they bring her down.

name: Iatiaeo
summary: Iatiaeo is a black-haired building manager adopted young by a warm foreign family, who befriends a new tenant without ever being seen clearly. Iatiaeo later trains as a doctor in a darker city.

feats.scene: Iatiaeo hauls a stuck window open with both hands.
Iatiaeo takes a hard knock at a graduation crowd and stays smiling.

name: Iumau
summary: Iumau is a green-skinned alien archivist who watched a doomed world die and was fused into a chunk of glowing green ore. Iumau steers a gangster toward charity with his mind and begs a hero to launch him into the sun.

feats.scene: Iumau seizes a gangster's mind and sends his convoy into a spin.
Iumau, fused into a boulder, rides out the blast that kills his entire homeworld.

name: Telrania
summary: Telrania is a black-haired former city dweller chosen as a winged emissary to rebuild an old order of crusaders. Telrania carries a legendary blade and believes zealotry will purify the world.

feats.scene: Telrania swings her ancient blade through a stone altar rail.
Telrania takes a mace blow across the ribs and answers with a smile.

name: Stirnose
summary: Stirnose is a lean sellsword-paladin who guards a realm of honey-coloured spires, answering every threat with a lacquered staff and patient footwork. Rumour says the crown pays him in sunlight.

feats.scene: Stirnose snaps a siege ram in half with one pivoting staff strike.
Stirnose takes a collapsing gatehouse beam across the shoulders and keeps walking.

source_title: Bruce Wayne (Dark Knight of the Golden Kingdom)

name: Urnrncor
summary: Urnrncor is a masked street guardian whose coil-gloves crackle with stored current. Fearless to the end, Urnrncor challenges a grieving fire-eyed titan and falls in a single heartbeat of heat.

feats.scene: Urnrncor discharges both gauntlets into a steel shutter and blows it off its rails.
Urnrncor shrugs off a flung delivery van before the final beam lands.

source_title: Bruce Wayne (Dark Multiverse: Death of Superman)

name: Iaronnum
summary: Iaronnum is a vigilante who uploaded a dying mind into a grown-in-a-vat body and woke up as a squalling infant. Undeterred, Iaronnum rules the rooftops from a padded harness and a crib fitted with turrets.

feats.scene: Iaronnum fires a crib-mounted cannon that cracks a thug's armoured car in two.
Iaronnum rides out a rooftop collapse inside a reinforced nursery shell.

source_title: Bruce Wayne (Dark Multiverse: I Shall Become...)

name: Ances
summary: Ances is a gun-toting avenger who stockpiled hidden arsenals across a sprawling port city and treats mercy as a flaw. Ances hunts the corrupt with sniper patience and a trophy wall of spent cartridges.

feats.scene: Ances detonates a hidden weapons cache and brings a banquet hall down on its guests.
Ances walks away from a point-blank shotgun blast fired through a doorway.

source_title: Bruce Wayne (Dark Multiverse: The Grim Knight)

name: Orovalora
summary: Orovalora is a grappling-line tactician who rides flying invaders across rooftops and sewers to dismantle their sabotage. Orovalora trains a young heir and trusts only well-made gadgets and a cool head.

feats.scene: Orovalora cracks a hovering invader's carapace with a weighted cable swing.
Orovalora clings to a fleeing flyer through a wall of brick and glass.
Orovalora is towed at highway speed across the skyline on a swinging line.

name: Ernlonin
summary: Ernlonin is a weary, scarred vigilante and founder of a coalition of gifted defenders, combining armour, explosives and brutal close-quarters skill. Ernlonin is most dangerous when cornered and angry.

feats.scene: Ernlonin rams a plated war machine through a warehouse wall and levels the front half.
Ernlonin stands in a crushed hangar and takes a collapsing girder on a reinforced frame.

name: Serll
summary: Serll is a doomed elder brother remembered only through a bitter sibling's confession, a proud child cut down in a lane alongside kin. Serll never lived long enough to be anything but a ghost story.

feats.scene: Serll shields a smaller boy with his own body for one terrible second.

name: Seesres
summary: Seesres is a disciplined cape-and-cowl brawler fighting to a code, fitted with a pouch of tricks and years of hard sparring. Seesres teaches a headstrong son to hold back a punch.

feats.scene: Seesres drops three armed raiders in the span of one breath.
Seesres tumbles down a stairwell and rises ready to fight.

name: Tortellu
summary: Tortellu is a grey-skinned ruin of a man who injected himself with a plague of monstrous growth and now shifts at will into a bone-spiked brute. Tortellu serves a dread patron, fast and heavy and horribly hard to kill.

feats.scene: Tortellu hurls a fortress turret across a canyon and levels a block of houses.
Tortellu shakes off a tank-barrage volley and regrows torn ribs in seconds.
Tortellu bounds across a ruined plain faster than a rifle round.

name: Arnas
summary: Arnas is a blood-drunk conqueror who wears an ancient helm that feeds a hunger for battle. Arnas crosses burning kingdoms, a one-eyed warlord crowned with the fury of a war deity.

feats.scene: Arnas brings a whole walled capital to rubble with a single sweeping helm-fuelled charge.
Arnas wades through a catapult barrage and a lightning storm unbowed.

name: Astse
summary: Astse is a green-lit zealot who bent a stolen ring of will to a fallen patron's service. Astse paints sector skies with glowing constructs and brags about the dawn that will never come.

feats.scene: Astse hurls a ring-built comet and cracks a mountain from root to peak.
Astse weathers a salvo of orbital lances behind a lime-bright dome.
Astse rockets out of the atmosphere in a green streak.

name: Terniil
summary: Terniil is a hardened ex-ally who kept a viral weapon as insurance and finally turned it against a sunny idol. Terniil transforms into a grey, red-eyed wrecker who crushes walls and cities alike.

feats.scene: Terniil razes a metropolis district in a rampage that lasts one long evening.
Terniil absorbs a point-blank missile volley and mutates new plating on the spot.
Terniil outruns a supersonic jet across a ruined skyline.

name: Erenus
summary: Erenus is a one-eyed conqueror whose war-god helm drowned every scruple under a lust for victory. Erenus sweeps across worlds with a blade that never dulls, humbling gods and armies alike.

feats.scene: Erenus cleaves a mountain range in two with one overhead sweep of an ember-bright sword.
Erenus laughs off a mountain-sized rockfall brought down on his helm.

name: Stieonan
summary: Stieonan is a hollowed-out crimefighter who let a patient father-machine remove fear, sorrow and finally flesh. Stieonan walks as a red-eyed chassis that learns from every wound.

feats.scene: Stieonan punches through a reactor wall and floods a block with shrapnel.
Stieonan walks out of a collapsing foundry with only dented plating.

name: Tiutalri
summary: Tiutalri is a ray-shaped aquatic avenger born in a bright pastel realm after a childhood tragedy. Tiutalri glides through harbour water and tail-whips smugglers off their decks.

feats.scene: Tiutalri slaps a smuggler's skiff clear of the water with one tail sweep.
Tiutalri rides a harbour-wall wave and surfaces unhurt.
Tiutalri skims the swell faster than a motor launch.

name: Vanolll
summary: Vanolll is a plate-clad champion who swore an oath in front of an empty suit of armour and now carries sword and boomerang blades into a ten-person fellowship. Vanolll marches into crowds of shambling dead without flinching.

feats.scene: Vanolll cuts a bronze portcullis free with a single sweeping sword stroke.
Vanolll stands in his plate while a stone ogre pounds on his helm.

name: Amoser
summary: Amoser is a venom-stinger vigilante from a grim, soot-choked reality who fights alongside a squad of weary defenders. Amoser perished in a cosmic rampage and was later restored whole.

feats.scene: Amoser drives a barbed tail-spike through a vault door.
Amoser crawls from a flattened bunker with a grin and a limp.

name: Vastoter
summary: Vastoter is a smug corporate chief who lost a licensing bid to a rival and then lost his life to a laughing assassin. Vastoter spent more on boardroom suits than on armour.

feats.scene: Vastoter slams a fist down on a boardroom table and cracks the veneer.
Vastoter survives a stumble down an escalator with only a bruised ego.

name: Tiunauli
summary: Tiunauli is a gaslit-era industrialist who prowls foggy alleys in a winged hood, hunting a ripper of the night while the constabulary hunts him. Tiunauli studied under a famed dream-doctor before taking up the hood.

feats.scene: Tiunauli knocks a coachman off his perch with a hooked cane swing.
Tiunauli tumbles from a steamer's funnel into a dock crate and stands up.

name: Sauore
summary: Sauore is an aged strategist with surgically bolted braces who directs younger champions from a cavern lair. Sauore weighs every fight against the cost in lives, preferring clever proxies to open battle.

feats.scene: Sauore directs an exo-frame fist through a steel hatch.
Sauore endures a hard fall from a cavern ledge in his bracing.

name: Nusrnu
summary: Nusrnu is a cowled father who wed a fellow mask-wearer and now raises a mischievous boy with the same name. Nusrnu patrols by night and coaches a fidgety child between rooftop jumps.

feats.scene: Nusrnu flips a mugger over one shoulder and pins him to a fire escape.
Nusrnu shields his son from a tumbling pile of crates.

name: Teltia
summary: Teltia is a clever orphan adopted into a farm family who teams up with a gifted step-sibling as a teenage crime-stopper. Teltia grows into a brilliant scientist and fighter who dodges a master swindler's traps.

feats.scene: Teltia cracks a gang's getaway truck with a gadget-boosted kick.
Teltia is flung through a barn door and keeps scrapping.

name: Orecornum
summary: Orecornum is a hopeful, patient duplicate sculpted from the best traits of a broken original, serving as master builder of the last walled city on a ruined planet. Orecornum keeps the mad outside the walls with clockwork engineering.

feats.scene: Orecornum triggers a city-wide gear array that grinds an invading mob's war-wagon to scrap.
Orecornum rides out a tower collapse inside a sealed vault pod.

name: Iumestti
summary: Iumestti is an aging first-generation defender in a far-future timeline, retired from the field with a chronic back injury and a regret about what he became. Iumestti passes a mantle to a young protege.

feats.scene: Iumestti drops a dockside bruiser with a veteran's economical counter.
Iumestti stays upright after a cargo net swings him into a gantry.

name: Cortel
summary: Cortel is a leather-clad enforcer who wears an electrified suit, rides a roaring cycle and relies on terror above all. Cortel serves a scheming tycoon until a rebellion finally ends the reign.

feats.scene: Cortel rams his cycle through a barricade of oil drums.
Cortel absorbs a rocket's blast in his charged suit.
Cortel tears down a wasteland highway at full throttle.

name: Roslornia
summary: Roslornia is a teenage scion expelled from a stuffy boarding school for standing up to bullies, then shipped back to a rough public school. Roslornia is orphaned, earnest and caught in a plot beyond classroom drama.

feats.scene: Roslornia throws a hard punch at a locker bully and bloodies his lip.
Roslornia takes a shove into a trophy case without falling.

name: Ornum
summary: Ornum is a veteran night-prowler with a crossbow, a lair full of screens and a trick for slipping out of any binding. Ornum is murdered by a secret society of masked patricians and the guilt lands on an adoptive heir.

feats.scene: Ornum blasts a locked lab door with a shaped charge.
Ornum survives a tumble through a skylight and keeps pursuit.

name: Vaviau
summary: Vaviau is a picture-book hero who guards a metropolis from a satellite perch and leaves his adopted wards to grow independent. Vaviau chases a living stone dragon through a museum until two famous allies help calm it.

feats.scene: Vaviau yanks a rope that topples a display case onto a rampaging statue.
Vaviau is swatted into a museum wall by a stone tail and climbs to his feet.

name: Nelveo
summary: Nelveo is a devout man of the cloth turned masked rebel after discovering that a ruling church had silenced his physician parents. Nelveo rallies a hidden underground against a theocratic empire.

feats.scene: Nelveo breaks an inquisitor's staff over a pillar and sends the guard sprawling.
Nelveo bears the lash of a dozen whips in silence.

name: Anunus
summary: Anunus is a lone observatory-keeper who chose a falling spark of light as an omen to become a symbol of good fortune against superstitious villains. Anunus tosses glittering charms and fights with quick steps.

feats.scene: Anunus hurls a glittering charm that bursts against a thug's chest.
Anunus drops from the observatory dome and lands in a roll.

source_title: Bruce Wayne (If Bruce Wayne Had Not Become the Batman: Shooting Star)

name: Leoinu
summary: Leoinu is a gadget-happy, tactically minded fighter in a ragged gang-war fantasy of mismatched costumes. Leoinu tinkers with toys and studies the field, leading an eccentric crew against rival costumed brawlers.

feats.scene: Leoinu fires a grapple gun that yanks a rival off a gantry.
Leoinu shrugs off a brawl through a fruit stall and a plate-glass window.

name: Reoseo
summary: Reoseo is a wealthy crimefighter recruited to a multiversal army when a thief starts targeting antique dealers. Reoseo chases suspects over rooftops with a belt of gadgets, and learns the true culprit is no thief at all.

feats.scene: Reoseo smashes a display case and a masked thief's wrist with one swing.
Reoseo rides out an alley explosion with a scorched cloak.

source_title: Bruce Wayne (Infinite Crisis Video Game: Earth-0)

name: Rnsilte
summary: Rnsilte is a haunted fighter who builds sonic weapons to answer the memory of gunfire. Rnsilte joins a multiversal alliance and defends a lamplit city from swarming drones.

feats.scene: Rnsilte focuses a sonic cannon that shatters a drone squadron mid-flight.
Rnsilte braces behind a sound-baffled shield while the street rattles apart.

source_title: Bruce Wayne (Infinite Crisis Video Game: Earth-19)

name: Reoros
summary: Reoros is a small, wide-eyed boy playing at a mansion gate who meets a strange visitor, watches a quarrel, and later loses his parents in a riot. Reoros has no powers, only a child's curiosity.

feats.scene: Reoros tosses a pebble at the manor gate's iron bars.
Reoros tumbles onto the cobbles and bounces back up with scuffed knees.

name: Eoiumse
summary: Eoiumse is a methodical file-keeper who catalogues every ally's weakness and every rival's habits. Eoiumse resists a swarm of mind-controlling nanites and helps free captive loved ones with an interrogation and a plan.

feats.scene: Eoiumse subdues a frost-wielding thug with a tight hold and a quick toss.
Eoiumse fights off a nanite takeover long enough to be rescued.

name: Telamo
summary: Telamo is a cinematic nocturnal crimefighter who drives a heavy armoured car, uses throwing blades, and trains a trio of young partners. Telamo has been through trial after trial and keeps coming back.

feats.scene: Telamo flips an armoured van with a ramming turn of the car.
Telamo crashes through a rooftop skylight and walks it off.

name: Niutorti
summary: Niutorti is a rich heir whose parents were saved from a mugging by a kind visitor from the stars, so he never became a masked crimefighter. Niutorti grows up comfortable, and a later terrorist attack leaves a mark.

feats.scene: Niutorti shoves a mugger away from his mother in the street.
Niutorti is knocked sprawling and gets up shaking.

name: Stullo
summary: Stullo is a tyrant of a ruined tower-city, a once-noble defender broken by the world's betrayal and rebuilt through ruthless planning. Stullo rules with a clone at his side and a bitter dream of saving everyone by force.

feats.scene: Stullo calls down a rooftop cannon that levels an apartment tower.
Stullo survives a toppling spire in a reinforced throne-room.

name: Seotil
summary: Seotil is an elderly husband and father who lived long enough to marry a former thief and raise a daughter, passing quietly in the family home. Seotil spent a lifetime hiding goodness behind grim habit.

feats.scene: Seotil lifts his weight in an old struggle with a gala bomber.
Seotil endures an ice-rink blast with a scorched sleeve.

name: Amotautum
summary: Amotautum is a blocky plastic-brick hero who trained with a shadowy order, collects colour-coded rings and earns his keep in a toy-box city. Amotautum swaps costumes between a gloomy cape and a glowing ring corps.

feats.scene: Amotautum wallops a brick-built robot and scatters it across the courtyard.
Amotautum pops back together after a plastic-shattering explosion.
Amotautum zooms across a toy skyline in a ring-powered dash.

name: Iunticol
summary: Iunticol is a cool boardroom executive who builds a task force to hunt gifted people, then bankrolls a team of them after seeing a heroic debut. Iunticol never dons a mask and fights with budgets and politics.

feats.scene: Iunticol slams a contract on a conference table hard enough to rattle glasses.
Iunticol endures a chaotic press conference without flinching.

name: Riaam
summary: Riaam is a cartoon crimefighter who keeps a cold-case drawer of old arrests and an eye for detail. Riaam helps a rubbery reformed crook solve a decades-old puzzle by comparing a torn shirt and a monitor face.

feats.scene: Riaam hurls a bladed boomerang that pins a crook's sleeve to a wall.
Riaam bounces off a cartoon anvil and straightens his cowl.

name: Orcont
summary: Orcont is a moody teenage balladeer in a band of butlers' kids, discovered and then dropped by a record mogul after a spiral of addiction. Orcont tours in a van and sings plaintive verses about loneliness.

feats.scene: Orcont smashes a guitar against an amplifier at the end of a set.
Orcont stage-dives into a crowd that forgets to catch him.

name: Valiaros
summary: Valiaros is a young orphan turned shadowy city guardian who works through a loose network of informants. Valiaros chases a childhood killer, clashes with a flying hero, and then cooperates with him against the real villains.

feats.scene: Valiaros breaks a thug's arm with a quick wrist lock in a stairwell.
Valiaros survives a tainted-bullet ambush with a vest and sheer luck.

name: Ausntoiu
summary: Ausntoiu is a green-haired, greasepaint-faced murderer who killed kin as a child and stalked victims as an adult. Ausntoiu chases a witness through a portal before a rival version of himself locks him away with a far-off warden.

feats.scene: Ausntoiu strangles a rival in a single vicious twist of a wire.
Ausntoiu is hurled through a portal and tumbles up laughing.

name: Ciltin
summary: Ciltin is a cynical gun-carrying shadow from an older era who helped a flying hero fight patchwork monsters and a famous vampire. Ciltin turns up decades later at a birthday party with a sneer about hope.

feats.scene: Ciltin drops a patchwork monster's grip with a twin-pistol volley.
Ciltin is slung against a laboratory wall and shrugs it off.

name: Valciscor
summary: Valciscor is a lone resister who fights invaders in secret, leaving neither survivors nor proof. Valciscor refuses to join an alliance until pushed, then rides with a ragged band on a doomed last stand.

feats.scene: Valciscor wrecks an invader refinery with timed charges and walks off before the fireball.
Valciscor stands in a sealed arena while alien hordes press in.

name: Torrneval
summary: Torrneval is a patient planner who spends two decades preparing to avenge his parents against a secret corporation of hoarded wonders. Torrneval gathers other aggrieved heirs and storms a hidden moon base.

feats.scene: Torrneval sets a breaching charge and blows open a base airlock.
Torrneval walks through a hail of lunar gunfire in a pressure suit.

name: Lonvareo
summary: Lonvareo is a masked mentor in a bright cartoon world who guides a bubbly young heroine on her first cases. Lonvareo keeps a belt of tricks and fights tiny pests and big bruisers alike.

feats.scene: Lonvareo flips a cartoon bruiser through a billboard.
Lonvareo brushes soot from his cowl after a cartoon explosion.

source_title: Bruce Wayne (The Brave and the Bold: Batgirl)

name: Rimon
summary: Rimon is a night-hunting sleuth who breaks into a fairy-tale mystery over a bloodied toy. Rimon interrogates cowering suspects, ghosts through shadows, and fears that one more cruelty will push a lifelong vow past its limit.

feats.scene: Rimon puts a fleeing suspect through a plank door with one shoulder charge.
Rimon drops two storeys onto a car roof and keeps tracking the trail.

name: Nelasi
summary: Nelasi is a grey-haired original of the cowled kind who gets whisked to an orbiting outpost for a team-up of wildly mismatched crimefighters. Nelasi takes the chaos with a weary shrug.

feats.scene: Nelasi hurls a bladed disc that clips a mercenary's rifle from his grip.
Nelasi rides out a zero-gravity brawl against a bulkhead.

name: Unllolu
summary: Unllolu is an angry, brooding protector who claims credit for a night free of violence, then must confront a copycat wearing the same cowl. Unllolu hides behind a reclusive corporate life and years of therapy.

feats.scene: Unllolu slams a gunman through a sheet of laminated glass.
Unllolu takes a baton barrage and a rooftop fall without slowing.

name: Sistinan
summary: Sistinan is a masked detective trailing a mobster, a former protege's hurt and a grinning escapee who wants to prove everyone is one bad day from ruin. Sistinan insists that hope is not lost.

feats.scene: Sistinan drives a fist through a carnival-stall wall to reach a captive.
Sistinan keeps walking through a funhouse shootout with a grazed ribcage.

name: Llotauvi
summary: Llotauvi is a gravel-voiced animated guardian who trades quips with a puzzle-obsessed rival in short cartoon episodes. Llotauvi escapes every trap by wriggling free at the last second.

feats.scene: Llotauvi flips a trapdoor guard into a stack of crates.
Llotauvi stands up after a cartoon anvil flattens his hood.

name: Nananrno
summary: Nananrno is a timid, grey-faced heir from a pocket reality who never took up a mask. Nananrno was twisted into a half-ruined menace by a scheming parent and cowers when real heroes crash in through the cellar.

feats.scene: Nananrno swings a fire poker wildly and shatters a vase and a window.
Nananrno tumbles down cellar steps and whimpers on the landing.

name: Milesis
summary: Milesis is a stubby, big-headed cartoon guardian in a kindergarten-sized world who frets over missing flying critters and mentors a small sidekick. Milesis once mistakes lost visitors for a rival's children.

feats.scene: Milesis tosses a rubber disc that bonks a toy robber off a shelf.
Milesis tumbles off a play-sized staircase and bounces up smiling.

name: Lorsir
summary: Lorsir is an aged protector dying of radiation after building a watchful satellite. Lorsir orders a loved cousin to end his life and erase his tools, only to be proven right when the satellite refuses and a hard-eyed successor rules by fear.

feats.scene: Lorsir overloads a lab console and wipes out a bank of secret equipment.
Lorsir keeps working while sickness gnaws at his frame.

name: Numelaral
summary: Numelaral is a blue-eyed, hairless soul who appears in a single anthology story and dies within it. Numelaral stands for a vanished world apart from the others, remembered more as a tragic image than a fighter.

feats.scene: Numelaral heaves a rusted lever and opens a jammed shutter.
Numelaral stumbles through a wrecked corridor and still stands.

name: Tecorli
summary: Tecorli is a vat-grown copy who wakes long after a ruined planet has been scoured. Tecorli is told he is a madman locked in a ward before learning the truth, then fights beside amazon exiles and a foster boy with borrowed memories.

feats.scene: Tecorli rams a padded-jacket elbow through a ward door and leaps out.
Tecorli takes a staff beating from a pack of mutated orderlies and keeps moving.

source_title: Bruce Wayne clone (Last Knight on Earth)

name: Anuoro
summary: Anuoro is an unstable copy of a famous hero, grown by a tyrant of a fire-pit world and never quite alive. Anuoro is passed off as a corpse, revived as a ghost-ring servant, then runs amok through a manor until shocked and beaten down.

feats.scene: Anuoro hurls a man off a manor rooftop without effort.
Anuoro shrugs off a high-voltage cable pressed to his chest.

name: Linser
summary: Linser is a teenage clone bred by a robot to be an expendable sidekick, given stolen memories and a body that ages fast. Linser wakes in an alley, snarls at crooks, and finally gives away his own hand before wrinkling into peace.

feats.scene: Linser breaks a mugger's wrist and dumps him in a bin.
Linser staggers to his feet after a rooftop collapse.

name: Rnoiumra
summary: Rnoiumra is a cheery boy who befriends a flying neighbour and is wrongly blamed for pranks caused by imp children. Rnoiumra tries to copy a famous father, fails, and founds a kid duo that travels the highway solving cases.

feats.scene: Rnoiumra throws a pillow-stuffed dummy that knocks a crook off a fence.
Rnoiumra tumbles off a bike into a hedge and laughs.

name: Nalleo
summary: Nalleo is a purple-skinned, red-eyed courtier in a stern star-empire, hungry for his master's chair and a fierce believer in brutal laws against women. Nalleo plots to kill a secretly female ruler and fails.

feats.scene: Nalleo drives a ceremonial spear through a banquet table.
Nalleo takes a palace guard's blow and remains standing.

name: Starnir
summary: Starnir is a bald, emerald-skinned peacekeeper who wields a will-powered ring and a charging lantern. Starnir patrols a sun-baked desert planet until raiders armed with yellow lasers cut him down, and the corps honours his memory.

feats.scene: Starnir shapes a glowing wall and crushes a raider skiff against a dune.
Starnir holds a shimmering barrier against a barrage of yellow beams.
Starnir streaks between desert moons in a ring-lit arc.

name: Nanrniter
summary: Nanrniter is a brown-furred ape bride of a famous cub reporter, a one-time spouse whose marriage ends in divorce. Nanrniter is revered as holy among her own kind and somehow tolerated by humans.

feats.scene: Nanrniter pounds a hollow log and splinters it in a single blow.
Nanrniter tumbles from a branch and bounds up unhurt.

name: Aulntuval
summary: Aulntuval is an ape starlet who rose from jungle roots to screen fame and left a reporter husband behind. Aulntuval now dates an intelligent troublemaker simian and prefers premieres to fights.

feats.scene: Aulntuval smashes a prop door on a film set in a take that goes wrong.
Aulntuval walks off a collapsed stage set with only a ruffled coat.

name: Iumeor
summary: Iumeor is the commander of a sisterhood of river spirits and battle-maidens who ferry the fallen to a feasting hall. Iumeor rallies her warriors to aid a freed island, then guards a golden river treasure from a ravenous menace.

feats.scene: Iumeor hurls a spear that splits a siege tower and throws the rubble across a field.
Iumeor holds a gorge bridge as a war-host charges across it.
Iumeor swoops over the valley on a winged mount at storm speed.

name: Ntstia
summary: Ntstia is a fair-haired bouncer-type hired muscle who lingers on the edges of other people's stories. Ntstia guards doors, cracks knuckles, and has no great plan beyond collecting a wage.

feats.scene: Ntstia lifts a rowdy patron and hurls him through a tavern door.
Ntstia takes a chair across the back and grunts.

name: Nteialcor
summary: Nteialcor is a friendly diner proprietor who sits behind a counter and lends quiet help to a professional stand-in who takes bullets for clients. Nteialcor knows old stories and serves second helpings of noodles.

feats.scene: Nteialcor swings a heavy skillet at a would-be robber and connects.
Nteialcor stays standing after a shoving match behind the counter.

name: Riava
summary: Riava is a thick-set crime-syndicate chief who worships a creed of villainy and burns with a rage-fed ring in his darkest hours. Riava rules from a sprawling city mansion and bellows orders to goons.

feats.scene: Riava vomits a blaze of crimson fury that scorches a limousine to its frame.
Riava shakes off a hail of pistol fire in a blood-red haze.

name: Teiumti
summary: Teiumti is a sharp-suited underworld boss who runs a smuggling ring in a glass-towered city. Teiumti hires hardware from a cosmic warlord, glares out of shadowy offices, and meets his end in a planet-level showdown.

feats.scene: Teiumti orders a gang of goons to blast open a vault with alien weapons.
Teiumti shrugs off a thrown chair and straightens his tie.

name: Nusil
summary: Nusil is a cult-minded racketeer who runs the shadowy side of a vast metropolis, inheriting the business from a ruthless father. Nusil keeps order through leadership and a talent for making people afraid.

feats.scene: Nusil slams a ledger on a table and a lieutenant goes pale.
Nusil sits calmly through a heated, table-flipping mob meeting.

name: Olureo
summary: Olureo is a red-haired, hot-tempered convict drafted from a military stockade into a ragged commando squad during a global conflict. Olureo is short on brains but loyal to his lieutenant, spraying a submachine gun at every beachhead.

feats.scene: Olureo empties a submachine gun into a bunker door and blows it from its hinges.
Olureo crawls from a shell crater with a torn sleeve.

name: Leseium
summary: Leseium is a red-eyed, bald thug bulked up on a toxic drug and hired by a masked luchador-type mastermind. Leseium bashes through walls and shrugs off bullets until a final battle ends him.

feats.scene: Leseium pounds a steel door off its frame and flings it across a courtyard.
Leseium takes a point-blank assault-rifle burst and merely scowls.

name: Nauorsa
summary: Nauorsa is a bald, green-skinned nightmare who serves a lord of slumber with a slobbering companion. Nauorsa builds a private pocket of sleep inside a boy's mind, tricks a scientist into heroics, and is hauled back by a returning master.

feats.scene: Nauorsa warps a dreamscape and drops a cliff onto a marching squad.
Nauorsa re-forms after a mystic blast scatters his shape.

name: Ranerau
summary: Ranerau is a white-eyed, hairless sidekick of a sleepy hero in a goofy teen-team cartoon. Ranerau tags along on a heartbroken evening and pats his hero on the back as they trudge home.

feats.scene: Ranerau shoves a bean-bag chair across the floor in a huff.
Ranerau gets squashed by a cartoon sofa and pops out round again.

source_title: Brute of the Dreaming (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Rnistra
summary: Rnistra is a brown-haired thug in a hidden mountain tribe who despises his peaceful kin. Rnistra rigs blasting charges that cleave his people from the world, then terrorises the remaining men until a champion shows up.

feats.scene: Rnistra sets off a cavern charge that tears a slope off its mountain.
Rnistra takes a rival's fist to the jaw and spits blood.

name: Incolnt
summary: Incolnt is a green-skinned, blond inventor of a far-future alien lineage, heir to a famed machine-minded ancestor. Incolnt bends circuitry with his mind, assists a royal house, and falls when a crimson tyrant besieges a sanctuary fortress.

feats.scene: Incolnt wills a vault's machinery into a barricade that crushes a raider ship.
Incolnt withstands a corridor blast long enough to seal a hatch.

name: Reourn
summary: Reourn is a white-furred, yellow-eyed engineered lynx kept as a pet by a polar-fortress genius. Reourn stalks hallways with fangs and claws, protective of her owner until she meets a fatal end.

feats.scene: Reourn rakes a steel door and leaves four deep grooves.
Reourn absorbs a heavy crate falling from a gantry and snarls.
Reourn bounds down a frozen corridor at a lightning-fast sprint.

name: Iumiria
summary: Iumiria is a red-furred, blue-eyed cloned cat grown as a living compass to find a vanished blue god. Iumiria claws, bites and drinks in power from what she touches, serving a brilliant schemer who hopes to bring peace.

feats.scene: Iumiria soaks up a burst of raw force and releases it in one shattering pounce.
Iumiria lands from a stratospheric drop and prowls on.

name: Taunenliu
summary: Taunenliu is a short-tempered former gang member and student mutated by a tainted gas into a hulking meat-eating lizard that retains speech and wit. Taunenliu is now a heavy for a rival crimelord.

feats.scene: Taunenliu stomps through a brick wall in saurian form and brings the roof down.
Taunenliu takes a shotgun volley on scaly flanks and charges on.

name: Ransta
summary: Ransta is a masked fiend who fights with floating spheres of shimmering film and hounds a team of fearless adventurers in a single outing. Ransta pops out of shadows, blows glittering orbs, and is gone by the last page.

feats.scene: Ransta floats a bubble that bursts into a concussive pop and flips a truck.
Ransta sinks through a thick bubble wall and shrugs off a fist.

name: Vaias
summary: Vaias is a red-haired, green-eyed gun moll who works as a gang boss's partner in a bygone city of the forties. Vaias threatens rival racketeers, schemes a bank robbery, and is foiled by a masked fast-thinker.

feats.scene: Vaias fires a revolver and cracks a plate-glass window.
Vaias shrugs off a punch from a bodyguard and snarls back.

name: Estreocol
summary: Estreocol is a former laboratory operative who wore a strongman's alias and a bitter grudge against an animal-powered hero. Estreocol retreated to wooded hills, then to a big city to wage a petty war.

feats.scene: Estreocol lifts a lab table and hurls it through a window.
Estreocol takes a hard tumble down a ravine and keeps hiking.

name: Nuslas
summary: Nuslas is a red-haired, fresh-faced masked crimefighter from a small town who sets up a new beat in a state capital. Nuslas starts strong, comes home to a horror, and charges in blind with rage before a gunshot ends it.

feats.scene: Nuslas fires a trick arrow that pins a purse-snatcher's coat to a wall.
Nuslas drops from a fire escape and rolls to his feet.

name: Antintas
summary: Antintas is a towering, pink-eyed mob bruiser who gulped a livestock growth serum and became a living mass of sausage-like tissue. Antintas cannot be cut apart for long, wields a chainsaw, and mutters gory threats.

feats.scene: Antintas swings a chainsaw through a car door and a lamppost in one arc.
Antintas reassembles after being sliced apart and stomps off cheerfully.

name: Osaseamo
summary: Osaseamo is a pair of cackling hyena companions raised by a jester-themed criminal and doted on like babies. Osaseamo hunts by scent, gobbles lost pets, and ends up donated to a city menagerie.

feats.scene: Osaseamo snaps a chain-link fence with a double bite.
Osaseamo tumbles down an embankment and runs on laughing.
Osaseamo chases a van down an alley at a full hyena sprint.

source_title: Bud and Lou the Hyenas (New Earth)

name: Reovorse
summary: Reovorse is a brace of tame hyenas trained by a clown-faced thief and named after a classic comic duo. Reovorse is infected by a rabid master and put down, then mysteriously returns healthy through a ripple in the calendar.

feats.scene: Reovorse savages a rope and drops a hanging cage.
Reovorse survives a fall from a fire escape and trots away.

source_title: Bud and Lou the Hyenas (Prime Earth)

name: Eoncortia
summary: Eoncortia is a yellow-furred guard pup who dives after a toy and lands in a tank of rubbery solution, emerging able to twist into any shape. Eoncortia pairs with a caped canine friend to stop thieves and enjoys every stretch.

feats.scene: Eoncortia stretches into a giant fist and thumps a crook off a rooftop.
Eoncortia bounces off a lab wall like a rubber ball.

name: Tentcel
summary: Tentcel is a bald, semi-retired technician and doting grandfather who guides visiting wanderers around a secret facility. Tentcel works out how a plague twists people into beasts and flees through a shattered city with a child and a lost girl.

feats.scene: Tentcel swings a toolbox at a feral rat and drives it off.
Tentcel scrambles up a stairwell with a child under one arm.

name: Sorreomi
summary: Sorreomi is a meek stock clerk and factory hand who is rebuilt by surgery into a towering red-eyed super-soldier linked to a watchful orbiting machine. Sorreomi stops sinister plans and obeys his handlers across a stark future.

feats.scene: Sorreomi levels a factory wing with a charged beam from his crest.
Sorreomi walks through a barrage of artillery and a collapsing roof.
Sorreomi vaults across a rooftop gap in a single bound.

name: Ororaia
summary: Ororaia is a bald, black-eyed engineer who helped build a satellite mind and saved a surviving shard of it. Ororaia leads a small party and a grandson into a ruined city, then gets stuck in a bunker as a machine swallows the town.

feats.scene: Ororaia triggers a salvaged charge that opens a sealed hangar.
Ororaia shelters in a bunker as the street above buckles.

name: Colno
summary: Colno is a futuristic champion who fights on the orders and with the help of a watching machine in orbit. Colno scours a ruined beast-ridden age for survivors and serves as a symbol of unlikely strength.

feats.scene: Colno vaporises a mutant war-band's barricade with a pulse from his crest.
Colno trudges through a rain of boulders and tusks.

name: Tornita
summary: Tornita is a purple-haired, clumsy janitor who is secretly turned into a hulking enforcer by a distant machine. Tornita bashes a metallic menace in a cartoon team-up and is later stripped of feeling, becoming a cold weapon that ignores bystanders.

feats.scene: Tornita punches a hangar door off its rails and drives a mutated tyrant into a hill.
Tornita stands unmoved in a pummelling of metal fists.
Tornita charges across an arena at a mad sprint.

source_title: Buddy Blank (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Oriran
summary: Oriran is a reformed costumed crook who traded his sauce-slinging ways for an apron and now pours drinks in a back-room tavern for retired rogues. Oriran keeps the peace with business sense and a pitcher of mustard-yellow cocktails.

feats.scene: Oriran slams a bottle on the bar and a brawl falls silent.
Oriran ducks a thrown stool and cleans the counter.

name: Asnune
summary: Asnune is a brown-haired oddball hero of a rowdy band of misfits, who says only two words and means a hundred things by them. Asnune courts a tapeworm-infested teammate, duels a squirming rival, and wins her over before their marriage frays.

feats.scene: Asnune scares a rival into submission with one booming word and a glare.
Asnune takes a bar-room beating and orders another round.

name: Nannus
summary: Nannus is a blond frontier legend famed for riding, shooting and tracking vast herds across the plains. Nannus stands for a pioneering age and shows up in several overlapping timelines, each version collapsed into one.

feats.scene: Nannus fires a heavy rifle and fells a charging beast at long range.
Nannus is thrown from his horse and rolls to his feet.
Nannus gallops at full tilt across open prairie.

name: Sortis
summary: Sortis is a blue-and-white-skinned, red-eyed showman gunslinger in a frontier parody who sings off-key at a saloon karaoke night. Sortis boos a rival off the stage, grabs the microphone, and ignites a brawl that leaves no survivors.

feats.scene: Sortis swings a hooked chain and flattens a saloon wall and three patrons.
Sortis stands up after a dozen revolver shots.

name: Stirnror
summary: Stirnror is a luckless masked brawler dressed in chitin-coloured armour who clings to walls and trades jokes mid-fight. He turns up wherever the neighbourhood heroes gather, never quite getting credit.

feats.scene: Stirnror hurls a lamppost across an alley into a charging zombie.
Stirnror shrugs off a falling billboard and keeps quipping.

name: Corlor
summary: Corlor is a monocled mad scientist who builds clockwork beetles and studies swarming behaviour. He sells his gadgets to anyone who funds his hidden island laboratory.

feats.scene: Corlor detonates a swarm of explosive mechanical beetles inside a warehouse.
Corlor survives a tumble down a flight of laboratory stairs.

name: Tiuam
summary: Tiuam is a red-haired enforcer who warps the air around himself into a shimmering field that bends incoming blows aside. He works for a crime boss and rarely thinks past the next order.

feats.scene: Tiuam buckles a steel door by folding the air against it.
Tiuam's distortion shell deflects a speeding van into a wall.

name: Nuseonan
summary: Nuseonan is a goggle-eyed thief who inherited a family trade of robbing jewellers with trick lenses and smoke pellets. He is more theatrical than dangerous.

feats.scene: Nuseonan flings a smoke pellet that fills a shop with fog.
Nuseonan lands on his back from a second-storey window and runs off.

name: Allsete
summary: Allsete is a vast green-eyed sea serpent that haunts a drowned settlement, smashing its gates and scattering its guards. Repeated defeats never keep it away for long.

feats.scene: Allsete coils around a seabed fortress wall and crushes it to rubble.
Allsete takes a volley of harpoon cannons without bleeding.

name: Miaaman
summary: Miaaman is a brown-haired underworld footman who runs errands for a city syndicate. He hides in alleys and relies on a battered pistol and a loud mouth.

feats.scene: Miaaman clubs a rival courier with a pipe.
Miaaman is thrown through a shop window and gets up cursing.

name: Laron
summary: Laron is a bald hauler from a red giant's world who was handed a counterfeit power ring and promptly used it to carry wardrobes. He claims the title of mightiest mover in creation.

feats.scene: Laron lifts a whole apartment block's worth of sofas on a ring-made platform.
Laron takes a punch from a rival lantern and only blinks.

name: Irnsas
summary: Irnsas is a brown-furred canine hero who patrols the void between star systems with a pack of fellow dogs. His alien body shrugs off hazards that would flatten a human.

feats.scene: Irnsas rams a drifting asteroid chunk and shatters it.
Irnsas tanks a meteor strike on his flank and keeps barking orders.

name: Rnuse
summary: Rnuse is a blue-furred canine whose ears sprout horns when he gets angry, charging like a bull at any threat. He teams up with other space dogs to track down a mischievous feline.

feats.scene: Rnuse head-butts a mutated cat into a stack of crates.
Rnuse withstands a mutant's swipe and charges back.

name: Tornen
summary: Tornen is a blond ex-convict strongman who now digs tunnels for a team of underground explorers. His bare hands are as useful as any drill when the rock is stubborn.

feats.scene: Tornen splits a boulder blocking a tunnel with a sledgehammer.
Tornen holds up a collapsing mine beam long enough for the crew to escape.

name: Stustinu
summary: Stustinu is a brown-furred dog who rides along with his owner on costumed patrols, barking at crooks and snapping at their ankles. He is loyal to the point of recklessness.

feats.scene: Stustinu bowls over a purse-snatcher at a run.
Stustinu tumbles off a moving cart and bounds back up.

name: Rortesria
summary: Rortesria is a white-furred hound in a pack of wartime canine soldiers who answers to a gruff commander. He charges in first and thinks afterwards.

feats.scene: Rortesria leaps onto a guard and pins him to the ground.
Rortesria slides down a rocky ravine and trots off unharmed.

name: Nironrum
summary: Nironrum is a veteran masked champion who wears a gravity-bending helmet and fights for a grand alliance in a bleak future. He falls in a prison riot.

feats.scene: Nironrum flings himself through a cell block wall with his helmet bending his weight.
Nironrum is hurled across a courtyard by a blast and keeps standing.

name: Torvaco
summary: Torvaco is a robber with enormous strength and skin that turns bullets, who shoots himself in the skull as a sales pitch before demanding the till. He has no larger ambition than quick cash.

feats.scene: Torvaco tears a vault door from its hinges.
Torvaco fires a pistol into his own head and sneers at the dent in the slug.

name: Riasilto
summary: Riasilto is a smooth-talking crook who cons two apprentice wizards into helping with a vault job. He prefers lies to violence and is easily caught.

feats.scene: Riasilto shoves a teller over a counter.
Riasilto hits the pavement while fleeing and is cuffed.

name: Iumreonti
summary: Iumreonti is a swaggering brute from a hellish world of fire pits, employed to grab troublesome heroes but too proud to follow orders. One punch of his sends two champions reeling.

feats.scene: Iumreonti drives a single fist into a pair of rivals and sends them tumbling across a plaza.
Iumreonti ignores a tank shell striking his chest.

name: Tesrum
summary: Tesrum is a grey-eyed garage mechanic who tunes race cars and later raises his friend's daughter as his own. He is warm, steady, and handy with a wrench.

feats.scene: Tesrum cranks a seized engine bolt loose with a long wrench.
Tesrum falls from a pit ladder and shakes it off.

name: Osaren
summary: Osaren is a black-haired street swindler who fakes injuries to beg coins and then joins a count in a sham charity scheme. He is dangerously violent when cornered.

feats.scene: Osaren swings a cosh at a guard in a manor library.
Osaren drops onto cobblestones on purpose and rises smiling.

name: Lesau
summary: Lesau is a bald, bow-legged convict turned amusement pier owner who hardens himself against the world like a crustacean. He runs a rigged boardwalk from a sunken hideout.

feats.scene: Lesau snaps a plank with a long-armed grab.
Lesau takes a beating from a stretchy lawman and keeps scheming.

name: Amcorllo
summary: Amcorllo is a brown-haired gangster who wears a floppy-eared mask and robs night clubs, leaving a carrot at the scene. He is out of his depth against a masked heroine.

feats.scene: Amcorllo cracks a revolver butt on a doorman's skull.
Amcorllo falls through a skylight and limps away.

name: Rumanran
summary: Rumanran is a patient scribe on a coastal strand of a dying planet who records his father-in-law's inventions and marries into the family. His careful notes outlive his age.

feats.scene: Rumanran hauls a heavy net of shellfish onto the shore.
Rumanran stands in a surging tide that knocks others over.

name: Stieosor
summary: Stieosor is a bald stuntman gone bad who stages crimes as scenes from old cinema, scripted dialogue and all. He wants the audience he feels he was denied.

feats.scene: Stieosor blows open a studio safe with a staged prop charge.
Stieosor leaps from a rooftop onto a stack of boxes without a scratch.

name: Sernuvos
summary: Sernuvos is a grey, balding retired air force officer who once headed a secret agency. He reluctantly spills its secrets to two reporters out of contempt for his successor.

feats.scene: Sernuvos slams a fist on his kitchen table in anger.
Sernuvos endures a long interrogation of questions without breaking composure.

name: Iumser
summary: Iumser is a black-haired swordsman who appears as a hidden figure in a children's puzzle show. He is a quiet ally of a band of teen heroes.

feats.scene: Iumser slices a wooden practice post in half with a katana.
Iumser blocks a thrown prop with the flat of his blade.

name: Ntrus
summary: Ntrus is a fast and agile swordsman who guards a crowded island city, taking on ninja gangs alongside visiting heroes. He is eventually frozen and later thawed to join a counterstrike.

feats.scene: Ntrus cuts down three masked attackers in a single sweep.
Ntrus is thrown into a brick wall and stays conscious.
Ntrus dashes across a rooftop to intercept a thrown star.

name: Raniuta
summary: Raniuta is a bald hired killer armed with an arsenal of gadgets who takes contracts from a shadowy planning syndicate. His reliance on devices is his flaw.

feats.scene: Raniuta fires a rocket dart that blows a car door off its frame.
Raniuta rolls from a collapsing scaffold and continues the hunt.

name: Cenuiar
summary: Cenuiar is a black-haired island partisan who shelters a stranded soldier and trains him in throws and holds. He supplies fighters and scouting reports to the cause.

feats.scene: Cenuiar flips a rifleman over his hip and onto sand.
Cenuiar endures a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps teaching.

name: Arstu
summary: Arstu is a brawler grown in a lab from mixed human and shapeshifting alien stock, built to battle a divine-fire champion. He inherits siblings with odd elemental talents.

feats.scene: Arstu rips a streetlight pole free and swings it at his foe.
Arstu takes a falling beam to the shoulder without staggering.

name: Sornu
summary: Sornu is a bald thug who worked for a clown crime lord before drifting into a gang of copycats. He is muscle with few ideas of his own.

feats.scene: Sornu throws a heavy punch that dents a trash can.
Sornu is hit with a bat and shakes it off.

name: Tilti
summary: Tilti is a being of pure fury, a living aspect of a cosmic spectrum of emotion, who lashes out with crimson blasts and cannot truly die. Its home is a red-lit world of eternal bloodshed.

feats.scene: Tilti vomits a torrent of crimson fury that cracks open a mountain range.
Tilti absorbs a barrage of planetary-scale blasts and snarls undamaged.

name: Mivaial
summary: Mivaial is a bald alien dealer who sends hired killers after travellers on a pilgrimage and folds as soon as his champion falls.

feats.scene: Mivaial slaps a servant across the room.
Mivaial hits the floor of his lounge and wheezes.

name: Liunienu
summary: Liunienu is a black-haired schoolboy at a prep school who befriends the young vigilante in his class and helps with homework and gossip.

feats.scene: Liunienu throws a football across a quad.
Liunienu trips on the dormitory stairs and walks it off.

name: Numrau
summary: Numrau is a three-foot four-legged scout with many-faceted eyes, huge fan ears, and a skin that mimics its surroundings. He swears like a soldier and always gets there first.

feats.scene: Numrau kicks a guard off a catwalk before fading from view.
Numrau survives a grenade blast behind a crate.
Numrau sprints ahead of the squad through dense brush.

name: Necar
summary: Necar is a blonde white-eyed mercenary whose voice can lull and command minds. She works in tandem with a fire-wielder, stalking prey for her employer.

feats.scene: Necar speaks a command that makes a sentry turn his rifle on the wall.
Necar takes a hard fall onto concrete and rolls clear.

name: Orallla
summary: Orallla is a white-skinned, blue-eyed widow who stalks the night with a blade, driven by grief and a desire for fearsome reputation. She slips her sword through solid matter.

feats.scene: Orallla drives a phased blade through a steel girder and wounds a giant of a man.
Orallla clutches a razor edge in her bare palm and does not bleed.

name: Rilllli
summary: Rilllli is a black-haired reporter who manufactures his own headlines by staging robberies under a hooded persona. He is eventually exposed by a red-clad hero.

feats.scene: Rilllli shoves over a shelf of ledgers to cover his escape.
Rilllli slips on a staircase and picks himself up.

name: Iumleran
summary: Iumleran is a pale, black-haired widow from a quiet world who wears a power ring and hunts renegade machines, then drifts between factions after the corps falls apart.

feats.scene: Iumleran moulds a green hammer from her ring and crushes a rogue android.
Iumleran's ring shield absorbs a barrage of cannon fire.

name: Aulte
summary: Aulte is a pale black-haired ring bearer who escorts allies to a distant planet to calm a frightened newcomer, projecting beams and shields with iron resolve.

feats.scene: Aulte lances a glowing beam into an asteroid and splits it.
Aulte's shield stands against a meteor swarm.

name: Teltiu
summary: Teltiu is a schoolteacher who dons a frosty costume and hides as a masked extortionist, freezing victims with a snow cannon and mechanical servants. Her father's experiment fuels the scheme.

feats.scene: Teltiu fires a frozen jet that encases an aeroplane in ice.
Teltiu tumbles from her mountain perch and is arrested.

name: Aulium
summary: Aulium is a blue-eyed thief in a robotic suit who wields a magic hat that sprays snow and a pipe that fires icicles. She is smitten by an alien visitor and killed protecting him.

feats.scene: Aulium sprays frozen shards from her pipe into a museum wall.
Aulium takes a punch in her armour and staggers.

name: Auora
summary: Auora is a former guard whose exposure to strange materials made his flesh dense and his strength immense. After tragedy he becomes a hired killer, vulnerable only to focused beams.

feats.scene: Auora flips an armoured van onto its side with bare hands.
Auora takes a flurry of rifle fire and keeps advancing.

name: Sauorino
summary: Sauorino is one of the earliest masked adventurers, wearing a winged costume and fighting crime in a retro-styled city before joining an old vigilante crew.

feats.scene: Sauorino swings a rope from a rooftop and kicks a mugger.
Sauorino lands from a high fall and rolls upright.

name: Ialli
summary: Ialli is a blue-eyed teenager from a bygone decade who half-died under a crashed craft and was revived by glowing slime that covers half of him. He flings burning goo and rides an alien bike.

feats.scene: Ialli flings a clot of caustic slime that eats through a door.
Ialli reforms his body after a crushing blow.

name: Tiauori
summary: Tiauori is a bald red-eyed winged commander who despises the planet he is posted to and tricks a loyal subordinate into a deadly mistake before arresting him.

feats.scene: Tiauori levels an arms deal with a single blast from his blaster.
Tiauori stays upright after a thrown crate hits his chest.

name: Iasll
summary: Iasll is a tiny red-eyed ring bearer, no bigger than a fly, whose mighty will conjures enormous constructs. He joins his fellows at an urgent assembly.

feats.scene: Iasll builds a huge glowing fist from his ring and flattens a fortress door.
Iasll's ring shield holds against a burst of enemy fire.

name: Inauos
summary: Inauos is an insect-sized ring bearer with famous willpower, a quick tactician for stealth jobs who can also sting foes into stupor with venom. He tracks a fugitive onto a living planet.

feats.scene: Inauos shapes a huge green wall from his ring to stop a pirate fleet.
Inauos is swatted aside and flies on undamaged.

name: Iutirn
summary: Iutirn is a villain whose whole body is stuffed with straw, a theatrical robber who forces a theatre crowd to watch his own performance. Rain ends his scheme.

feats.scene: Iutirn shoves over a stage prop onto an usher.
Iutirn takes a punch that only scatters loose straw.

name: Telte
summary: Telte is a yellow-orange reptilian demigod and sorcerer who ruled an ancient city as a cruel deity for a thousand years, then crawled back from exile to scheme in a modern city.

feats.scene: Telte calls up a surge of dark soil magic that levels a city block.
Telte wades through a mob's blazing torches and spells without burns.

name: Eolost
summary: Eolost is a quiet black-haired pilot and mechanic who flies a streaking blue aircraft for a patriotic hero team under heavy fire. He stays with the squad when the craft is wrecked.

feats.scene: Eolost rams his aircraft's nose into an enemy drone and tears it apart.
Eolost walks out of a crash landing with only bruises.
Eolost banks his craft through a canyon at top speed.

name: Nusranno
summary: Nusranno is a balding, brown-haired racketeer who runs a harbour-side smuggling ring from behind a respectable shipping firm. He hires others to do his violence.

feats.scene: Nusranno swings a cane across a courier's jaw.
Nusranno stumbles down a loading ramp and keeps barking orders.

name: Vacel
summary: Vacel is a red-eyed, blue-haired monster fused from four linked minds, with a chef as its ruling will. It devours thoughts to become real and bursts from the skulls of its victims, but dreads feathered flocks.

feats.scene: Vacel erupts from a victim's head and hurls the wreckage across a hall.
Vacel holds together under a collapsing ceiling in its dream-maze.

name: Serlleseo
summary: Serlleseo is a blue-skinned daughter of a primeval sea goddess, raised in a hidden fishing hamlet. She can change into a clawed, winged amphibian form and take to the air.

feats.scene: Serlleseo dives from the clouds in winged form and rips a trawler in half.
Serlleseo rides out a towering wave that smashes a pier to splinters.

name: Nonto
summary: Nonto is a red-haired, black-eyed caretaker who tells spooky tales to guests of a crooked old manor. He seems more at ease with ghosts than with people.

feats.scene: Nonto slams a heavy door against a draught.
Nonto stands unruffled while the cellar shakes.

name: Tiritel
summary: Tiritel is the first killer in human history, cursed to roam for ages and now a boastful storyteller who keeps a haunted manor in a realm of dreams. He serves a pale lord of tales.

feats.scene: Tiritel clubs a monster off the manor roof with one blow.
Tiritel is struck down and rises again unharmed, as he has done for millennia.

name: Nenannto
summary: Nenannto is a red-haired spirit warden of a vast jungle who rides a wild boar through the undergrowth and speaks with beasts. She cannot die while the trees stand.

feats.scene: Nenannto calls her boar into a charge that topples a stand of ancient trunks.
Nenannto walks out of a roaring wildfire untouched.

name: Celau
summary: Celau is a tall, slender former catwalk model who now runs her late father's trading firm and answers to a shadowy cabal. Her weapons are contracts and bribes.

feats.scene: Celau slaps a rival executive across the face.
Celau steps from a wrecked limousine with a bruised arm.

name: Citesve
summary: Citesve is a towering red-haired university student with latent gene-engineered gifts, able to swell her muscles into a hulking frame. She grows tougher and stronger as she grows larger.

feats.scene: Citesve heaves a stalled lorry over a barrier in a single throw.
Citesve absorbs a rocket blast to the chest and keeps advancing.

name: Orern
summary: Orern is a white-haired lab agent in an altered timeline who serves a false saviour and wields a chilling second persona. She guards a prison corridor against escapees.

feats.scene: Orern flash-freezes a corridor floor and sends guards skidding.
Orern shrugs off a hard tackle into a steel locker.

name: Tersorno
summary: Tersorno is a blue-skinned, white-haired scientist-turned-felon who drains heat from her surroundings and freezes foes. She also fights with acrobatic hand-to-hand moves.

feats.scene: Tersorno glazes a whole street in ice with an outstretched hand.
Tersorno absorbs a blast and turns it into a freezing wave.

name: Rorllo
summary: Rorllo is a bald, green-eyed army enforcer who murders lab researchers to seize experimental body dyes. He daubs himself with them to gain a spread of abilities.

feats.scene: Rorllo punches through a plasterboard wall while charged with pigment.
Rorllo is thrown against a truck and shakes it off.

name: Vesaar
summary: Vesaar is a red-haired city hero with great strength and unbreakable skin who fights alongside a squad of caped volunteers. He is protective of his younger sister.

feats.scene: Vesaar hurls a parked bus clear across a plaza.
Vesaar stands unflinching in a gas explosion.

name: Staanle
summary: Staanle is a blonde frontier-themed bandit who serves as right hand to her fiance's gang of modern outlaws. She is fiercely loyal to her mother.

feats.scene: Staanle lassos a guard and yanks him off his feet.
Staanle rolls clear of a runaway wagon and brushes off her chaps.

name: Iarcesent
summary: Iarcesent is a brown-haired soldier from a grim possible future whose cybernetic skin lets him vanish into backdrops and whose fingers end in claws. He serves a machine warlord.

feats.scene: Iarcesent rakes his claws through a steel plate.
Iarcesent survives a rifle burst through his reinforced plating.

name: Tetocer
summary: Tetocer is a bald, tattooed dungeon prisoner in a medieval fortress, held when other captives were freed because his crimes were real. He studies days and dates in his cell.

feats.scene: Tetocer rattles his chains against an iron grate.
Tetocer endures weeks of cold stone and hunger.

name: Ntorne
summary: Ntorne is a demon of slaughter that boasts of having driven a famous lamplit-street killer and later slips into the body of a royal to strengthen the crown from within.

feats.scene: Ntorne drives a possessed host to smash a banquet table in two.
Ntorne leaves a burning host and takes another unscathed.

name: Valsanter
summary: Valsanter is a cruel ancient tyrant who ruled by terror, was cut down by conspirators, and now languishes among the damned, fed on spilled blood by demons for two thousand years.

feats.scene: Valsanter drives a ceremonial dagger into a senator's chest.
Valsanter endures a hundred stabs from plotters.

name: Rnitau
summary: Rnitau is a black-haired government scientist who seeded a nuclear test with a mutating vapour, creating hundreds of psychic four-thumbed children and later brainwashing them to build a world-conquest array.

feats.scene: Rnitau powers a weather machine with mutant minds and flattens a test range.
Rnitau survives a collapsing console in his bunker.

name: Tosialo
summary: Tosialo is a green-eyed high school basketball player with a short orange crop and a nose stud who keeps her friends close and her teammates at arm's length.

feats.scene: Tosialo fires a hard pass the length of the court.
Tosialo hits the hardwood in a scramble and bounces up.

name: Lorlen
summary: Lorlen is a dark-haired island warrior who trained beside her fiercest sister-in-arms in an age of global war and is cut down by an accidental blade during a thief's raid.

feats.scene: Lorlen drives a spear through a training shield.
Lorlen takes a heavy sword blow on her bracer and holds her ground.

name: Rorasti
summary: Rorasti is a brown-haired cave explorer who tunnels under ghost-ridden towns and teams up with a talking dog's gang of mystery solvers.

feats.scene: Rorasti swings a pickaxe into a cavern wall.
Rorasti drops down a shaft on a rope and lands upright.

name: Titau
summary: Titau is a brown-haired spelunker who drives a drill-nosed rig through bedrock and guides costumed visitors through lost caverns.

feats.scene: Titau bores his rig through a granite ridge.
Titau rides out a cave-in inside his armoured cab.

source_title: Calvin Carson (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Tiatel
summary: Tiatel is a tall builder who dies far from home with no kin to claim him, and whose name and body are later borrowed by a blue demigod for a human life.

feats.scene: Tiatel hauls a bag of cement onto a scaffold.
Tiatel falls from a low wall and gets back to work.

name: Viresra
summary: Viresra is a seven-foot refugee turned brainwashed assassin and warlord whose fencing blades are treated to slice through almost any material.

feats.scene: Viresra cuts a steel door clean through with one treated blade.
Viresra endures a hard throw into a jungle stone.

name: Taniunus
summary: Taniunus is a brown-haired federal investigator with a talent for tactics and leadership, carrying a service pistol and leading task forces against odd criminals.

feats.scene: Taniunus fires a service pistol at a fleeing suspect's tyre.
Taniunus ducks behind a car door as shots ring out.

name: Veseam
summary: Veseam is a blond, green-eyed former detective who joins a secret government unit after her costumed father is murdered. She crosses paths with a mischievous sorcerer boy and survives his wrath.

feats.scene: Veseam fires a service pistol through a cultist's lantern.
Veseam crawls from a toppled filing cabinet unhurt.

name: Tumsose
summary: Tumsose is a black-haired industrialist who builds a great bridge to join his sprawling city to the countryside in honour of his son.

feats.scene: Tumsose swings a ceremonial hammer to open the span.
Tumsose stands unmoved at a roaring construction site.

name: Iaser
summary: Iaser is a blue-skinned, white-haired teenage villain who hurls ice spears from the supports of a suspension bridge for the attention of heroes.

feats.scene: Iaser flips a row of cars with a wave of frozen spikes.
Iaser is clipped by an arrow and drops from the span.

name: Lleesi
summary: Lleesi is a pale-skinned, white-eyed villain who makes chilly puns and freezes things, joining a gang of cold-themed crooks to freeze a city and stealing a sports trophy.

feats.scene: Lleesi coats a harbour district in thick ice with his gang.
Lleesi is knocked out by a pursuing hero's tackle.

name: Tiaviva
summary: Tiaviva is a seafaring marauder with command over frost, crewing a mercenary ship that is boarded by sea-folk. He freezes a handful of raiders before gunfire fells him.

feats.scene: Tiaviva freezes three boarders solid on the deck.
Tiaviva stands for a moment under a hail of rounds.

name: Vieontel
summary: Vieontel is a black- and grey-haired former silent-film actress who rents rooms to a heroine and keeps her fencing skills sharp.

feats.scene: Vieontel parries a burglar's bat with an old prop foil.
Vieontel stumbles on a stair and catches the rail.

name: Sosticil
summary: Sosticil is an orange-skinned heiress turned warrior, mutated by a protester's bomb into a hulking form, who joins a team of young heroes and is slain in a distant galaxy.

feats.scene: Sosticil punches a hole through an armoured hull.
Sosticil stands against a blast that levels a hangar.

name: Cinora
summary: Cinora is an ancient white-eyed wish-granting deity, born in a child's mind and fated to coat the world in wax. He is bound to serve the girl who refuses to fight him.

feats.scene: Cinora wraps a district of a city in hardened wax in one breath.
Cinora melts and reforms after fire and blades pass through him.

name: Ronsia
summary: Ronsia is a thought-born egregore wearing a white-eyed wax body, fed by the world's dread of annihilation and channelled through a girl's wishes until a team halts him.

feats.scene: Ronsia unleashes a wave of molten wax that swallows a hillside town.
Ronsia reforms from a pool of wax after being blasted apart.

name: Llanum
summary: Llanum is a nineteenth-century seal-hunting ship's master who races a rival to remote ice-fields, wrestling with sabotage, a stowaway boy, and a damaged hull.

feats.scene: Llanum hurls a harpoon from the bow of his three-masted ship.
Llanum keeps his footing on a pitching deck in a gale.

name: Colultiu
summary: Colultiu is a black-haired, strongest member of a gang of paperboys turned heroes who grows bored with adventures and becomes a college athlete before a sinister tailor twists his fate.

feats.scene: Colultiu hurls a pigskin the length of a field.
Colultiu takes a savage beating in a swamp and still stands.

name: Rnitiu
summary: Rnitiu is a white-haired, blue-eyed gangster who commands a speedboat crew, endangers fishermen to escape, and hunts a long-buried hoard under a college campus.

feats.scene: Rnitiu rams a fishing boat with his speedboat prow.
Rnitiu clings to a wet deck as waves smash over him.

name: Serni
summary: Serni is a white-haired, ruthless sea raider who boards a small boat, holds a couple hostage in a hunt for treasure, and is dragged under by a summoned tentacled beast.

feats.scene: Serni fires a pistol into a boat's hull.
Serni is seized by a huge tentacle and survives briefly.

name: Erulleval
summary: Erulleval is a brown-haired sea thief who attacks a pleasure cruiser for the guests' jewels and is locked in a magical cage by a sorceress before the sea king can arrive.

feats.scene: Erulleval fires a pistol at the cruiser's safe door.
Erulleval shoulders a lounge door and bounces off.

name: Aullra
summary: Aullra is a blond schoolboy surfer at an academy for young heroes who flashes a dazzling grin that sears the eyes and rides a flying board.

feats.scene: Aullra flashes a blinding grin that scorches a training dummy.
Aullra crashes his board into a gym wall and walks off.
Aullra skims above the rooftops on his board.

name: Iueon
summary: Iueon is a red-haired member of a trio of junior safety patrollers, strong enough to hoist a small vehicle overhead.

feats.scene: Iueon lifts a small truck off a trapped child.
Iueon is clipped by a runaway cart and shrugs.

name: Serse
summary: Serse is a grinning android built by a villainous prankster to pilot a refuse barge spreading a laughing toxin. Its brute strength and metal frame easily overpower a masked hero until a car crusher ends it.

feats.scene: Serse hurls a masked hero through a wall of the barge cabin.
Serse takes a heavy truck impact and keeps walking.

name: Naurau
summary: Naurau is a smuggler of frost weaponry who sells chilled ammunition to dockside crews. Entire harbours glaze white after one of its deals goes wrong, and rivals keep trying to steal the projector it carries.

feats.scene: Naurau flash-freezes a loading bay so hard that the steel doors shatter outward.
A thrown crate bounces off Naurau's padded coat without a bruise.

name: Lecorial
summary: Lecorial is a frost-pistol thief who joins a cabal of showy villains and spends his days picking fights with a famous sprinter. He sulks, schemes and shoots ice with surprising patience.

feats.scene: Lecorial coats a whole rooftop in ice to trap a pursuing runner.
He shrugs off a bar stool broken across his back.

name: Llnti
summary: Llnti is a college student who gained flight and great strength after a glowing space rock burst over a campus quad. Llnti rushes into a foreign war that stronger heroes avoid, and pays dearly for the choice.

feats.scene: Llnti punches through a tank column and flips the lead vehicle into a barracks wall.
Llnti walks out of an artillery barrage with torn clothes and no wounds.
Llnti streaks across a river valley faster than the sound of the guns.

name: Valnorsiu
summary: Valnorsiu is a masked wartime volunteer of average build who fights alongside a band of airborne heroes. Records are thin, but the mask and brisk marching voice made the figure a rallying sight for tired crews.

feats.scene: Valnorsiu kicks in a barricaded hatch with one boot.
Valnorsiu takes a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps advancing.

name: Valra
summary: Valra is a scarred young commander in a ruined timeline who rallies the last survivors into an elite flying patrol. Valra carries a lifelong dread of causing the end, and the burden shapes every order given.

feats.scene: Valra drives a blade through a collapsed bulkhead to free trapped scouts.
Valra stands up from a falling girder that flattened the cart beside him.

name: Vavena
summary: Vavena is a licensed sea raider who only attacks other raiders, carrying papers signed by three distant governments. Vavena sails a fast brig and keeps a tidy ledger of every captured prize.

feats.scene: Vavena fires a broadside that splits the mast of a rival brig.
Vavena shakes off a cutlass slash across a heavy leather coat.

name: Tilirn
summary: Tilirn is a one-handed sea bandit who dresses and swaggers like a buccaneer from centuries past. Tilirn raids freighters from a rusty boat and brags loudly about every haul.

feats.scene: Tilirn rams a patrol skiff and tears its side open.
Tilirn takes a boathook to the shoulder and laughs it off.

name: Sanos
summary: Sanos is an old-fashioned ship master who sails into puzzling disappearances and deaths with no marks on the bodies. Sanos leads through steady nerves, charts and a good ear for a lying sailor.

feats.scene: Sanos swings a belaying pin and drops a mutinous deckhand.
Sanos hangs on to a rigging line through a roaring gale.

name: Silmali
