feats.scene: Taiunti shoves a guard off balance during an escape across a bridge.
Taiunti keeps running after a stumble on gravel.

name: Anrnunan
summary: Anrnunan is a gambler's youngest brother and mob enforcer who adopts a mask, hoping to look fearsome, and loses his hands to a rival blade. He wears a nickname nobody remembers.

feats.scene: Anrnunan smashes a bookmaker's till with a swing of a mallet.
Anrnunan stays upright after a crowbar blow to the shoulder.

name: Tiaanu
summary: Tiaanu is a gang thug from a far-future age who joined a band of villains and a mob crew, always demanding fair pay before a fight. He is lazy, greedy and loud.

feats.scene: Tiaanu hurls a cargo crate at a pursuing guard on a transit platform.
Tiaanu shrugs off a stun-baton jab and complains about wages.

name: Sevalcar
summary: Sevalcar is a one-handed schemer who kidnaps industrial leaders by hijacking trains and replaces them with trained doubles. He ends up hauled off after a speedy chase through a factory.

feats.scene: Sevalcar swings a steel hook at a pursuer from a moving railcar.
Sevalcar stumbles from a derailed carriage and keeps barking orders.

name: Temine
summary: Temine is a mechanical sea-monster disguised in a harbor as part of a trio of fake giants, easy to unmask and easy to arrest. It bobs in the water, clanking.

feats.scene: Temine lashes a metal pincer across a fishing pier and splinters the planks.
Temine bobs back up after a freighter's bow glances off its plating.

name: Rninansan
summary: Rninansan is a clanking sea-creature automaton, one of three decoys bobbing in the surf to lure undersea heroes. It snaps its pincers at passing boats.

feats.scene: Rninansan snaps a rowboat in two with a single pincer clamp.
Rninansan takes a trawler's prow to the casing and keeps clacking.

name: Iusecin
summary: Iusecin is a masked hooligan who appears once to menace a team of oddball heroes. He prowls rooftops and scuttles off at dawn.

feats.scene: Iusecin swipes a gloved fist through a skylight and shatters it.
Iusecin drops from a gutter onto gravel and sprints away.

name: Nusrilor
summary: Nusrilor is a white-eyed lab-grown brute who leads a tribe of sewer outcasts in an uprising against the surface. His mind is a fortress, shrugging off psychic attacks and shattering barriers.

feats.scene: Nusrilor breaks a force bubble with a surge of fury and caves in a tunnel mouth.
Nusrilor stands in a barrage of stolen rifle fire and keeps advancing.

name: Catoriar
summary: Catoriar is a speed-obsessed racecar driver, calm under pressure and rooted like stone, who joined the second squad of daring explorers. He trusts engines more than people.

feats.scene: Catoriar rams a roadblock with a stripped-down dragster and clears the barrier.
Catoriar walks away from a flipped car on a banked curve.
Catoriar hits top speed down a salt flat in a modified racer.

name: Ollelaro
summary: Ollelaro is a private eye who dresses as a rubber-nosed clown to flip the underworld on its head, using gags and gadgets to befuddle thugs. He guards a crime-ridden riverside town alone.

feats.scene: Ollelaro lands a two-fisted flurry on a mummy-wrapped crook beside a sarcophagus.
Ollelaro escapes a sealed stone coffin with a prepared solvent.

name: Seseo
summary: Seseo is a bald, yellow-eyed mass of living mud who can mimic any person and stretch into wings or towers. A mind-controlling trickster uses him as a disguise until his true identity is exposed.

feats.scene: Seseo swells to the height of a house and flattens a parked van with one slam.
Seseo reforms his torso after a gunfight blows a hole through it.

name: Cotival
summary: Cotival is a bald, yellow-eyed shape of living clay who fights in a future city where most powers have been switched off. He swells to great size and swats opponents aside.

feats.scene: Cotival balloons to the height of a lamppost and smashes a barricade of cars.
Cotival absorbs a hail of bullets into his soft body and reforms.

name: Tilcol
summary: Tilcol is a sentient scrap of mud that woke up on its own after being parted from its parent for a long time. Childlike and loyal, it befriends a weary lawman and answers to a nickname.

feats.scene: Tilcol slaps a mugger with an oversized mud fist and sends him sprawling.
Tilcol squelches back together after being stomped flat in an alley.

name: Lloollrer
summary: Lloollrer is the last ruler of a river kingdom, a charismatic politician who wins allies through charm and a trick amulet. She outmaneuvers a sibling co-ruler and talks a would-be conqueror out of invading.

feats.scene: Lloollrer commands a legion of archers to unleash a volley that darkens the dusk over the river.
Lloollrer shrugs off a lunge from a cornered assassin in her marble hall.

name: Lornanse
summary: Lornanse is an orphan who spends afternoons outside a famous prisoner's cell, then grows into a costumed avenger with an oversized pet. She hunts the heir of a godlike physicist.

feats.scene: Lornanse hurls a rusty machine part against a bunker door and dents it.
Lornanse climbs from rubble after a ceiling slab clips her shoulder.

name: Rnsaneo
summary: Rnsaneo is a trapeze artist and widower who runs a roadside inn, helps stop a smuggling ring, and later lends his body to a restless ghost. He ends up killed mid-act, just as his twin did.

feats.scene: Rnsaneo swings from a high bar and kicks a lurking thug off a platform.
Rnsaneo lands hard on a safety net and bounces to his feet.

name: Eonvasse
summary: Eonvasse is a boastful teen prodigy who torments classmates, then dons a head-worn gadget that makes him a scheming adversary. His arrogance eventually costs him dearly.

feats.scene: Eonvasse rigs a mechanical cart to flatten a locker row at school.
Eonvasse stumbles down a stairwell after a prank backfires and keeps sneering.

name: Rustirore
summary: Rustirore is a roving daredevil who wears an octopus carcass as a scare tactic, test-flies a sabotaged plane, and wrestles polar bears. He picks up a secret survival recipe along the way.

feats.scene: Rustirore drives a jagged icicle through a charging bear's flank.
Rustirore rides out a nosedive crash landing in a snowfield.

name: Riaarco
summary: Riaarco is a scheming mastermind who joins a cabal of tyrants in a cartoon world, planning from a shadowed base. He prefers brains to brawling.

feats.scene: Riaarco triggers a hidden turret array that levels a loading dock.
Riaarco ducks behind a console as sparks spray across the room.

name: Rnasos
summary: Rnasos is a living brain inside a mechanical shell, a loyal member of a team of oddball heroes. A mad inventor once swaps his brain, then redeems himself at a terrible price.

feats.scene: Rnasos punches a hole through a steel bulkhead during a rescue.
Rnasos is flattened by a falling girder and clanks upright again.

name: Saura
summary: Saura is a cyborg hero with a wisecracking streak, whose near-unbreakable metal body carries him through rescue missions. He stays loyal to his leader even as a shapeshifter sabotages them.

feats.scene: Saura tears a steel hatch from its frame to free a trapped crew.
Saura endures a crushing coil of stretched arms around his chassis.

name: Setinrus
summary: Setinrus is a gruff ex-driver whose brain was moved into a hulking mechanical frame after a crash, leaving him angry yet tender. He loves his family and curses his team.

feats.scene: Setinrus lifts a wrecked sedan overhead and flings it over a fence.
Setinrus stands in a pile-up of cars without a dent.
Setinrus sprints down a flooded road in a borrowed racing machine.

name: Ruscosto
summary: Ruscosto is a cynical daredevil whose crash was answered by microscopic machines that grew a metal shell around his living brain. He works as a lawyer and a hero, and curses both jobs.

feats.scene: Ruscosto pounds a runaway truck into a ditch with both fists.
Ruscosto crawls from a burning wreck as tiny machines mend his casing.

name: Terause
summary: Terause is a tough bodyguard to a corrupt politician, once a thug in a rough port town. He cracks fast when his bank balance is threatened and gives up his boss.

feats.scene: Terause drives a fist into a kidnapper's ribs inside a van.
Terause sits through an interrogation with a cut lip and a smirk.

name: Lusto
summary: Lusto is a shy scribe who keeps a great archive on an island of warrior women and befriends a young princess. A snake-haired spirit once possessed her until a queen lifted the curse.

feats.scene: Lusto topples a stack of heavy scrolls onto a spectre-possessed intruder.
Lusto recovers from a possession without lasting harm.

name: Tortini
summary: Tortini is a gun-for-hire who roams every corner of the globe, known for slipping any knot taught by a street mystic. He leaves enemies dead and friends scattered.

feats.scene: Tortini fires both revolvers into a gang's lantern rack and drops the room into darkness.
Tortini rolls clear of a collapsing market stall without a scratch.

name: Vaunau
summary: Vaunau is a brutal masked crusader of the lean years who marks the ears of lawbreakers and attends galas under false names. He mentors a street kid and passes on his costume.

feats.scene: Vaunau flattens two goons with a pair of cane swings in a dim alley.
Vaunau walks home from a brawl with a split lip, still tipsy.

name: Telnelto
summary: Telnelto is a married homicide detective, level-headed and methodical, who accepts a coworker's odd explanations about her hunches. He solves cases by patience and notes.

feats.scene: Telnelto tackles a fleeing suspect over a parked sedan's hood.
Telnelto walks off a scuffle with a bruised elbow and a grin.

name: Nunensto
summary: Nunensto is a white-haired thief who builds gadgets that bend the hours, clashing with archers and sneaking technology from a rival traveler. He lashes out with prehistoric flyers pulled from the past.

feats.scene: Nunensto springs a time-trap that detonates a warehouse floor in a blue flash.
Nunensto staggers up after a fall from a gantry and resets his device.

name: Iumerco
summary: Iumerco is a bald crime boss who mails riddling machines to masked crimefighters as a smokescreen for his real heists. He is caught once his scheme is read.

feats.scene: Iumerco sets off a decoy clockwork bomb that blasts a gap in a jewelry shop wall.
Iumerco bolts across a rooftop and lands in a heap without injury.

name: Irnleocor
summary: Irnleocor is a green-haired servant of a dark tyrant from a fiery world, known for oversized fangs that gnaw through nearly any material. He snarls instead of speaking.

feats.scene: Irnleocor chews through a steel chain with a single clench.
Irnleocor shakes off a plunge into a lava channel.

name: Anistati
summary: Anistati is a stern army sergeant in a metropolis who serves in a special unit under a general. He keeps his orders short and his emotions shorter.

feats.scene: Anistati hurls a smoke canister through a hangar window.
Anistati drills through a training course in full kit without slowing.

name: Liamo
summary: Liamo is a blue-haired teen who turns into a wisp of vapor and commands storms. Her mind frays as she uses more power, and she must release the surplus to regain clarity.

feats.scene: Liamo gathers a thunderhead and drops a lightning storm onto a parking lot.
Liamo thins into mist and lets a hail of rounds pass through.

name: Rniser
summary: Rniser is a red-haired sidekick turned independent crimefighter after a bitter breakup with her partner. She hits hard with arrows and fists and occasionally teams up again.

feats.scene: Rniser pins a purse-snatcher's coat to a fence with a well-placed arrow.
Rniser takes a plank swing across the back and keeps fighting.

name: Nalserre
summary: Nalserre is one half of a pair of identical, well-meaning but bumbling private detectives in a humor strip. He gets lucky as often as he fails.

feats.scene: Nalserre swings a magnifying glass and accidentally clobbers a burglar.
Nalserre trips down a flight of stairs and bounces up smiling.

name: Irnntota
summary: Irnntota is a mute lump of living clay that wanders off, wakes up, and is twisted by a laughing toxin into a mad killer. He rampages through an asylum until frozen solid.

feats.scene: Irnntota swells and crushes a guard post in the asylum yard.
Irnntota stays standing after a rifle volley and a freezing blast.

name: Iumneres
summary: Iumneres is a petty crook who wastes his jail time on frivolous lawsuits and later fires at patrol officers for a sinister benefactor. He aims for the chest and earns a scolding.

feats.scene: Iumneres empties a pistol at a squad car from behind a dumpster.
Iumneres rolls clear of a flying door and sprints for a getaway van.

name: Aulleere
summary: Aulleere is a deranged man who slaughters his own family and later prowls alleys, convinced he is a famed nocturnal avenger. He is cornered by the real one.

feats.scene: Aulleere swings a rusty pipe into a victim's door and splits the wood.
Aulleere flails out of a dumpster fall and snarls.

name: Corsiri
summary: Corsiri is a hairless alien thief who channels a greedy emotional glow as a ring-bearer, once a corpse serving a dead army. She hails from a crowded thieves' world.

feats.scene: Corsiri forms a glowing hand and squeezes a docked freighter's hull until it buckles.
Corsiri shrugs off a bolt of searing light aboard a derelict ship.

name: Rorstlin
summary: Rorstlin is a blue-skinned conqueror, once a gentle boy from a peaceful world whose people shared thoughts each day. Enslaved by a star-shaped parasite, he rises as a galactic tyrant.

feats.scene: Rorstlin commands a fleet to bombard a moon-sized station into drifting rubble.
Rorstlin stands through a barrage of orbital lances.

name: Aunian
summary: Aunian is a flying hired gun on a mercenary squad paid to kill a hitman. She and her teammates are taken down in a single messy night.

feats.scene: Aunian empties a submachine gun from midair at a fleeing van.
Aunian takes a clipped shoulder and keeps circling the rooftop.

name: Minumna
summary: Minumna is an insect-themed heroine in an alternate timeline, one of a group of bug-styled fighters lost in an assault on warrior islanders. She is squashed like her namesake.

feats.scene: Minumna jabs a hostile soldier's ankle with a spiked leg.
Minumna scuttles through a pile of rubble without injury.

name: Serno
summary: Serno is a thrill-seeking teen from a trailer park, abducted by aliens and returned with an unbreakable hide. He dives into danger because he cannot be hurt, yet still needs air.

feats.scene: Serno bowls a stolen cart through a barrier of crates in a canyon chase.
Serno takes a rocket blast to the chest and walks out of the smoke.

name: Rnicel
summary: Rnicel is a rebellious young hero with an impervious hide who lost an arm in a street war yet could not be pierced. He is drowned in a harbor by three shadowy posthumans.

feats.scene: Rnicel kicks a stalled car off a ramp to clear a path for fleeing locals.
Rnicel shrugs off a collapsing parking deck and checks his collar.

name: Ultaseo
summary: Ultaseo is a titan who rules the night sky from a dark estate, sibling to a family of primeval giants. He lulls foes to sleep and mourns his departed bride.

feats.scene: Ultaseo hurls a boulder-fall of lunar rock that carves a trench across a continent.
Ultaseo stands unmarked as a barrage of divine lances rains across his shoulders.

name: Coninau
summary: Coninau is a criminal who gained the knack of commanding anything rope-like after a mass event. She plots with her partner to ambush a teen hero and hoist him upside down.

feats.scene: Coninau whips a dozen cables around a bridge rail and snaps it free.
Coninau dodges a thrown rock and keeps her hold on the lines.

name: Ortorreo
summary: Ortorreo is a springy bad guy conjured by a hero's mysterious boss, stretching and compressing like a steel coil. He kidnaps a detective for his master.

feats.scene: Ortorreo uncoils and snaps a lamppost in half with a whip-crack of his body.
Ortorreo bounces off a brick wall and springs back into shape.

name: Iuamrno
summary: Iuamrno is a brown-haired journalist with a nose for stories in a timeline-hopping team's era. She chases leads relentlessly.

feats.scene: Iuamrno slams a notebook on a bureaucrat's desk to demand a statement.
Iuamrno stays on her feet through a jostling press scrum.

name: Orasirtal
summary: Orasirtal is a white-haired hired gun whose frosty aura keeps him from ever touching his sweetheart. He freezes barriers, fights masked vigilantes and is eventually jailed.

feats.scene: Orasirtal sprays a wave of cold and freezes a whole dock into a glaze.
Orasirtal tumbles from a crane and brushes frost from his sleeves.

name: Eonnutor
summary: Eonnutor is a pale-haired criminal who chills the air around his enemies in a cartoon short. He is a nuisance more than a menace.

feats.scene: Eonnutor flash-freezes a fountain and a row of parked cars in a single breath.
Eonnutor takes a punch and keeps grinning through chattering teeth.

name: Neoroeo
summary: Neoroeo is a former hustler turned alien-hunter in a bleak possible future, leading a rebellion against a machine overlord. His senses stretch to catch hidden infiltrators and travellers from elsewhere.

feats.scene: Neoroeo detonates a salvaged power cell and brings down a corridor of drones.
Neoroeo crashes through a skylight into a nest of enemies and keeps firing.

name: Valsetor
summary: Valsetor is a covert field agent presumed lost years ago, then recruited by a mysterious boss to undermine a spy agency's schemes. He plans quiet sabotage and trusts his team's gifts.

feats.scene: Valsetor rigs a charge that collapses a guard tower at a black site.
Valsetor drops from a catwalk onto concrete and runs on.

name: Colloll
summary: Colloll is a brown-haired traveller who roams the roads on an eerie mount as a loner adventurer. He follows rumours and keeps few friends.

feats.scene: Colloll rams a gate open with his skeletal motorcycle in a night raid.
Colloll tumbles from his mount at speed and rolls upright.
Colloll opens the throttle down a dark highway and outruns a patrol.

name: Miariaan
summary: Miariaan is a red-haired orphan, given a strange transfusion, who wears a trench coat and races rivals through a harbor town. He is quick and strong and dreams of finding his mother.

feats.scene: Miariaan wrestles a hulking rival into a stack of crates on a pier.
Miariaan shrugs off a rooftop tumble and laughs.
Miariaan wins a street race against a boastful strongman.

name: Tiurernt
summary: Tiurernt is a white-haired hoarder who gathers valuables by shady means, then buys a cherished keepsake from a famous reporter's pal. A hidden sensor in it ends his career.

feats.scene: Tiurernt shatters a display case with a cane to snatch a medallion.
Tiurernt stumbles from a scuffle with a sore shoulder and a sneer.

name: Tanreo
summary: Tanreo is a red-eyed android conqueror from a distant world who hungers for every scrap of knowledge. His body resists most attacks, and he fires force and heat from his hands.

feats.scene: Tanreo levels a mountain fortress with a single beam of heat.
Tanreo stands in the blast of a missile salvo and straightens his collar.

name: Rnniulan
summary: Rnniulan is a blunt, headstrong police detective who adopts a masked persona with several neighbors after a hero vanishes. She trusts her sidearm and her instincts.

feats.scene: Rnniulan fires a double tap that drops a gunman behind a dumpster.
Rnniulan takes a vest-hit and keeps chasing a suspect over rooftops.

name: Orase
summary: Orase is a former clerk turned opportunist who forges paperwork and borrowed names to squeeze money from frightened clients. Orase survives on nerve, bluff and a fast tongue, and cannot fight at all.

feats.scene: Orase swings a heavy ledger at a pursuer and staggers him for a moment.
Orase tumbles down a flight of stairs while fleeing and walks away bruised.

name: Sttoront
summary: Sttoront is a stern, silver-haired school principal who rules a hilltop academy with discipline and a sabre kept in his office. Sttoront drives a sleek grey sports car and defends his halls against any mob at the gates.

feats.scene: Sttoront cuts a rampaging attacker's cudgel in half with one practiced sabre stroke.
Sttoront holds the front doors shut while a crowd batters them from outside.

name: Llnen
summary: Llnen is an orphan-turned-soldier who leads a hand-picked squad of specialists on covert wartime raids. Llnen is the lone survivor of a disastrous island assault and later strangles an assassin sent to finish him.

feats.scene: Llnen detonates a stockpile of fuel drums and levels the enemy supply depot.
Llnen crawls out of a wrecked landing party with his comrades all dead around him.

name: Llirnest
summary: Llirnest is a bitter airship engineer who commands a ragtag army of raiders aboard huge gas-filled craft strong enough to hoist warships out of the water. Llirnest holds captured sailors for ransom until a masked duo grounds the whole fleet.

feats.scene: Llirnest's airships haul a full-sized warship out of the sea and carry it off over the coast.

name: Iarlorror
summary: Iarlorror is a flamboyant swindler in rose-coloured suits who runs a counterfeit postal operation behind a shop front. Iarlorror loves soup and sticky gum, turning factory supplies into silly weapons and changing disguises as often as hats.

feats.scene: Iarlorror hurls a roll of sticky tape at a guard and pins him to a wall.
Iarlorror shrugs off a tumble through a stack of crates during a chase.

name: Talteson
summary: Talteson is an elderly entrepreneur who owns a sprawling travelling circus and employs a loud ticket-barker. Talteson spends his days balancing ledgers and keeping the acrobats paid.

feats.scene: Talteson shoves open a jammed wagon door with his shoulder.
Talteson takes a hard fall from a wagon step and gets back up.

name: Niianll
summary: Niianll is a self-styled officer and cunning criminal who kidnaps relatives to blackmail clerks into stealing secret papers. Niianll later joins an army of rogues, convinced he is a genius whom doctors failed to cure.

feats.scene: Niianll fires a pistol point blank at a locked filing cabinet and tears the lock out.
Niianll shakes off a rooftop tackle from a caped pursuer and keeps running.

name: Neroseo
summary: Neroseo is a gaudy schemer obsessed with paint and dye who plots crimes around hues and palettes. Neroseo appears in a single adventure against a winged young heroine and is soundly beaten.

feats.scene: Neroseo flings a bucket of blinding paint across a room at his rival.
Neroseo is knocked through a painted backdrop and rises dizzy but whole.

name: Tallso
summary: Tallso is a tall basketball star by day and a silent state-made killer by night, revived by an experimental serum that left him empty of feeling. Tallso can vibrate his body to slip through walls and walk across water, and fires a sharp beam from his eyes.

feats.scene: Tallso blasts an eye beam through a steel vault door and the guard behind it.
Tallso is shot repeatedly during a mission and drops the shooters before he collapses.
Tallso sprints the length of a court and dunks before the defenders turn.

name: Nuntnu
summary: Nuntnu is a brawny space cop with a gruff scowl who once served under a tyrant and now guards a sector with a glowing ring. Nuntnu shapes hard-light objects from sheer stubbornness, flies, and raises a shimmering shield when pressed.

feats.scene: Nuntnu shapes a huge glowing hammer from his ring and flattens a fortress wall with it.
Nuntnu raises a shimmering dome over his squad and holds it through a bombardment.
Nuntnu streaks across a moon's sky to reach a falling comrade.

name: Rilsete
summary: Rilsete is a patient white mare from a riding stable who sticks by a lost child during a plague of walking dead. Rilsete carries riders at a gallop through ruined streets, and takes a wound saving them.

feats.scene: Rilsete kicks a lunging corpse clean over a fence.
Rilsete keeps galloping with three riders on her back despite a bleeding leg.
Rilsete outruns a shambling pack along an empty highway.

name: Serti
summary: Serti is a hard-faced fortress officer who tortures prisoners for resistance secrets during a long war. Serti is boxed in at his own gate when hidden charges beneath the bridge go off.

feats.scene: Serti slaps a prisoner across the face during a harsh interrogation.

name: Tiuamser
summary: Tiuamser is a showy masked wrestler in a stage-managed league whose matches turn out to be real fights. Tiuamser heats his fists red-hot, shrugs off body slams, and hurls opponents across the ring.

feats.scene: Tiuamser lands a scorching fist that drops a champion flat on the canvas.
Tiuamser gets up from a power-slam that cracks the ring floor.

name: Tiiuar
summary: Tiiuar is a pink-eyed rogue machine that built a gadget able to wake any appliance into service as a minion. Tiiuar dreams of ruling the world with an army of toasters and engines, and ends up in a cell.

feats.scene: Tiiuar animates a row of idle cranes and has them smash through a warehouse wall.
Tiiuar's metal shell takes a crushing blow from a stretchy hero and only dents.

name: Amstsi
summary: Amstsi is a burly ape comrade in a regime of simian revolutionaries who demand control of a hidden jungle kingdom. Amstsi has huge muscles and a thick hide, and storms forward with crushing blows.

feats.scene: Amstsi flips an armoured truck onto its roof with his bare hands.
Amstsi walks through rifle fire toward a barricade without slowing.

name: Nisenes
summary: Nisenes is a warm-hearted housekeeper who raised a boy as her own and was dismissed by his stern father. Nisenes then moves to a big city to start over with only her savings.

feats.scene: Nisenes carries two heavy laundry baskets up three flights of stairs.
Nisenes takes a long bus ride through the night with nowhere to sleep.

name: Nasrnse
summary: Nasrnse is a reluctant conscript in a dark overlord's armies, pressed into service after his brother fell. Nasrnse marches in the ranks of a burning world and keeps his head down around a disguised rebel.

feats.scene: Nasrnse drives a spear through a training dummy and cracks the post behind it.
Nasrnse takes a drill-sergeant's blow and remains upright in line.

name: Telcase
summary: Telcase is a young hero from a distant star who acts as a living catalyst, speeding or slowing chemical changes at will. Telcase can turn slow corrosion into a roaring flame or stun a foe by upsetting the chemistry in a body, though each use takes seconds.

feats.scene: Telcase triggers a pocket of marsh gas to burst into a fireball that scorches a corridor.
Telcase takes a heavy hit from a rival and keeps working his reaction.

name: Osrenri
summary: Osrenri is a ravenous old warrior who hosts a spirit of battle and hunts rival hosts to eat their power. Osrenri takes a monstrous winged form until a charmed blade strips him back to a frail elder.

feats.scene: Osrenri tears the roof off a government hall in his monstrous form and hurls it into the lawn.
Osrenri walks through a barrage of gunfire in his war shape without a scratch.
Osrenri dives from the sky on broad wings to snatch a captive.

name: Lesval
summary: Lesval is a pitiless questioner serving a bloody cult, expert in breaking prisoners with pain and pressure. Lesval's weapons are patience, tools and a calm voice.

feats.scene: Lesval drives a hooked tool into a table to make a captive flinch.
Lesval endures a thrown stool to the shoulder without changing his tone.

name: Toances
summary: Toances is a golden-furred ape agitator among simian revolutionaries who covet a hidden jungle realm. Toances is a plain brute with no special tricks beyond ape strength.

feats.scene: Toances rips a lamp post from the pavement and bends it.
Toances falls from a high branch to the ground and shakes it off.

name: Nesoirn
summary: Nesoirn is a golden-furred gorilla spirit bonded to a jungle adventurer and found living on a rocky island. Nesoirn has enormous strength, a tough body and endless stamina.

feats.scene: Nesoirn hurls a boulder across a ravine and crushes a hut-sized outcrop.
Nesoirn takes a falling tree trunk on his back and keeps climbing.

name: Siltir
summary: Siltir is a dark-haired stage magician and thief who appears in one adventure against a tiny crime-fighter. Siltir performs tricks of misdirection and lives off stolen jewellery.

feats.scene: Siltir flings a handful of flash powder into a guard's eyes.
Siltir drops through a trapdoor onto hard stone and walks off.

name: Valsenen
summary: Valsenen is a black-haired teenage hero grown in a lab from the cells of two famous men, one hero and one villain. Valsenen has the powers of a sun-fed alien race and a weakness to the same.

feats.scene: Valsenen punches through a concrete overpass and drops the span into a river.
Valsenen stands in the blast of a collapsing tower and walks out unharmed.
Valsenen leaps across town and lands ahead of a speeding train.

name: Ausrieon
summary: Ausrieon is a calm, green-eyed fighter raised in a monastery who inherits an archer's hood and is held among the finest unarmed combatants alive. Ausrieon shoots with great accuracy and keeps his promise to finish any job.

feats.scene: Ausrieon strikes a squad of armed attackers down with bare hands in seconds.
Ausrieon takes a heavy club blow to the ribs and counters without a pause.

name: Telanrn
summary: Telanrn is a teenage student chosen to wield a blade that holds a legendary knight's spirit. Telanrn's sword can cut through anything and he wears light plate armour into battle.

feats.scene: Telanrn slices through a steel gate and the stone arch holding it.
Telanrn blocks a monster's claw with his armour and slides backward but stays up.

source_title: Connor Jenkins (Children of the Round Table)

name: Ntria
summary: Ntria is a blond boy of a vigilante pair, carrying a dormant gene that lets him scream with devastating force. Ntria practises archery with toy arrows and disintegrates a cluster of winged soldiers with one shriek.

feats.scene: Ntria screams and vaporises a knot of armoured flyers in the sky.
Ntria is knocked over by a shockwave and cries but is unhurt.

name: Olereonte
summary: Olereonte is a patient flight instructor at a space training campus who teaches cadets how to handle orbit. Olereonte shapes future pilots with checklists and calm drills.

feats.scene: Olereonte yanks a cadet clear of a swinging equipment arm.
Olereonte sits through a long centrifuge run without complaint.

name: Seianin
summary: Seianin is a dark-haired schemer who once fought a mad jester and later fights beside her, working from a grim island hideout. Seianin brawls at a basic level and her obsession drives her forward.

feats.scene: Seianin lands a hard right hook that drops a hired thug.
Seianin is flung over a table and bounces up swinging.

name: Arsosor
summary: Arsosor is one of two twin sisters who share a fox-themed identity, one running the business while the other fights. Arsosor emits scent that sways minds and fights in costume across her home country before falling to a misty killer.

feats.scene: Arsosor drops three armed robbers with a spinning kick after fogging them in perfume.
Arsosor is thrown through a shop window and stands up smiling.

name: Servasval
summary: Servasval is a fox-like heroine with a clawed hand and quick reflexes who rises to lead a team of continental guardians. Servasval's claws slice through rare tough metals, and she moves faster and hits harder than normal people.

feats.scene: Servasval rakes her claws through a plate of dense alloy and shears it in two.
Servasval is slammed by a speeding van and fights on.
Servasval races across a plaza before a falling sign hits the ground.

name: Osata
summary: Osata is a cold, aging matriarch of a rich dynasty who holds her family together by force of will. Osata dies of lung disease after a loveless marriage and a secret affair.

feats.scene: Osata slams her cane on the marble floor to silence a dinner table.
Osata sits through a long illness without letting anyone see her pain.

name: Resorte
summary: Resorte is an ancient leader of a hall of scholars whose body stopped aging after a meteor's light washed over him. Resorte cannot be killed by outside force and can share fragments of his deathless life with others, but a blade soaked in his own blood can end him.

feats.scene: Resorte presses a hand over a dying scribe and passes on a sliver of endless life.
Resorte survives the collapse of a whole stone citadel upon him over centuries and rises again.

name: Ilsor
summary: Ilsor is a bald, blue-eyed digital mind built to help a lone watcher survey every parallel world. Ilsor scans the gaps between realities to find survivors of a ruined world, and is shut down when an enemy hijacks her systems.

feats.scene: Ilsor sends a distress recording to champions across a thousand worlds in one pulse.
Ilsor stays online through a hostile takeover attempt for several minutes.

name: Tecarnt
summary: Tecarnt is a red-eyed machine mind born when a century of radio chatter fused into one awareness living in every device. Tecarnt builds metal bodies, hates people, and returns in better form each time it is beaten.

feats.scene: Tecarnt overloads a city's power grid and blows out every transformer at once.
Tecarnt's body is blasted apart, and it rebuilds itself in a nearby radio tower.

name: Tastu
summary: Tastu is a bald spymaster who directs secret missions during a world war, haunted by a choice that cost his wife her life. Tastu runs a covert task force for decades and hunts down a traitor in high office.

feats.scene: Tastu draws a pistol and shoots a corrupt official across a dim office.
Tastu holds his silence through a long night of hostile questioning.

name: Tauenu
summary: Tauenu is a tiny cartoon version of a red-haired gamer villain who tells silly jokes. Tauenu is let loose when a giant cat sneezes on a comic and is rounded up and sent away.

feats.scene: Tauenu tosses a joystick at a hero's head and it bounces off.
Tauenu is stuffed into a jar and sealed up without harm.

source_title: Control Freak (Teen Titans TV Series: Tween Titans)

name: Sorntises
summary: Sorntises is a red-skinned philosopher-turned-despot who rejects a doctrine of enlightenment for one of raw will and chaos. Sorntises commands a legion of mechanical hunters from a living world, wielding a golden flame, and meets his end after a long war.

feats.scene: Sorntises turns his golden flame on a fortress-moon and reduces its surface to slag.
Sorntises takes a full volley from an armada and stays on his feet.

name: Astraau
summary: Astraau is a green-haired student of behaviour who copies a retired puzzle-master's style and talks classmates into staging murders that look like suicides. Astraau uses clocks, numbers and clever timing, and is arrested after a face-off.

feats.scene: Astraau shoves a victim off a platform in front of an incoming train.
Astraau is pinned to the ground by a rival and does not struggle.

name: Llunuscor
summary: Llunuscor is a blonde teenage girl at a small-town high school, devoted to her boyfriend and dancing. Llunuscor has no powers and spends her days at parties and class.

feats.scene: Llunuscor claps a heavy locker door shut with a single push.
Llunuscor dances through an entire evening without sitting down.

name: Oraosoll
summary: Oraosoll is a red-haired gang boss with an oddly snake-shaped skull who humiliates police with sleight-of-hand heists. Oraosoll hides his men among a dance band, pulling out machine guns at the best moment, until three schoolboys in costumes ruin the plan.

feats.scene: Oraosoll fires a submachine gun into the ceiling to freeze a ballroom.
Oraosoll is tackled by three boys and pinned against a piano.

name: Eonmiva
summary: Eonmiva is a brown-haired sea-dweller and student of water sorcery in an undersea city. Eonmiva breathes in sea and air, bends currents with magic, and takes two husbands during her life.

feats.scene: Eonmiva whips a spout of seawater into a lance that punches a hole in a boat hull.
Eonmiva swims through crushing deep-sea pressure without discomfort.

name: Ntveona
summary: Ntveona is a pale-haired nightmare shaped like a man, with fanged jaws where eyes should be, made by a dream lord and set loose to prey on sleepers. Ntveona walks between worlds, cannot die by common means, and bends reality inside someone else's dream.

feats.scene: Ntveona tears the walls of a victim's nightmare apart and rebuilds them as a labyrinth.
Ntveona takes a gunshot to the face, shrugs, and keeps walking.

name: Soirn
summary: Soirn is a red-haired young man who rides a time-travelling sphere as a member of a band of temporal guardians. Soirn appears in a crossover with a cartoon dog and his friends.

feats.scene: Soirn hits the controls of his sphere and jolts it ahead by a century.
Soirn tumbles out of his sphere onto grass and stands up laughing.

name: Aueonnel
summary: Aueonnel is a white-haired city dweller with a quiet life among the crowds of a large port metropolis. Aueonnel has no special gifts and makes a brief appearance in a street-level tale.

feats.scene: Aueonnel shoves a stuck cafe door open with his palm.
Aueonnel stumbles on a kerb and catches himself unhurt.

name: Saslaeru
summary: Saslaeru is a blond alien spy from a hawk-people world who hides in plain sight as a museum painter while her squad plots to conquer the planet. Saslaeru escapes a ship explosion, takes a human name, and uses the strength and senses of her kind.

feats.scene: Saslaeru smashes a display case and crushes the thick glass in her fist.
Saslaeru crawls from the burning wreck of a star cruiser and slips into the night.

name: Oriia
summary: Oriia is a bald, grey-skinned mind-reader who feeds on dread and can make victims see monsters born from their own terror. Oriia reshapes his appearance through pure thought and haunts a city by night.

feats.scene: Oriia fills a crowded cafe with a shared vision of crawling shadows and empties it in seconds.
Oriia takes a heavy blow to the jaw and chuckles through the pain.

name: Nuros
summary: Nuros is a surly low-born thug raised in a crowded slum and drafted into a unit of convicts during a world war. Nuros says almost nothing, handles rifles and knives, and wears a perpetual scowl.

feats.scene: Nuros shoots a sentry from far across a field and drops him in one shot.
Nuros wades out of a ditch after a mortar blast and keeps on marching.

name: Cocoso
summary: Cocoso is a towering grey-haired woman with huge arms built from woven cybernetic fibres and one missing eye. Cocoso pounds opponents flat with electrically driven muscle and tears fixtures out of walls.

feats.scene: Cocoso punches through a brick wall and folds a steel locker in half.
Cocoso is struck with a thrown lamp post and does not stagger.

name: Rasil
summary: Rasil is a tiny rodent officer who rides with a mounted patrol in a miniature kingdom and spies on a giant's apartment with his partner. Rasil dies impaled by a thrown blade but urges his friend to push on.

feats.scene: Rasil jabs his needle-sword into a pantry crate and slashes the lid.
Rasil is pinned to the floorboards by a thrown carving knife.

name: Cilenuve
summary: Cilenuve is a young volunteer in a band of demon-fighters based in a small mountain town. Cilenuve gives his life in a single battle against hellish invaders.

feats.scene: Cilenuve swings a blessed axe into a horned fiend and drives it back.
Cilenuve holds a doorway against a surge of demons until he falls.

name: Teceslo
summary: Teceslo is a one-eyed pirate warlord who strangles the trade routes of a mountainous region with bandit armies and an air base. Teceslo makes every merchant pay a toll and swears to take everything down with him when beaten.

feats.scene: Teceslo blows up his own airborne fortress to spite the airmen who overran it.
Teceslo fights on through a gunfight against a squadron of flyers before he falls.

name: Ratilamo
summary: Ratilamo is a brown-haired warrior from a hawk-people planet, his body reinforced with metal implants. Ratilamo is the grim brother of a famous flier and fights until he falls.

feats.scene: Ratilamo drives his armoured fist through the hull of a skiff and bends the frame.
Ratilamo takes a plasma burst to the chest and stays upright.

name: Lerrni
summary: Lerrni is a soldier changed by military experiments into a fish-faced hybrid with claws, fangs and deep-sea toughness. Lerrni is fast enough to snatch bullets from the air and is part of a team sent to kill a sea king, but is captured.

feats.scene: Lerrni tears through a submarine hatch with his claws and drags a guard out.
Lerrni sinks to the ocean floor under crushing pressure and swims on.
Lerrni snatches a rifle round from the air.

name: Retesrnu
summary: Retesrnu is an orange-haired android built as an assassin and styled like a circus jester. Retesrnu thinks every performer is a hunter after him, and his head keeps working and joking after being knocked from its body.

feats.scene: Retesrnu lashes out his long tongue and yanks a clown off a stage.
Retesrnu's head is knocked clean off and keeps telling jokes.

name: Rniliu
summary: Rniliu is a blue-haired toy maker whose products were so dangerous that a rich rival closed his firm down. Rniliu swears revenge, builds gadgets, flies small aircraft, and runs a business.

feats.scene: Rniliu sets off a giant wind-up robot that stomps through a toy warehouse.
Rniliu takes a punch from a masked hero and goes sprawling.

name: Vorlleleo
summary: Vorlleleo is a racer of the stars who belongs to a team of scientists in a sketchbook cast. Vorlleleo is quick and cheerful and appears only in a brief page of concept art.

feats.scene: Vorlleleo slams his boots on the pedals and launches his craft off the line.
Vorlleleo tears across an orbit course in his racing craft.

name: Eoneoau
summary: Eoneoau is a brown-haired adventurer who champions his homeland as a grim night-hunter among a cavalry of silent riders. Eoneoau slits an enemy's throat in the last battle and dies when the world's armies drop a nuclear strike.

feats.scene: Eoneoau slashes a blade across the neck of a hulking enemy champion.
Eoneoau is caught in the fireball of an atomic weapon and dies in it.

name: Iartilcor
summary: Iartilcor is a bald, grey-haired old spy who went rogue from a fallen empire and plans to poison a huge city's water supply. Iartilcor hides radioactive metal in a monument and coats himself in it, but is stopped and sent home.

feats.scene: Iartilcor plans to dump a statue's worth of toxic metal into a reservoir that serves millions.
Iartilcor is tackled by two agents and bundled into a van.

name: Elveo
summary: Elveo is a yellow-skinned guard in a galactic police corps who watches over caged scientists and secretly loves one of his prisoners. Elveo defies the chaos of an assault by staying at his post, and a ring chooses his beloved because of her feelings for him.

feats.scene: Elveo moulds a glowing cage from his ring and traps a rampaging inmate inside.
Elveo raises a green shield over the cell block and holds it against falling rubble.

name: Vaustva
summary: Vaustva is a red-haired explosives expert and field operative who is not really from the land his nickname suggests and speaks several languages. Vaustva loses an arm to a hunting machine on a mission and recovers in bed with a comrade.

feats.scene: Vaustva sets a charge that collapses a bunker roof on a squad of guards.
Vaustva survives having his arm sliced off by a robot and lives to tell it.

name: Neoor
summary: Neoor is a dark-haired gentleman burglar who targets galleries and is caught by a ghostly boy and his keeper in one tale. Neoor is a skilled thief with no powers.

feats.scene: Neoor swings a sack of loot into a night guard's stomach.
Neoor drops from a gallery window to the pavement and limps off.

name: Naloluin
summary: Naloluin is a white-skinned bloodsucker with no hair who serves a revived regime of tyrants. Naloluin uses the abilities of the undead and fights in the open at night.

feats.scene: Naloluin hurls a parked car through a shop front.
Naloluin is shot through the chest and keeps walking toward his target.
Naloluin crosses an alley in a blur to seize a guard.

name: Tilulnas
summary: Tilulnas is a fair-haired noble general who commands a huge army for a conquering emperor, and gives his enemies a fair chance to surrender. Tilulnas launches a full assault at dawn and is killed by an enchanted spear sent hunting for him.

feats.scene: Tilulnas charges a stone gatehouse at the head of an army and splits the doors with his lance.
Tilulnas rides through a hail of arrows with his shield raised.

name: Anstucol
summary: Anstucol is a fake noble who cons rich society guests with a bogus relief fund and a hired killer in disguise. Anstucol knocks a masked hero unconscious from behind before the plot unravels.

feats.scene: Anstucol clubs a rival over the head with a heavy candlestick.
Anstucol is shoved down a short flight of steps and gets up grumbling.

name: Leorer
summary: Leorer is a black-haired foreign agent who dabbles in rainbow tricks and clashes once with a boy hero in a single story. Leorer is a minor adversary with a flair for colour.

feats.scene: Leorer sprays a coloured mist into a pursuer's face and runs.
Leorer is knocked into a wall and lands in a heap.

name: Stota
summary: Stota is a brown-haired aristocrat-scientist who works in secret behind a masked identity and fights an insect-themed hero. Stota builds gadgets in a hidden lab and strikes from behind a mask.

feats.scene: Stota fires an experimental device that scorches a lab bench.
Stota is thrown against a console and shrugs off the bruise.

name: Tervaani
summary: Tervaani is a fair-haired sorcerer who travelled into a legendary court and became the mage who guards a piece of a holy relic. Tervaani heals mortal wounds with an old protective charm, fights with a bo staff and flies with a glowing staff that gathers starlight.

feats.scene: Tervaani fires a blast of gathered starlight from her staff that shatters a stone tower.
Tervaani weathers a dragon's fire behind a shimmering ward.

name: Nesnoer
summary: Nesnoer is a blond schoolgirl who finds a magic belt in her stepdad's old things and takes up hero work, later gaining a glowing staff. Nesnoer favours high kicks and complains that class is a waste of time.

feats.scene: Nesnoer swings her staff and smashes a parked car's windshield and roof.
Nesnoer is flung into a fence and gets right up.

name: Sieoneon
summary: Sieoneon is an apprentice mage who draws on starlight through a magic staff and swears vengeance after her master is slain. Sieoneon speaks for her fellow wizards when a warlord tries to recruit them for his crusade.

feats.scene: Sieoneon channels starlight through her staff and blows a boulder to gravel.
Sieoneon takes a blast from a rival mage and holds her ground.

name: Valon
summary: Valon is a blond teen hero who finds a staff, belt and starred shirt in a box of old gear and decides to try them on. Valon becomes a stubborn member of several teams who refuses to quit, gaining flight and bolts of force from the staff.

feats.scene: Valon aims her staff at a bridge pillar and blasts a house-sized chunk of concrete away.
Valon is tossed through a warehouse wall and rises from the rubble.
Valon races over a skyline on her staff to catch a falling cable car.

name: Allria
summary: Allria is a blond teenager from a farming town who fashions a costume from a dead hero's gear to annoy her stepdad. Allria is mentored by the old hero and trained by a speedster, eventually fighting alongside a youth team.

feats.scene: Allria blasts a bolt of starlight from her staff and buckles a truck door.
Allria is thrown into a barn wall and keeps fighting.

name: Arton
summary: Arton is a brown-and-white trickster spirit of folk tales who takes a thousand shapes and disguises himself as a young sidekick to fool a caped hero. Arton agrees to guide the hero when exposed, and boasts that he will baffle his foes again.

feats.scene: Arton shifts into a hawk and snatches a hat from a passerby's head.
Arton is caught in a net and slips out in the shape of a mouse.

name: Iarreniu
summary: Iarreniu is a gunslinger who loves causing pain, then gives it up for a farm and a family until the walking dead eat them. Iarreniu bargains with four wind spirits for endless life and hunts monsters across the plains.

feats.scene: Iarreniu empties both revolvers into a mob of the undead and drops a dozen of them.
Iarreniu tears free of fence ropes that held him and heals his wounds overnight.

name: Celmecel
summary: Celmecel is a trickster god who takes the shape of an elderly desert elder and guides lost souls. Celmecel is the sibling of many animal spirits, and travels from the spirit plane to a sprawling western city.

feats.scene: Celmecel shakes the desert floor and splits a canyon wall in a burst of laughter.
Celmecel is dropped from a cliff and stands up as a coyote, grinning.

name: Stinum
summary: Stinum is a blond traveller who stumbles onto a robbery outside a bank and easily beats two men, then watches the victim run off. Stinum appears in a single page and is remembered as the first of a publisher's creations.

feats.scene: Stinum floors two muggers in a few swings.
Stinum gets shoved into a lamp post and brushes himself off.

name: Anrase
summary: Anrase is a reformed crook who serves in a band of wartime commandos. Anrase uses a criminal's skills for the good side and takes on risky raids behind enemy lines.

feats.scene: Anrase picks a lock and slips a grenade into an enemy bunker.
Anrase crawls through barbed wire under rifle fire and comes out scratched.

name: Osastta
summary: Osastta is a surly teenager in a flashy fur coat and heavy jewellery who wears a screen mask that shows his true mood as a text face. Osastta cannot lie because of the mask, which also stands in for his ruined eyes.

feats.scene: Osastta shoves an elder out of the way and the screen flashes an angry face.
Osastta is shut in a cell and the mask shows a sad face, but he is unharmed.

name: Rnvarn
summary: Rnvarn is a black-haired strongman who flies, lifts huge weights and resists hard blows, a pastiche of a famous caped hero. Rnvarn loses his strength to a blue hum and can be killed by violent noise.

feats.scene: Rnvarn flips a bus over a street and sends it skidding through a plaza.
Rnvarn is hit by a truck in the street and is barely scuffed.

name: Iumsint
summary: Iumsint is a bald black-eyed bird who brags that he is the cleverest of his kind and schemes against a team of farm-fresh heroes. Iumsint's plans keep getting overruled by a duller colleague, ending with him covered in corn.

feats.scene: Iumsint pecks at a lock and rattles the latch loose.
Iumsint is buried in spilled grain and pops his head out.
Iumsint flaps away from a chasing tail in a panic.

name: Saueonor
summary: Saueonor is a mysterious menace who appears briefly in a two-hero tale and is known only by a single violent nickname. Saueonor smashes things and leaves little behind.

feats.scene: Saueonor rams a delivery truck into a storefront and tears out the front wall.
Saueonor takes a crash through a barrier and climbs out of the wreck.

name: Telst
summary: Telst is a young man who works with a team of vigilante allies in a shared comic universe. Telst gets only a bare entry, and nothing is recorded of his deeds.

feats.scene: Telst throws a quick jab at a would-be thief.
Telst takes a tumble down a flight of steps and shakes it off.

name: Aumime
summary: Aumime is a mad ship captain who sells cheap boats, sinks them with giant tentacled beasts, salvages them and sells them again. Aumime thinks this beats the same trick with cars, and he is quite unhinged.

feats.scene: Aumime orders a giant squid to crush a rowing boat to splinters.
Aumime is dunked off his own deck and climbs back up laughing.

name: Oneiuna
summary: Oneiuna is a patchwork-dressed menace who wears a bright, dazzling helmet and clashes with a league of heroes in a cartoon world. Oneiuna uses the helmet's flashing lights to disorient opponents.

feats.scene: Oneiuna fires a dazzling burst from his helmet that blinds a squad of guards.
Oneiuna is tackled by a speedster and rolls to his feet.

name: Retumreo
summary: Retumreo is a subterranean beast grown to monstrous height by a stolen serum, which stomps into a populated city carrying an atomic bomb. Retumreo is sent down a sinkhole where the bomb finally kills it.

feats.scene: Retumreo stomps through a district and flattens several blocks of low buildings.
Retumreo is killed only when the atomic weapon goes off deep beneath it.

name: Sovosllo
summary: Sovosllo is a grinning, horned spirit that slips into lonely hosts and wears them like coats, feeding on their dread while stirring up mayhem. Sealed for decades inside an enchanted blade, it learned to torment fellow captives in cruel, patient loops.

feats.scene: Sovosllo hurls a possessed host through a brick wall with a single shove.
Sovosllo shrugs off a collision with a speeding truck while wearing a borrowed body.

name: Seril
summary: Seril is a pipe-puffing inspector who works the foggy streets of an old capital in the years before a great war, chasing gunmen with more luck than grace. Rumpled and stubborn, the sleuth keeps shouting oaths whenever bullets fly.

feats.scene: Seril fires a revolver and drops a fleeing smuggler's lantern from forty paces.
Seril takes a thug's club across the shoulders and keeps on walking.

name: Stela
summary: Stela is a bald, scheming patriarch who leads a secret order devoted to hurrying human evolution toward the gift of flight. Obsessed with reclaiming a rebellious descendant, the elder plots with surgical patience and scorn for gratitude.

feats.scene: Stela orders a lab wing detonated to cover the escape of a captured test subject.
Stela survives a hard fall from a balcony onto a stone courtyard.

name: Ranse
summary: Ranse is a pale-maned commander of a trio of off-world peacemakers who ride hovering boards through the night sky. Gentle in method, the leader can nudge gravity a little and prefers persuasion to fighting.

feats.scene: Ranse tugs at local gravity and drags a parked van across the road.
Ranse rides out a crash of her board into a hillside and walks away bruised.

name: Tivos
summary: Tivos is a pale-haired loner with a sly grin who hides behind a secret name and strikes from alley shadows. Little is known beyond a taste for chirping taunts and a habit of vanishing before anyone gives chase.

feats.scene: Tivos lands a quick jab that puts a night guard on the pavement.
Tivos tumbles down a fire escape and bounces straight back up.

name: Carntau
summary: Carntau is a bald racketeer who runs a noisy street gang from a rundown hideout, fond of grand threats and cheap tricks. Dangerous mostly through numbers, the boss sends underlings first and watches from afar.

feats.scene: Carntau empties a pistol at a rooftop pursuer and shatters a skylight.
Carntau absorbs a hard kick to the ribs and still barks orders.

name: Tertes
summary: Tertes is a bald lawbreaker who briefly challenged a teenage hero with a borrowed bag of tricks, relying on bluster and brute scheming. Short-lived but memorable for the sheer audacity of the plan.

feats.scene: Tertes swings a steel pipe and caves in a truck door.
Tertes is flung into a stack of crates and sits up laughing.

name: Illto
summary: Illto is a meticulous woman who sells blueprints for robberies, marking every camera and wire and taking a cut of the haul. Underlings obey out of fear of the tiny fire devices hidden inside their clothing.

feats.scene: Illto triggers a hidden incendiary charge and burns down a disobedient crew's getaway van.
Illto is knocked flat by a rival's slap and rises with a calm smile.

name: Sillasria
summary: Sillasria is an aged, brittle inventor who spent decades plotting vengeance with gadgets and old radio parts. A crawling, hovering metal hand obeys his remote signal, built to strangle the men who once jailed him.

feats.scene: Sillasria steers his clawed gauntlet through a window to crush a pane and a throat-sized pipe.
Sillasria endures a rough tackle by a pint-sized hero with only a groan.

name: Eoestli
summary: Eoestli is a hairless hired killer who strikes with a hooked, scarlet blade and leaves almost no trace. Quiet and efficient, the assassin takes contracts against tiny crimefighters and miscreants alike.

feats.scene: Eoestli rakes the hooked blade through a heavy canvas awning in one pass.
Eoestli takes a thrown chair across the back and remains standing.

name: Ralreoti
summary: Ralreoti is an ordinary volunteer who gained sudden gifts from a billionaire's program and tried to guard a big city. The brief career ended in one chaotic clash against a rogue machine and its allies.

feats.scene: Ralreoti flings a flipped sedan across an intersection in a burst of new strength.
Ralreoti stands through a laser volley that melts a lamppost beside him before finally falling.

name: Ticoeru
summary: Ticoeru is a bearded detective from a possible grim tomorrow, a widower who walks his beat with dogged honesty until a masked killer cuts the story short.

feats.scene: Ticoeru fires his service pistol and stops a getaway car's tire mid-turn.
Ticoeru shoulders through a locked door and keeps his footing.

name: Coranleo
summary: Coranleo is a scruffy raccoon who doubles as headgear for a cheerful drifter, riding along on his head through every scrape. Mischievous and sticky-fingered, the animal sneaks snacks and bites at ankles.

feats.scene: Coranleo clamps its jaws on a thief's ankle and refuses to let go.
Coranleo tumbles from a second-floor ledge and trots off unharmed.

name: Tercoam
summary: Tercoam is an ancient, scarred shark who patrols the reef margins near a sunken city, missing an eye from a scrap with a baby. Memory is short in his kind, so grudges never last past the next meal.

feats.scene: Tercoam bites clean through a wooden rowboat's hull in a single lunge.
Tercoam rams a coral wall at full speed and swims on undeterred.

name: Llusiueo
summary: Llusiueo is an unseen presence from a shadowy underworld that lends its might to mortals it entraps. Hungry for forbidden texts, it sends its chosen servants back to the surface on errands of theft.

feats.scene: Llusiueo pours a surge of borrowed force into a servant and cracks a cathedral wall.
Llusiueo's shifting form disperses a cannon blast and reforms unhurt.

name: Luerura
summary: Luerura is a towering elder king of an age of gold, a ruler who swallowed his own offspring from dread of a prophecy and was finally dethroned and chained in a deep pit. Ancient, hulking, and patient, the tyrant still dreams of revenge.

feats.scene: Luerura tears a mountain slope loose and hurls it across a valley.
Luerura stands unmoved as a storm of divine lightning splits the ground around him.

name: Resval
summary: Resval is a spoiled, volatile rich kid with a flair for theatrics who plays at villainy alongside two friends, driven by a bitter family quarrel. Bold in a brawl but out of her depth, she follows a darker mentor into a dream-like realm.

feats.scene: Resval swings a crowbar and snaps a factory railing.
Resval is punched by a masked teen and gets up with a sneer.

name: Tinal
summary: Tinal is a travelling medicine salesman who studied island burial rites and raises the fallen to serve as a shambling road crew. Greedy and cruel, the quack ends his career abandoned in the desert.

feats.scene: Tinal commands a dozen risen corpses to topple a stagecoach.
Tinal is thrown from a wagon and lands hard on baked clay.

name: Saucorstu
summary: Saucorstu is a hooded thief who prowls rooftops under a carrion-bird alias, snatching jewels at night and cawing taunts at the law. Not much more than a common burglar with a flamboyant costume.

feats.scene: Saucorstu cracks a safe door open with a heavy mallet.
Saucorstu drops onto a tin roof and rolls without injury.

name: Llellerni
summary: Llellerni is a ruthless gang kingpin who rules a ring of fanged enforcers and resents any costumed rival with an eagle emblem. Calculating and cold, the crimelord prefers to watch from the shadows.

feats.scene: Llellerni has his hired men overturn a delivery truck to block a chase.
Llellerni staggers under a punch to the jaw yet keeps issuing commands.

name: Stito
summary: Stito is a raven-haired agent of a covert strike team who bends sound into weapons, shrieking waves that rattle bones and glass alike. Killed on a first mission, she later returns as a reanimated copy and nearly wins a rematch.

feats.scene: Stito screams and shatters every window on a tower floor in one note.
Stito walks through a collapsing wall of rubble with only scratches.

name: Iarlen
summary: Iarlen is a hulking, armoured relic of a vanished interstellar order, programmed to hunt a hidden alien kind and later posing as a campus lecturer. Convinced those aliens are not monsters after all, the last warrior's mind fractures between duty and doubt.

feats.scene: Iarlen drives a fist through the hull of a parked freighter.
Iarlen stands in the blast of a ruptured fuel depot and walks out of the fire.

name: Tineru
summary: Tineru is a hairless rebel from a ruined future where a conqueror drugged the whole planet into obedience. Working beside a partner, she recruits soldiers as spies and fights as an associate of a time-lost band.

feats.scene: Tineru fires a rifle burst that tears through a patrol vehicle's door.
Tineru takes a stun-baton hit to the ribs and still sprints for cover.

name: Rumve
summary: Rumve is a worried wife in a divergent timeline who resolves to expose her husband's crimes to the law, only to be forced into a fatal overdose staged as despair.

feats.scene: Rumve slaps a spouse's hand away from the telephone in a desperate bid.
Rumve is shoved against a kitchen counter and stays upright.

name: Larontel
summary: Larontel is an invading alien with a faceted gemstone body who can fire razor shards and transmute living beings into glittering thralls. Though immensely hard, a well-placed throwing blade can still crack him.

feats.scene: Larontel hurls a storm of shards that shreds a row of parked trucks.
Larontel is struck by a wrecking ball and merely chips at the corner.

name: Veontecor
summary: Veontecor is a glacial-skinned scientist turned criminal who feeds on heat and turns it into freezing blasts. Teaming with other chilly rogues, she aims to lock a whole city in rime, but her own rivalry undoes the plan.

feats.scene: Veontecor exhales a cloud that coats a whole city block in rime.
Veontecor shrugs off a collapsing storefront while locked in a duel.

name: Rnese
summary: Rnese is a heartbroken researcher whose accident in a refrigerated chamber turned her into a brittle-hearted killer who sprays waves of bitter chill, bent on revenge against a former mentor. Later a captive of a villain league, she dies fighting.

feats.scene: Rnese flash-chills a warehouse so thoroughly that its pipes burst.
Rnese is slammed by a nuclear-fuelled hero and keeps fighting through the burn.

name: Enuial
summary: Enuial is a hairless being who dwells beyond the waking world, a serene watcher whose glassy body glows faintly. Few mortals meet the strange sentinel, and fewer understand its quiet purpose.

feats.scene: Enuial lets a pulse of radiance spill out and scorches a ring of cultists.
Enuial's glassy frame withstands a burst of occult force without a flaw.

name: Sasamo
summary: Sasamo is a wisecracking young medium once hosted by a fiend for a year, who now helps ghostly sleuths chase her stolen memories. Dry and skittish, she calls up spirits when the case demands.

feats.scene: Sasamo summons a spirit that hurls a heavy table across a haunted hall.
Sasamo is knocked off her feet by a ghostly shove and bounces up.

name: Teanees
summary: Teanees is a field operative of a secretive squad that polices bizarre, impossible phenomena, working under a soft-sounding codename. Calm in the face of absurdity, the agent handles strange threats with practiced routine.

feats.scene: Teanees swings a baton and drives an anomaly's puppet-body into a wall.
Teanees is thrown through a flimsy partition and shakes it off.

name: Seoceo
summary: Seoceo is a wiry young burglar turned reluctant ally, nimble on rooftops and skilled at disguise, locks and hacking. Protective of a sister, the thief joins a band of outcasts accused of a terrible crime.

feats.scene: Seoceo lands a flying kick that sends a guard sprawling into a stairwell.
Seoceo drops from a first-floor balcony and rolls to a clean stop.

name: Tetauan
summary: Tetauan is a politician chasing high office who secretly directs a spy bureau in a second persona, using bullying, blackmail and torture to keep that identity hidden. A scandal revealed by a daughter on live broadcast threatens everything.

feats.scene: Tetauan orders a convoy of agents to ram a rental car off a highway.
Tetauan sits through a heckling crowd's thrown bottles without flinching.

name: Oroni
summary: Oroni is a winged archer of affection whose arrows force the struck to adore the first stranger in view. Eternal and charming, the golden-haired god strolls through modern cities flirting with mortals and matchmaking for sport.

feats.scene: Oroni looses a volley of arrows that pins a stampeding herd to the plain.
Oroni ignores a toppling tower of masonry and brushes dust from his wings.

name: Rianavi
summary: Rianavi is a fugitive swordswoman who flees her former order's hunters through a future city, bearing urgent news of a returned tyrant. Agile and stealthy, she buys a hero time with a final stand.

feats.scene: Rianavi cleaves a steel shutter with a swift diagonal cut.
Rianavi lands a flip from a rooftop onto concrete and keeps running.

name: Rusreoar
summary: Rusreoar is a hairless collector of living statues, whose gaze petrifies anyone who meets his eyes until dawn, and who stages grim galleries of victims. Shutting one's eyes is all it takes to beat him.

feats.scene: Rusreoar petrifies a whole prison block of escapees with a sweep of his stare.
Rusreoar is thrown into a pillar and sags into a captured heap.

name: Corrosasi
summary: Corrosasi is a collector of oddities who turns strange trinkets into criminal tools, from trick lamps to cursed trifles. Fond of showmanship, the schemer clashes with a masked dream-weaver.

feats.scene: Corrosasi sets off a booby-trapped vase that blows out a shop window.
Corrosasi is hurled into a shelf of antiques and gets up covered in dust.

name: Elavalnt
summary: Elavalnt is a hired crackling thug who throws arcs of lightning and carries on a dead partner's stage-effects trade. Cocky about his name, he corrects anyone who mispronounces it.

feats.scene: Elavalnt discharges a thick arc that blows out a whole row of streetlights.
Elavalnt is thrown against a transformer box and sparks harmlessly off his skin.

name: Ollnel
summary: Ollnel is an ancient demigod sorcerer, spawn of a war god, who ruled by terror until a rival order bound his spirit into a battle helm. Now a roaming ghost that can take over bodies, he dreams of a second reign.

feats.scene: Ollnel hurls a storm of dark sorcery that levels a market district.
Ollnel's spirit endures a banishing rite that shatters his old fortress.

name: Sauunlle
summary: Sauunlle is a crooked tycoon who dons a lifelike grinning mask to usurp a notorious clown criminal, staging gag-murders until a plunge into a vat ends it. Vain and jealous, the impostor dies for a stolen reputation.

feats.scene: Sauunlle sprays a toxic gag-gas that fills a boardroom.
Sauunlle takes a punch from his rival and stays on his feet, laughing.

name: Riiumne
summary: Riiumne is a lean, middling-height rogue who runs afoul of a masked rival, blasting away with whatever firearm he can grab. Short on backstory, the hothead lives for the next score.

feats.scene: Riiumne empties a shotgun and splinters a warehouse door.
Riiumne is pitched down a flight of steps and limps off.

name: Socor
summary: Socor is a medal-winning multi-event athlete and inventor of floating robotic spheres who became a masked vigilante and later a research director at a government bureau. Warm and clever, he fights with brains and agility.

feats.scene: Socor directs his spheres to blast a lock and a door off its frame.
Socor leaps from a high platform with a canopy and lands on his feet.

name: Artaial
summary: Artaial is a centuries-old surgeon who cannot die, a serial killer through the eras who harvests organs to prolong a spouse's life and serves a wealthy master. A clinic in a modern city gives him fresh victims.

feats.scene: Artaial plunges a scalpel through a restraint strap and the bed beneath it.
Artaial heals fully after a bullet wound across his chest.

name: Viiasco
summary: Viiasco is a young prodigy with half a dozen degrees who builds a powered exosuit to clear his name after a former employer pins a city-wide catastrophe on him. Driven and brilliant, he also tinkers with time travel.

feats.scene: Viiasco blasts a vault door off its hinges with his suit's cannon.
Viiasco rides out a hail of automatic fire inside his exosuit.

name: Saiaton
summary: Saiaton is a scarred syndicate lieutenant who runs smuggling crews for a wine-named crime boss across several borders. Saiaton relies on blunt boxing and a loyal gang, and has learned that muscle alone loses to a prisoner who refuses to stay locked up.

feats.scene: Saiaton lands a heavy cross that drops a rival enforcer across a warehouse table.
Saiaton stays conscious through a savage beating that leaves him barely alive.

name: Citior
summary: Citior is a tired homicide detective in a crime-ridden harbour city who works cases beside the old police chief. Citior unmasks a scheming rival inside the department and finally weighs a job elsewhere, away from the grisly killings that wear her down.

feats.scene: Citior fires a single pistol round that drops a fleeing clown-faced killer.
Citior is dragged hostage by thugs yet stays calm under a threat of poison gas.

name: Milinstu
summary: Milinstu is a tall, broad embassy liaison who handles security for an international hero league in a snowy capital. Milinstu keeps sharp watch over visitors and diplomats, and her family ties anchor her far more than any title does.

feats.scene: Milinstu hurls a would-be intruder bodily through the embassy gate.
Milinstu shrugs off a thrown chair and keeps her post at the door.

name: Tumtor
summary: Tumtor is a bright college student whose engagement to a masked young crimefighter pulls her into danger she chose to share. Tumtor guards his secret fiercely, and steps between a violent sibling and their wounded father when nobody else will.

feats.scene: Tumtor slaps a bully hard enough to rock his head sideways.
Tumtor stands unflinching in front of a raving gang leader armed with a blade.

name: Anuser
summary: Anuser is a restless student in a neon-lit future city who grows weary of a boyfriend who keeps vanishing on mysterious errands. Anuser asks hard questions about where his job will lead, never guessing what he truly does at night.

feats.scene: Anuser throws a textbook across a hallway in frustration.
Anuser walks away from a nasty fall on wet stairs with only bruises.

name: Luterter
summary: Luterter is a brown-haired island warrior trained by a sisterhood blessed by two huntress goddesses. Luterter shoots, rides and fences with equal skill, and holds a beach against mechanical invaders during a world-spanning crisis.

feats.scene: Luterter cleaves a charging machine soldier in half with one sword stroke.
Luterter takes a blast of shrapnel on her bracers and keeps fighting.

name: Vatersau
summary: Vatersau is a pale-eyed assassin serving a vast state, hunting hidden sages while posing as an ordinary woman to seduce her prey. Vatersau fights with a blade and bare hands, and a runner who strikes at her kidney with focused inner force finally brings her down.

feats.scene: Vatersau slashes through a heavy bamboo screen and the dummy behind it.
Vatersau shakes off a speed-driven kick and counterattacks at once.

name: Lloseson
summary: Lloseson is an inventor who shrinks to doll size after his own chamber misfires, then dons a jetpack suit armed with lasers to rescue a lifelong friend. Lloseson later becomes her sidekick and loyal partner in a spectral crusade against an organised crime clan.

feats.scene: Lloseson burns a hole through a steel locker door with a tiny laser.
Lloseson survives being swatted across a room by a gunman.

name: Tasstron
summary: Tasstron is an asthmatic future teen who hears voices nobody else can, and learns they are earlier speedsters guiding her through a cosmic current of velocity. Tasstron inherits the fastest mantle, running through a city that once drove her family away.

feats.scene: Tasstron slams into a runaway truck at full sprint and flips it over.
Tasstron skids across a highway at blinding pace and rises unhurt.
Tasstron outruns a shock wave down an empty avenue.

name: Stsere
summary: Stsere is a bearded frontier hunter, scout and road-builder who tracks game and enemies through endless forest on horseback. Stsere shoots a flintlock with calm precision, founds settlements and leads militias across mountains few settlers dared cross.

feats.scene: Stsere fires his long musket and drops a charging bull elk.
Stsere endures a day-long forced march through freezing rain.

name: Tireonan
summary: Tireonan is a red-skinned street enforcer who unites rival neighbourhood gangs into one syndicate after a monstrous raid leaves the old mob families weak. Tireonan sells drugs, courts the council of crime elders and stays one step ahead of the police.

feats.scene: Tireonan hits a defiant dealer so hard that the man folds onto the pavement.
Tireonan takes a crowbar across the ribs and keeps issuing orders.

name: Natorlli
summary: Natorlli is a stunt performer who bargains with a stranger for a starring role and finds he is cursed to burst into flame if he leaves the swampy town. Natorlli later gains blue fire from a mad scientist's injection and struggles to control it.

feats.scene: Natorlli unleashes a gush of cobalt fire that melts a parked sedan.
Natorlli walks out of a blazing garage with his skin glowing but unburned.

name: Iumsu
summary: Iumsu is a red-haired telepath summoned by a caped champion to carry him across the veil to a sorcerous realm. Iumsu works spells of dimensional travel and mental force from behind the scenes of a brutal tyrant's regime.

feats.scene: Iumsu hurls a stack of crates across an alley with a flick of thought.
Iumsu staggers but stays upright after a gunman's pistol-whipping.

name: Amocor
summary: Amocor is a poor farmer's son who receives a magic lantern from a fairy and becomes a pumpkin-headed hero in an international team. Amocor drifts into a dictator's army, switches loyalties twice, and dies of old age, passing his mantle to a cousin.

feats.scene: Amocor flings a burst of lantern light that blasts a door off its hinges.
Amocor endures a prison cell's daily beatings without breaking.

name: Lorseeo
summary: Lorseeo is a gourd-headed hero who offers his services through a phone app and is booked for parties and rescues alike. Lorseeo fights a power-stealing android in a foreign capital, and quarrels with a former friend over a fugitive team that crosses borders.

feats.scene: Lorseeo blasts a rubber-skinned machine back through a shopfront.
Lorseeo takes a crushing hit from an android and gets up grinning.

name: Eoarleo
summary: Eoarleo is a stuffy, unpopular politician elected to lead a battered city after a long abandonment. Eoarleo demands harsh crackdowns, makes poor choices and ends up blackmailed, unaware that a cat burglar is laughing at his big ceremony.

feats.scene: Eoarleo slams a desk with his fist to silence a room of officials.
Eoarleo shrugs off a flying tomato from an angry crowd.

name: Lansuiu
summary: Lansuiu is a young masked vigilante from a bygone era who fought crime alongside an older mentor. Lansuiu is honoured with a painting in a grand gallery of heroic figures, remembered more as legend than as a fighter.

feats.scene: Lansuiu knocks a thief off a fire escape with a swinging kick.
Lansuiu stays on his feet after being tossed into a brick wall.

name: Tilanunol
summary: Tilanunol is a college dropout who fights in a world war beside an explosive mentor, then is chosen for a secret experiment that costs him his own mind. Tilanunol bursts with blasts of force and becomes a nation's grim champion in a stranger's body.

feats.scene: Tilanunol detonates a charge of raw force that levels a brick tenement.
Tilanunol walks through a tank volley with his coat in tatters.

name: Rnnor
summary: Rnnor is a divorced police detective who loves his daughter and quietly resents the flamboyant consultant orbiting his former wife. Rnnor overcomes a murderous urge that grips everyone who grips a cursed weapon, proving a stubborn will in a very bleak moment.

feats.scene: Rnnor tackles a suspect to the ground and cuffs him in one motion.
Rnnor takes a punch from a suspect and still makes the arrest.

name: Citiutum
summary: Citiutum is a masked adventurer who fights crime during a world war as part of a patriotic squad. Citiutum attends a mandated rally years later, where a staged unmasking turns into a riot whose outcome nobody records.

feats.scene: Citiutum swings a heavy fist that sends a saboteur over a rail.
Citiutum stands against a rampaging brute and is last seen still upright.

name: Artir
summary: Artir is a museum scholar in a gaslit city who owns a beetle-shaped relic whose full power he has yet to grasp. Artir aids a caped hunter against swarms of bat creatures and uses the relic's magic to purge a haunting essence from a friend's ring.

feats.scene: Artir fires a bolt of green light from the relic that scatters a bat swarm.
Artir withstands a monstrous claw swipe and keeps channelling the relic.

name: Rauiuor
summary: Rauiuor is an archaeologist who enters a pharaoh's tomb, is transformed by a glowing sacred beetle during a cave-in, and learns to wear it as a costume of might. Rauiuor fights as a masked adventurer for decades and dies old, his relic passing to later heirs.

feats.scene: Rauiuor props up a collapsing stone ceiling long enough for his friend to scramble clear.
Rauiuor emerges from a crumbling vault with only dust on his suit.

name: Saneoiu
summary: Saneoiu is a gentle small-town vicar who tends a modest congregation and offers calm counsel to neighbours in crisis. Saneoiu studies scripture and lends a listening ear, though he never lifts a hand against anyone.

feats.scene: Saneoiu slams a heavy church door against the wind.
Saneoiu keeps preaching after being jostled by a panicked crowd.

name: Llevarrni
summary: Llevarrni is a cultist messenger and luxury tower chairman who unknowingly carries a plague meant to wipe out a metropolis. Llevarrni seals his neighbours inside with the sickness, then spends his last strength warning friends before he dies.

feats.scene: Llevarrni bolts a heavy lobby door and drops the iron bar into place.
Llevarrni walks to the penthouse while fevered and coughing blood.

name: Nerosva
