Rnnaias takes the combined assault of a champion squad and keeps coming.
Rnnaias races across an ocean in a heartbeat to seize his prey.

name: Olucato
summary: Olucato is a grey despot who rules a fire-wracked world as part of a cabal of masterminds, struggling for supremacy with an immortal rival. Olucato fires rays that disintegrate matter, fathers three heirs and matches armies on his own.

feats.scene: Olucato fires a crimson beam that vaporises a fortified bluff.
Olucato stands unharmed through a barrage of heavy artillery.

name: Cisralvor
summary: Cisralvor is the undying master of a burning world whose reign stretches to the last days of time, and who even leads a lost people after their homeland falls. Cisralvor crushes a band of warrior women and finally dies in a duel inside a dying sun.

feats.scene: Cisralvor sweeps aside an island army and scorches its green hills to ash.
Cisralvor grapples a rival deep inside a collapsing star before succumbing.

name: Stsene
summary: Stsene is a grey, brick-bodied overlord of a smoking planet who commands underlings to capture rivals and seize a coveted cube. Stsene hurls rays, flies, bends minds, leaps, and shrugs off poisons, though his plans collapse when captives escape.

feats.scene: Stsene fires a ray from his eyes that demolishes a row of toy-like towers.
Stsene is smashed through a wall by a heroic fist and steps out unmarked.

name: Auiuniu
summary: Auiuniu is a hulking, red-eyed overlord of a fiery world, drawn in blocky plastic style as an invader with a booming voice. Auiuniu lifts armoured vehicles overhead and fires searing rays from his eyes.

feats.scene: Auiuniu fires a pair of beams that turns a toy city block to rubble.
Auiuniu stands unmoved as a stack of plastic bricks explodes over him.

name: Irnnutia
summary: Irnnutia is a pint-sized, grey-faced emperor of a scorched world who glowers at a caped detective and scolds a nervous underling. Irnnutia wields a searing glare from his eyes and a ferocious temper that erupts when his servant asks for better quarters.

feats.scene: Irnnutia flicks a ray from his eyes that blows a hole through a stone wall.
Irnnutia is knocked flat by a caped fist and brushes it off with a scowl.

name: Tirtilirn
summary: Tirtilirn is a grey invader who spends weekdays working in a school kitchen and weekends plotting world takeover. Tirtilirn hurls a flaming rock at a planet and traps a rescue team on it with searing rays before leaving to make it to work on time.

feats.scene: Tirtilirn hurls a burning boulder toward a populated planet.
Tirtilirn takes a pummelling from small heroes and still reports for his shift.

name: Aminuse
summary: Aminuse is a green-eyed war criminal from a wrecked postwar country who escapes judgment and delves into the occult. Aminuse wields a mystic sphere to raise armies of the dead and strike foes with uncanny bolts until a vengeful hunter and a revived twin end her.

feats.scene: Aminuse lifts a hundred corpses from a field and sends them marching on a village.
Aminuse is bruised by a hunter's strike and keeps hold of her sphere.

name: Naulaval
summary: Naulaval is one of many lab-grown minions sent by a hidden overlord to hunt a pair of teenagers who borrow heroic forms by dialling. Naulaval fires bursts of energy of unclear origin and obeys without question.

feats.scene: Naulaval hurls a bolt of raw energy that sets a parked van alight.
Naulaval takes a heavy blow from a teen disguised as a hero and holds on.

name: Colorst
summary: Colorst is a primordial being from beneath the waves, the wellspring of a drowned civilisation's sorcery and a terror that makes the fears of wizards solid. Colorst is locked away by a wary monarch who dreads the entity's power to remake everything.

feats.scene: Colorst warps a flooded city into a nightmare of its citizens' deepest fears.
Colorst withstands a barrage of sorcery and reabsorbs every spell.

name: Aullu
summary: Aullu is a colossal armoured reptile that drifts in from deep space as an egg, devours every living thing on a world, and enslaves its mightiest survivors. Aullu is finally launched into space and punched back down so hard that he forms a new landmass.

feats.scene: Aullu swallows a whole continent's armies and unleashes a beam that scorches the coast.
Aullu shrugs off the mightiest attacks of a league of heroic reptiles.

name: Stitesi
summary: Stitesi is a cheerful girl who, with five friends, merges into one mighty champion by shouting a magic word. Stitesi helps her merged self challenge a warrior queen in a doomed war, and dies when the world ends.

feats.scene: Stitesi and her friends combine and hurl a stone column across a battlefield.
Stitesi's merged form tanks a spear thrust before being forced apart.

name: Ntnoleo
summary: Ntnoleo is a bright schoolgirl and natural sprinter who is gifted the swiftness of a messenger god in a timeless sanctum. Ntnoleo shouts with five friends to fuse into a lightning-flinging champion, and joins a desperate time-warped campaign.

feats.scene: Ntnoleo and her friends merge and drive a fist through a thick stone door.
Ntnoleo's merged form shrugs off a flurry of hits from a sorceress.
Ntnoleo streaks through a crowded street faster than any engine.

name: Toserst
summary: Toserst is a faceless make-believe companion, born in a lonely girl's mind, who returns bent on revenge after being cast aside. Toserst depends on her creator's thoughts to exist, and fades once her maker regains control.

feats.scene: Toserst bursts a wardrobe door and pins a sleeper to the floor.
Toserst absorbs a wild blow and remains in place.

name: Telsorori
summary: Telsorori is a fair-haired staff officer in military spycraft who briefs a daring spy during a great war. Telsorori coordinates reports and orders from a cramped office, never seeing the front.

feats.scene: Telsorori slams a map-table drawer shut in anger.
Telsorori shakes off a stumble down a flight of stairs.

name: Renanora
summary: Renanora is a quick-witted scholar who briefly fights crime in a borrowed costume, using a band that stores kinetic force. Renanora later grows apart from her mentor and begins a quiet romance with a friend's former love.

feats.scene: Renanora releases the band's stored shock and knocks a mugger across an alley.
Renanora is clipped by a thrown bottle and the band cushions the blow.

name: Caliu
summary: Caliu is a married hero who shrinks to the size of a toy while keeping his full strength, and is swept through a swirling gate to a war-torn alternate world. Caliu fights tyranny for decades alongside patriot comrades before returning home to a world he hardly knows.

feats.scene: Caliu shrinks, darts across a table and slams a tiny fist into a spy's jaw.
Caliu rides out a shell burst while the size of a toy.

name: Selliu
summary: Selliu is a dark-haired fanatic who loathes anything odd and thinks himself a model of the ordinary, though he secretly wields bizarre devices himself. Selliu recruits a sham death squad, falls to the oddballs he hunted, and is humiliated by a living lane.

feats.scene: Selliu opens a humming crate and blasts a hallway with a wave of confusion.
Selliu gets thrown to the pavement and sits up demanding order.

name: Vosrnill
summary: Vosrnill is a pink-streaked botanist and aspiring vocalist who keeps his parents' expectations at arm's length. Vosrnill lives by strict nonviolence, avoids meat, and befriends a plant-loving outlaw when he finds a corpse in the greenhouse.

feats.scene: Vosrnill pushes open a stuck greenhouse door.
Vosrnill is shoved aside by a panicking crowd and stands back up.

name: Lloratau
summary: Lloratau is a red-haired rampager in a violent gang who can form knives of pure mental force but prefers the noise of explosives. Lloratau is knocked out in one punch by a stronger hero during a rampage through farm country.

feats.scene: Lloratau detonates a cache of dynamite that wrecks a general store.
Lloratau tries to stand after a single punch and falls unconscious.

name: Saunantau
summary: Saunantau is an orange-skinned, red-haired alien wanderer whose whole body was remade by cloning experiments. Saunantau now fires a limitless supply of quills from his skin and regrows them within hours, though he can still be wounded.

feats.scene: Saunantau fires a spray of quills from his shoulders that pin a thug's coat to a crate.
Saunantau takes a heavy fall and grits his teeth as his skin regrows its spines.

name: Toeoes
summary: Toeoes is a century-old, brown-haired immortal woman from an elder race, equipped with a glowing band and years of experience. Toeoes fights three heroes who thwart her father's time-bending scheme, and burns her own hand touching his remains before swearing vengeance.

feats.scene: Toeoes projects a green construct that crushes an empty cargo ship.
Toeoes survives a scorching blast of emerald force and hurries away.

name: Inulluli
summary: Inulluli is a swaggering researcher who tests an experimental machine on himself and becomes a hulking simian brute bent on proving his genius. Inulluli plots to steal a visiting spacecraft and trigger an interplanetary quarrel, only to be beaten by a stretchy hero.

feats.scene: Inulluli rips open the hatch of a flying saucer with his hairy fists.
Inulluli is thrown into a swamp tree and rises, snarling.

name: Llotaust
summary: Llotaust is a green-eyed noblewoman in a hilltop fortress who moves objects by thought and transforms matter and living things into other forms. Llotaust turns soil into obedient golems, makes a jaguar into a monster that runs on air, and teleports a whole party at once.

feats.scene: Llotaust raises a troop of stone golems from a hillside and sends them to smash a gatehouse.
Llotaust takes a hard blast and teleports away before the next.

name: Tetiaser
summary: Tetiaser is a green-eyed robotic menace built for brute force, capable of soaring and blasts of power. Tetiaser charges a pair of atom-powered heroes of heroes and is destroyed after a short run.

feats.scene: Tetiaser fires an energy lance that bores through a tenement wall.
Tetiaser walks through a missile strike with only scorch marks.

name: Saamoto
summary: Saamoto is a one-eyed gifted mind who runs his family's research firm while a virus slowly kills the whole clan. Saamoto breeds experimental subjects, arms himself with a beam pistol, and is killed aboard an orbital station by one of his own creations.

feats.scene: Saamoto fires a beam pistol that burns through a bulkhead door.
Saamoto stays on his feet through a violent shudder of the failing station.

name: Ernium
summary: Ernium is a scruffy pet canine adopted by an adolescent who wanted a small companion to call his own. Ernium chases balls, howls at the moon and loyally follows his owner around a cartoon town.

feats.scene: Ernium pounces on a squeaky toy and shakes it hard.
Ernium tumbles down a staircase and trots off wagging his tail.

name: Iumlor
summary: Iumlor is a motorcycle-riding bloodsucker who turns a handful of young women into his brides and forces them to hunt for him. Iumlor is torn apart by bikes and staked, returns for revenge, and is again shot with a crossbow bolt and dismembered into five backpacks.

feats.scene: Iumlor hurls a former bride across a living room into a bookcase.
Iumlor is pulled by four engines in four directions and is still undead.

name: Lesca
summary: Lesca is a grey-haired ex-assassin from a secretive cabal who trains his daughter in lethal skills. Lesca moves with the cold precision of a practised killer and answers to no master.

feats.scene: Lesca drives a palm strike that folds a trained bodyguard.
Lesca shrugs off a baton to the ribs and counters at once.

name: Taante
summary: Taante is a sullen teenager at a rough boarding school who is lumped in with his violent father's crimes. Taante resents the label, speaks to the guards with weary contempt and just wants to be left alone.

feats.scene: Taante shoves a bully into a locker with a flat palm.
Taante takes a punch in the dining hall and does not flinch.

name: Tenauno
summary: Tenauno is a polite, worried lawman in a dusty desert town who keeps the peace when local boys vanish. Tenauno calms a mob of armed parents, jails outsiders for questioning and finally mounts a rescue at a collapsed cave.

feats.scene: Tenauno fires a warning shot that scatters an angry crowd.
Tenauno wades into a shoving mob and keeps his badge on.

name: Esraami
summary: Esraami is a fair-haired technician who co-owns a small scrap-recovery firm and runs its technical side. Esraami reverse-engineers fallen alien gadgets and turns the company from a scrapyard into a laboratory.

feats.scene: Esraami wrenches a seized bolt loose from a wrecked hull.
Esraami keeps working while sparks rain on his coat.

name: Iaseo
summary: Iaseo is a smooth-voiced broadcaster who takes a spooky stage name from a drama to expose a careless builder after a collapse. Iaseo later fights beside a patriot team, teams up with an eccentric genius and his talking primate, and retires after the war.

feats.scene: Iaseo slugs a foreman and sends his hard hat spinning.
Iaseo takes a pipe across the back and keeps interrogating.

name: Vaslu
summary: Vaslu is a late-night broadcaster who dons dark clothes and a mask after a tower collapses, crashing a rich host's party to collect donations for the victims. Vaslu carries a suction pistol on a silk cord and a screen that finds crimes.

feats.scene: Vaslu fires a suction cup that yanks a gunman off his feet.
Vaslu swings from a ledge and takes a hard landing on a balcony.

name: Selle
summary: Selle is a blue-eyed chrono-voyager who rewrites the founding of a republic, defeats its troops and rules for centuries as a monarch. Selle is hunted down by a band of cartoon heroes who cross the centuries to undo his schemes.

feats.scene: Selle commands a time-skipping cannon that flattens a fort.
Selle withstands a charge by several heroes before his device is shut off.

name: Iarilvor
summary: Iarilvor is a mild researcher who flies into rage and swells into an indestructible overgrown infant. Iarilvor loses his wits while transformed, charges at a giant hare and is knocked out for his trouble.

feats.scene: Iarilvor swings a giant fist that caves in a brick wall.
Iarilvor shrugs off a battering volley of tank shells.

name: Silval
summary: Silval is a gang boss posing as a graduate student who gains borrowed alien powers after a brain-cell transplant. Silval dons a lead-lined mask and goes on a crime spree, but his powers fade mid-fight and a hero must catch him.

feats.scene: Silval smashes a vault door off its frame with a single blow.
Silval takes a pounding from the rescuer and stays standing until his gift fades.

name: Auiumlu
summary: Auiumlu is a respectable business-club chairman who knows what every member can afford and exploits it. Auiumlu hides behind a gangster persona to run a shakedown ring until a clever sleuth breaks up his crew.

feats.scene: Auiumlu slaps a shopkeeper across the face to make him pay up.
Auiumlu is flung over a counter and rises to run.

name: Leocormi
summary: Leocormi is a bereaved deckhand with a young son who survives a shipwreck only to share a cramped raft with two others. Leocormi dies so that scant supplies can keep a boy alive.

feats.scene: Leocormi hauls a heavy rope up the side of a lifeboat.
Leocormi endures cold waves and hunger for days on open water.

name: Rumtilveo
summary: Rumtilveo is a blond swordsman born into a serf bloodline and trained in secret by a noble lover. Rumtilveo bears a ring of raw fury and fights with cunning more than brute force, and has changed sides more than once.

feats.scene: Rumtilveo drives a lance of ring-fire through a fortress gate and the wall behind it.
Rumtilveo shrugs off a collapsing watchtower while his ring flickers.

name: Lasleo
summary: Lasleo is a white-haired, green-eyed god-soldier who defected from a hard regime to serve a gentler one. Lasleo fights beside a lover in a small elite squad and is quietly cynical about every ruler.

feats.scene: Lasleo hurls a storm of radiant spears that reduces a ridge of cliffs to gravel.
Lasleo takes a direct blast from two rival warriors and is only winded.

name: Nusvece
summary: Nusvece is a black stallion once bred for polo, now the loyal mount of a masked rider. Nusvece is strong, fast, and fierce enough that bandits back off at the sight of his flared nostrils.

feats.scene: Nusvece kicks a barn door clean off its hinges.
Nusvece gallops flat out across a dry plain with a rider crouched low on his back.

name: Auianol
summary: Auianol is a masked crook who plays the part of a jewelled card in a gang of thieves. Auianol picks fights with a young flying hero, and mostly relies on cheap tricks and a handy escape route.

feats.scene: Auianol hurls a razor-edged card that sticks in a plank at the far end of an alley.
Auianol tumbles down a fire escape and bolts for the next rooftop.

name: Soamces
summary: Soamces is a black-haired queen of a warrior nation in a world of knights and castles. Soamces fell in love with a foreign princess, stood against a king's lies, and warns enemies she will crush their faces if pushed.

feats.scene: Soamces breaks a heavy iron gauntlet and the arm in it with a single squeeze.
Soamces holds a charging horse at bay with her bare arms.

name: Leslu
summary: Leslu is a peace-minded champion of an island nation, given gifts by the gods and a rope that forces truth. Leslu resents being called a warrior, and her bracelets turn bullets as easily as raindrops.

feats.scene: Leslu snaps a steel gantry in half to free a trapped crew.
Leslu walks out of a collapsing power station with her hair barely mussed.

name: Lloeol
summary: Lloeol is a haughty diplomat-princess from a paradise isle who has worn a ring of death and a ring of light in her time. Lloeol rides a winged steed, prefers conversation to fighting, and looks down on rude company.

feats.scene: Lloeol shatters a stone pier with a single clap of her bracelets.
Lloeol tanks a blast from a ring-powered foe without breaking her smile.

name: Rauis
summary: Rauis is a tall, black-haired demigoddess warrior who flies, heals fast, and does not age. Rauis bears a lasso, tiara, and bracelets, and stood on a team of heroes before it came apart.

feats.scene: Rauis hurls a shipping container through the hull of a gunboat.
Rauis shrugs off a barrage of rockets and her wounds close within moments.

name: Sturi
summary: Sturi is a diplomat-warrior princess in a cinematic series, with metal-boosted limbs and a wide streak of command. Sturi flies, wields a sword and shield, speaks many tongues, and once fought under another's mind control.

feats.scene: Sturi cleaves a tank turret clean off its mount with her sword.
Sturi is struck by a creature's full-strength blow and slides back only a few paces.

source_title: Diana of Themyscira (DC Animated Movie Universe)

name: Stiriatiu
summary: Stiriatiu is a museum curator hiding a war-hardened demigoddess, a godkiller who once wanted to end war. Stiriatiu has learned that love matters more than conquest, and fights on with sword and shield for a flawed humanity.

feats.scene: Stiriatiu lands a downward sword stroke that splits a battlefield crag from top to base.
Stiriatiu absorbs a hammer blow from a rival deity and stays standing.

name: Lluveval
summary: Lluveval is a gifted but awkward student in a cartoon high school who tops her class and still feels out of place. Lluveval trained from childhood to be perfect, won a tournament in defiance of her mother, and sneaked off to see the wider world.

feats.scene: Lluveval throws a gym mat stack through a cafeteria window.
Lluveval is struck by a runaway school bus and brushes herself off.

source_title: Diana of Themyscira (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Leerson
summary: Leerson is the cheerful, self-conscious demigod daughter of a queen and a thunder-throwing father, attending a school for gifted teens. Leerson hates showy trophies, bonds with new friends, and rejects the divine half of her family.

feats.scene: Leerson punches a training dummy through the wall of the gym and out onto the lawn.
Leerson stands in a collapsing field house and is only dusty after.

source_title: Diana of Themyscira (DC Super Hero Girls)

name: Tesiulan
summary: Tesiulan is a game-world champion who flies, hits hard, and mentors fresh heroes in the use of magic. Tesiulan works under a plain name in a government office and answers to a council of heroes.

feats.scene: Tesiulan drives her shield into a giant war machine and splits its torso.
Tesiulan tanks an orbital strike while shielding a group of recruits.

name: Llunan
summary: Llunan is a fallen warrior queen whose mind was taken by a plague of mindless hunger. Llunan once held a godlike invader down with her golden rope, only for him to shrug it off and leave, and she now preaches that death is the only constant.

feats.scene: Llunan rips a bridge span from its footings and throws it onto a column of survivors.
Llunan stands in the burning wreck of a skyline and her flesh is unmarked.

name: Llsorrni
summary: Llsorrni is an immortal queen and teacher who rides a giant kangaroo and carries a mental radio. Llsorrni is half god, half mortal, strong enough to bend iron, and knows a good many tongues and trades.

feats.scene: Llsorrni brings her sword down on a fortress wall and the whole battlement splits.
Llsorrni is pummelled by a rival army and does not age a day.

name: Eorast
summary: Eorast is a toy-sized android hero in a pastel world of mechanical citizens. Eorast carries a shining headband and wristguards, and quietly obeys a hidden master she cannot see.

feats.scene: Eorast flings a metal bin across the playground into a wall.
Eorast is bumped by a runaway cart and wobbles but stays upright.

name: Numia
summary: Numia is a queen of an island nation who turned her loyalty to a radical cause. Numia befriended a powerful foreign leader, later fell into a captor's hands, and her grey hair marks a long, bitter career.

feats.scene: Numia levels a field gun's barrel with one overhead blow.
Numia takes a tank shell on her shield and slides back only a metre.

name: Numleorn
summary: Numleorn is a lone wanderer on a battered motorbike who roams a ruined wasteland, helping strangers. Numleorn once swam for days to reach a lost home only to find the shore empty, and is whispered about as a myth by the outcasts.

feats.scene: Numleorn drives a broadsword through the engine block of a raider truck.
Numleorn is flung from her bike at speed and walks away with a limp.

name: Teltirnt
summary: Teltirnt is a kid-sized hero in a cartoon club of tiny crusaders. Teltirnt wears a bright headband and bracelets, wants to help, and takes everything a little too seriously.

feats.scene: Teltirnt shoves a toy cart across the classroom and knocks a stack of chairs flat.
Teltirnt tumbles down the slide and bounces up at the bottom.

name: Llain
summary: Llain is a brown-eyed, divinely gifted hero in a pint-sized comedy of costumed heroes. Llain sorts out a mess caused by a love potion and fights her sworn feline rival on a satellite base.

feats.scene: Llain knocks a rival through a wall of reinforced glass.
Llain absorbs a swing from a giant mallet and hardly notices.

name: Anniti
summary: Anniti is a godly champion who fights in a tournament crossover against a field of masked fighters. Anniti loses to two foes, then returns home, finds strange relics, and arms herself against a looming evil.

feats.scene: Anniti drives a fist into a stone arena wall and brings down a whole section.
Anniti takes a two-handed hammer blow from a bruiser and keeps her footing.

source_title: Diana of Themyscira (Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe)

name: Neranto
summary: Neranto is a brick-built warrior who takes a seat among a council of inventive builders. Neranto is captured by a police force, freed by a clumsy hero, and fights a robot horde in a toy city.

feats.scene: Neranto kicks through a wall of plastic masonry and scatters its bricks across the lot.
Neranto is crushed under a stack of towers and clicks herself back together.

name: Iaamsa
summary: Iaamsa is a big-sister mentor in a cartoon where every hero is a pocket-sized child. Iaamsa flies, hits hard, and catches thieves with a golden rope, all while signing a patient word to her pupils.

feats.scene: Iaamsa lifts a toy-sized treehouse over her head and hauls it across a field.
Iaamsa takes a tumble through a pile of furniture and giggles.

name: Lastau
summary: Lastau is a clay-born princess raised on a hidden isle after a long war with the god of battle. Lastau trained until she outfought her own aunt, then chased a crash-landed pilot and began a journey far from home.

feats.scene: Lastau hurls a boulder across a canyon and tears a mast from a passing ship.
Lastau takes a god-forged club on her bracers and the shockwave scours the beach.

name: Licor
summary: Licor is a black-eyed champion who flattened a world in a rage and spent centuries guarding what remained. Licor flies, heals, hits with lightning, never dies, and tells stories to survivors as they huddle against mutated horrors.

feats.scene: Licor smashes the crust of a continent into a field of broken glass in a single fit of fury.
Licor endures a punishing duel against a rival of equal might and her hair is barely singed.

source_title: Diana of Themyscira (Wonder Woman: Dead Earth)

name: Ialan
summary: Ialan is a nurse who lent her name to a famous princess and later asked for it back. Ialan has a baby and an inventor husband, and her life was once threatened by spies who wanted his work.

feats.scene: Ialan shoves a heavy medical cart into a spy's knees.
Ialan is bundled into a car boot and keeps her head in the dark.

name: Ulseor
summary: Ulseor is a dark-haired military nurse who tends wounded soldiers on the front line. Ulseor works long shifts in a field hospital and keeps calm no matter how many arrive at once.

feats.scene: Ulseor hauls a wounded soldier on a stretcher through a flooded trench.
Ulseor is bowled over by a shell blast and gets up to keep working.

name: Torna
summary: Torna is a blond farm girl turned test pilot who married an airman and raised a son. Torna flew supply missions through wartime, took up a new jet for the thrill, and vanished after lightning clipped her wing over open water.

feats.scene: Torna hauls a full ferry satchel up a ladder and slams the canopy shut.
Torna ejects from a tumbling jet and survives the plunge into cold water.

name: Collu
summary: Collu is a green-eyed executive who funds her costumed double life through a company that hands out scholarships. Collu runs a public campaign against a corrupt drug firm and has the press on her side, and the law watching her.

feats.scene: Collu kicks in a warehouse door and drags a witness out by the collar.
Collu takes a baton to the ribs and keeps walking toward the van.

name: Relen
summary: Relen is a red-haired hunting goddess of an old empire who sold out her fellow gods to a shattering power. Relen survived while her kin were turned to stone, then used the same curse on an island of warriors.

feats.scene: Relen turns a whole island's population to stone in a single sweep of her arm.
Relen is struck by a pantheon's combined blows and merely staggers.

source_title: Diana, Goddess of the Hunt (New Earth)

name: Tortecor
summary: Tortecor is a blond police detective who partners with a calm, quiet colleague and believes he is the finest sleuth alive. Tortecor catches the odd modest dig from her partner, and takes it in good humour.

feats.scene: Tortecor shoulders open a stuck interview-room door.
Tortecor is bumped down a stairwell by a fleeing suspect and gets up cursing.

source_title: Diane Meade (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Taani
summary: Taani is a white-haired film director who hides a second life as a golden-masked mage. Taani has a taste for spectacle on set and off, and treats his magic like a very expensive special effect.

feats.scene: Taani conjures a golden pillar of flame that burns down a set in seconds.
Taani is thrown from a camera crane and lands in a cloud of confetti.

name: Neocetel
summary: Neocetel is a brown-haired fighter of a sisterhood of archers and riders who guard a hidden island. Neocetel held the shore against a swarm of machines and trusts her training above all else.

feats.scene: Neocetel looses an arrow that pins a mechanical raider to a palm trunk.
Neocetel takes a heavy blow from a machine's arm and keeps her bow steady.

name: Meliunt
summary: Meliunt is a hulking criminal who slips into a high school disguised as a mild art teacher to steal lab chemicals. Meliunt breaks free of police restraints with a surge of drug-fuelled strength, then is led away again.

feats.scene: Meliunt snaps a pair of steel handcuffs with a flex of his shoulders.
Meliunt takes a thrown desk across the back and laughs.

source_title: Diego Dorrance (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Niarelu
summary: Niarelu is a bald thug in the pay of a rabbit-themed gang who can swell his body to a larger size. Niarelu lifts a man with one hand and shrugs off small-arms fire.

feats.scene: Niarelu swells and lifts a gunman off his feet with one hand.
Niarelu takes a point-blank pistol volley and only grunts.

name: Iasti
summary: Iasti is a dark-haired scholar of a sisterhood of archers who pored over old scrolls with her queen. Iasti read about child-rearing when the knowledge had faded, and can ride and fight when the day demands.

feats.scene: Iasti draws a war bow and sinks an arrow in a wooden shield.
Iasti is thrown from a pony and gets up laughing.

name: Rnitiamo
summary: Rnitiamo is a brown-eyed police sergeant in a mirrored world who secretly helped a masked bomber. Rnitiamo grilled a rich businessman for clues and was arrested just as her whole reality faded.

feats.scene: Rnitiamo slams an interview-room table against a suspect's knees.
Rnitiamo is cuffed to a bench and shrugs off a rough shove.

name: Ialstalin
summary: Ialstalin is a blond teen vocalist at a school for gifted teens who forms a band and loses a contest over a stolen aircraft. Ialstalin dissolves the group after a stint in custody and chases a solo career.

feats.scene: Ialstalin hurls a microphone stand at a rival drummer's kit and topples the cymbals.
Ialstalin tumbles off a stage into the crowd and bounces to her feet.

name: Eotaar
summary: Eotaar is a green-eyed fashion model in a sunny coastal city who studied karate in her spare time. Eotaar began as a rival to her neighbour and ended up a friend.

feats.scene: Eotaar breaks a stack of roof tiles with the edge of her hand.
Eotaar takes a hard fall on a polished runway and bounces up with a smile.

name: Teorete
summary: Teorete is a blond vigilante who stalks a rainy northwest city, convinced no woman should be a default victim. Teorete went after a bow-wielding killer, was mistaken for a hostage, and turned her captor's mistake against him.

feats.scene: Teorete fires a revolver through the door of a locked cellar.
Teorete is bound and dragged across a gravel yard, then slips her ropes.

name: Riacolre
summary: Riacolre is a blond masked crimefighter from a bygone generation of heroes who vanished from her family. Riacolre was framed by a secret agency for crimes she did not commit, and passed her calling to her daughter.

feats.scene: Riacolre drives a boot through a locked warehouse door.
Riacolre is thrown against a brick wall by an agent and keeps swinging.

name: Telseno
summary: Telseno is a grieving clerk turned cold-blooded killer who learned to fly, fight, pick locks and slip out of ropes. She hunts senior officers across the war from the cockpit of a diving bomber, trading her ledger for a compact automatic pistol.

feats.scene: Telseno empties a full magazine into a staff car from a moving rooftop ledge.
Telseno rolls clear of a tumbling hangar door and walks away bruised.

name: Lirasta
summary: Lirasta is a boy conjured by a lonely cosmic being to keep a famous runner from leaving a dying world. He carries only a sliver of his borrowed father's swiftness, yet it lets him blur across fields faster than any engine.

feats.scene: Lirasta crosses a wheat plain in a blink, leaving flattened stalks in a straight line.
Lirasta skids through a barn wall at full tilt and splinters it into kindling.

name: Orevar
summary: Orevar is a half-competent knight errant whose heroics succeed mostly by accident and bad luck. He rides a patient horse named for a racehorse, juggles in a pinch and brags louder than he fights.

feats.scene: Orevar brings a rusty sword down on a barrel and splits it, then loses his grip and drops it on his foot.
Orevar takes a cudgel blow on his dented helm and only complains about the noise.

name: Ororta
summary: Ororta is a smiling getaway driver who teaches wealthy pupils how to flee police through tight streets. His lessons are cruel to bystanders and he pays for that in the end.

feats.scene: Ororta slams a stolen coupe through a market stall and a fence at full throttle.
Ororta threads a coastal road at triple the posted limit with one hand on the wheel.
Ororta shrugs off a rough tackle from a pursuing officer.

name: Orenasar
summary: Orenasar is a quiet contract killer who followed an order too literally and spared the wrong child. Decades later he is still scarred by what his hands did that night.

feats.scene: Orenasar fires a silenced rifle through a dining room window in one clean motion.
Orenasar survives a brutal beating and a blade across the mouth and still crawls away.

name: Stuanor
summary: Stuanor is a gruff federal operative who hounds teenage vigilantes from a secret base carved into a mountain. Underneath the bluster he is a tender father who quietly shields his own daughter.

feats.scene: Stuanor fires a heavy rifle from the hip and punches a hole in a steel door.
Stuanor is thrown into a rock wall by an overturned cycle and gets back up.

name: Renelter
summary: Renelter is a gentle young man chosen by cosmic order to serve as a champion of calm and reconciliation. He fights beside a hot-tempered brother who answers to the opposite principle.

feats.scene: Renelter shoulder-checks a charging thug and sends him through a wooden fence.
Renelter stands his ground as a collapsing ceiling falls across his shoulders.

name: Nusntonte
summary: Nusntonte is a soft-spoken hero who shouts a single word with his brother and shifts into a swifter, lighter-fisted form. He avoids fights when he can and uses his speed to dodge rather than strike.

feats.scene: Nusntonte lands a measured shove and tips a parked truck onto its side.
Nusntonte zigzags between falling girders faster than the eye can follow.

name: Cesser
summary: Cesser is a black-sheep thief who stole a prototype cloak and became a hired spy and bruiser for the desperate. His disappearing act works until his own estranged father recognises the man behind the mask.

feats.scene: Cesser clubs a security guard from behind while perfectly unseen in a hallway.
Cesser is driven down a cellar staircase by a crowd and gets up groaning.

name: Nensiam
summary: Nensiam is an island-raised teen with fuzzy memories and a rope that compels honesty. He can lift a car, leap rooftops and spin so fast that he calls up help, and he hates the nickname he was given as a child.

feats.scene: Nensiam trades punches with a hulking green brawler and cracks the pavement under them.
Nensiam is struck by a construct shaped like an airliner and stands back up laughing.

name: Nalanuam
summary: Nalanuam is a grey-haired municipal official who steps into the top office after a disaster empties it. He makes bold promises about housing and public inquiries and tries to keep a frightened city steady.

feats.scene: Nalanuam slams a podium with an open palm to silence a shouting council room.
Nalanuam stumbles through a surging crowd of protesters without losing his footing.

name: Sontau
summary: Sontau is a ruthless racketeer who rose during dry years and executed every informer who crossed her. In old age her own early crimes finally catch up with her and she switches sides to save herself.

feats.scene: Sontau signs an order and a lieutenant fires a revolver at a witness through a restaurant door.
Sontau sits calmly through a hostile interrogation without flinching.

name: Tintval
summary: Tintval is a determined teenager who joins a street protest against unjust detention and calls in help from a stronger friend. She carries a duplicated silver rope, tiara and cuffs as a symbol of her cause.

feats.scene: Tintval flicks a silver rope and yanks a placard away from a heckler.
Tintval is shoved against a lamp post by a policeman and shakes it off.

name: Iarreau
summary: Iarreau inherits her mentor's mantle and warns a visiting counterpart not to build her life around other people's wishes. She is struck down by a rampaging flyer who hammers her head against her own jet.

feats.scene: Iarreau drives a punch through an armoured tank and sends it spinning into a river.
Iarreau absorbs a flying hammerblow that levels a pier before she finally falls.

name: Resreovi
summary: Resreovi is a mother in a grim possible future whose son grows into a tyrant. She wields radiant energy and is murdered for never telling him about his divine blood.

feats.scene: Resreovi unleashes a column of white light that levels a residential block.
Resreovi holds her ground in a firestorm that melts the street around her.

name: Ternasil
summary: Ternasil is an island-born princess and first apprentice of a famed warrior who sometimes joins a team of young heroes. She flies, throws with great accuracy and fights with trained gymnastic grace.

feats.scene: Ternasil hurls a boulder that flattens a robot guard in a mountain pass.
Ternasil crashes through a stone archway during a sparring bout and keeps fighting.

name: Ntineo
summary: Ntineo is a cartoon sidekick who flies, fights and carries a lasso in a lighthearted team adventure. She is quick on her feet and faster to laugh than to scold.

feats.scene: Ntineo knocks a hovering drone out of the sky with a flying kick.
Ntineo is flung into a billboard and leaves a dent shaped like her silhouette.

source_title: Donna Troy (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Antilco
summary: Antilco is a grieving immortal warrior from a doomed timeline who outlived every comrade and killed the last one in rage. After fourteen centuries she travels back to erase her younger self's future pain by murdering their friends.

feats.scene: Antilco crushes a tyrant's armoured fortress with a single overhead blow of her glowing whip.
Antilco stands in the heart of a collapsing citadel and walks out untouched.

name: Corauium
summary: Corauium is a mother who takes up a playing-card persona in a costumed gang of thieves. She appears in a sleeping butler's strange vision, arresting him on orders from a higher card.

feats.scene: Corauium slaps handcuffs onto a startled butler in a dream parlour.
Corauium tumbles down a short staircase in the dream and keeps her composure.

name: Vaserna
summary: Vaserna is a bedridden scholar of forbidden lore who lost limbs to sickness caused by radiation. He cannot walk, but his spells reach well beyond his sickbed and he gives his last strength to a secret circle.

feats.scene: Vaserna mutters a rite and slams a locked cellar door shut from across the room.
Vaserna survives a bout of poison that would kill a healthy adult.

name: Oresan
summary: Oresan is a rebellious fortune hunter whose crew is flown into deep space on a poisoned errand. He is brought back from an explosion by an ancient cosmic being and is chosen to fight an ancient war.

feats.scene: Oresan rams a stolen cruiser through a hostile patrol line and shreds two hulls.
Oresan survives the blast of his own reactor and is revived by a glowing entity.

name: Sonra
summary: Sonra is a shape-shifting trickster from a higher plane who tours lower worlds to test which champion is mightiest. He bends time, fire and size at will and leads an army of mischievous raiders.

feats.scene: Sonra snaps his fingers and a whole world bursts into violet flame.
Sonra stands in the middle of a collapsing star system and laughs.

name: Lanse
summary: Lanse is a grey-skinned living weapon bred for a dark lord and released onto a planet to cause ruin. Its blows crack towers, it copies the heat gaze used against it and it shrugs off ordinary punishment.

feats.scene: Lanse brings both fists down and shakes a downtown hall of columns to rubble.
Lanse is blasted by a searing beam from point-blank range and keeps advancing.

name: Celsesir
summary: Celsesir is a red-eyed ogre who roams a gate of bones and prefers to grind his enemies with his bare hands. He has heavy muscle and thick hide, and he fears nothing that walks.

feats.scene: Celsesir crushes a stone pillar between his palms until it turns to gravel.
Celsesir takes a swung tree trunk across the face and only grunts.

name: Reiar
summary: Reiar is a white-haired artificial monster from some unknown reality, made by a cold intelligence to be unbeatable. Its blood poisons the one it was made to fight, and the pair were said to have died together.

feats.scene: Reiar slams a fist into a stadium wall and brings down a whole section of seats.
Reiar is hit by a rolling convoy of trucks and keeps on walking.

name: Veonu
summary: Veonu is a pale legend of the high peaks, a white-haired snow giant that haunts passes and fights those who climb too near. Few have seen it and fewer have returned to speak of it.

feats.scene: Veonu hurls a frozen boulder down a slope and buries a climbing camp.
Veonu is hit by a rolling avalanche and brushes the snow from its shoulders.

name: Neleseo
summary: Neleseo is a one-eyed, grey-skinned mercenary built from the worst parts of three famous killers. He is clever with weapons and engineering, mends fast, and is blamed for razing an entire metropolis.

feats.scene: Neleseo sets a charge among a skyline's pillars and drops a whole city to ash.
Neleseo takes a rocket volley to the chest, regrows his torn skin and fires back.

name: Nisoce
summary: Nisoce is a bitter clerk who steals a freezing scientist's device and uses it to make every man in town vanish. When that plan fails she hides behind a puppet official and tries again.

feats.scene: Nisoce aims a stolen device across a plaza and a crowd of men simply disappears.
Nisoce falls from a police desk and picks herself up with a scowl.

name: Saron
summary: Saron is a glamorous socialite whose living, flowing hair works like extra arms. She lifts, grips and swings with them, and is only afraid of scissors.

feats.scene: Saron braids her hair around a falling machine and slows its crash above a crowd.
Saron is jerked off her feet by a metal arm and lands in a heap.

name: Taanam
summary: Taanam is a quick-tongued shopkeeper who runs a quirky bookstore and dabbles in the occult. She turns down an old schoolmate who became a monster and never changes her mind about him.

feats.scene: Taanam slams a heavy hardback on a counter to end an argument.
Taanam is lifted off her feet by a monstrous hand and set down gently.

name: Nttumanu
summary: Nttumanu is a red-haired villain who grows to towering size and splits from a husband who bewitched her. She raises a son alone and tries to move on with a new beau.

feats.scene: Nttumanu swells to ten storeys and swats a delivery van across a avenue.
Nttumanu is hit by a speeding bus and shakes it off.

name: Ratel
summary: Ratel is a gigantic brawler who towers over a stage arena. A single swing from her flings a rival into a skyscraper wall with crushing force.

feats.scene: Ratel punches a rival into the side of a tower and cracks its facade.
Ratel shrugs off a crashing girder as if it were a pillow.

name: Resmaont
summary: Resmaont is a fierce bounty seeker who joins a vast crowd of villains chasing two heroes after a fallen ally. She is more eager than careful and quick to pull a trigger.

feats.scene: Resmaont fires a launcher at a rooftop and brings down a chimney.
Resmaont is thrown through a shop window and rolls to her feet.

name: Luliril
summary: Luliril is a shy telepath with a simian face and a gift for stirring other minds. She reads emotion, pushes objects aside with thought and floods enemies with their own worst terrors.

feats.scene: Luliril hurls a parked car aside with a flick of thought.
Luliril takes a stinging slap and stays focused on her counterattack.

name: Lleranau
summary: Lleranau is a white-haired island scientist who studies rocks, metals and the physics of strange alloys. She fights with a sword when raiders arrive and explains the science after.

feats.scene: Lleranau cleaves a chunk of ore with a single stroke of her blade.
Lleranau is blown off her feet by a falling shelf of samples and brushes off the dust.

name: Rereslon
summary: Rereslon is a swaggering distant relative who crashes a family gathering and plots to join a motorbike gang. His scheme falls apart when the real hero arrives.

feats.scene: Rereslon knocks a man out with a swinging punch behind a barn.
Rereslon is thrown onto a gravel road and limps to his feet.

name: Ereleser
summary: Ereleser is a daring combat flyer who downs bombers, rescues a general and sinks a floating airfield almost single-handedly. He keeps spare submachine guns in the cockpit just in case.

feats.scene: Ereleser drops a torpedo and sinks an enemy flat-top in one pass.
Ereleser crash-lands a shot-up fighter in the surf and swims ashore.

name: Tumrn
summary: Tumrn is a young man who can convert his whole body into living metal at will. In that state he is strong, tireless and nearly impossible to hurt, and he reverts to flesh the moment he loses consciousness.

feats.scene: Tumrn in metal form punches through a brick wall and out the other side.
Tumrn shrugs off a hail of gunfire and a furnace blast.

name: Lenvenu
summary: Lenvenu is a young man whose twin gave his life, leaving him lost in a spiral of other timelines. He turns his flesh to metal, merges with a version of himself, and in one branch is turned against his old friends.

feats.scene: Lenvenu in his metal shape crushes the hull of a landing pod with both hands.
Lenvenu absorbs a volley of laser fire without a scratch.

name: Callnu
summary: Callnu is a grey-haired small-town lawman who keeps order on quiet streets and knows everyone by name. He is steady, fair and comfortable letting a young stranger find his own way.

feats.scene: Callnu cuffs a drunk driver with a firm hand beside a patrol car.
Callnu is bumped by a stumbling cow and stays upright.

name: Tetoriar
summary: Tetoriar is a restless former cavalry officer who trades his commission for a spy post and chases a lost treasure across desert and steppe. A glamorous noblewoman and her scheming rival keep dragging him into scrapes.

feats.scene: Tetoriar fires a rifle across a canyon and drops a bandit's horse.
Tetoriar is dragged by a camel through a gravel pit and gets up laughing.

name: Taute
summary: Taute is a fanatical weapons builder who assembles guns from scrap and pushes others into violence to prove his creed. He rigs a depot with automatic rifles and uses a hostage to turn a gunman on the hero.

feats.scene: Taute fires a homemade rocket launcher and levels a warehouse corner.
Taute rolls off a roof into a dumpster and sprints away.

name: Ialam
summary: Ialam is a masked fighter from a vigilante band in a small town. He falls early in a bloody scrap and is remembered only for how fast he threw himself into danger.

feats.scene: Ialam charges a gunman and tackles him through a wooden porch rail.
Ialam takes a shotgun blast to the vest before going down.

name: Reocolu
summary: Reocolu is a young woman who inherits a family legacy of frost crime and takes up an ice weapon to follow it. She was raised in the shadow of a stern grandfather and a rival brother.

feats.scene: Reocolu levels her cold gun and freezes a fountain solid in one pull.
Reocolu slips on her own ice and slams into a bench without a mark.

name: Renlasam
summary: Renlasam is a proud arena fighter who plays along with a cruel overlord to protect his homeland. He wins bout after bout, is cheered by the crowd, and loses only to an opponent who refuses to humiliate him.

feats.scene: Renlasam lifts a stone slab and slams it through a rival's shield.
Renlasam is buried under a pile of arena rubble and heaves his way out.

name: Orasonlu
summary: Orasonlu is a yellow-skinned gladiator who challenges a famous hero for glory and loses. Later he is kidnapped by a weapon-hoarding rebel who offers him a glorious battle, and he gladly chooses to stay.

feats.scene: Orasonlu hammers a steel gate with both fists and bends it off its hinges.
Orasonlu takes a heavy rocket blast on his chest and laughs.

name: Asorenum
summary: Asorenum is a masked warrior who defends his homeland alongside other patriots in an armoured crusade. He is killed in a blast that levels a battlefield.

feats.scene: Asorenum strikes a heavy door with a hardened forearm and caves it in.
Asorenum is caught in a huge blast on an open field and holds on a moment longer than expected.

name: Tacor
summary: Tacor is a hidden mountain tyrant who rules from the high passes and crushes any intruder who climbs too close. His secret identity is guarded as fiercely as his territory.

feats.scene: Tacor smashes a rope bridge with a spiked club and plunges it into the gorge.
Tacor shrugs off a rockfall on a snowy ledge.

name: Luausam
summary: Luausam is a black-haired criminal who strikes once and vanishes behind a serpent mask. His one crime is remembered more than his face.

feats.scene: Luausam hurls a curved blade across a hangar and pins a coat to a crate.
Luausam is knocked into a stack of crates and breaks them without a wince.

name: Numre
summary: Numre is a brilliant scientist who rises to the second seat of an island empire and forges a lethal gas. He joins a cursed chalice to a spear of legend and casts a sphere that bends every hero who enters it.

feats.scene: Numre raises the sphere across two continents and turns a squad of champions against each other.
Numre ducks behind a stone altar as a grenade bursts nearby.

name: Iuesi
summary: Iuesi is a hairless mercenary who rides a drake-shaped war machine against a team of corporate heroes. His vehicle does most of the work and he does most of the shouting.

feats.scene: Iuesi cuts a van in half with a swipe of his machine's tail.
Iuesi's armour shrugs off a volley of shotgun pellets.

name: Anutelani
summary: Anutelani is a black-haired criminal in a seven-person syndicate. She wears a costume with glittering wings and relies on speed and surprise.

feats.scene: Anutelani slashes a rope with a wing-edge blade and drops a crate on a guard.
Anutelani lands on a fire escape after a long fall and rolls away.

name: Raall
summary: Raall is a small-time white-haired gangster who runs animal fights and darker rackets from a rundown district. He is cruel but not clever, and everyone in his corner of town knows to pay him.

feats.scene: Raall slaps a debtor with the back of his hand and drops him in the gutter.
Raall takes a bottle to the head and just snarls.

name: Micerni
summary: Micerni is a theatrical masked crook who stages elaborate heists as if they were stage plays. He hams up every robbery and expects applause from the victims.

feats.scene: Micerni fires a prop pistol and a real window shatters.
Micerni tumbles off a stage and takes a bow.

name: Inuvar
summary: Inuvar is one half of a cybernetic pair who throws and tumbles with unnatural grace. He and his partner run with a gang of kids and menace the local metal-suited hero.

feats.scene: Inuvar hurls a steel drum across a lot and dents a parked truck.
Inuvar lands on pavement after a rooftop leap and keeps running.

name: Esttuse
summary: Esttuse is an orange-skinned guardian of a bright sister world who flares into a being of vast power. He is called on when ordinary champions fail.

feats.scene: Esttuse unfolds a ring of light and shatters a mountain peak in a heartbeat.
Esttuse stands in the heart of an energy storm without a scratch.

name: Niutantiu
summary: Niutantiu is a red-haired sorceress who charms men through their sleep and makes them her servants. She appears once, and then fades like a dream at sunrise.

feats.scene: Niutantiu whispers a command and a sleepwalking guard hurls a table at her pursuer.
Niutantiu takes a rough shove in a dream corridor and fades away.

name: Rortumiu
summary: Rortumiu is a violet-eyed daughter of a bright sister world who travels with a band of youthful wanderers. She never ages and she paints false pictures in the minds of her foes.

feats.scene: Rortumiu conjures a mirage of a charging army and sends a patrol running.
Rortumiu is struck by a runaway cart and stands up unhurt.

name: Tumllceo
summary: Tumllceo is a gentle immortal wanderer whose gift is to plant comforting illusions in a mind. She can look like whatever calms a frightened stranger and can jump through folds in space.

feats.scene: Tumllceo lifts a fallen girder with one arm and tosses it out of a tunnel.
Tumllceo walks out of a collapsed hall without a mark.

name: Vistisar
summary: Vistisar is a bald, brawny thug who flies and throws blasts of flame as part of a team of extremists. He is a rough pastiche of a more famous menace and leans on brute force.

feats.scene: Vistisar hurls a column of fire across a rooftop and melts a water tower.
Vistisar crashes through three walls and shakes off the plaster.

name: Stolamil
summary: Stolamil is a shapeless, blob-bodied pirate who commands a crew of odd aliens in deep space. He raids cargo ships and fights a winged officer from another star.

feats.scene: Stolamil oozes through a bulkhead and crushes a cargo robot in his folds.
Stolamil takes a point-blank volley and reforms around the holes.

name: Amirnte
summary: Amirnte is a blue-skinned grey-haired guardian of a far sector who carries a living lantern and a ring of willpower. He is slain by a rebel tyrant, kept animated by his ring, and later raised again as a hollow soldier.

feats.scene: Amirnte shapes a green hammer from his ring and smashes a pirate cruiser.
Amirnte raises a shield of light and stops a cannon barrage.

name: Naustil
summary: Naustil is a bald school delinquent who stores motion as kinetic force and fires it in bursts. He is swift and slick, and he loves smashing public property for fun.

feats.scene: Naustil unleashes a stored volley and flattens a school bus.
Naustil is run out a classroom window and lands on a lawn.

name: Varseval
summary: Varseval is a bald television producer on a distant world who stirs up disasters on another planet to keep his show exciting. He uses advanced gadgets to animate towers and make a hero too heavy to stand.

feats.scene: Varseval triggers a device and a speedster sinks through the pavement under his own weight.
Varseval stumbles off a ramp in his own studio and shrugs it off.

name: Sorseau
summary: Sorseau is a white-furred hound whose drool is a weapon, controlled with astonishing aim. He forms sticky bubbles that trap, soak and daze his foes in a team of space-patrolling pups.

feats.scene: Sorseau flicks a glob of drool and plasters a robot's lens.
Sorseau bounces off a metal crate and wags his tail.

name: Ninsite
summary: Ninsite is a white-haired conqueror who enslaves a world in a possible tomorrow and renames it for his lost home. He trusts his people's strength and delights in humiliating captured heroes.

feats.scene: Ninsite punches a fortress wall and sends a cloud of masonry across a valley.
Ninsite takes a salvo from an orbital gun and is only singed.

name: Lurivor
summary: Lurivor is a hard-line general in a rebuilt copy of a lost world who dreams of a coup against a rival house. He is beaten before he can finish his plan, and he promises vengeance to the last.

feats.scene: Lurivor drives his fist through a tank turret and tosses it aside.
Lurivor is hit by a rocket volley and stands up shouting orders.

name: Rnluos
summary: Rnluos is a once-honoured commander who led a doomed uprising and was exiled to a spectral prison instead of being executed. Free again, he arms himself with a rifle and swears to turn a new planet into his lost home.

feats.scene: Rnluos fires his rifle at a ridge and brings down a slab of cliff.
Rnluos is thrown through a stone wall and rises without a scratch.

name: Eomil
summary: Eomil is an amber-eyed leader of the survivors of a lost world who plans to conquer a planet of green-ringed guardians and remake it as a new home. He wields a mighty digging tool shaped like a drill.

feats.scene: Eomil plants his drill-tool in a plain and cracks open a canyon.
Eomil is thrown through a bulkhead on a space station and walks it off.

name: Ntice
summary: Ntice is a dark-skinned, grey-haired general trapped in a spectral jail where his body passes through solid walls. He keeps his iron will and his mind-reading skill, and he leads inmates by force of personality.

feats.scene: Ntice reaches through a prison wall and grips a guard's wrist.
Ntice stands in a storm of grey static and is untouched.

name: Rnticel
summary: Rnticel is a ruthless terrorist freed from a hidden prison with the help of a scheming magnate. He becomes ruler of a pocket world and kills anyone who stands against his rule.

feats.scene: Rnticel hurls a truck through a laboratory wall and brings the ceiling down.
Rnticel is hit by a salvo of missiles and keeps walking toward his target.

name: Amnesam
summary: Amnesam is a revered ancestor of a conquering house who commanded a fleet of star ships that scouted worlds for conquest. His flagship crashed on a distant planet and lay buried for centuries.

feats.scene: Amnesam orders a full broadside from his fleet and levels a fortified plain.
Amnesam walks out of the wreck of his flagship after the crash.

name: Stoniaesi
summary: Stoniaesi is a smooth, ruthless official of a time-keeping order who argues that authority makes execution different from murder. He works in secret with a deathless conqueror and dies when his citadel explodes.

feats.scene: Stoniaesi orders an assassin to hunt children across the decades.
Stoniaesi stands at the heart of his collapsing citadel as it detonates.

name: Monorlli
summary: Monorlli is a balding sorcerer who rules a world smaller than an atom and drinks in the magic of anyone who attacks him. He taunts his opponents with the failures of their parents.

feats.scene: Monorlli points a gnarled staff and a bolt of green light splits a boulder.
Monorlli glows as he swallows an incoming spell and grins.

name: Illeolsti
summary: Illeolsti is a purple-haired outcast who carries thousands of diseases and can choose whom she infects. She is immune herself and serves in a squad of reserve heroes that was turned away.

feats.scene: Illeolsti breathes on a squad of guards and they collapse with fever.
Illeolsti shrugs off a plague that fells a crowded hall.

source_title: Drura Sehpt (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Mivarau
summary: Mivarau is a joke of a villain who dresses like an insect and kidnaps wealthy matrons for ransom. He is tired of being laughed at, and his latest scheme is more dangerous than it looks.

feats.scene: Mivarau fires a stun gun at a bodyguard and drags a hostage into a van.
Mivarau is thrown from a rooftop by two young vigilantes and limps away.

name: Vauvi
summary: Vauvi is a petty costumed thief who skips a gathering of rogues and is spared by a monster hunting the others. Even the hero is not worried about his safety.

feats.scene: Vauvi tosses a net at a pigeon and tangles himself in it.
Vauvi trips on a curb and bounces up with a smile.

name: Seamnt
summary: Seamnt is a cartoon bug-themed crook who wears his goofy suit with a straight face. He schemes for money and is beaten by plucky heroes every time.

feats.scene: Seamnt fires a glue gun at a pair of guards and sticks them together.
Seamnt is flung into a hay wagon and sneezes.

source_title: Drury Walker (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Liarova
summary: Liarova is a gentle grey-skinned engineered watcher who listens to dozens of minds at once and weaves shared dreams over crowds to calm them. Raised in a hidden lab, it prefers guiding quarrels to ending them by force.

feats.scene: Liarova hurls a stalled delivery truck across a loading yard with a pulse of focused thought.
Liarova shrugs off a thrown crate that would have cracked a human skull.

name: Terluore
summary: Terluore is a tubby, white-haired old gentleman who speaks one magic word and becomes a lightning-bright champion able to fly and lift trucks. He prefers shouting plans from behind the real fighters.

feats.scene: Terluore hoists a bus overhead and flings it into a monstrous crab attacking the waterfront.
Terluore laughs off a collapsing warehouse wall dropped on his back.
Terluore rockets over the harbor faster than a jet.

name: Vausau
summary: Vausau is a flustered business manager who blames an imaginary ailment whenever asked to show off powers he does not have. He survives on bluster, theatrical acting and a talent for slipping out of danger.

feats.scene: Vausau swings a rolled umbrella at a lurking thug and lands a loud, stinging thwack.
Vausau tumbles down a flight of stairs and gets up grumbling but unhurt.

name: Lorau
summary: Lorau is a bumbling elderly gadgeteer in a children's television adventure, forever tinkering with contraptions that half work. He reluctantly steps in whenever his young friends need a clever fix.

feats.scene: Lorau fires a homemade spring-launcher that knocks a cardboard villain flat across the studio.
Lorau takes a tumble from a stepladder and dusts off his knees.

name: Rinocis
summary: Rinocis is a sneering career thief nicknamed for the wrench he carries and the gears he sabotages. Little is known beyond whispers of heists in a farm-country town.

feats.scene: Rinocis wrenches a vault hinge off its mount with a heavy steel bar.
Rinocis takes a crowbar blow across the ribs and keeps running.

name: Telosa
summary: Telosa is a green-eyed, wild-haired daughter of a gambling crook, fighting in a stylised cartoon-inspired world. She laughs through every scrap and leaves a trail of cards and confetti.

feats.scene: Telosa kicks a steel door off its frame during a rooftop chase.
Telosa bounces off a parked van and rolls back to her feet grinning.

name: Sesenum
summary: Sesenum is a ruthless stalker of glamorous strangers, creeping through back alleys with a blade for cutting boxes. She feels little pain and hides well in shadows, and her cruelty is her only talent.

feats.scene: Sesenum drives a blade through a thick leather jacket in a single lunge.
Sesenum keeps sprinting after taking a heavy fall onto concrete.

name: Iarolent
summary: Iarolent is a restless reality-hopping trickster who changes costumes and false parentage as often as she changes towns. She fights with joke weapons such as exploding powder puffs and lipstick that fires bullets.

feats.scene: Iarolent detonates a bundle of trick lipsticks and blows a hole in a brick wall.
Iarolent is flung through a shop window and rolls up laughing.

name: Llironla
summary: Llironla is a pink-haired zealot who rules a tribe of sewer dwellers and preaches that ugliness is a weapon. She scars herself on purpose and fights with brutal, unsettling glee.

feats.scene: Llironla slams a rusted pipe through a guard's shield and sends him sprawling.
Llironla tanks a point-blank shotgun blast to the shoulder and keeps smiling.

name: Llerelu
summary: Llerelu is a pink-haired schoolchild with chalk-white skin, a big grin and a clownish streak, drawn in a cute cartoon style. She turns every classroom disaster into a game with face paint and pranks.

feats.scene: Llerelu flings a custard pie straight into a teacher's face from across the playground.
Llerelu tumbles off a tall slide and bounces up unbothered.

name: Valeretu
summary: Valeretu is a green-haired killer from a doomed possible future, ruined by a father who would not love her. She rampages through a gloomy metropolis with bombs and a bleak sense of humour.

feats.scene: Valeretu plants a charge at the foot of a skyscraper and brings a whole corner of it down.
Valeretu drops off a rooftop, snags a ledge and swings away bruised.

name: Erneo
summary: Erneo is a towering, slow-witted giant whose overgrown frame came from a faulty gland. Clamped into a borrowed suit of armour with a flying mace, he is led around by whichever bully gives the orders.

feats.scene: Erneo swings the glowing mace through a parked bus and cleaves it in half.
Erneo walks through a wall of gunfire and a crushing truck without slowing.
Erneo hovers down a street in pursuit at the pace of a speeding car.

name: Riarno
summary: Riarno is a bald, bulky brute who bullies a river-valley city with raw muscle. His strength is great but his plans are clumsy, and swifter heroes run rings around him.

feats.scene: Riarno tears a lamp post from the pavement and bends it around a van.
Riarno stays standing after a speeding car clips him at the crossroads.

name: Iurncor
summary: Iurncor is a dark-haired young thief serving a brooding armoured prince in a medieval retelling. He slips through castle windows and lifts keys, jewels and secrets without being seen.

feats.scene: Iurncor hurls a dagger across a great hall and pins a banner to the oak beam.
Iurncor drops from a battlement into a hay cart and walks away.

name: Orleseo
summary: Orleseo is a scheming noble of an island kingdom who plots to seize its throne by force and fear. He rules through guards and threats rather than skill, and his schemes unravel when kindness wins the people.

feats.scene: Orleseo slashes a ceremonial sabre through a heavy curtain and a table behind it.
Orleseo is thrown to the marble floor in a scuffle and stays only dazed.

name: Ceeoia
summary: Ceeoia is a cheerful young crimefighter in a cartoon where cars have personalities. He swings from a grapple line, throws gadgets, and rides a sporty red machine that talks back.

feats.scene: Ceeoia launches a boomerang gadget that smashes a robber's getaway tyre and a loading dock crate.
Ceeoia is bumped by a runaway cart and shakes it off.
Ceeoia races through the tunnel on his talking ride at highway speed.

name: Ntovaaul
summary: Ntovaaul is the lone survivor of a dying multiverse, a dark-clad hunter stalking monsters through the ruins of fallen worlds. Grief has hollowed him out, leaving only resolve and the cold of an empty sky.

feats.scene: Ntovaaul drives a blazing lance into a dragon the size of a continent and shatters its flank.
Ntovaaul stands in a wave of ruin that unmakes a whole world and walks out the other side.

name: Naaneau
summary: Naaneau is a sugar-addicted teenage killer from a coastal country, famous for a rampage she began as a child. She fights dirty with little training and cannot stop herself craving sweets.

feats.scene: Naaneau jams a sharpened lollipop stick into a guard's hand and bolts for the door.
Naaneau shakes off a kick to the stomach and bites back.

name: Lltelnau
summary: Lltelnau is a mute winged guardian who reigns over a fiery underworld by silent decree. Immortal, strong and swift, he flies between realms carrying keys and judgments without uttering a word.

feats.scene: Lltelnau brings a closed fist down and levels a craggy mountain of black glass.
Lltelnau stands in a firestorm that scorches a whole plain and is unmarked.
Lltelnau dives down through the underworld skies far faster than sound.

name: Nauiarser
summary: Nauiarser is a masked agent of a poison-dealing syndicate in an island nation, once part of a rival beast-themed gang. He kills for pay and dies in the same shadowy trade.

feats.scene: Nauiarser flicks a poisoned needle that drops a sentry in the doorway.
Nauiarser shrugs off a baton strike to the back of the neck.

name: Seceo
summary: Seceo is a tiny crime boss who dresses like a stringed puppet to unnerve rivals. He hires goons to do the lifting and runs elaborate scams from a cluttered toy-themed hideout.

feats.scene: Seceo pulls a lever that drops a heavy crate onto his enemy's getaway path.
Seceo tumbles from a shelf in his lair and stays only scuffed.

name: Sernantau
summary: Sernantau is a bald, round-faced thug who works alongside a lookalike relative, bickering and bragging as they rob banks. He hits hard enough to bruise but flees at the first sign of real trouble.

feats.scene: Sernantau swings a pair of cast-iron skillets and dents a teller's cage.
Sernantau falls off a building ledge and lands heavily on a awning.

name: Tiusina
summary: Tiusina is a bald, brawling leader of a gang of costumed bank robbers that revives its old crew with a cousin. His crimes are loud and silly, ending in handcuffs more often than loot.

feats.scene: Tiusina shoulder-charges a bank door off its hinges.
Tiusina keeps standing after a cop swings a nightstick across his ribs.

name: Serreo
summary: Serreo is a pink-feathered, cartoon bird who captains a pleasure cruiser and is easily fooled by his clever amphibian pal. He is cheerful, loyal, and a very capable sailor.

feats.scene: Serreo hauls the wheel hard over and slams the bow into a rotted pier.
Serreo is dunked into the harbor by a rogue wave and paddles back aboard.

name: Uloraami
summary: Uloraami is a hired soldier who leads raids for a shadowy group, charging in behind a wall of followers. He fails at his main mission but his troops escape with the samples they were sent for.

feats.scene: Uloraami drives a rifle butt through a crate lid in a cell block corridor.
Uloraami takes a heavy punch to the jaw and stays on his feet.

name: Osaco
summary: Osaco is a tall mage from a mountain people, angry about smog and poisoned rivers. He lures a girl into a ritual to loose a stampede of spirit-beasts and a wave of flame across a crowded square.

feats.scene: Osaco channels a spell through a kidnapped girl and sets a whole plaza ablaze.
Osaco is thrown into a stone statue by a counterspell and rises with a snarl.

name: Oleam
summary: Oleam is a pale, pink-eyed assassin, the overlooked son of a ruthless immortal chieftain. Healing waters have stretched his lifespan and toughened his body, and he serves with fierce, unrewarded loyalty.

feats.scene: Oleam drives a short blade through a reinforced door in a swift double strike.
Oleam endures a fall through a glass atrium and walks off.
Oleam sprints along a rooftop at the pace of an elite runner.

name: Tonamse
summary: Tonamse is a black-haired woman who spins wind into twisters and hovers on the swirling gale. She joins a crew of storm-bringers and uses her gusts for burglary and chaos.

feats.scene: Tonamse whips up a funnel that tears the roof off a warehouse.
Tonamse is slammed against a billboard by a rival's blast and drops to a crouch.
Tonamse rides her own wind down a boulevard faster than traffic.

name: Llurilro
summary: Llurilro is a red-haired, pipe-smoking sailor of the old wooden-ship days who turns to flying bombers when war arrives. He is brave, cheerful and sure-handed at the helm of any craft.

feats.scene: Llurilro hoists a harpoon and drives it deep through a hull plank.
Llurilro survives a plunge from the rigging onto the deck.

name: Esveotum
summary: Esveotum is a steady, bald harbor-town patrolman, engaged to a fellow officer. He walks his beat, breaks up brawls on the docks, and does his job without fuss.

feats.scene: Esveotum tackles a fleeing pickpocket onto the quay planks.
Esveotum takes a bottle to the shoulder during a dockside brawl and arrests the thrower.

name: Serllelu
summary: Serllelu is a hero-shaped weapon: a muscle-bound patriot's body secretly driven by a tyrant's stolen mind. Built to be a poster-boy for a rigged campaign, he hides cruel ambitions behind a flag and a grin.

feats.scene: Serllelu pummels an armoured car into a crumpled heap with his bare fists.
Serllelu takes a rifle volley square in the chest and keeps advancing.

name: Varevor
summary: Varevor is a heavy-fisted enforcer for a street gang that harasses an archer vigilante. He drives a hard bargain with his knuckles and has no patience for strategy.

feats.scene: Varevor punches through a brick wall to snatch a fleeing rival.
Varevor walks away from a head-on crash with a stolen van.

name: Tausimi
summary: Tausimi is a blue-skinned, one-limbed ring-bearer from a far-off peacekeeping force who bends stubborn will into glowing constructs. A battered lantern recharges the ring and keeps him aloft.

feats.scene: Tausimi shapes a giant emerald hammer and flattens a row of enemy bunkers.
Tausimi raises a shimmering barrier that absorbs a full cannon salvo.
Tausimi streaks between moons in the time it takes to cross a town.

name: Iusuvor
summary: Iusuvor is a tiny, black-eyed imp from a flat, colourful dimension who adores a masked acrobat and sincerely wants to help. He can warp reality, change shape, teleport and fly around his idol's rooftop adventures.

feats.scene: Iusuvor snaps his fingers and turns a runaway truck into a harmless pile of balloons.
Iusuvor bounces off a falling lamp post and giggles.

name: Teroas
summary: Teroas is a hapless colonial lad whose strange gift cracks and splinters whatever stands near him. Applicants like him are turned away because a handshake with him spells ruin for friends and foes alike.

feats.scene: Teroas touches a bridge rail and a fracture races down the whole span until it crumbles.
Teroas trips over his own shoelaces and skids across a pavement.

name: Iumsa
summary: Iumsa is an ordinary city dweller handed unexpected abilities by a billionaire's scheme and who takes up a costume to guard the streets. A dark-haired volunteer, he fights bravely in a clash that costs many lives.

feats.scene: Iumsa leaps and lands a heavy blow that dents a metal shutter.
Iumsa shrugs off a flying chunk of concrete in the melee.

name: Illser
summary: Illser is a loyal bald eagle, kept as a pet and best friend by a gruff masked vigilante. He glides above rooftops, grabs foes with his talons and refuses to be house-trained.

feats.scene: Illser dives and rakes his talons across a gunman's gun hand.
Illser tumbles through a hedge after a collision and hops up squawking.
Illser stoops on a fleeing rabbit at the speed of a diving raptor.

name: Riaeorli
summary: Riaeorli is a brown-feathered pet eagle with yellow eyes who patrols the skies for his owner, a boastful soldier of fortune. His talons and wings are his only weapons.

feats.scene: Riaeorli swoops low and snatches a radio from a lookout's hand.
Riaeorli takes a clip from a branch and recovers mid-air.
Riaeorli banks over a canyon rim at full speed.

name: Oramoan
summary: Oramoan is a bald, sickly pirate who sails the underground tunnels of a great city with iron hooks in place of hands. Bathing near a glowing relic poisoned his body, and he is wasting away between drinks.

feats.scene: Oramoan swings both hooks and rips a turnstile bar loose.
Oramoan keeps standing after a hard shove into a tiled platform wall.

name: Tiuvalan
summary: Tiuvalan is a grey-haired crime lord who collects secrets by listening through walls and keyholes. He is taken down in a single outing by a feathered hero.

feats.scene: Tiuvalan hurls a heavy ashtray at a window and shatters it.
Tiuvalan takes a shove against a desk and wheezes.

name: Aulesinil
summary: Aulesinil is a dark-haired freelance reporter chasing a string of grisly murders through a large coastal city. He suspects a ghostly avenger but never pins down the truth behind it.

feats.scene: Aulesinil shoves a stuck newsroom door open with his shoulder.
Aulesinil is knocked flat by a thug's punch and gets back up with notebook in hand.

name: Raseveo
summary: Raseveo is a dark-haired city preacher who campaigns against street drugs, angering a local mobster. Threatened again and again, he hires a lookalike stand-in to protect his wife and young son.

feats.scene: Raseveo slams a hand on the pulpit and the whole congregation falls silent.
Raseveo endures a shove from a gang enforcer on the church steps.

name: Eoialnu
summary: Eoialnu is a wealthy rancher who finds a trinket in a souvenir stall and becomes convinced he is the creator of everything. While it lasts he can heal wounds, then wakes with no memory when the trinket is removed.

feats.scene: Eoialnu waves a hand over a bleeding patient and the wound closes at once.
Eoialnu takes a punch in the face and merely blinks.

name: Telliu
summary: Telliu is a brown-haired racketeer who runs a blackmail ring in a capital city, using a seductive informant to coax secrets out of officers. His gang is rounded up by a band of university girls and a masked heroine.

feats.scene: Telliu pounds a desk and sends a typewriter crashing to the floor.
Telliu goes down under a pile of cheering students and is cuffed.

name: Miauau
summary: Miauau is a small world conjured inside a newborn cosmos to test whether a people could flourish without a caped champion. Its history runs in a hyper-fast blur, ending with the people inventing their own legends.

feats.scene: Miauau endures the furious heat of its own sun-driven birth and a whole civilisation's rise within one blink.

name: Llutareo
summary: Llutareo is a weathered prairie farmer who pulls a bawling infant from a burning wreck on a country road and raises the child with his wife. His quiet decency and stubborn heart make him the moral anchor of a small farming town.

feats.scene: Llutareo heaves a smouldering wreck panel aside with both arms to reach the screaming child.
Llutareo endures scorching heat on his shoulders while carrying the child to safety.

name: Siullsil
summary: Siullsil is a pale, white-haired bloodsucker who leads a cult of fanatical night-dwellers from a humid port town. He is strong, swift and nearly impossible to wound, yet daylight burns him to ash.

feats.scene: Siullsil punches through a stone wall of a cellar and drags a screaming captive through the hole.
Siullsil walks off a point-blank truck collision with only torn clothes.
Siullsil outruns a speeding car down a dark alley.

name: Arseo
summary: Arseo is a red-eyed, grey-haired sentinel of paradise, assigned to bar the gates to an invading army of ancient giants. Overconfident and lazy, he steps forward alone and is burned to the bone by a single blast.

feats.scene: Arseo swings a radiant spear and shatters a cliff face guarding the approach.
Arseo endures a searing bolt that chars him to the skeleton, yet the gate stands.
Arseo wheels across the sky above the gates faster than sound.

name: Estamo
summary: Estamo is a hulking clockwork giant forged by a vengeful inventor, built to parrot every order it hears. Its blind obedience makes it deadly in the lab and disastrous at the edge of a high window.

feats.scene: Estamo pounds a factory wall with iron fists and brings down a section of brickwork.
Estamo shrugs off a volley of pistol rounds and a swinging beam.

name: Urnstu
summary: Urnstu is a reborn nightmare with black hair and, at times, no eyes at all, who stalks the sleeping world after an unhappy life ended in despair. She is both haunted and haunting, wearing a grin she once borrowed from a murderer.

feats.scene: Urnstu rakes a hand across a dreamer's bedroom and the walls peel away into screaming dark.
