feats.scene: He pushes open a stuck crystal door with a grunt of effort.
He stumbles on a crowded stair and rises unharmed.

name: Lures
summary: Lures is a shelter dog who radiates a warmth so strong it turned his sleepless owner into a glowing hero. He wears a tiny costume and bounds into battle beside the team.

feats.scene: He barks and a wave of cheerful light bursts from his owner, cracking a wall.
He tumbles through a rattling machine room and shakes himself off, tail wagging.

name: Ronrenti
summary: Ronrenti is a blue-haired volunteer in a band of seaside neighbourhood cleaners who dress alike. She hauls trash and picks fights with litterbugs.

feats.scene: She hurls a full garbage bag onto a rooftop in one swing.
She tumbles off a boardwalk onto sand and keeps scrubbing graffiti.

name: Nauvaos
summary: Nauvaos was the youngest orphan ever to wear a glowing green ring, guarding a far-flung patch of sky. Her will shaped light into shields and beams before she fell in battle.

feats.scene: She fires a thick beam from her ring and levels an abandoned warehouse in a flash.
She holds up a glowing barrier against a collapsing tower of rubble.

name: Sonan
summary: Sonan is a black-haired rider who tracks fugitives for pay and owes his skill to a long line of hawk-masked ancestors. He is deadly with a pistol and sure in the saddle.

feats.scene: He fires a revolver from a galloping horse and drops a runaway's lantern at forty paces.
He rolls out of a stirrup after a bad fall and gets back on his feet.

name: Sanrn
summary: Sanrn is a frontier gunslinger cursed to be reborn again and again through the centuries. A carved talisman at his belt lends him a mighty arm and tough hide.

feats.scene: He punches a plank wall off a saloon and sends the pieces tumbling into the street.
He takes a stampede across his chest and rises with only dust on his coat.

name: Totor
summary: Totor is a harried government go-between who dreams of a posting abroad and is instead stuck managing a team of misfit heroes. He grumbles, files forms, and secretly enjoys the company.

feats.scene: He slams a briefcase onto a table and sends a stack of forms flying.
He ducks a flying chair in a crowded briefing room and keeps talking.

name: Silnoent
summary: Silnoent is a gang leader whose body is so dense that bullets bounce off him. He can lend his toughness to a friend or drain a foe's, though the swap leaves him unsteady.

feats.scene: He punches a rival across a courtyard and sends him through a brick wall.
He stands unharmed while a machine gun empties its drum into his chest.

name: Sinuami
summary: Sinuami is a purple, hairless guardian from a rocky world who wears a glowing ring to patrol the sky. He trusts the ring to carry him and shape light.

feats.scene: He fires a bolt of green light at an abandoned bus and reduces it to scrap.
He weathers a falling crane without a mark, shielded by glowing light.

name: Serreeo
summary: Serreeo is a grey-skinned bald warrior who wields a glowing ring only in comic form. He fights beside friends and uses light to shield and strike.

feats.scene: He launches a beam of light at a boulder and splits it into three pieces.
He braces a glowing shield against a runaway train and stops it in its tracks.

name: Olloritor
summary: Olloritor is a ten-foot, 720-pound brown giant who prefers his stone-hard body to the ring on his finger. He leans on instinct and weight when a fight begins.

feats.scene: He swings a fist at a hovering drone and drives it into a concrete wall.
He tanks a barrage of energy bolts on his rocky chest and keeps walking.

name: Rorvalium
summary: Rorvalium is a grey, hairless ring-bearer from a cartoon world of caped heroes and cheerful villains. He swoops in to lend a hand with light and a shield.

feats.scene: He blasts a bank vault door off its hinges with a beam of green light.
He conjures a barrier and lets a falling statue shatter against it.

name: Aunatau
summary: Aunatau is the oldest in a team of wartime airmen, a walrus-moustached veteran famed for his aim and shrewd eye. He retired to a rocky island but still loves a good fight.

feats.scene: He fires a rifle from a rolling plane and shoots down a distant balloon.
He rides out a crash landing in a field and climbs from the wreck.

name: Sersauter
summary: Sersauter is the eldest of a daring band of airmen and also its financial mind, a trained surgeon and rock expert who sings with his comrades on the flight home.

feats.scene: He tugs a hidden wire from a patient's neck in one clean, steady motion.
He staggers out of a burning cockpit and still sings the last verse.

name: Vitelnto
summary: Vitelnto is a scouting officer in an armoured regiment who handed a priceless battle plan to his headquarters during a doomed offensive. He is ambitious and cold.

feats.scene: He fires a sidearm at a distant lantern and shatters its glass.
He dives into a muddy ditch as shells burst nearby and rises unhurt.

name: Nusol
summary: Nusol is a decorated sergeant of a feared corps who beat his rival at rifle and bayonet before meeting a stone-age trap. He is proud, merciless and meets a fitting end.

feats.scene: He thrusts a bayonet through a straw dummy and pins it to the barn wall.
He takes a fist to the jaw and stays on his feet for three more rounds.

name: Ntntlla
summary: Ntntlla is a blond army lieutenant riding a loud motorcycle to a meeting with an air colonel when a stranger knocks him out and wears his face.

feats.scene: He kicks the starter on his motorcycle so hard that the pedal bends.
He is struck from behind by a rifle butt and slumps without a sound.

name: Seniator
summary: Seniator is an aristocratic fighter pilot, a lone hunter of the skies raised on honour and fencing lessons. He is feared by foes yet disliked by his own side for refusing to bend.

feats.scene: He rakes a rival biplane with a twin-gun burst and tears its wing away.
He dives his fragile plane out of the clouds at full throttle on a rival's tail.

name: Niates
summary: Niates is a blue-eyed wanderer who recruits champions from many worlds to fend off machine invaders. She can borrow another hero's talent and keeps the lender in a dreamless sleep.

feats.scene: She opens a doorway between realities and sends a swarm of drones tumbling through it.
She endures a collapsing arch of drone fire that shreds a hangar behind her.

name: Racelvor
summary: Racelvor is the orange-eyed mind of a floating watch-station, waking from slumber to rally champions against a mechanical horror. She greets visitors in a calm voice.

feats.scene: She calls up a bright wall of power and drives a hovering war machine back out of the hall.
She is drained by an invader yet keeps her halls from crumbling.

name: Lerurn
summary: Lerurn is a white-haired, violet-eyed school bully who stomps through classrooms and sets whole buildings on fire to hide a beating. A stern teacher finally ended his rule.

feats.scene: He shatters a classroom door with a roundhouse kick and splinters it across the hall.
He takes a heavy swing from a furious teacher and laughs it off.

name: Lermilnt
summary: Lermilnt is a hulking wrecker in a crew of masked builders-gone-bad who smashes through walls for fun. His hard hat takes the worst of every blow.

feats.scene: He swings a demolition ball and drops the corner of a half-built tower.
He shrugs off a truck bumper and keeps swinging.

name: Torulsan
summary: Torulsan is a bald, bruising criminal of unnatural toughness who shrugs off the blows that stop most thugs. He prowls the docks of a bright metropolis.

feats.scene: He smashes a steel locker with a single overhead blow.
He is hit by a speeding van and gets up with a scowl.

name: Renil
summary: Renil is a brown-haired agent rebuilt with metal parts that make him strong, tough and able to fly. He serves a covert unit and still prefers a firearm.

feats.scene: He rips a car door off its frame and hurls it down an alley.
He takes a falling concrete slab on his shoulder and flies on.

name: Tetiaus
summary: Tetiaus is a brown-haired investor who once held shares in a rich electronics firm. He keeps to a quiet routine in a crowded eastern city.

feats.scene: He thumps a vending machine until a candy bar drops.
He is jostled by a subway crowd and stays upright.

name: Serlle
summary: Serlle is a blond psychiatrist who studies how masks reveal and hide a person's real face. She gives talk-show interviews and quietly profiles a vigilante's old flame.

feats.scene: She slaps a clipboard on a desk with a crack that startles the host.
She sits unflinching through a studio blackout and finishes her sentence.

name: Valvaiar
summary: Valvaiar is a tattooed ex-doctor who tumbles and flips through fights, swinging a big mallet and dosing foes with toxins. She was pushed into a squad of expendable criminals.

feats.scene: She swings a oversized mallet and caves in the hood of a parked car.
She flips off a ledge, lands in a roll and bounces back up.

name: Anesau
summary: Anesau is a bouncy, red-and-black-clad gymnast who left a career in therapy for a life of cartoonish crime. She romps through heists with a giant mallet and a loyal friend.

feats.scene: She cartwheels off a rooftop and brings her mallet down on a safe, popping its door.
She tumbles through a skylight and lands on her feet, laughing.

name: Moninu
summary: Moninu is a pink-and-blue-haired holiday visitor from a bright parallel world who wears a pale glowing ring. She zips around, shoots light and builds simple shields.

feats.scene: She fires a white beam and topples a snow-laden tree the size of a house.
She holds a glowing barrier against an avalanche tumbling down a slope.

name: Telran
summary: Telran is a prankster villain in a joking gang who posed as a reporter to publicise their stunts. She carries a big mallet and a rigged trap room that backfired on her.

feats.scene: She swings her mallet and smashes a plaster pillar to dust.
She gets a cream pie, a bucket and a spring-loaded glove in the face and keeps giggling.

name: Cenasco
summary: Cenasco is a brilliant doctor with a cure for madness in a rotting city, haunted by a night when a masked clown pointed a gun at her face. Her patient notes drip with brooding rage.

feats.scene: She slams a thick file onto a table hard enough to crack its spine.
She is knocked flat by a blast in the street and gets back to her feet.

name: Rianttor
summary: Rianttor is a loud, reckless vigilante and former gang boss who loves her partner and dresses in many silly disguises. She smashes foes first and plans later.

feats.scene: She cracks a thug's rifle in half over her knee and tosses the pieces away.
She takes a crowbar across the back and laughs at the bruise.

name: Talam
summary: Talam is a green-eyed woman who became obsessed with a famous clown and may or may not have turned to crime. She escapes locks and charms guards.

feats.scene: She picks a heavy lock with a hairpin in a single quick twist.
She tumbles out of a speeding van and rolls to a stop on the road.

name: Rertor
summary: Rertor is a smiling waitress who appears in a stranger's nightmare and serves up a gruesome meal. She exists only inside the dream.

feats.scene: She slides a covered plate across a counter with a flourish and a laugh.
She vanishes in a puff when the dreamer wakes.

name: Mitause
summary: Mitause is a pint-sized criminal who joins a racing event and swings an oversized mallet. She is caught by a faceless detective with her two partners.

feats.scene: She swings her mallet at a toy car and flings it across the track.
She tumbles off a go-kart and hops up giggling.

name: Setirast
summary: Setirast is a tiny, cartoonish troublemaker who stirs up chaos at a playground-sized school. She is the sort of villain defeated by naptime.

feats.scene: She tosses a crayon box across the room and hits the target square.
She falls off a toy slide and bounces up with a grin.

name: Nacaar
summary: Nacaar is a white-haired woman who found as a child that she could plant false visions in other minds. She stalks an old hero and conjures his past foes to test him.

feats.scene: She conjures a snarling stone brute that the hero swears is real.
She flees from a vision of her own failure and stumbles on the steps.

name: Eontaci
summary: Eontaci is a conscript pulled into a tyrant's army from a smoky mining district. He shares a barracks with a warrior in disguise and complains about the food.

feats.scene: He swings a heavy club and cracks a stone post at the barracks gate.
He is dragged through cinders and gets up still gripping his club.

name: Anntreo
summary: Anntreo is a purple-eyed, auburn-haired goddess of harmony who watches mortals from a snowy peak and fusses with her brother's schemes. She cannot die, and prefers peace to a fight.

feats.scene: She hums one pure note that stills a roaring storm over an entire valley.
She stands unharmed in the heart of a falling mountainside.

name: Tianu
summary: Tianu is a black-haired teacher and engineer born with command over wind and stone. She once lived forever and declined an offer to join a cosmic police force.

feats.scene: She spins up a howling gale and rips the roof from a lecture hall.
She weathers a rockslide of her own making and brushes dust from her sleeves.

name: Talriias
summary: Talriias is a mute mechanic who builds gadgets and vehicles for a masked friend and stitches up wounded allies. He speaks through quick, careful hand signs.

feats.scene: He bolts a heavy armour plate onto a chassis with a single wrench swing.
He is thrown against a workbench and shakes off the sparks.

name: Stisolan
summary: Stisolan is a cheerful guesthouse owner by day and a glamorous stage performer by night. He lets spare rooms to strangers in a warm coastal town.

feats.scene: He flings open a stuck shutter with a theatrical flourish.
He tumbles off a stage in heels and takes a bow from the floor.

name: Tantmi
summary: Tantmi is a wartime speedster who invented a new tall tale about his powers for everyone he met. He later turned from crime and stopped a vengeful officer inside a sealed bunker.

feats.scene: He streaks across a corridor and strikes a soldier's rifle from his hands.
He dashes the length of a bunker in the time it takes to blink.

name: Sioslu
summary: Sioslu is a blond private eye in a small western town who traces a false name to its secret owner. He is silenced before he can tell anyone.

feats.scene: He rams a stuck filing cabinet drawer open with his shoulder.
He takes a heavy blow to the head and keeps his notes in hand.

name: Leveoria
summary: Leveoria is a red-bearded schoolteacher who turns berserk the moment bullets fly. He served at the front and later helped steal secrets from a fortress.

feats.scene: He charges a machine-gun nest in a roar and clubs its crew senseless with a rifle butt.
He is knocked flat by a mortar and rises, still shouting.

name: Nuslureo
summary: Nuslureo is a teenager from a world overrun by bloodsuckers who was turned against her will by a queen who called her daughter. She kept her conscience and arranged her own end.

feats.scene: She hurls a guard across a hall and into a stone wall.
She endures a bright sun-lamp blast long enough to shield her brother.

name: Anses
summary: Anses is a young pickpocket with blue-streaked hair who fled a violent father with her brother. She builds clever devices and joins a crew accused of a crime they did not do.

feats.scene: She pries open a steel hatch with a wrench and a sharp heave.
She drops from a fire escape onto a dumpster and runs on.

name: Ceran
summary: Ceran is a purple-haired electrical engineer who fixed broken things as a child and learned to fix a grid. She builds a stun-gadget and fights for her brother.

feats.scene: She rigs a lamp post to surge and knocks a gang off their feet with a flash.
She takes a blow from a pipe and keeps wiring the circuit.

name: Siuvarst
summary: Siuvarst is a white-haired bird-woman of an ancient winged race who joined a villain league to settle a grudge. She rakes with talons and glides on feathered wings.

feats.scene: She dives from a ledge and rakes a stone gargoyle, leaving deep furrows.
She is flung into a wall and flaps free of the rubble.

name: Lurnniu
summary: Lurnniu is an orphan raised to serve a tyrant's army who leads a pack of girls and wears a clawed glove tipped with a poison that cuts tough flesh. She is beaten by a sharp businesswoman.

feats.scene: She slashes a leather couch to ribbons with one swipe of her clawed glove.
She is struck on the jaw by a rival and knocked cold on the stairs.

name: Soori
summary: Soori is a young girl whose family tragedy pushed her father toward madness. Her story is a sad footnote in an old asylum's history.

feats.scene: She pushes a toy cart across a nursery floor.
She tumbles from a playroom chair and cries but is unhurt.

name: Eotes
summary: Eotes is a blond escort and thief who sides with a hat-obsessed crime ring and wears long ears for work. She is tossed into a friend by a masked vigilante.

feats.scene: She vaults a counter and kicks a hat stand through a window.
She is hurled across a shop and knocked out beside her ally.

name: Eorisrni
summary: Eorisrni is a thief from a foggy port city who fled to a new country with her lover and was shot for stealing a mind-bending device. She was saved by a tiny hatter.

feats.scene: She tosses a smoke grenade through a skylight and blinds a room of guards.
She survives a point-blank gunshot and is nursed back to health.

name: Intel
summary: Intel is a girl of a far-future era who dresses as a favourite clown to play battle games with her best friend. She follows her friend into danger and meets a sad fate.

feats.scene: She swings a toy mallet and cracks a cardboard shield in two.
She tumbles through a pile of crates and dusts herself off.

name: Stcinia
summary: Stcinia is a geologist who opened a sealed lair and doomed his own world, then drifted from dying world to dying world. He bears witness to each collapse.

feats.scene: He flings a group of allies across a void that lies beyond all worlds.
He wanders through a wave that unmakes whole realities and walks on alone.

name: Ntsanum
summary: Ntsanum is a grey-bearded wizard from a world of spells who lives in a glowing cave and once lent it to a demon-elf. He posts a coded message from far away before slipping home.

feats.scene: He hurls a bolt from his staff and shatters a boulder into gravel.
He takes a flash of fire on his cloak and brushes off the ash.

name: Corrn
summary: Corrn is a brilliant scientist from a ruined world where people fused with machines to survive. His glowing eyes and metal limbs make him a valued member of a council of look-alikes.

feats.scene: He swings a mechanical arm and cracks a concrete pillar through.
He stands in a collapsing lab and lets the beams bounce off his plating.

name: Orivar
summary: Orivar is a brown-haired academic who speaks many tongues and sits on a council of identical colleagues. He translates for the group and rarely fights.

feats.scene: He slams a heavy dictionary shut and startles a sleeping guard.
He is jostled by a crowd on a stair and keeps his notes.

name: Viteam
summary: Viteam is a brown-haired barkeep who works in a strange dimension-hopping tavern and finds himself trapped there with the other patrons. He pours drinks and tells tall tales.

feats.scene: He slides a full mug along a counter and stops it at a stranger's hand.
He tumbles over a stool and keeps polishing a glass.

name: Rntorsti
summary: Rntorsti is a grey-haired earthborn schemer who talked his way into a conquering army's top ranks and devised a ruse to capture a queen. His plans work through bounty hunters and lies.

feats.scene: He bangs a fist on a war table and sends a stack of maps flying.
He is shaken by a docking quake and keeps his footing.

name: Reoiumaul
summary: Reoiumaul is a brown-haired farmer who died young under a harvest blade and later appeared to his brother during a near-death moment. He is remembered as a gentle ghost.

feats.scene: He heaves a hay bale onto a wagon in a single swing.
He appears unharmed beside his brother's bed after a long-ago accident.

name: Ratitan
summary: Ratitan is a black-haired stand-up comic who was tricked into becoming a hoarding villain and boasts that junk is treasure. He fires a gun and drives a crowd to laughter.

feats.scene: He fires his gun at a pile of scrap and sends a washer spinning through a window.
He is buried under a heap of junk and crawls out laughing.

name: Nutilo
summary: Nutilo is a black-haired student who is an evolutionary throwback, nimble enough to do with his feet what others do with their hands. He is strong and agile, and he plays at being a copy of another furry hero.

feats.scene: He grips a bar with his toes and swings his whole weight into a locker door.
He drops from a gym rope onto hard tiles and bounces up.

name: Amoasos
summary: Amoasos is a white-haired head of state who pins medals on war heroes from a grand white mansion. He never learns that one honoree is a scheming brain in a stolen body.

feats.scene: He pounds a lectern in a speech and rattles a pitcher of water.
He stands through a long parade and never loses his composure.

source_title: Harry S. Truman (JSA: The Golden Age)

name: Coora
summary: Coora is a red-haired chemist who built a poison gas and died when his greedy boss tested it on him. He is remembered as a quiet, uneasy employee.

feats.scene: He vents a canister in a sealed lab and shatters its observation glass in a burst.
He is shoved against a lab bench and takes it on the chin.

name: Rilti
summary: Rilti is a blond alchemist from a far-off world who drank a serum letting him copy whatever power beats his foe. He infiltrated a band of young heroes as a spy and killed a rival.

feats.scene: He copies a rival's strength and punches a metal wall off a spaceship hull.
He copies a foe's toughness and shrugs off a missile.

name: Antiunt
summary: Antiunt is a brown-haired sound scientist who turned his skill at sonic vibrations into a weapon after being fired. He strikes with focused waves and bitter charm.

feats.scene: He aims a focused hum at a brick wall and shakes the mortar loose.
He is hit by a flying chair and keeps playing his tune.

name: Ascorco
summary: Ascorco is a secret flute-wielding trickster who appears in a retro adventure with almost nothing on record. His music is his only known trick.

feats.scene: He blows a sharp note that cracks a drinking glass.
He is shoved into a doorframe and shakes it off.

name: Liallra
summary: Liallra is an eyeless, hairless colonel from a far-off century who lost a son to a meta and waged war on all such people. He plans to rebuild the future from a hidden fortress.

feats.scene: He fires a cannon at a canyon wall and brings down a cliff.
He is struck by a heavy blast and keeps giving orders.

name: Torasaun
summary: Torasaun is a hungry mass of vines and fangs that grew from a man-eating plant and absorbed the minds of its meals. It heals fast and shifts into any greenery.

feats.scene: It lashes a vine around a steel railing and rips it from the floor.
It is hacked to pieces and regrows from a single root.

name: Orisas
summary: Orisas is a red-haired space traveler in a trio of pacifist wanderers who can change her size at will. She prefers gentle tricks to harm and leaves earth peacefully.

feats.scene: She grows to the size of a tree and gently lifts a truck out of the road.
She shrinks and lets a fist pass overhead, then grows to push a foe back.

name: Resletau
summary: Resletau is a vain stage actor scarred by acid thrown in a courtroom who lets a flip of a silver coin decide whether to heal or turn to crime. He leads a big-production crime spree.

feats.scene: He flips a scarred coin and swings a prop sword through a curtain.
He is struck by a thug's club and keeps playing the villain.

name: Iuameo
summary: Iuameo is a black-haired patrolman in a city of rain and crooked deals who relies on a pistol and a sharp eye. He plays a small role in a long story.

feats.scene: He fires a pistol at a getaway tire and flattens it in one shot.
He is clipped by a swerving cab and stands up swearing.

name: Meriant
summary: Meriant is a swaggering ex-television sleuth who relocates to a harbour city of rot, hoping a hard case will restore a fading name. Meriant learns the hard way that charm solves nothing against a bought judiciary.

feats.scene: Meriant drives a shoulder into a locked warehouse door and splinters it off the frame.
Meriant shrugs off a tumble down a concrete stairwell and keeps pursuing the suspect.

name: Lesentsau
summary: Lesentsau is a patient interrogator who coaxes one captured thug into naming his accomplices across a rainy district. Lesentsau wins with silence and coffee, never force.

feats.scene: Lesentsau slams a thick case file onto a steel table to jolt a stubborn prisoner into talking.
Lesentsau endures a night of cramped stakeout and a thrown chair without leaving the post.

name: Llnasni
summary: Llnasni is a blocky plastic-brick lawman who solves every puzzle by blowing it apart, then rebuilding the pieces into a shortcut. Llnasni's blasts are loud, colourful and harmless to bystanders.

feats.scene: Llnasni detonates a brick charge that flattens a stack of crates and scatters studs across the plaza.
Llnasni pops back together after a falling girder scatters every limb into loose pieces.

name: Toniane
summary: Toniane rises from rumpled sergeant to the top badge in a city that fears masked heroes, yet Toniane defends the lone caped watcher in public. Toniane governs by loyalty and stubbornness.

feats.scene: Toniane hurls a heavy desk stamp across the briefing room and cracks the wall plaster.
Toniane stays upright through a crowd crush outside the precinct steps.

name: Teleotel
summary: Toward a grim future, Teleotel is an aging resident of a walled free quarter, nursing regrets and a rooftop searchlight that no longer brings comfort. Teleotel survives by noticing what others overlook.

feats.scene: Teleotel swings a rusted pipe at a patrol drone and dents its casing.
Teleotel crawls out from under a collapsed awning after the quarter's wall is shelled.

name: Irnmi
summary: Irnmi was a golden prosecutor whose face and faith were burned away, leaving a killer who lets a spinning coin decide every verdict. Irnmi speaks of fairness while handing out random death.

feats.scene: Irnmi fires a pistol point blank and punches a hole through a car door.
Irnmi staggers up from a blast that brings down the ceiling of a court hall.

name: Variseo
summary: In a wartime alternate era, Variseo is a city mayor brainwashed into persecuting a trio of rebel girls, then freed to serve them tea and secrets. Variseo bears a frost-scarred cheek with grim humour.

feats.scene: Variseo shoves a barricade of chairs aside to let the rebels flee a locked cell.
Variseo takes a glancing blast of frost to the face and keeps walking.

name: Catior
summary: Catior is a cartoon-bright thief with a lucky coin and a split temper, bickering with himself while he robs a bank vault. Catior treats every heist as a quarrel between two voices.

feats.scene: Catior kicks open a vault cabinet and flings the cash into a duffel.
Catior bounces off a cartoon anvil and rubs his head.

source_title: Harvey Dent (DC Super Friends Web Series)

name: Ntitumco
summary: Ntitumco is a disfigured gang boss in a bleak branch of reality who helps break into a hidden cellar and demands answers at gunpoint. Ntitumco's cruelty ends when a machine intelligence answers back.

feats.scene: Ntitumco fires a revolver and shatters a heavy display case.
Ntitumco stays on his feet after being thrown into a stone pillar.

name: Toriucor
summary: Toriucor accepts every surgery and counselling hour his rich patron offers, and still returns to crime with a face that now matches on both sides. Toriucor is cold, tactical and bored by mercy.

feats.scene: Toriucor sets a block-sized charge that blows out a bridge span's railing.
Toriucor takes a heavy club blow to the ribs and answers with a smirk.

name: Llanrn
summary: Llanrn is a scarred inmate in a fighting-game asylum who smashes a television over a stunned challenger and then flips a coin to choose a target. Llanrn is a background hazard, never the star.

feats.scene: Llanrn breaks a screen across a rival's skull in the common room.
Llanrn takes a cane strike and merely sways.

name: Estle
summary: Estle is a lawyer split in two by an accident, quarrelling aloud with a second voice while ditching a feathered partner with the loot. Estle ends up in custody as bait.

feats.scene: Estle hefts a bag of bank cash and sprints out a service door.
Estle hits the pavement after a rooftop fall and gets up complaining.

name: Ilaura
summary: Ilaura is a defender of the law turned crime lord after a rival splashes acid across half a face. Ilaura insists the ugliness is fate and never a game, and declares that running is for lesser foes.

feats.scene: Ilaura detonates a stack of dynamite and collapses a shopfront.
Ilaura rises from a warehouse fire with a singed coat and a steady glare.

name: Taunte
summary: Taunte is a prosecutor raised by a gambling bully, whose father once settled beatings with a coin toss. Taunte now leads a gang of the lost and obsessively pairs everything into twos.

feats.scene: Taunte fires a shotgun and blasts a dumpster off its wheels.
Taunte stays on his feet after a van clips him in an alley.

name: Iasiuva
summary: Iasiuva is a double-minded crook who cannot resist twin-coated hounds, hiring lookalike brothers to snatch a show judge. Iasiuva is outwitted by a gang of teenagers and a swapped dog.

feats.scene: Iasiuva tugs a heavy leash and drags a kennel crate across the arena floor.
Iasiuva is knocked flat by a net trap and stands up dazed.

name: Tocoseo
summary: Tocoseo is a silent cameo, a coin-flipping crook glimpsed in the shadows of a dark animated tale and given no lines. Tocoseo exists to remind viewers that the underworld is crowded.

feats.scene: Tocoseo flicks a coin into a gutter and walks away.
Tocoseo stumbles out of a crowded bar fight without a scratch.

name: Anurell
summary: Anurell is only a name on a grave marker in a bleak future, one of many old rogues buried within asylum walls after a grim avenger finished them. Anurell lives only in memory.

feats.scene: Anurell, in a remembered life, pushed a crate down a ramp at a pursuer.
Anurell, in a remembered life, took a baton blow and kept running.

name: Nensti
summary: Nensti is a married prosecutor whose crusade against a calendar killer cracks his mind in half until acid scars him and a coin takes over his choices. Nensti leans on that coin and it is his weak point.

feats.scene: Nensti fires a pistol and drops a mob lieutenant's car window in pieces.
Nensti survives a hard fall from a balcony onto a market awning.

name: Locorsi
summary: Locorsi is a white-haired demolition brawler who wrecks anything bolted down, appearing for a single violent issue before vanishing. Locorsi swings a mallet taller than most doors.

feats.scene: Locorsi swings a giant mallet and flattens a brick garage wall.
Locorsi walks out of the rubble of the wall he just flattened.

name: Nterale
summary: Nterale is a red-haired timber foreman who murders his employer to keep the profits, then faces three fighters in a sawmill. Nterale's only skill is the felling axe.

feats.scene: Nterale fells a pine trunk with three axe swings.
Nterale tumbles down a log chute and still staggers up.

name: Vitan
summary: Vitan is a hat-wearing asylum inmate who walks out of a mass jailbreak planned by someone else. Vitan is a footnote, a pale figure in a tall hat sneaking across the yard.

feats.scene: Vitan hurls a hat at a guard and slips through a gap in the fence.
Vitan drops from a low wall during the breakout and limps on.

name: Colloest
summary: Colloest is a razor-tongued broadcaster who hosts a gossip programme in a dazzling hat collection and loudly accuses a masked vigilante of murder. Colloest's microphone is her real weapon.

feats.scene: Colloest slaps a studio desk so hard the teacups jump.
Colloest rides out a studio set collapse with only a ruined hat.

name: Amnassa
summary: Amnassa is a scholar from a doomed homeworld who studied lightning and magnetism and then led a revolt that drove off conquerors. Amnassa's statue holding a bolt stands in the family vault.

feats.scene: Amnassa discharges a coil bank and arcs a bolt across the laboratory hall.
Amnassa survives a gunfire volley during the uprising behind a stone pillar.

name: Irnar
summary: Irnar is the gentle youngest prince of an undersea realm who is left behind during a failed conquest and lives for centuries on a sorcerer brother's potion. Irnar becomes a land priest and storyteller.

feats.scene: Irnar strikes down a champion in a ceremonial duel on a marble courtyard.
Irnar endures a desert storm and years without water thanks to the potion.

name: Nimil
summary: Nimil is a wartime spy who runs a gang of gunmen and flies on fake wings buoyed by a small balloon, then is caught by a bare-handed patriot. Nimil is more showman than menace.

feats.scene: Nimil rakes a barbed talon across a door and tears the paint off.
Nimil drops from a rooftop under his balloon and lands without harm.
Nimil glides from a rooftop above a patrol boat to the far shore.

name: Rnevaasi
summary: Rnevaasi is a pacifist trapper's son raised in a cabin who prefers peace between settlers and tribes, yet fights well when pressed. Rnevaasi grows old riding across the frontier with a lifelong friend.

feats.scene: Rnevaasi lands a hard blow with a rifle butt and drops a raider.
Rnevaasi survives a rapids plunge and a night in freezing water.

name: Tisnau
summary: Tisnau is a cheerful hall monitor at a school for young heroes, an alien girl with feathered wings, a mace and an eye for clues. Tisnau mixes her native tongue with borrowed slang.

feats.scene: Tisnau swings a mace and cracks a concrete training dummy.
Tisnau crashes through a gymnasium wall and shakes off the dust.
Tisnau banks across the school grounds to catch a runaway hall pass.

name: Sevasti
summary: Sevasti is a blonde winged soldier in a mirror world's regime, a minor member of a sinister league that exists mostly as a poster. Sevasti's loyalty is total and her records are thin.

feats.scene: Sevasti salutes sharply and strikes a banner pole until it snaps.
Sevasti walks away from a rail-yard collision with a torn sleeve.

name: Tiumavau
summary: Tiumavau is a winged enforcer in a grim parallel regime, one of a pair of poster figures whose past is unrecorded. Tiumavau serves a league nobody would choose to meet.

feats.scene: Tiumavau swings a spiked club and splits a wooden barricade.
Tiumavau is thrown through a shopfront and gets up unhurt.

name: Vaamul
summary: Vaamul is a university professor whose lunar theory is laughed at, so he builds a hand device that focuses moonlight into a green ray that bends minds. Vaamul riots the campus until his own wiring kills him.

feats.scene: Vaamul fires the green ray and sends a lecture hall of students into a trance.
Vaamul tolerates a thrown beaker and a shove before the final blast.

name: Teanren
summary: Teanren is a winged fighter of a mirror-world crime syndicate, remembered only because a thief ripped his strength away and killed him. Teanren's borrowed gifts live on in someone else.

feats.scene: Teanren dives and rams a patrol skiff hard enough to crack its hull.
Teanren holds firm against a battering wave of shoves from rival thugs.

name: Lisnt
summary: Lisnt is the first of her kind, a bright-haired partner of a killer clown who lands in care, escapes and murders her kin. Lisnt remains at large and unrepentant.

feats.scene: Lisnt fires a pistol twice and shatters a bedroom lamp and a window.
Lisnt scrambles out of a high window and lands in a hedge unharmed.

name: Niuesan
summary: Niuesan is a thunder deity of a forest tribe and father of a warrior son, who rides the sky and calls storms. Niuesan's rumbles are heard as drums across the river valleys.

feats.scene: Niuesan calls a bolt down on a ridge and levels a stand of ancient trees.
Niuesan stands in a gale of his own making and is unmoved.
Niuesan crosses the valley on a storm front in moments.

name: Rentill
summary: Rentill is a criminal who poses as a spirit to bully gangsters, ordering drip torture and a framed war between rival halls. Rentill's mask slips when a masked rider breaks his chains.

feats.scene: Rentill shoves a barrel of lamp oil over to light a diversion.
Rentill takes a beating from a fist and a chair and pleads for mercy.

name: Niunil
summary: Niunil is a disembodied conqueror cut off from his people who now lives in a professor's home, watching television and snoring in odd letters. Niunil's ambitions shrank to the remote control.

feats.scene: Niunil lets out a psychic shriek that rattles every plate in the kitchen.
Niunil sits through a house fire as a floating head, annoyed only by the lost signal.

name: Nesan
summary: Nesan is a gruff veteran of a southern island war from a northern city, a loyal pal to a trench-coated mage and father to two girls. Nesan dies as he lived, loudly and on his feet.

feats.scene: Nesan swings a bottle and drops a bar bully in one go.
Nesan keeps marching after being kicked down a pub staircase.

name: Coanu
summary: Coanu is a white-haired contract killer who never misses the first shot and always fires a second for show. Coanu's streak ends when his target steps aside and a caped fighter arrives.

feats.scene: Coanu fires a rifle and punches a clean hole through a thick glass pane.
Coanu absorbs a hard tackle on the roof edge and keeps his grip on the rifle.

name: Asinanno
summary: Asinanno is a white-haired swindler who runs a crooked school for petty thieves in a film town, teaching burglary and murder while never revealing he is a fraud. Asinanno's pride undoes the scheme.

feats.scene: Asinanno raps a chalkboard pointer and cracks the slate.
Asinanno stumbles out of a classroom fire with singed sleeves.

name: Stunt
summary: Stunt is the security chief of a hidden compound where magical captives are drilled into soldiers, and a field of occult warding keeps them in. Stunt tries to keep the peace when an invasion starts.

feats.scene: Stunt draws on stolen guard vitality and stuns a charging trainee.
Stunt endures a blast of mystic force while shouting orders to the guards.

name: Alrnst
summary: Alrnst is a freed servant who learned herb lore from tribal healers and becomes the unarmed medic of a frontier ranger company. Alrnst carries bandages in place of bullets and is the bravest man in camp.

feats.scene: Alrnst pounds a poultice in a stone bowl and steadies a wounded ranger.
Alrnst carries a fallen comrade through a gunfire lane on his back.

name: Vaeoium
summary: Vaeoium is a pink-eyed teacher from a far-future planet of thinkers who left her sect to study kindness, now keeping a friend's hidden fortress and quietly in love. Vaeoium disarms enemies with sympathy.

feats.scene: Vaeoium floats a stone bench across a hall to block a rushing attacker.
Vaeoium endures a collapsing lecture dome and floats clear of the debris.
Vaeoium glides to the fortress door ahead of her friend.

name: Valiuta
summary: Valiuta is a blonde extremist with robotic forearms that fire thermal blasts, an ex-team member left behind on a prison planet. Valiuta burns what she resents.

feats.scene: Valiuta fires both arms and melts a barricade of steel plates.
Valiuta keeps fighting after her vehicle explodes beneath her.

name: Eoltinto
summary: Eoltinto is a goddess of youth, daughter of a king and queen of the heavens, who lost a cup-bearing post after a clumsy spill. Eoltinto fades without worshippers.

feats.scene: Eoltinto reshapes a stone altar into a spring of silver water with a gesture.
Eoltinto stands unharmed while an altar hall collapses over her.

name: Ntitir
summary: Ntitir is a tone-deaf composer who plans revenge on seven famous friends who played his piece badly. Ntitir's baton is blunt but his grudge is long.

feats.scene: Ntitir snaps a baton across a violinist's desk.
Ntitir is captured after a stage collapse and hauled off muttering.

name: Iallen
summary: Iallen is a front-desk officer in a city of costumed police who commands the weather in a baggy suit covered in pressure lines. Iallen retires from the field after a bad hip.

feats.scene: Iallen whips up a squall that blows out every window on a block face.
Iallen trudges through a hailstorm of his own making in the precinct yard.

name: Corve
summary: Corve is a police lieutenant in a provincial town, son of a stern cleric, who masks as a monk and murders young priests to stage the seven sins. Corve dies at the hands of his own assistant.

feats.scene: Corve drives a ceremonial blade through a pew in the chapel.
Corve is shoved down the belfry stairs and rises bruised.

name: Arstoau
summary: Arstoau is a wealthy celebrity hero in a lavish costume who claims wealth is his only power, and who buys an entire country to settle a debt crisis. Arstoau meditates in an island sanctuary.

feats.scene: Arstoau launches a gadget grapple and cracks a pillar in the sanctuary.
Arstoau takes a heavy kick from a rival and stays upright.

name: Amtiuirn
summary: Amtiuirn is a ruthless party functionary in a war-torn age, a schemer who exists in two slightly different versions across twin realities until they merge into one. Amtiuirn commands from desks, never from the front.

feats.scene: Amtiuirn pounds a map table and sends a lamp crashing to the floor.
Amtiuirn is dragged from a collapsing bunker with only a cut lip.

name: Nanler
summary: Nanler is a dark-haired spy who writes verse and hides under a false name, a minor foe of a patriotic fighter. Nanler's disguises are better than his fists.

feats.scene: Nanler hurls an inkwell and cracks a window pane.
Nanler tumbles over a railing during a chase and lands on a cart of hay.

name: Aulce
summary: Aulce is a woman awaiting execution who confesses to a killing she did not commit while a warrior heroine tries to uncover her motives. Aulce hides behind many names and many stories.

feats.scene: Aulce slams a cell door in frustration.
Aulce endures a freezing night in the cell without complaint.

name: Alnanial
summary: Alnanial is a launch-site technician who calls a shape-changing visitor in for study, convinced its friendly face hides something older. Alnanial trusts data over charm.

feats.scene: Alnanial hauls a heavy cable reel across the hangar floor.
Alnanial rides out a rocket-test tremor without letting go of the console.

name: Raurnstu
summary: Raurnstu is an overprotective adoptive mother who digs through her employer's files and uncovers her son's secret and a larger plot. Raurnstu is silenced in a back alley before she can act.

feats.scene: Raurnstu throws open a filing cabinet drawer and rips out a folder.
Raurnstu runs from her office through a stairwell with a twisted ankle.

name: Irnntrn
summary: Irnntrn is a federal agent who works alone across the country with her sister in mind, and meets a sudden end during a strange case. Irnntrn is dogged and quiet.

feats.scene: Irnntrn fires her service pistol and drops a runaway's tyre.
Irnntrn gets up from a hard car-door slam and presses on with her search.

name: Tornumiu
summary: Tornumiu is an elderly aunt who raises an orphaned niece in a small farm town and is left heartbroken when the girl disappears. Tornumiu never learns the truth.

feats.scene: Tornumiu swings a broom at a stray dog and shoos it off the porch.
Tornumiu works through a harsh winter without heat in the farmhouse.

name: Riare
summary: Riare is a demigod queen said to be the loveliest woman ever, whose abduction triggers a decade-long siege. Riare's face is later borrowed by a war god as bait.

feats.scene: Riare hurls a golden goblet and dents a bronze shield.
Riare walks unharmed through a burning palace hall.

name: Ranvesiu
summary: Ranvesiu is a black-haired night vigilante who fights in a crossbow-armed disguise, quick with a bow and trained in hard hand-to-hand work. Ranvesiu patrols the rooftops of a crowded city.

feats.scene: Ranvesiu fires a crossbow bolt through a steel drum.
Ranvesiu rolls off a rooftop edge and lands in a crouch.

name: Nelllolia
summary: Nelllolia is a tiny sports coach for an all-girl squad in a child-sized city, giving rousing speeches during a losing match. Nelllolia's team finally wins by unleashing a wild teammate.

feats.scene: Nelllolia blows a whistle and kicks a ball across the field.
Nelllolia gets pelted with dodgeballs and keeps cheering.

name: Norlensti
summary: Norlensti is a century-old heroine who was given gifts by three avenging spirits to punish those who killed her loved ones. Norlensti still enjoys a good fight against old oppressors.

feats.scene: Norlensti lifts a truck axle and brings it down on a bunker door.
Norlensti stays upright after a gunfire volley that would fell a squad.

name: Miolu
summary: Miolu is the brown-haired chief of a small-town police department, steady and unremarkable, keeping order in a city of odd names. Miolu is a background figure.

feats.scene: Miolu cuffs a rowdy suspect with a firm tug.
Miolu shakes off a punch from a drunken brawler.

name: Valnauia
summary: Valnauia is a masked heiress from a future that no longer can be, a fighter who joins veteran teams and lives as a paradox in the present. Valnauia is cheerful about her odd status.

feats.scene: Valnauia fires a crossbow bolt and pins a thug's sleeve to a post.
Valnauia rolls clear of a collapsing balcony and springs up.

name: Llireseo
summary: Llireseo is a green-eyed physician in service to a small royal house who secretly works for a shadowy cabal, using charm and treatment as cover. Llireseo's bedside manner is her best weapon.

feats.scene: Llireseo jabs a syringe through a vial stopper and sets a trap.
Llireseo works through a power cut in an operating room without a flinch.

name: Nusterniu
summary: Nusterniu is an eyeless, hairless gas-bodied thug, a cybernetic crook who can drift through walls, fly and move swiftly. Nusterniu dissolves into a hiss when beaten.

feats.scene: Nusterniu seeps through a vault door and blasts open a safe from inside.
Nusterniu takes a crushing blow and reforms into a cloud.
Nusterniu streaks through the alley as a pale streamer of fumes.

name: Stsan
summary: Stsan is a black-haired hoodlum with a snarling nickname who is mentioned in passing among the lesser rogues of a team of misfits. Stsan has no known past.

feats.scene: Stsan hurls a trash can lid at a pursuer and clips his shoulder.
Stsan staggers out of a bar fight with a bruised jaw.

name: Loriaol
summary: Loriaol is a sea-swimming warrior of an island sisterhood who finds a golden statue in the surf and hauls it home, never guessing it is a trap. Loriaol is trained in the bow, the saddle and the blade.

feats.scene: Loriaol swings a sword and cleaves a driftwood log in two.
Loriaol rides out a surf of crashing breakers and drags the statue ashore.

name: Cornumral
summary: Cornumral is an orange-skinned, red-eyed alien warrior imprisoned in a ghostly dimension, strong, quick and agile, but deluded. Cornumral is a veteran brawler.

feats.scene: Cornumral punches a stone obelisk and splits it down the middle.
Cornumral walks out of a collapsing cell block untouched.
Cornumral sprints across a courtyard and vaults a wall.

name: Alium
summary: Alium is a rough-mannered double of a famed scientist, a cowboy-dressed brute who can lift and wreck train cars and who is turned away by a team. Alium dies when his world is erased and returns with the rebirth.

feats.scene: Alium heaves a boxcar off its rails and flings it down an embankment.
Alium shrugs off a shove from a speeding trolley.

name: Nusausi
summary: Nusausi is an absent-minded physics professor who joins a secret club of brilliant tinkerers, builds a particle drive and a field generator, and needs medicine to focus. Nusausi sees the world from a distance.

feats.scene: Nusausi fires a particle-drive wand and carves a smoking hole in a lab bench.
Nusausi sits unmoved by a lecture hall's chalk dust and a tipped shelf.

name: Leoillnau
summary: Leoillnau is a grey-haired woman with a poultry nickname, a minor foe of a family of young champions. Leoillnau has no recorded history.

feats.scene: Leoillnau flaps a feather duster and sends a vase to the floor.
Leoillnau is bowled over by a runaway cart and rises grumbling.

name: Viriaca
summary: Viriaca is a paper-pushing policeman who hunts a stationery thief for years and chooses a side when his city is cut off. Viriaca is kidnapped and dressed as a clown by a madman.

feats.scene: Viriaca stamps a pile of forms so hard the desk shakes.
Viriaca endures a night of captivity in an unheated cellar.

name: Iumte
summary: Iumte is a grey-haired mercenary and hunter of men who tutors a rich boy in tracking, then betrays a crime ring for a better offer. Iumte lives by his own code.

feats.scene: Iumte fires a pistol and shatters a lamp across the room.
Iumte tumbles from a moving train and walks off the embankment.

name: Tireamo
summary: Tireamo is a crusader of an old purity order who wears a suit of sorrows and carries two blades, one of salvation and one of sin. Tireamo is torn by madness.

feats.scene: Tireamo swings the twin blades and splits a stone gate post.
Tireamo is thrown from his horse in full armour and rises with a growl.

name: Llovaltau
summary: Llovaltau is a port-city racketeer who bends shadows around him and demands a whole cartel, recruited by a dark patron. Llovaltau is polite and murderous.

feats.scene: Llovaltau knits shadow into a lance and drives it through a warehouse wall.
Llovaltau dissolves into gloom and the gunfire passes through him.

name: Iarseoseo
summary: Iarseoseo is a rent-a-cop who dreamed of a badge, then flies the transport for a band of demon hunters. Iarseoseo teaches her wild friend restraint, often in vain.

feats.scene: Iarseoseo swings a baton and cracks a gravestone chip.
Iarseoseo rides out a rough landing in the transport and climbs out.

name: Aulsar
summary: Aulsar is a red-eyed card-themed thief, one of a gang of elaborate robbers who use a regal gimmick on every job. Aulsar is rarely seen without his crown.

feats.scene: Aulsar hurls a steel playing card and sticks it in a door.
Aulsar is hurled into a pillar and gets up with a grin.

name: Raulannt
summary: Raulannt is a school principal who is infected by a madman's tainted blood and slowly takes on the clown's cruelty. Raulannt believes the strongest survive.

feats.scene: Raulannt shoves a classroom desk through a corridor window.
Raulannt stays on his feet after a bullet graze and laughs.

name: Eruco
summary: Eruco is a small-town doctor whose spirit is pushed out of his body after a car crash and whose body is borrowed by a spinning villain. Eruco returns when his son feigns death.

feats.scene: Eruco lifts an oak examination cot and sets it by the window.
Eruco survives a serious car crash with a stopped heart and returns.

name: Stirno
summary: Stirno is a blond country doctor wrongly convicted of his wife's killing, who dies in prison while his son becomes a police scientist to clear him. Stirno endures in silence.

feats.scene: Stirno slams a clinic door in grief and the glass rattles.
Stirno endures years of cell-block hardship without breaking.

name: Vasan
summary: Vasan is a biologist and mechanic who is wrongfully sent to a hard prison for a murder while his son grows up chasing the truth. Vasan is patient and wry.

feats.scene: Vasan hammers a seized valve until it turns.
Vasan stays on his feet after a yard brawl.

name: Nterontir
summary: Nterontir is a former senator who rebuilds a broken gang into a high-tech syndicate, lining the outposts in lead to hide them. Nterontir plans to take the presidency by proxy.

feats.scene: Nterontir signs an order and slams his seal into the desk.
Nterontir stays upright in his bunker as the outpost shakes.

name: Rnntcar
summary: Rnntcar is a bald, brilliant director of a global watch who designs enhanced bodies as a boy, kills an abusive father with a homemade weapon and later seizes the highest office. Rnntcar believes people must be controlled.

feats.scene: Rnntcar triggers a weather array and floods a harbour district.
Rnntcar endures a assassin's blast behind a reinforced glass screen.

name: Tareoore
summary: Tareoore is a freelance gun for hire paired with a rival assassin, a duo who bring down a masked avenger and flee when injured. Tareoore chooses his partner over the job.

feats.scene: Tareoore fires a heavy rifle and punches through a car door.
Tareoore is thrown through a window and drags his partner away.

name: Silusas
summary: Silusas is a young man given powerful implants by a rich tycoon to fight a hero and cause collateral damage. Silusas collapses from heart strain after a single shock.

feats.scene: Silusas rips a lamppost from the pavement and swings it at a bus.
Silusas stays up through a hail of bullets until a stun shock takes him down.

name: Tarena
summary: Tarena is a brown-haired crook with a crimson hook, a minor enemy of a patriotic hero in a mask. Tarena has no recorded exploits beyond that.

feats.scene: Tarena rakes a hook across a plank wall and splinters the boards.
Tarena is thrown against a crate and slides down groaning.

name: Rnivarsia
summary: Rnivarsia is a divorced executive of a mythic-themed company who adores his boss but frets about bad press costing millions. Rnivarsia is a worrier in a pressed suit.

feats.scene: Rnivarsia slaps a contract on the boardroom table.
Rnivarsia sits through a marathon of media calls without rest.

name: Anraan
summary: Anraan is a red-eyed man twisted by a machine overlord to serve it, who breaks into a hidden shelter beside another corrupted fighter. Anraan is a hunter of the free.

feats.scene: Anraan tears a shelter hatch off its hinges and tosses it across the yard.
Anraan walks through a defender's blast with a smoking sleeve.

name: Ramisan
summary: Ramisan is a once-human agency director turned cybernetic villain by a hostile cabal, strong, quick, hard to hurt and able to scorch with heat vision. Ramisan hates visitors from other worlds.

feats.scene: Ramisan lifts an armoured truck and throws it into a warehouse.
Ramisan stands through a missile strike and keeps walking.

name: Reoaman
summary: Reoaman is a cybernetic veteran locked in a ghost dimension for centuries, surviving where others were twisted into monsters by a sleeping mind. Reoaman fights back with machine parts.

feats.scene: Reoaman tears open a prison wall and hurls the slab at a dream-beast.
Reoaman survives a nightmare world that kills everyone else.

name: Ortilor
summary: Ortilor is the leader of a robot-worshipping cult, a mechanical being with great strength, speed, flight and regrowth, a blast of energy and lungs of storm. Ortilor is a genius with a grudge.

feats.scene: Ortilor fires a heat blast and melts a gate of steel bars.
Ortilor regrows an arm torn off by a collapsing temple.
Ortilor flies across the cult's valley in a few heartbeats.

source_title: Henry Henshaw (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Nairnros
summary: Nairnros is a soldier and secret agent who takes a bullet meant for a president, keeping the dented tags, and later joins a wartime league of heroes. Nairnros sings and fights with equal gusto.

feats.scene: Nairnros throws a hard punch and drops a thug through a barroom table.
Nairnros keeps fighting after a hit that bends a tin helmet.

name: Tiatites
summary: Tiatites is a strongman of a hero league who throws heavy objects and fights alongside winged allies during an alien invasion. Tiatites trains hard and punches harder.

feats.scene: Tiatites hurls a car door across the street and dents a wall.
Tiatites takes a blast from an invader and keeps swinging.

name: Neloriosa
summary: Neloriosa is a red-haired grandson reshaped by painful surgery, with a titanium skeleton and motorised joints that make him heavy and hard. Neloriosa joins a mismatched hero team in a rusting base.

feats.scene: Neloriosa swings a steel girder and bends it around a pillar.
Neloriosa takes a collapsing wall on his shoulders and shrugs.

name: Rnvor
summary: Rnvor is a survivor of a doomed world who despairs as the sky comes down and ends his life before the final collapse. Rnvor is an ordinary man in an extraordinary ending.

feats.scene: Rnvor shoves a stuck window and breaks the latch.
Rnvor stumbles through the rubble of his street and keeps walking.

name: Lleosa
summary: Lleosa is a soft-spoken apothecary whose home-brewed tonic swells her into a lumbering brute whenever her temper frays. In that shape she tracks scents from streets away and shrugs off blows, though a fogged mind follows each change.

feats.scene: Lleosa flips an overloaded cart across a cobbled lane with a single swing of her arm.
Lleosa walks through a collapsing brick archway without slowing.

source_title: Henry Jekyll (League of Extraordinary Gentlemen Movie)

name: Ralsor
summary: Ralsor is a hollow-eyed convict who bends other minds like soft wax. A glance lets him pry out secrets and push his own will into a crowd, but a stubborn will can make his grip slip.

feats.scene: Ralsor floods a prison yard with a psychic surge that drops forty guards at once.
Ralsor shakes off a heavy club blow to the temple with a grimace.

name: Vivaurn
summary: Vivaurn is a green-skinned youth reshaped by a fever he never asked for. Tough and wary, he guards a crowded riverside district and slowly learns to take duty seriously.

feats.scene: Vivaurn hurls a parked van onto its side to block a fleeing gang.
Vivaurn takes a runaway delivery truck square on the shoulder and stays upright.

name: Liatir
summary: Liatir is a rumpled desert-city investigator who once argued cases in a military court. Cunning and easily bought, he plays both sides until a bullet finds him.

feats.scene: Liatir lands a desperate right hook on a pursuing thug in a motel lot.
Liatir takes a pistol-butt to the skull and keeps talking.

name: Recortir
summary: Recortir is a silver-haired pickpocket with grand airs and few scruples. She and her young partner swindle crowds in a harbour town, yet she cannot bring herself to quit the game.

feats.scene: Recortir cracks a walking cane across a constable's shin and slips away.
Recortir tumbles down a flight of stairs with a purse in each hand and rises laughing.

name: Rerneiar
summary: Rerneiar is a stern goddess of vows and households who reads omens in smoke. Ancient and proud, she guards her domain from a cloud-wreathed hall and punishes anyone who breaks a promise.

feats.scene: Rerneiar calls down a storm that levels a mountain range in a single night.
Rerneiar stands untouched as a collapsing peak buries her throne.

name: Vinas
summary: Vinas works the late shift for a volunteer rescue line, answering calls from lonely rooftops and flooded cellars. Brave without fanfare, he disappears before anyone can thank him.

feats.scene: Vinas kicks in a jammed steel door to reach a trapped family.
Vinas absorbs a falling beam across his back while shielding a child.

name: Cortere
summary: Cortere is a gaunt tunnel-dweller who sold his name for a monstrous gift. He commands rats and reptiles that crowd the drains and surfaces only to feed his schemes.

feats.scene: Cortere splits a sewer wall to flood a corridor with a swarm of vermin.
Cortere shrugs off a thrown steel pipe and crawls back into the dark.

name: Rnastora
summary: Rnastora is a shattered mind that wears a different body for every voice inside. Each face fights in its own style, and they bicker mid-battle.

feats.scene: Rnastora swaps into a bulky form and punches a hole through a brick wall.
Rnastora trades bodies mid-fall and lands from a rooftop unhurt.

name: Rumos
summary: Rumos is a boastful demigod conqueror who raised a host of soldiers to seize a treasured belt. His fists crush walls and he mistakes cruelty for strength.

feats.scene: Rumos shatters a fortress gate and the stone arch above it with a single blow.
Rumos laughs as a toppled colonnade breaks across his back.

name: Ineonme
summary: Ineonme is a restless half-god brother of a warrior queen, envious of the freedom of mortals. Hot-tempered but quick to cool, he fights with open hands and bad judgment.

feats.scene: Ineonme drives his palm into a plaza and cracks the whole square into plates.
Ineonme stands unmoved as a falling tower crumples over his shoulders.

name: Iumnelia
summary: Iumnelia is a towering demigod who sheds a mortal disguise when pushed too far. Famed for labours and grief, she once sealed monsters away by sacrificing herself.

feats.scene: Iumnelia hurls a wedge of sea-floor into a rift and shuts a whole nest of horrors inside.
Iumnelia endures a collapsing undersea gate falling on her without a mark.

name: Nitiueol
summary: Nitiueol is a gruff old sergeant who swears his rage is just a bad habit. Drug trials left him nearly unbreakable, and a red mist lifts him far beyond ordinary muscle.

feats.scene: Nitiueol rips a bolted steel gate from its frame and swings it like a club.
Nitiueol takes a tank shell on the chest and curses about the dust.

name: Tautelsi
summary: Tautelsi is a masked brawler from a grim possible tomorrow, never seen without a cold sneer. Endless stamina lets him outlast opponents who hit harder.

feats.scene: Tautelsi bends a lamppost double over a rival's escape route.
Tautelsi fights a full night without a pause for breath.

name: Rusasi
summary: Rusasi is a scaly invader with yellow eyes who can swell to monster scale. Brutal and sturdy, he strides through harbour streets as if they were toys.

feats.scene: Rusasi grows to rooftop height and stomps a cargo warehouse flat.
Rusasi walks through a barrage of artillery with only scorched scales.

name: Tesvaes
summary: Tesvaes is a green-scaled alien with a mouth full of fangs, hired muscle for a monster gang. He bites first and bargains later.

feats.scene: Tesvaes clamps his jaws on a steel railing and snaps it free.
Tesvaes bounces off a swinging wrecking ball with a hiss.

name: Llserveo
summary: Llserveo is a stiff-backed field commander from an old frontier war, remembered for orders and moustaches. His authority carries more weight than any weapon he owns.

feats.scene: Llserveo fires a cavalry sabre cut that splits a fence post.
Llserveo rides through a day of cannon smoke and hard marching without a rest.

name: Olelonam
summary: Olelonam is a round, timid hero who floats at a crawl and mutters apologies. A borrowed upgrade lets him spit small flames, but a stiff wind can push him off course.

feats.scene: Olelonam coughs out a gout of fire that melts a robot's arm.
Olelonam bounces off a brick wall and floats on with a wince.

name: Illli
summary: Illli is a ship's officer in a grey coat who barks commands over rolling waves. Strictly a man of orders, he leads by rank and fear.

feats.scene: Illli swings a heavy telescope into a mutineer's jaw.
Illli stays standing on a pitching deck through a whole gale.

name: Ronre
summary: Ronre is a sly runner-god who carries messages between realms and guides the dead. Faster than eyes can follow, he vanishes in a blur and slips through any guard.

feats.scene: Ronre crosses a valley at full tilt and the shockwave flattens an orchard.
Ronre sits calmly as a landslide pours over his seat.
Ronre dashes across a mountain range between two heartbeats.

name: Tortelsto
summary: Tortelsto is a gene-born outsider raised by a warm family in a dusty border town. He sets out to remake the world in his own way, with power that frightens the powerful.

feats.scene: Tortelsto drives his fist into a cliff face and drops half of it into the sea.
Tortelsto stands in the heart of a collapsing refinery and walks out clean.

name: Rersesi
summary: Rersesi is a devout shopkeeper who stacks tins and keeps his worries inside. Gentle but stubborn, he struggles to say what he feels to his own child.

feats.scene: Rersesi swings a broom at a shoplifter and lands a hit.
Rersesi lifts crates all day without complaint.

name: Lenntlo
summary: Lenntlo is a quiet young archer, once bent to a cause she did not choose. She breaks free and learns to trust her family again.

feats.scene: Lenntlo puts an arrow through a wooden target at long range.
Lenntlo takes a rough tumble down a hillside and keeps running.

name: Iucorta
summary: Iucorta is a grey-haired giantess of an elder bloodline, proud and fair in battle. She wields natural forces and enormous strength to win back lost glory.

feats.scene: Iucorta whips a gale across a coast and flips every ship in the bay.
Iucorta stands as a cliff-side temple collapses on her.

name: Reste
summary: Reste is a bound priest who rose from a desert tomb and used a stolen jewel to remake a city block in the image of his old home. Vain and vengeful, he craves an audience even among gods.

feats.scene: Reste transforms a city block into an ancient temple district in one breath.
Reste walks out of a collapsing sarcophagus chamber unharmed.

name: Torreoun
summary: Torreoun is a stern island ruler in an old uniform, feared for his orders and his propaganda. He commands armies from a desk rather than a battlefield.

feats.scene: Torreoun slams a hand down on a map table and a room goes quiet.
Torreoun endures a long night of council shouting without flinching.

name: Ruslor
summary: Ruslor is a hired guard in a clumsy outfit with telescoping cybernetic legs that raise him to rooftop height. His wrist plates spit bursts of force, which he boasts about too loudly.

feats.scene: Ruslor fires a gauntlet blast that knocks a stack of crates across a dock.
Ruslor stumbles on his own stilt legs and falls through a shop awning, unhurt.

name: Reliasa
summary: Reliasa is a purple-haired sea assassin who breathes beneath the waves. She hardens water into hurled shards and speaks mind to mind with others of her kind.

feats.scene: Reliasa fires a salvo of hardened water that punches through a ship's hull.
Reliasa weathers a crushing wave surge against a seawall.

name: Amtoranu
summary: Amtoranu is a scheming sea-queen's double who seizes a throne by lies. Bred for deep-water pressure, she is strong, quick and nearly impossible to bruise.

feats.scene: Amtoranu drives a trident through a harbour wall and cracks the pier above.
Amtoranu descends to the deepest trench with no sign of strain.

name: Amter
summary: Amter is a bulky, sinister mercenary in a stained flight suit, a mocking copy of a cowardly hero. He appears in the crowd of hired killers and is never seen again.

feats.scene: Amter heaves a crate of ammunition onto a truck bed.
Amter absorbs a rifle butt and grins.

name: Tauian
summary: Tauian is a tall island queen trained from girlhood in sword and shield. Vowing to lead her warriors in battle, she cuts through lines of foes with unshaken poise.

feats.scene: Tauian splits a war-chariot in two with one sweep of her blade.
Tauian holds a shield wall against a stampeding charge.

name: Corisvor
summary: Corisvor is a battle-hardened island queen who fights to the last so survivors can escape. Skilled with weapons and bare hands, she hands her crown on before the end.

feats.scene: Corisvor smashes a charging attacker through a wooden gate.
Corisvor fights on through a horde's assault on the harbour wall.

name: Corenlor
summary: Corenlor is a warrior queen who accepts a glowing ring and a lantern of light, and uses its constructs to stop a tyrant. Her ring shields allies, blasts foes and carries her through the void.

feats.scene: Corenlor fires a green beam that vaporises an asteroid.
Corenlor raises a ring-shield against a falling moonlet fragment.

name: Numreslin
summary: Numreslin is a regal, deathless matriarch who gathers copies of her daughter from across time into one household. She floats above her court and rules with a gentle, firm hand.

feats.scene: Numreslin hurls a marble pillar through a palace wall.
Numreslin sits unharmed as a ceiling of stone falls around her.

name: Nirau
summary: Nirau is an ancient warrior queen slain for her sash, who afterward lends strength to a young champion. Her gift lives on in the arms of others.

feats.scene: Nirau cleaves a boulder in two to protect her sisters.
Nirau stands against a charging giant for a full minute.

name: Stiorlle
summary: Stiorlle is a gracious island ruler gifted by divine mothers with strength, speed and quick healing. She rides, lassoes and speaks every tongue with ease.

feats.scene: Stiorlle flings a loaded wagon over a cliff edge.
Stiorlle shrugs off a rockslide that buries her to the waist.

name: Estermi
summary: Estermi is a blonde adventurer with tangled family ties and an eye for a fight. She teams up with younger heroes and eventually becomes mother to a dream-lord.

feats.scene: Estermi flings a stone bench across a courtyard.
Estermi takes a long fall onto concrete and stands up.

name: Ntova
summary: Ntova is a grey-haired professor and tinkerer who can recreate whole planets' weather and climate inside his lab. A friend of a stretchy hero, he is cheerful and absent-minded.

feats.scene: Ntova sets off a miniature sandstorm in a glass dome.
Ntova works through a whole night of chemical fumes.

name: Sanluri
summary: Sanluri is a teenage engineer from a neon-lit city, building armoured suits and swarms of tiny machines. Lonely and clever, he fakes crises to win friends.

feats.scene: Sanluri pilots a giant composite robot to smash an incoming rock.
Sanluri's battlesuit absorbs a crashing vehicle without damage.

name: Ilteora
summary: Ilteora is a small boy lost in his toys on a fast commuter train. Danger passes him by only because a stranger arrives in time.

feats.scene: Ilteora throws a toy at a window seat.
Ilteora tumbles from a seat and laughs.

name: Raeonse
summary: Raeonse is a scheming young inventor in a cartoon world who builds clanking gadgets for crime. Bright but petty, he is often beaten by his own clever traps.

feats.scene: Raeonse launches a spring-loaded boxing glove that dents a vault door.
Raeonse bounces off a rubber net and flaps his arms.

source_title: Hiro Okamura (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Miaseo
summary: Miaseo is a hardened fascist inventor of a dark future, riding inside a towering walking machine. He serves a cause of order and seldom smiles.

feats.scene: Miaseo drives his machine's fist through a concrete overpass.
Miaseo's armour absorbs a collapsing billboard.

name: Vanti
summary: Vanti is a purple-skinned guardian of a galactic corps, wearing a ring that weaves hard-light shapes. Her will is sharp and her focus unbroken.

feats.scene: Vanti fires a ring-beam that cuts a freighter in two.
Vanti's shield holds against an exploding fuel depot.

name: Rnvalval
summary: Rnvalval is a violet-skinned corps member who patrols the stars with a glowing ring and a stubborn will. She cheerfully fights alongside strangers.

feats.scene: Rnvalval fires a green-white beam to destroy a pirate cruiser.
Rnvalval braces behind a ring-shield as a comet fragment splits around her.

name: Valntoiu
summary: Valntoiu is a nervous municipal politician who ends up in charge of a troubled city for a few months. He gives speeches and then watches things fall apart.

feats.scene: Valntoiu bangs a gavel and demands quiet.
Valntoiu weathers a hostile press conference.

name: Ceorti
summary: Ceorti is a coastal vigilante who senses the feelings of crowds and uses them as fuel. Inherited visions and violent fits shape her, and she leads a small band of idealists.

feats.scene: Ceorti lets a crowd's anger surge through her and sends a blast that overturns a car.
Ceorti survives a violent seizure on a stone floor.

name: Seoserni
summary: Seoserni is a cloned engineered teen whose touch unpicks the bonds in matter. She can slow living tissue or pass through walls, and she gets a new body when she dies.

feats.scene: Seoserni lays a hand on a steel bulkhead and dissolves it into dust.
Seoserni eats a fatal blow and wakes in a fresh tank.

name: Tesrau
summary: Tesrau is an angry sibling who draws chaos into her limbs and boasts she can tear through tanks, ships and armies. She is brash and reckless, and falls in a family fight.

feats.scene: Tesrau rips the turret off a tank and hurls it through a barracks wall.
Tesrau walks through a volley of cannon fire.

name: Tauliamo
summary: Tauliamo is a blind coach with sharp hearing, who trains a rowdy gang at a seaside amusement strip. Her patience is limited and her tongue is sharper.

feats.scene: Tauliamo swings a cane in a flawless arc and lands a hit by sound alone.
Tauliamo stands her ground through a rowdy brawl.

name: Telis
summary: Telis is a gloomy woman who only becomes strong while asleep on her feet. She drowns herself in pills and loud music to never wake, so her power runs without her.

feats.scene: Telis stumbles through a shop wall in her sleep and carries a vending machine out.
Telis walks in her sleep through a falling scaffold and keeps on going.

name: Litumni
summary: Litumni is a warm second wife who tries to keep a household calm amid strange visitors she cannot see. She falls to those forces and is briefly raised against her will.

feats.scene: Litumni shoves a stubborn kitchen window open on a hot day.
Litumni endures a harsh fall on a stair landing.

name: Nanil
summary: Nanil is a streetwise runaway who learns to fight back from an older mentor. She grows into a lithe cat burglar who watches out for her friends.

feats.scene: Nanil lands a kick that folds an alley bully against a dumpster.
Nanil drops from a fire escape and rolls up on her feet.

name: Anuarra
summary: Anuarra is a bitter orphan trained in stick-fighting to channel her anger. A grief-fuelled vendetta drives her to run from the law under a borrowed name.

feats.scene: Anuarra snaps a hardwood staff across an attacker's ribs.
Anuarra takes a knife wound and still boards a night flight.

name: Tetinnau
summary: Tetinnau is a faded child performer who stopped ageing under a bad deal. She can imitate any voice and now haunts fan gatherings with a drink in hand.

feats.scene: Tetinnau throws a convincing slap in a staged scene.
Tetinnau survives decades of late nights on a bar stool.

name: Untesco
summary: Untesco is a brown-haired wanderer with a talent for firearms and invoices. He keeps a ledger of favours and works for a crew of star-hopping traders.

feats.scene: Untesco fires a pistol round through a lantern at forty paces.
Untesco shrugs off a bar-room shove.

name: Niunania
summary: Niunania is a small, secretive creature of a magician's design, glimpsed in a crowded laboratory. Nobody knows what he wants, only that he keeps watching.

feats.scene: Niunania hurls a glass flask across a workshop.
Niunania lands on stone after a long fall and scurries on.

name: Terneiu
summary: Terneiu is a dark-haired folk hero in a stovepipe hat who gives plain advice to strangers. He turns up on the edge of a big story and then vanishes.

feats.scene: Terneiu swings an axe at a log and splits it clean.
Terneiu trudges through a snowstorm in his shirtsleeves.

name: Valsorsor
summary: Valsorsor is a fair-haired aide on a covert team who wants to leave the work behind. She is ashamed of what her employers do and sticks close to a trusted friend.

feats.scene: Valsorsor swings a heavy briefcase into a guard's arm.
Valsorsor holds steady through a long, tense stakeout.

name: Toveo
summary: Toveo is a combat chassis hidden under a human shell, with an organic brain at its core. She fires blasts from her palms, wrestles heavy men and ignores arrows.

feats.scene: Toveo punches a crack through a concrete wall while lifting a man by the throat.
Toveo lets a quiver of arrows break against her metal chest.

name: Calasllu
summary: Calasllu is a teenage helper who tosses sticky vines at pursuers. Recruited young by a gang of rogues, she changes sides when asked to hurt people.

feats.scene: Calasllu throws a sticky vine that glues a young hero's boots to a floor.
Calasllu tumbles through a crowded rooftop and stands up.

name: Tooraceo
summary: Tooraceo is a lean assassin who carries a device that creates a pocket of silence. She throws knives on the move and relies on stealth and training.

feats.scene: Tooraceo throws a knife through a moving target's shoulder in a quiet arcade.
Tooraceo takes a heavy kick in a silence field and stays on her feet.

name: Sauterias
summary: Sauterias is a retired killer who projects zones of dead quiet and wants only an ordinary family life. When old masters fall out, she picks up her blades again to protect her home.

feats.scene: Sauterias drops a silent field over a hallway and strikes down five guards without a sound.
Sauterias keeps fighting after a rooftop fall.

name: Orcorvi
summary: Orcorvi is a cheerful lab assistant who once spilled a glowing mixture on himself and gained a short-lived power of sight through walls. He stays home and watches over the equipment.

feats.scene: Orcorvi swings a heavy wrench at a lab intruder.
Orcorvi stumbles into a shelf of beakers and is fine.

name: Neoaneo
summary: Neoaneo is a cruel drill-commander who tormented a boy and later marched an army of winged hounds into a foreign city. He lost rank once and came back for revenge.

feats.scene: Neoaneo drives a spiked mace through a barracks door.
Neoaneo takes a ricocheting blast in the chest and keeps shouting orders.

name: Nuseril
summary: Nuseril is a black-haired gunman with a missing limb, quiet and watchful. He lets his weapon speak and rarely trusts anyone with a plan.

feats.scene: Nuseril fires a pistol round through a crowded room and hits a glass.
Nuseril crashes through a thin door and gets up swinging.

name: Rallan
summary: Rallan is a skull-faced former director who stole a death-defying treatment and wore out his own body. Reduced to a bare skull on a frame, he still gives orders.

feats.scene: Rallan crushes a steel desk with a skeletal fist.
Rallan survives a blast of radiant crystals that would burn a normal man.

name: Ntitorvos
summary: Ntitorvos is a brown-eyed owl who rides a physician's shoulder and glides over rooftops. He is a loyal pet with sharp talons and a night-time habit.

feats.scene: Ntitorvos strikes a mouse from a branch with his talons.
Ntitorvos tumbles out of a window and flaps away.

name: Sorsia
summary: Sorsia is a manufactured heroine, built as a corporate mascot and secretly rigged to explode. She flies, hurls bolts of lightning and hits hard enough to hurt a giant.

feats.scene: Sorsia discharges lightning that blackens a whole street.
Sorsia takes a beam of scorching heat to the chest and keeps fighting.

name: Iumntvar
summary: Iumntvar is a tall, calm bodyguard of warrior heritage who decides to turn on her boss. Trained in close combat, she is taken and wiped before a stranger rescues her.

feats.scene: Iumntvar flips a heavy man over her shoulder and onto a marble floor.
Iumntvar bears a rough interrogation without a sound.

name: Anore
summary: Anore is a hard-working single mother who flips tacos and pays bills. She befriends a stranger at work and cheerfully helps chase a deadbeat husband.

feats.scene: Anore slaps a fryer lid shut in a fit of irritation.
