feats.scene: Iumamoco pounds a table with his fist and the inkwell jumps.
Iumamoco rides in a rattling coach through a stormy week.

name: Nolnusna
summary: Nolnusna is a blonde teen whose face cannot form expressions, so his parents buy him a permanent grin. He grows resentful and murderous, and worships a cackling villain.

feats.scene: Nolnusna smashes a window with a pipe in one swing.
Nolnusna keeps his grin through a tackle that drops him on the pavement.

name: Cellsas
summary: Cellsas is a famed director of horror films who murders a rival in self defense, then masquerades as that rival to silence blackmailers aboard a yacht. A sharp-eyed sleuth sees through the makeup.

feats.scene: Cellsas fires a pistol across a banquet deck and a window shatters.
Cellsas is punched in the jaw and goes down flat.

name: Miaial
summary: Miaial is a black-haired general who defends a river fortress during a bloody civil war. A single unexpected soldier cracks his line, knocks half his men cold, and forces him to give up the town by nightfall.

feats.scene: Miaial orders a cannon volley that tears a gap in a field of fence.
Miaial rides through a hail of musket smoke without a scratch.

name: Saulonau
summary: Saulonau is a dark-haired terrorist with a bomb wired to his heartbeat, who threatens to wreck a famous tower. The device was a stunt staged by a manipulative patron, who pulled its firing pin in advance.

feats.scene: Saulonau threatens a chest-mounted blast that could level a lobby.
Saulonau is tackled by a squad of agents and keeps struggling.

name: Viinunu
summary: Viinunu is a chain-smoking occult detective who sends demons back where they came from, travels in spirit between planes, and starts fires with a lighter. He can also see monsters under their human faces.

feats.scene: Viinunu flicks a lighter and a hellish flame engulfs a snarling fiend.
Viinunu is slammed into a wall by a spirit and coughs it off.

name: Vasirn
summary: Vasirn is a blond sorcerer who leads a band of magical misfits in a dream-born world. His spells are rough and loud, and his adoptive son's fate haunts him.

feats.scene: Vasirn recites a rhyme and a crooked manor wall bursts into colored sparks.
Vasirn stands unharmed inside a ring of chalk as a spirit howls past.

name: Llunimi
summary: Llunimi is a sharp-tongued sorcerer and former rock musician who turns up whenever cosmic evil needs sorting out. He manipulates friends and foes alike, and wants only to get to the pub.

feats.scene: Llunimi chalks a sigil and a hovering horror is hauled screaming into the floor.
Llunimi shakes off a curse that withers a row of potted plants around him.

name: Ianasor
summary: Ianasor is a blond former rock singer from a parallel city, settled down and married. A magical clash overhead makes him faint and hallucinate, and a torn wizard falls out of him at a pub.

feats.scene: Ianasor thumps a table at the pub and rattles the glasses.
Ianasor stays on his stool through a heat wave and a faint.

name: Aulniler
summary: Aulniler is a tall blond shopkeeper in the occult trade who rarely shows his strength, yet is a seriously powerful wizard. He joins forces with a young stage magician and a gloomy teenager to hunt a cursed book.

feats.scene: Aulniler walks through a hail of flying books without a scratch.

name: Arcersu
summary: Arcersu is a cybernetic soldier powered by a glowing green core, brought across worlds to pacify a hero and hold his captives. His chest fires a beam, and he is wrecked by a combined team.

feats.scene: Arcersu fires a chest beam that cuts a hovering gunship in half.
Arcersu takes a rocket on the chest plate and keeps marching.

name: Numsarau
summary: Numsarau is a former sergeant whose body is replaced with machine parts and a glowing green heart. Hired as an enforcer by a powerful politician, he fires radiation at a flying champion.

feats.scene: Numsarau drives a metal fist through a bus and tosses it across a plaza.
Numsarau takes a tank shell on his chest and laughs.

name: Iantornes
summary: Iantornes is a metal-bodied brute with a poisonous green glow, who lumbers through a cartoon city as a major threat to a flying champion. He is strong, tough and slow to tire.

feats.scene: Iantornes punches a delivery truck and folds it around a lamp post.
Iantornes walks through a wall of gunfire and flicks off a spark.

name: Silmeau
summary: Silmeau is a dark-haired veteran and married father who serves in the marines and meets a rough end in a gritty tale. He is a good shot and a decent scrapper.

feats.scene: Silmeau fires a rifle and drops a target at the far end of the yard.
Silmeau takes a rough shove in a barracks brawl and keeps swinging.

name: Tareomi
summary: Tareomi is a tide-bound alchemist whose flesh slips between brine, slate and glass whenever a rusted crank at the hip is turned. The shifting began with a mishap at a salt works and now rules every hour of the day.

feats.scene: Tareomi hardens one arm into slate and caves in a quay wall with a single swing.
Tareomi, turned to glass, shrugs off a falling crane hook.

name: Orevosst
summary: Orevosst was a high-bar flyer in a travelling tent show, trusted to catch his brother's grip at the top of every arc. He lived for the hush before a release and died when a sabotaged rig gave way mid-act.

feats.scene: Orevosst kicks a jammed rope winch loose from a swinging bar.
Orevosst lands flat on a stretched net after a forty foot drop and walks away.

name: Artaunu
summary: Artaunu is the younger of two trapeze brothers in a wandering troupe, engaged to a seamstress who mends the costumes. He is cheerful, light on his feet, and certain the road will always bring a better town.

feats.scene: Artaunu vaults over a wagon rail and drives both heels into a bully's shield.
Artaunu takes a fall from the rigging onto packed sawdust and finishes the show.

name: Rerniora
summary: Rerniora, the older cousin of a famous young acrobat, taught the boy to trust a catcher's hands. He had an easy word for every nervous performer before a show, and his loss silenced a whole caravan.

feats.scene: Rerniora swings his weight into a stuck tent pole and drops it clear of the crowd.
Rerniora hangs from a single wrist loop for a full minute while the rig groans.

name: Rnterni
summary: Rnterni is a scrapyard prodigy who bolts together armour, a jet harness and a heavy piston mallet from salvaged parts. Driven by a debt to a mother who once caught him mid-fall, he builds things to keep people from hitting the ground.

feats.scene: Rnterni brings the piston mallet down on a bridge pier and splits it to the waterline.
Rnterni stands in the armour as a loaded freight car rolls into him and stops.
Rnterni rides the jet harness low over a river at the speed of a diving hawk.

name: Sorlluurn
summary: Sorlluurn is a weapons designer who quit a foundry over an unsafe battle suit, then rebuilt it so the wearer could survive. His reinforced frame turns him into a flying repairman for a crew of far stronger allies.

feats.scene: Sorlluurn fires the suit's palm cannon and bores a hole through a cargo container.
Sorlluurn takes a collapsing gantry on his shoulders while the frame screams but holds.

name: Nttirent
summary: Nttirent is a mass-produced hammer-bearer in a society of identical machine people, each loyal to an unseen hand. The kinetic mallet stores each blow and releases it in one bright thud.

feats.scene: Nttirent stores a dozen swings in the mallet and releases them to flatten a gantry tower.
Nttirent's plating dents but does not split under a collapsing roof.

name: Telmiali
summary: Telmiali is a quiet boy who reads picture books beside an old burial mound, dreaming of heroes who build rather than fight. His only strength is stubborn curiosity, which carries him farther than any muscle.

feats.scene: Telmiali throws a pebble across a creek and clips a fence post.
Telmiali tumbles down a grassy slope and stands up laughing.

name: Rinusti
summary: Rinusti is a lab-coated researcher who swaps an easy life for a prototype suit with rocket boots and a shock mallet. He is friendly, nicknamed by his students, and always first to answer a distress signal.

feats.scene: Rinusti swings the shock mallet and shatters a concrete barrier into gravel.
Rinusti walks out of a collapsed lab in the suit without a scratch on the faceplate.

source_title: John Henry Irons (My Adventures with Superman)

name: Numva
summary: Numva was shipwrecked as a boy with a crate of books, read them all until a ship passed, and came home able to answer any question. He sells replies for a coin from a booth and tinkers with a lab on wheels.

feats.scene: Numva rigs a spring catapult and launches a barrel through a barn door.
Numva climbs back onto a drifting raft after a night in cold water.

name: Lecarter
summary: Lecarter is a charming tycoon who rebuilds crumbling harbour towns, then quietly buys every debt in them until the residents serve him. Behind the philanthropy sits a cold temper and a locked kitchen.

feats.scene: Lecarter overpowers an intruder with a hand to the throat and a kitchen knife.
Lecarter shrugs off a thrown bottle at a gala and finishes his speech.

name: Iantaer
summary: Iantaer is a pulp-era lab man who studied statutes just to protect his patents, then invented a trade that blends microscope and courtroom. He cracks mysterious thefts with a wall-sized humming coil in his office.

feats.scene: Iantaer discharges the humming coil and blows a safe door off its hinges.
Iantaer ducks a thrown chair in his laboratory and keeps pouring the flask.

name: Llotau
summary: Llotau is a hard-throwing mercenary who can hurl a stitched leather ball with the force of a mortar round. Declared lost after one explosion, he strolls back into crowds with a shrug and a fresh wad of cash.

feats.scene: Llotau hurls the ball and punches a hole through a steel shutter.
Llotau stands up from a blast that wrecked a van.

name: Sorsor
summary: Sorsor is a shy inventor of a glove that copies its wearer into a crowd of equals. One copy resents being a tool, imprisons the original, and goes on to rob galleries with a swarm of itself.

feats.scene: Sorsor spawns twelve selves who haul a statue out of a gallery in seconds.
Sorsor is struck by a thrown baton and splits to dodge the follow-up.

name: Ntilleson
summary: Ntilleson was a gruff statesman handed a ruined country when his predecessor fell during an alien assault. He ruled with a heavy hand while the cities were rebuilt brick by brick.

feats.scene: Ntilleson slams a gavel so hard the council table cracks.
Ntilleson stays upright through a long night of shelling in the cellar.

name: Renuti
summary: Renuti is a covert operative of a secret board, trained to move through offices and embassies without being noticed. Few details of his career survive, which is exactly the point of the job.

feats.scene: Renuti disarms a guard and pins him against a filing cabinet in one move.
Renuti takes a baton across the ribs and keeps walking.

name: Naninau
summary: Naninau is a desert mage who hides his craft behind a plain name and a quiet life in a river city. His spells drift on dry wind and old sand, bending fate more than steel.

feats.scene: Naninau lifts a dune and drops it on a convoy of raiders.
Naninau wraps himself in whirling sand and takes a cannon shell.

name: Sesso
summary: Sesso is a convicted physicist who built an hourglass in a prison cell that skips a target a day through time. He wears a stolen cape and plans to make the city beg for his pardon.

feats.scene: Sesso flips the hourglass and a pair of pursuers vanish a day into the past.
Sesso tumbles down a stair and flips the glass to undo the fall.

name: Rasilco
summary: Rasilco is a sober draughtsman drawn into a monastic order that tends a golden flame, learning to carry its heat in his chest. He resists the call at first, but the flame has other plans for him.

feats.scene: Rasilco opens his hands and the flame carves a trench across a stone plain.
Rasilco meditates through a rockfall that bounces off his heat shimmer.

name: Rniumma
summary: Rniumma is a former rifleman who carries a glowing ring that shapes whatever his will can picture. In a crisis he builds barricades and bridges, and he drills new recruits with a tough, fair hand.

feats.scene: Rniumma shapes a green hammer and flattens an abandoned tower block.
Rniumma holds a glowing shield against a falling bridge deck.
Rniumma leaves the atmosphere at the pace of a ballistic missile.

name: Nauamolli
summary: Nauamolli is a ring-bearing guardian who fights beside a tall flyer and stands in for him when he is away. He is lost when a tyrant blasts the central battery of his corps and the fire rolls over a world.

feats.scene: Nauamolli fires a green lance that bores through a drifting asteroid.
Nauamolli survives the first wave of a planetary blast before his shield finally fails.

name: Ntlell
summary: Ntlell is a long-serving ring-bearer who was nearsighted as a boy and joined the infantry before being chosen for his steadiness. Whenever the ring flickers, a friend reminds him that the master is the person, not the tool.

feats.scene: Ntlell sweeps a luminous fist through a robot fleet and scatters the wreckage.
Ntlell withstands a heavy laser volley that melts the plating around him.

name: Orseres
summary: Orseres is a lawman of a darker coast city who takes bribes to pay for a child's surgery, then loses his temper in an alley. A cursed ring answers him, and a ruthless knight in emerald armour is born from guilt.

feats.scene: Orseres smashes a cruel crime lord's armoured car with a swing of glowing steel.
Orseres shrugs off a rocket volley fired from a rooftop.

name: Rntastas
summary: Rntastas guards a bright orbital station and cooperates with ring-wielders from other worlds. He builds glowing constructs in a hurry and trusts them to hold long enough to pull someone out.

feats.scene: Rntastas conjures a glowing ram and punches through a sealed vault door.
Rntastas stands in the open as shrapnel rains across his barrier.

name: Stiiumosa
summary: Stiiumosa is an engineer on a peaceful exchange mission who ends up holding a rage-fuelled ring handed over by a repentant guard. He insists that heroism means sacrifice, and fights with the ring only when his friends need an exit.

feats.scene: Stiiumosa fires a yellow beam through a prison wall and floods the cells with light.
Stiiumosa keeps a glowing bubble together as the rescue ship takes hits.

name: Orior
summary: Orior is a veteran sergeant turned ring-bearer who runs his training sessions with strict kindness. He trains the grandson of his own mentor and hands out food parcels to neighbours between missions.

feats.scene: Orior forms a green battering ram and flattens a stone pillar.
Orior covers a trainee with a shield as a boulder bounces away.

name: Iulanter
summary: Iulanter is a marksman-turned-ring-bearer who rejoins a brutal faction and falls on a field full of undead. A friend's betrayal ends him, and the blame for it lands on someone else.

feats.scene: Iulanter blows a crater through a column of undead with a single green shot.
Iulanter takes three claws to the shoulder and keeps his aim steady.

name: Raveo
summary: Raveo is a rebuilder who hates seeing homes broken and swaps drafting tools for a luminous ring. Loss has followed him across several teams, yet his hands are as steady with a blueprint as with a beam.

feats.scene: Raveo drops a glowing anvil on a siege machine and crushes its frame.
Raveo stands through a collapsing arena roof, shield bright and level.
Raveo crosses a gulf between planets at a fraction of light speed.

name: Ntteres
summary: Ntteres is an older ring-bearer from a far-flung layer of reality, led by a smiling forger who hides his purpose. When the forger falls out with the heroes, Ntteres follows orders and is last seen fading in white light.

feats.scene: Ntteres pours white light into a vast fist and crushes a floating citadel.
Ntteres endures a volley that scours the surface from the rock beneath him.

name: Irnortia
summary: Irnortia is a ring-bearing cartoon hero whose adventures end in captivity, dragged off by a grim god with the rest of his team. He stays cheerful in his cell and swears a pun at every guard.

feats.scene: Irnortia stamps a glowing foot and the whole cell block lifts a metre.
Irnortia takes a thunder blast to the chest and grins.

source_title: John Stewart (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Macaosa
summary: Macaosa is a stern drill-sergeant and father who raised three sons in a cramped house on an iron schedule. He once hoped to be chosen for a cosmic honour, but never lost his habit of asking questions that sting.

feats.scene: Macaosa shoves a stalled pickup up a ramp with his shoulder.
Macaosa stands at attention through a long hailstorm without flinching.

name: Conusor
summary: Conusor is a young digger who finds a sea-god's ring in a collapsed trench and wakes the memory of an ancestor-hero. He holds a bronze blade and round shield and vows endless war on tyranny.

feats.scene: Conusor lifts a toppled column and hurls it across a ravine.
Conusor stands under falling masonry without a mark.

name: Liest
summary: Liest is a freedom fighter in a bleak world, flying on bladed metal wings that also cut like shears. His eyes throw bright beams and his jokes break the silence in the trench.

feats.scene: Liest crosses the sky and slices a patrol tank open with his wing blades.
Liest takes a cannon blast across the back and keeps his heading.
Liest dives out of the clouds at the speed of a falling hawk.

name: Lisesso
summary: Lisesso is a weathered screen cowboy who tips his hat to every stranger and talks like a man who has seen too many deserts. He fights with a squint and a steady voice.

feats.scene: Lisesso lands a sledging haymaker on a loud brawler in a roadside bar.
Lisesso takes a saloon chair across the back and stays on his feet.

name: Riiuva
summary: Riiuva is a soldier whose body was tuned to an unseen harmonic of the universe, letting him tug on gravity and light. He raised a floating city above the clouds and eventually slipped into a quieter dimension.

feats.scene: Riiuva folds the air and lifts a hillside into the sky.
Riiuva bends light around himself and a blast passes through empty air.

name: Ninreoasi
summary: Ninreoasi was a stage performer with a vicious grudge, who drew a pistol in a crowded hall and learned how fast a mighty guest could move. His plot ended on the point of his own blade.

feats.scene: Ninreoasi fires a single pistol shot that splinters a balcony rail.
Ninreoasi is tossed over a balustrade and lands in a heap.

name: Liasleo
summary: Liasleo is a machinist who forges two iron mallets after his family is lost to a hooded mob. He hammers at them through the night and becomes a folk hero before the mob catches up.

feats.scene: Liasleo swings an iron mallet and drops a door-sized timber in one blow.
Liasleo shakes off a beating from a dozen men and crawls onward.

name: Asnuan
summary: Asnuan is a white-haired elder who rises to lead a masked order that rules a stone city from the rafters. He prefers whispers to violence, and his patience is longer than any ledger.

feats.scene: Asnuan strikes a table with a cane and silences a room of schemers.
Asnuan stays standing after a shove down a short stair.

name: Tirlu
summary: Tirlu is a stage conjurer whose words work backward into real spells, bending props into hounds and lights into rain. He travels with a trunk of old costumes and a black cat.

feats.scene: Tirlu speaks a reversed phrase and a stage curtain becomes a whirlwind that rips a roof.
Tirlu vanishes in a puff of smoke just as a trap door snaps shut.

name: Oreol
summary: Oreol was a revered illusionist whose blessing let him grant any wish except his own. A heavy book unlocked backward speech, and he spent his last strength saving his daughter from a threat that never had a face.

feats.scene: Oreol speaks the final phrase in reverse and a stone wall dissolves into sand.
Oreol throws up a glimmering veil that turns a speeding truck aside.

name: Tilllu
summary: Tilllu is an ordinary man of an alternate town who pops up in the background of old adventures. Nothing about him stands out, which is the joke and also his secret strength.

feats.scene: Tilllu pushes a stalled handcart over a kerb.
Tilllu falls off a ladder and shakes it off.

name: Lanstaau
summary: Lanstaau is a patriotic eagle-person in a team of talking animals, loud about duty and quick to question anyone who looks shifty. His banner-coloured feathers flare when he is angry.

feats.scene: Lanstaau dives and drives a beak into a rusted padlock.
Lanstaau tumbles from a high perch and spreads his wings just in time.

name: Terni
summary: Terni is a good-looking small-time thief who borrows a dead man's costume to impress a ruthless boss. A scarred face and a prison sentence follow, and a quake eventually opens his cell.

feats.scene: Terni hurls a bottle and shatters a ballroom chandelier.
Terni crashes face-first into a mirror and still staggers on.

name: Norser
summary: Norser is a captured trooper drugged with strange herbs until he swells into an armoured giant. His handlers send him against a hero, but the rescue breaks the spell and he goes home.

feats.scene: Norser, grown huge, hurls a jeep into a treeline.
Norser walks through a mortar barrage without slowing.

name: Istelle
summary: Istelle is a gaunt courier who brews a bitter potion from stolen blood and runs faster than sound while it lasts. The addiction eats at his body, and he wears a cracked helmet to keep the wind out of his eyes.

feats.scene: Istelle punches a train carriage at a dead sprint and caves in the door.
Istelle tumbles across gravel at speed and the helmet takes the worst.
Istelle crosses a salt flat faster than a rifle round.

name: Sautil
summary: Sautil is a prairie ranch hand who inherits two humming pistols from a fallen visitor after a stampede ends in disaster. He swears to guard the plains with them in case the hungry strangers ever come back.

feats.scene: Sautil fires both pistols and a charging bull-sized creature is blown back across the corral.
Sautil is tossed from a bronco and lands in a trough, still gripping the grips.

name: Ilcor
summary: Ilcor is a quick-handed rider on a clockwork mare who can outrun a rifle round across the flats. He draws faster than the eye follows and answers to nobody in the dust.

feats.scene: Ilcor empties a revolver in a blur and perforates a water tower.
Ilcor rolls off the clockwork mare at full gallop and jumps up unhurt.
Ilcor outpaces a rifle shot across a dry lakebed.

name: Eoreo
summary: Eoreo is a stiff, short-fused deputy of a harbour crime family who runs the ledgers and the loyalty tests. He barks orders over a mansion table and cannot stand a stranger who talks back.

feats.scene: Eoreo slams a heavy ledger into a challenger's jaw.
Eoreo takes a thrown ashtray to the brow and keeps issuing instructions.

name: Ornas
summary: Ornas is a school bully who inhales a glittering dust after a meteor storm and for one season can move objects with his mind. He turns the gift to thievery before it fades.

feats.scene: Ornas hoists a vault door with his mind and sets it down on a counter.
Ornas is thrown through a window and sits up groaning.

name: Lletoles
summary: Lletoles is a theatrical mesmerist who plots elaborate heists in a bright suit and brings dancers to every robbery. He escapes custody with patter alone and goes back to the same stage in a week.

feats.scene: Lletoles swings a heavy lamp into a guard and sends him sprawling.
Lletoles drops through a trap and lands in a laundry cart.

name: Llitiurn
summary: Llitiurn is a cackling inmate who breaks out of a hospital wing during a storm and drifts between feuds. A plot against him by a masked rival ends only when his partner turns on them both.

feats.scene: Llitiurn swings a flag-pistol like a club and cracks a visor.
Llitiurn is thrown against a cell wall and laughs through the pain.

name: Orlle
summary: Orlle was a vicious bandit who caught a plague that rewrites minds, rose after a shotgun blast, and was later strapped to a car bonnet. His body slowly dissolved into the rain.

feats.scene: Orlle tears a car door off its hinges with bare hands.
Orlle keeps walking after a point-blank shotgun blast.

name: Rosseo
summary: Rosseo is a reformed schemer who builds a hand-cranked generator for a village of survivors after a great war. His craft keeps the lights on until the sky itself breaks apart.

feats.scene: Rosseo winds a flywheel and lights a whole street for an evening.
Rosseo shelters under a table while a gale tears the roof off.

name: Tiullu
summary: Tiullu was a feared prisoner kept in a cold sleep chamber by a militia until a masked newcomer wandered in. He never woke long enough to learn why he was being kept.

feats.scene: Tiullu swings a numb fist at a stasis glass and chips it.
Tiullu survives decades of freezing sleep.

name: Inriate
summary: Inriate is a smiling poisoner of a gaslit age who weds wealthy widows and buries them one by one. A failed attempt on his own life leaves his face frozen in a dreadful grin.

feats.scene: Inriate slips a vial into a tea cup and sets the whole table to coughing.
Inriate swallows his own poison and survives with a rigid face.

name: Raanco
summary: Raanco is a prankster supervillain whose gang rigs a hideout with spring-loaded gags. The scheme goes sideways when the villains trip every trap themselves.

feats.scene: Raanco sprays a rubber fish that bowls over three guards.
Raanco falls through his own trapdoor and bounces out grinning.

name: Nantausti
summary: Nantausti is a street thug who injects himself with a thick green serum that swells his muscles and toughens his hide. He is stronger than any gang he has ever met, and twice as reckless.

feats.scene: Nantausti drives a fist through a van door and out the other side.
Nantausti stands up from being hit by the same van.

name: Letes
summary: Letes is a lab worker who turns to crime for a quick retirement fund and wears a bright hood on his first job. He grows into the most cunning criminal of his city, with an odd private code about clumsiness.

feats.scene: Letes cracks a safe with a stethoscope and a swift kick.
Letes tumbles into a vat and clambers out, hood sodden.

name: Lloleul
summary: Lloleul is a silent child left by a stranger at a lonely trailer, who learns from a fugitive how little a blade needs to hurt. He paints his own face and follows the fugitive into the night.

feats.scene: Lloleul pushes a kitchen knife through a leather boot with his whole weight.
Lloleul tumbles off a porch and keeps laughing.

name: Tiuurn
summary: Tiuurn is a widowed killer of a neon city who abducts an old butler, then returns after death by hijacking a young hero's mind. He is finally cast out for good.

feats.scene: Tiuurn swings a handgun like a hammer and breaks a visor.
Tiuurn drops from a tower and rises in a borrowed body.

name: Eorra
summary: Eorra is a terrorist whose poison trick tricks a mighty ruler into a terrible act. He is later struck down for it by the same ruler.

feats.scene: Eorra detonates a hidden charge and levels a city district.
Eorra takes one blow from a furious hero and does not rise.

name: Stistu
summary: Stistu is a retired killer in a seaside town who still turns up uninvited in a thief's heist. Years later, his own grandchildren hardly know him.

feats.scene: Stistu drives a crowbar through a trophy case with one heave.
Stistu falls off a deck chair and brushes it off.

name: Stiiusto
summary: Stiiusto is a toy-world villain who bursts into bright plastic cities with a joy buzzer and a drum-fed popgun. He cannot be poisoned and shrugs off every fall.

feats.scene: Stiiusto zaps a plastic skyscraper with a buzzer and topples it.
Stiiusto bounces off a toy bridge and keeps cackling.

name: Iueote
summary: Iueote is a street criminal who drifts into a tournament between merging worlds, then steals a surge of strange power and turns on his allies. He returns home fighting with the stolen energy.

feats.scene: Iueote hurls a stolen bolt and cracks an armoured car in half.
Iueote walks through a thrown column and shakes off the dust.

name: Corlestor
summary: Corlestor is a TV-era schemer who impersonates a professor and steals a water-going car. He baits a caped rival with riddles and a hyena, and is netted at last.

feats.scene: Corlestor cranks the wheel and slams a prototype car through a boathouse door.
Corlestor is tangled in a fishing net and shrugs off the tug.

name: Aulorerus
summary: Aulorerus is a tireless mass-murderer with a thousand names, a dozen faces and a view of the world as one long joke. He remakes his own history to suit the day and never forgets a grudge.

feats.scene: Aulorerus floods a stadium with poison gas and clears it in minutes.
Aulorerus walks out of a burning tower laughing.

name: Anute
summary: Anute is a nervous crook hunted by a nameless creature that mauls his old rivals one by one. He hoards henchmen in a garden grotto and is carried out of it half-conscious.

feats.scene: Anute throws a lit flare into a thicket and sets a hedge alight.
Anute survives a savage mauling that would kill most people.

name: Erore
summary: Erore is a master mimic who impersonates voices with ease and poses as a playing-card thief for a dark god's plot. A rival team spoils the plan within a week.

feats.scene: Erore throws a card that slices a rope in two.
Erore falls from a rooftop and lands on an awning.

name: Aunintau
summary: Aunintau is a sharp-minded gangster with a strict golden rule about who may tell the jokes. He has a tattooed past and a possible daughter, and he rules his block with a gun.

feats.scene: Aunintau fires a pistol and shatters a streetlamp from across a lot.
Aunintau takes a pipe across the shoulder and laughs it off.

name: Tonva
summary: Tonva is a needy toy-city villain who craves attention from a caped rival and marshals a freed army of exiles to raze a plastic town. His grandmother still scolds him on Sundays.

feats.scene: Tonva commands his army to topple a toy skyline in a night.
Tonva falls from a scaffold of bricks and brushes himself off.

name: Rianill
summary: Rianill is a gaunt schemer who steals alien gauntlets and traps heroes inside a hospital wing under a glowing dome. He tears allies apart before a grieving rival smashes the gauntlets.

feats.scene: Rianill clenches both gauntlets and rips a reinforced door off its frame.
Rianill is beaten with a bare fist until he falls.

name: Lesva
summary: Lesva is a future-city criminal captured by a warden and warped into a fanged beast in a cold prison. He lurches through the corridors of his cell block, half mind and half hunger.

feats.scene: Lesva bites through a cell bar and tears it from the wall.
Lesva takes a stun-baton burst and bares his fangs.

name: Anror
summary: Anror is a grey murderer in a bleak future whose estranged daughter goes on a bloody rampage after he turns away. He is eventually put to rest in a gloomy cemetery.

feats.scene: Anror shoves a mourner into a headstone with a hard push.
Anror stumbles on a root and curses.

name: Nilceo
summary: Nilceo is a menace in a family comedy who stalks a young hero and his parents, then snatches the boy. The household pulls together and the boy is brought home.

feats.scene: Nilceo swings a bat and shatters a shop window.
Nilceo takes a tray to the head and keeps grinning.

name: Tinttia
summary: Tinttia is an unwanted child raised in orphanages who scars his own face to mirror a feared father and rallies a network of cells against a mother who gave him up. His attack on the cities ends in a confrontation.

feats.scene: Tinttia sets off a chain of charges across a dozen shopfronts.
Tinttia takes a boot to the face and keeps ranting.

name: Neocator
summary: Neocator is a teenager from a distant colony whose entire society watches broadcasts of far-off heroes. Sprayed with chemicals by a bitter friend, he later begs two young heroes for help.

feats.scene: Neocator snaps a ship's lock with a single sharp yank.
Neocator drops off a ledge and rolls to his feet.

name: Nianirn
summary: Nianirn is a nightclub sorceress in a war-torn capital who keeps a young magician as her servant and bargains with a dark binder for the dead. Her left arm carries a stolen power.

feats.scene: Nianirn sends a pulse of dark light through a ballroom and shatters every mirror.
Nianirn shrugs off a volley of pistol rounds behind a shimmering veil.

name: Iasria
summary: Iasria is a murderous swamp reptile who kills for pleasure and gathers a horde to storm a prehistoric city. A great devourer swallows him whole before the final battle.

feats.scene: Iasria spits venom that dissolves a log and the gate behind it.
Iasria takes a club across the skull and keeps charging.

name: Iaauau
summary: Iaauau is a gambling-ruined father from a far-future century who abandons his twin children and later joins a band of thieves of time. His mind is quick but his debts catch up in the end.

feats.scene: Iaauau fires an energy gauntlet and blows a hole in a vault wall.
Iaauau takes a hit from a heavy blast and staggers on.

name: Ntitorlas
summary: Ntitorlas is a young soldier of a dimension-hopping force who is thrown through a shimmering wall by his dying commander. He ends up as a quiet priest with an unspoken power.

feats.scene: Ntitorlas opens a rift and a distant city block vibrates.
Ntitorlas steps through a fire storm with his robes barely singed.

name: Oluamiam
summary: Oluamiam is a brainwashed agent of a state programme who spirals into hatred of foreigners and their pets. A government clean-up squad ends him after a brawl with a night-time vigilante.

feats.scene: Oluamiam hurls a street bench through a window.
Oluamiam takes a crowbar blow across the ribs and keeps swinging.

name: Miaces
summary: Miaces is a sixteenth-century privateer in a black mask who hunts cruel buccaneers and lays waste to an enemy navy. He marries a lovely woman and founds a seafaring line.

feats.scene: Miaces swings a cutlass and splits a boarding plank in two.
Miaces falls from a mast into the sea and swims ashore.

name: Conanu
summary: Conanu is a northern warrior doomed to wander forever after a god's curse leaves him unable to be hurt by any weapon. He seeks a heroic death to rejoin a lost love and is frozen in ice for centuries.

feats.scene: Conanu cleaves a longboat's keel with a single axe stroke.
Conanu walks out of an avalanche of ice unmarked.

name: Varta
summary: Varta is a gunslinger who owns a frontier mine hiding a rare restorative pool. He warns off two trespassers, loses the fight, and vanishes when the multiverse collapses.

feats.scene: Varta fires a rifle shot that splinters a mine beam.
Varta shakes off a hard punch to the jaw.

name: Enuteaun
summary: Enuteaun is an alien hired gun who partners with a brutal bounty hunter in a space cab and is ditched in orbit for his trouble. His metabolism needs no food, which is the only reason he lives.

feats.scene: Enuteaun fires a blaster and punches a hole in a cab door.
Enuteaun floats in vacuum for a week and is rescued alive.

name: Nttule
summary: Nttule is a metropolitan reporter who dates a colleague just as a new hero lands in town. He chases leads on foot and loses sleep chasing stories.

feats.scene: Nttule shoulders a jammed newsroom door open.
Nttule slips on wet steps and gets up clutching his notebook.

name: Llineo
summary: Llineo is a lightning-struck runner who flees an abusive home on foot and later joins a band of villains in a harsh sister city. His speed comes from a storm that mixed with chemical fumes.

feats.scene: Llineo sprints through a wall of bricks and leaves a man-shaped hole.
Llineo is knocked off his feet by a heavy truck and is running again in seconds.
Llineo outruns a supersonic jet down an empty highway.

name: Ntoll
summary: Ntoll is a chemist who fills glass vials with a mist that drives victims to panic and hacks a train network to prove his point. He is jailed in a hospital cell and his belongings are shelved.

feats.scene: Ntoll floods a train station with mist and clears a whole platform.
Ntoll is dragged off a roof and tackled to the gravel.

name: Soiasi
summary: Soiasi is a toxicologist who muses that every possibility comes down to facing oneself. He wears a yellow-eyed mask in a monster-filled adventure and mixes a nasty brew for the heroes.

feats.scene: Soiasi flings a flask that bursts into gas and fells three guards.
Soiasi is shoved against a bench and keeps talking.

name: Leotelse
summary: Leotelse is a former lecturer in fear who is turned into a black-feathered mutant by an experimental ooze. He lays an ambush in a boiler room and dazes a turtle warrior before being beaten by his own illusions.

feats.scene: Leotelse flaps and rakes a steel pipe off a boiler with a talon.
Leotelse shrugs off a sword slash across the feathers.

name: Rnserium
summary: Rnserium is a gaunt chemist in a patched sackcloth hood who sells hazy vapours that make a crowd's worst memories grow loud. He prefers rented cellars and long rumours to open fights.

feats.scene: Rnserium smashes a glass vial on a brick wall and the vapour empties a whole market hall.
Rnserium tumbles down a cellar staircase and limps off with only bruises.

source_title: Jonathan Crane (Batman: Under the Red Hood)

name: Aunriaiu
summary: Aunriaiu is a soft-spoken ward doctor who distils a nerve tonic that fills sleep with crawling shapes. A cracked straw-stuffed hood hides a calm, courteous face.

feats.scene: Aunriaiu hurls a flask of tonic that bursts across a corridor and sends a guard crawling for the exit.
Aunriaiu shrugs off a chair broken across his back during a patient riot.

name: Sticone
summary: Sticone is a washed-up counsellor turned smuggler who carries a curved harvest blade and a canister of terror mist. He fights like a bar brawler and talks like a pulpit preacher.

feats.scene: Sticone swings his curved blade through a wooden door in a single stroke.
Sticone is slammed through a warehouse crate by two younger fighters and keeps standing.

name: Senelneo
summary: Senelneo is a stitched-hood bogeyman of a lawless harbour district, remembered for a rhyme children chant at night. He was ended by a grinning rival who wanted the whole stage to himself.

feats.scene: Senelneo bangs a rusted pipe against a dock gate until the guards flee.
Senelneo takes a rival's crowbar blow to the ribs and laughs it off.

name: Cante
summary: Cante is a rooftop prankster who weaves fright into every stunt, until a stranger with borrowed lightning pace tears into the city. Cante's story ends in one terrible blow.

feats.scene: Cante knocks a chimney pot off a ledge onto a sleeping patrol car.
Cante survives a three-storey drop onto an awning before the final blow lands.

name: Eoaunan
summary: Eoaunan is a rare-book collector who funds his hobby with racketeering, dressing in a threadbare field costume and leaving riddles at every crime. He is easily outwitted by sharper detectives.

feats.scene: Eoaunan topples a shelf of folios onto a pursuing constable.
Eoaunan is tackled onto a stone floor and still mutters his riddle.

name: Tiaeonst
summary: Tiaeonst is a cheery chemist with a patchwork scarecrow rig who hides gas inside festival gourds that burst when warmed. He trades jabs more often than punches.

feats.scene: Tiaeonst heats a rack of gourds and the cloud drifts over three streets of a fairground.
Tiaeonst takes a flying kick from a masked rival and stays upright for several breaths.

source_title: Jonathan Crane (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Tauosno
summary: Tauosno is a quiet cellblock resident of a crumbling asylum, known mostly for a sackcloth mask stitched from bedsheets. Staff swear he mutters sums to himself all night.

feats.scene: Tauosno rattles a cell door hard enough to wake the whole corridor.
Tauosno endures a night of freezing damp without a blanket.

name: Erncor
summary: Erncor is a veteran frogman who simply never ages, passing his diving knowledge to a son's crew. He pilots a hammer-headed submersible and treats the sea as a long-time friend.

feats.scene: Erncor rams his hammer-headed submersible into a sunken wreck and splits its hull.
Erncor rides out a depth-charge blast and surfaces unharmed.

name: Nueon
summary: Nueon is a smooth-talking field agent who leaks secrets to a big-headed schemer while supervising younger operatives. He relies on bluff, bribes and a very good poker face.

feats.scene: Nueon slams a steel briefcase into a rival's jaw during a rooftop handover.
Nueon survives a car clipping him at a crossing and brushes off the dust.

name: Orcolvos
summary: Orcolvos is a down-at-heel private eye on a foggy waterfront who solves small mysteries for rent money. A pool hustler and a waitress are his only real friends.

feats.scene: Orcolvos lands a short right hand on a bouncer outside a dockside bar.
Orcolvos is tossed over a pier railing and swims to shore unhurt.

name: Ntitia
summary: Ntitia is a grieving orphan who turned vigilante after losing a sibling, then volunteered for an official programme that woke his mind-reading gift. He drifts between safehouses and takes jobs from officials who never admit it.

feats.scene: Ntitia wrenches a parked van across a lot with a thought and pins two hired gunmen against a wall.
Ntitia takes a pistol grip to the temple and keeps his focus unbroken.

name: Iumrnnt
summary: Iumrnnt is a brilliant bio-chemist whose mind cracked after a failed teleport experiment, leaving him able to turn his body into any element he likes. He robs vaults by flowing through them as molten metal or shifting stone.

feats.scene: Iumrnnt becomes a wave of scalding iron and collapses the back wall of a bank.
Iumrnnt turns himself to diamond and lets a collapsing parking deck rain down on him.

name: Entneosti
summary: Entneosti is a cheerful street kid, born to a famous news-selling gang, who joins a junior squad and rides alongside costumed heroes in a rattling cart. He trusts everyone and runs fast.

feats.scene: Entneosti throws a rolled newspaper that knocks a hat off a thief's head.
Entneosti tumbles off his cart on a hill and bounces up laughing.

name: Sorlis
summary: Sorlis is a weathered grain farmer who raises an orphan found in a smoking crater and teaches him to hide what he can do. His advice is plain and patient.

feats.scene: Sorlis swings a wooden mallet and drives a fence post a full forearm into frozen ground.
Sorlis is knocked flat by a bull and gets up to finish his chores.

name: Irnson
summary: Irnson is a quiet elder farmer whose barn smells of hay and old oil. He tells his adopted boy that being decent matters more than being strong.

feats.scene: Irnson heaves a feed sack onto a trailer with one swing.
Irnson works a whole harvest day in blistering heat without a break.

name: Lureo
summary: Lureo is a grey-haired farmer held in a polar vault by government agents and later by his own adopted son, who has turned tyrant. He watches the world slide toward ruin and does not forgive himself.

feats.scene: Lureo slaps a tray out of an agent's hands in a cold vault.
Lureo endures weeks of frozen confinement and still stands to argue with his captors.

name: Rntauva
summary: Rntauva is a gentle, grey-haired crop farmer who appears in a cheerful cartoon about caped friends, always handing out pie and advice. A planet-splitting stunt barely ruffles his straw hat.

feats.scene: Rntauva pitches a bale of hay across a barn loft.
Rntauva rides out a rattling hay wagon on a bumpy road with a grin.

name: Numil
summary: Numil is a retired army man with a rough voice who farms near a river town and quietly guards his adopted boy's secret. Old drills still shape how he stands and speaks.

feats.scene: Numil drops a trespasser with a quick military shove into a feed trough.
Numil stays on his feet after being hit by a fence gate swinging in a storm.

name: Teranulan
summary: Teranulan is a hairless, curious infant of two worlds, born to a famous reporter and a sun-fed hero, who drifts through a collapsing multiverse in his mother's arms. His eyes track every flash of light.

feats.scene: Teranulan gurgles and a crib's wooden bars split from a sudden tiny jolt of force.
Teranulan sleeps through a shockwave that flattens the nursery walls.

name: Aulsanva
summary: Aulsanva is a friendly, athletic teenager and twin who plays quarterback, grows up in a small town and keeps wondering why his parents guard so many secrets. He teases his brother but always has his back.

feats.scene: Aulsanva throws a football fifty yards through a tire swing.
Aulsanva is flattened by a linebacker and jogs back for the next snap.

name: Colra
summary: Colra is the grown heir of a legendary flier, taking up a cape in a neon-lit future and urging a revived league to share the work with ordinary people. He carries both parents' strength and calm.

feats.scene: Colra punches through a collapsing tower and the shockwave levels the neighbouring block.
Colra takes a missile salvo head-on over a harbour and flies on unmarked.

name: Literere
summary: Literere is a one-legged war reporter who curses fate in a ruined shrine and is adopted by a smith-god, who grants him a mighty frame and bright armour. He fights wars and crime with a shield that no blow dents.

feats.scene: Literere brings his hammer down on a siege tower and splits it into kindling across a plain.
Literere stands under a collapsing temple roof and walks out through the dust.

name: Iumrnsas
summary: Iumrnsas is a mortal correspondent who, in a war between pantheons, is flooded with every god's gift at once, from crushing might to sleep-bringing spells. He falls to a sorceress's trick, and his spirit is led to a quiet meadow.

feats.scene: Iumrnsas hurls a divine spear that flattens a coastal city's harbour district.
Iumrnsas stands in a burning storm of divine fire without a scratch.

name: Tielinu
summary: Tielinu is a quiet child raised overseas by a clever mother, who reads him bedtime comics about her old adventures. He grows up in a flat above a noodle shop.

feats.scene: Tielinu tosses a stuffed toy across a bedroom into a basket.
Tielinu falls off a bicycle on a gravel path and gets up laughing.

name: Retal
summary: Retal is a sunlit-hearted young hero who inherits his father's mantle after a digital plague wipes out the old world. He leads survivors to a new home and hands out hope like bread.

feats.scene: Retal punches a plague-driven horde's war machine and the blast levels a quarter of an abandoned district.
Retal is buried beneath a crumbling skyscraper and digs himself out with only dust on his cape.

name: Saunt
summary: Saunt is a young hero who takes up a famous cape after a father's exile, travels between stars and leads a roster of heroes across ages. He has to decide how to be a man for his own day.

feats.scene: Saunt throws a punch through a drifting moon-sized rock and the shockwave levels a distant city's skyline.
Saunt crosses a stellar flare and arrives at a harbour unburned.

name: Aueon
summary: Aueon is a plastic-brick-built boy of two worlds, soaking up sunlight to blaze with heat, fly and punch through walls, while keeping a notebook of photographs. He is fast, strong and mostly cheerful.

feats.scene: Aueon fires a bright beam from his eyes and levels a whole block of brick towers.
Aueon is struck by a toppling crane and shrugs it off like a pebble.
Aueon streaks across a skyline in the time it takes to blink.

name: Iareoal
summary: Iareoal is a small half-alien boy who soars in a cartoon dream, joining a crowd of caped friends to rescue an old butler's sleeping mind. He mostly flies, giggles and waves.

feats.scene: Iareoal slams into a dream monster and knocks it over a bed.
Iareoal is thrown through a dream wall of bricks and keeps giggling.

name: Iunusest
summary: Iunusest is a bright teenage vigilante from a flooded city who moves to a lakeside town, befriends a witty classmate and a rival's son, and solves a mystery about his mother's strange illness. His senses are sharp and his body is hardy.

feats.scene: Iunusest punches a rusted door off its hinges and it clatters across a courtyard.
Iunusest is slammed by a van and gets up with a wince.

name: Esllante
summary: Esllante is a boy of two heritages who appears in a lively online family comic, joining city outings, sleepovers and school drama with famous relatives. His abilities show up as cheerful gags more than as battles.

feats.scene: Esllante lifts a couch to retrieve a lost game controller.
Esllante tumbles down a flight of stairs in a play fight and bounces up grinning.

name: Rnconum
summary: Rnconum is a calm, polite tenant with a dark belt in an old striking art who lives down the hall from a famous reporter. He fixes leaky taps and breaks up fights without raising his voice.

feats.scene: Rnconum snaps a wooden practice board with a clean palm strike.
Rnconum takes a hard fall in a dojo and rolls back to his feet.

name: Nueol
summary: Nueol is a self-taught inventor with a rust-red thatch who builds little insect drones to steal jewels, then retreats to a riverside lair with a plan for revenge. His gadgets are clever but his luck is poor.

feats.scene: Nueol triggers a pocket charge that blows a hole in a display case.
Nueol stumbles into a pile of scrap and comes away scratched.

name: Rosern
summary: Rosern is a decorated, white-haired general with a chest full of medals who guards a desert airbase and a stubborn secret project. He frowns at reckless pilots and still respects them.

feats.scene: Rosern punches a cocky young pilot square on the cheek.
Rosern is thrown against a hangar wall in a drill and walks on.

name: Cilenva
summary: Cilenva is a cheerful outback mechanic who rebuilds a broken android's frame from planks, hubcaps and spare parts behind his shed. He talks to the engine as he works.

feats.scene: Cilenva hammers a bent axle straight with three hard blows.
Cilenva slides out from under a jacked truck that slips and clips his shoulder.

name: Riaullan
summary: Riaullan is a rescue worker caught in a chemical blast that turns his body to living mud, then is cornered by a masked manipulator who holds his family hostage. His mutated cells slowly eat the rest of him.

feats.scene: Riaullan swings a mud-heavy fist and caves in a delivery truck's side.
Riaullan is hit by a stack of falling girders and flows back together in seconds.

name: Estleli
summary: Estleli is a red-haired cosmic referee who floats above the story pages to fix slips and contradictions, armed with an uncanny awareness of every detail. She returns from death wearing a ring of dark energy.

feats.scene: Estleli flings a bolt of black light that cracks a skyscraper from foundation to roof.
Estleli passes through a collapsing tower of binders and sheets unharmed.

name: Auseotu
summary: Auseotu is a scarred frontier outlaw whose family burned in a fire set by cruel neighbours, leaving him with a ruined jaw and a legendary temper. He leads a gang of fellow outcasts on train robberies in the desert.

feats.scene: Auseotu blasts a railway car's door off its track with a burst of raw heat.
Auseotu is blown across a boxcar by a mechanical soldier's cannon and rises.

name: Arntu
summary: Arntu is a young construction-site tough who wears a bright hard hat as a calling card and bullies his way into small-time jobs. He always picks the wrong target.

feats.scene: Arntu swings a shovel into a shop window and shatters it.
Arntu takes a bike-lock blow to the helmet and only blinks.

name: Strnuser
summary: Strnuser is a long-suffering butler who dresses as a clock-faced sorcerer in secret, plotting against a young hero who borrows a magic word. He rules the cellar staircase.

feats.scene: Strnuser drops a silver tray on a guest's foot.
Strnuser rides out a tumble down the cellar steps with his bowtie still straight.

name: Tautater
summary: Tautater is a patient inventor asked to investigate strange tremors, who builds a model rocket in secret when the council laughs at him. He argues kindly with his wife over who should board the tiny craft.

feats.scene: Tautater fires his model rocket and its exhaust scorches a launch pad black.
Tautater is thrown to the floor by tremors and gets back up.

name: Olreinu
summary: Olreinu is a brilliant but controversial researcher who studies quakes, finds their cause and secretly builds a one-seat ship to carry a whole population through a ghostly gate. He ends up using it only as a lifeboat for his son.

feats.scene: Olreinu ignites the little ship's engine and its blast boils a launch trench dry.
Olreinu is knocked down by a rolling quake and gets back to his feet.

name: Enuliren
summary: Enuliren is a senior scholar of an ancient noble house who finds that a hidden foe has sealed his planet's heat inside, then etches his people's lessons into the molecules of a prototype rocket. He and his wife watch it rise over the burning horizon.

feats.scene: Enuliren fires a prototype rocket and its engines blow the silo's doors outward across a canyon.
Enuliren shields his face from a rolling blast of heat and keeps working.

name: Reornisi
summary: Reornisi is a bearded researcher in an animated team-up saga, a loving father and grandfather who studies the sciences and fights for his family's survival in a grand finale. His calm advice is hard to forget.

feats.scene: Reornisi triggers a lab reactor and a whole bench of glassware bursts outward.
Reornisi stays on his feet through a rocking quake in his observatory.

name: Erealta
summary: Erealta is a clever scientist with great mental gifts, recalled only in passing as the one who sends his only son away to save him when the world is dying. His few words carry a lot of love.

feats.scene: Erealta hurls a tiny capsule into the sky with an engine that rattles the whole yard.
Erealta falls onto a stone path in a tremor and gets up at once.

name: Orentolu
summary: Orentolu is a devoted scientist of a dying world who builds a single escape pod and sends his only child away to safety. He spends his last hours beside his wife, watching the sky.

feats.scene: Orentolu fires the little pod's engine and its blast scours the launch field to glass.
Orentolu stays upright through a rolling quake that topples his shelves.

name: Allna
summary: Allna is a husband and father who, when the ground starts to split, tucks his son into a rocket and kisses his wife goodbye. Few records of him survive beyond that single act.

feats.scene: Allna ignites a hand-built rocket and its exhaust cracks a paved yard.
Allna is thrown to the floor by tremors and climbs back up.

name: Sesiarn
summary: Sesiarn is an anxious scholar who learns too late that old wars poisoned his planet's depths, then sends his unborn child toward a frontier prairie where gentle people live. He and his wife record a last message of courage.

feats.scene: Sesiarn launches a plain steel capsule and its thrust gouges a trench through a plateau.
Sesiarn stands in a hail of falling stone and keeps recording.

name: Niuneil
summary: Niuneil is a grey-eyed scholar in a television drama who speaks mind to mind with his family and sends a baby out in a tiny pod. His quiet resolve moves every scene he is in.

feats.scene: Niuneil lights an engine and the pod's thrust shatters the glass walls of a lab.
Niuneil is knocked flat by a rolling tremor and rises.

name: Testrn
summary: Testrn is a tall council scientist who, in youth, fell for an earthly woman and learned that bullets bounce off his skin. He later follows orders to build a cloning orb and secretly spoils it to save others.

feats.scene: Testrn rips a barn door from its frame in panic and hurls it across a yard.
Testrn stands in a hail of gunfire and every shell flattens against his coat.

name: Austicel
summary: Austicel is a serious scientist in an old black-and-white serial who builds a lone rocket as his world shakes apart. He speaks in short, grave sentences.

feats.scene: Austicel starts a rocket motor and its flame carves a deep furrow into the dust.
Austicel hangs on to a lab table during a violent shake and then lets go.

name: Tuntoium
summary: Tuntoium is a white-haired copy of an old scientist, grown in an orb and woken years later on a farm, who tries to bluff a conqueror into trusting a masked rescuer. He dies in a friend's arms asking mercy for a rival.

feats.scene: Tuntoium shoves a heavy farm cart across a barn floor in alarm.
Tuntoium shrugs off a thrown tractor wheel before the final blow lands.

name: Lasteste
summary: Lasteste is a cold, ruthless planner who lets a monstrous visitor poison his people's world, then rides out the crisis by shooting his way to a lifepod. He sneers at his frail child and records harsh lectures for the voyage.

feats.scene: Lasteste fires a rifle into a crowd of rivals and clears a path to the pod.
Lasteste is thrown against a wall by a tremor and spits dust.

name: Rialan
summary: Rialan is a practical engineer who builds sensible gadgets that the old guard dismisses, then races his own brother to launch a rescue rocket. His marriage to a former librarian is full of quiet warmth.

feats.scene: Rialan tests a rocket early and its flame scorches a whole workshop wall.
Rialan is hurled across the floor by an eruption and gets up bleeding.

name: Toriarva
summary: Toriarva is a sharp-eyed investigator in an imagined far future, chasing a pirate queen and her crew across the star lanes. He exists only inside a lecturer's story.

feats.scene: Toriarva fires a pistol at a pirate's engine and silences it with one shot.
Toriarva dives behind a cargo crate as a stray bolt scorches the paint.

name: Ntumi
summary: Ntumi is a pale-haired tycoon born into a family that can freeze the air, who turns that gift into a campaign of vengeance for a lost wife. He leads a gang of masked old-timers and is thought dead after a showdown.

feats.scene: Ntumi exhales a blizzard and freezes the whole front of a school gym solid.
Ntumi is thrown off a roof onto a car and walks away without a wince.

name: Cortornto
summary: Cortornto is a bitter ex-officer who dons a mask and tracks a rival's secrets, targeting everyone she loves and her good name. He has no powers, only patience and cruelty.

feats.scene: Cortornto fires a rifle at a rooftop tank and the burst soaks a stakeout.
Cortornto is clubbed by a pair of trained fighters and stays conscious for a few moments.

name: Locarse
summary: Locarse is a quiet engineer on an island of a dying world who builds a craft with his wife to save their son. His hardy body helps him survive the shaking long enough to launch it.

feats.scene: Locarse activates a hand-built engine and its thrust gouges a pit in the island rock.
Locarse is pinned under a fallen beam and lifts it off himself.

name: Rnuronll
summary: Rnuronll is the secret second-generation caped hero of a far-flung year, raising a son who will take up the same mantle. His calm temper masks great power.

feats.scene: Rnuronll slams a fist into a rogue asteroid and it splinters over an empty ocean.
Rnuronll takes a missile barrage on the chest and does not flinch.

name: Raerunti
summary: Raerunti is a harmless-looking android built by a worried scholar to lure children away from a failing world, using a hypnotic hum. A stray laser knocked it into the void for ages.

feats.scene: Raerunti shrugs off a volley and answers with a pulse that cracks a hangar wall.
Raerunti is struck by a heavy laser bolt and drifts for centuries without a mark.

name: Nanauveo
summary: Nanauveo is a former boxing champion turned teacher who puts on a rough suit to protect teenagers from street gangs in a poor district. A broken spine later forces him to accept a cybernetic fix.

feats.scene: Nanauveo lands a hook on an armoured brute and rattles his helmet.
Nanauveo takes a crushing hit that breaks his back and still finishes the fight.

name: Reolen
summary: Reolen is the first street fighter in a rough suit, now offering services through an app and passing the mantle to a niece. He keeps a rule of never leaving a block unwatched.

feats.scene: Reolen hits a gang boss with a straight jab that sends him over a rail.
Reolen is tossed through a plywood fence and keeps walking.

name: Anuia
summary: Anuia is a young conscript who becomes the first wearer of a bulky crimson battle suit, built with the help of a visiting alien welder. He serves a rigid state and stays loyal to his friend.

feats.scene: Anuia punches a steel gate in his crimson suit and bends it off its hinges.
Anuia withstands a tank shell on his chest plate and stays on his feet.

name: Lintircol
summary: Lintircol is a gentle, grey-haired newsman who writes a column and drives an old sedan, who worries about a young colleague's reckless streak. He once pulled his friend out of the way of a falling building.

feats.scene: Lintircol yanks a friend out of the way of a crumbling wall with a sharp tug.
Lintircol is knocked down by falling masonry dust and brushes off his coat.

name: Isamva
summary: Isamva is a teen who agrees to a stranger's deal to save his dying hometown and his family, and turns into a horned creature wreathed in flame. He no longer cares who wins between order and chaos.

feats.scene: Isamva unleashes a column of fire that burns a whole mining town to ash.
Isamva is buried in a collapsing mine and walks out of the rubble smiling.

name: Nanusor
summary: Nanusor is a petty thug with white hair who shoots a couple in a back alley for their purse, an act that shapes a whole city's future. He lives out his days in a quiet, bitter hush.

feats.scene: Nanusor fires a pistol twice in a narrow alley.
Nanusor stumbles down a flight of back steps and curses.

name: Iarern
summary: Iarern is a small-time thug who commits one terrible robbery in an alley, then hides in a prison cell, afraid of what the victim's child might do. He lets his one chance go and runs.

feats.scene: Iarern fires a revolver once and the echo rolls down an empty alley.
Iarern is shoved into a cell wall by a guard and does not resist.

name: Vicer
summary: Vicer is a low-rent hired gun who, on a boss's orders, ambushes a couple outside a cinema but cannot bring himself to hurt their child. He is later killed by gangsters who learn what he did.

feats.scene: Vicer fires two quick shots in a cinema alley and flees.
Vicer shrugs off a punch from an angry gang member before being cornered.

name: Tento
summary: Tento is a gray-haired hitman, living in squalor, who claims his famous crime was a mistake over a pearl necklace. A man in a mask later brings him to a prison where he sits as a model inmate.

feats.scene: Tento fires a pistol in a dim alley and the shot echoes against a wall.
Tento is knocked to the ground by an angry teenager and lies still.

name: Oroor
summary: Oroor is a dark-haired professional crook who appears under a menacing nickname for a single caper in the past. His plans rely on speed and bluster.

feats.scene: Oroor swings a crowbar at a safe's hinge and snaps it.
Oroor is slammed onto a conveyor belt and rolls off cursing.

name: Saseo
summary: Saseo is a failed paper-seller fired for tossing coins in the office, who turns every crime into a coin-themed prank after robbing a till full of change. He is brought down by the very copper he hates.

feats.scene: Saseo flings a handful of coins through an arcade window and cracks the glass.
Saseo is tackled onto a pile of loose change and wheezes.

name: Vosnti
summary: Vosnti is a white-haired lawmaker snared in a scandal over selling public contracts, who keeps smiling for the cameras to the last. He relies on lawyers and favours, not fists.

feats.scene: Vosnti slams a gavel on a podium so hard it splits the wood.
Vosnti stumbles off a stage platform and brushes off the dust.

name: Lesos
summary: Lesos is a grieving widower, once a city worker, who becomes a masked killer in the name of saving the city. His motives are tragic and his hands are steady.

feats.scene: Lesos fires an arrow through a security door's lock and swings it open.
Lesos is thrown through a window and rolls back to his feet.

name: Lanva
summary: Lanva is a cheerful factory hand who plays ball with the neighbourhood kids after shifts, until he is lost in a distant war. His helmet is kept by his son as a memory.

feats.scene: Lanva swings a bat and sends a ball over a fence.
Lanva works a long shift at the line and goes home laughing.

name: Roncati
summary: Roncati is a dour ministry official who spreads rumours by radio and poster, and who ends his own days by fire when his side collapses. He appears briefly in the background of a bleak war tale.

feats.scene: Roncati slams a desk drawer shut so hard that the radio jumps.
Roncati sits in a flaming bunker for a moment and does not move.

name: Torcolia
summary: Torcolia is a crude builder who finds a magic dialling device in the rubble, spins a code and wakes up as a blonde, crackling heroine. She flies out of the window in a sulk and fights the wrong people for a while.

feats.scene: Torcolia lets out a crackling surge that blows a whole truck's windows out.
Torcolia crashes through a plate-glass window and lands unscratched.

name: Tumnumeon
summary: Tumnumeon is a flamboyant officer who dresses in garish star-and-stripe colours and takes assignments from a shadowy government office. He loves a parade more than a battlefield.

feats.scene: Tumnumeon shoves a cadet off a stage in a staged salute.
Tumnumeon is jostled by a crowd at a parade and keeps waving.

name: Rianulla
summary: Rianulla is a white-haired despot of a jungle republic who hires mercenaries and bodyguards to put down rebels. He is blown to pieces when a patched-up tank rolls into his capital.

feats.scene: Rianulla fires a revolver into a ceiling to silence his aides.
Rianulla survives a bomb scare, shaken but standing.

name: Natesan
summary: Natesan is a bald convict with a glowing skull who leads a gang of powered inmates in a high-security cellblock. A rival's riot leaves him beaten and betrayed.

feats.scene: Natesan lets loose a pulse that fractures a cell door and a nearby wall.
Natesan is mobbed by the rioting prisoners and clings to consciousness.

name: Sonroslon
summary: Sonroslon is a dark-haired lawmaker who looms in the background of old tales, remembered for a harsh campaign against supposed enemies at home. He only ever appears in newsreels and rumour.

feats.scene: Sonroslon bangs a fist on a lectern during a long hearing.
Sonroslon sits through a heckling crowd without flinching.

name: Vaauseo
summary: Vaauseo is a thuggish brawler who kills three men in a bar and is then switched on by a foreign tyrant's scientists, becoming a huge, bulletproof-ish mercenary. He can take a direct energy burst with only mild damage.

feats.scene: Vaauseo punches a wall of a safehouse and collapses a whole side of it.
Vaauseo takes a direct energy blast at point-blank range and only scowls.

name: Sinen
summary: Sinen is a soot-smudged pyromaniac in a bright flame-proof suit who carries a pair of flamethrowers and talks to the fire as if it listens. He ends his story singing in the blaze.

feats.scene: Sinen sets a whole warehouse alight with a double sweep of his flamethrowers.
Sinen stands in the heart of a burning room and his suit only chars.

name: Neammia
summary: Neammia is a rescue-service worker with a fascination for flames, skilled with engines and driving, who finds his talent for stoking infernos is a curse. He keeps a rule of military precision even in madness.

feats.scene: Neammia coaxes a stairwell fire into a roaring blast that gutted an entire floor.
Neammia walks through a burning corridor without a blister.

name: Llevi
summary: Llevi is a hardy young soldier, a widower from a family of famous fighters, placed on an elite covert team after a stint as a corporal. He is skilled at marksmanship, stealth and leading others.

feats.scene: Llevi fires a rifle through a distant sentry's lamp from a ridge.
Llevi is tossed by a grenade blast and rises to keep fighting.

name: Iuosase
summary: Iuosase is a short, black-eyed ruler of a vast eastern state who takes in a boy of extraordinary abilities and calls him a man of metal. His jealous protege plots poison behind his back.

feats.scene: Iuosase slaps a report onto a table in a council meeting.
Iuosase sips a poisoned cup without noticing until it is too late.

name: Tiureo
summary: Tiureo is a mustachioed dictator who rules a great northern empire with a harsh hand, famous for crushing a neighbour's army and for paranoia. Two different versions merged into one long story.

feats.scene: Tiureo pounds a table with a fist as officers fall silent.
Tiureo sits stone-faced through a long, tense banquet.

name: Nteotir
summary: Nteotir is a stern premier who defends brutal policies as terrible necessities, until a far stronger visitor burns him down with a beam from the eyes. His speeches are chillingly calm.

feats.scene: Nteotir signs a decree with a stab of his pen that tears the paper.
Nteotir endures a long, cold night in a bunker without complaint.

name: Iumtelmi
summary: Iumtelmi is a cheerful trapeze artist who performs with his wife and son as an airborne family act, and who helps catch a gang in a zoo. His fall ends the act and begins a boy's new life.

feats.scene: Iumtelmi flips off the high bar and kicks a pursuer into a sawdust pile.
Iumtelmi lands a bad dismount on the ring floor and gets up grinning.

name: Iumcis
summary: Iumcis is a brash street dealer with a gang who orders a rough lesson for a schoolteacher's friend, only to be cut down in a three-way brawl. His arrogance outpaces his skill.

feats.scene: Iumcis smashes a gym window with a baseball bat to scare a crowd.
Iumcis is thrown across a court by a masked fighter and sputters.

name: Lonvaltau
summary: Lonvaltau is a fast-talking publicist who books halls, trades favours and keeps a client's name in the papers. Lonvaltau owns nothing stronger than nerve, a fat address book and a knack for turning a bad evening into a good headline.

feats.scene: Lonvaltau drives a shoulder into a jammed stage door and bursts it open.
Lonvaltau tumbles down a flight of backstage stairs and stands up with only bruises.
Lonvaltau sprints across a lobby to catch a departing reporter.

name: Aninsi
summary: Aninsi is a brilliant, bitter schemer who lost his family young and now plots against a famous rival with cold patience. Aninsi pays a hired brute to do the fighting while he builds traps from cheap parts and cruel ideas.

feats.scene: Aninsi swings a lead pipe into a hired thug's ribs.
Aninsi takes a brutal beating from the hired brute and keeps laughing.

name: Terlloirn
summary: Terlloirn is a gruff veteran detective turned precinct chief, a devoted parent who raises children that are not all his by blood. Terlloirn fights with a steady aim, hard-won street sense and a stubborn refusal to quit on anyone.

feats.scene: Terlloirn tackles a fleeing suspect and pins him to the pavement.
Terlloirn is thrown across a parking lot by a blast and gets back up.
Terlloirn chases a runner for three blocks and still makes the arrest.

name: Sestnau
summary: Sestnau is a silent young fighter who speaks through signs and through the minds of others, slipping into a stranger's body and steering it. Sestnau also hurls objects by thought and wears a gravity-bending harness that lets him hover and cover himself in a psychic shell.

feats.scene: Sestnau flings a parked van across a street using only his mind.
Sestnau's psychic shell stops a charging truck short.
Sestnau skims over rooftops in his gravity harness.

name: Rileoser
summary: Rileoser is a quiet student whose borrowed alien code lets him step into another body through a shared glance. Rileoser can also link two minds so that thoughts pass between them, though he cannot speak aloud himself.

feats.scene: Rileoser, riding a guard's body, slams a locker door shut.
Rileoser takes a heavy fall from a gym balcony and walks away.

name: Tureci
summary: Tureci is a haunted young man whose voice was taken in childhood and whose gift for entering minds grew from an experiment on his family. Tureci wields that gift with bitter reluctance and drifts toward crime when pressed.

feats.scene: Tureci, sliding into a bruiser's body, punches through a plank wall.
Tureci is thrown through a window and gets up without a break.

name: Vaiutiu
summary: Vaiutiu is a resentful postal worker who feels invisible and begins carving masks from the faces of those who ignored him. Vaiutiu wears each victim's likeness, fights with a long blade and is clever enough to hold his own against a trained brawler.

feats.scene: Vaiutiu drives a long knife through a wooden door.
Vaiutiu is kicked down a stairwell by a trained brawler and keeps crawling.

name: Ntusan
summary: Ntusan is a seasoned field spy who gave up a quiet romance to carry a title passed down from one agent to the next. Ntusan wears her mask like a second skin and is trained in disguise, firearms and close fighting.

feats.scene: Ntusan flips a larger guard over her hip and into a crate.
Ntusan survives a rooftop fall by rolling into an awning.
Ntusan sprints down an alley with two pursuers a step behind.

name: Resan
summary: Resan is an elderly farmer who buries a baby of his own and finds a strange child in a fallen vessel, then makes a choice he never fully forgives himself for. Resan raises the foundling with plain decency and hides a secret machine on his land.

feats.scene: Resan swings a spade into hard frozen soil to dig a grave.
Resan hauls a heavy wagon out of a ditch in winter wind.

name: Rnent
summary: Rnent is a teenage tinkerer who taps radio traffic and flashes a warning to heroes when his brother falls in with a street gang. Rnent has no powers but knows wiring, signals and circuits better than most adults.

feats.scene: Rnent shorts a sparking junction box and throws off a bright arc.
Rnent is knocked from a fire escape and lands on a rubbish pile.

name: Ialta
summary: Ialta is a soft-spoken caretaker and physician who became more than human yet refuses to use the change. Ialta tends fragile patients in a remote house and quietly hates the schemer who made them that way.

feats.scene: Ialta lifts a frail patient from a bed without strain.
Ialta shrugs off a heavy fall down the manor steps.

name: Lenniaser
summary: Lenniaser grew up in a rough tenement district, served as a medic and, horrified by a massacre, loosed a burst of force from his bare hands. Lenniaser fled for a decade before a team recruited him to fight again.

feats.scene: Lenniaser blasts a rusted car across a junkyard with a kinetic burst.
Lenniaser takes a heavy grenade blast and keeps his feet.

name: Llsite
summary: Llsite is a weary fighter who is killed by an old mentor and lingers as a gentle spirit to console a lonely friend. Llsite is later copied by a phantom queen as a cruel illusion that wears his face.

feats.scene: Llsite slams a shoulder into a locked cellar door.
Llsite is thrown across a cluttered room and stays standing.

name: Sercornel
summary: Sercornel was a blind counsellor lifted into a role as keeper of an infinite wellspring, then saw every outcome at once. Sercornel could beat three champions with ease, but fled the world, afraid that his boundless strength would harm everyone near him.

feats.scene: Sercornel scatters three champions with a single sweep of the wellspring's force.
Sercornel absorbs a surge that would crack a mountain and feels nothing.
Sercornel leaves the planet's sky in a heartbeat.

name: Iumlini
summary: Iumlini is a volatile youth whose raw powers once wrecked a children's home and kept him in a frozen vault for years. Iumlini projects shields and thumping blasts of force and absorbs energy to fuel them.

feats.scene: Iumlini loses control and flattens a small orphanage wing in a single pulse.
Iumlini's shield holds against a collapsing ceiling.

name: Lleernan
summary: Lleernan is a stoic founder of a hired hero squad who can turn his body to dense stone and fire bursts of force from it. Lleernan once ran a research lab and now directs his team with calm patience.

feats.scene: Lleernan fires a stone-fisted blast that cracks a concrete wall.
Lleernan stands in stone form as a bus slams into him.

name: Numtist
summary: Numtist is a courageous airframe pilot who inherits a loaned weapon of will from a dying alien and is thrown into a doomed war. Numtist shapes glowing constructs, flies and shields allies, though barely trained, and falls on his first day.

feats.scene: Numtist hurls a glowing wall across a cratered street to hold back a wave.
Numtist braces his shield against the antimatter surge for a final moment.
Numtist streaks through a ruined sky on his ring's glow.

name: Eriuri
summary: Eriuri is a blunt, pale soldier of a star-spanning police force who refers to himself by name alone. Eriuri lost a limb in the line of duty and still wields a glowing ring to shield allies, fly and blast.

feats.scene: Eriuri blasts a hole through a freighter's hull with his ring.
Eriuri's shield absorbs a barrage of plasma and shrugs it off.
Eriuri races a patrol skiff between asteroids.

name: Llutor
summary: Llutor is a stern, fair-haired tribunal figure who hands down sentences in a ruined future. Llutor works with a small band of enforcers and treats mercy as a flaw.

feats.scene: Llutor strikes a prisoner's shackle with a mallet and snaps it.
Llutor takes a heavy blow to the chest and stays on her feet.

name: Tetumna
summary: Tetumna is a stern, grey-haired arbiter of an extra-dimensional court who regulates how others may use their gifts. Tetumna can exile offenders to a lower plane and lock them there until set terms are met.

feats.scene: Tetumna tears a rebel from his home plane with a word and hurls him down a level of reality.
Tetumna stands unmoved as a rioting crowd's spells break against his bench.

name: Corres
summary: Corres is the unseen head of a secret society of old-money schemers who left their city for years and returned when riots began. Corres commands by letter and shadow and is rarely seen in the open.

feats.scene: Corres brings a cane down on a table to end a debate.
Corres is knocked off a balcony and is pulled out by loyal servants.

name: Silcaseo
summary: Silcaseo was a painter of strange dreams who lived in a bohemian quarter a century ago and died young, leaving her sister to avenge her. Silcaseo is remembered for her vivid canvases and her sister's fury.

feats.scene: Silcaseo flings a pot of paint across a studio in a rage.
Silcaseo falls from a low stage and gets up bruised.

name: Ollsor
summary: Ollsor is a grim vigilante who kills criminals after a family loss and moves his own children across an ocean to hide it. Ollsor fights hand to hand with practised skill and finally steps off a ledge rather than face a cell.

feats.scene: Ollsor hammers a gunman off his feet with a straight punch.
Ollsor takes a savage beating on a building site and still rises.

name: Ceterval
summary: Ceterval is a diver who handles radios and gadgets for a crew of undersea adventurers. Ceterval sets up the signals that let her brother and a sea king's envoy reach the surface.

feats.scene: Ceterval cranks a heavy winch to haul up a dive cage.
