Ceterval endures a deep dive's pressure and comes up shaking.

name: Semaium
summary: Semaium is a petty crook who steals a formula that soaks up the force of every blow and turns it into muscle and toughness. Semaium picks fights to grow stronger, then burns out when the stored force runs dry.

feats.scene: Semaium throws a stored-up punch that dents a steel vault door.
Semaium laughs as a hail of heavy blows only swells his frame.

name: Cinseaul
summary: Cinseaul is a showy street performer turned thief who hides blades and gas in a set of juggling clubs and drives a car shaped like one. Cinseaul is more theatre than danger, but his tricks can hurt.

feats.scene: Cinseaul hurls a weighted club that cracks a shop window.
Cinseaul is thrown into a crate stack and keeps juggling.

name: Arliani
summary: Arliani is a yellow-eyed warrior of ancient captivity who fights in a pit built to keep prisoners hungry. Arliani throws bolts of alien magic and weaves shields that can trap an enemy, and now guards a frontier outpost.

feats.scene: Arliani hurls a roaring bolt of sorcery that blasts a stone wall to rubble.
Arliani's magic ward holds against a charging brute.

name: Vioratum
summary: Vioratum is a former counter-terror policeman who declines to join a state experiment out of fear and watches his brother and friends become a super-squad. Vioratum later joins a strike team and sees the same brother sour into a dangerous politician.

feats.scene: Vioratum breaks down a locked door with a kick.
Vioratum takes a hard fall from a truck bed and keeps moving.

name: Numvasiu
summary: Numvasiu is a blind, deranged killer who befriends giant spiders in a dungeon and returns home to avenge himself on those who jailed him. Numvasiu sends threats, kidnaps victims and sets his eight-legged pets on them in a hollow tree den.

feats.scene: Numvasiu swings a rope to drop a trapdoor on his guests.
Numvasiu is slammed to the ground by his pursuers and does not cry out.

name: Temieo
summary: Temieo is a calm hospital administrator who runs a clinic ward and plans her wedding. Temieo has no gifts beyond a steady head and a fondness for tidy schedules.

feats.scene: Temieo shoves a stuck gurney through a ward doorway.
Temieo slips on a wet floor and gets up with a scrape.

name: Seoril
summary: Seoril is a learned dig-site scholar who studies old machines and old myths and welcomes a young traveller into her home. Seoril dies in a street clash, and her loss pushes her daughter toward vengeance.

feats.scene: Seoril swings a trowel to break a layer of dry clay.
Seoril is flung against a wall by a shockwave in the street.

name: Nianto
summary: Nianto is a devoted mother whose gifted daughter is injured in a street attack and later heals through a daring medical trial. Nianto dies in a car crash, which sends her daughter spiralling.

feats.scene: Nianto helps lift a wheelchair up a flight of steps.
Nianto takes the full force of a roadside collision.

name: Rnnum
summary: Rnnum is a precise, rule-minded lab examiner and former soldier who clashes with a careless colleague. Rnnum hides a darker alter ego that works in alchemy and later returns home to put his past in order.

feats.scene: Rnnum throws a trained rifle-butt strike that staggers a guard.
Rnnum is flung across a lab bench and keeps his composure.

name: Iutelor
summary: Iutelor is a vengeful son who blames a dark knight for his father's fall and builds a worldwide band of masked killers from old costumes. Iutelor directs his army from a screen and sends a modified soldier after his target.

feats.scene: Iutelor hammers a console in fury and cracks the glass.
Iutelor is thrown against a bunker wall and stays upright.

name: Rnost
summary: Rnost is a jail-hardened obsessive who times each crime to a date on the almanac and boasts of his early work. Rnost wears a sneer and taunts his captor, and his plots grow more elaborate with every season.

feats.scene: Rnost swings a metal tray to knock a guard aside.
Rnost takes a vicious beating from his captor and keeps talking.

name: Nenrisiu
summary: Nenrisiu is a petty holiday-themed crook who is magically upgraded into a muscular tyrant with a flock of seasonal monsters. Nenrisiu reverts when a meddling imp loses interest, and finds his new power gone.

feats.scene: Nenrisiu sweeps a cluster of festive beasts into a charge that smashes a pillar.
Nenrisiu shrugs off a crashing blow from a bus-sized beast.

source_title: Julian Day (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Niluti
summary: Niluti is a sullen physicist who builds an orb that bends luck at the smallest scale, then uses it to win prizes and rise to high office. Niluti is stopped when his rival smashes the device and his rigged luck unwinds.

feats.scene: Niluti slams a fist on a podium to start his speech.
Niluti is bowled over by a guard rush and waves it off.

name: Tiunaneon
summary: Tiunaneon is a boastful doctor who announces himself as a master of everything and plans to rewrite history to rule the world. Tiunaneon mostly tries to bluff, with a lot of talk and a few clever devices.

feats.scene: Tiunaneon slaps a switch so hard a console panel cracks.
Tiunaneon is bowled over by a fast runner and bounces up complaining.

name: Lerauci
summary: Lerauci is a sharp-tongued widow who takes over her late husband's crime ring and quarrels with a rival boss. Lerauci rules by threat and gossip and meets a violent end.

feats.scene: Lerauci slaps a rival's face in a crowded bar.
Lerauci is shoved to the floor and rises with her drink still in hand.

name: Ronan
summary: Ronan is a once-gentle wife who, in a grim possible future, lets her spirit pour into a hulking war machine to punish those she blames for her father's end. Ronan is driven back to her flesh and sent to care.

feats.scene: Ronan, driving the war machine, crushes a stone balustrade in one swing.
Ronan's metal shell takes a heavy blast and holds.

name: Ntoial
summary: Ntoial is a red-haired socialite in a distant alternate city who weds a famous millionaire. Ntoial is known for good humour and for standing by her husband when the streets turn dark.

feats.scene: Ntoial pushes open a heavy ballroom door.
Ntoial trips on a stair and catches the rail.

name: Torlu
summary: Torlu is a wealthy actress who breaks an engagement, marries into royalty twice and rules a small kingdom after her first husband dies. Torlu is once cloned by kidnappers, whose copy briefly marches an army to war.

feats.scene: Torlu slams a gavel to open a court session.
Torlu is jostled by a panicked crowd and does not fall.

name: Austine
summary: Austine is an ancient general and consul pulled through time to a modern beach by a careless crew, who then conquers most of the world when he reads his own fate. Austine commands legions with charisma and fights with a short sword.

feats.scene: Austine cleaves a wooden shield in half with a short sword.
Austine endures a mass of armed students swinging at him and stays upright.

name: Coaule
summary: Coaule is an ancient commander who pushed his realm's borders across a continent and then wrote a false report to hide a defeat he could not explain. Coaule is remembered as a general, a statesman and a ruler.

feats.scene: Coaule hews through a wooden palisade gate with a heavy blade.
Coaule takes a spear strike on his breastplate and does not flinch.

name: Raurnar
summary: Raurnar is a springy, pouched pet of a warrior queen and a loyal ally to a team of animal heroes. Raurnar bounds over tall walls and dodges blows with remarkable agility.

feats.scene: Raurnar kicks a heavy crate across a courtyard.
Raurnar lands badly from a high bound and shakes it off.
Raurnar bounds along a stone road faster than a galloping horse.

name: Numsova
summary: Numsova is a gentle, pouched companion of a warrior princess who glides above the island meadows and does not age. Numsova is protective of her friend and fast to leap into danger.

feats.scene: Numsova thumps a bandit with a tail swipe and sends him tumbling.
Numsova survives a fall from a cliff top and hops away.
Numsova skims over the meadow in a gliding leap.

name: Reonal
summary: Reonal is a hooded, masked criminal who bounces in and out of alleys and leaves no name behind. Reonal fights dirty, hits hard and vanishes before the cops arrive.

feats.scene: Reonal vaults a wall and drives both boots into a guard.
Reonal is knocked off a loading dock and runs on.
Reonal sprints through an alley after a snatched purse.

name: Vostel
summary: Vostel is a pale, red-eyed sleeper who tumbles out of a burning cradle-ship and stalks a quiet farming valley by night. Vostel kills without speech and vanishes skyward before dawn.

feats.scene: Vostel flattens a timber barn and a rusting truck with a single sweep of one arm.
Vostel walks unharmed through a hail of shotgun fire and cracked fence posts.

name: Torminau
summary: Torminau is a patient elder who outlived a spouse and a farm and now steers a council of wandering champions with quiet advice. Torminau fights rarely, but when pressed the ground itself buckles.

feats.scene: Torminau drives a fist into a quarry wall and drops a whole cliff face into the pit.
Torminau stands in the centre of a collapsing bridge span and shrugs off the falling steel.

name: Lanlinllu
summary: Lanlinllu is a gentle protector who returns from the dead only to shield a frightened crowd from falling rubble. Lanlinllu's strength is vast, but a single poisoned radiance ends it.

feats.scene: Lanlinllu catches a toppling tower floor and sets it down softly between the huddled bystanders.
Lanlinllu absorbs a green beam at point-blank range before finally falling.

name: Irnoreneo
summary: Irnoreneo is a veteran envoy from a drowned star colony, famed among allied cities for hauling wrecked orbiters out of the sky. Irnoreneo carries an old grief over a lost spouse and clone-kin.

feats.scene: Irnoreneo punches a falling orbital wreck apart before it reaches the harbour district.
Irnoreneo endures a siege-engine volley that levels the avenue around the envoy.
Irnoreneo crosses the sky above the capital in the span of a heartbeat.

name: Auautiu
summary: Auautiu is a tent-show strongman who juggles anvils nightly and secretly hears every whisper in the crowd. Auautiu once taught a rival how to shut out a deafening machine by breathing slowly.

feats.scene: Auautiu snaps a ship's iron anchor chain with a casual flex during the finale.
Auautiu laughs while a drill of sound rattles the canvas and cracks every lantern.

name: Iumiri
summary: Iumiri survives only as a legend of a star-child who never reached the harbour world, intercepted in the dark by a warlord. Songs say Iumiri would have been unrivalled.

feats.scene: Iumiri, as a swaddled infant, cracks the hull of a drifting capsule with one startled kick.
Iumiri lies unharmed beneath a collapsing cabin ceiling.

name: Stcorte
summary: Stcorte is a cheerful newshawk in plated ancestral armour who carries a spectral prison lantern for emergencies. Stcorte believes the press can shield a city as well as any fist.

feats.scene: Stcorte hurls a derailed freight convoy into the empty salt flats beyond the suburb.
Stcorte stands in a blast that scorches the whole plaza and walks out smiling.

name: Sertaam
summary: Sertaam is a sulking conqueror in battered ancestral plate, bitter and certain the universe owes a throne. Sertaam punches at the walls of reality when denied.

feats.scene: Sertaam tears a hole in the sky by hammering a closed fist at the air.
Sertaam endures a mountain-sized impact and complains only about the dust.

name: Civase
summary: Civase is a golden, sun-fed wanderer from a far future age who outlived everyone dear and now drifts past the edges of time. Civase is said to have brushed the gates of afterlives.

feats.scene: Civase unleashes a flare from outstretched palms that blinds a star-cluster for a season.
Civase sits at the heart of a collapsing sun and rises unscathed.

name: Lucival
summary: Lucival is a retired star pupil who now guides schoolchildren through drills on rooftops. Lucival keeps a spotless record and a modest temper.

feats.scene: Lucival lifts a wrecked gymnasium roof overhead so a class can walk out beneath it.
Lucival takes a runaway cargo truck head-on in the schoolyard and stops it cold.

name: Oleor
summary: Oleor is a grim overlord who seized an entire world after a fatal betrayal, ruling from an orbiting fortress guarded by copies of himself. Oleor calls every arrest a mercy.

feats.scene: Oleor sears a rival's palace to slag with a lance of red light from the eyes.
Oleor ignores a barrage that would level a town and keeps reading the dispatch.

name: Llume
summary: Llume is a grieving despot who closed the gates of a great city and declared war on its criminals after an unforgivable loss. Llume sleeps little and trusts only a scheming financier.

feats.scene: Llume rips a rail gate from its hinges and flings it through a smuggler's warehouse wall.
Llume absorbs a rocket salvo in the open street without breaking stride.

name: Losael
summary: Losael leads a loose band of heroes in a war-won world, married to a last warrior of an island tribe. Losael is shaken when a rift pulls the sky open above the capital.

feats.scene: Losael hurls a crashed airship from a boulevard into the sea.
Losael is thrown through a stone fortress wall and rises without a bruise.

name: Eosiavor
summary: Eosiavor survives a scorched world after a global blaze burned away every gift. Eosiavor leads a ragged caravan of survivors, raises a child, and dies alone as the planet breaks apart.

feats.scene: Eosiavor swings a salvaged pickaxe through a mutant hound's skull.
Eosiavor survives the shockwave of a rolling blast, though badly bruised.

name: Veotern
summary: Veotern is a kind and honest guardian who patrols a glittering port city and a cold crystal hideaway. Veotern works days as a mild reporter and nights as an unyielding flier of astonishing power.

feats.scene: Veotern shoves a toppling dam face back into place with both palms.
Veotern is struck by lightning-fed cables the size of towers and stays upright.
Veotern streaks around the globe fast enough to turn the day backward.

name: Iasillrn
summary: Iasillrn is a dutiful reporter who defends a skyline with restraint, letting a robot bandit shatter its own knuckles against sturdy skin. Iasillrn talks a despairing clerk down from a ledge.

feats.scene: Iasillrn punches a steel automaton across a vault and through the far wall.
Iasillrn lets a metal fist break itself on the chest without flinching.

name: Rnilin
summary: Rnilin was a respected guardian in a doomed realm, lost before a war-god's two-year campaign devoured the world. Rnilin is remembered mostly in whispered eulogies.

feats.scene: Rnilin cracks a steel tank in half to rescue the crew inside.
Rnilin tanks a rocket volley at the edge of the harbour.

name: Ninun
summary: Ninun was a brave ally of a masked avenger who was cut down by an automated guardian after its maker lost his mind to grief. Ninun is recalled as the first to arrive and the last to fall.

feats.scene: Ninun smashes a reinforced garage door off its frame with a shoulder charge.
Ninun holds off a cannon burst long enough for bystanders to flee.

name: Siseror
summary: Siseror raced a speedy friend along city rooftops for sport and was cherished by both partners. Siseror's story is told in a single wistful anecdote.

feats.scene: Siseror vaults a freight yard in one bound and splinters the far gate on landing.
Siseror outruns a supersonic jet along the coast road.

name: Llasoror
summary: Llasoror is the weathered lawman of a prairie town and the heir of a vanished sky-folk whose reckless magic broke their home world. Llasoror guards the dust roads with a tin star and a thunderous temper.

feats.scene: Llasoror pounds the earth and a rolling thunderclap flattens a fleet of invading sky-barges.
Llasoror stands under a pyramid ship's cannon and lets it fire.

name: Onerense
summary: Onerense is a first and foremost protector who grew up on a quiet farm after a rocket brought a lost child down. Onerense works as a reporter by day and rescues entire districts by night.

feats.scene: Onerense shoves a plummeting skyscraper back upright and holds it until crews evacuate.
Onerense is hit by a stray missile barrage and carries on speaking.

name: Stiamont
summary: Stiamont is a stern uniformed brute from a dictatorship-ruled reality, drafted into a warlord's raiding party. Stiamont falls when a trap robs the power and a blade finds the heart.

feats.scene: Stiamont rams a hovering gunship and drives it into a snowy hillside.
Stiamont laughs off rifle volleys on the open slope.

name: Aucelse
summary: Aucelse is a weary patriarch of a splintered hero order, twice widowed and still firm in his sense of right. Aucelse counsels the younger generation and works the fields between crises.

feats.scene: Aucelse shatters a mountain ridge to stop an advancing army.
Aucelse takes a continental-scale blast and slowly stands again.

name: Ntolutan
summary: Ntolutan is a grizzled hero who served a government against an older vigilante, loving fatherhood more than any victory. Ntolutan speaks of sharing humanity as the finest experience.

feats.scene: Ntolutan lifts a crashed freighter and tosses it into open water.
Ntolutan takes a nuclear-tipped missile on the chest and is merely scorched.

name: Sarail
summary: Sarail is a farm lad chosen by cosmic wardens to wield an emerald ring, working alongside two other earthlings on emergency calls. Sarail never took up any other career.

feats.scene: Sarail conjures a green hammer the size of a stadium and flattens a raider fleet.
Sarail sits inside a ring-spun shield through a cruel bombardment.

name: Irlern
summary: Irlern is a wealthy orphan-raising crimefighter in a mirror city, assisting the police with a young ward by his side. Irlern mistakes a visiting stranger for a criminal and jails him.

feats.scene: Irlern tackles a burly bank thief and cracks the wooden counter with the impact.
Irlern takes a fall from a high gantry and rolls to his feet.

name: Lesiumvi
summary: Lesiumvi is a champion from a long-ago era who drank sunlight, flew above a gleaming metropolis, and joined a future youth league. Lesiumvi feared a few things: green dust, enchantment, and red light.

feats.scene: Lesiumvi blows a hurricane from the lungs and ices a rolling flood solid.
Lesiumvi rides out a bombardment that cracks the bedrock under the city.

name: Alnum
summary: Alnum is a hero who was cleaved in two by a failed mind-booster, becoming two bright minds that each wed a different woman. Alnum's halves still finish each other's schemes.

feats.scene: Alnum, in two bodies at once, lifts opposite ends of a broken viaduct.
Alnum soaks a laboratory detonation that melts the walls.

name: Leoeorer
summary: Leoeorer is a former powerhouse who lost every gift and fights as a masked glider-flier inspired by archers without any powers. Leoeorer is blackmailed into striking at friends and breaks free only with a borrowed jamming watch.

feats.scene: Leoeorer drops from a gargoyle on a glider and knocks a gunman cold with a boot.
Leoeorer shrugs off a cudgel blow from a hired thug.

name: Ialtilin
summary: Ialtilin is a smith's apprentice in a feudal age, strong beyond reason and engaged to a lady who was taken from him. Ialtilin forges a sword and storms a castle for vengeance.

feats.scene: Ialtilin hammers a red-hot blade straight and folds an iron bar like clay.
Ialtilin keeps charging through a courtyard of crossbow bolts.

name: Caore
summary: Caore is a star-born warrior raised in a fire-pit world by a tyrant father, once its greatest champion and the wrecker of a rival paradise. Caore later turns on that master and becomes a saviour.

feats.scene: Caore plants a doom-charge in a living world's core and watches it die.
Caore walks through a firestorm of dark beams, bruised but unbent.

name: Amveo
summary: Amveo is a greying elder reporter-hero who fathered a line of champions and kept honest hours at a newspaper. Amveo hands his emblem to descendants without a speech.

feats.scene: Amveo shoves a collapsed overpass off a flooded underpass with a single push.
Amveo stands beneath a falling crane and the machine bends around him.

name: Corter
summary: Corter is a famed founder of a multigenerational hero family, beginning as a teenage prodigy and ending as a widowed newspaper editor. Corter appears now and then to watch over the grandchildren.

feats.scene: Corter punches a rogue tidal wave into spray over the harbour.
Corter withstands a cannonade without scuffing the old red cloak.

name: Iucorser
summary: Iucorser is a slapstick-drenched guardian whose city is full of bumbling heroes and failed gadgets. Iucorser banters with comedians and survives a robot sabotage scheme with good humour.

feats.scene: Iucorser flicks a toy-sized robot and it bursts in a cloud of dust.
Iucorser sits through a days-long bout with a tireless mechanical brute.

name: Rnlere
summary: Rnlere is a future hero who vanished for years and returned as a hollow husk merged with a mad machine-mind. Rnlere's ruby eyes and frightening speed horrify his old allies.

feats.scene: Rnlere fires an optic beam that burns a trench across a whole district.
Rnlere takes a tank battalion's volley and advances.

name: Rnitumolu
summary: Rnitumolu is a cloned hero grown from borrowed genes in a distant century, slightly flawed, short on powers, and boastful. Rnitumolu dies quickly beneath a swarm of screaming horrors.

feats.scene: Rnitumolu drives a fist through a frozen moon-bunker door.
Rnitumolu absorbs a rail-gun blast but staggers.

name: Estis
summary: Estis is a cheerful reporter-hero who can split into a red and a blue half and soaks up sunlight stored in unknown organs. Estis fights to keep a city safe from cartoonish villains.

feats.scene: Estis spins a rampaging power station off its foundation and lifts it into orbit.
Estis tanks a grid overload that blacks out the whole region.

name: Eornitin
summary: Eornitin is a dream-bright guardian from a nightmare reality, snatched through a fissure and locked in a dungeon until a stranger frees him. Eornitin wears jeans and a red cloak and fights giant robots.

feats.scene: Eornitin hurls a giant robot through a mountain wall and out the other side.
Eornitin shrugs off a dungeon's worth of bone-breaking spells.

name: Rnmil
summary: Rnmil is a young noble in a gaslit empire, heir to a tyrant king, who grows doubtful about the cost of order. Rnmil rescues a woman from ruffians and is slapped for it.

feats.scene: Rnmil hurls a printing press out the window with a heave.
Rnmil takes a heavy blow in the face and barely blinks.

name: Neesli
summary: Neesli is a sunny newsroom hero in a cheerful romance, living with a spouse and juggling a dozen aliases. Neesli says what he can do is a job and who he is stays at home.

feats.scene: Neesli bats a runaway train car off the tracks and into an empty field.
Neesli steps through a gas explosion in a warehouse without singeing a thread.

name: Lerntel
summary: Lerntel is a reporter who looks out for an orphan boy and stands against a magic-fed brute who is his match in strength. Lerntel is hurled through several walls and gets up.

feats.scene: Lerntel punches a charging brute across a quarter of a mile of diner and street.
Lerntel is blasted through multiple brick walls and stands up from the rubble.

name: Asosaiu
summary: Asosaiu is a cold heir to a corporate family on a mirror earth who killed a brother and wandered into another reality by accident. Asosaiu assumes another man's life without shame.

feats.scene: Asosaiu rips a steel gantry from a dock and pitches it across the bay.
Asosaiu takes a gold-tinted blast without pausing.

name: Lulen
summary: Lulen is a human-seeming reporter from a possible future, friend to a rich family and uncle figure to a child. Lulen never shows any gift in this telling.

feats.scene: Lulen shoves a stuck filing cabinet across the newsroom floor.
Lulen stumbles down a flight of stairs and stands up fine.

name: Terla
summary: Terla is a barn-raised alien guardian who leaves his hideout in the care of a dog and a cat who would rather compete than watch it. Terla works mornings as a reporter.

feats.scene: Terla lifts a toppled ice spire off a sleeping fortress door.
Terla ignores the pets crashing a vault door onto his head.

name: Lulasar
summary: Lulasar is a college lad and government intern who spends weekends solving odd cases across small towns. Lulasar is strong and quick but never boastful.

feats.scene: Lulasar punches a hole through a collapsed mine shaft to reach trapped diggers.
Lulasar is run over by a cargo truck in a campus lot and dusts off.

name: Riastitiu
summary: Riastitiu is a world-conquering tyrant raised by a fear-preaching foster father, ruling an entire planet from a southern capital. Riastitiu's life story is taught like scripture to every child.

feats.scene: Riastitiu levels a rebel stronghold with a wave of the hand.
Riastitiu stands in an artillery barrage meant to topple a city.

name: Rilsaural
summary: Rilsaural is a white-haired retiree from an older timeline, once a boy hero and then a grown one, who helps a younger visitor beat a wicked scientist. Rilsaural never wore the classic colours on screen.

feats.scene: Rilsaural throws a heavy transport off a parking deck with a tired grin.
Rilsaural takes a cracked pipe to the ribs and chuckles.

name: Cesvar
summary: Cesvar is a foundling drifting in a stasis womb for a thousand years until a rich merchant raises him in a far future. Cesvar breaks traffic lanes with his enthusiasm and later helps found a youth league.

feats.scene: Cesvar lifts a stalled sky-barge over a city wall with one hand.
Cesvar is struck by a patrol cruiser's cannon and finishes his joke.

name: Vatelran
summary: Vatelran is a hero in a doorway-hopping fragment world who fights a bone-plated brute and a hook-clawed hunter-beast. Vatelran's story reaches us only as a flicker of film.

feats.scene: Vatelran puts both fists through a lumbering brute and drops it onto an empty lot.
Vatelran is hammered by a monster's bony spikes and shakes it off.

name: Torlate
summary: Torlate is a farm-raised sports prodigy, discovered unharmed after a hit-and-run, who becomes the greatest athlete alive and a part-time reporter. Torlate's guilt-ridden finder turned his life around.

feats.scene: Torlate throws a ball clean through a stadium's back wall in the opening game.
Torlate gets up laughing after being flattened by a speeding sedan.

name: Ninolne
summary: Ninolne is a toddler refugee, one of two children who escape a warring world in a damaged rocket, drifting between planets while dodging bounty gangs. Ninolne goes by a bird name and clings to a cousin.

feats.scene: Ninolne throws a tin cup that dents a bulkhead.
Ninolne rides out a hull breach inside a sealed escape pod.

name: Inuta
summary: Inuta is a reporter-hero who adopts a refugee boy and defends a tower against a brutish raider, with a team of lookalike champions at his side. Inuta is told he may do anything he wants.

feats.scene: Inuta pounds a raider into a pit the size of a city block.
Inuta is blasted through a laboratory tower and walks out of the ruins.

name: Cocoreon
summary: Cocoreon is a hero in a pocket world of clean energy where a wealthy scientist revolutionised society, hiding behind a bumbling reporter's front. Cocoreon beats a mad inventor with ease.

feats.scene: Cocoreon bats a charged battery-engine into the sky before it can burst.
Cocoreon stands unfazed in the arc of a runaway generator.

name: Amoore
summary: Amoore is a legendary hero of a television future, fated enemy of a cloning magnate and sire of a teenage clone. Amoore misses a meeting because he is off saving a distant solar system.

feats.scene: Amoore turns a comet from its path with open palms.
Amoore flies through a fusion plume and arrives with a calm apology.

name: Nesllosor
summary: Nesllosor is an agent and reporter with a quiet fortress, called a flying man by early witnesses, heir to a lost world's destiny. Nesllosor works within a close-knit family of allies.

feats.scene: Nesllosor carries a burning cargo rig out of a harbour and lowers it into deep water.
Nesllosor takes a planet-hungry monster's strike in the chest.

name: Autorcil
summary: Autorcil is a team hero who fights a villain league over rising seas and tackles an enraged rival in orbit. Autorcil helps rescue a frozen schemer from a future-sent warning.

feats.scene: Autorcil smashes a spy satellite array in low orbit with a hurled fragment.
Autorcil is struck by a thick ice shard fired from an overloaded relay.

name: Resser
summary: Resser is a hero who fails to prevent a nuclear holocaust over an island kingdom and is killed by an enraged warrior queen in a fight that levels the planet. Resser's spine ends up fashioned into a mace.

feats.scene: Resser trades blows with a furious warrior until the whole crust splits.
Resser takes a global shockwave and keeps fighting for a while.

name: Llaconum
summary: Llaconum is a hero who never returned after being slain by a bone-spiked monster in a bleak timeline, leaving a partial clone to carry his name. Llaconum is remembered in grief.

feats.scene: Llaconum smashes a freight container with one punch in his last fight.
Llaconum survives a long beating before the final blow lands.

name: Sinan
summary: Sinan is a vicious champion who leads a gang of mirror-world villains after his parents killed their way to a lifeboat. Sinan blasts a hand with red light as a toddler and grows into a boastful criminal.

feats.scene: Sinan burns a steel foundry to slag with twin beams from the eyes.
Sinan eats chunks of green rock as a child and merely burps.

name: Neoam
summary: Neoam is a married hero of an alternate dark-fated world who dies after the loss of a cousin. Neoam's last fight is remembered as a bitter tragedy.

feats.scene: Neoam flings a derailed monorail into the sea.
Neoam is hit by a rain of cosmic debris and holds the line.

name: Tersornum
summary: Tersornum is a fire-eyed priestess who leads an interstellar faith and shelters her deity from godkilling hunters. Tersornum is blessed with a sliver of divine flame and dies defending that goddess.

feats.scene: Tersornum sets a ruined temple ablaze with a whispered prayer.
Tersornum stands in a pillar of flame without a burn on her robes.

name: Ostersor
summary: Ostersor is a fifteen-foot horned beast from a pocket dimension, boasting of being the first wave of a coming swarm. Ostersor is crushed by a small band of rival heroes.

feats.scene: Ostersor rams a parked bus and folds it against a wall.
Ostersor roars through a hail of gunfire.

name: Estloas
summary: Estloas is a rain-shy teen who discovers gills and glowing markings when a downpour wakes the sea in his blood. Estloas ends up a sea-prince's apprentice and later a party disc spinner.

feats.scene: Estloas whips a rain squall into a lashing wall of water.
Estloas takes a hard hit on the jaw and keeps grinning.

name: Russto
summary: Russto is a tide-folk guardian in a parallel realm, serving as a quiet hero with no flashy deeds recorded. Russto guards a harbour with webbed hands and patient eyes.

feats.scene: Russto drives a gate wedge into a seawall to stem a flood.
Russto dives through a rock-strewn rapid without a mark.

name: Siarnuul
summary: Siarnuul is a bored schoolboy afraid of water, who learns to command rain, glows with markings, and discovers gills. Siarnuul's feared parent is a masked sea pirate.

feats.scene: Siarnuul spins a rain shower into a spear of water that cracks a fence.
Siarnuul takes a thrashing from pursuers and gets up.

name: Iatil
summary: Iatil is a blond prisoner whose gift for bending light into dizzying colour is only hinted at in a cell-block scuffle. Iatil is a petty thief with a prismatic secret.

feats.scene: Iatil flashes a prism-burst that blinds a guard squad.
Iatil takes a baton blow and shakes it off.

name: Siramiliu
summary: Siramiliu is a president-hero raised by a poor couple who defends a republic and an entire multiverse of kin. Siramiliu fights for equality, liberty and truth.

feats.scene: Siramiliu hurls a sea-fort into the surf to stop an invasion.
Siramiliu stands at ground zero of a siege weapon and remains.

name: Ralorori
summary: Ralorori is a part-human grandson who takes the family emblem in a floating future city, switching careers and aliases often. Ralorori wins by calling for help and trusting a community.

feats.scene: Ralorori teams with his father and grandfather to hurl a gang's airship into a lake.
Ralorori is struck by a purist's weapon and recovers fast.

name: Arcesta
summary: Arcesta is a green-eyed goddess of ruin, feeding on the sorrow of everyone nearby and boasting that she is cosmic wreckage made flesh. Arcesta laughs at poisons and potions.

feats.scene: Arcesta feeds on a crowd's wailing and blasts the arena to cinders.
Arcesta absorbs a battery of cannon fire and grows louder.

name: Tearra
summary: Tearra is a brutish, unloved son of a dark god, trying to earn a cold father's praise by hunting a distant hero. Tearra is hurled out of a city and later punished by a death-beam.

feats.scene: Tearra swings a spiked club that flattens a whole street.
Tearra is thrown through several blocks and walks back.

name: Amoto
summary: Amoto is a battle-hardened son of a dark god who comes to a war-ravaged world to win a conflict for his master. Amoto turns on an ally for her weakness and loses her to a portal.

feats.scene: Amoto smashes a walker machine apart with bare fists.
Amoto weathers a blast and loses only a few teeth.

name: Ulrniro
summary: Ulrniro is a pink, bald warrior from a hostile dimension who can swell to towering size or shrink to nothing. Ulrniro lost his sight in a cosmic upheaval and relies on sharpened senses.

feats.scene: Ulrniro grows tall as a tower and kicks a wall of crates into the street.
Ulrniro is crushed by a falling girder in giant form and sits up.

name: Covaser
summary: Covaser is a blond survivalist and pilot, handy in wild country and nothing more. Covaser keeps a compass and a sharp knife.

feats.scene: Covaser hacks a vine bridge free with a single knife swing.
Covaser survives a bumpy plane crash with a few bruises.

name: Erucornus
summary: Erucornus is a boy raised in a bunker full of androids, pushed through a portal into a ruined future of beast-folk, later a spymaster in the past. Erucornus survives by wit and stubbornness.

feats.scene: Erucornus drives a spear through a rat soldier's shield.
Erucornus survives a fall from a ruined tower into brush.

name: Sananuve
summary: Sananuve is a masked fanatic who can burst into pieces in an explosion and knit himself back together. Sananuve serves a band of blood-oath soldiers.

feats.scene: Sananuve detonates in the middle of a convoy and reassembles on the far curb.
Sananuve is torn apart by his own blast and rebuilds in moments.

name: Irnone
summary: Irnone is a young noble of a dying world whose crime in a drunken haze ignites a civil war over cloned minds. Irnone leaves a posthumous confession behind.

feats.scene: Irnone shatters a banquet table with a drunken swing.
Irnone stumbles down a marble stair without injury.

name: Valcortor
summary: Valcortor is a tentacled sea creature picked to represent every animal on earth in a cosmic contest. Valcortor bends shadow around herself and slips out of reach.

feats.scene: Valcortor smothers a lamp-lit chamber in sudden darkness.
Valcortor slips free of a crushing grip.

name: Rnles
summary: Rnles is a temple-trained shadow warrior who flees his homeland after his parents are hanged and serves a spymaster in a long war. Rnles can send his spirit across time by trance.

feats.scene: Rnles drops a sentry with a single palm strike.
Rnles runs for an hour through a barrage and arrives unwinded.

name: Taauam
summary: Taauam is a crystal-crusted green mass grown from diseased cells, convinced a creator abandoned it. Taauam's touch rots flesh and its borrowed strength can harm even the mighty.

feats.scene: Taauam slams a tower wall and brings down the whole floor.
Taauam wades through shells and keeps growing.

name: Liuna
summary: Liuna is a drilled foot-soldier raised to crush protests who spares a boy at the cost of his own body. Liuna's disembodied head is rescued and rigged to a machine.

feats.scene: Liuna overloads a sidearm and blows apart a charging squad.
Liuna's head survives the blast of his own weapon.

name: Torerncor
summary: Torerncor is an orange-eyed, hairless alien thief caught in a small crossover caper. Torerncor's gifts are alien but never fully described.

feats.scene: Torerncor tosses a vending machine across a mall.
Torerncor shakes off a guard's stun baton.

name: Rensesres
summary: Rensesres is a smooth go-between of a dark god and a crime syndicate, sleek in blue and always smiling. Rensesres brokers deals and avoids fights.

feats.scene: Rensesres crushes a steel briefcase in one hand to make a point.
Rensesres is thrown into a wall and straightens his cuffs.

name: Stocaia
summary: Stocaia is a silent assassin of a hellish court, shown only in a fleeting appearance. Stocaia strikes from the shadows and leaves no trace.

feats.scene: Stocaia drives a blade through a stone door from the far side.
Stocaia shrugs off a pistol round to the chest.

name: Iuaunium
summary: Iuaunium is a cousin in disguise at a rival's side who reveals herself mid-fight and lectures a bullying kinsman about honour. Iuaunium is blasted through a newspaper tower and keeps fighting.

feats.scene: Iuaunium catches a thundering fist and bends the arm of the foe.
Iuaunium is slammed into pavement and beamed with red eyes, then rises.

name: Sellliu
summary: Sellliu is a girl who lands among a group of old heroes and grows to see a warrior queen as a mother. Sellliu helps expose a mentor's murder and refuses to kill him.

feats.scene: Sellliu hurls a collapsed bridge section off a flooded street.
Sellliu stands up from a blast that wrecks a whole rooftop.

name: Nauore
summary: Nauore is a widow-hero from a war-won world who fought beside a husband in a leading team. Nauore perishes in a dimension-wide catastrophe.

feats.scene: Nauore shoves a wrecked airship away from a crowded stadium.
Nauore weathers a tearing rift for several minutes.

name: Soramori
summary: Soramori is an ancient deity of beauty in a vanished culture, remembered as a sign in the night sky. Soramori's name lingers in a custom of naming children after stars.

feats.scene: Soramori sets a constellation burning over a temple for a single night.
Soramori sits unharmed in a collapsing shrine.

name: Arlareo
summary: Arlareo is a mysterious woman who steps out of a cave wall, befriends a young man, and disintegrates a prying agent, only to be dissolved by an unseen voice. Arlareo may be a borrowed face.

feats.scene: Arlareo disintegrates a parked sedan with a gesture of the hand.
Arlareo is struck by a fist and passes through it.

name: Neoore
summary: Neoore is a brash, enthusiastic girl from a sister world, the last of her people after a catastrophe, now guarding a city alongside a foster cousin. Neoore is hailed with wonder by a young photographer.

feats.scene: Neoore lobs a loaded freight container over the skyline.
Neoore weathers a blast in a mine and complains of the dust.

name: Reoora
summary: Reoora is a blonde heroine who lands in a farm country, founds a company selling alien tech, and openly rejects any mask. Reoora trades quips with a rival who hides behind a gigantic robot.

feats.scene: Reoora tears a giant robot in half and lets the pieces drop into a river.
Reoora walks through a laser grid that melts a hangar.

name: Resticor
summary: Resticor is a hybrid girl whose floating powers appear at six, so a mother gives her a red pendant to keep her on the ground. Resticor grows into a hero in a black wig and marries a childhood partner.

feats.scene: Resticor lifts a stalled tram off a trapped crowd.
Resticor withstands a villain's lightning bolt and giggles.

name: Maial
summary: Maial is a young traveller sent to a new world to stop a hungry machine-mind, arriving late and finding her cousin already grown. Maial helps shut down a planetary core.

feats.scene: Maial rips a core relay free from a planet-spanning computer.
Maial survives an assault that cracks the continent's crust.

name: Vaeore
summary: Vaeore is a lifelong hero who grows from a city-born girl to a student advisor and eventually a state governor, never marrying. Vaeore feels the toll of the cape on her private life.

feats.scene: Vaeore flies a flooded school bus out of a river in one pull.
Vaeore shakes off a gunman's burst and finishes her speech.

name: Siinu
summary: Siinu is a sky-fallen orphan raised on a frozen collective farm who learned to fight from the cockpit of a night bomber. Siinu now carries a borrowed homeland's grief and a stubborn loyalty to one friend.

feats.scene: Siinu shoved a collapsing ridge back up into the clouds with both palms.
Siinu stood unmoved while a shelled bridge fell across her shoulders.

name: Iumtiaria
summary: Iumtiaria grew up starved of sunlight in a locked cell, thin and wary. Iumtiaria's strength returned slowly once freed, and the anger it carried became a weapon for strangers she barely trusted.

feats.scene: Iumtiaria tore a steel cell door off its hinges and flung it across the yard.
Iumtiaria shrugged off a rifle volley that had dented a truck.

name: Renunas
summary: Renunas is a loud, restless schoolgirl from another sky who hides immense strength behind sarcasm. Renunas would rather win an argument than a fight, though both tend to end with a dented wall.

feats.scene: Renunas flattened a gymnasium roof with one flailing, embarrassed punch.
Renunas sneezed through a collapsing lecture hall without a scratch.

source_title: Kara Zor-El (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Vornaneo
summary: Vornaneo lives in a hidden bubble of sealed air with a dying settlement. Vornaneo chases a lost crystal across worlds, learning to use gifts she never knew she had.

feats.scene: Vornaneo punched through the wall of a pocket dimension to retrieve the crystal.
Vornaneo walked out of a blazing refinery unburned.

name: Tenumsor
summary: Tenumsor was a hero of a doomed timeline, poisoned by a mad rival with a glowing mineral. Tenumsor's last act was a tragic rampage against the very people she once protected.

feats.scene: Tenumsor crushed a farmhouse in a delirious frenzy.
Tenumsor endured a dozen cannon shells before the poison finally stopped her.

name: Comiava
summary: Comiava left a violent age behind and joined a band of far-future heroes. Comiava later raised a child with a brilliant machine-minded partner.

feats.scene: Comiava smashed a drifting asteroid into dust above a harbor city.
Comiava took a collapsing orbital platform on her back and did not buckle.

name: Tasst
summary: Tasst inherited a mountain fortress and a famous legacy after a hero fell in battle. Tasst shares the halls with a distant young relative and guards a quiet corner of the world.

feats.scene: Tasst split a glacier in two to stop a flood from reaching the valley.
Tasst held a falling cliff over her head while villagers fled below.

name: Lusor
summary: Lusor arrived from a surviving floating city and was taken in by a rich guardian. Lusor fights alongside a reformed tycoon in a world where every role is swapped.

feats.scene: Lusor toppled a clock tower onto a gang of smugglers.
Lusor was hit by a runaway train and brushed off the dust.

name: Anunolnti
summary: Anunolnti stepped into a mantle of her own choosing while a famous friend lost his memory. Anunolnti kept an awkward secret for years and never let it slip.

feats.scene: Anunolnti shoved a runaway freighter back out to sea with one arm.
Anunolnti stood in the middle of a refinery blast and walked out smiling.

name: Veoamni
summary: Veoamni was born before her world ended and fled with both parents to a quiet farm. Veoamni lost her gifts to a golden mineral, then became a detective who solves cases with sharp wits and a borrowed mask.

feats.scene: Veoamni lifted a loaded grain silo over her head to free a trapped farmhand.
Veoamni shrugged off a burning barn collapsing across her back.

name: Reianin
summary: Reianin was shipped to a distant relative who sent her to an orphanage to learn control. Reianin grew into a long-serving traveler across centuries, and her final visit was a gentle farewell.

feats.scene: Reianin flung a runaway comet fragment away from a coastal town.
Reianin sat in a burning stadium until the flames died down around her.

name: Sieonmon
summary: Sieonmon is a dark-haired schoolgirl adopted by a married couple of reporters. Sieonmon struggles to fix a toy robot while an overzealous inspector watches her every move.

feats.scene: Sieonmon bent a girder into a perfect ring to impress her new mother.
Sieonmon fell from a skyscraper window and walked home unhurt.

name: Lillullo
summary: Lillullo has worn many names, studied in many schools and survived every plot twist the years could throw. Lillullo has divorced once, been split in two once, and still finds time to take photographs.

feats.scene: Lillullo hurled a crumbling mountaintop into the open ocean to save a coastal town.
Lillullo tanked a collapsing dam without losing her footing.

name: Lataura
summary: Lataura lived through a grim future and took up a new alias on a barren moon. Lataura is short on patience but long on grudges, and sunlight is her only real fuel.

feats.scene: Lataura cracked a crater wall in a single furious punch.
Lataura stood through a collapsing lunar dome unscathed.

name: Siust
summary: Siust runs a company by day and fights by night, until a rogue machine mind takes over her body. Siust spies on mercenaries before her own limbs betray her.

feats.scene: Siust punched a freight crane clean through a warehouse roof.
Siust weathered a barrage of tank shells without staggering.

name: Vasastu
summary: Vasastu is a gentle survivor who spent decades asleep in a tiny ship before waking. Vasastu gave her life in a battle against a being that devoured worlds, and the sacrifice shook a whole multiverse.

feats.scene: Vasastu drove a cosmic devourer back across a field of shattered continents.
Vasastu withstood the unraveling of a nearby star before finally falling.

source_title: Kara Zor-El (Infinite Crisis Video Game: Earth-0)

name: Invarlla
summary: Invarlla was taken captive and made to serve a villain council through parasitic mind-worms. Invarlla broke free and burned through a plant-tyrant's thicket with a single glare.

feats.scene: Invarlla melted a vine wall with a stare that left the stones glowing.
Invarlla stood in a storm of thorns without a mark on her skin.

name: Numrecis
summary: Numrecis is a sweet, sheltered child who loves berries and hates arguments. Numrecis can unleash a sonic wail so powerful that even her older teammates keep their distance.

feats.scene: Numrecis wailed and shattered every window in a tall tower.
Numrecis sat calmly through a toppled bookshelf of boulders.

name: Savauium
summary: Savauium was stolen as a child and bent into a weapon by a collector of whole worlds. Savauium has since turned that terrible training toward protecting one city, and she wears her guilt as a second skin.

feats.scene: Savauium cracked a planet's crust along its equator in one dive.
Savauium endured a fleet's combined broadside and kept advancing.

name: Nireria
summary: Nireria is a dutiful hero with a long list of aliases and a longer list of teams. Nireria has trained among warriors, joined science guilds and quietly grown into a happy, imperfect protector.

feats.scene: Nireria split a floating rock-island in half to save a convoy beneath it.
Nireria bore the full blast of an orbital cannon and stayed upright.

name: Reostu
summary: Reostu was raised as a tycoon's foster daughter and became an unflinching government agent. Reostu is sent to arrest a reporter and is won over by an unexpected stranger.

feats.scene: Reostu kicked a locked door off its frame during a raid.
Reostu took two pistol rounds before collapsing.

name: Sonseriu
summary: Sonseriu was one of many guests at a grand anniversary celebration. Sonseriu mostly stood in the crowd, waved at passers-by and left the heavy lifting to others.

feats.scene: Sonseriu cleared a rubble field by blowing across it.
Sonseriu leaned on a collapsing balcony and held it up until the party ended.

name: Iurilval
summary: Iurilval is a frightened teenager whose pod was trapped in a drifting chunk of her ruined home for years. Iurilval crashes into a harbor and burns a computer to slag before learning to channel her strength.

feats.scene: Iurilval ripped up a street in a terrified stampede toward the harbor.
Iurilval emerged from a crashed meteor unharmed.

name: Tiuvor
summary: Tiuvor is a bubbly schoolkid who runs with a gang of pint-sized heroes and keeps two goofy pets. Tiuvor can spin around the planet fast enough to undo a small mistake.

feats.scene: Tiuvor flew in a circle so fast that a toppled cupboard stood back up.
Tiuvor shrugged off a stack of collapsing desks with a giggle.

name: Sacisor
summary: Sacisor is a hot-headed older teen who remembers being helpless while a stranger shrank a whole city. Sacisor now refuses to stand by while anyone is hurt.

feats.scene: Sacisor hurled a stolen starship hull back out through the sky.
Sacisor was struck by a capital ship's beam and kept walking.

name: Tentele
summary: Tentele was grown in a bunker laboratory from a stolen strand of hair. Tentele defended a besieged city every night, then turned on her maker when she learned she was only a puppet.

feats.scene: Tentele flattened a tank column across a frozen river in one sortie.
Tentele took a night's worth of artillery and left at dawn without a limp.

name: Rnniures
summary: Rnniures began as six tiny duplicates grown by a shadowy board, which merged into one full-sized woman. Rnniures believes she is somebody else and travels to a distant city to start a plain life.

feats.scene: Rnniures hurled a boulder the size of a bus over a river.
Rnniures was thrown into a furnace core and climbed out cooling.

name: Cocor
summary: Cocor arrives on a remade world and finds a mirror-self already living there. Cocor hunts an imagined impostor and fights with a ferocity that scatters her allies.

feats.scene: Cocor hurled a mountain slope across a valley at her double.
Cocor stood through a collapsing cavern roof with her arms folded.

name: Vacinrnu
summary: Vacinrnu landed years after her older relative became a celebrated champion. Vacinrnu helped found a team of young heroes and became its quiet backbone.

feats.scene: Vacinrnu launched a satellite dish into orbit with a single toss.
Vacinrnu blocked a crashing airship with her shoulder.

name: Telula
summary: Telula is a blocky plastic heroine who tumbles through bright toy cities. Telula is cheerful, acrobatic and always ready to break apart and be rebuilt.

feats.scene: Telula smashed a plastic skyscraper flat with one cartoonish stomp.
Telula was blown into a hundred studs and snapped back together.

name: Esauna
summary: Esauna is a three-story god of molten rock that wakes whenever a sacrifice stops. Esauna can raise lesser servants from cooling slag, and it reforms from ash every time it is broken.

feats.scene: Esauna split a coastal cliff open with a gout of magma.
Esauna re-formed from a puddle after its head was crushed flat.

name: Aunau
summary: Aunau is an enormous tentacled guardian that sleeps beneath a hidden sea. Aunau can drive off an entire fleet and swims faster than anything its size should.

feats.scene: Aunau capsized a flotilla with a single sweep of its limbs.
Aunau took a volley of torpedoes without flinching.
Aunau surged through the deep trench faster than a speedboat.

name: Lueonta
summary: Lueonta is a floating, pulsing organ that hovers over parks and sucks up children through hollow tubes. Lueonta falls apart under pressure and slowly knits itself back together.

feats.scene: Lueonta pulled a playground's swing set out of the ground in a vacuum gust.
Lueonta was blasted to chunks and reassembled by nightfall.

name: Sacarn
summary: Sacarn is a nervous inventor whose homemade suit shrinks her instead of enlarging her. Sacarn learns to trust the little wings on her back, and her tiny buzz turns out to be her trademark.

feats.scene: Sacarn swung a wrench with a metallic ping against a rampaging vine.
Sacarn bounced off a locker door and kept flying.

source_title: Karen Beecher (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Numceo
summary: Numceo is a brilliant scientist with a famously cold bedside manner. Numceo joins a covert program and discovers too late that the killers are closer than she thought.

feats.scene: Numceo slammed a ledger onto a table to end a heated debate.
Numceo hid beneath a billiard table while the intruders swept through.

name: Rnunni
summary: Rnunni is a woman of old southern gentry, pushed to the edges of her family because of an unplanned child. Rnunni finds her old cruelty visited on her own doorstep when that child returns.

feats.scene: Rnunni slapped a visitor's hand away from the kitchen door.
Rnunni endured a long night of grief without breaking.

name: Tanll
summary: Tanll is a small child who loves bedtime tales about a glowing hero. Tanll and her brother wait patiently at home while their father works late.

feats.scene: Tanll threw a pillow across the nursery at her brother.
Tanll tumbled off the couch and bounced back up laughing.

name: Rialelu
summary: Rialelu was a psychic agent who went rogue after learning her boss served a villain. Rialelu is killed in a chase, yet her spirit keeps whispering warnings to the living.

feats.scene: Rialelu shoved a cabinet across a floor with a focused thought.
Rialelu lingered as a pale shape after a fatal blow.

name: Niarorun
summary: Niarorun is a late-night talk host who has chatted with every important guest in his world for twenty years. Niarorun is witty, patient and, to some, an odd double of a famous comedian.

feats.scene: Niarorun tossed a cue card across the studio to a stagehand.
Niarorun sat through a heckler's tirade without losing his grin.

name: Conava
summary: Conava is a mugshot of a new villain hanging in a gallery, and little else is known. Conava is a masked figure whose reputation is bigger than his record.

feats.scene: Conava smashed a display case with a single hammer swing.
Conava was shoved into a wall and shook it off.

name: Teriumtan
summary: Teriumtan is a scientist who dusts whole cities with poison and demands ransom for the cure. Teriumtan is scarred by his own fire, relies on hulking servants and holds a deep grudge against one masked vigilante.

feats.scene: Teriumtan dumped a tank of toxin from a helicopter across a harbor district.
Teriumtan survived a laboratory fire that cost him half his face.

name: Iaorinas
summary: Iaorinas is a retired roboticist who once taught a young billionaire and built a rogue mind. Iaorinas now keeps a quiet farm far from the city and does not talk about the machine.

feats.scene: Iaorinas hammered a stuck panel loose on an old tractor.
Iaorinas ignored the fall of his own career without a word.

name: Telauniu
summary: Telauniu is an enemy spy who poses as a foreign noble to romance a rancher's daughter. Telauniu plans to blow up oil derricks and is undone by sheer chance.

feats.scene: Telauniu planted charges that levelled a row of oil derricks.
Telauniu was tackled by a cheerful rancher and held down.

name: Cortaval
summary: Cortaval is a collaborator who styled himself the protector of a conquered country. Cortaval appears once in a wartime tale and does not survive it.

feats.scene: Cortaval swung a sabre across a table and cracked it in half.
Cortaval was shot once and fell.

name: Inerune
summary: Inerune is a villain whose hair is a living torch that no tide can put out. Inerune leads a trio of thieves and wears diving gear to chase prey beneath the waves.

feats.scene: Inerune whipped her burning hair across a dock and set the pier alight.
Inerune walked through a blazing warehouse without a blister.

name: Celllo
summary: Celllo is a gorilla who gained a scientist's mind and bent him to his will. Celllo absorbed a vigilante's skills, strapped on a bomb and was sent back to the jungle when the gift wore off.

feats.scene: Celllo triggered a bomb strapped to his chest in a failed attempt to flatten a city district.
Celllo took a hard fall from a rooftop and shook it off.

name: Sialevos
summary: Sialevos is an undercover agent sent to spy on a hidden ape city. Sialevos is captured and tortured, yet keeps his thoughts walled off until a rescue team arrives.

feats.scene: Sialevos swung a chair at a guard in a last-ditch escape attempt.
Sialevos endured days of mental pressure without giving a word.

name: Rnutila
summary: Rnutila is a pale sorcerer-scientist who bought immortality with the lives of an entire civilization. Rnutila hides in a mountaintop keep and uses a stolen watching device to enthrall powerful pawns.

feats.scene: Rnutila disrupted the magnetic fields of two worlds with a single spell.
Rnutila weathered a battering from his own conjured storm.

name: Aniulu
summary: Aniulu is a blue-skinned, white-eyed deity of a broken dimension who preaches that love must be burned out of the world. Aniulu soars on wings, sees the future and carries a pair of blades.

feats.scene: Aniulu cut a glowing rift into the sky with a pair of crossed blades.
Aniulu took a hammering from a rival deity and laughed.

name: Ausase
summary: Ausase is a blind, ancient survivor of a war that wrecked her world, who outlived even her own powers. Ausase waited alone in a poisoned waste for centuries, then warned a visitor from the past.

feats.scene: Ausase hurled a derelict transport across a canyon in her former glory.
Ausase starved and slept nothing for three centuries and did not die.

name: Liton
summary: Liton was a winged commander of war whose zeal outgrew his judgement. Liton raised half an army against the underworld and wielded flaming blades to cut down its defenders.

feats.scene: Liton set a thousand demons ablaze with one sweep of a flaming sword.
Liton took the combined charge of a hellish army and stayed standing.

name: Saulanlle
summary: Saulanlle was raised by three beasts after her family died, and later joined a fear-fuelled army of rings. Saulanlle shapes glowing copies of her old pack and uses them to hunt.

feats.scene: Saulanlle sent three glowing beasts through a reinforced gate.
Saulanlle took a vehicle's impact against her ring shield.

name: Luserte
summary: Luserte is a criminal profiler whose father is a murderous immortal. Luserte hunts a copycat killer and has to ask her father for help.

feats.scene: Luserte tackled an escaped inmate in a prison corridor.
Luserte took a hard blow without losing her composure.

name: Rosser
summary: Rosser is a winged lawman from a distant world, loyal to a team and later bent to a conqueror's will. Rosser hits hard with a spiked mace and lives longer than most.

feats.scene: Rosser smashed an armored truck with a single mace swing.
Rosser took a rocket in the chest and flew on.

name: Seolu
summary: Seolu is an android with a pair of wings, one of many on a world run by a hidden hand. Seolu belongs to a junior team and takes orders without question.

feats.scene: Seolu dented a steel barrier with a shoulder charge.
Seolu took a collision with a lamp post and flew on.

name: Lloreir
summary: Lloreir is a winged lawman turned museum curator, hiding in plain sight beside his wife. Lloreir collects ancient weapons and flies on artificial wings and a gravity belt.

feats.scene: Lloreir shattered a stone statue with an old war axe.
Lloreir took a fall from a rooftop and kept pace with the thief.

name: Ortil
summary: Ortil is a gladiator-noble whose hard luck bonded him to a living metal. Ortil is bloodied and moody, and he finds comfort only in the sting of his own wounds.

feats.scene: Ortil cleaved a siege door in half with a heavy mace.
Ortil survived a stab from an old rival and fought on.

name: Ortum
summary: Ortum is a winged, hairless protector who lives in a hidden valley with his mate. Ortum spares a boy's life and pays for it with his own.

feats.scene: Ortum tore a thorn bush out of the ground to shield the boy.
Ortum shielded a child from a falling beam with his own back.

name: Ismiiu
summary: Ismiiu is a winged lawman who drops into a cartoon mystery with a spiked club. Ismiiu has used many aliases across the ages and can out-fly a ghost train.

feats.scene: Ismiiu flattened a haunted statue with a swing of his club.
Ismiiu took a hurled boulder on the chin and grinned.

name: Rnustono
summary: Rnustono is a scholar and museum co-founder who saves a friend and loses his life to a rampaging machine. Rnustono's death pushes his wife away from the planet she had come to love.

feats.scene: Rnustono shoved a friend out of the path of a toppling statue.
Rnustono took the first blow from a rampaging machine and fell.

name: Valtete
summary: Valtete is a grown-in-a-lab predator that hides in the drains of a city and sedates its prey with its eyes. Valtete rakes with talons and is hungry, ill and angry.

feats.scene: Valtete raked a metal grate off a storm drain with its claws.
Valtete was beaten with a pipe and kept lunging.

name: Illtumsi
summary: Illtumsi is a ranch-raised sheriff in a frontier town, winning the post in an open contest. Illtumsi can shoot from a leaping horse and builds clever traps for her quarry.

feats.scene: Illtumsi shot a bottle off a post while leaping between two horses.
Illtumsi took a fall from a galloping horse and was back in the saddle.

name: Ilnin
summary: Ilnin is a wealthy woman engaged to be married who tries to reach a cousin before a party. Ilnin gets no reply and quietly keeps her own counsel.

feats.scene: Ilnin pushed open a heavy office door and walked in.
Ilnin waited patiently through a long silence.

name: Orcitan
summary: Orcitan is a masked vigilante with sharp acrobatic skills who works with a police agency to stop a terror group. Orcitan fights in a dark suit and strikes from the shadows.

feats.scene: Orcitan drove a rooftop kick through a rotting skylight.
Orcitan took a bruising fall and rolled back to her feet.

name: Iscortor
summary: Iscortor is a former ballplayer who dons a black uniform and swings a bat at wartime crooks. Iscortor loses a son, finds a new love and leads a band of fierce women.

feats.scene: Iscortor swung a bat through a locked warehouse door.
Iscortor took a hard hit in the ribs and kept swinging.

name: Rnuveo
summary: Rnuveo is a vigilante who joins a breakaway faction in a divided team. Rnuveo carries a gadget belt and fights with discipline.

feats.scene: Rnuveo drove her boot through a guard's riot shield.
Rnuveo took a hard fall off a ledge and kept running.

name: Ceamor
summary: Ceamor is a wealthy socialite who joins a hunt for two runaway children and briefly takes up a mask. Ceamor's husband and son are the only people who know her secret.

feats.scene: Ceamor tackled a fleeing pickpocket in the street.
Ceamor searched through a rainy night without rest.

name: Rnuernren
summary: Rnuernren is a heiress and circus performer who dons a costume to impress a famous hero. Rnuernren outwits a few crooks and has to be shown that disguises are easy to see through.

feats.scene: Rnuernren swung down from a trapeze and bowled over a mobster.
Rnuernren bounced off a net and stood up grinning.

name: Coarnor
summary: Coarnor is a guest at a quiet birthday gathering in a grand house. Coarnor says little, laughs a lot and carries no weapons.

feats.scene: Coarnor lifted a heavy cake stand and set it on the table.
Coarnor stood through a long toast without sitting.

name: Vaeoltor
summary: Vaeoltor is a mind-controlled slave who is freed and joins a secret order to oppose a broken tyrant. Vaeoltor dies in a desperate siege, and her costume is kept as a memorial.

feats.scene: Vaeoltor smashed through a barricade in the final siege.
Vaeoltor took a volley of bolts before finally falling.

name: Riavorser
summary: Riavorser is a masked vigilante in a cartoon crossover who freezes a clay monster with a stolen cold gun. Riavorser helps round up a convention of rogues.

feats.scene: Riavorser froze a mud monster solid with a borrowed cold gun.
Riavorser bounced off a cartoon crate and carried on.

name: Rerorser
summary: Rerorser is a former soldier and part-time vigilante who watches over a mansion at the holidays. Rerorser gives dating advice and lets the kids make a mess of the kitchen.

feats.scene: Rerorser carried a stack of chairs up the stairs without stopping.
Rerorser stood patiently through a chaotic family dinner.

name: Soeon
summary: Soeon is a student who is really a piece of a vengeful actor, sent to a school to ruin a rival. Soeon can change her shape like wet clay, but she fears water.

feats.scene: Soeon pulled a stage curtain rail down with a clay arm.
Soeon was crushed under a prop and reformed.

name: Ralsti
summary: Ralsti is a famous actress who left her first husband for a leading man and then left him too. Ralsti survives only as a faded poster above a student's bed.

feats.scene: Ralsti slammed a dressing room door in anger.
Ralsti took a long night of bad reviews and went back on stage.

name: Naulanta
summary: Naulanta is an orphan driven by the need to hunt down her father's killers. Naulanta became a bounty hunter with a deadly aim and a talent for throwing stars and knives.

feats.scene: Naulanta drove a throwing star through a plank at twenty paces.
Naulanta rode on through a night with a bullet in her shoulder.

name: Iureron
summary: Iureron is the only survivor of a police family blown up at a public ceremony. Iureron returns scarred and vengeful, with a gun and a talent for brawling.

feats.scene: Iureron fired a pistol through a window pane at a rooftop target.
Iureron crawled from the rubble of a collapsed stand.

name: Leonama
summary: Leonama is a veteran spy who founded a secret task force against a rival agency. Leonama served in a wartime service and still plans operations from a prison fortress.

feats.scene: Leonama blew a door off a hinge with a small charge.
Leonama endured a long interrogation without cracking.

name: Nolcin
summary: Nolcin is a conservationist who is changed by a sorcerer into a cat-like predator. Nolcin prefers her new form, with its sharper eyes that see across worlds.

feats.scene: Nolcin raked a tree trunk to splinters with her claws.
Nolcin took a heavy blow and landed on her feet.

name: Ntuani
summary: Ntuani is a child of a cursed man and a mortal woman, conceived as part of a demon's scheme. Ntuani is stolen from her mother's arms hours after her birth.

feats.scene: Ntuani shattered a church window with a cry of unholy power.
Ntuani lay in a burning altar unharmed.

name: Temaliu
summary: Temaliu is a woman in a small village who raised five children and outlived most of them. Temaliu makes her living quietly and keeps a close-lipped dignity.

feats.scene: Temaliu slapped a drunk's hand off her sleeve.
Temaliu endured hard winters and harder losses.

name: Tacaor
summary: Tacaor is a farm girl who is secretly an exile from a lost world, and who can lift a boy by the throat using only her mind. Tacaor regrets what a villain made her do and turns on him.

feats.scene: Tacaor lifted a boy off the ground by a mental squeeze.
Tacaor took a hard shove from a bigger foe and stood her ground.

name: Iuamiu
summary: Iuamiu is a mother who killed to protect her son and returned from the dead to bring him home. Iuamiu vanishes and reappears at will and shrugs off blows that would stop a man.

feats.scene: Iuamiu flung a hockey-masked intruder across a hallway with a mental shove.
Iuamiu took a hail of bullets with a bored look.

name: Sarvani
summary: Sarvani is a witch who pushed her mind into a stone beast to outrun an illness. Sarvani was later empowered by a dark patron and fights in a squad of expendable villains.

feats.scene: Sarvani tore a parked car in half with her talons.
Sarvani took a rocket on her stone hide and kept diving.

name: Ntsanso
summary: Ntsanso is a cartoon space-cop who dodges capture when her colleagues are rounded up. Ntsanso aids a hapless duck and uses her ring to free the whole corps.

feats.scene: Ntsanso blasted open a prison hull with a ring-born beam.
Ntsanso raised a green shield against a barrage of cartoon lasers.

name: Rumlinvi
summary: Rumlinvi is a ring-bearer promoted by a rebellious millionaire who defies a tyrant. Rumlinvi is later hunted by her own order and leaves the matter to her superiors.

feats.scene: Rumlinvi crushed a rogue patrol cruiser with a glowing fist.
Rumlinvi stood through a barrage of ring blasts behind her shield.

name: Ntsiucis
summary: Ntsiucis is one of thousands of ring-bearing wardens who patrol the stars from a central world. Ntsiucis flies by ring and builds glowing shapes at will.

feats.scene: Ntsiucis built a giant glowing fist and flattened a mining platform.
Ntsiucis took a ship's salvo behind a shimmering barrier.

name: Amlean
summary: Amlean is a veteran ring-bearer who trained a stubborn recruit and taught him restraint. Amlean fell in battle and returned as a restless shade, then loved the recruit.

feats.scene: Amlean broke a rogue moon-sized fortress door with a glowing hammer.
Amlean endured a flare from a dying sun inside her shield.

name: Istiuso
summary: Istiuso is a ring-bearing warden in a grim, altered world, fighting beside her unlikely allies. Istiuso builds shields and bolts of pure will.

feats.scene: Istiuso smashed a cruiser's engine block with a ring-forged hammer.
Istiuso weathered a hail of cannon fire behind her ring shield.

name: Rnutanco
summary: Rnutanco is a silver ruler whose race grew from iron and ruled the world until a meteor ended them. Rnutanco slept in a tube for eons, then woke to steal and conquer with a mind ray.

feats.scene: Rnutanco lifted a safe from a vault and carried it away.
Rnutanco was struck by a speeding fist and stayed slippery and unhurt.

name: Ntillo
summary: Ntillo is a cheerful green warrior trained by a veteran commander. Ntillo hunts her missing teacher and wins a fight in a deadly trap-house.

feats.scene: Ntillo cracked a staff across a rival's guard in a deadly bout.
Ntillo took a hard blow and fought on for the rest of the round.

name: Eoloriseo
summary: Eoloriseo is a stretchy hero in a dream-city group that stops weird threats. Eoloriseo can twist and grow to any shape and reaches anything out of reach.

feats.scene: Eoloriseo wrapped a runaway cart in a stretched arm and stopped it.
Eoloriseo bounced from a rooftop and snapped back to shape.

name: Amicilnum
summary: Amicilnum is a hired alien fighter who snatches champions through time for a warlord. Amicilnum later turned to love and raised a very large family with a thief.

feats.scene: Amicilnum skewered a warrior with a tentacle and carried him off.
Amicilnum was thrown into a gap between moments and walked out of it.

name: Miserar
summary: Miserar is a ferry-dock bookkeeper who raised her daughter alone and kept ledgers for smugglers without ever carrying a weapon. Her whole story turns on one tense night when she tried to bargain for her child's safety with only a calm voice.

feats.scene: Miserar shoves a loaded crate down a ramp to block a doorway.
Miserar takes a hard fist to the ribs and keeps talking.

name: Riniuter
summary: Riniuter is a dock-clan enforcer who repays family debts of honor with risky cargo runs and a quick temper. He guards a failing fleet of old boats and trusts nobody who carries a briefcase.

feats.scene: Riniuter cracks a baton across a smuggler's forearm hard enough to snap the bone.
Riniuter shrugs off a thrown deck chair and keeps walking.

name: Riraan
summary: Riraan is a crimson-skinned, horned courier-warden who weaves hard light from a hip-mounted charge-core. Stubborn willpower, not skill, keeps his constructs standing as he patrols a quiet frontier of drifting stations.

feats.scene: Riraan hammers a drifting ore barge into dust with a condensed light mallet.
Riraan's own glowing shield holds while a hangar roof collapses onto him.

name: Vairnva
summary: Vairnva is a gruff drill instructor who flunks more recruits than he passes, and the few graduates never forget him. Cut down once by a cosmic devourer, he later rose again as a hollow, grey-lit revenant.

feats.scene: Vairnva slams a wall of hard light through a fortress gate and the whole gatehouse folds.
Vairnva stands in the blast of a siege cannon before the beam finally unmakes him.

name: Elrarni
summary: Elrarni is a glowing larva coughed up by a retired pilot and left in a forest with a blanket and scraps. It grows into a drifting being of pale blue static that lends its adoptive parent strength in fights.

feats.scene: Elrarni bursts through a hospital ward ceiling in a flare of blue static and demolishes the room.
Elrarni lets a cargo truck pass straight through its body without a flicker.

name: Reosertil
summary: Reosertil is a being from a flickering sideways dimension who shares a body with a crash-landed airman and can be summoned out of his chest at will. It rides the radio spectrum, shifting up and down to scald or soften whatever it touches.

feats.scene: Reosertil sweeps a wall of shifting radiation across a quarry and fuses the entire pit to glass.
Reosertil lets a collapsing refinery pass through it harmlessly.

name: Seoirle
summary: Seoirle is an infiltrator brainwashed into servitude and sent to steal a sacred belt from an island of warriors. Her loyalty was only borrowed, and a long rehabilitation slowly gave her own back.

feats.scene: Seoirle snatches the belt from a sleeping guard and sprints for the dock.
Seoirle crashes into a stone doorframe in her escape and gets up at once.

name: Sesrnire
summary: Sesrnire is a railway magnate who turned engineering skill into extortion, building a humming box that smothers electronics across wide districts. He threatened firms with permanent blackout until a stronger hand ended his scheme.

feats.scene: Sesrnire swings a wrench at a guard and barely dents his sleeve.
Sesrnire tumbles down his lab stairs and walks away bruised.

name: Nosirn
summary: Nosirn is a pet rodent soaked in strange orange crystal dust who bends water into streams and spheres. Timid and fire-shy, he proves surprisingly brave whenever his owner is in trouble.

feats.scene: Nosirn flings a pressurized water jet that shatters a car window.
Nosirn tumbles off a high shelf and bounces to his feet.

name: Ontos
summary: Ontos is the restless spirit of a seventeenth-century nobleman who haunts his own portrait by day and walks the castle halls by night. Decades later he borrows a living man's body to hunt invaders with a ghostly flourish.

feats.scene: Ontos hurls a suit of armor across a courtyard and scatters three saboteurs.
Ontos lets a volley of rifle rounds pass through his misty frame.

name: Lliveo
summary: Lliveo is a schoolchild in a northern town who begs for bedtime tales about a distant hero. He is cheerful and observant, and helps hold his family together while his father is away.

feats.scene: Lliveo hurls a hard-packed snowball at a fence post and splits it.
Lliveo slides down an icy hill and crashes into a snowbank unharmed.

name: Valoll
summary: Valoll is a gunman trained from the cradle by a cruel patriarch to kill for hire. Reckless and undisciplined, he never learned that skill matters less than caution.

feats.scene: Valoll fires a rifle through a plank door and drops the man hiding behind it.
Valoll gets thrown through a table in a brawl and rolls up swinging.

name: Llolerane
summary: Llolerane is a decorated armored champion celebrated by a harsh regime in an alternate timeline, living in a shared mansion with his kin. His fame rests on propaganda more than principle.

feats.scene: Llolerane drives an armored fist through the hood of a parked car.
Llolerane walks out of a wrecked sedan after a highway pileup without a scratch on his plating.

name: Caiava
summary: Caiava is the last of a hidden people who hate towers of glass and steel and tear them down with a stone hammer. Ageless and able to step across short distances, he is a one-man demolition crew.

feats.scene: Caiava smashes his stone hammer into a high-rise foundation and the tower topples.
Caiava takes a falling crane on his shoulder and laughs.

name: Raianau
summary: Raianau is a junkyard inventor barely past childhood who rewired a dead stranger's wrist-device into a light-casting toy. Her brazen, clever builds draw scoldings from veterans who insist she is not qualified.

feats.scene: Raianau fires a beam of light through a scrapyard crusher and cuts it in half.
Raianau shields herself with a glowing dome as a truck lands on it.

name: Niaco
summary: Niaco is a lone scientist cast out across parallel worlds after a lab experiment woke a devouring force. He wanders from reality to reality, doomed to witness collapse and to warn people who will not listen.

feats.scene: Niaco's reckless experiment detonates his entire laboratory dome and cracks the planet's crust beneath it.
Niaco survives the blast of his collapsing home world while drifting out of it.

name: Anulle
summary: Anulle is a pink-skinned overseer who sits on a council of immortal administrators and projects sheets of energy at anyone who challenges its rulings.

feats.scene: Anulle sends a sheet of raw energy over a rebel district and levels the whole quarter.
Anulle stands unmoved as a siege engine detonates against his chair.

name: Varsan
summary: Varsan is a teenage rider with a haunted buckler that guards her against every kind of sorcery. A twin and a student, she carries the quarrelsome spirit of a long-dead champion in her shield.

feats.scene: Varsan bashes a charging raider off his horse with her buckler.
Varsan crouches behind her buckler while a sorcerous blast flattens the field around her.

name: Serarto
summary: Serarto is a trauma counselor and former soldier who patrols her city at night with a plain shield and a hacker's patience. She carries the faint echo of a mind-link and cares most for people who feel abandoned.

feats.scene: Serarto drives her shield into a mugger's chest and lifts him off his feet.
Serarto takes a metal pipe across the shoulder and stays on her feet.

name: Rusvortis
summary: Rusvortis is a sexless household automaton serving a scientist couple on a doomed homeworld. It hovers behind them projecting calming ghost-light displays.

feats.scene: Rusvortis rams a locked laboratory door off its hinges.
Rusvortis is struck by a falling shelving unit and only dents its casing.

name: Ricin
summary: Ricin is a xenophobic inventor who built a sealed-world device meant to silence one preacher and to trap an entire culture. His remote hologram outlived him and rebuilt a banished zealot into a cosmic menace.

feats.scene: Ricin's quarantine engine floods a council hall with a crushing pulse that shatters its pillars.
