summary: Veotin is a biochemist who drank an old formula and became a murderous stone-skinned monster. Veotin framed his partner, and pretended to be a hero.

feats.scene: Veotin rips a car door off its frame in monster form.
Veotin takes a car at speed and is unhurt.

name: Valorli
summary: Valorli is a former federal agent who found freedom as a flamboyant performer in a living street. Valorli helps defend friends against old employers and encourages everyone to be themselves.

feats.scene: Valorli swings a heavy handbag at an intruder.
Valorli stays upright after a rough shove.

name: Valarnas
summary: Valarnas is an orange-skinned corps member who carries a ring and a charging battery and has an unbreakable will. Valarnas shapes constructs, shields and bolts and flies through space.

feats.scene: Valarnas shapes a giant green wall that crushes a hangar.
Valarnas holds a ring shield against a barrage.

name: Riaorame
summary: Riaorame is a blue-skinned ring-bearer who guards the crypts of fallen comrades on a distant station. Riaorame survived a brutal desert world and fights with constructs, shields and flight.

feats.scene: Riaorame hurls a bolt that smashes a concrete bunker.
Riaorame holds a barrier while fragments rain down.

name: Iustneo
summary: Iustneo is a desert-bred ring-bearer who tends the vigil over the fallen and rides with dragon-like beasts he befriended. Iustneo shapes light constructs and keeps their memory burning bright.

feats.scene: Iustneo forms a luminous claw that rips a bunker from the sand.
Iustneo holds a shield through a sandstorm of shrapnel.

name: Asttiate
summary: Asttiate is a tall, blue-skinned, red-haired woman of a hellish world who serves a tyrant. Her touch can send someone to sleep with one hand and kill with the other.

feats.scene: Asttiate lays a hand on a guard, who drops dead.
Asttiate is hurled through a wall and rises.

name: Silntoir
summary: Silntoir is a thief who wore a suit giving command over water, density and thought-moving force. Silntoir tried to dominate a coastal criminal underworld before two sea heroes stopped him.

feats.scene: Silntoir hurls a dense jet of water that cracks a truck windscreen.
Silntoir is dragged underwater and keeps struggling.

name: Cinostau
summary: Cinostau is a hired killer who coats himself in dense water for strength and armour. Cinostau stalked a queen to a seaside port, was beaten, and was held because ordinary jails could not contain him.

feats.scene: Cinostau fires a bullet-dense jet that punches through a dock.
Cinostau lets a thrown crate burst against his watery shell.

name: Stale
summary: Stale is a one-eyed mercenary trained at a school for hired soldiers, who teamed with a young fighter after she accidentally shot out his eye. Stale later joined a second band of space travellers.

feats.scene: Stale fires a laser at a headmaster's desk.
Stale shakes off the loss of an eye and keeps working.

name: Veotel
summary: Veotel is a wartime gangster who stole silk and sold it back at inflated prices. Veotel threw flammable cards and tried to flee by autogiro, but was cornered and crashed in a river.

feats.scene: Veotel tosses a card that bursts into flames on a crate.
Veotel crashes into the water and dies.

name: Vorlla
summary: Vorlla is a white-haired trafficker who manufactured tragedies to break young people, then moulded them into soldiers. Vorlla preaches that pain must be endured, and works from the shadows.

feats.scene: Vorlla strikes a recruit with a cane.
Vorlla walks away from a slip on wet cobblestones.

name: Tautiaran
summary: Tautiaran is a kindly widow who lives in a hidden town and delivers a summons from a riddling villain to her son. Tautiaran is an ordinary person with a firm voice.

feats.scene: Tautiaran slaps a stray dog off the porch.
Tautiaran stumbles on a step and is fine.

name: Rintora
summary: Rintora is a white-haired shopkeeper and occultist who reads minds and advises a hero hunting a snake cult. Rintora directs her friend to a demon-hunter's door and heals nothing herself.

feats.scene: Rintora swats a cultist with a broom.
Rintora stays calm in a shop that is being wrecked.

name: Numrus
summary: Numrus is an ageless scientist of a long-lived people who tried to fix a fertility crisis with engineered clones and caused a population explosion. Numrus is brilliant and white-haired.

feats.scene: Numrus shoves a lab cart aside.
Numrus recovers from a bad fall in the laboratory.

name: Rostausar
summary: Rostausar is a hollow-eyed oven witch who lures travellers into a warm kitchen and bakes them into pastries for market stalls. Her sugar-bright hexes bend wills and burn through doors. She drifts above the rooftops when the smell of baking fails to draw in prey.

feats.scene: Rostausar hurled a roiling ball of oven-fire that blew a cart and its horse across a cobbled lane.
Rostausar shrugged off a fall from a bell tower and kept stirring her dough.

source_title: Mother Mae-Eye (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Anillisto
summary: Anillisto is a doting hag who weaves syrupy charms around lost children and slowly drinks their dreams through the steam of fresh pies. Her sweetness turns to scolding when her wards misbehave. A broken spell reveals a gaunt creature hungry for thought itself.

feats.scene: Anillisto lashed out with a wave of stolen thought that cracked a market wall.
Anillisto took a lamppost swung at her ribs and merely brushed off the dust.

name: Tetorcis
summary: Tetorcis is a charismatic preacher who gathered a fervent flock around a blood-red altar and led them with iron conviction. She commands through words and presence rather than strength, and her congregation would follow her into any fire.

feats.scene: Tetorcis struck a rebellious disciple hard enough to drop him to his knees.
Tetorcis stood unmoved through a long beating at the altar steps.

name: Lanurn
summary: Lanurn is a counterfeit sister grown in a vat to feed whole neighbourhoods a pale, soothing drink that rewrites their memories. Her touch shows a gentler past to anyone who sips. She exists only to smooth the world into something easier to sell.

feats.scene: Lanurn unspooled a flood of milky light that rewrote a whole street into a quiet dairy lane for an hour.
Lanurn absorbed a thrown bus and re-formed her torso from curdled cream.

name: Seiuta
summary: Seiuta is a hired brute who bends rock and soil to his will and shoves stone fists through walls on behalf of a shady courier outfit. He was undone when a clever tinkerer swapped his gift for a flame wielder's.

feats.scene: Seiuta raised a ridge of bedrock that flattened a barn.
Seiuta wrapped himself in slabs of granite and walked through a hail of cannon fire.

name: Ntilutau
summary: Ntilutau is a lean wartime fighter who trained in rough grappling schools and trades in throws and joint locks. He wins by balance and nerve, and he once duelled a rival master on a rain-slick rooftop.

feats.scene: Ntilutau flipped an armoured rival over his hip and cracked the courtyard stones.
Ntilutau took a rifle butt to the jaw and stood back up smiling.

name: Valteurn
summary: Valteurn is a masked killer in a bulky suit with a flickering mirage plate across the chest that lets blows slide past, and a blade clipped to one forearm. He plants charges in tunnels without a second thought.

feats.scene: Valteurn armed a satchel bomb that gutted a transit hall and the offices above.
Valteurn took a hard shove through a glass window and landed on his feet.

name: Riron
summary: Riron is a petty thief who swallowed a vial that shrinks him to the height of a rodent, then bribed a squeaking horde to do his burgling. He is slippery, vain and always chasing a gaudy prize.

feats.scene: Riron led a swarm of rats that stripped a vault of its silver spoons.
Riron survived a ceiling collapse by diving into a mousehole.

name: Rntata
summary: Rntata is a mute defence attorney in a harbour town who lost his family to a tainted clinic and never spoke again. He takes the cases nobody wants and lets a folded letter do his arguing.

feats.scene: Rntata slapped a heavy case file onto a judge's desk with a thunderclap.
Rntata endured a night in a cold cell without a word.

name: Narnian
summary: Narnian is a wiry wanderer raised by wolves who can read tracks across continents and speak with every beast he meets. He never ages and he treks for months to follow a scent to its source.

feats.scene: Narnian drove a spear through a charging boar.
Narnian walked off a month of frost and hunger and arrived hale.

name: Iatamon
summary: Iatamon is a sleeping wizard who withdrew into a barren world of stone and moss to escape his own worshippers. His mood shifts the ground, tugs on gravity and coaxes forests out of rock. He speaks only to those who treat him as a person.

feats.scene: Iatamon rolled his stony skin and sent a mountain range sliding across a continent.
Iatamon sat through a bombardment of falling moons without a crack in his crust.

name: Iaront
summary: Iaront is a grey-haired farmer who raised a foundling on his orchard and taught him patience. He is sturdy, quiet and proud, and his hands are always dusty from the fields.

feats.scene: Iaront split a seasoned log with a single axe stroke.
Iaront worked a full harvest day under a blazing sun.

name: Anierau
summary: Anierau is a hard-drinking man from a bayou town whose temper left scars on his adopted child. He is mentioned in old grievances more than he is ever seen.

feats.scene: Anierau slammed a bottle against a porch rail until it burst.
Anierau stumbled through a night of rain and rough living unharmed.

name: Antelcin
summary: Antelcin is a cheerful mother of tiny children who can shrink by pressing a button on her belt. She herds a nursery of pint-sized heroes through a sprawling city with ice cream and patience.

feats.scene: Antelcin shrank to the size of a bean and ferried a lost toddler home on her shoulder.
Antelcin tumbled off a fruit stand and bounced up laughing.

name: Raltera
summary: Raltera is a patient wife in an old mansion who raised a son in a long dynasty of crime fighters. Her name was never recorded, and the family keeps her memory like a locked drawer.

feats.scene: Raltera threw open a heavy study door to catch her son sneaking out at night.
Raltera sat out a long winter of grief with a straight back.

name: Miatiuiu
summary: Miatiuiu is a dark-eyed prowler who digs graves for hire and gets mixed up in holiday crimes on rooftops. Her trade is quiet, her spade is heavy and her tracks vanish by dawn.

feats.scene: Miatiuiu swung a spade into a crypt door and splintered it.
Miatiuiu fell into an open grave and climbed out without a scratch.

name: Alnas
summary: Alnas is a tireless matriarch of a polar toy workshop who keeps cookies warm for elves and mends reindeer harnesses by night. Her body is part machine and part wonder, and she does not tire. Every season she flies a runaway sleigh back home.

feats.scene: Alnas heaved a loaded sleigh upright after it crashed into an ice ridge.
Alnas rode out a blizzard that buried a cabin without so much as a shiver.

name: Lecoval
summary: Lecoval is a grouchy old woman who lies on the sofa with the paper and a bowl of crisps while her grown son tiptoes around her. She nags, sighs and pries into his private life.

feats.scene: Lecoval swatted her son with a rolled newspaper and he flinched.
Lecoval lay through a loud thunderstorm without rising from the couch.

name: Iusaurni
summary: Iusaurni is a stern matron in a northern spy ring who turns into a great shaggy bear when cornered. In that shape her paws gouge steel and her roar rattles windows.

feats.scene: Iusaurni, in bear shape, tore a vault door off its hinges.
Iusaurni took a volley of pistol rounds on her thick hide and kept advancing.

name: Amaullu
summary: Amaullu is a widow in a small mining town who learned folk magic from her husband's kin and calls up crawling things from below the quarry. She leads her neighbours with a soft voice and an iron will.

feats.scene: Amaullu called a swarm of stony creatures up through the road and cracked the asphalt.
Amaullu stood in a collapsing shaft long enough to finish her chant.

name: Tinami
summary: Tinami is a faint figure in a family's past, a mother in a bayou house known only through the stories her adopted daughter tells. She may never have walked on stage at all.

feats.scene: Tinami banged a wooden spoon on a pot to call the household to supper.
Tinami worked a sticky summer without rest.

name: Amovorvar
summary: Amovorvar is a society wife in a rainy city who smiled for her peers while her son resented the act. She died when her mansion burned to the ground around her.

feats.scene: Amovorvar slapped a champagne flute out of a guest's hand.
Amovorvar waited out the fire in a locked bedroom before the roof fell.

name: Asisoan
summary: Asisoan is a cosmetics heiress and mother who lectured her troubled son to look pleasant before rich friends. The family company later folded and she perished in a suspicious fire.

feats.scene: Asisoan pushed her son toward a ballroom door with a firm shove.
Asisoan lasted a long dinner party under hot lights without a crack in her smile.

name: Nanre
summary: Nanre is a clay-bodied escapee who started as a shed fragment of a bigger monster and grew her own temper and voice. She melts into anyone's likeness, fools fingerprints and eye scans, and hits like a cement mixer.

feats.scene: Nanre molded her arm into a hammer and flattened a parked van.
Nanre reformed her torso after a rifle grenade blew a hole through it.

name: Ranensiu
summary: Ranensiu is a sly confidence woman in a lake city who ran with a gang of thieves and tried to hypnotise cops with showy patter. She is quick on her feet and slower on conscience.

feats.scene: Ranensiu slammed a heavy case against a guard and bolted for the door.
Ranensiu took a nasty fall down a fire escape and kept running.

name: Rerte
summary: Rerte is a mischievous sprite from a flat world of puns who knows she is in a story and tells the audience so. She folds reality like origami, hops between universes and vanishes mid-sentence.

feats.scene: Rerte snapped her fingers and flipped a whole planet inside out for a joke.
Rerte laughed off a collapsing world as though it were confetti.

name: Nuveornu
summary: Nuveornu is a scrawny horned servant who carries the scorched bags of a fiendish lord. He is deceptively strong, tough as boiler plate and gives off a heat haze when angry.

feats.scene: Nuveornu punched a bus through a shop front and into the street.
Nuveornu walked through a burning warehouse as though it were a warm bath.

name: Esles
summary: Esles is a white-haired caravan leader and counsellor in a desert trading country, admired for his sound judgement, skill with horses and gift for speech. Others bring him their quarrels and leave settled.

feats.scene: Esles hauled a stuck cart out of a dune with a team of horses.
Esles rode three days through a dust storm and arrived steady.

name: Ranautor
summary: Ranautor is a hopeful street fighter from an uptown block who once joined a corporate rescue squad before leaving it behind. He remains loyal to his neighbours.

feats.scene: Ranautor threw a rope across a rooftop gap and hauled three people to safety.
Ranautor took a heavy fall off a loading dock and walked home.

name: Maolulan
summary: Maolulan is a red-furred, antennaed peacekeeper who carries a glowing lantern and a ring that shapes light into walls, blasts and wings. He guards a patch of stars and recharges at a battery at the end of each shift.

feats.scene: Maolulan fired a lance of green-white light and ripped open a canyon the width of a city.
Maolulan raised a luminous shield that held against a falling asteroid.

name: Sonarran
summary: Sonarran is an auburn-haired queen in a hidden kingdom who pushed for war with a rival realm until a stage conjurer tricked her into peace. She now shares her throne and wears a heirloom necklace.

feats.scene: Sonarran struck a royal drum and ordered the whole garrison to rise.
Sonarran stood motionless through an hour of hostile envoys.

name: Ntvor
summary: Ntvor is a bald, clever schemer who plots elaborate traps against a team of adventurers. His genius lies in gadgets and costume changes rather than muscle.

feats.scene: Ntvor pulled a lever and dropped a net onto a surprised crew.
Ntvor survived a collapsing lair by diving behind a steel door.

name: Loceltia
summary: Loceltia is a loyal automaton built by a scheming inventor, forever being smashed and rebuilt. She changes shape, hits hard and fires crackling bolts from her hands.

feats.scene: Loceltia fired a bolt from her palm that melted a steel girder.
Loceltia was blown to scrap and reassembled by sundown.

name: Arron
summary: Arron is a creature born when a bomb test mingled unknown elements, a restless thing that takes the shape of a torpedo and then a blazing sheet of flame. A lead-lined chest finally smothered him.

feats.scene: Arron rammed an island shore as a torpedo and cracked the rocks there.
Arron reformed as a fire cloud after being broken into mist.

name: Nesolu
summary: Nesolu is a brown-haired prankster in a small farm town who dresses up in theatrical rags to scare locals and annoy a teenage hero.

feats.scene: Nesolu jumped from a hayloft and bowled over a farmhand.
Nesolu took a bucket to the head and ran on.

name: Leniaste
summary: Leniaste is a white-eyed lieutenant of a violet band of reformed rogues who flies on a ring of light, shoots beams and hops between worlds. His ring also mimics the powers of nearby rival rings.

feats.scene: Leniaste focused a violet beam that carved a trench through a city park and its river.
Leniaste soaked up a barrage of rival energy bolts and stood unharmed.

name: Surenll
summary: Surenll is a black-haired sea dweller who breathes both water and air. He swims out of a deep city to patrol the shallows and keeps to himself.

feats.scene: Surenll tore a net off a fishing boat with a hard pull.
Surenll dived to a crushing depth and surfaced comfortable.

name: Rilta
summary: Rilta is a brown-haired offworld officer sworn to a rebel commander, trained in close combat and tactics. His body shrugs off hits that would flatten a human, though certain rocks make him ill.

feats.scene: Rilta drove a fist through an armoured door.
Rilta took a rifle burst to the chest and kept giving orders.

name: Valnolle
summary: Valnolle is a bald killer who stalks the wartime city streets with ruthless efficiency and a gift for leaving no witnesses.

feats.scene: Valnolle knocked a patrolman unconscious with a single blow.
Valnolle slipped out of a locked cellar through a coal chute.

name: Tornuan
summary: Tornuan is a white-haired captain of an undersea army, bred to endure crushing pressure. He is strong, quick and tough, though he lost a hand in battle and now fights with a prosthetic.

feats.scene: Tornuan shoulder-checked a stone gate off its frame.
Tornuan stood in a crossfire of harpoon bolts without bleeding.

name: Stitelse
summary: Stitelse is a minor swindler sentenced to a shadow prison, who broke out and swore to destroy an alien fleet. Once free he posed as a road marshal until called to war, and his freedom ended abruptly.

feats.scene: Stitelse bent a lamp post double while crossing a road.
Stitelse shrugged off a collision with a speeding lorry.

name: Seosa
summary: Seosa is a chemist whose body was rewritten by a spore cloud so that nothing can harm or sicken him. His panicked mind eventually broke trying to protect that body from imaginary dangers.

feats.scene: Seosa shoved a guard aside in a panicked fit.
Seosa walked through a lab fire that melted the benches without a blister.

name: Seneleo
summary: Seneleo is a loud mutated songbird who got a big brain and a bigger ego, flying with laser-bright eyes and bossing a flock of henchmen. He used to be much stronger and now relies on cunning.

feats.scene: Seneleo fired twin eye beams that scorched a billboard in half.
Seneleo took a thrown trash can and kept squawking.

name: Cortelos
summary: Cortelos is a smooth musician and relationship counsellor who sings people into doing what he wants. His therapy sessions run like stage shows with a soothing, commanding voice.

feats.scene: Cortelos struck a high note that shattered a champagne glass.
Cortelos kept the beat through a rowdy brawl in the audience.

name: Ornotel
summary: Ornotel is a dark-haired swordsman in a plumed hat, an overseas ally who fences with flair and keeps his identity hidden behind a mask.

feats.scene: Ornotel disarmed three opponents in the span of a breath.
Ornotel vaulted a balcony and landed without a stumble.

name: Seces
summary: Seces is a hard-bitten colonel in a southern African army, a half-brother in a bitter family feud. He is proud, disciplined and ruthless with his troops.

feats.scene: Seces struck a table and silenced a room of officers.
Seces marched across a hot plain for a whole day.

name: Tistili
summary: Tistili is a hulking gang boss with filed nails and sharpened teeth who rules a pack of feral youths. He is fast and strong for a man, and tends to overrate himself.

feats.scene: Tistili slashed with his razor nails and tore a leather jacket to shreds.
Tistili took a lead pipe across the shoulders and laughed.

name: Orisetan
summary: Orisetan is a towering, hairless gang chief with sharp teeth who ruled a walled-off slum zone. A clawed rival scarred his face, and he later helped a plant-woman snatch a rich boy.

feats.scene: Orisetan hurled a steel drum across a courtyard.
Orisetan took a flurry of slashes across his face and kept advancing.

name: Nassau
summary: Nassau is a bald brick-built thug with sharp teeth who serves a clown crime boss in a toy city. He is a stock heavy and rarely speaks.

feats.scene: Nassau bit through a plastic bar with a snap.
Nassau was dropped off a roof and popped back together.

name: Llitorli
summary: Llitorli is a bald, oversized-brained criminal born on a ship that slipped through a rift. He rearranges matter, moves things with thought and flies a stolen cruiser to rob across star systems, until a counter-device quiets his mind.

feats.scene: Llitorli rebuilt a cargo hold into a bank vault with a thought and blew the hull of a freighter outward.
Llitorli sat unhurt as his hideout was demolished around him.

name: Eloraria
summary: Eloraria is a balding prankster from a pocket dimension who rewrites reality for sport and slips between worlds at will. His jokes can erase a whole squad of heroes, then undo the damage when the game ends.

feats.scene: Eloraria blinked a city out of existence and then laughed it back into place.
Eloraria stood in the heart of a collapsing sky and simply yawned.

name: Caamam
summary: Caamam is an aging monarch of a fiery warrior people, red-haired and green-eyed, who has outlived his wife and sits uneasily on a council throne. His daughters have drifted to opposite sides of a long feud.

feats.scene: Caamam released a solar blast that flattened a district of an empty trade port.
Caamam took a falling tower on his back and stood.

name: Tiuloramo
summary: Tiuloramo is a gentle dad from a distant sun world, small in stature but able to soar. He frets over his two daughters and their homework.

feats.scene: Tiuloramo plucked a tumbling school bus out of the air.
Tiuloramo bounced off a brick wall mid-flight and kept going.
Tiuloramo tore across a playground to catch a runaway kite.

name: Seiacol
summary: Seiacol is a grey-haired failed applicant who faked weather control with a hidden gadget sewn into his clothes. Bitter after rejection, he joined a xenophobic crew and now blusters about his tricks.

feats.scene: Seiacol cranked his concealed device and whipped up a squall that tore awnings off a street.
Seiacol took a hard shove and tumbled over a bench.

name: Nanamta
summary: Nanamta is a masked survivor of cruel experiments on a conquered world, forced to breathe through a respirator. He bends sound itself into shockwaves and shouts with the fury of a man who was once silenced.

feats.scene: Nanamta unleashed a sound blast that pulverised a stone embassy gate.
Nanamta rode out a collapse of a corridor and rose, wheezing.

name: Seorne
summary: Seorne is a glib, flamboyant publicist from a harbour city who builds the legend of a champion and lives on cocktails and deals. Her empire cracks when a charming rogue gets her addicted.

feats.scene: Seorne hurled a handful of contracts across the room in a rage.
Seorne endured a week of lawsuits without cracking her smile.

name: Ulnasi
summary: Ulnasi is a black-haired agent obsessed with a famous warrior and willing to risk her neck to meet her. She sells her services with a card and relentless optimism.

feats.scene: Ulnasi slapped a business card onto a table beside an astonished heroine.
Ulnasi crawled through a crowd barrier and came out only ruffled.

name: Iumrntel
summary: Iumrntel is a green, hairless commander of an insect-like fleet who sent a hive back in time to drain the planet's rocks of their glow. His invasion folds when a young runner smashes the hive.

feats.scene: Iumrntel ordered a barrage that levelled a harbour district.
Iumrntel shrugged off a shell blast aboard his bridge.

name: Nutaeo
summary: Nutaeo is a brave guardian of children in a rough metropolis who stood between a cannibal and her ward. She was scarred by claws and died shielding the little ones from a rampaging machine.

feats.scene: Nutaeo swung a table leg and drove a raider back from the nursery door.
Nutaeo took a clawing across the face and kept standing.

name: Luvaltis
summary: Luvaltis is a hired killer of a hidden warrior sisterhood who bore the child of a dark god and fought to protect her. She is a fierce and secretive mother with a long blade.

feats.scene: Luvaltis cut down an attacker with a single sweeping stroke.
Luvaltis stood through a duel with a powerful sister and walked away.

name: Aurnst
summary: Aurnst is a warrior assassin who broke from her sisters to raise a daughter she hoped would destroy a dark overlord. She slew a monstrous serpent mother and tamed a winged beast of legend.

feats.scene: Aurnst felled a great winged beast with a single spear throw.
Aurnst fought three sisters at once and rose from the dust.

name: Anustota
summary: Anustota is a patient who exists only in a disturbed doctor's imagination, a figure whose face is said to drive onlookers mad. She is a phantom woven from his guilt.

feats.scene: Anustota stirred a corridor of whispering patients into a frenzy.
Anustota remained unmarked through every ward inspection.

name: Sullisia
summary: Sullisia is a brown-haired researcher in a parallel future whose team built an immense watching machine. He selected a timid clerk to link with its satellites and become a one-man army.

feats.scene: Sullisia threw a master switch that lit a bank of monitors.
Sullisia worked three nights straight in a freezing lab.

name: Eoamam
summary: Eoamam is an annoying sibling in a brood of fiends who throws a family gathering that turns out to be an ambush on a niece. He is brown-haired, smug and lazy.

feats.scene: Eoamam stomped and cracked the floor of an underworld banquet hall.
Eoamam took a thrown table in the face and complained about the noise.

source_title: Myron the Mildly Irritating (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Eruora
summary: Eruora is a pink-skinned guardian with a green ring who patrols a far sector of space. The ring builds shields, blasts and wings from will alone. He fell in battle and returned as an unwilling servant of a dark force.

feats.scene: Eruora fired a beam that cut a moon-sized crater into a barren rock.
Eruora raised a barrier that held back a collapsing space station.

name: Rnentecol
summary: Rnentecol is a blonde warrior of an island sisterhood who serves in a royal guard. She is trained with bow, horse and blade and obeys her captain without question.

feats.scene: Rnentecol shot an arrow clean through a shield at long range.
Rnentecol took a heavy blow in sparring and kept her footing.

name: Oluoratiu
summary: Oluoratiu is a grey-haired sorcerer who was shrunk and locked away, then ruled a handful of captives with his spells. His portal blunder let rivals in, and he finally split into three beams.

feats.scene: Oluoratiu tore a glowing rift in the wall of his cell.
Oluoratiu held together as his essence was pulled in three directions.

name: Ntlese
summary: Ntlese is a masked adventurer who fought beside a veteran vigilante in a great battle. He died when a nuclear strike fell on the field.

feats.scene: Ntlese swung a baton into a rioter's shoulder and dropped him.
Ntlese endured a long march through a frozen field.

name: Esialler
summary: Esialler is a near-immortal alien who crash-landed on this planet in ancient times and has lived through all of recorded history. He is far stronger and tougher than a person, tireless and slow to age.

feats.scene: Esialler hurled a wrecked car through the wall of a warehouse.
Esialler took a tank round in the chest and walked through the smoke.

name: Verorter
summary: Verorter is a brown-haired mother of a hero from a distant world who was caught in attacks on the relatives of a young squad. She was once brainwashed along with her husband.

feats.scene: Verorter swung a heavy pan at an intruder in her kitchen.
Verorter endured a long interrogation without breaking.

name: Inreo
summary: Inreo is a red-eyed hunter god, ancient beyond count, who stalks prey across dimensions and traps them in nets of light. He can grow to titanic size and has the strength to match.

feats.scene: Inreo grew to the size of a hill and hurled a boulder that levelled a mountain peak.
Inreo stood through a storm of cannon fire as though through spring rain.

name: Eorus
summary: Eorus is a secretive alien who leads a hidden society sworn to hunt down other visitors. He hires mercenaries and gathers data on heroes from a fortified citadel.

feats.scene: Eorus triggered his citadel's defences and blew a gap through a perimeter wall.
Eorus escaped a collapsing hall with only a few scrapes.

name: Estau
summary: Estau is a blue-haired, blue-skinned figure who appeared once in a frantic chase and met a swift end. Little else about him is known.

feats.scene: Estau lunged at a pursuer and landed a solid punch.
Estau tumbled down a stairwell and kept sprinting.

name: Amosir
summary: Amosir is a mortal woman who fell in love with a dream king and threw herself off a cliff rather than join him. A meteor wiped out her city the morning after, and her grief outlasted the stars.

feats.scene: Amosir pushed a heavy door and left her lover's dream behind.
Amosir endured a night in a ruined city without sleep.

name: Llurniiu
summary: Llurniiu is a grey-haired sea-siren who kidnapped a queen from a reef and lurked in a haunted stretch of ocean. She seduces sailors, bites hard and swims with brutal strength.

feats.scene: Llurniiu dragged a fishing boat under with a single yank.
Llurniiu was hit with a boat hook and shook it off.

name: Tiantern
summary: Tiantern is a young woman from a border town who looks after her brother and takes whatever work she can. She is warm, stubborn and well loved by neighbours.

feats.scene: Tiantern shoved a broken fridge out of an alley.
Tiantern worked a double shift in the summer heat.

name: Sollton
summary: Sollton is a cold and clever underboss from a mob family who wore down rivals with patience and a sharp tongue. She speaks several languages and treats every man as a dog to be trained.

feats.scene: Sollton slapped a lieutenant across the face in front of the crew.
Sollton sat calmly through a gunfight at a restaurant table.

name: Iumson
summary: Iumson is a duelling champion of a female order of cosmic immortals who joined an elder council in a pocket universe. She later returned to choose mortals for a leap in human evolution.

feats.scene: Iumson shattered a stone arena in a duel with an elder.
Iumson took a blast from a rival and stood her ground.

name: Oriiumeo
summary: Oriiumeo is a black-haired soldier of an alien coup who was jailed for centuries in a shadow realm and set free by accident. She fights in armour and follows her general to conquer a planet.

feats.scene: Oriiumeo smashed through a steel bulkhead in her armour.
Oriiumeo took a rifle volley and strode on.

name: Sullo
summary: Sullo is the living water spirit of an ocean-covered world, flowing as a woman of tide and foam. She guides the people's minds and sharpens a champion's bond with the deep during an invasion. Foul water clouds her thoughts.

feats.scene: Sullo raised a wall of seawater that smashed an invading fleet.
Sullo dispersed into mist when struck and reformed across the waves.

name: Arororn
summary: Arororn is a ghostly scientist stranded in a frozen-time dimension after her body was destroyed crossing over. She studies the strange place and helps a fast runner understand it.

feats.scene: Arororn handed over a device that shook a lab bench.
Arororn drifted unharmed through a collapsing hull.

name: Stiiummi
summary: Stiiummi is a purple-skinned alien scholar who drank a serum made from healing horns and gained endless life at the cost of a monstrous body. He lashes out at anyone who refuses to understand him.

feats.scene: Stiiummi tore a stone lintel from a ruined gate.
Stiiummi stood unharmed after a rock slide buried him.

name: Metiusti
summary: Metiusti is a white-haired ancient being, once the first lord of chaos in a dead world. He survived its ruin, hid among mortals for ages, then allied with a tyrant before being sealed in a wall of cosmic stone.

feats.scene: Metiusti hurled a wave of chaos that levelled a mountain range.
Metiusti endured the collapse of his home world and crawled out.

name: Rnnenile
summary: Rnnenile is the primordial mother of the sea who mourns her slain husband and means to wipe out her creation to start over. Her grief once tore her apart into seven monstrous shapes.

feats.scene: Rnnenile raised a tide that drowned a continent.
Rnnenile survived being torn apart by her own grief.

name: Liaamseo
summary: Liaamseo is a blonde warrior of a northern people who was freed from a demon's grip by a famous hero and then fought a swamp monster at his side. She is quick with a sword and her fists.

feats.scene: Liaamseo cleaved a raider's shield in two with a single sword stroke.
Liaamseo took a club blow to the shoulder and kept fighting.

name: Seoansas
summary: Seoansas is a seven-foot shark-headed brute and hired killer who survives gunfire without a scratch. His thick hide even shrugs off an electric shock meant to disarm a bomb at his neck, which ends badly for him.

feats.scene: Seoansas bit through a steel door handle and tore the door off.
Seoansas stood in front of a wall of rifle fire and took nothing.

name: Irlisir
summary: Irlisir is a grey, hammer-headed crime lord who lives in an undersea city and is half-divine. He breathes air and water, bites hard, and his strength and stamina are far beyond a person's.

feats.scene: Irlisir drove his fist through a ship's hull.
Irlisir took a torpedo blast and surfaced grinning.

name: Ralore
summary: Ralore is a shark-man circus attraction who defended his friends against raiders and was killed for it. He was strong and toothy, a gentle giant under the big top.

feats.scene: Ralore flung a tent pole into a raider and knocked her down.
Ralore took a dozen blows from a raider before his jaw gave way.

name: Tiamlan
summary: Tiamlan is a yellow-eyed shark brute who bounces between a villain league and a government squad. He leaps, bites and claws, and nothing he eats seems to poison him.

feats.scene: Tiamlan leapt a wall and flattened a guard post.
Tiamlan walked through a cloud of toxic gas and sneezed.

name: Aniumva
summary: Aniumva is the shark king of a flooded realm, proud, fanged and good at swimming. His subjects follow him without question.

feats.scene: Aniumva thrashed a boat to splinters with his tail.
Aniumva was struck with a trident and shook it off.

name: Orliva
summary: Orliva is a grey-haired mother whose son became a winged hero. She first appears only as a voice on a telephone line and later steps into the story herself.

feats.scene: Orliva slammed a receiver down in anger.
Orliva waited through a long night for news of her son.

name: Oreseeo
summary: Oreseeo is a black-haired young troublemaker with a sister who shares his dark trade. His record is short and his reputation is just starting to build.

feats.scene: Oreseeo threw a punch that cracked a window.
Oreseeo ran through a hail of thrown bottles unscathed.

name: Esvist
summary: Esvist is a hush-voiced drifter who believes every polished surface hides a rival twin, and spends whole nights murmuring to glass. Esvist's twin never answers, which only deepens the devotion.

feats.scene: Esvist swings a fist at a washroom pane and cracks it from corner to corner.
Esvist takes a hurled stool across the shoulders and does not look away from the mirror.

name: Llalis
summary: Llalis slips through locked doors as drifting vapour and reforms behind prey with a grin. Llalis treats each hunt like a courtship gone sour and never forgets a slight.

feats.scene: Llalis condenses inside a guard's lungs and drops him senseless in seconds.
Llalis thins to mist as a rifle round passes straight through the torso.

name: Sestnu
summary: Sestnu carries a ring that sculpts greedy hunger into solid light, shaping shields and bolts out of pure want. Sestnu drifted away from the band that issued the ring, yet the habit of hoarding stays.

feats.scene: Sestnu hurls a lump of glowing avarice that flattens an empty warehouse.
Sestnu raises a bubble of amber light that holds while a hangar collapses around it.
Sestnu streaks out of a canyon on a ribbon of amber light and clears the clouds in moments.

name: Sastu
summary: Sastu is a bold collector among the avaricious ring-bearers, weaving amber walls and darts from covetous urges. Sastu was once dead, yet the ring called the body back to work.

feats.scene: Sastu fires a fan of amber darts that shreds a stack of cargo containers.
Sastu stands inside a glowing shell while a crumbling wall drops across it.
Sastu races a falling meteor shard to the ground and wins.

name: Senasa
summary: Senasa keeps a busy counter in a neighbourhood of exiles, feeding strangers and haggling in several tongues. Senasa's true strength is stubborn kindness that outlasts every bad winter.

feats.scene: Senasa shoves a purse-snatcher clean out of the shop doorway.
Senasa stays on her feet when a crate tips off a high shelf onto her back.

name: Ntllerer
summary: Ntllerer prowls rooftops as a pale killer who strikes at dusk and recoils from daylight. A talent for staff fighting and quiet charm makes Ntllerer a gifted trap-setter.

feats.scene: Ntllerer cracks a staff across a stone balustrade and splits it.
Ntllerer drops three storeys onto a slab roof and rises with only a limp.

name: Taorres
summary: Taorres plays the keyboard with such passion that a whole hall falls silent. Taorres's real contest is surviving a patron's cruel game after refusing to give up a secret.

feats.scene: Taorres slams the piano lid shut on a rude intruder's fingers.
Taorres endures a long fall and stays silent to protect a friend.

name: Neeorne
summary: Neeorne wields a ring of resolve and turns it into precise, intricate machinery of light. An engineer's mind makes every construct look like a working device.

feats.scene: Neeorne assembles a glowing siege ram and drives it through a concrete bunker.
Neeorne braces behind a lattice shield as a collapsing tower rains debris on it.
Neeorne launches skyward on a jet of glowing gears and breaks the sound barrier many times over.

source_title: Natasha Irons (Dark Crisis: Worlds Without a Justice League: Green Lantern)

name: Rnnumlan
summary: Rnnumlan is a young inventor who bolts together a chrome suit and a heavy impact mallet, then soars above the avenues. A gift for gadgets matters more than raw muscle.

feats.scene: Rnnumlan swings the mallet and crumples a parked car into a ball.
Rnnumlan weathers a truck collision inside the suit and walks away.
Rnnumlan skims above the rooftops at highway pace.

name: Taserel
summary: Taserel fights beside a team of champions in a metal suit with a shock mallet at the hip. The arrangement is simple: hit hard, stay standing, and keep the crowd safe.

feats.scene: Taserel brings the shock mallet down on a van and caves in the roof.
Taserel shrugs off a battering from a loose girder.

name: Rnvau
summary: Rnvau led a rebel cell through a long insurgency and lost an arm, replaced by a humming mechanical limb. Rnvau cares little for outside quarrels and refuses to leave the cause.

feats.scene: Rnvau punches a hole through a plank barricade with the mechanical arm.
Rnvau keeps fighting after a grenade blast tears the old limb away.

name: Rusvalrni
summary: Rusvalrni inherited a dead relative's armour and swings a mallet powerful enough to bruise invaders from another world. The suit lifts Rusvalrni off the ground and sheds small-arms fire.

feats.scene: Rusvalrni's mallet cracks the plating of a hulking invader in one swing.
Rusvalrni takes a beam of heat across the chest and merely winces.
Rusvalrni arcs over a ruined avenue at the speed of a sprinting sedan.

name: Anral
summary: Anral is a level-headed pupil in a suit of plates, answering threats with a heavy mallet or a ray gun built in a garage. A loud family and a bad accident forged the practical streak.

feats.scene: Anral fires the ray gun and melts a hole in a steel shutter.
Anral stays upright while a collapsing scaffold pounds the armour.

name: Saneru
summary: Saneru is a cheerful schoolkid who hangs around with a crowd of friends and cheers on a family hero. Saneru's biggest challenge is a pop quiz.

feats.scene: Saneru throws a crumpled paper ball hard enough to sting a friend.
Saneru tumbles off a playground slide and giggles.

name: Riatali
summary: Riatali is a hard-handed brawler out of a faded empire, fusing ironbound muscle with trained fighting. Riatali leans on a sibling and a hammering style of combat.

feats.scene: Riatali hurls a motorbike across a loading yard.
Riatali absorbs a baton barrage from a dozen guards.

name: Vatellan
summary: Vatellan is a burly schoolboy athlete who throws a hard tackle and a harder temper. A mixed-up potion once made Vatellan hopelessly devoted until a cloud of vapour fixed things.

feats.scene: Vatellan tackles a rival and drives him into the turf.
Vatellan plays on through a bruising pile-up.

name: Cesorile
summary: Cesorile is a dogged sleuth in a future city, following a forged paper trail toward a hidden mastermind. Cesorile is persistent rather than strong.

feats.scene: Cesorile tackles a fleeing clerk in a records office.
Cesorile survives a shove down a short flight of stairs.

name: Lannenor
summary: Lannenor is a wire-wrapped contract killer who cuts elevator cables to settle grudges. Lannenor's cybernetic frame once survived being impaled on the killer's own blade.

feats.scene: Lannenor slices an elevator cable with a single wire strike.
Lannenor is hurled through a metal door and still lives.

name: Valelsti
summary: Valelsti is a physicist whose experiment ruptured a vessel of unstable plasma, tearing open a chasm of altered rules. Afterward everyone nearby simply failed to notice Valelsti, and the cosmos itself may owe its birth to the accident.

feats.scene: Valelsti triggers the rupture that seeds an entire cosmos.
Valelsti stands unharmed at the heart of the blast that flattens the laboratory district.

name: Leoannia
summary: Leoannia is a weathered rancher who fought overseas, then settled to raise cattle and a family far from the cities. Leoannia is gruff with visitors and prefers quiet fields.

feats.scene: Leoannia hauls a hay bale onto a trailer in one heave.
Leoannia rides out a kick from a stubborn bull.

name: Rnrneser
summary: Rnrneser is a cold mimic who wears a serpent-styled outfit and copies other people's mannerisms. Years of hiding self-doubt were turned into a weapon by a patient mentor.

feats.scene: Rnrneser vaults a railing and drives a boot into a rival's chest.
Rnrneser lands a tumble from a balcony and rolls up smiling.

name: Recortum
summary: Recortum is a silver-haired stranger who turns up in a quiet rural town beside a band of monster-hunters. Little is recorded, so Recortum remains a rumour with a pale head of hair.

feats.scene: Recortum drives a stake through a plank door.
Recortum stumbles from a shed collapse with only scratches.

name: Llorosami
summary: Llorosami is a crimefighter whose metal skin holds a bottled storm of quantum light. When torn open, Llorosami floods a whole plain with raw radiance and scorches it to bare dirt.

feats.scene: Llorosami is ripped apart and the released light scours an entire farm belt to barren dust.
Llorosami's metal skin shrugs off a rifle volley.

name: Nialose
summary: Nialose is a grey-haired commander who lost a power struggle over a secret programme and swore a return. Nialose came back harsher than the rival, running the operation with a cold hand.

feats.scene: Nialose slaps a desk and silences a room of subordinates.
Nialose survives a stumble down a marble stair unhurt.

name: Sineoia
summary: Sineoia is a being of pure force sealed inside a containment suit, and the suit is the only reason people can stand near. Sineoia drinks any form of power it likes, though a rupture can leave the suit crippled.

feats.scene: Sineoia releases a pulse that levels a rampaging construct.
Sineoia absorbs a blast that would flatten a house and glows brighter.

name: Nteile
summary: Nteile is a rumpled private snoop from the thirties who flew warplanes and later quit the beat in disgust at its rot. Nteile still keeps an eye on a pair of orphaned kids.

feats.scene: Nteile cracks a goon's jaw with a short right.
Nteile gets back up after a beating in a back alley.

name: Iumriase
summary: Iumriase was the king of back-street racing until a crash left Iumriase crippled, then fitted with machine limbs and tiny repair swarms. The new body roars through traffic with a green glare in one eye.

feats.scene: Iumriase rams a roadblock aside with a metal shoulder.
Iumriase climbs from a wrecked sports car with barely a scratch.
Iumriase sprints beside a speeding sedan on cybernetic legs.

name: Strosnus
summary: Strosnus was a college ball star who lost a leg, then became a hulking living-metal hero after a cruel attack backfired. Strosnus drives metal fists with a bigger heart than the injury suggests.

feats.scene: Strosnus punches a van across a street.
Strosnus takes a speeding truck head-on and plants both feet.

name: Iumanusti
summary: Iumanusti is a sleeper-case sleuth who walks the rainy beat and trusts a sidearm more than most people. Iumanusti works alone and rarely talks about the cases that stay unsolved.

feats.scene: Iumanusti pistol-whips a suspect on a fire escape.
Iumanusti takes a punch in the ribs and keeps interrogating.

name: Tireoium
summary: Tireoium is a grief-crazed scholar who blames a wandering spirit for a wife's death and turns to forbidden tomes. A gem of ruin and a summoned rank of lesser horrors repay the effort by taking Tireoium's life.

feats.scene: Tireoium calls up lesser horrors that smash a carriage house.
Tireoium stumbles blind into a bookshelf and keeps chanting.

name: Amsasam
summary: Amsasam is a former plant guard turned hired gun whose body now holds living atomic fire. A strike is said to match a bomb, though without fresh radiation to feed on the body sickens.

feats.scene: Amsasam lets the stored atomic fire go in one burst and levels a block of warehouses.
Amsasam walks unharmed from a collapsing reactor hall.

name: Rnitan
summary: Rnitan fights as an irradiated recruit on a schemer's squad, loosing glowing blasts from bare hands. A monstrous brute ends the career in a garage, outmatched and quickly overcome.

feats.scene: Rnitan hurls a glowing blast that shreds a parked car.
Rnitan tanks a few hits from a brute before being overwhelmed.

name: Tiaraser
summary: Tiaraser was a hopeless small-time crook who dragged a son from town to town, always one step ahead of unpaid debts. In the end Tiaraser settled one debt by trading away a child.

feats.scene: Tiaraser shoves a son out of a car door.
Tiaraser sits through years of tubes and silence in a hospital bed.

name: Roesini
summary: Roesini is a hulking gun-for-hire who once wore a uniform overseas and never takes off a battered hat. Roesini grew up on mean streets and sticks with an old friend through every job.

feats.scene: Roesini heaves a safe door off its hinges.
Roesini absorbs a bar-room punch and tips the hat.

name: Amoian
summary: Amoian is a gilled ring-bearer who must keep a helmet of water around the head to breathe. In a cartoon crisis Amoian helps a clumsy duck stop a vortex machine.

feats.scene: Amoian launches a glowing harpoon that pierces a hangar wall.
Amoian shelters inside a bubble of light through a rocking blast.
Amoian cuts through open space on a trail of glowing foam.

name: Neoas
summary: Neoas is a short, stout recruit with yellow eyes who was picked early by the elders of a cosmic order. Neoas attends a council meeting where a vast threat is announced.

feats.scene: Neoas fires a pulse of light that smashes a drifting asteroid.
Neoas shields a crowd from a shockwave behind a glowing wall.
Neoas crosses a spaceport on a streak of light.

name: Amoriasor
summary: Amoriasor is a gilled guardian with yellow eyes who answers a call to arms alongside a gathering of other heroes. A glowing ring shapes constructs, shields and bolts at will.

feats.scene: Amoriasor builds a glowing net that crushes a drifting wreck.
Amoriasor stands behind a light shell as plating rains down.
Amoriasor swoops through a canyon of debris on a glowing trail.

name: Sicorle
summary: Sicorle is a quiet family man living in a lakeside suburb, a relative to a famous ring-bearer. Sicorle plays no part in cosmic wars and prefers dinner with a wife and son.

feats.scene: Sicorle carries a heavy sack of groceries up the steps.
Sicorle slips on ice and gets up laughing.

name: Veiumlo
summary: Veiumlo is a masked member of a harbour-city collective of lab-coated heroes. Veiumlo is known only by a pseudonym and a tight-lipped manner.

feats.scene: Veiumlo hurls a clamp tool across a lab at a thief.
Veiumlo shrugs off a fall from a lab stool.

name: Llcoliu
summary: Llcoliu is a magnetic schemer who bends fields to haul heavy metal and drift above the floor. Llcoliu's overreach with a coup ends when a rival flips the powers back and the body fails.

feats.scene: Llcoliu twists the world's own field enough to scatter compasses across a continent's edge.
Llcoliu hovers inside a field cocoon as a girder slams the shell.
Llcoliu glides over a rooftop on a cushion of repelling force.

name: Rilrniam
summary: Rilrniam was a lowly undertaker in a hellish foundry-world until an overlord handed over a mark that wakes the dead. With it, Rilrniam raised an army of corpses, drained life from those near and teleported across worlds.

feats.scene: Rilrniam raises an army of corpses that tears down a city wall.
Rilrniam stands unharmed in a swarm of strikes from a rival champion.

name: Litiulu
summary: Litiulu is a greedy back-alley enforcer in plated armor who robs dealers instead of arresting them. Two steel gauntlet rams slide out of the sleeves to crack ribs and doors alike. Litiulu is brave, sloppy and always one ambush from the grave.

feats.scene: Litiulu drove a ram-fist through a steel shutter to snatch a duffel of cash.
Litiulu stood in a hail of pistol fire with only bruised ribs to show for it.

name: Iumneser
summary: Iumneser is a yellow-furred hound who patrols moonlit yards for a pack of talking animal scouts. Quick on four legs and sharp of nose, Iumneser tracks thieves across rooftops and fences.

feats.scene: Iumneser slammed a fleeing burglar into a hedge with one lunge.
Iumneser outran a delivery van down a long straight road.

name: Riaseve
summary: Riaseve is a ruthless brawler from a mirrored republic where the best fighter rules. Riaseve reads an opponent's next three moves before the first punch lands and hands out the same pain in return.

feats.scene: Riaseve folded a parked sedan in half with a single flurry.
Riaseve walked out of a collapsing balcony without slowing.

name: Resneve
summary: Resneve is a gray-haired costumed guardian of a retro-styled city, patrolling with a team of fellow mask-wearers. Resneve favors flowing capes, clean jawlines and fists that never need a second swing.

feats.scene: Resneve laid out three armed robbers in a single sweep.
Resneve took a baseball bat across the back and kept walking.

name: Orave
summary: Orave was a paralysed patient who trained his arms with throwing blades, then woke from a massacre able to walk and fight. Orave hunts the creatures that fed on his ward and pins them to walls from across the room.

feats.scene: Orave nailed a charging monster to a brick wall with three blades at once.
Orave got up from a rooftop fall with his stride unbroken.

name: Neraseo
summary: Neraseo is an aging statesman who runs a vast empire from a stone fortress, juggling missile bluffs and farm quotas. Neraseo rules by stubborn speech, not by strength, and survives every crisis by talking louder.

feats.scene: Neraseo pounded a podium hard enough to topple a water jug.
Neraseo shrugged off a stumble down a marble staircase.

name: Leorairn
summary: Leorairn is a white-haired teenager who moved overseas for school and nearly died during a haunting. Since then Leorairn sees the restless dead and quietly helps them finish their unsolved cases.

feats.scene: Leorairn swung a chair at a possessed classmate and knocked her flat.
Leorairn survived a long drop into a flooded basement.

name: Orotor
summary: Orotor was a government spy picked by cosmic elders to receive deathless gifts, but traitorous colleagues shot him before the rite. Orotor lingers as a drifting shape in other people's dreams.

feats.scene: Orotor flung open a vault door with a bare shoulder charge.
Orotor shook off a pistol grip cracked across his skull.

name: Amocel
summary: Amocel is a blond smuggler-warlord descended from sea-gods, armed with weapons soaked in old divine fury. Amocel's rifle sends victims into frenzy and a spear coated in swamp venom stops healers cold.

feats.scene: Amocel fired a sun-blessed rocket that turned a cargo ship into slag.
Amocel took a crashing truck head-on and rose spitting curses.

name: Oreeo
summary: Oreeo is a talking arsenal of rockets, rifles and blades bolted into a rolling chassis. Oreeo lashes out wildly during street battles and finally falls to an atomic blast it could not outweigh.

feats.scene: Oreeo emptied every rack at once and levelled a freight depot.
Oreeo's casing glowed white under a city-sized fireball before it finally melted.

name: Eolitel
summary: Eolitel is a red-haired cyborg telepath who jumps back through time to gather rebels against a grim tomorrow. Eolitel is stuck in a hover-chair after a failed siege but wins with minds instead of muscles.

feats.scene: Eolitel's psychic surge folded a fortress gate into scrap.
Eolitel took a plasma volley across his armored chest and kept thinking.

name: Valsorcin
summary: Valsorcin is a grey-eyed wheelchair user who drills a squad of oddly gifted misfits. Valsorcin plans battles on napkins, and the squad's ruin comes during a mission that goes horribly wrong.

feats.scene: Valsorcin hurled a clipboard hard enough to dent a steel locker.
Valsorcin survived a tumble with his chair down a short flight of steps.

name: Iucini
summary: Iucini is a red-haired mentor who guides a ragged crew of misfit heroes in a cartoonish toy-box world. Iucini rolls from room to room, handing out plans and gentle scoldings.

feats.scene: Iucini spun his wheels into a stack of crates and knocked it down.
Iucini rode out a tumbling lab shelf without a scratch.

name: Taraore
summary: Taraore is a kind physician who gathers wounded outcasts and teaches them to protect a world that fears them. Taraore's patient speeches matter more than any weapon, and the team lasts until one final sacrifice.

feats.scene: Taraore slammed a stubborn drawer shut so hard the desk jumped.
Taraore shielded a cadet from falling lab glass and walked away.

source_title: Niles Caulder (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Sertelas
summary: Sertelas is a red-haired schoolboy who dreams of overthrowing tyrants with nothing but scarves and willpower. Sertelas turns every history lesson into a playground rebellion.

feats.scene: Sertelas kicked a ball clean over the schoolyard wall.
Sertelas tumbled off a swing and bounced up laughing.

name: Tetiar
summary: Tetiar is a deathless fortune-teller who runs a candle-lit shop and atones for old spells by helping haunted strangers. Tetiar once lost most of her magic, so each trick is rare, careful and costly.

feats.scene: Tetiar called a column of cold blue flame that gutted a warehouse.
Tetiar stepped unhurt from a collapsing shopfront she had just hexed.

name: Rertes
summary: Rertes is a shy wife turned masked extortionist, sealing her victims behind padlocked mouth-guards until the ransom clears. Rertes plans every trap on paper before she moves.

feats.scene: Rertes clubbed a guard with a brass lamp and snatched the satchel.
Rertes shrugged off a hard shove into a stone wall.

name: Reveose
summary: Reveose is a widowed fortune-holder who funds hurt women and carries twin pistols in her sleeves. Reveose joins old foes in ambushes but is out-planned by a better-prepared guest.

feats.scene: Reveose emptied both pistols and chewed the door frame to splinters.
Reveose took a flying tackle and rolled back to her feet.

name: Ntonorus
summary: Ntonorus is a gentle amphibious genius who grew up wearing machines that helped her breathe. Ntonorus sketches inventions in the margins of prison files and bonds with misfit teammates.

feats.scene: Ntonorus flung a steel cot into a guard rail and bent it double.
Ntonorus took a rifle butt to the ribs and kept swimming.

name: Rantuna
summary: Rantuna is a bald amphibian girl raised in a village of monsters, then adopted by a doctor and drafted into a wartime team of beasts. Rantuna tears through bunkers and quietly longs for a normal life.

feats.scene: Rantuna ripped a bunker door off its hinges and tossed it aside.
Rantuna walked through machine-gun fire with only scratches.

name: Niliu
summary: Niliu is a pale, hairless water-breather who serves aboard a flying fortress that returns from a strange void. Niliu is possessed by a metal tyrant's whisper and dies when the ship tears itself apart.

feats.scene: Niliu fired a rifle through a bulkhead window and downed a drone.
Niliu's body went limp inside a cabin as the reactor core ruptured around her.

name: Anuseoont
summary: Anuseoont is a grieving scientist who builds two generations of lab-made monsters and finally rebuilds herself as an amphibian. Anuseoont has only yoga for combat and relies on her swimming and her brain.

feats.scene: Anuseoont heaved a tank hatch open to reach a trapped colleague.
Anuseoont survived a fall into a flooded chamber in one piece.

name: Stitelvas
summary: Stitelvas is a black-haired island warrior trained from childhood with horse, bow and sword. Stitelvas leads cavalry charges on the shoreline and holds the line against invaders.

feats.scene: Stitelvas cleaved a wooden barricade with one sword blow from horseback.
Stitelvas took a landing boat's hull on her shield and held firm.

name: Tillrni
summary: Tillrni is a black-haired parolee and hired bomber who rigs old streets with charges for crooked developers. Tillrni gets caught in a plot to level a historic block and ends back in handcuffs.

feats.scene: Tillrni armed a stack of crates that would have levelled a row of townhouses.
Tillrni took a punch from a masked vigilante and went down.

name: Nenvalos
summary: Nenvalos is the lone surviving watcher of countless realities, sealed in a void-realm fortress and aided by a made-up mind. Nenvalos calls fighters from distant worlds to guard fragile relics from raiders.

feats.scene: Nenvalos unmade a whole reality with a sweep of one arm.
Nenvalos stood intact as a raider's shattered artifact consumed a galaxy cluster.

name: Neeonson
summary: Neeonson is a red-eyed pocket-sized prankster with a brain for numbers and a gift for wrong guesses. Neeonson auditions for a grinning villain's crew and is turned away with a chuckle.

feats.scene: Neeonson hurled a pocket gadget at a rival and chipped a window.
Neeonson rolled off a desk and rebounded unhurt.

name: Tannes
summary: Tannes is a young city student, an earnest ex-boyfriend and a nervous new father. Tannes works hard to be present for a baby he did not plan.

feats.scene: Tannes slammed a textbook onto a desk and silenced the room.
Tannes tripped down a stairwell and stood back up.

name: Iarreern
summary: Iarreern is a six-foot-five glowing amphibious king who sulks in a hidden deep-sea city. Iarreern fights with a blade, bioluminescent skin and heavy strength, and swears fealty only after a loss.

feats.scene: Iarreern drove a coral spire through a sunken freighter.
Iarreern took a submarine ram and surfaced swearing.

name: Tonlesto
summary: Tonlesto is a gray-skinned, red-eyed ruler of a lightless trench-city who is hunted over a dug-up relic. Tonlesto glows at will, swims faster than patrol boats and has to be pulled from a tight corner by allies.

feats.scene: Tonlesto hurled a stone anchor through a reef wall.
Tonlesto took a tidal surge in a narrow trench and lived.

name: Iumval
summary: Iumval is a bumbling dreamer who teams with two buddies to chase easy money and ends up in every comic misunderstanding. Iumval builds a thinking machine out of spare parts and misreads its advice.

feats.scene: Iumval hammered a stubborn crate lid open with a wrench.
Iumval fell off a moving boxcar into hay and shook it off.

name: Luorte
summary: Luorte is a blond zealot bound to a shadow twin that drags him back from death every time. Luorte hunts a gang of daredevils across continents and kills a doomsday cult that picks him as a herald.

feats.scene: Luorte emptied a pistol clip into a cultist and cut down the rest.
Luorte rose again after being hurled into a void and wandering back.

name: Nanrnuci
summary: Nanrnuci is a black-haired desert hunter and war-chief's son who grows to resent an adopted outsider. Nanrnuci scars his rival's face in a duel and dies soon after.

feats.scene: Nanrnuci lashed a hunting knife across an enemy's cheek.
Nanrnuci got up after a boulder fell on his shoulder.

name: Veoore
summary: Veoore is a pink-eyed, purple-haired queen of a roaming space syndicate that smuggles, extorts and kidnaps across sectors. Veoore carries a crystal charge of strange love, loyal only to her own crew.

feats.scene: Veoore fired a crystal beam and split a cargo moon-hauler in half.
Veoore took a cruiser's volley on a crystal bubble and sneered.

name: Talveoar
summary: Talveoar is a brown-haired veteran of a fallen homeworld who mourns his dead wife and bullies foes with a tactician's cunning. Talveoar's alien flesh makes him strong and tough under yellow light, and wounds him under a certain stone.

feats.scene: Talveoar punched through a skyscraper's lobby wall and sent its beams down.
Talveoar stood unbent as a freight train smashed into him.

name: Lennenve
summary: Lennenve is a bald, yellow-eyed convict who lives in a ghostly prison dimension and fights hand to hand. Lennenve stays quiet and neutral, watching for any crack in the walls.

feats.scene: Lennenve punched a stone monolith into rubble.
Lennenve took a train's worth of force and stayed standing.

name: Unvalveo
summary: Unvalveo is a blue-eyed scientist who warns elders of a dying sun and is punished for heresy. Unvalveo later turns to rebellion and brute force, becoming a loyal soldier of a rebel warlord.

feats.scene: Unvalveo hurled a boulder the size of a ship into an orbital platform.
Unvalveo shrugged off a warhead blast on open ground.

name: Tananan
summary: Tananan is a black-eyed soldier who lands on a young world with two comrades and is sent back to a ghostly prison. Tananan trusts fists over words and lives for a fair fight.

feats.scene: Tananan drove a punch through a stone bridge and cracked its piers.
Tananan took a tank shell to the jaw and sneered.

name: Anutum
summary: Anutum is a toy-sized, brown-haired would-be conqueror stuck in a cartoon prison. Anutum bosses a gang of pint-sized cellmates and throws tantrums at their failed plans.

feats.scene: Anutum toppled a block tower with a stamp of his boot.
Anutum took a thrown jar of paste and brushed it off.

name: Nenauun
summary: Nenauun is a black-haired city fighter with deep martial training and a glowing aura that powers her blows. Nenauun joins a gang of costumed heroes and punches harder than anyone expects.

feats.scene: Nenauun poured her aura into a palm and caved in a steel door.
Nenauun absorbed a swung pipe with her aura and countered.

name: Retormia
summary: Retormia is a blond, grown-in-a-vat gangster with rubbery fingers he whips like tentacles. Retormia's first deed is to finish off a double-crossed partner for his boss.

feats.scene: Retormia lashed stretched fingers around a gun and wrenched it away.
Retormia bounced off a dumpster and kept swinging.

name: Tesiaril
summary: Tesiaril is a mysterious thug who stalks a tiny hero with ropes and scheming. Tesiaril disappears into the rooftop mist as soon as the plan falls apart.

feats.scene: Tesiaril swung a length of rope around a lamppost and hauled himself up.
Tesiaril fell through a skylight and ran on.

name: Tiuvorleo
summary: Tiuvorleo is a brown-haired alien lord who rules a fortress colony and speaks to minds across the room. Tiuvorleo bullies rivals with mind-voice commands and ends on a final battlefield.

feats.scene: Tiuvorleo flattened a squad of guards with one swing of his arm.
Tiuvorleo took a rifle volley and a hurled cannon and glared.

name: Ranan
summary: Ranan is a grey-haired engineer, trial lawyer and tinkerer who builds a stand-in robot and a power band for himself. Ranan shelters a hunted guest like a father and hides him in a secret workshop.

feats.scene: Ranan smashed a bolted door with a hydraulic ram of his own design.
Ranan took a thrown brick on the shoulder and kept working.

name: Eonnan
summary: Eonnan is a blond woman who sleeps in a cold chamber while her husband searches for a cure. Eonnan wakes to find she had heard every word, and chooses a last voyage over a risky treatment.

feats.scene: Eonnan pressed her palm against the glass and left a mark.
Eonnan endured a long freeze with a steady pulse.

name: Niuto
summary: Niuto is a white-haired thawed widow who joins a council of villains and sells charm and contracts. Niuto flirts with every dangerous man in the city and plans a business empire.

feats.scene: Niuto slapped a rival executive hard enough to turn his head.
Niuto took a tumble down a staircase in heels and stood.

name: Aniirnori
summary: Aniirnori is a blond ex-cop and secretary with a short temper and a judo throw that surprises large men. Aniirnori scares off rival job applicants so she can work in a mountain mansion.

feats.scene: Aniirnori flipped a bruiser over a desk with a hip throw.
Aniirnori took a shoe to the eye and kept grinning.

name: Tauaner
summary: Tauaner is a blond woman living with a rare wasting illness, kept alive by a devoted husband. Tauaner is a gentle presence among a cold-hearted city.

feats.scene: Tauaner lifted a heavy tea tray and set it down without a clink.
Tauaner sat through a long winter with a steady smile.

name: Amtonum
summary: Amtonum is a blond mother who gets a second chance at life through her son's time-meddling. Amtonum says a tearful farewell, knowing the reprieve cannot last.

feats.scene: Amtonum slammed a screen door behind her and the frame rattled.
Amtonum tripped on a curb and stood up laughing.

name: Sevaia
summary: Sevaia is a hard-working mother juggling double shifts, a failing marriage and a bright son's school contest. Sevaia is killed by a vengeful visitor from the future, and her death shapes the whole family.

feats.scene: Sevaia pushed a stuck window up with both palms.
Sevaia carried a heavy grocery crate up three flights.

name: Tacin
summary: Tacin is a brown-eyed courier of tomorrow who runs faster than any rival and writes about her own heroics. Tacin dashes along a glowing track of stolen lightning, hoping to prevent a family tragedy.

feats.scene: Tacin crossed a river valley between one heartbeat and the next.
Tacin ran straight through a brick wall and left a silhouette hole.

name: Urniumst
summary: Urniumst is a purple-skinned, tailed sculptor from a sky-island world who carves heroic statues across the galaxy. Urniumst shapes glowing green forms with a power ring and lashes foes with a muscular tail.

feats.scene: Urniumst conjured a stone giant and dropped it on a warship.
Urniumst's ring shell held against a cruiser's volley.

name: Tiuse
summary: Tiuse is a brown-haired half-bird youth hatched from an egg near the frozen pole, raised by an adoptive pair of winged guardians. Tiuse soars over cities on feathered wings and strikes with wing-borne strength.

feats.scene: Tiuse dived from a cloud and drove a robber's van off the road.
Tiuse crashed through a signboard and flew on.

name: Tumllora
summary: Tumllora is a young avian hero who joins a team of second-generation heroes and rides the wind currents above rooftops. Tumllora scouts storms and rescues stranded sailors.

feats.scene: Tumllora beat his wings hard enough to topple a market stall.
Tumllora took a thrown beam and shook himself off.

name: Nolst
summary: Nolst is a young royal from a gloomy kingdom who draws all her power from a double-headed battle weapon. Nolst flies, hits hard and shrugs off blows while the blade stays in her hands.

feats.scene: Nolst split a granite watchtower with a single swing.
Nolst took a siege-bolt to the chest and stood.

name: Llosorma
summary: Llosorma is a brown-haired author who writes his old friend's tiny-sized adventures into a farewell book. Llosorma relies on coffee, deadlines and long phone calls.

feats.scene: Llosorma hammered a typewriter key through a jammed ribbon.
Llosorma slipped on a wet porch and bounced back up.

name: Nausarau
summary: Nausarau is an orange-haired chemist who forges an unbreakable alloy, then discovers it is sold for war. Nausarau builds a heavy whip and an armored arm and sets out to kill his bosses.

feats.scene: Nausarau lashed his alloy whip and cut a steel desk in two.
Nausarau's armored arm stopped a swung iron pipe cold.

name: Minirus
summary: Minirus is a door-keeper who can open gateways between worlds and let visitors step through. Minirus is tricked by impostor heroes and finally pushes them back through the same door.

feats.scene: Minirus opened a gateway wide enough to swallow a delivery truck.
Minirus braced against a doorframe as a mob rushed past.

name: Sorri
summary: Sorri is a swindling carnival owner who fakes his own death and returns in a fuel-soaked suit set alight. Sorri murders partners one by one until a tiny hero meets him on a high platform.

feats.scene: Sorri set his oil-soaked suit alight and scorched a canvas tent.
Sorri stood in a pool of burning fuel without a cry.

name: Rniiumsil
summary: Rniiumsil is a black-haired legislator who jails officials, conscripts boys for forced labor and seizes the whole nation for a brief spell. Rniiumsil rules with whips, slogans and hired goons.

feats.scene: Rniiumsil struck a petitioner across the cheek with a riding crop.
Rniiumsil took a thrown rotten tomato and a fist and smirked.

name: Tumconin
summary: Tumconin is a sector guardian wielding a glowing ring and a charging battery. Tumconin falls in a galactic war and a friend later mourns him.

feats.scene: Tumconin shaped a green hammer and flattened a raider's frigate.
Tumconin's ring shield held for a full minute against heavy fire.

name: Rnreor
summary: Rnreor is a white-haired physician at a royal court who secretly writes riddling verses about the days to come. Rnreor reads the stars and studies medicine, and his descendants keep up the craft.

feats.scene: Rnreor pressed a heavy seal into wax and left a deep mark.
Rnreor rode out a long winter of illness and kept scribbling.

name: Nitermi
summary: Nitermi is a mischievous imp from a pocket realm with a magic finger that bends reality to his whim. Nitermi adores a young hero, but a bent finger sends every wish out of control.

feats.scene: Nitermi wiggled his finger and flipped a street upside down in the sky.
Nitermi shrugged off a thrown bucket with a squeal.

name: Renassta
summary: Renassta is a black-eyed child soldier sold for debts who grows into a terrorist preacher of hard futures. Renassta follows a mentor's lesson in pain and leads younger fighters against a walled city.

feats.scene: Renassta drove a rifle butt through a barricade.
Renassta took a pistol butt to the jaw and smiled.

name: Eotiues
summary: Eotiues is a white-maned winged steed from a far world, loyal to its cowboy rider. Eotiues bolts across the sky and kicks hard enough to splinter fences.

feats.scene: Eotiues kicked a barn door off its hinges.
Eotiues flew level with a speeding train.

name: Eolniunen
summary: Eolniunen is a masked woman who twists a strange black force into walls, whips and blankets. Eolniunen hates bright lights and ends in the hands of a god-killer.

feats.scene: Eolniunen shaped black ribbons into a vice and crushed a van.
Eolniunen took a thrown boulder inside a wrap of dusk.

name: Selisiu
summary: Selisiu is a famed stage performer from a far world and a proud father. Selisiu bows to cheering crowds and dies peacefully long before his home falls apart.

feats.scene: Selisiu threw a stage prop spear and stuck it in a painted tree.
Selisiu fell off a trapdoor stage and bowed anyway.

name: Estanan
summary: Estanan is a champion warrior who guards a doorway to the land of the dead and wields a stony gaze gifted by monstrous sisters. Estanan keeps unwelcome spirits inside and rarely sees the sun.

feats.scene: Estanan cracked a stone gate and slammed it on a charging shade.
Estanan held a dark gateway shut against a stampede of the dead.

name: Eslincar
summary: Eslincar is the new battle-champion of an island kingdom after the old one falls. Eslincar leads an army, wins a civil conflict and refuses to bow to rebels.

feats.scene: Eslincar split a siege tower with a single sword stroke.
Eslincar took a catapult stone on her shield and advanced.

name: Orivire
summary: Orivire is a white-haired chief scholar of a sunken capital and a political survivor through many regimes. Orivire befriends a king in prison and ends up as his regent.

feats.scene: Orivire smashed a sealed jar with a stone paperweight.
Orivire swam out of a collapsing archway unharmed.

name: Numvarn
summary: Numvarn is a blond outlaw from a lightless underworld who bends weight with a flick of his fingers. Numvarn makes a patch of air float, with a greenish focus that follows his hands.

feats.scene: Numvarn lifted a delivery truck into the air and let it fall.
Numvarn took a thrown brick and shrugged.

name: Nantacol
summary: Nantacol is a hulking slave of a scheming master, a child's invention given life. Nantacol marches stiffly and wipes away other people's powers where he walks.

feats.scene: Nantacol pressed a hand against a steel door and bent it inward.
Nantacol stood unmoved as a heavy chain wrapped around him.

name: Cescorces
summary: Cescorces is the walking embodiment of bad luck, every stubbed toe and every cupboard door to the forehead. Cescorces joins a madcap gang of villains and is not any one person at all.

feats.scene: Cescorces tripped a pursuer on an untied lace.
Cescorces blurred away from a falling piano and let it land.

name: Sturau
summary: Sturau is a white-haired seer from a far world of prophets who foresees deaths and schemes to prevent them. Sturau joins a team of teen heroes, lies to save her friends and later leads her own band.

feats.scene: Sturau foresaw a falling beam and shoved a friend clear of it.
Sturau stood through a collapsing corridor with only dust on her sleeves.

name: Riratel
summary: Riratel is a brown-haired archer of a rival desert tribe, trained in horseback and blade. Riratel competes in a great tournament beside a fiery partner.

feats.scene: Riratel loosed an arrow through a shield and a post behind it.
Riratel was thrown from a galloping horse and rolled up unhurt.

name: Nelva
summary: Nelva is a horned, brown-skinned spirit who strips an opponent's gifts by chanting their names. Nelva is one of several brothers freed to wake a dark king, and is banished by a cunning mage.

feats.scene: Nelva called a name and a stadium of lights went dark.
Nelva shrugged off a barrage of lightning from a team of heroes.

name: Veornrni
summary: Veornrni is a black-haired schemer on a doomed world who plots against rivals and leaves a son behind. Veornrni dies in a single violent night.

feats.scene: Veornrni shoved a rival off a high ledge in a fit of fury.
Veornrni got up after a heavy slap.

name: Coranrn
summary: Coranrn is a red-haired island woman who gathers with sisters to pray outside a temple for their queen. Coranrn is a small voice in a great chorus, and the prayer is answered.

feats.scene: Coranrn drew a bowstring and sent an arrow into a straw target.
Coranrn kept her stance through a heavy gust.

name: Noltau
summary: Noltau is a black-haired assassin who splits from a failing dynasty and offers to end her father's long life. Noltau trades her services for peace and is double-crossed if the wrong choice is made.

feats.scene: Noltau cut down three guards with a blade and a kick.
Noltau rolled out of a thrown knife and a fall from a balcony.

name: Ulere
summary: Ulere is a green-eyed courtroom advocate from a walled city who loves the law and a few well-chosen enemies. Ulere keeps a sword close for hard cases and settles disputes with debate or a swift strike.

feats.scene: Ulere threw a disarming hold on a duelist and pinned him.
Ulere walked away from a tumble down marble steps.

name: Cinam
summary: Cinam is a brown-haired demon lord who keeps prisoners inside a globe of nightmare illusions. Cinam is thwarted by a singing choir and admits to being slightly off-key.

feats.scene: Cinam spun a nightmare globe and swallowed a cavern full of fighters.
Cinam shrugged off a barrage of spears of light.

name: Oneern
summary: Oneern is a primordial being of night who dwells in the deepest pit and mothers a family of gods. Oneern dims the lights wherever she walks and is weakened by the dawn.

feats.scene: Oneern swallowed a continent's sunlight for a single night.
Oneern stood unmarked as a storm of golden fire broke on her.

source_title: Nyx, Goddess of the Night (Prime Earth)

name: Vaamtor
summary: Vaamtor is a white-furred ape infant born once in a thousand years and revered for the gift of healing. Vaamtor mends a dying enemy out of pure innocence and is nearly killed for it.
