feats.scene: Vaamtor clutched a banana and squeezed it flat.
Vaamtor tumbled from a cradle and gurgled with delight.

name: Telersia
summary: Telersia is a balding, white-haired trickster from a folded realm and an older, stronger cousin to a famous prankster. Telersia bends the rules of the world for a laugh.

feats.scene: Telersia rolled a cosmos up like a rug and laughed.
Telersia stood unscathed as a star's heart burst beside him.

name: Conill
summary: Conill is a white-haired, sharp-tongued manager of a daredevil escape artist. Conill suffers through reckless stunts and is kidnapped by a stern matron of an orphanage.

feats.scene: Conill threw a clipboard at a heckler and hit the mark.
Conill fell off a folding chair and kept grumbling.

name: Llusau
summary: Llusau is a red-eyed, genderless child of an ancient titan, freed from a cold belly to serve a returned tyrant. Llusau walks through memories and feeds them back until minds burst.

feats.scene: Llusau looped a single memory through a city until its streets emptied.
Llusau stood unharmed as a divine spear shattered against its chest.

name: Tumlitel
summary: Tumlitel is a shapeshifting double formed from a hero's anger, fear and envy, convinced he is the original. Tumlitel warps a desert town with false faces and stretched buildings.

feats.scene: Tumlitel stretched a whole street into a corkscrew of glass.
Tumlitel soaked up a burst of green light and giggled.

name: Tumloni
summary: Tumloni is a blue-eyed storm of living rage that wears the shape of a childhood nightmare. Tumloni sweeps across star systems and trounces a famed team before being locked back inside his maker.

feats.scene: Tumloni swept a ring of worlds out of orbit with a lazy sweep.
Tumloni's frame held as a squad of heroes unleashed everything at once.

name: Tumtusi
summary: Tumtusi is a black-haired spy who can turn his body into a living statue of dark volcanic glass. Tumtusi changes sides when a new ruler arrives and keeps his loyalties flexible.

feats.scene: Tumtusi swung a glassy fist and smashed a brick pillar.
Tumtusi took a dropped girder on his stone back and rose.

name: Esieont
summary: Esieont is a white-haired conquering queen who rides a giant tentacled beast and scorns her own son. Esieont is overwhelmed by three fighters who mock her cold parenting.

feats.scene: Esieont urged her beast to sink a battle fleet in a single sweep.
Esieont took a wave of trident blasts and sneered.

name: Osareoul
summary: Osareoul is a red-eyed, blue-haired spirit of rivers, love and beauty who first steps into the world to calm a dark conflict. Osareoul can steer floods and never truly ages.

feats.scene: Osareoul called a river out of its banks to drown a whole valley.
Osareoul stood unmoved as a shadowy twin struck her with a flash of ink.

name: Tautor
summary: Tautor is a bald, eight-limbed schemer in a cheap suit who runs petty shakedowns. Tautor grabs wallets with long arms and flees before the whistles blow.

feats.scene: Tautor shoved a shopkeeper into a barrel and snatched the till.
Tautor tumbled down an alley stair and ran on.

name: Orntico
summary: Orntico is a gang boss who sets up a rolling carnival of crime and recruits crooks to man the booths. Orntico is caught on his first outing by a sorcerous hero.

feats.scene: Orntico tipped a ticket booth onto a rival's feet.
Orntico tumbled off a carousel horse and swore.

name: Amoluone
summary: Amoluone is a tide-bound brute that drags a barnacled blade longer than a rowboat through the shallows. Fishermen swear it surfaces only when the water turns cold, and no sailor finds its lair twice.

feats.scene: Amoluone swings its barnacled blade through a trawler's mast and splits the hull in a single arc.
Amoluone shrugs off a ship's keel grinding across its shell during a storm.

name: Iuriaium
summary: Iuriaium is a one-eyed throne-holder who bargains with the dead and punishes defiance with gifts that feel like chains. His halls hold a hundred vows, and he remembers every broken one.

feats.scene: Iuriaium brings his spear down on a frozen plateau and the shock levels a forest of pines for miles.
Iuriaium stands unharmed inside a collapsing hall of ice as the whole roof falls around him.

name: Elvaco
summary: Elvaco is a grey-bearded war chief who gave up an eye for a drink of forbidden insight, and now presides over a feasting hall of fallen warriors. His thrown spear never misses and his temper calls down crackling bolts.

feats.scene: Elvaco hurls a bolt from his open palm that reduces a hilltop fortress to glass.
Elvaco walks out of a toppled stone keep with his cloak barely dusted.

name: Sannensti
summary: Sannensti is a wandering monarch who returns from every death wearing a new face. Pilgrim, hermit, or sailor, he walks among mortals and hands out gifts of unbreakable life.

feats.scene: Sannensti sends a pulse of sorcery through a harbor town and lifts every vessel out of the water at once.
Sannensti rises whole again after a mountainside collapses on top of him.

name: Iallont
summary: Iallont is a ruthless meat-packing magnate who buys sheriffs, hires dynamiters, and holds a hostage to force a showdown on a bridge. A bolt from the sky ruins his plan at the last moment.

feats.scene: Iallont wires charges beneath a row of shopfronts and the blasts bring down a whole street of facades.
Iallont staggers away upright after a stormbolt lands squarely on his shoulders.

name: Aucercol
summary: Aucercol is a blue-haired time thief freed from captivity on the promise of a second chance. A borrowed ring lets her skip through the sky while she hunts for the one score that clears her name.

feats.scene: Aucercol rams a stolen cargo skiff into a vault door and bursts it off its hinges.
Aucercol tumbles through a wall of sheet metal and lands with only a bruise.

name: Iullu
summary: Iullu is a patient herbalist from an island of warrior women who grows rare blooms on windswept cliffs. She talks to giant sharks as easily as to her neighbors.

feats.scene: Iullu heaves a barrel of loam across the garden terrace without breaking stride.
Iullu rides out a storm wave that smashes the terrace wall right beside her.

name: Rasele
summary: Rasele is a city patrolman who swears loyalty to a blood-soaked congregation after dark. He is never seen outside his uniform by day.

feats.scene: Rasele clubs a fleeing suspect against the door of a parked car.
Rasele takes a van's bumper to the ribs and keeps on moving.

name: Ntnau
summary: Ntnau is a cloven-hoofed exile, once a gifted young deity, who nurses a grudge across the centuries. Ambition curdled him, and every road he takes bends toward a reckoning with a boy he has never met.

feats.scene: Ntnau stamps a hoof and a crack splits a mountain road from end to end.
Ntnau stands in the heart of a collapsing temple dome without a scratch.

name: Stitilern
summary: Stitilern is a plainspoken town lawman who rides hard, shoots straight, and gathers unlikely allies when a smooth-talking outsider arrives with impossible gadgets. He is happiest in the saddle.

feats.scene: Stitilern fires a revolver and knocks a lantern off its post at forty paces.
Stitilern is thrown from a bolting horse and rolls to his feet unhurt.

name: Silsa
summary: Silsa is a thief in stolen power armor that soaks up stray current and hurls it back as crackling arcs. The suit leaves its wearer reckless and overconfident.

feats.scene: Silsa discharges stored current into a substation and the whole district goes dark.
Silsa drinks in a live cable's full surge and strolls on, glowing.

name: Olusulo
summary: Olusulo is a pale-haired stranded soldier whose chest gem feeds him strength, flight, and a staff of hard light. He misses a home torn apart by two feuding factions.

feats.scene: Olusulo drives his light staff into a bridge pier and the whole span drops into the river.
Olusulo crashes through a frozen lake and rises without a mark.

name: Valeli
summary: Valeli is a masked ring performer who tag-teams with a lupine partner in staged bouts that are secretly real. He loses badly to better-prepared opponents.

feats.scene: Valeli drops a forearm on an opponent's chest and the whole ring shakes.
Valeli lands flat on the mat from the top rope and gets back up.

name: Anuisia
summary: Anuisia is a bald, orange-skinned guardian who trained a successor and then came out of retirement to hunt rival rings seeking recruits. A ring forged from willpower is his only weapon.

feats.scene: Anuisia wraps a glowing cage around a tumbling asteroid and crushes it to powder.
Anuisia holds his ground as a rival's blast carves a crater around him.

name: Loane
summary: Loane is a pale villain turned enforcer who infiltrates prison worlds, brawls with hardened inmates, and serves a distant tyrant. Leaden metal makes him collapse.

feats.scene: Loane hurls a guard through a cell wall.
Loane takes a collapsing gantry across his back and rises.

name: Tiarontan
summary: Tiarontan is a fair-haired fighter pilot who flies a twin-engine escort in a war that spans the skies. He dies in a final dogfight.

feats.scene: Tiarontan rakes a transport with cannon fire and its wing folds.
Tiarontan survives a hard landing that tears off his landing gear.

name: Rumlli
summary: Rumlli is a lantern-jawed tumbler who traded the big top for a cockpit. A stretchy suit from an inventor made him a springy troublemaker, and later he taught skiing in the mountains.

feats.scene: Rumlli bounces off a rooftop and drives both boots into a gunman's chest.
Rumlli walks away from a belly landing in a battered jet.

name: Animiun
summary: Animiun is a blond airman from a small northern kingdom who wins duels in the sky. Quick hands and cockpit instincts are his only gifts.

feats.scene: Animiun strafes a supply convoy and sets three trucks ablaze.
Animiun limps a flak-torn fighter home and climbs out unscathed.

name: Nteorese
summary: Nteorese is a pouch-carrying plant-folk guardian who is reborn into a fresh seedling whenever her body fails. Enemies mistake her slow gait for weakness.

feats.scene: Nteorese pulls a glowing lance from her ring and pins a raider's frigate to a cliff.
Nteorese regrows her whole body after a barrage reduces her to ash.

name: Sortianti
summary: Sortianti is a bald street brawler who cheats at every chance and washes out of a savage island tourney early.

feats.scene: Sortianti flings a fistful of sand and lands a low kick.
Sortianti takes a roundhouse to the jaw and stays on his feet for a moment.

name: Eoislan
summary: Eoislan is a red-haired sky-skimmer from a sun-drinking people who soak up radiation and turn it to lift. Cold nights leave her sluggish.

feats.scene: Eoislan dives through a stone arch and the shockwave topples the whole gate.
Eoislan plows into a cliff face at full speed and shakes off the dust.

name: Riateser
summary: Riateser is an exiled horse queen who leads a band of riders and a doomed romance with a bald schemer. Her plots keep failing at the last scene.

feats.scene: Riateser leads a charge that scatters a line of guards.
Riateser is thrown from her mount into a hay cart and laughs it off.

name: Liamte
summary: Liamte is a cheerful bus-tour narrator who points out landmarks to gawking visitors and wonders about his distant ancestors. His route often passes a famous clubhouse.

feats.scene: Liamte slams his bus door shut on a heckler's sleeve.
Liamte rides out a bumpy collision with a lamp post.

name: Rninnu
summary: Rninnu is a small ball-player with strength far beyond her years who must learn restraint. Her teammates feel outmatched.

feats.scene: Rninnu hits a fastball so hard it clears the park and the nearby roofs.
Rninnu hauls a boy out of deep mud without losing her grip.

name: Tontu
summary: Tontu is a ruthless archer-dictator who rules a shattered world with an iron grip and weeps over a dying spouse. He will kill to save her.

feats.scene: Tontu looses a shaft that pins a guard's helmet to a wall.
Tontu takes a speeding truck's glancing blow and keeps shouting orders.

name: Urnta
summary: Urnta is a wealthy archer-vigilante who survived a shipwreck and turned jungle skills into a crusade. Gadget-tipped shafts are his signature.

feats.scene: Urnta fires an explosive shaft into a loading crane and drops it across a smuggler's pier.
Urnta rolls clear of a burning warehouse with only singed sleeves.

name: Ntoniu
summary: Ntoniu is an engaged billionaire who fights crime with a fast bow and a faster mouth.

feats.scene: Ntoniu looses a net-tipped shaft that drags a speeding sedan to a halt.
Ntoniu hits a brick wall after a rooftop leap and stands up.

name: Stnto
summary: Stnto is a mass-produced android in a city of obedient machines who serves an unseen master in a little squad. Strange malice lurks beneath its polite face.

feats.scene: Stnto crushes a steel pipe in its grip and bends it into a loop.
Stnto keeps marching after a delivery truck clips its frame.

name: Llena
summary: Llena is a bald veteran archer who joins a secret undercover force to expose a plot, and falls to a heavy bombing run.

feats.scene: Llena fires a shaft through a guard tower's lamp and plunges the yard into darkness.
Llena survives a grenade barrage by diving behind a concrete barrier.

name: Inoneser
summary: Inoneser is a news reporter in a world drifting left, who wins a prize for his writing despite a bumbling reputation. His paper folds in the end.

feats.scene: Inoneser slaps a rolled-up newspaper down on a desk to make a point.
Inoneser takes a fall down the newsroom steps and gets back up with his notebook.

name: Naora
summary: Naora is a one-armed sniper-saboteur who sank a warship in protest and grips arrows with his teeth and a mechanical limb. He helps topple a corrupt regime.

feats.scene: Naora lodges charges along a submarine's hull and sinks the whole vessel.
Naora survives a rooftop collapse with a cracked prosthetic.

name: Milara
summary: Milara is a blond partner who teaches two young heroes about legacy while chasing a mastermind of crime.

feats.scene: Milara pins a fleeing crook's coat to a fence with a single shaft.
Milara shields a child with his own back as glass rains down.

name: Stierval
summary: Stierval is a quiet mourner at a hero's farewell who sets his bow aside for a day.

feats.scene: Stierval lays a single flower on the casket with a steady hand.
Stierval stands through a long rain without moving.

name: Tistco
summary: Tistco is a scholar of ancient relics who takes up a bow after a fire destroys his collection and becomes a veteran masked hunter of criminals.

feats.scene: Tistco launches a rope-line shaft and swings across a rooftop gap to drop on a burglar.
Tistco takes a bad fall into an alley and hauls himself upright.

name: Latean
summary: Latean is a blond archer who sent a last-ditch signal as his headquarters collapsed on him, then returned from supposed death at the head of a hidden army.

feats.scene: Latean fires a pulse-tipped shaft that blacks out a giant watching machine.
Latean lives through tons of crushed concrete and steel on top of him.

name: Reseorus
summary: Reseorus is a shy student left on a remote island after a crash. He learns to bring down game with a bow and carries his hurt father to safety.

feats.scene: Reseorus draws a crude bow and drops a boar at thirty paces.
Reseorus hauls his injured father across a ravine on his back.

name: Osaoneti
summary: Osaoneti is an insurgent archer who cushions a fallen enemy with padded shafts and survives a blast that should have ended him.

feats.scene: Osaoneti fires a cushioned shaft that slows a falling brute to a gentle stop.
Osaoneti is thrown across a plaza by a ring blast and rises coughing.

name: Illorava
summary: Illorava is a castaway turned heroic marksman who stays proud of having no cosmic gifts. He judges the moment and fires.

feats.scene: Illorava loosens a shaft that pops a bandit's rifle from his hands.
Illorava crashes through a rotten dock and climbs back out soaked.

name: Neluni
summary: Neluni is a lead singer in a four-man rock group signed to a villain's label, and the band falls apart over artistic differences.

feats.scene: Neluni smashes his guitar on stage in a final burst of anger.
Neluni dives into a crowd and is carried to the back unharmed.

name: Llrorn
summary: Llrorn is a hunted champion who fought invaders and was murdered by the very people he protected.

feats.scene: Llrorn sends a shaft through a patrol drone's lens.
Llrorn endures a full mob's blows before the crowd finally overpowers him.

name: Corvalia
summary: Corvalia is a white-haired quitter who argues with everyone at a holiday gathering and is paired up with a former flame.

feats.scene: Corvalia fires a gag shaft that pops a streamer cannon across the party hall.
Corvalia endures a long evening of insults and spilled punch without leaving.

source_title: Oliver Queen (The Birds of Christmas Past, Present and Future)

name: Tuiansti
summary: Tuiansti is a wheelchair-bound archer turned conspiracy preacher after a disastrous fight with a rogue android.

feats.scene: Tuiansti fires from his chair and spears a poster off a wall.
Tuiansti survives being crushed under a toppled girder.

name: Onellu
summary: Onellu is a cold property mogul who hunts people on private islands for sport, driven by an itch to prove himself again.

feats.scene: Onellu levels a hunting rifle and drops a stag from a ridge.
Onellu endures a brutal night of exposure on a bare rock.

name: Lineru
summary: Lineru is a serpentine ring-bearer who fights an anti-matter schemer beside a comic mercenary.

feats.scene: Lineru casts a glowing wall that stops a rogue vortex's pull on a harbor.
Lineru takes a blast to the chest and keeps his fangs bared.

name: Sernumcor
summary: Sernumcor is a schoolgirl who finds a star-shaped charm that grants flight and light beams. She charges an overwhelming foe head-on.

feats.scene: Sernumcor fires a bright beam that melts a rooftop observatory's dome.
Sernumcor takes a ramming blow that shatters her charm.

name: Lorluan
summary: Lorluan is a child with a big heart whose soul was bartered before birth. She punches an intruder through a house wall.

feats.scene: Lorluan punches a kidnapper straight through a brick wall.
Lorluan is flung into a stack of crates and is only dusty.

name: Stoallanu
summary: Stoallanu is a night-news reporter who flips against a corrupt candidate after seeing forged papers, and hands the evidence to retired lawmen.

feats.scene: Stoallanu slams a folder onto the anchor desk in front of the cameras.
Stoallanu stands firm against a bullying campaign manager's shoves.

name: Erntumler
summary: Erntumler is a stern school director and secret member of a cabal of nocturnal aristocrats who bullies, deceives, and commands.

feats.scene: Erntumler raps her cane on a lectern and the hall falls silent.
Erntumler stands calmly while a student shoves her against the blackboard.

name: Seuntiu
summary: Seuntiu is a toy-company saleswoman who hides an enormous mind that flares when she is cornered. She forgets the episode afterward.

feats.scene: Seuntiu lets her hidden mind flare and a giant's whole courtroom shudders into silence.
Seuntiu stands unmoved as her captors' weapons burn out against her.

name: Sernaute
summary: Sernaute is a professional thief who inherited a mobile getaway trade from a late parent. A suit crammed with projectors lets her vanish into any crowd and borrow any face.

feats.scene: Sernaute cracks a safe door with a pry bar and a shoulder.
Sernaute tumbles down a fire escape and bounces up uninjured.

name: Minuti
summary: Minuti is a golden-eyed hairless ruler of the sky and the first of a divine family born to a mother goddess. He once fashioned a burning orb to light the mortal lands and stills quarrels with a gesture.

feats.scene: Minuti kindles a blazing orb in his palms and hangs it above a sleeping world.
Minuti stands unscathed in a storm of two clashing champions' blows.

name: Nieol
summary: Nieol is a purple-skinned native of a far-off world who inherited mind-reading gifts from her mother. She helps a rescuer when a conquering machine-mind subjugates her people.

feats.scene: Nieol turns a guard's mind to fog and lets a prisoner walk past.
Nieol keeps her mind steady against a hypnotic lure meant to break her.

name: Monlin
summary: Monlin is a dark-haired mirror-world warrior who runs a drug lab for a gang of enforcers. She carries a short blade and a spear and loses a hand-to-hand fight to her counterpart.

feats.scene: Monlin hurls her spear through a warehouse wall and brings down the loading dock.
Monlin shrugs off a tank shell that rips apart the lab around her.

source_title: Olympiad (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Teanst
summary: Teanst is a government agent who draws her might from a legendary woolly relic. She can fly, grow to giant size, and trade blows with a mad deity.

feats.scene: Teanst swells to giant size and drives a fist into a rampaging deity's jaw, cracking a hillside.
Teanst is pressed against a wall by a god's whole weight and gets up.

name: Eolar
summary: Eolar is a genderless police machine built to patrol a coastal city, with guns in its arms. A glitch turns it on its handlers until a trickster ends it.

feats.scene: Eolar fires both arm cannons and shreds a patrol car's engine block.
Eolar keeps walking after a barrage that peels back its chest plate.

name: Ortiaern
summary: Ortiaern is a pink-haired armored fighter who migrates between worlds to guard a streaming idol. Berserker programming from an arena master turns the armor against friends.

feats.scene: Ortiaern rips an arena gate off its hinges and hurls it across the sand.
Ortiaern endures a pounding from an overwhelmed champion without a dent.

name: Ntelu
summary: Ntelu is an older brother in a space-police force who pulls on metal with his mind. He treats his younger sibling with condescension.

feats.scene: Ntelu drags a steel shutter shut across a corridor with a flick of his wrist.
Ntelu staggers back from a collapsing console and stands again.

name: Nutison
summary: Nutison is a monster born from the hatred of every living thing, who marches from deep space to wish the whole universe out of existence. Only being declared a ruler can slow it.

feats.scene: Nutison lets out a wave of pure malice that scours a whole star system down to its bones.
Nutison wades through a barrage of a hundred champions' blasts and never slows.

name: Aulsusti
summary: Aulsusti is a purple-skinned alien wrestler who beams into arenas and clears the area of civilians before each bout. A single blow once flung him out of time itself.

feats.scene: Aulsusti drives a flying elbow into a rival and the ring crumples into the stadium floor.
Aulsusti is clipped by a starship at speed and bounces up grinning.

name: Luninntu
summary: Luninntu is a gold-skinned observer of unimaginable power who watches lives end without lifting a hand. He grows and shrinks at will, and a lone survivor's escape stirs his curiosity.

feats.scene: Luninntu opens his hand and a whole ringed planet goes dark.
Luninntu lets a swarm of warships break across his chest and does not notice.

name: Ntiseo
summary: Ntiseo is a brown-haired villain who calls himself a doctor and quarrels with a lone hero. Few know his methods, and fewer know his goals.

feats.scene: Ntiseo swings a heavy lab stool at a rival's knees.
Ntiseo stumbles from a smoke-filled lab with only a cough.

name: Nenauna
summary: Nenauna is a teen mutant who leads a small squad of classmates and later sides with their jailers. His eyes fire energy beams, and he regrets the choice he makes.

feats.scene: Nenauna fires a red beam that slices a guard tower in half.
Nenauna tumbles through a cell wall and stands up shaken.

name: Cinstu
summary: Cinstu is a hooded killer who hunts masked heroes without powers and mimics every noise he hears. He speaks plainly only once, over a victim.

feats.scene: Cinstu fires a pistol in the hallway and the echo mimics a second shot.
Cinstu shakes off a rooftop fall and slips away in the dark.

name: Lortarn
summary: Lortarn is a minor villain from a dark circle whose methods and gifts are mostly unknown. He appears in a dream-themed episode of a long-running animated serial.

feats.scene: Lortarn flicks a switch and a trap door falls open.
Lortarn tumbles down a stairwell and brushes off the dust.

name: Stoole
summary: Stoole is a red-haired rebel from a mind-controlled world who develops an antidote in secret. She befriends a ring-bearer on a visit and returns to rally a doomed uprising.

feats.scene: Stoole smashes a control panel with a wrench to free her cell block.
Stoole resists a mind-bending ray that drops everyone around her.

name: Tuilcar
summary: Tuilcar is a bald assassin trained in swordplay and silent movement, who ambushes a veteran killer before being cut down. She defects from one cult to another.

feats.scene: Tuilcar slashes her sword across a gate rope and drops the portcullis.
Tuilcar takes a rival's sword on her bracer and stays upright.

name: Cortiust
summary: Cortiust is a white-haired monster in a plastic-brick tale who joins a band of villains against a lightning-wielding champion.

feats.scene: Cortiust stomps a toy fortress flat with a single heel.
Cortiust is knocked through a plastic mountain and gets back up.

name: Riatil
summary: Riatil is a grey-haired brute in a cartoon adventure who joins a pack of villains and wades in with raw strength.

feats.scene: Riatil swings a boulder at a rooftop billboard and flattens it.
Riatil is thrown through a billboard and shakes off the splinters.

name: Ronleva
summary: Ronleva is an artificial helper that runs surveillance for a night-time crime-fighting family. It has no body and is wiped when a scheming hacker takes it over.

feats.scene: Ronleva flips a thousand traffic lights green in a single pulse.
Ronleva keeps running through a power surge that fries the room.

name: Rntinti
summary: Rntinti is an ancient seer who hid a dream relic in a pocket world to keep it from invaders. Her magic reaches across time and across realities.

feats.scene: Rntinti seals a spire's door with a word and the stone hums.
Rntinti stands in a burning temple and the flames part around her.

name: Eoriumli
summary: Eoriumli is a temple priestess blessed with foresight and a voice for the fates. Several women have held the post over the ages, and the true seer lies far below.

feats.scene: Eoriumli sets a crystal sphere on its stand and the cavern lights up.
Eoriumli stays kneeling as an earthquake cracks the altar beside her.

name: Cisecar
summary: Cisecar is a warrior of an island of women who rides, shoots, and fights with blade and bow. She falls in the first battle of a long war.

feats.scene: Cisecar looses an arrow while riding at full gallop and cleaves a shield.
Cisecar takes a rifle round on her bracer and stays in the saddle.

name: Iarauar
summary: Iarauar is a middle-aged weapons engineer who works freelance for petty villains with her husband and treats a young boss like a son. She dies instantly when a stone goes critical.

feats.scene: Iarauar rigs a bundle of charges and brings a loading bay crashing down.
Iarauar rides out a wall of shrapnel behind a steel table.

name: Ananeor
summary: Ananeor is a blond orator who speaks from the shadows of a secret council on a sunlit island. Little is known of his gifts or his schemes.

feats.scene: Ananeor pounds a podium and the chamber falls silent.
Ananeor takes a shove from a rival and does not blink.

name: Ceaulmi
summary: Ceaulmi is a bitter sea emperor who never learned kindness and wages a bloody war against a warrior queen. He sinks half a continent beneath the waves.

feats.scene: Ceaulmi calls the ocean up and a whole coastline slides under the waves.
Ceaulmi stands unmoved in the shell of his flooded throne room.

name: Eonsaria
summary: Eonsaria is a game-world swimmer who hails from a lost undersea realm. He speaks with fish and dolphins and fights with sword and wits.

feats.scene: Eonsaria wrenches a trawl net from a boat's winch and splinters the rail.
Eonsaria dives from a high cliff and surfaces laughing.

name: Tiseo
summary: Tiseo is a lighthouse keeper's son who studies marine life and frees dolphins from a research lab. A sea-born mother gave him gifts he finds late.

feats.scene: Tiseo snaps a padlock chain on a tank gate and tips the pen over.
Tiseo survives a long dive in cold, dark water.

name: Reoaurn
summary: Reoaurn is a red-eyed son of a tyrant raised in a bright city of gods who fights as a hound of war. A glowing cube at his side warns him when his temper surges.

feats.scene: Reoaurn leaps from the clouds and his strike cracks a whole mesa.
Reoaurn walks out of a collapsing sky-tower and his armor is barely scratched.

name: Letilll
summary: Letilll is a red-haired son of a conqueror, traded as a baby for peace, who rises to lead as a patriarch among gods. His birth is kept secret and his rage runs deep.

feats.scene: Letilll charges a horde of winged raiders and the shockwave flattens a forest.
Letilll is hit by a doomsday warhead's flash and is flung but whole.

name: Rautiuveo
summary: Rautiuveo is a strawberry-blond warrior of a divine people, raised as a foster child among peaceful gods. He grapples with a fierce lineage and loves a rebel's daughter.

feats.scene: Rautiuveo hurls a war-hammer from a cliff and a peak slides into the sea.
Rautiuveo takes a falling battlement across his shoulders and steps free.

name: Ianninum
summary: Ianninum is a vengeful killer with a satellite-shard dagger that cancels the gifts of others. The blade lets him fly, throw bolts, and shrug off lightning.

feats.scene: Ianninum slams his dagger into the ground and a blast cracks the street.
Ianninum takes a full lightning strike to the chest and laughs.

name: Liuasi
summary: Liuasi is a scheming half-brother with a three-pronged staff who tries to push a king into war. Sea ancestry gives him a double life.

feats.scene: Liuasi drives his staff into a pier and the dock splits.
Liuasi is struck by a freighter's bow and shakes it off.

name: Orleia
summary: Orleia is a deposed sea king who went to war with the surface after inheriting a crown, only to be unseated by a half-brother. A sceptre calls storms, and his armor and heavy limbs make him a brute in close combat.

feats.scene: Orleia lifts his sceptre and a storm bolt blasts a seawall into rubble.
Orleia takes a ship's cannonade on his armor and keeps advancing.

name: Veosatau
summary: Veosatau is a bitter half-brother who covets a throne and builds a private fleet to plunder a harbor project. He hypnotizes his sibling to serve as muscle.

feats.scene: Veosatau rams a fleet vessel into a pier and the planks fly.
Veosatau takes a hard collision at the helm and holds the wheel.

name: Nesiurn
summary: Nesiurn is a pure-blooded warlord who rules a drowned city and threatens a coast with a crown that can flood it. He is engaged to a surface woman.

feats.scene: Nesiurn raises his crown and a wall of water crashes into the seawall.
Nesiurn is thrown through a harbor gate and rises wet and furious.

name: Tauvalni
summary: Tauvalni is a professional criminal and half-sibling of a hero, who lives between swamp and shore and swims like a fish.

feats.scene: Tauvalni pries open a trawler's hatch with a crowbar.
Tauvalni is dragged by a speedboat and surfaces coughing.

name: Lessia
summary: Lessia is a bald child-prodigy soaked in raw power in the womb and kept by a warlord as his prized asset. He defects and follows his protector's memory.

feats.scene: Lessia unleashes a wave from his cradle and a wall of black stone collapses.
Lessia is struck by a champion's blast and the cradle holds.
